a.en: I got an A in French.
Julia got straight A’s (=all A’s) in high school.
a.zh: 朱莉娅读中学时成绩全部是A

abandon.en: How could she abandon her own child?
abandon.zh: 她怎么能抛弃自己的孩子呢？

abandon.en: We had to abandon the car and walk the rest of the way.
abandon.zh: 我们只好弃车，步行走完剩下的路。

abbreviation.en: W.H.O. is short for ‘World Health Organization’.

abide.en: I can’t abide that man – he’s so self-satisfied.
abide.zh: 我受不了那个人，他太自满了。

abide.en: You have to abide by the referee’s decision.
abide.zh: 你必须服从裁判的决定。

ability.en: The health center serves all patients, regardless of their ability to pay.
ability.zh: 医疗中心为所有病人服务，不管他们的支付能力如何。

ability.en: The test measures your mathematical ability.
ability.zh: 这种测试考查的是数学能力。

able.en: I’ve always wanted to be able to speak Japanese.
I’d like to do more gardening, but I never seem able to find the time.
able.zh: 我想多干点园艺活，可似乎总是抽不出时间。

abnormal.en: My parents thought it was abnormal for a boy to be interested in ballet.
abnormal.zh: 我父母认为一个男孩子对芭蕾舞感兴趣并不正常。

aboard.en: They finally went aboard the plane.
The plane crashed, killing all 200 people aboard.

abolish.en: Slavery was abolished in the US in the 19th century.

abort.en: The rescue mission had to be aborted.
The disease causes pregnant animals to abort.
abort.zh: 这种疾病会导致怀孕的动物流产。

abortion.en: She decided to have an abortion.

abound.en: Rumours abound as to the reasons for his resignation.
abound.zh: 有关他辞职的原因有各种各样的谣传。

abound.en: Examples of this abound in her book.
abound.zh: 这样的例子在她书中比比皆是。

about.en: She said something about leaving town.
about.zh: 她说了些要离开镇子的话。

above.en: Our office is above the hairdresser’s.
above.zh: 我们的办公室在理发店上面。

above.en: He had a bruise just above his left eye.
above.zh: 就在他左眼上方有块瘀伤。

abrasion.en: She was treated for cuts and abrasions.
abrasion.zh: 她因划伤和擦伤而接受治疗。

abreast.en: It’s important to keep abreast of the latest developments in computers.
abreast.zh: 了解计算机的最新发展很重要。

abreast.en: The planes were flying four abreast.
abreast.zh: 飞机分成四架一排飞行。

abroad.zh: 我以前从未在国外生活过。

abroad.en: She often goes abroad on business.

abrogate.en: Both governments voted to abrogate the treaty.
abrogate.zh: 两国政府均投票通过废除这项条约。

abrupt.en: The bus came to an abrupt halt.
abrupt.zh: 公共汽车突然停了下来。

abrupt.en: Sorry, I didn’t mean to be so abrupt.
abrupt.zh: 对不起，我不是故意这样无礼的。

absence.en: Ms Leighton will be in charge during my absence (=while I am away).
absence.zh: 我不在时，由莱顿女士负责。

absence.en: Her work involved repeated absences from home.
absence.zh: 她的工作使她经常不在家。

absent.en: He's away at the moment. He’s gone to Hawaii.
absent.zh: 他现在不在，他到夏威夷去了。

absent.en: I called in to see her but she wasn't there.

absent-minded.en: Grandad’s been getting rather absent-minded lately.
absent-minded.zh: 爷爷最近变得越发健忘了。

absolute.en: I have absolute confidence in her.
We don’t know with absolute certainty that the project will succeed.
absolute.zh: 我们没有绝对的把握这个项目一定会成功。

absolutely.en: He made his reasons for resigning absolutely clear.
absolutely.zh: 他把辞职的理由讲得一清二楚。

absorb.en: Plants absorb nutrients from the soil.
absorb.zh: 植物从土壤中吸收养分。

absorb.en: Water and salts are absorbed into our bloodstream.
absorb.zh: 水分和盐被吸收进我们的血液中。

absorption.en: I don’t understand James’ absorption with military history.
absorption.zh: 我不明白詹姆斯为何对军事史那么着迷。

abstract.en: By the age of seven, children are capable of thinking in abstract terms.
abstract.zh: 儿童到了七岁就具有抽象思维的能力。

abstract.en: Human beings are the only creatures capable of abstract thought (=thinking about ideas).
abstract.zh: 人类是唯一具有抽象思维能力的动物。

abstraction.en: She rocked the baby gently, gazing in abstraction at the flickering fire.
abstraction.zh: 她轻轻地摇晃着宝宝，出神地望着摇曳的火光。

absurd.en: It seems quite absurd to expect anyone to drive for 3 hours just for a 20-minute meeting.

absurd.zh: 这似乎是个荒唐的想法。

abundance.en: One quality the team possessed in abundance was fighting spirit.
abundance.zh: 该队的一大特点是斗志昂扬。

abundantly.en: She’d made her feelings towards him abundantly clear.
abundantly.zh: 她非常清楚地表明了对他的感情。

abundantly.en: Melons grow abundantly in this region.

abuse.en: Many children suffer racial abuse at school.
abuse.zh: 许多孩子在学校遭受种族虐待。

abuse.en: An independent committee will look into alleged human rights abuses.
abuse.zh: 一个独立委员会将对涉嫌践踏人权的行为进行调查。

abusive.en: Smith denies using abusive language to the referee.
He became abusive and his wife was injured in the struggle.
abusive.zh: 他动了粗，妻子在扭打中受伤。

acceleration.en: The latest model has excellent acceleration.
acceleration.zh: 这款最新型号加速性能优异。

accent.en: He had a strong Irish accent.
accent.zh: 他有浓重的爱尔兰口音。

accent.en: In the word ‘dinner’ the accent is on the first syllable.

accept.en: Rick accepted her offer of coffee.
accept.zh: 她请里克喝咖啡，他接受了。

accept.en: He accepted the invitation to stay with us.
accept.zh: 他接受了邀请来我们家住。

acceptable.en: Students who achieve an acceptable standard will progress to degree studies.
acceptable.zh: 达到一定程度的学生可以进一步攻读学位。

acceptable.en: How do we reach an acceptable level of data security?
acceptable.zh: 我们如何使数据安全达到令人满意的程度？

acceptance.en: He wrote a letter of acceptance (=a letter in which you agree to accept a job, university place etc) to the university.
acceptance.zh: 他给那所大学写了一封接受函。

acceptance.en: There is still not widespread acceptance that fathers can care for children as well as mothers do.
acceptance.zh: 父亲和母亲一样能照顾好孩子的观点尚未得到普遍接受。

access.en: Access to the papers is restricted to senior management.
access.zh: 只有高级管理层才有权查阅这些文件。

access.en: Cats should always have access to fresh, clean water.
access.zh: 应该让猫总能喝到新鲜、干净的水。

accessible.en: The island is only accessible by boat.
accessible.zh: 这个岛只有坐船才能到。

accessible.en: There is a church which is easily accessible from my home.

accident.en: I met her quite by accident (=completely by accident).
The discovery was made almost by accident.
accident.zh: 这项发现几乎纯属意外。

accidental.en: Buy an insurance policy that covers accidental damage.
accidental.zh: 购买一份意外损害保单。

accidental.en: I accidentally locked myself out of the house.
accidental.zh: 我不小心把自己锁在了门外。

acclaim.en: His work was acclaimed by art critics.
acclaim.zh: 他的作品得到艺术评论家的推崇。

acclaim.en: The young singer is enjoying critical acclaim (=praise by people who are paid to give their opinion on art, music etc).
acclaim.zh: 那位年轻歌手得到评论家的赞赏。

accommodate.en: He bought a huge house to accommodate his library.
accommodate.zh: 他买了一座大房子来放他的藏书。

accommodation.en: The price for the holiday includes flights and accommodation.
accommodation.zh: 度假的价格包括机票和住宿。

accommodation.en: Universities have to provide student accommodation for first-year students.
accommodation.zh: 大学必须为一年级生提供学生宿舍。

accompaniment.en: He plays folk music with guitar accompaniment.
accompaniment.zh: 他在吉他伴奏下演唱民乐。

accompaniment.en: A group of children danced around to the accompaniment of drums and piano.
accompaniment.zh: 一群孩子在鼓和钢琴的伴奏下跳舞。

accompany.en: Children under 14 must be accompanied by an adult.
Wherever her husband went, she would accompany him.
accompany.zh: 不论丈夫去哪里，她都陪伴左右。

accomplish.en: We have accomplished all we set out to do.
accomplish.zh: 所有计划要做的事情，我们都已完成。

accomplish.en: Mission accomplished (=we have done what we intended to do).

accomplishment.en: Cutting the budget was an impressive accomplishment.
accomplishment.zh: 削减预算是一项了不起的成就。

accomplishment.en: It was a major accomplishment for a player who had been injured so recently.
accomplishment.zh: 对于一个刚受过伤的选手来说，这是很好的成绩。

accord.en: He decided to go of his own accord.
The door seemed to move of its own accord.

accordance.en: Article 47 may only be used in accordance with international law.
Use this product only in accordance with the manufacturer’s instructions.
accordance.zh: 必须依照厂商说明书使用本产品。

accordingly.en: Katherine still considered him a child and treated him accordingly.
accordingly.zh: 凯瑟琳仍旧把他当作小孩子，像对待小孩子一样对他。

accordingly.en: Some of the laws were contradictory. Accordingly, measures were taken to clarify them.
accordingly.zh: 有些法律相互矛盾，因此，采取了措施将其阐明。

account.en: He was too shocked to give an account of what had happened.
account.zh: 他因受惊过度而无法描述所发生的事情。

account.en: Chomsky’s account of how children learn their first language
account.zh: 乔姆斯基关于儿童如何学习第一语言的描述

accountable.en: The government should be accountable to all the people of the country.
accountable.zh: 政府应当对全体国民负责。

accountable.en: Managers must be accountable for their decisions.
accountable.zh: 管理人员必须对自己作出的决定负责。

accrue.en: Interest will accrue until payment is made.
accrue.zh: 利息将会累计增加，直至付清款项。

accumulate.en: It is unjust that a privileged few should continue to accumulate wealth.
accumulate.zh: 少数特权阶级继续积聚财富，这是不公平的。

accumulate.en: Fat tends to accumulate around the hips and thighs.
accumulate.zh: 脂肪常常积聚在臀部和大腿部位。

accuracy.en: He passes the ball with unerring accuracy.

accurate.en: The brochure tries to give a fair and accurate description of each hotel.
accurate.zh: 该手册尽量公正、准确地介绍每一家酒店。

accurate.en: Police believe Derek gave a reasonably accurate account of what happened.
accurate.zh: 警方相信德里克对事情的叙述是比较准确的。

accusation.en: A number of serious accusations have been made against her.
accusation.zh: 她受到了多项严重指控。

accusation.en: The main accusation levelled against him was that he tried to avoid military service.
accusation.zh: 对他提出的主要指控是他想逃避兵役。

accustom.en: It took a while for me to accustom myself to all the new rules and regulations.
accustom.zh: 我过了一段时间才适应所有的新规章制度。

accustomed.en: We were accustomed to working together.
Her eyes quickly became accustomed to the dark.
accustomed.zh: 她的眼睛很快就适应了黑暗。

ace.en: I’ve got a pair of aces.
The Americans hold most of the aces in this technology.
ace.zh: 在这一技术领域美国人占绝对优势。

ache.en: His feet were aching from standing so long.
ache.zh: 他站了那么久，双脚隐隐作痛。

achieve.en: She eventually achieved her goal of becoming a professor.
achieve.zh: 她终于实现目标，当上了教授。

achieve.en: Wilson has achieved considerable success as an artist.
achieve.zh: 威尔逊作为一名艺术家成就斐然。

achievement.en: We try to celebrate the achievements of our students.
achievement.zh: 我们想要庆祝学生取得的成就。

achievement.en: His great achievement is to make all the players into a united team.
achievement.zh: 他的伟大成就在于把所有选手组织成一支团结的队伍。

acid.en: I was expecting another of his acid remarks, but he remained silent.
acid.zh: 我等着他再说一句刻薄的话，但他不吭声了。

acid.en: People ask if the team is good enough. This match will be the acid test.
acid.zh: 人们问这支球队是不是够好，经过这场比赛的考验就可见分晓。

acidic.en: Some fruit juices taste a bit acidic.

acknowledge.en: The family acknowledge the need for change.
acknowledge.zh: 全家人都承认需要改变一下。

acknowledge.en: He acknowledges that when he’s tired he gets bad-tempered.
acknowledge.zh: 他承认自己累了就会发脾气。

acknowledgement.en: We want an acknowledgement of the existence of the problem.
acknowledgement.zh: 我们希望这问题的存在能够得到承认。

acknowledgement.en: The reduction in their grant is an acknowledgement that they have been paid too much.
acknowledgement.zh: 减少对他们的拨款就是承认他们拿得太多了。

acquaint.en: I need to acquaint myself with the new regulations.
acquaint.zh: 我得熟悉一下新的规章制度。

acquaint.en: You need to acquaint the police with the facts.
acquaint.zh: 你得把事实真相告诉警方。

acquaintance.en: She was a casual acquaintance of my family in Vienna.
acquaintance.zh: 她是我们家在维也纳的一个交情不深的朋友。

acquaintance.en: He heard about the job through a mutual acquaintance (=someone you and another person both know).
acquaintance.zh: 他是通过一个双方都认识的人知道有这份工作的。

acquainted.en: Were you acquainted with a friend of mine, Daniel Green?
acquainted.zh: 你认识我的一个朋友丹尼尔·

acquainted.en: We would like to get better acquainted.
acquainted.zh: 我们希望加深对彼此的了解。

acquire.en: Manning hoped to acquire valuable works of art as cheaply as possible.
acquire.zh: 曼宁希望以尽可能低的价格买到有价值的艺术品。

acquire.en: The college acquired a reputation for very high standards.
acquire.zh: 那所学院以学术水平高而闻名。

acquisition.en: The Art Society is holding an exhibition of recent acquisitions.
acquisition.zh: 艺术协会在为新近购得的艺术品举办展览。

across.en: They ran straight across the road (=without stopping).

act.en: The new president’s first act should be to end the war.
act.zh: 新总统的第一步行动应当是结束战争。

act.en: The act of writing a list can help to calm you down.
act.zh: 列清单可以帮助你冷静下来。

action.en: The government must take action (=do something) now to stop the rise in violent crime.
action.zh: 政府现在必须采取行动遏止暴力犯罪的上升。

action.en: Environmental groups want tougher action on pollution from cars.
action.zh: 环境保护团体希望对汽车污染采取更严厉的措施。

activate.en: Cooking fumes may activate the alarm.
activate.zh: 烹调时的油烟可能会触发警报器。

activate.en: The yeast’s growth is activated by sugar and warmth.
activate.zh: 糖分和温暖的环境会激发酵母菌的生长。

active.en: She’s over 80, but is still very active.
My father always led a very active life.
active.zh: 我父亲一直过着忙忙碌碌的生活。

activity.en: Everyone is free to engage in peaceful political activity.
activity.zh: 每个人都可以自由参加和平的政治活动。

activity.en: Regular physical activity helps to control your weight.
activity.zh: 定期参加体育活动有助于控制体重。

actor.en: She has starred with many leading actors.
actor.zh: 她曾与许多大牌演员一起担任主角。

actual.en: I’m not joking. Those were his actual words.
actual.zh: 我没开玩笑，那都是他的原话。

actual.en: I know Germany won, but I can’t tell you the actual score.
actual.zh: 我知道德国队胜了，但我不知道确切的比分。

actuality.en: In actuality, it’s much more complex than that (=used when talking about what a situation is really like).
actuality.zh: 实际情况比那要复杂得多。

actually.en: I’ve known Barbara for years. Since we were babies, actually.
actually.zh: 我认识芭芭拉很多年了，实际上我们从小就认识。

actually.en: Actually, on second thoughts, I don’t think I want to go out tonight.
actually.zh: 其实再想想，我今晚不打算出去了。

acute.en: The housing shortage is more acute than first thought.
acute.zh: 住房短缺情况比一开始想的要严重。

acute.en: Young children have a particularly acute sense of smell.

adapt.en: The children are finding it hard to adapt to the new school.
adapt.zh: 孩子们觉得很难适应新学校。

adapt.en: The ability to adapt is a definite asset in this job.
adapt.zh: 适应能力是做这份工作的绝对有利条件。

adaptable.en: The American Constitution has proved adaptable in changing political conditions.
adaptable.zh: 事实证明美国宪法能适应政治形势的变化。

adaptable.en: The catfish is adaptable to a wide range of water conditions.
adaptable.zh: 鲶鱼能适应很多种水环境。

adaptation.en: He’s working on a screen adaptation of his latest novel.
adaptation.zh: 他在把自己的最新小说改编成电影。

add.en: If the mixture seems dry, add water.
add.zh: 如果混合物看上去干，加点水。

add.en: Do you want to add your name to the list?
add.zh: 你想把你的名字加到名单里吗？

addict.en: My nephew is a complete video game addict.
addict.zh: 我侄子绝对是个电子游戏迷。

addictive.en: It started as a hobby, but it got so addictive I had to keep on doing it.
addictive.zh: 开始时只是爱好，但它让人如此着迷，我只得继续下去。

addition.en: The company provides cheap Internet access. In addition, it makes shareware freely available.
addition.zh: 该公司提供廉价的因特网接入服务。

addition.en: In addition to his movie work, Redford is known as a champion of environmental causes.
addition.zh: 除了电影事业外，雷德福还是位公认的环保斗士。

additional.en: Additional information can be obtained from the centre.
additional.zh: 可以从中心获取更多信息。

additional.en: An additional charge is made on baggage exceeding the weight allowance.

additionally.en: A new contract is in place. Additionally, staff will be offered a bonus scheme.

additive.en: Our products are free from artificial additives.
additive.zh: 我们的产品不含人工添加剂。

address.en: I can give you the address of a good attorney.
address.zh: 我可以给你一个好律师的地址。

adept.en: Melissa quickly became adept at predicting his moods.
adept.zh: 很快梅莉莎就学会了预测他的情绪。

adept.en: Silas proved adept in the art of avoiding potholes in the road.
adept.zh: 赛拉斯看来很善于避开路上的坑坑洼洼。

adequate.en: Farmers have been slow to make adequate provision for their retirement.
adequate.zh: 农民们迟迟没有为退休做好适当安排。

adequate.en: Some creams we tested failed to give adequate protection against UV light.
adequate.zh: 我们检测的有些防晒霜不能提供足够的防紫外线保护。

adhere.en: The eggs of these fish adhere to plant leaves.
adhere.zh: 这些鱼产下的卵附着在植物叶片上。

adhere.en: We adhere to the principles of equal rights and freedom of expression for all.
adhere.zh: 我们坚持人人平等和言论自由的原则。

adjacent.zh: 我们住在毗连的房间里。

adjoin.en: A vacant plot of land adjoins his house.
adjoin.zh: 有一块空地紧挨着他家。

adjudicate.en: The Dean adjudicates any faculty disputes.
adjudicate.zh: 系主任裁决教师间的纠纷。

adjudicate.en: The owner can appeal to the court to adjudicate on the matter.
adjudicate.zh: 物主可请求法院裁定此事。

adjunct.en: Online instruction is a useful adjunct to the real thing.
adjunct.zh: 线上教学是对真人面对面教学的有用辅助。

adjust.en: They’ll soon settle in – kids are very good at adjusting.
It took a few seconds for her eyes to adjust to the darkness.
adjust.zh: 过了几秒钟她的眼睛才适应了黑暗。

adjustment.en: Once we make the adjustments for inflation, the fall in interest rates is quite small.
adjustment.zh: 如果我们按通货膨胀调整，利率降幅其实很小。

adjustment.en: It just needs a few minor adjustments.
adjustment.zh: 只需要作一些小小的调整。

administer.en: The money will be administered by local charities.
administer.zh: 这笔资金将由当地慈善机构管理。

administer.en: Our office administers the affairs of the Society.
administer.zh: 我们办公室管理协会的事务。

administration.en: We’re looking for someone with experience in administration.
administration.zh: 我们正在寻找一个有管理经验的人。

administration.en: The health service spends too much on administration.
administration.zh: 医疗服务部门在行政方面花费太多。

administrative.zh: 这份工作主要是行政方面的。

admiration.en: Daniel gazed at her in admiration.
admiration.zh: 丹尼尔用爱慕的眼神注视着她。

admiration.en: I wanted to express my admiration for the way the crew handled the crisis.
admiration.zh: 我想对机组人员处理此次危机的方式表达敬佩之情。

admire.en: I really admire the way she brings up those kids all on her own.
admire.zh: 我十分佩服她独力把那些孩子抚养大。

admire.en: Lewis was much admired for his work on medieval literature.
admire.zh: 刘易斯因其对中世纪文学的研究而备受赞誉。

admission.en: The Senator’s admission that he had lied to Congress shocked many Americans.
admission.zh: 参议员承认他对国会说谎，这令许多美国人感到震惊。

admission.en: Silence is often interpreted as an admission of guilt.
admission.zh: 沉默常被解读为承认有罪。

admit.en: You may not like her, but you have to admit that she’s good at her job.
admit.zh: 你也许不喜欢她，但你不得不承认她很能干。

admit.en: Paul admitted to me that he sometimes feels jealous of my friendship with Stanley.
admit.zh: 保罗向我承认，说他有时候妒忌我与斯坦利的友谊。

admittance.en: Gaining admittance to the club was no easy matter.
admittance.zh: 获准进入那家俱乐部并非易事。

admittedly.en: This has led to financial losses, though admittedly on a fairly small scale.
admittedly.zh: 这已造成了经济损失，尽管这个损失其实还比较小。

adopt.en: Sally was adopted when she was four.
The couple are unable to have children of their own, but hope to adopt.
adopt.zh: 那对夫妇自己无法生育，但希望领养孩子。

adoption.en: She decided to put the baby up for adoption.
adoption.zh: 她决定让人收养那个婴儿。

adore.zh: 我简直太喜欢巧克力了。

adrenalin.en: There’s nothing like a good horror film to get the adrenalin going (=make you feel nervously excited).
adrenalin.zh: 好的恐怖片最能让人看得血脉偾张。

adrift.en: Several of the lifeboats were still afloat a month after being cast adrift.
adrift.zh: 放漂一个月后，有几艘救生艇还在漂流。

adrift.en: Her hair was forever coming adrift from the pins she used to keep it in place.
adrift.zh: 她的头发总是从固定头发的发夹中散开来。

adult.en: Some children find it difficult to talk to adults.
adult.zh: 一些孩子觉得与大人很难谈得来。

adult.en: The adults have white bodies and grey backs.
adult.zh: 这些成年动物的身体为白色，背部为灰色。

advance.en: I should warn you in advance that I’m not a very good dancer.
advance.zh: 我要先提醒你，我跳舞不是很好。

advance.en: Many thanks, in advance, for your help.
advance.zh: 对你的帮助预先表示万分感谢。

advanced.en: The disease was too far advanced to be treated.
advanced.zh: 病情已经发展到晚期，没法治疗了。

advanced.en: Despite his advanced age, he often travelled abroad.
advanced.zh: 尽管上了年纪，他还是常常出国旅行。

advantage.en: Her experience meant that she had a big advantage over her opponent.
advantage.zh: 她的经验意味着她比对手有很大优势。

advantage.en: Younger workers tend to be at an advantage (=have an advantage) when applying for jobs.
advantage.zh: 年轻点的工人申请工作时往往处于优势地位。

advantageous.en: He was now in a more advantageous position.

adventure.en: Come on – where’s your sense of adventure?

adventurous.en: Andy isn’t a very adventurous cook.
adventurous.zh: 安迪不是一个敢于大胆创新的厨师。

adverse.en: They fear it could have an adverse effect on global financial markets.
adverse.zh: 他们担心这会对全球金融市场产生不利影响。

adverse.en: Miller’s campaign has received a good deal of adverse publicity.
adverse.zh: 米勒的竞选活动招来许多负面报道。

advertise.en: They no longer advertise alcohol or cigarettes at sporting events.
advertise.zh: 他们不再在体育赛事上做烟酒广告了。

advertise.en: Many companies will only advertise in the Sunday paper.
advertise.zh: 许多公司只会在周日报纸上刊登广告。

advertisement.en: The Sunday papers are full of advertisements for cars.
advertisement.zh: 周日报纸上全是汽车广告。

advertisement.en: She saw an advertisement for a ski vacation in Vermont.
advertisement.zh: 她看到一则去佛蒙特州滑雪度假的广告。

advertising.en: Both candidates are spending millions on television advertising.
advertising.zh: 两位候选人都花费数百万元在电视上做广告。

advice.en: You should have followed my advice.
I need some advice about my computer.
advice.zh: 我需要一点有关我的电脑的意见。

advisable.zh: 定期检查身体是明智的。

advisable.en: It is advisable to write a career objective at the start of your resume.
advisable.zh: 简历开头最好写上职业目标。

advise.en: She needed someone to advise her.
advise.zh: 她需要有个人给她出主意。

advise.en: Evans advised him to leave London.

advisory.en: He was employed in a purely advisory role.
advisory.zh: 他纯粹以顾问身份受聘。

advisory.en: The State Department issues travel advisories about conditions overseas.
advisory.zh: 国务院就海外局势发布旅游警报。

advocate.zh: 极端主义者公开鼓吹使用暴力。

advocate.en: Those who advocate for doctor-assisted suicide say the terminally ill should not have to suffer.
advocate.zh: 主张可以在医生协助下结束生命的人说，晚期病人不应当受罪。

aesthetic.en: From an esthetic point of view, it’s a nice design.
aesthetic.zh: 从美学角度看，这是个不错的设计。

affair.en: Are you interested in world affairs?
affair.zh: 你对世界大事感兴趣吗？

affair.en: Women had little role in public affairs.
affair.zh: 女性过去几乎不参与公共事务。

affect.en: Trading has been adversely affected by the downturn in consumer spending.
affect.zh: 贸易受到消费支出回落的不利影响。

affect.en: We were all deeply affected by her death.
affect.zh: 我们都为她的去世深感悲痛。

affection.en: Bart had a deep affection for the old man.
affection.zh: 巴特对这位老人有很深的感情。

affection.en: She looked back on those days with affection.
affection.zh: 她深情地回顾那些日子。

affectionate.en: Jo is very affectionate towards her.

affiliate.en: The Society is not affiliated with any political party.
affiliate.zh: 该社团不隶属任何政党。

affiliate.en: She affiliated herself with the Impressionist school of painting.
affiliate.zh: 她加入了印象主义画派。

affirm.en: The general affirmed rumors of an attack.
affirm.zh: 将军证实了袭击的传闻。

affirm.en: A spokesman for the company affirmed that a merger was likely.
affirm.zh: 该公司的一位发言人证实合并是可能的。

affix.en: A label must be affixed to all parcels.
affix.zh: 所有的包裹都必须贴上标签。

afford.en: We can’t afford to go on vacation this year.
I couldn’t afford the rent on my own.
afford.zh: 我单靠自己付不起房租。

affront.en: He stepped back, affronted by the question.
affront.zh: 他觉得这个问题语带冒犯，退后了几步。

affront.en: The comments were an affront to his pride.
affront.zh: 那些话伤害了他的自尊。

afield.en: They were exporting as far afield as Alexandria.
afield.zh: 他们出口货物远至亚历山德里亚。

afloat.en: The Treasury borrowed £40 billion, just to stay afloat.
Somehow we kept the ship afloat.
afloat.zh: 我们总算没有让船沉下去。

afraid.en: There’s no need to be afraid.
Zoe was afraid to go back into the house.
afraid.zh: 佐伊有点害怕回到那幢房子里。

after.en: After the war many soldiers stayed in France.
after.zh: 战后，许多士兵留在法国。

after.en: I go swimming every day after work.
after.zh: 我每天下班后都去游泳。

afternoon.en: There’s a meeting on Thursday afternoon.
It was very hot in the afternoon.

afterwards.zh: 过了不多久，查尔斯来了。

afterwards.en: The experience haunted me for years afterwards.
afterwards.zh: 此后多年，这经历一直困扰着我。

again.en: Can you say that again? I didn’t hear.

against.en: Every council member voted against the proposal.
against.zh: 每位市政会委员都对该提案投了反对票。

age.en: Francis is the same age as me.
Experts disagree over the age of the drawings.
age.zh: 专家对这些画作的年代意见不统一。

aged.en: Police are looking for a man aged between 30 and 35.
aged.zh: 警察正在寻找一名年龄介于30

aged.en: The course is open to children aged 12 and over.

agenda.en: Measures to combat terrorism will be high on the agenda.
agenda.zh: 采取行动打击恐怖主义是当务之急。

agenda.en: The government set an agenda for constitutional reform.
agenda.zh: 政府为宪法改革定下了日程。

agent.en: Our agent in Rio deals with all our Brazilian business.
agent.zh: 我们在里约热内卢的业务代表处理我们在巴西的全部业务。

agent.en: We’re acting as agents for Mr Watson.
agent.zh: 我们是沃森先生的代理人。

aggravate.en: Their money problems were further aggravated by a rise in interest rates.
aggravate.zh: 由于利率上调，他们的财务问题更加严重。

aggravate.en: Building the new road will only aggravate the situation.
aggravate.zh: 建造那条新路只会使情况恶化。

aggregate.en: The smaller minorities got an aggregate of 1,327 votes.
aggregate.zh: 较小的少数党总共获得1,327

aggregate.en: In the aggregate (=as a group or in total), women outlive men by 7 or more years.
aggregate.zh: 总体来看，女性比男性多活七年或以上。

aggression.en: Television violence can encourage aggression in children.
aggression.zh: 电视暴力会助长儿童的攻击性行为。

aggression.en: Our dogs have never shown aggression towards other dogs.
aggression.zh: 我们的狗从不向其他狗挑衅。

aggressive.en: Teachers apparently expect a certain amount of aggressive behaviour from boys.
aggressive.zh: 老师显然料到男孩子多少会有些好勇斗狠的行为。

aging.en: Europe’s ageing population (=with more old people than before)
aging.zh: 欧洲渐渐老龄化的人口

aging.en: Memory loss is often a part of ageing.
aging.zh: 记忆力衰退往往是衰老的一种表现。

agitate.en: His family are agitating to get him freed.
agitate.zh: 他的家人在多方游说将他释放。

agitate.en: I must warn you that any mention of Clare agitates your grandmother.
agitate.zh: 我必须提醒你，一提到克莱尔你奶奶就会不安。

agitation.en: She was in a state of considerable agitation.
agitation.zh: 她处于相当焦虑的状态。

ago.en: He should have finished at university long ago, but he kept taking extra courses.
ago.zh: 他大学早就该毕业了，但是他不停地选修额外课程。

agonize.en: All the way home she agonized about what she should do.
agonize.zh: 回家一路上，她都在发愁该怎么办。

agree.en: Teenagers and their parents rarely agree.
agree.zh: 十几岁的孩子跟父母意见很少一致。

agree.en: If she felt he was right, she would agree with him.
agree.zh: 如果她觉得他是对的，就会同意他的看法。

agreeable.en: We spent a most agreeable couple of hours.
agreeable.zh: 我们非常愉快地度过了几个小时。

agreeable.en: My parents are quite agreeable to my studying abroad.
agreeable.zh: 我父母很同意我去国外留学。

agreed.en: The important thing is to have agreed objectives.
agreed.zh: 重要的是要有一致的目标。

agreed.en: All parties are now agreed on the plan.
agreed.zh: 所有党派现在都一致同意这个计划。

agreement.en: They had made an agreement that they would share the profits equally.
agreement.zh: 他们达成协议，平分利润。

agreement.en: Haydon came to an agreement with his creditors.
agreement.zh: 海登与债主达成了一项协议。

agriculture.en: More than 75% of the land is used for agriculture.

ahead.en: He kept his gaze fixed on the car ahead.
ahead.zh: 他的目光一直盯着前面的那辆汽车。

ahead.en: A hill loomed ahead of them.
ahead.zh: 一座小山赫然耸现在他们面前。

aid.en: Foreign aid from many countries poured into the famine area.
aid.zh: 来自许多国家的救援物资纷纷送到饥荒地区。

aid.en: He has been granted legal aid (=free legal services).

ail.en: This initiative is not the answer to what ails our educational system.
ail.zh: 这一新方案并不能解决我们教育体制的弊病。

aim.en: The aim of the research is to find new food sources.
aim.zh: 此项研究的目的是寻找新的食物来源。

aim.en: The main aim of the course is to improve your writing.
aim.zh: 这一课程的主要目的是提高写作能力。

air.en: Let’s go outside and get some fresh air.
air.zh: 我们出去呼吸些新鲜空气吧。

air.en: You need to put some air in the tyres.

airing.en: Put your houseplants outside to give them an airing.
airing.zh: 把室内盆栽植物搬出去透透气。

airport.en: The plane landed at Heathrow Airport.
airport.zh: 飞机降落在希思罗机场。

airport.en: Her family went to see her off at the airport.

airy.en: All the hotel’s bedrooms are light and airy.
airy.zh: 这家酒店的所有客房都明亮通风。

airy.en: He dismissed her concerns with an airy wave of the hand.
airy.zh: 他漫不经心地挥一下手，对她的忧虑不屑一顾。

aisle.en: Would you like a window seat or an aisle seat (=seat next to the aisle)?
aisle.zh: 您想要靠窗的座位还是靠过道的座位？

akin.en: Something akin to panic overwhelmed him.
akin.zh: 一种近似惊恐的感觉使他不知所措。

alarm.en: I forgot to set the burglar alarm.
alarm.zh: 我忘记打开防盗警报器了。

alarm.en: Car alarms are always going off in the street.
alarm.zh: 街上总有汽车警报器在响。

alarming.en: The rainforest is disappearing at an alarming rate.
alarming.zh: 热带雨林在以惊人的速度消失。

alas.zh: 唐纳德去年不幸去世了。

album.en: The band plan to release their new album next week.
album.zh: 该乐队计划下周发行他们的新专辑。

alert.en: The animal raised its head, suddenly alert.
alert.zh: 那只动物突然警觉地抬起头来。

alert.en: Taking notes is one of the best ways to stay alert in lectures.
alert.zh: 记笔记是听课时集中注意力的最佳方法之一。

alien.en: In those days people from other countries rarely came to Japan.
alien.zh: 那个时候，很少有外国人到日本来。

alienate.en: The latest tax proposals will alienate many voters.
alienate.zh: 最新的纳税提案将失去远许多选民的支持。

alienate.en: He felt that his experiences had alienated him from society.
alienate.zh: 他感到自己的经历令他与社会格格不入。

alienation.en: Unemployment may provoke a sense of alienation from society.
alienation.zh: 失业可能会引起不容于社会的感觉。

alight.en: The car was set alight and pushed over a hill.
alight.zh: 那辆汽车被点燃后就被推下山去。

alight.en: The car had been deliberately set on fire.
alight.zh: 这辆车被人蓄意纵火焚烧。

align.en: Church leaders have aligned themselves with the opposition.
align.zh: 教会领袖和反对派站在同一阵线上。

align.en: The desks were neatly aligned in rows.
align.zh: 书桌一行行排得整整齐齐。

alignment.en: The wheels were out of alignment.
alignment.zh: 车轮偏位，不在一条直线上。

alike.en: My mother and I are alike in many ways.
alike.zh: 我和母亲在许多方面很相似。

alive.en: It was a bad accident – they’re lucky to be alive.

alive.zh: 我的祖父母和外祖父母都还健在。

all.en: Have you done all your homework?
He had worked all his life in the mine.
all.zh: 他在矿场工作了一辈子。

allay.en: The president made a statement to allay public anxiety.
allay.zh: 总统发表了一项声明以缓解公众的忧虑。

allegation.en: Mr Singh has strongly denied the allegations of sexual harassment.
allegation.zh: 辛格先生强烈否认性骚扰的指控。

allegation.en: The teacher made serious allegations against a colleague.
allegation.zh: 那位老师对一位同事提出严重指控。

allege.en: It was alleged that the policeman had accepted bribes.
allege.zh: 有人声称这名警察收受贿赂。

allege.en: The prosecution alleged that the man had been responsible for an act of terrorism.
allege.zh: 控方指控那名男子发起了一次恐怖主义行动。

alleged.en: The alleged victim made the complaint at a police station in York.
alleged.zh: 那位自称是受害者的人在约克一家警察局报了案。

allegiance.en: You owe allegiance (=have a duty to give allegiance) to your king.
I pledge allegiance to the flag of the United States of America.
allegiance.zh: 我向美国国旗宣誓效忠。

allergic.en: Most men are allergic to housework!
allergic.zh: 大多数男人都对做家务过敏！

allergy.en: I have an allergy to cats.

alley.en: The alley led to the railway bridge.
She found the side alley where the stage door was located.
alley.zh: 她找到了剧场后门所在的小巷。

alliance.en: Britain’s military alliance with her NATO partners
alliance.zh: 英国与其北约伙伴的军事联盟

alliance.en: The companies have formed an alliance to market the product.
alliance.zh: 各家公司联手将该产品推向市场。

allied.en: Anthropology is closely allied to the field of psychology.
allied.zh: 人类学与心理学领域紧密关联。

allocate.en: You should allocate the same amount of time to each question.
allocate.zh: 你应当给每个问题分配相同的时间。

allocate.en: One million dollars was allocated for disaster relief.

allocation.en: Twelve hours a week seemed a generous allocation of your time.

allot.en: Try and allot two or three hours a day to revision.
allot.zh: 每天设法抽出两三个小时复习。

allot.en: Each school will be allotted twenty seats.

allotment.en: The budget allotment for each county is below what is needed.
allotment.zh: 分配给每个县的预算低于所需。

allow.en: My parents wouldn’t allow me to go to the party.
allow.zh: 父母不许我去参加聚会。

allow.en: Are dictionaries allowed in the exam?

allowance.en: His father gives him a monthly allowance of £200.
Do you get an allowance for clothes?

alloy.en: Brass is an alloy of copper and zinc.

allude.en: Rick didn’t want to discuss his past, though he alluded darkly to ‘some bad things that happened.’
allude.zh: 里克不想谈论自己的过去，不过他曾伤感地暗示“

allusion.en: The committee made no allusion to the former president in its report.
allusion.zh: 委员会在报告中没有影射前总统。

allusion.en: Eliot’s poetry is full of biblical allusions.
allusion.zh: 艾略特的诗作中圣经典故比比皆是。

ally.en: Ridley was one of the Queen’s closest allies.
ally.zh: 里德利是女王最亲密的盟友之一。

ally.en: She knew she had found an ally in Ted.
ally.zh: 她知道泰德已经是她的盟友了。

almond.en: Stir in the ground almonds and egg.
almond.zh: 拌入碾碎的扁桃仁和鸡蛋。

aloft.en: He emerged, holding a baby aloft.
aloft.zh: 他高举着一个小宝宝出现了。

alone.en: You shouldn’t leave a child alone in the house.
alone.zh: 你不应该把小孩独自留在家里。

alone.en: My wife and I like to spend time alone together away from the kids.
alone.zh: 我和妻子喜欢没有孩子打扰，过二人世界。

along.en: I was driving along, thinking about Chris.
along.zh: 我一边开车，一边想着克里斯。

along.en: You’re welcome to come along if you like.
along.zh: 你愿意的话可以一起去。

alongside.zh: 一辆车在旁边停了下来。

alongside.en: Children’s prices are shown alongside adult prices.
alongside.zh: 儿童票价标在成人票价旁边。

aloof.en: They worked hard, but tended to stay aloof from the local inhabitants.
aloof.zh: 他们工作努力，但是一般不和当地居民来往。

aloof.en: She had always kept herself aloof from the boys in class.
aloof.zh: 她对班上的男生一直很冷漠。

aloud.en: Joanne, would you read the poem aloud?
aloud.zh: 乔安妮，你来朗诵这首诗好吗？

aloud.en: The pain made him cry aloud.

alpha.en: Collective bargaining was viewed as the alpha and omega of trade unionism.
alpha.zh: 集体谈判被视为工会主义的全部法宝。

alphabetical.en: The files are arranged in alphabetical order.
alphabetical.zh: 这些文件按字母顺序排列。
这些记录是以字母顺序归档的吗？

already.en: The design of the new house is similar to those that have already been built.
already.zh: 新房的设计与那些已建好的房子相似。

already.en: The performance had already started when we arrived.
already.zh: 我们到达时表演已经开始了。

also.en: Information is also available on women’s health care.
also.zh: 还可以获得有关女性保健方面的资料。

also.en: She sings beautifully and also plays the flute and piano.
also.zh: 她歌唱得好，而且还会吹长笛和弹钢琴。

alter.en: Her face hadn’t altered much over the years.
alter.zh: 过了这么多年，她的容貌并没有多大改变。

alter.en: The city centre has altered beyond recognition (=changed very much).
alter.zh: 市中心变得都认不出来了。

alteration.en: If you make alterations to the Windows setup, save the new settings before closing.
alteration.zh: 如果更改了视窗操作系统的设置，关闭前要保存新的设置。

alteration.en: Have you noticed any alteration in the patient’s behaviour?
alteration.zh: 你有没有注意到病人的行为有什么改变？

alternate.en: The service runs on alternate days.
alternate.zh: 这个服务机构隔天开放一次。

alternate.en: Arrange the leeks and noodles in alternate layers.
alternate.zh: 一层韭葱、一层面条地交替放置。

alternative.en: An alternative route is along the Via Unione.
alternative.zh: 另一条路线是沿着联合路走。

although.en: Although in poor health, she continued to carry out her duties.
although.zh: 尽管身体不好，她仍继续执行任务。

although.en: We decided to take rooms in Longwood House, although we knew we could not really afford the rent.
although.zh: 虽然我们知道自己其实付不起租金，但还是决定住朗伍德庄园的房间。

altitude.en: We’re flying at an altitude of 40,000 feet.
altitude.zh: 我们的飞行高度为四万英尺。

altitude.en: At high altitudes it is difficult to get enough oxygen.
altitude.zh: 在海拔高的地方很难呼吸到足够的氧气。

altogether.en: Congress could ban the procession altogether.
altogether.zh: 国会可以完全禁止这次游行。

altogether.en: In Canada, the situation is altogether different.
altogether.zh: 在加拿大，情况完全不一样。

always.en: Always lock your bicycle to something secure.
always.zh: 每次都要把自行车锁在牢固的物体上。

always.en: She’d always assumed that Gabriel was a girl’s name.
always.zh: 她一直认为加布里埃尔是个女孩名字。

amalgamate.en: The agency is expected to amalgamate with the National Rivers Authority.
amalgamate.zh: 这个机构预计会与国家河流管理局合并。

amalgamate.en: Stir until the ingredients are amalgamated.

amass.en: For 25 years, Darwin amassed evidence to support his theories.
He amassed a fortune after the war.
amass.zh: 战后，他积累了大量财富。

amateur.en: Mickelson won his first major golf tournament while still an amateur.
amateur.zh: 米克尔森还是业余选手时就赢得了他第一个高尔夫球锦标赛大奖。

amateur.en: You English are a bunch of amateurs when it comes to romance.
amateur.zh: 谈情说爱你们英国人就外行了。

amaze.en: Dave amazed his friends by suddenly getting married.
amaze.zh: 戴夫突然结婚，令朋友们非常吃惊。

amaze.en: It still amazes me how much she has improved.
amaze.zh: 她进步很大，至今仍让我惊讶。

amazement.zh: 拉尔夫吃惊得倒抽了一口气。

amazement.en: To everyone’s amazement, the goal was disallowed.
amazement.zh: 令大家吃惊的是，进球被判无效。

amazing.en: He’s an amazing player to watch.
amazing.zh: 看他比赛那才叫精彩呢。

amazing.en: It’s amazing how often you see drivers using mobile phones.
amazing.zh: 常常看到司机在打手机，真让人难以置信。

ambassador.en: He has made some good films and he is a good ambassador for the industry.
ambassador.zh: 他拍摄过一些好电影，是这个行业的杰出代表。

ambience.en: The restaurant’s new owners have created a welcoming ambience.
ambience.zh: 这家餐厅的新主人营造出一种舒适的气氛。

ambiguity.en: There was an element of ambiguity in the president’s reply.
ambiguity.zh: 总统的回答有点模棱两可。

ambiguous.en: The language in the Minister’s statement is highly ambiguous.
ambiguous.zh: 部长的声明措辞很含糊。

ambiguous.en: His role in the affair is ambiguous.
ambiguous.zh: 他在这起事件中的角色并不明确。

ambition.en: She had always had an ambition to be a pilot.
An injury ended his ambitions of becoming a professional footballer.
ambition.zh: 一次受伤使得他当职业足球员的理想落空了。

ambitious.en: Alfred was intensely ambitious, obsessed with the idea of becoming rich.
ambitious.zh: 艾尔弗雷德雄心勃勃，一心想着发财。

ambivalent.en: We are both somewhat ambivalent about having a child.
ambivalent.zh: 我们两人对于生孩子这件事心情都有点矛盾。

ambivalent.en: O'Neill had a genuine ambivalence toward US involvement in the war.
ambivalent.zh: 对于美国参战，奥尼尔内心很矛盾。

ambulance.en: The ambulance crew removed him from the wreckage.
ambulance.zh: 救护车上的人员将他从残骸中移出来。

ambulance.en: Mike had to be taken by ambulance to hospital.
ambulance.zh: 不得不用救护车把迈克送往医院。

ameliorate.en: It is not clear what can be done to ameliorate the situation.
ameliorate.zh: 可以采取什么办法来改善局面并不明确。

amenable.en: She was always a very amenable child.
amenable.zh: 她一向是个很听话的孩子。

amenable.en: Young people are more amenable than older citizens to the idea of immigration.
amenable.zh: 年轻人较年老公民更易接受移民的想法。

amend.en: The law was amended to include women.
amend.zh: 该法律经修改把女性也包括在内。

amend.en: The defendant later amended his evidence.

amends.en: He seized the chance to make amends for his behavior.
amends.zh: 他抓住机会补救他的行为。

amenity.en: The hotel is in the city centre, close to shops and local amenities.
amenity.zh: 该酒店位于市中心，紧邻商店和当地的便利设施。

amiable.en: The driver was an amiable young man.
amiable.zh: 司机是位友善的年轻人。

amiable.en: She was in an amiable mood.

amicable.en: Their relationship hasn’t always been amicable.
amicable.zh: 他们的关系不是一直都很和睦。

amicable.en: The two parties have reached an amicable settlement.

amid.en: The dollar has fallen in value amid rumors of weakness in the US economy.
amid.zh: 在一片美国经济疲软的传言中，美元贬值了。

amid.en: Demonstrators ripped up the national flag amid shouts of ‘Death to the tyrants!’

ammunition.en: His mistakes provided political opponents with even more ammunition.
ammunition.zh: 他的过失授给政敌更多的把柄。

among.en: The girl quickly disappeared among the crowd.
among.zh: 女孩转眼消失在人群中。

among.en: I could hear voices coming from somewhere among the bushes.
among.zh: 我能听到灌木丛中某个地方传来说话的声音。

amount.en: They spend equal amounts of time in California and New York.
amount.zh: 他们在加利福尼亚和纽约待的时间同样长。

amount.en: Please pay the full amount (=of money) by the end of the month.

ample.en: You’ll have ample time for questions later.
ample.zh: 稍后你们会有充裕的时间来提问。

ample.en: There is ample evidence that climate patterns are changing.
ample.zh: 有足够的证据表明气候模式正在改变。

amplify.en: These stories only amplified her fears.
amplify.zh: 这些故事徒增了她的恐惧感。

amplify.en: Would you care to amplify that remark?
amplify.zh: 请你把那句话解释一下好吗？

amputate.en: Two of her toes were amputated because of frostbite.
amputate.zh: 她的两个脚趾因为冻伤被截掉了。

amuse.en: He made funny faces to amuse the children.
amuse.zh: 他做鬼脸逗孩子们开心。

amuse.en: The question seemed to amuse him in some way.
amuse.zh: 这个问题似乎不知怎么把他给逗乐了。

amusement.zh: 她的眼睛里闪烁着笑意。

amusement.en: She looked at him in amusement.

amusing.en: I don’t find his jokes at all amusing.
amusing.zh: 我觉得他的笑话一点都不好笑。

amusing.en: The book is full of amusing stories about his childhood.
amusing.zh: 这本书里全是一些他童年的趣事。

analogous.en: The report’s findings are analogous with our own.
analogous.zh: 这篇报告的发现与我们的类似。

analogy.en: She drew an analogy between childbirth and the creative process.
analogy.zh: 她将分娩和创造过程进行类比。

analogy.en: Dr Wood explained the movement of light by analogy with (=using the analogy of) the movement of water.
analogy.zh: 伍德博士用水的运动作类比，解释光的运动。

analyse.en: She still needs to analyse the data.
analyse.zh: 她仍需要分析这些数据。

analyse.en: You need to sit down and analyse why you feel so upset.
analyse.zh: 你得坐下来想一想自己为什么会那么生气。

analysis.en: Further analysis of the data is needed.
analysis.zh: 这些数据需要做进一步分析。

analysis.en: They were doing some type of statistical analysis.
analysis.zh: 他们正在进行某种统计分析。

analyst.en: Political analysts expect the Conservatives to win.
analyst.zh: 政治分析家预计保守党获胜。

analyst.en: Cleary has been working as a computer analyst in Winchester.
analyst.zh: 克利里在温彻斯特当计算机分析员。

analytical.en: During the course, students will develop their analytical skills.
analytical.zh: 在这门课上，学生的分析能力将得到提高。

anathema.en: His political views were anathema to me.
anathema.zh: 我对他的政治观点全然反感。

anatomy.en: Knowledge of human anatomy is essential to figure drawing.
anatomy.zh: 人体解剖学知识对于人体素描是极其重要的。

anatomy.en: You could see a part of his anatomy that I’d rather not mention.
anatomy.zh: 你都能看到他的某个身体部位，是什么部位我就不想说了。

ancestor.en: Lions and house cats evolved from a common ancestor (=the same ancestor).
ancestor.zh: 狮子和家猫从共同的原种进化而来。

ancestry.en: Her mother is of German ancestry (=has German ancestors).
Helen’s family can trace their ancestry back to the 1700s.
ancestry.zh: 海伦家的世系可追溯至18

anchor.en: We dropped anchor a few yards offshore.
anchor.zh: 我们在离岸几码远的地方抛锚停航。

ancient.en: That photo makes me look ancient!
It’s all ancient history and I’m not upset anymore.
ancient.zh: 这都是陈年往事了，我不再生气了。

and.en: He’s gone to get some fish and chips.
The film starred Jack Lemmon and Shirley Maclaine.

anecdotal.en: His findings are based on anecdotal evidence rather than serious research.
anecdotal.zh: 他的发现依据的是传闻轶事，而不是认真的调查研究。

anecdote.en: The book is full of amusing anecdotes about his life in Japan.
anecdote.zh: 这本书里全是他在日本生活的趣闻轶事。

anew.en: I was ready to leave everything behind and start anew in California.
anew.zh: 我准备好舍弃一切，在加利福尼亚开始新的生活。

anew.en: The committee is going to examine the whole situation anew.
anew.zh: 委员会将重新调查整个情况。

angel.en: That little girl of theirs is an angel.
angel.zh: 他们的小女儿是个小天使。

angel.en: Sam is no angel (=often behaves badly).

anger.en: There is growing anger among the people against the government.
anger.zh: 民众对政府越来越不满。

anger.en: She struggled to control her anger at her son’s disobedience.
anger.zh: 儿子不听话，对此她强压怒火。

angle.en: You didn’t measure the angle accurately.
We’re approaching the issue from many different angles.
angle.zh: 我们从许多不同的角度来考虑这个问题。

angry.en: I was angry because he hadn’t told me his plans.
angry.zh: 我很生气，因为他没有告诉我他的计划。

angry.en: He was beginning to get angry.

animal.en: The cosmetics have not been tested on animals.
animal.zh: 这些化妆品没有进行过动物试验。

animal.en: Beth is an animal lover (=someone who likes animals).
animal.zh: 贝丝是个喜欢动物的人。

animate.en: Laughter animated his face for a moment.
animate.zh: 笑容使他的脸上一时增添了生气。

animation.en: They used computer animation in the film.
animation.zh: 他们在影片中使用了计算机动画制作。

ankle.en: Janet slipped on the stairs and twisted her ankle.
ankle.zh: 珍妮特在楼梯上滑倒，扭伤了脚踝。

annex.en: The Baltic republics were annexed by the Soviet Union in 1940.

annihilate.en: Just one of these bombs could annihilate a city the size of New York.
annihilate.zh: 这种炸弹只要一颗就能彻底毁灭纽约那么大的一座城市。

annihilate.en: Tyson annihilated his opponent in the first round.
annihilate.zh: 泰森在第一个回合就轻取对手。

anniversary.en: Jack and Kim celebrated their twentieth wedding anniversary in January.
A huge parade was held on the anniversary of the 1959 revolution.

announce.en: They announced their engagement in ‘The Times’.
announce.zh: 他们在《泰晤士报》上宣布了订婚的消息。

announce.en: The government has announced plans to create 10,000 new jobs.
announce.zh: 政府宣布了创造一万个就业机会的方案。

announcement.en: The minister made the announcement at a news conference.
announcement.zh: 部长在记者招待会上发表了这项声明。

announcement.en: They heard the announcement that the mayor was resigning.
announcement.zh: 他们听到了市长要辞职的公告。

annoy.en: What annoyed him most was that he had received no apology.
annoy.zh: 最令他生气的是没人向他道歉。

annoy.en: She annoyed him with her stupid questions.
annoy.zh: 她那些愚蠢的问题令他很恼火。

annoyance.en: A look of annoyance crossed her face.
annoyance.zh: 她的脸上掠过一丝不快。

annoyance.en: To his annoyance, he discovered they hadn’t waited.
annoyance.zh: 他发现他们没有等他，感到很气恼。

annual.en: The school trip has become an annual event.
annual.zh: 学校组织的旅行成了一年一度的活动。

annual.en: The jazz festival is held annually in July.
annual.zh: 爵士音乐节每年7月举行。

anomaly.en: In those days, a woman professor was still an anomaly.
anomaly.zh: 那个时候，女教授仍旧十分稀罕。

anonymous.en: According to one employee, who wishes to remain anonymous, the company engaged in illegal activities.
anonymous.zh: 根据一位不愿透露姓名的员工所述，这家公司曾从事非法活动。

another.en: I’m going to have another cup of coffee.
There’ll be another bus along in a few minutes.
another.zh: 几分钟后就会再来一辆公共汽车。

answer.en: You don’t have to give them an answer now.
answer.zh: 你不必现在就给他们答复。

answer.en: Every time I ask him about it, I get a different answer.
answer.zh: 我每次问他此这件事，都得到不同的回答。

anthem.en: The Rolling Stones’ ‘Satisfaction’ was an anthem for a generation.
anthem.zh: 滚石乐队的《满足》是一代人传唱的经典歌曲。

anticipate.en: The schedule isn’t final, but we don’t anticipate many changes.
anticipate.zh: 日程还没有最后定下来，但是我们预料不会有许多变化。

anticipation.en: She waited in eager anticipation for Robert to arrive.
anticipation.zh: 她急切地期盼着罗伯特到来。

anticipation.en: Taylor was excited and full of anticipation at the prospect of the trip.
anticipation.zh: 泰勒很兴奋，对这次旅行满怀期待。

anticlockwise.zh: 往逆时针方向转动盖子。

antipathy.en: There’s always been a certain amount of antipathy between the two doctors.
antipathy.zh: 这两个医生之间一向有嫌隙。

antique.en: The palace is full of priceless antiques.
antique.zh: 宫殿里到处都是价值连城的古董。

antique.en: They bought the clock at an antique shop in Bath.
antique.zh: 他们在巴斯一家古玩店里买了这只钟。

antiquity.en: The common household fork was nearly unknown in antiquity.
antiquity.zh: 古时，几乎看不到普通的家用餐叉。

anxiety.en: There is considerable anxiety among staff about job losses.
There is growing public anxiety over levels of air pollution in our cities.
anxiety.zh: 公众越来越担心城市中的空气污染程度。

anxious.en: He was a bit anxious about the safety of the machinery.
anxious.zh: 他有点担心机器的安全性。

any.en: Do you need any further information?
any.zh: 你需要更详细的信息吗？

anyhow.en: The scandal could damage her reputation but the press reported it anyhow.
anyhow.zh: 这宗丑闻可能损害她的名声，不过报纸还是给登了出来。

anyhow.en: I’ve never been to a circus, not recently anyhow.
anyhow.zh: 我从没看过马戏，至少最近没看过。

anyone.en: They offer help and advice to anyone interested in becoming a teacher.
anyone.zh: 他们为任何有兴趣当老师的人提供帮助和咨询。

anyplace.en: I can’t imagine living anyplace else now.
anyplace.zh: 我现在不能想象住在其他地方会怎么样。

anything.en: You can buy anything you want.
He was prepared to do anything to make a bit of money.
anything.zh: 只要能赚一点钱，他什么都愿意做。

anytime.en: Call me anytime. I’m always home.
anytime.zh: 随时给我打电话，我一直在家。

anytime.en: They should arrive anytime between noon and 3 p.m.

anyway.en: Catherine wasn’t sure the book was the right one, but she bought it anyway.
anyway.zh: 凯瑟琳不能确定就是这本书，但她还是买了。

anyway.en: This idea probably won’t work, but let’s try it anyway.
anyway.zh: 这个办法可能行不通，不过我们还是试试吧。

anywhere.en: You can buy clothes like these anywhere.
anywhere.zh: 这样的衣服到处都可以买到。

apace.en: Expansion of the company has continued apace.

apart.en: Place the two posts 6 metres apart.
They have offices in countries as far apart as India and Peru.
apart.zh: 他们的办事处远至印度、秘鲁等国。

apartment.en: She lives in a small apartment.
I had never been in the prince’s private apartments before.
apartment.zh: 我以前从未进过王子的私人套房。

ape.en: He could ape his teachers perfectly.
ape.zh: 他可以把老师模仿得惟妙惟肖。

apiece.en: The pictures are worth about £10,000 apiece.
apiece.zh: 这些画每幅价值约一万英镑。

apiece.en: The two top teams have ten points apiece.
apiece.zh: 排名最高的两支球队各得十分。

apologetic.en: The manager was very apologetic about everything.
She gave me an apologetic smile.

apologize.en: I’m so sorry, I do apologize.
apologize.zh: 非常对不起，我真心道歉。

apologize.en: I think you should apologize to your brother.
apologize.zh: 我觉得你应该给你弟弟赔个不是。

apology.en: The minister had to issue a formal public apology for his remarks.
apology.zh: 部长不得不为他的言论作出正式的公开道歉。

apology.en: She finally received an apology from the company.
apology.zh: 她终于接到了公司方面的道歉。

appal.en: The way we kill animals appals a lot of people.
appal.zh: 我们屠杀动物的方式令许多人震惊。

appal.en: The decision to execute the two men has appalled many politicians.
appal.zh: 处死那两名男子的判决令许多从政者震惊。

apparatus.zh: 航天员有专门的呼吸装装备。

apparatus.en: The tax will require a massive administrative apparatus.
apparatus.zh: 税收需要大规模的行政机构。

apparel.en: She looked lovely, despite her strange apparel.
apparel.zh: 她身穿奇装异服，但是看上去很可爱。

apparel.en: We sell a full range of sports apparel.
apparel.zh: 我们出售各种各样的运动装。

apparent.en: It soon became apparent that we had a major problem.
apparent.zh: 不久就看出来，我们有了大麻烦。

apparent.en: It is apparent from scientific studies that the drug has some fairly nasty side effects.
apparent.zh: 科学研究表明，这种药有相当严重的副作用。

apparently.en: Apparently the company is losing a lot of money.
apparently.zh: 据说该公司目前亏损很大。

apparently.en: I wasn’t there, but apparently it went well.
apparently.zh: 我当时不在，但是据说事情进展顺利。

appeal.en: The police have issued a new appeal for information.
appeal.zh: 警方再次发出呼吁，征求线索。

appeal.en: All the organizations involved have sent urgent appeals to the government, asking for extra funding.
appeal.zh: 有关机构都向政府发出紧急呼吁，要求增加拨款。

appealing.en: The city offers an appealing combination of sporting and cultural events.
appealing.zh: 这座城市集体育活动和文化活动于一身，颇具吸引力。

appealing.en: It creates an atmosphere which visitors find so appealing.
appealing.zh: 它创造了一种吸引游客的氛围。

appear.en: It appears that all the files have been deleted.
appear.zh: 看来所有文件都已被删除。

appear.en: Police have found what appear to be human remains.
appear.zh: 警方发现了疑似人体遗骸的东西。

appearance.en: He was always criticising his wife’s appearance.
appearance.zh: 他老是批评妻子的外表。

appearance.en: They’ve changed the appearance of the whole building.
appearance.zh: 他们改变了整幢建筑的外观。

appendix.en: Christine had to go into hospital to have her appendix out (=have it removed).
appendix.zh: 克里丝蒂娜不得不去医院切除阑尾。

appetite.en: Her husband always had a huge appetite.
Symptoms include tiredness and loss of appetite.
appetite.zh: 症状包括疲倦和食欲不振。

applaud.en: A crowd of 300 supporters warmly applauded her speech.

applause.en: She got a round of applause (=a short period of applause) when she finished.
applause.zh: 她结束的时候获得一阵掌声。

applause.en: He left the stage to rapturous applause.
applause.zh: 他在热烈的喝彩声中离开舞台。

apple.en: Ben was always the apple of his father’s eye.
apple.zh: 本一直是他父亲的心肝宝贝。

appliance.en: There’s plenty of space for all the usual kitchen appliances.
appliance.zh: 有足够的空间摆放各种日常厨房器具。

applicable.en: The offer is only applicable to bookings for double rooms.
applicable.zh: 这个报价只适用于预订双人房。

applicant.en: He was one of 30 applicants for the manager’s job.
Successful applicants will be expected to travel extensively.
applicant.zh: 获录用者需要经常出差。

application.en: The university welcomes applications from overseas students.
application.zh: 本大学欢迎海外学生申请入学。

application.en: We receive hundreds of job applications each year.
application.zh: 我们每年收到数百封求职信。

apply.en: She applied for a job with the local newspaper.
apply.zh: 她申请了当地报社的一个职位。

apply.en: We need to apply for planning permission to build a garage.
apply.zh: 我们建车库需要申请规划许可。

appoint.en: He’s been appointed to the State Supreme Court.
appoint.zh: 他奉命到州最高法院任职。

appoint.en: A committee was appointed to consider the plans.
appoint.zh: 一个委员会被委派去研究这些计划。

appointment.en: I’d like to make an appointment to see the doctor.
He has an appointment with a client at 10.30.

apportion.en: It’s not easy to apportion blame (=say who deserves to be blamed) when a marriage breaks up.
apportion.zh: 婚姻破裂很难说是谁的错。

apportion.en: Court costs were equally apportioned between them.

appraisal.en: It needed a calmer appraisal of her situation.
appraisal.zh: 她的情况需要更为冷静的评判。

appraise.en: Greenpeace has been invited to appraise the environmental costs of such an operation.
appraise.zh: 绿色和平组织已受邀评估这样一次行动对环境的影响。
他两眼端详着她的脸庞。

appreciable.en: There’s no appreciable change in the patient’s condition.
