comment.zh: 这番讲话引来了媒体热议。

commentary.en: We’ll be bringing you full commentary on the game between Notts and Brescia.
commentary.zh: 我们将为您全场解说诺士郡队和布雷西亚队的比赛。

commercial.en: Our top priorities must be profit and commercial growth.
commercial.zh: 我们必须把利润和贸易增长作为我们的第一要务。

commercial.en: Gibbons failed to see the commercial value of his discovery.
commercial.zh: 吉本斯没有意识到自己的发现所具有的商业价值。

commercialize.zh: 圣诞节现已变得非常商业化了。

commercialize.en: Some space launches will be commercialized to help pay for more space research.
commercialize.zh: 一些太空发射将会商业化，为更多的太空研究提供经费。

commission.en: The Government set up a commission to investigate allegations of police violence.
commission.zh: 政府成立了一个委员会调查对警察施暴行为的指控。

commission.en: The dealer takes a 20% commission on the sales he makes.

commit.en: Women commit fewer crimes than men.
Brady committed a series of brutal murders.
commit.zh: 布雷迪犯下了一连串残忍的谋杀案。

commitment.en: Are you ready to make a long-term commitment?
commitment.zh: 你是否准备好作出长久的承诺？

commitment.en: Our company has a commitment to quality and customer service.
commitment.zh: 我们公司对质量和客户服务作出承诺。

committee.en: The environmental health committee will meet again next Wednesday.
committee.zh: 环境卫生委员会将于下周三再次举行会议。

common.en: Heart disease is one of the commonest causes of death.
common.zh: 心脏病是最常见的死因之一。

common.en: Bad dreams are fairly common among children.
common.zh: 小孩做噩梦是很常见的。

commonly.en: Sodium chloride is more commonly known as salt.
Lung cancer is the most commonly found cancer in men.
commonly.zh: 肺癌是男性最常见的癌症。

commonplace.en: Car thefts are commonplace in this part of town.
commonplace.zh: 镇上的这个地段盗车案屡见不鲜。

commonplace.en: Women’s groups have become a commonplace.
commonplace.zh: 妇女团体已经成了常见事物。

commotion.zh: 他们听见楼下一阵骚动。

commotion.en: Everyone looked to see what was causing the commotion.
commotion.zh: 大家都在看是什么引起了喧闹。

commune.en: Take time to relax and commune with nature.
commune.zh: 花点时间放松一下，去和大自然融为一体。

communicate.zh: 我们主要是用电子邮件沟通。

communicate.en: People use more than words when they communicate with each other.
communicate.zh: 人们相互交流时不仅仅使用语言。

communication.en: Good communication is vital in a large organization.
communication.zh: 在大机构里良好的沟通是极为重要的。

communication.en: Radio was the pilot’s only means of communication.
communication.zh: 无线电是飞行员唯一的通信手段。

communicative.en: Tom wasn’t very communicative, and kept himself to himself.
communicative.zh: 汤姆不大善于言谈，不喜欢与人交往。

community.en: The new arts centre will serve the whole community.
community.zh: 这座新的艺术中心将为整个社区服务。

community.en: We meet once a month to discuss community problems.
community.zh: 我们一个月碰头一次讨论社区问题。

commute.en: Jim commutes to Manhattan every day.
commute.zh: 吉姆每天长途乘车到曼哈顿上班。

commute.en: Baldry’s 20-year prison sentence was commuted to three years.
commute.zh: 鲍德里二十年的刑期被减至三年。

compact.en: The compact design of the machine allows it to be stored easily.
compact.zh: 这台机器的设计小巧灵便，易于存放。

compact.en: The students’ rooms were compact, with a desk, bed, and closet built in.
compact.zh: 学生的房间很小巧，配有一张书桌、一张床和一个壁橱。

companion.en: For ten years he had been her constant companion.
companion.zh: 十年来他一直陪伴她左右。

companion.en: His dog became his closest companion.
companion.zh: 他的狗成了他最亲密的伙伴。

companionship.en: When Stan died, I missed his companionship.
companionship.zh: 斯坦去世后，我怀念我们的友情。

company.en: Which company do you work for?
I called the phone company about the bill.
company.zh: 我就电话账单的事给电话公司打了电话。

comparable.en: A car of comparable size would cost far more abroad.
comparable.zh: 同样大小的汽车在国外要贵得多。

comparable.en: Pluto is comparable in size to the Moon.
comparable.zh: 冥王星的大小和月球差不多。

comparative.en: After a lifetime of poverty, his last few years were spent in comparative comfort.
comparative.zh: 他穷了一辈子，最后几年还算过得比较舒适。

comparative.en: She didn’t want to leave the comparative safety of the shelter.
comparative.zh: 她不愿离开相对来说还算安全的掩蔽处。

comparatively.en: Comparatively few books have been written on the subject.
comparatively.zh: 有关这方面的书相对较少。

comparatively.en: Crime on the island is comparatively rare.
comparatively.zh: 这个岛上犯罪活动相对较少。

compare.en: The report compares the different types of home computer available.
compare.zh: 这份报告比较了市场上不同类型的家用计算机。

compare.en: The police compared the suspect’s fingerprints with those found at the crime scene.
compare.zh: 警方把疑犯的指纹和在犯罪现场发现的指纹作了对比。

comparison.en: Comparison with his previous movies shows how Lee has developed as a director.
comparison.zh: 和先前的影片进行比较，可以看到李作为一名导演的成长过程。

comparison.en: In comparison to other recent video games, this one isn’t very exciting.
comparison.zh: 和其他最新的电子游戏相比，这个游戏不太刺激。

compartment.en: The bag is divided into separate compartments.
compartment.zh: 这个包有一些独立的隔层。

compartment.en: She kept the money hidden in a secret compartment in her briefcase.
compartment.zh: 她把钱藏在公文包的暗层里。

compass.en: Within the brief compass of a single page, the author covers most of the major points.
compass.zh: 在短短一页的篇幅中，作者涵盖了大部分要点。

compassion.en: Did he feel any compassion for the victim of his crime?
compassion.zh: 他对自己罪行的受害者是否感到同情？

compassion.en: Lieberman explores this sensitive topic with compassion.
compassion.zh: 利伯曼以同情的态度来探讨这个敏感的话题。

compatible.en: Stephen’s political views often weren’t compatible with her own.
compatible.zh: 斯蒂芬的政治观点经常和她自己的观点无法相容。

compatible.en: On paper they seemed like the perfect couple, but maybe they just weren't right for each other.
compatible.zh: 理论上讲他们应该是完美的一对，不过可能就是合不来。

compel.en: The law will compel employers to provide health insurance.
compel.zh: 这项法律将强制雇主提供健康保险。

compel.en: She felt compelled to resign because of the scandal.
compel.zh: 因为这个丑闻，她感到必须辞职。

compelling.en: Lucy had no compelling reason to go into town.
compelling.zh: 露西没有充分的理由去镇上。

compelling.en: The court was presented with compelling evidence that she’d murdered her husband.
compelling.zh: 有人向法庭出示了令人信服的证据，证明她谋杀了丈夫。

compensate.en: Because my left eye is so weak, my right eye has to work harder to compensate.
compensate.zh: 因为我左眼视力差，右眼就要辛苦点来弥补一下。

compensate.en: Her intelligence more than compensates for her lack of experience.
compensate.zh: 她才智过人，因此虽然经验不足，却也游刃有余。

compensation.en: She received compensation from the government for the damage caused to her property.
compensation.zh: 她得到了政府给她的财产损失补偿金。

compensation.en: The jury awarded Tyler $1.7 million in compensation.

compensatory.en: She was awarded a large sum in compensatory damages.
compensatory.zh: 她得到了一大笔损失赔偿金。

compensatory.en: Workers are given a compensatory day off when a national holiday falls on a weekend.
compensatory.zh: 如果法定假日赶上周末，工人可以得到一天补休。

compete.en: They found themselves competing with foreign companies for a share of the market.
compete.zh: 他们发现自己在与外国公司争夺市场份额。

compete.en: The Renault Clio competes against such cars as the Peugeot 206.

competence.en: Students will gain competence in a wide range of skills.
competence.zh: 学生们将学到多种技能。

competence.en: He questioned the competence of the government.
competence.zh: 他质疑政府的执政能力。

competent.en: A competent mechanic should be able to fix the problem.
competent.zh: 一名合格的机修工应该能够解决这个问题。
她是一位非常杰出的语言学家。

competition.en: Competition for the job was intense.
Sometimes there’s a lot of competition between children for their mother’s attention.
competition.zh: 为了得到母亲的关注，有时孩子之间会争得很厉害。

competitive.en: Some US industries are not as competitive as they have been in the past.
competitive.zh: 美国有些行业不如以前有竞争力了。

competitive.en: The team seems to have lost its competitive edge recently (=its ability to compete well).
competitive.zh: 这支球队近来好像丧失了竞争优势。

competitiveness.en: New machinery has enhanced the company’s productivity and competitiveness.
competitiveness.zh: 新机器帮助公司提高了生产力，增强了竞争力。
欧洲在国际市场上的竞争力

competitor.en: Last year they sold twice as many computers as their competitors.
competitor.zh: 去年他们的计算机销量是竞争对手的两倍。

competitor.en: The company’s four major competitors have nothing to rival the new product.
competitor.zh: 该公司的四家主要竞争对手拿不出东西来和这种新产品竞争。

compile.en: The document was compiled by the Department of Health
compile.zh: 这份文件是由卫生部汇编的。

compile.en: The report was compiled from a survey of 5,000 households.

complain.en: Residents are complaining because traffic in the area has increased.
complain.zh: 由于这个地区的交通流量有所增加，居民都在抱怨。

complain.en: She complained that no one had been at the airport to meet her.
complain.zh: 她抱怨说没人到机场去接她。

complaint.en: If you wish to make a complaint, you should see the manager.
complaint.zh: 如果你要投诉，应该去找经理。

complaint.en: The sales assistants are trained to deal with customer complaints in a friendly manner.
complaint.zh: 售货员都受过培训，要以友好的态度处理顾客的投诉。

complement.en: John and Bob complemented each other well.
complement.zh: 约翰和鲍勃互相配合得很好。

complement.en: The dark red walls complement the red leather chairs.
complement.zh: 深红色的墙和红色的皮椅很相配。

complementary.en: The computer and the human mind have different but complementary abilities.
complementary.zh: 电脑与人脑各不相同，却又互为补充。

complete.en: The police were in complete control of the situation.
complete.zh: 警方已完全控制了局势。

complete.en: Their engagement came as a complete surprise to me.
complete.zh: 他们的订婚让我感到非常意外。

completely.en: I completely forgot that it’s his birthday today.
completely.zh: 我完全忘了今天是他的生日。

completely.en: He had never completely recovered from his illness.
completely.zh: 他病后一直没有完全康复。

completion.en: The house is nearing completion (=almost finished).
The project has a completion date of December 22nd.

complex.en: Photosynthesis is a highly complex process.
complex.zh: 光合作用是一个非常复杂的过程。

complex.en: Peter seemed to have an instant understanding of the most complex issues.
complex.zh: 再复杂的问题彼得似乎也是一看就明白。

complexion.en: Drinking water is good for the complexion.
She was fair-complexioned with blonde hair.

complexity.en: There is increasing recognition of the complexity of the causes of poverty.
complexity.zh: 人们越来越认识到，造成贫困的原因错综复杂。

complexity.en: The complexities of economics are clearly explained.
complexity.zh: 经济情况的复杂性被解释得很清楚。

compliance.en: He changed his name to Lee in 1815 in compliance with his uncle’s will.
Patients should have a history of good compliance with treatment.
compliance.zh: 病人必须积极配合治疗。

complicate.en: The situation is complicated by the fact that I’ve got to work late on Friday.
complicate.zh: 我周五还得加班，这样一来事情更复杂了。

complicate.en: To complicate matters further, differences exist as regards legal systems, trade customs, and language.
complicate.zh: 使事情更复杂的是在司法体系、贸易惯例和语言方面存在差异。

complicated.en: For young children, getting dressed is a complicated business.
complicated.zh: 对幼童来说，穿衣服是件复杂的事。

complicated.en: Mental illness is a very complicated subject.
complicated.zh: 精神疾病是个非常复杂的课题。

complication.en: The fact that the plane was late added a further complication to our journey.
complication.zh: 飞机误点给我们的旅行带来了更大的麻烦。

complication.en: Pneumonia is one of the common complications faced by bed-ridden patients.
complication.zh: 肺炎是卧床病人所面临的常见并发症之一。

compliment.en: All the guests paid her extravagant compliments.
compliment.zh: 所有客人都对她赞不绝口。

compliment.en: Being compared to Abba is a great compliment.
compliment.zh: 能和阿巴乐队相提并论是极大的赞誉。

complimentary.en: There was a complimentary bottle of champagne in the hotel room.
complimentary.zh: 酒店客房里有一瓶免费赠送的香槟。

complimentary.en: I’ve got some complimentary tickets for the theatre tonight.
complimentary.zh: 我有几张今晚的免费戏票。

comply.en: Failure to comply with the regulations will result in prosecution.
The newspaper was asked by federal agents for assistance and agreed to comply.
comply.zh: 联邦探员要求这家报社给予协助，报社同意配合。

component.en: Exercise is one of the key components of a healthy lifestyle.
component.zh: 锻炼身体是健康生活方式的一个重要组成部分。

component.en: We’ve been breaking down the budget into its component parts.
component.zh: 我们把预算划分为不同的组成部分。

compose.en: Water is composed of hydrogen and oxygen.
The legal system is composed of people, and people make mistakes.
compose.zh: 法律体制由人组成，而人是会犯错误的。

composed.en: He appeared very composed despite the stress he was under.
composed.zh: 尽管压力很大，他看起来仍十分镇定。

composite.en: The author builds up a useful composite picture of contemporary consumer culture.
composite.zh: 作者勾勒出了一幅实用的当代消费文化全景图。

composite.en: The child’s character was a composite of two girls I knew.
composite.zh: 这孩子的性格综合了我认识的两个女孩的个性。

composition.en: The composition of the group that is studied depends on the interests of the researcher.
composition.zh: 被研究群体的组成取决于研究者的兴趣。

composition.en: Some minerals have complex chemical compositions.
composition.zh: 有些矿物的化学构成很复杂。

compound.en: Sulphur dioxide is a compound of sulphur and oxygen.
compound.zh: 二氧化硫是硫和氧的化合物。

compound.en: Teaching is a compound of several different skills.
compound.zh: 教书是多种不同技能的综合。

comprehend.en: She cannot comprehend the extent of the disaster.
comprehend.zh: 她无法理解这场灾难的严重程度。

comprehend.en: I did not fully comprehend what had happened.
comprehend.zh: 我没有完全理解发生了什么事。

comprehensible.en: Her speech was slurred and barely comprehensible.
comprehensible.zh: 她的发言含混不清，几乎无法听懂。

comprehensible.en: The procedure must be clear and comprehensible to all staff.
comprehensible.zh: 工作步骤必须明白易懂，让所有员工都能理解。

comprehension.en: They don’t have the least comprehension of what I’m trying to do.
comprehension.zh: 他们一点都不理解我想要干什么。

comprehension.en: The research project will focus on children’s comprehension of pretence.
comprehension.zh: 这项研究将集中于儿童对假象的理解。

comprehensive.en: We offer our customers a comprehensive range of financial products.
comprehensive.zh: 我们为客户提供全面的金融产品。

comprehensive.en: The following guidelines do not aim to be totally comprehensive.
comprehensive.zh: 以下指导原则并非想要面面俱到。

compress.en: Light silk is best for parachutes, as it compresses well and then expands rapidly.
compress.zh: 轻质丝绸最适合制作降落伞，因为这种面料便于压缩，而且展开迅速。
伊索贝尔紧闭着双唇点了点头。

comprise.en: The house comprises two bedrooms, a kitchen, and a living room.
comprise.zh: 这座房子有两间卧室、一间厨房和一间起居室。

comprise.en: The committee is comprised of well-known mountaineers.
comprise.zh: 委员会由知名的登山运动员组成。

compromise.en: Compromise is an inevitable part of marriage.
compromise.zh: 妥协是婚姻生活中必不可少的。

compromise.en: To stop the argument they decided on a compromise.
compromise.zh: 为停止争吵，他们决定作出妥协。

compute.en: Final results had not yet been computed.
compute.zh: 最终的结果还未计算出来。

computer.en: The information is stored on computer.
Shoppers can send in their orders by computer and pick up their goods later.
computer.zh: 购物者可以通过电脑提交订单，稍后再提货。

comrade.en: He misses his comrades from his days in the army.
comrade.zh: 他想念在部队时候的战友。
同志们，请支持这项动议。

conceal.en: The shadows concealed her as she crept up to the house.
conceal.zh: 她借着阴影蹑手蹑脚地走向房子。

conceal.en: The path was concealed by long grass.
conceal.zh: 小路隐藏在长长的草里。

concede.en: I conceded that I had made a number of errors.
concede.zh: 我承认自己犯了一些错误。

concede.en: The Georgian forces defended the capital but were finally obliged to concede.
concede.zh: 格鲁吉亚军队奋起保卫首都，但最终被迫投降。

conceit.en: His sermons were full of puns and conceits.
conceit.zh: 他的布道用了大量的双关语和巧妙比喻。

conceited.en: You’re the most conceited selfish person I’ve ever known.
conceited.zh: 你是我认识的人当中最自负、最自私的。

conceivable.en: It is conceivable that you may get full compensation, but it’s not likely.
conceivable.zh: 你可能会得到全额赔偿，但可能性不大。

conceivable.en: We were discussing the problems from every conceivable angle.
conceivable.zh: 我们正在从各个能想到的角度对问题进行讨论。

conceive.en: Many people can’t conceive of a dinner without meat or fish.
conceive.zh: 许多人无法想象正餐怎么可以没有肉或鱼。

conceive.en: He could not conceive that anything really serious could be worrying his friend.
conceive.zh: 他想象不出能有什么非常严重的事情让他的朋友操心。

concentrate.en: Adrian was finding it difficult to concentrate.
concentrate.zh: 阿德里安觉得自己很难集中注意力。

concentrate.en: Be quiet – let me concentrate on my homework.
concentrate.zh: 安静点，让我专心做家庭作业。

concentrated.en: He made a concentrated effort to improve his work.
concentrated.zh: 他集中精力把工作做得更好。

concentration.en: She needed all her powers of concentration to stop herself from slipping on the icy road.
concentration.zh: 她需要集中全部注意力才能不让自己在结冰的路上滑倒。

concentration.en: Lack of concentration was a real problem.
concentration.zh: 注意力不集中是个大问题。

concept.en: It’s very simple, once you grasp the concept.
concept.zh: 你一旦掌握了这个概念之后就很简单了。

conception.en: They have no conception of what women really feel and want.
conception.zh: 他们对女性真正的感受和需求一无所知。

concern.en: The recent rise in crime is a matter of considerable public concern.
concern.zh: 近来犯罪增多是民众极为关切的事。

concern.en: The activities of the far right have been a cause for concern for a while now.
concern.zh: 极右分子的活动引起关注已经有一段时间了。

concerned.en: Divorce is very painful, especially when children are concerned.
concerned.zh: 离婚是非常痛苦的，涉及孩子的话更是如此。

concerned.en: Some of the farmers concerned suffer particularly from the low prices.
concerned.zh: 涉及的农民当中，有些人因低价受到的损失尤为惨重。

concerning.en: I’ve already written to him about the problem.
concerning.zh: 我已经就此问题给他写了信。

concert.en: We were going to a concert in Bath Abbey.
concert.zh: 我们要去听一场在巴斯修道院内举行的音乐会。

concert.en: She still does about 100 concerts every year.

concerted.en: Libraries have made a concerted effort to attract young people.
concerted.zh: 各图书馆同心协力吸引年轻人。

concession.en: The British were not prepared to make any concessions.
concession.zh: 英国人没有打算作出让步。

concession.en: We will try to force further concessions from the government.
concession.zh: 我们打算迫使政府作出进一步的让步。

concise.en: Your summary should be as clear and concise as possible.
concise.zh: 你的总结应该尽可能地明白简洁。

conclude.en: The report concluded that the school should be closed immediately.
conclude.zh: 报告的结论是这所学校应该立刻关闭。

conclude.en: Richardson concluded from his studies that equality between the sexes is still a long way off.
conclude.zh: 理查森从他的研究中得出结论，两性之间的平等仍有很长的路要走。

conclusion.en: These are the report’s main conclusions.
conclusion.zh: 这些就是这篇报告的主要结论。

conclusion.en: I soon came to the conclusion that she was lying.
conclusion.zh: 我很快就得出了她在撒谎的结论。

conclusive.en: The investigation failed to provide any conclusive evidence.
conclusive.zh: 调查未能提供任何结论性的证据。

concoct.en: John concocted an elaborate excuse for being late.
concoct.zh: 约翰为迟到编造了一个巧妙的借口。

concoct.en: Jean concocted a great meal from the leftovers.
concoct.zh: 琼用剩菜剩饭做了一顿美餐。

concomitant.en: Deafness is a frequent concomitant of old age.

concrete.en: What does that mean in concrete terms?
concrete.zh: 具体来说那到底是什么意思？

concur.en: The committee largely concurred with these views.
concur.zh: 委员会大致上同意这些观点。

concur.en: Everything concurred to produce the desired effect.
concur.zh: 所有的事同时发生，产生了预期的效果。

concurrence.en: Jules expressed his concurrence with the suggestion.
concurrence.zh: 朱尔斯表示同意这个建议。

concurrent.en: The exhibition reflected concurrent developments abroad.
concurrent.zh: 该展览反映了国外的同期发展情况。

concurrent.en: My opinions are concurrent with yours.

condemn.en: Politicians were quick to condemn the bombing.
condemn.zh: 政治家们立即对爆炸事件进行了谴责。

condemn.en: The law has been condemned as an attack on personal liberty.
condemn.zh: 这项法律被指责侵犯人身自由。

condemnation.en: There was widespread international condemnation of the bombing.
condemnation.zh: 这次爆炸受到了国际社会的广泛谴责。

condensation.en: There was a lot of condensation on the windows.

condense.en: The gaseous metal is cooled and condenses into liquid zinc.
condense.zh: 气态金属被冷却并凝结成液态锌。

condense.en: This whole chapter could be condensed into a few paragraphs.
condense.zh: 这一整章可以压缩成几个段落。

condition.en: Conditions in the prison were atrocious.
condition.zh: 这座监狱的条件糟透了。

condition.en: Poor working conditions lead to demoralized and unproductive employees.
condition.zh: 工作条件差导致雇员士气低落，生产力低下。

conditional.en: His agreement to buy our house was conditional on our leaving all the furniture in it.
conditional.zh: 他同意买我们的房子，条件是要我们把所有家具留下。

conduct.en: We are conducting a survey of consumer attitudes towards organic food.
conduct.zh: 我们在进行一项顾客对有机食品态度的调查。

conduct.en: Is it really necessary to conduct experiments on animals?
conduct.zh: 在动物身上做试验是否真有必要？

conductor.en: Wood is a poor conductor of heat.

confederate.en: The young woman was his confederate, of course.
confederate.zh: 这个年轻女子当然是他的同谋。

confer.en: Franklin leant over and conferred with his attorneys.
confer.zh: 富兰克林俯身和他的律师商谈。

confer.en: An honorary degree was conferred on him by the University.
confer.zh: 该大学授予他一个荣誉学位。

conference.en: Representatives from over 100 countries attended the International Peace Conference in Geneva.
conference.zh: 来自一百多个国家的代表出席了在日内瓦举行的国际和平大会。

conference.en: After a brief conference with his aides, he left for the airport.
conference.zh: 他和助手进行简短的商谈后，就动身去机场。

confess.en: Edwards confessed to being a spy for the KGB.
confess.zh: 爱德华兹承认自己是克格勃间谍。

confess.en: Occasionally people confess to crimes they haven’t committed just to get attention.
confess.zh: 偶尔人们会承认自己并未犯过的罪行，那只是为了引人注意。

confession.en: Sanchez’s confession was read out to the court.
confession.zh: 桑切斯的供词在法庭上宣读了出来。

confession.en: At 3 a.m. Higgins broke down and made a full confession.
confession.zh: 凌晨三点，希金斯崩溃了，交代了一切。

confide.en: He confided to his friends that he didn’t have much hope for his marriage.
confide.zh: 他私下告诉朋友，他对自己的婚姻不抱太大的希望。

confide.en: He confided his money to his brother’s safekeeping.
confide.zh: 他把钱托付给他弟弟保管。

confidence.en: Public confidence in the government is at an all-time low.
confidence.zh: 公众对政府的信任度处于有史以来的最低点。

confidence.en: She had complete confidence in the doctors.
confidence.zh: 她对这些医生完全信任。

confident.en: We are confident next year’s profits will be higher.
confident.zh: 我们确信明年的利润会增加。

confident.en: He is quietly confident that there will be no problems this time.
confident.zh: 他心中很有把握，这次不会有问题了。

confidential.en: Doctors are required to keep patients’ records completely confidential.
confidential.zh: 医生必须对病人的病历完全保密。

confidential.en: The information will be regarded as strictly confidential (=completely confidential).
confidential.zh: 这一信息将被视为绝对机密。

confine.en: The police cadet’s duties were confined to taking statements from the crowd.
confine.zh: 这位警校生的任务只是记录那群人的口供。

confine.en: We confined our study to ten cases.
confine.zh: 我们把研究限定在十个案例以内。

confinement.en: They were held in confinement for three weeks.
confinement.zh: 他们被关押了三个星期。

confinement.en: He visited prisoners at their place of confinement.
confinement.zh: 他到犯人关押处访问了犯人。

confirm.en: New evidence has confirmed the first witness’s story.
confirm.zh: 新的证据证实了第一个证人的说法。

confirm.en: To confirm my diagnosis I need to do some tests.
confirm.zh: 为了证实我的诊断，我要做一些化验。

confirmation.en: There has still been no official confirmation of the report.
confirmation.zh: 这则报道仍未得到官方证实。

confirmation.en: Most hotels require confirmation from a prospective guest in writing.
confirmation.zh: 大多数宾馆都要求预订房间的客人写书面确认函。

conflate.en: He conflates two images from Kipling’s short stories in the film.
conflate.zh: 影片中，他把吉卜林短篇小说中的两个人物形象合并在一起。

conflict.en: Marx points out the potential conflicts below the surface of society.
conflict.zh: 马克思指出了隐藏在社会表层之下的潜在矛盾。

conflict.en: His views on the literal truth of the Bible brought him into conflict with other Christian leaders.
conflict.zh: 他坚持《圣经》字面真理的观点使他与其他的基督教领袖发生了冲突。

conform.en: Students can be expelled for refusing to conform to school rules.
conform.zh: 学生不遵守校规可能会被开除。

conform.en: All new buildings must conform with the regional development plan.
conform.zh: 所有新建房屋都必须遵从地方上的开发规划。

conformity.en: We must act in conformity with local regulations.
conformity.zh: 我们必须按当地的法规行事。

confront.en: The problems confronting the new government were enormous.
confront.zh: 新政府面临的难题是巨大的。

confront.en: Customers are confronted with a bewildering amount of choice.
confront.zh: 顾客面前有琳琅满目的商品供选择。

confrontation.en: She had stayed in her room to avoid another confrontation.
confrontation.zh: 她待在自己的房间里，以避免再次发生冲突。

confrontation.en: Japan seemed unlikely to risk military confrontation with Russia.
confrontation.zh: 日本似乎不大可能冒险去和俄罗斯发生军事冲突。

confuse.en: I understand the text but the diagrams are confusing me.
confuse.zh: 文字我理解，但是图表把我弄糊涂了。

confuse.en: People might well confuse the two products.
confuse.zh: 人们很容易混淆这两种产品。

confusion.en: There was some confusion as to whether we had won or lost.
confusion.zh: 我们究竟是赢是输，情况不太清楚。

confusion.en: The diversion led to considerable confusion.
confusion.zh: 这次改道造成了相当大的混乱。

congenial.en: The department provides a congenial atmosphere for research.
congenial.zh: 这个部门为研究工作提供了轻松愉快的环境。

congenial.en: Frank was a very congenial colleague.
congenial.zh: 弗兰克是一位很好相处的同事。

congested.en: London’s roads are heavily congested (=very congested).

congratulate.en: He never even stopped to congratulate me.
congratulate.zh: 他甚至没有过来向我祝贺。

congratulate.en: She congratulated me warmly on my exam results.
congratulate.zh: 她热情地祝贺我考试取得好成绩。

congratulation.zh: 对精彩的演出表示祝贺！
请向奥斯卡转达我的祝贺。

congregate.en: Crowds began to congregate to hear the president’s speech.
congregate.zh: 人群开始聚拢，来聆听总统的演讲。

congress.en: The president has lost the support of Congress.

conjunction.en: The worksheets are designed to be used in conjunction with the new coursebooks.
conjunction.zh: 这些活页练习题专门用来与新课本配套使用。

connect.en: The railway link would connect Felixstowe with Fishguard.
connect.zh: 这条铁路线将连接费利克斯托和菲什加德。

connect.en: Connect the speakers to the CD player.
connect.zh: 将扬声器连接到激光唱机上。

connection.en: There is a connection between pollution and the death of trees.
connection.zh: 污染和树木枯死之间有关系。

connection.en: Mr O'Hara had no known connection with terrorist activity.
connection.zh: 从已知情况来看，奥哈拉先生与恐怖活动没有关系。

connoisseur.en: Fry was a connoisseur of Renaissance art.
connoisseur.zh: 弗赖是文艺复兴时期艺术作品的鉴赏家。

conquer.en: Egypt was conquered by the Persian King Kambyses.
conquer.zh: 埃及被波斯国王冈比西斯征服。

conquest.en: He boasts about his many conquests.
conquest.zh: 他吹嘘自己征服了许多女孩的芳心。

conscience.en: It was his guilty conscience that made him offer to help.
conscience.zh: 他是因为心中有愧才提出帮忙的。

conscience.en: Well, at least I can face them all with a clear conscience (=the knowledge that you have done nothing wrong).
conscience.zh: 好吧，至少我可以问心无愧地面对他们所有人。

conscientious.en: A conscientious teacher may feel inclined to take work home.
conscientious.zh: 一个认真负责的教师可能会想着把工作带回家去做。

conscious.en: I became conscious of someone watching me.
conscious.zh: 我察觉到有人在监视我。

conscious.en: I was very conscious of the fact that I had to make a good impression.
conscious.zh: 我非常清楚，我必须给人留下一个好印象。

consciousness.en: David lost consciousness (=went into a deep sleep) at eight o'clock and died a few hours later.
consciousness.zh: 戴维八点钟失去知觉，几小时后便去世了。

consciousness.en: She could faintly hear voices as she began to regain consciousness (=wake up).
consciousness.zh: 她开始恢复知觉时，隐约听到有人在说话。

consecutive.en: It had rained for four consecutive days.
Can they win the title for the third consecutive season?
consecutive.zh: 他们能连续第三个赛季赢得冠军称号吗？

consensus.en: There is a consensus among teachers that children should have a broad understanding of the world.
consensus.zh: 教师们一致认为儿童应该对世界有广泛的了解。

consensus.en: The EU Council of Finance Ministers failed to reach a consensus on the pace of integration.
consensus.zh: 欧盟财政部长会议未能就一体化的进度达成共识。

consent.en: He took the car without the owner’s consent.
consent.zh: 他没有得到车主的许可就把车开走了。

consent.en: Her parents gave their consent to the marriage.
consent.zh: 她父母同意了这桩婚事。

consequence.en: Many believe that poverty is a direct consequence of overpopulation.
consequence.zh: 许多人认为贫困是人口过多的直接后果。

consequence.en: Our findings have far-reaching consequences for researchers.
consequence.zh: 我们的发现对研究人员具有深远的影响。

consequently.en: Most computer users have never received any formal keyboard training. Consequently, their keyboard skills are inefficient.
consequently.zh: 大多数的电脑使用者都没有经过正规的键盘操作训练，因此他们的键盘技巧不够熟练。

consequently.en: The molecules are absorbed into the bloodstream and consequently affect the organs.
consequently.zh: 这些分子被吸收到血液里，从而影响到器官。

conservative.en: At a conservative estimate, the holiday will cost about £1,500.
conservative.zh: 按照保守估计，这个假期大约要花费1,500

conservative.en: He was conservatively dressed in a dark business suit.
conservative.zh: 他保守地穿了一套深色的商务套装。

conserve.en: We must conserve our woodlands for future generations.
conserve.zh: 我们必须为子孙后代保护林地。

consider.en: I seriously considered resigning (=almost actually resigned).
Have you considered the possibility of retraining?
consider.zh: 你是否考虑过接受再培训的可能性？

considerable.en: We’ve saved a considerable amount of money.
considerable.zh: 我们存了一笔数额相当大的钱。

considerable.en: Michael has already spent considerable time in Barcelona.
considerable.zh: 迈克尔在巴塞罗那已经待了相当长的时间了。

considerably.en: Conditions have improved considerably over the past few years.
considerably.zh: 过去几年里条件已经得到了很大的改善。

considerate.en: He was always kind and considerate.
considerate.zh: 他总是很善良，为别人着想。

considerate.en: It was very considerate of you to let us know you were going to be late.
considerate.zh: 你事先告诉我们你会迟到，考虑得非常周到。

consideration.en: There are several amendments under consideration.
consideration.zh: 好几项修正案正在讨论中。

consideration.en: After due consideration, I have decided to tender my resignation.
consideration.zh: 经过认真考虑，我决定递交辞呈。

considering.en: Considering the strength of the opposition, we did very well to score two goals.
considering.zh: 考虑到对方实力强大，我们能攻进两球已经很不错了。

considering.en: I think we paid too much for the house, considering that we needed to get the roof repaired.
considering.zh: 考虑到还得修理屋顶，我觉得我们这房子买贵了。

consign.en: It was a decision which consigned him to political obscurity.
consign.zh: 就是一个决定使得他在政治上未能出人头地。

consign.en: Many older people feel they have been consigned to the medical scrapheap.
consign.zh: 许多老年人感觉自己在医疗方面被随随便便打发了。

consist.en: Happiness does not consist in how many possessions you own.
consist.zh: 幸福不在于你拥有多少财产。

consist.en: The buffet consisted of several different Indian dishes.
consist.zh: 自助餐由几种不同的印度菜组成。

consistency.en: Consumer groups are demanding greater consistency in the labelling of food products.
consistency.zh: 消费者团体要求食品标签更加统一。

consistency.en: Consistency of performance depends on several factors.
consistency.zh: 表现稳定取决于好几个因素。

consistent.en: She’s the team’s most consistent player.
consistent.zh: 她是该队中表现最为稳定的选手。

consistent.en: We need to be consistent in our approach.
consistent.zh: 我们在方法上要前后一致。

consolation.en: The only consolation for the team is that they get a chance to play the game again.
consolation.zh: 该队唯一的安慰是他们有机会再赛一场。

consolation.en: If it’s any consolation, things do get easier as the child gets older.
consolation.zh: 聊可安慰的是，随着这孩子慢慢长大，境况也好起来了。

console.en: No one could console her when Peter died.
console.zh: 彼得去世时没人能够安慰她。

console.en: She consoled herself with the fact that no one else had done well in the exam either.
console.zh: 她用别人也都考得不好这个事实来安慰自己。

consolidate.en: The company has consolidated its position as the country’s leading gas supplier.
consolidate.zh: 这家公司巩固了作为该国主要煤气供应商的地位。

consolidate.en: The team consolidated their lead with a third goal.
consolidate.zh: 球队以第三个进球巩固了领先优势。

consonant.en: This policy is scarcely consonant with the government’s declared aims.
consonant.zh: 这项政策与政府所宣称的目标基本上不符。

consortium.en: The aircraft will be built by a European consortium.
consortium.zh: 这种飞机将由欧洲的一个财团建造。

conspicuous.en: The notice must be displayed in a conspicuous place.
conspicuous.zh: 通告一定要贴在显眼的地方。

conspicuous.en: I felt very conspicuous in my red coat.
conspicuous.zh: 我穿着红外套，感觉自己十分显眼。

conspiracy.en: He was charged with conspiracy to commit criminal damage.
conspiracy.zh: 他被指控密谋进行刑事破坏活动。

conspiracy.en: There were many conspiracy theories (=beliefs that something is the result of a conspiracy) surrounding Princess Diana’s death.
conspiracy.zh: 围绕戴安娜王妃之死有许多阴谋论。

constant.en: There was a constant stream of visitors to the house.
constant.zh: 参观这幢房子的游客川流不息。

constant.en: Amy lived in constant fear of being attacked.
constant.zh: 埃米一直生活在害怕遭到袭击的恐惧之中。

constantly.en: He talked constantly about his work.
constantly.zh: 他不断地谈到他的工作。

constantly.en: The English language is constantly changing.

constituency.en: He represents the Essex constituency of Epping Forest.
constituency.zh: 他代表埃平森林区的埃塞克斯郡选区。

constituency.en: The trade unions were no longer the constituency of the Labour Party alone.
constituency.zh: 工会不再单单支持工党。

constituent.en: Sodium is one of the constituents of salt.

constitute.en: Failing to complete the work constitutes a breach of the employment contract.
constitute.zh: 不能完成工作被视为违反雇用合同。

constitute.en: The rise in crime constitutes a threat to society.
constitute.zh: 犯罪率上升对社会构成了威胁。

constitution.en: The right to speak freely is written into the Constitution of the United States.
constitution.zh: 言论自由的权利被写入美国宪法。

constitution.en: She’s got a strong constitution – she’ll recover in no time.
constitution.zh: 她体质强壮，很快就会恢复。

constitutional.en: He was constitutionally incapable of dealing with conflict.
constitutional.zh: 他天生不具备处理冲突的能力。

constrain.en: Financial factors should not constrain doctors from prescribing the best treatment for patients.
constrain.zh: 经济因素不应该妨碍医生为病人制订最好的治疗方案。

constrain.en: Poor soil has constrained the level of crop production.
constrain.zh: 贫瘠的土地限制了农作物的产量。

constraint.en: Constraints on spending have forced the company to rethink its plans.
constraint.zh: 由于开支受到限制，这家公司不得不重新考虑其计划。

constraint.en: There have been financial and political constraints on development.
constraint.zh: 发展受到了经济和政治上的限制。

constrict.en: Caffeine constricts the blood vessels in your body.
constrict.zh: 咖啡因会使体内的血管收缩。

constrict.en: Linda’s throat constricted and she started to cry.
constrict.zh: 琳达喉咙发紧，哭了起来。

construct.en: There are plans to construct a new road bridge across the river.
construct.zh: 有计划要建造一条新的跨河公路桥。

construct.en: Boyce has constructed a new theory of management.
construct.zh: 博伊斯创立了一套新的管理理论。

construction.en: The hotel is currently under construction.
construction.zh: 这家宾馆目前正在建造之中。

construction.en: Work out the exact design before you start construction.
construction.zh: 开始施工之前要准备好精确的设计方案。

constructive.zh: 我们欢迎任何有建设性的批评。

construe.en: The term can be construed in two different ways.
construe.zh: 这个用语可以有两种不同的理解。

consult.en: If symptoms persist, consult a doctor without delay.
consult.zh: 如果症状持续的话，马上咨询医生。

consult.en: An increasing number of people are consulting their accountants about the tax laws.
consult.zh: 越来越多的人向会计师咨询有关税法的问题。

consultation.en: The decision was reached after consultation with parents and teachers.
consultation.zh: 这个决定是和家长、老师磋商之后作出的。

consultation.en: He’s calling for urgent consultations between the government and the oil industry to resolve the problem.
consultation.zh: 他呼吁政府和石油界紧急磋商解决这个问题。

consume.en: Only 27% of the paper we consume is recycled.
A smaller vehicle will consume less fuel.

consumer.en: Consumers will soon be paying higher airfares.
consumer.zh: 不久消费者就要支付更高的机票价了。

consumer.en: It will offer a wider choice of goods for the consumer (=consumers in general).
consumer.zh: 它将为消费者提供更多的商品选择。

consumption.zh: 剧烈运动增加氧的消耗。

consumption.en: The consumption of alcohol on the premises is forbidden.

contact.en: There is very little contact between the two tribes.
contact.zh: 这两个部落间几乎没有什么交往。

contact.en: Many of us have no direct contact with elderly people.
contact.zh: 我们中有许多人和老人没有直接的接触。

contain.en: The thieves stole a purse containing banknotes.
contain.zh: 小偷们偷到了一个里面有钞票的钱包。

contain.en: The museum contains a number of original artworks.
contain.zh: 这家博物馆藏有一些原创艺术品。

contaminate.en: Drinking water supplies are believed to have been contaminated.
contaminate.zh: 据信饮用水已受到污染。

contaminate.en: He claims the poster ads have ‘contaminated Berlin’s streets’.

contemplation.en: The monks spend an hour in contemplation each morning.
contemplation.zh: 那些修道士每天早上默想一小时。

contemporary.en: The wall hangings are thought to be roughly contemporary with the tiled floors.
contemporary.zh: 壁饰和瓷砖地面被认为差不多出现在同一时代。

contemporary.en: Oswald was much admired by his contemporaries at the Academy.
contemporary.zh: 奥斯瓦尔德在皇家艺术学会中很受同时代人的敬仰。

contempt.en: The contempt he felt for his fellow students was obvious.
contempt.zh: 他对同学的蔑视是显而易见的。

contempt.en: The report shows utter contempt for women’s judgement.
contempt.zh: 这份报告显示出对女性判断力的极度蔑视。

contemptible.en: They were portrayed as contemptible cowards.
contemptible.zh: 他们被刻画成可鄙的胆小鬼。

contemptuous.en: He was openly contemptuous of his father.
contemptuous.zh: 他公开对自己的父亲表示鄙视。

contend.en: Three armed groups are contending for power.
contend.zh: 三个武装集团在争夺权力。

contend.en: Inevitably, fights break out between the members of contending groups.
contend.zh: 争权夺利的几个团体之间不可避免地发生了打斗。

contender.en: Her album is a strong contender for the Album of the Year award.
contender.zh: 她的专辑是年度专辑奖的有力竞争者。

content.en: The customs official rummaged through the contents of his briefcase.
content.zh: 海关官员把他公事包里的物品翻了个遍。

content.en: Most of the gallery’s contents were damaged in the fire.
content.zh: 画廊里的大多数东西都被大火烧毁了。

contented.en: I felt warm, cosy, and contented.
contented.zh: 我感到暖和、舒适和满意。

contented.en: They lapsed into a contented silence.
contented.zh: 他们沉默不语，沉浸在幸福之中。

contention.en: Her main contention is that doctors should do more to encourage healthy eating.
contention.zh: 她的主要观点是医生应该更多地鼓励健康的饮食习惯。

contention.en: The issue of hunting is a source of contention.
contention.zh: 狩猎问题是争论的焦点。

contentious.en: Animal welfare did not become a contentious issue until the late 1970s.

contest.en: Stone decided to hold a contest to see who could write the best song.
contest.zh: 斯通决定举行一场比赛，看谁能够写出最佳歌曲。

contest.en: I only entered the contest for fun.
contest.zh: 我只是为了好玩才参加这次比赛的。

context.en: To appreciate what these changes will mean, it is necessary to look at them in context.
context.zh: 要明白这些变化的意义，就有必要了解它们的背景。

context.en: These incidents are best understood in the broader context of developments in rural society.
context.zh: 这些事件放在农村社会发展这一更大的背景中就容易理解了。

contingency.en: Add up your outgoings, putting on a bit more for contingencies.
contingency.zh: 把你的经常性开支加起来，再增加些钱用于意外开支。

contingent.en: Further investment is contingent upon the company’s profit performance.
contingent.zh: 进一步的投资取决于公司的利润情况。

contingent.en: Has the Scottish contingent arrived yet?
contingent.zh: 苏格兰代表团到了没有？

continual.en: She has endured house arrest and continual harassment by the police.
continual.zh: 她被软禁起来，并且遭到警方的频繁骚扰。

continual.en: We are continually reassessing the situation.

continuation.en: The present economic policy is a continuation of the earlier one.
continuation.zh: 现在的经济政策是以前政策的延续。

continuation.en: The Baltic Sea is a continuation of the North Sea.
continuation.zh: 波罗的海是北海的延伸。

continue.en: Sheila continued to work after she had her baby.
continue.zh: 希拉生了孩子后继续工作。

continue.en: He will be continuing his education in the US.

continuity.en: We should ensure continuity of care between hospital and home.
continuity.zh: 我们应当保证医院护理和家庭护理的连续性。

continuous.en: UMNO had ruled Malaysia continuously since independence.
continuous.zh: 马来西亚自独立以来一直由巫统领导。

continuum.en: The Creole language is really various dialects arranged on a continuum.
All the organisms in an ecosystem are part of an evolutionary continuum.
continuum.zh: 生态系统中的所有生物都是进化连续体的一个环节。

contract.en: Tyler has agreed a seven-year contract with a Hollywood studio.
contract.zh: 泰勒与好莱坞的一家制片厂签订了七年合同。

contract.en: The firm operates schools under contract to state education authorities.
contract.zh: 这家公司和州教育局签约办学。

contractual.en: Tutors have a contractual obligation to research and publish.
contractual.zh: 大学导师按合同规定必须从事研究工作并发表作品。

contradict.en: Deborah opened her mouth to contradict, but closed it again.
contradict.zh: 黛博拉张口想要反驳，但又把嘴闭上了。

contradict.en: Dad just can’t bear to be contradicted.
contradict.zh: 爸爸就是受不了有人反驳他。

contradiction.en: You can say what you like without fear of contradiction.
contradiction.zh: 你可以想说什么就说什么，不用担心遭到驳斥。

contradiction.en: Your behaviour is in direct contradiction to the principles you claim to have.
contradiction.zh: 你的行为与你所宣称的原则背道而驰。

contradictory.en: The public is being fed contradictory messages about the economy.
contradictory.zh: 民众在被灌输的是互相矛盾的经济信息。

contrary.en: It wasn’t a good thing; on the contrary it was a huge mistake.
contrary.zh: 那不是好事，恰恰相反，是个巨大的错误。

contrary.en: Unless there is evidence to the contrary, we ought to believe them.
contrary.zh: 除非有相反的证据，否则我们就应该相信他们。

contrast.en: While there are similarities in the two cultures, there are also great contrasts.
contrast.zh: 这两种文化虽然有许多相似之处，但也存在巨大的差异。

contrast.en: The marble is smooth and polished, making a strong contrast with the worn stonework around it.
contrast.zh: 大理石平滑光洁，和周围破旧的石结构形成了强烈的对比。

contribute.en: City employees cannot contribute to political campaigns.
contribute.zh: 市政府雇员不得捐助政治宣传活动。

contribute.en: The volunteers contribute their own time to the project.
contribute.zh: 志愿者为工程奉献出自己的时间。

contribution.en: Einstein was awarded the Nobel Prize for his contribution to Quantum Theory.
contribution.zh: 爱因斯坦因对量子论的贡献而获授诺贝尔奖。

contribution.en: The school sees its job as preparing students to make a contribution to society.
contribution.zh: 这所学校以培养学生为社会作贡献为己任。

contributor.en: Dr Win was a major contributor to the research.
contributor.zh: 温博士是此项研究的主要贡献者。

contributor.en: Cars are still one of the principal contributors to air pollution.
contributor.zh: 汽车仍是空气污染的主要因素之一。

contributory.en: Smoking is a contributory factor in lung cancer.
contributory.zh: 抽烟是导致肺癌的一个因素。

contrive.en: Schindler contrived to save more than 1,000 Polish Jews from the Nazis.
contrive.zh: 辛德勒设法从纳粹手中营救了1,000

contrive.en: The lawsuit says oil companies contrived the oil shortage in the 1970s.
contrive.zh: 诉讼中说，是石油公司策划了20

control.en: The disease robs you of muscle control.
control.zh: 这种疾病会让你丧失肌肉控制力。

control.en: Babies are born with very little control over their movements.
control.zh: 婴儿出生时对自己的肢体运动几乎没有控制能力。

controllable.en: Diabetes is a serious but controllable disease.
controllable.zh: 糖尿病是一种严重但可以控制的疾病。

controversial.en: He is a controversial figure (=person who does controversial things) in the art world.
controversial.zh: 他是艺术界极具争议的人物。

controversy.zh: 法官的判决引发了争议。

controversy.en: Controversy arose (=began) over the use of the chemicals on crops.
controversy.zh: 对庄稼施用化学品的做法引起了争论。

convenience.en: Ready meals sell well because of their convenience.
convenience.zh: 即食餐因为方便销路好。

convenience.en: Most of us like the convenience of using credit cards to buy things.
convenience.zh: 我们大多数人都喜欢使用信用卡购物的便利。

convenient.en: Mail-order catalogs are a convenient way to shop.
convenient.zh: 使用邮购目录是一种方便的购物方式。

convenient.en: My secretary will call you to arrange a convenient time to meet.
convenient.zh: 我的秘书会打电话给你安排一个方便的时间见面。

conveniently.en: Conveniently, her parents are often willing to babysit.
conveniently.zh: 方便的是，她父母通常都愿意临时照看一下小孩。

conveniently.en: At that time, ice cream couldn’t be conveniently bought in a store.
conveniently.zh: 那时候冰激凌还无法很方便地在商店里买到。

convention.en: Playing together teaches children social conventions such as sharing.
convention.zh: 一起玩耍可教会儿童与人分享等社会常规。

convention.en: They defied the conventions of the time by living together without being married.
convention.zh: 他们无视当时的社会习俗，未婚同居。

conventional.en: Internet connections through conventional phone lines are fairly slow.
conventional.zh: 通过传统的电话线来连接因特网速度很慢。

conventional.en: Bake for 20 minutes in a conventional oven; 8 in a microwave.

converge.en: The two rivers converge into one near Pittsburgh.
converge.zh: 这两条河在匹兹堡附近汇合。

conversant.en: Staff members are conversant with the issues.
conversant.zh: 员工对这些问题很有经验。

conversation.en: Children quickly get bored by adult conversation.
conversation.zh: 儿童对成年人的谈话很快就会厌倦。

conversation.en: They had a short conversation in German and seemed to be disagreeing about something.
conversation.zh: 他们用德语说了一会儿，好像对什么事有分歧。

conversational.en: The article was written in straightforward, almost conversational language.
conversational.zh: 这篇文章用简单易懂、几乎是谈话式的语言写成。

converse.en: She enjoyed the chance to converse with another French speaker.
converse.zh: 她很高兴有机会与另一位说法语的人交谈。

converse.en: Some teachers welcomed the change; but for the majority of teachers, the converse was true.
converse.zh: 有些教师欢迎这一改革，但大多数教师则持反对意见。

conversely.en: American consumers prefer white eggs; conversely, British buyers like brown eggs.
conversely.zh: 美国的消费者喜欢白色的鸡蛋，而英国的消费者却相反，他们喜欢棕色的鸡蛋。

conversion.en: The warehouse was undergoing conversion into apartments.
conversion.zh: 这座仓库在被改建成公寓。

conversion.en: The British conversion to the metric system took place in the 1970s.

convert.en: They converted the spare bedroom into an office.
convert.zh: 他们把备用卧室改成了办公室。

convert.en: The stocks can be easily converted to cash.

convey.en: All this information can be conveyed in a simple diagram.
convey.zh: 所有这些信息可以通过一张简单的图表来表示。

convey.en: Ads convey the message that thin is beautiful.

conveyance.en: Wheeled conveyances of any kind are not allowed in the park.
conveyance.zh: 任何有轮子的交通工具都不许在公园里行驶。

conveyance.en: Facial expressions are part of the conveyance of meaning.
conveyance.zh: 面部表情也是在表达意思。

convict.zh: 她被判犯有偷窃商店货物罪。

convict.en: He was convicted on fraud charges.

conviction.en: The Dotens have a deep conviction that marriage is for life.
conviction.zh: 多滕夫妇深信婚姻是一辈子的事。

conviction.en: The students possess the conviction that they can make a difference to their community.
conviction.zh: 学生们坚信他们能为社区带来变化。

convince.en: Her arguments didn’t convince everyone, but changes were made.
convince.zh: 她的论点不能说服每个人，但还是引起了一些变化。

convince.en: Baker had to convince jurors that his client had been nowhere near the scene of the murder.
convince.zh: 贝克必须使陪审员相信，他的当事人根本不在凶案现场。

convinced.en: Molly agreed, but she did not sound very convinced.
convinced.zh: 莫莉同意了，但是她似乎不是很信服。

convinced.en: I was convinced that we were doing the right thing.
convinced.zh: 我确信我们做的事情是正确的。

convincing.en: Courtenay played the role in an utterly convincing way.
convincing.zh: 考特尼把这个角色演得非常有说服力。

cook.en: Where did you learn to cook?
Cook the sauce over a low heat for ten minutes.
cook.zh: 把这调味汁用低火烧十分钟。

cool.en: She swam out into the cool water.
cool.zh: 她往外游向清凉的水里。

cooler.en: Mike went to fetch a bottle of wine from the cooler.
cooler.zh: 迈克从冰桶里拿来一瓶酒。

cooperate.en: The two universities are to cooperate in the development of a new industrial process.
cooperate.zh: 这两所大学将合作研发一个新的工业流程。

cooperate.en: They agreed to co-operate with Brazil on a programme to protect the rain forests.
cooperate.zh: 他们同意和巴西合作进行一个保护热带雨林的项目。

cooperation.en: A study was undertaken in co-operation with oil companies.
cooperation.zh: 与石油公司合作进行过一项研究。

cooperation.en: Burglar alarm companies claim they work in close co-operation with the police.
cooperation.zh: 防盗警报器公司称他们与警方有密切的合作。

cooperative.en: He was doing his best to be cooperative.

coordinate.en: The agencies are working together to co-ordinate policy on food safety.
coordinate.zh: 这些机构在共同合作为食品安全政策做协调工作。
她动作协调，显得很优美。

coordination.en: Too much alcohol affects your coordination.
coordination.zh: 喝酒太多会影响你动作的协调。

cop.en: He pulled out his badge and said he was a cop.
cop.zh: 他拿出警徽说自己是警察。

cop.en: They say he’s not much cop as a coach.
cop.zh: 他们说他当教练当得不怎么样。

cope.en: Sometimes I find it hard to cope.
cope.zh: 有时候我觉得很难应付。

cope.en: He coped quite well as manager while still captaining the team.
cope.zh: 他是球队的主教练，同时兼任队长，干得相当好。

copper.en: He offered to do the job for a few coppers.
copper.zh: 他说他来做这份工作，给他几个铜板就行。

copy.en: She forwarded them a copy of her British passport.
copy.zh: 她给他们寄去了她英国护照的复印件。

copy.en: This chair is a copy of an original design.
copy.zh: 这把椅子是原创设计的仿制品。

copyright.en: Who owns the copyright of this book?
The database will be protected by copyright.
copyright.zh: 这个数据库将受到版权保护。

cord.en: The robe was held at the waist by a cord.
cord.zh: 在袍子腰处束了根细绳。

cord.en: He pulled explosives and some tangled cord from his bag.
cord.zh: 他从他的包里掏出炸药和一些乱糟糟的绳子。

cordial.en: The talks were conducted in a cordial atmosphere.
cordial.zh: 会谈在友好的气氛中进行。

cordially.en: You are cordially invited to our wedding on May 9.

core.en: Remove the cores, and bake the apples for 40 minutes.
core.zh: 去除果心，然后把苹果烤40

core.en: The core of the book focuses on the period between 1660 and 1857.
core.zh: 这本书的中心内容集中在1660

corn.en: All our chickens are fed on corn.
corn.zh: 我们所有的鸡都喂玉米。

corner.en: He pulled a dirty handkerchief out by its corner and waved it at me.
corner.zh: 他拽出一块脏手帕，捏着一角向我挥动。

corner.en: Their initials were sewn on the corner of every pillow.
corner.zh: 每个枕头的角上都绣着他们姓名的首字母。

cornerstone.en: The magazine became the cornerstone of McFadden’s publishing empire.
cornerstone.zh: 这本杂志成了迈克法登出版帝国的支柱。

corporate.en: The company is moving its corporate headquarters (=main offices) from New York to Houston.
corporate.zh: 这家公司要把总部从纽约迁到休斯敦。

corporate.en: Vince is vice-president of corporate communications.
corporate.zh: 文斯是负责企业宣传的副总裁。

corporation.en: He works for a large American corporation.
corporation.zh: 他在一家美国大公司工作。

corpse.en: The corpse was found by children playing in the woods.
corpse.zh: 这具尸体是在林子里玩耍的孩子发现的。

corral.en: They corralled the cattle before loading them onto the truck.
corral.zh: 他们在把牛装上车以前，先把牛赶入了畜栏。

corral.en: Once at the airport, we were herded to the gate and corralled into a small room.
corral.zh: 我们一到机场就被赶到登机口，关进一个小房间里。

correct.en: If my calculations are correct, we’re about ten miles from Exeter.
correct.zh: 如果我计算得没错的话，我们离埃克塞特大约十英里。

correct.en: Score one point for each correct answer.

correction.en: I just need to make a few corrections, and then we can send it to the printer.
correction.zh: 我只要修改几个地方，然后就可以把它发送到打印机。

correction.en: That will basically cover 50 ... correction 60 percent of all charges.
correction.zh: 那基本上足够支付百分之五十的费用，不，是百分之六十。

corrective.en: The biography is a useful corrective to the myths that have grown up around this man.
corrective.zh: 这部传记有助于澄清围绕此人越来越多的传言。

correlate.en: Poverty and poor housing correlate with a shorter life expectancy.
correlate.zh: 贫困以及住房条件差和预期寿命较短是有关系的。

correlate.en: Lack of prenatal care correlates strongly with premature birth.
correlate.zh: 缺乏产前护理与早产有密切关系。

correlation.en: There is a direct correlation between the best-known brands and the best-selling brands.
correlation.zh: 知名品牌和畅销品牌是有直接关联的。

correlation.en: There’s also some correlation with social class.
correlation.zh: 和社会阶层也有些关系。

correspond.en: The two halves of the document did not correspond.
correspond.zh: 这份文件的前后两部分不相符。

correspond.en: The numbers correspond to points on the map.
correspond.zh: 这些数字与地图上的各点相对应。

correspondence.en: A secretary came in twice a week to deal with his correspondence.
correspondence.zh: 一个秘书每个星期来两次处理他的信件。

correspondence.en: The magazine is unable to enter into any correspondence on medical matters.
correspondence.zh: 本杂志无法答复有关医学方面的来信。

correspondent.en: Our correspondent in South Africa sent this report.
correspondent.zh: 我们的驻南非记者发来这份报道。

correspondent.en: I’m not a very good correspondent, I’m afraid.
correspondent.zh: 恐怕我不是个勤于写信的人。

corresponding.en: The war and the corresponding fall in trade have had a devastating effect on the country.
corresponding.zh: 战争以及由此所导致的贸易量下降对这个国家产生了致命的影响。

corresponding.en: Sales are up 10% on the corresponding period last year.
corresponding.zh: 销售比去年同期增加了10%

corridor.en: We had to wait outside in the corridor until our names were called.
corridor.zh: 我们只好在外面的走廊上等候叫我们的名字。

corrode.en: Acidic water will corrode the pipes.
Corruption has corroded our confidence in the police force.
corrode.zh: 腐败现象损害了我们对警察机关的信任。

corrosion.en: They are sprayed with oil to prevent corrosion.
corrosion.zh: 它们被喷了油以防腐蚀。
检查一下有没有腐蚀的痕迹。

corrupt.en: Corrupt judges have taken millions of dollars in bribes.
corrupt.zh: 腐败的法官接受了几百万美元的贿赂。

corrupt.en: Young prisoners are being corrupted by the older, long-term offenders.
corrupt.zh: 年轻的囚犯正在被年纪较大、刑期长的犯人带坏。

corruption.en: The investigation uncovered widespread corruption within the police force.
corruption.zh: 这项调查揭发出了警察机关内部普遍的腐败。

corruption.en: The word ‘Thursday’ is a corruption of ‘Thor’s Day’.

cosmetic.en: We’re making a few cosmetic changes to the house before we sell it.
cosmetic.zh: 我们在给房子的外部稍作装修，准备出售。

cosmetic.en: Many MPs denounced the resolution as a cosmetic exercise (=something which will look good, but have no real effect).
cosmetic.zh: 许多议员都谴责这项决议，说它是表面文章。

cosmopolitan.en: Brigitta has such a cosmopolitan outlook on life.
cosmopolitan.zh: 布丽吉塔的人生观非常豁达。

cosset.en: He cosseted her with flowers and champagne.
cosset.zh: 他用鲜花和香槟向她大献殷勤。

cost.en: I offered to pay the cost of the taxi.
Insurance to cover the cost of a funeral is possible.
cost.zh: 可以用保险支付葬礼费用。

costly.en: Such a database would be extremely costly to set up.
costly.zh: 建立这样一个数据库要花很多钱。

costly.en: His delay in making a decision could prove costly in the long run.
costly.zh: 他的优柔寡断长久下去要付出巨大代价。

costume.en: The dancers were in national costume.

cosy.en: The living room was warm and cosy.
He was accused of being too cosy with some clients.
cosy.zh: 他因为和几个客户关系过于密切而受到指责。

cottage.en: We’re staying in a holiday cottage in Dorset.
cottage.zh: 我们住在多塞特的一个度假小别墅里。

couch.en: Tom offered to sleep on the couch.
The offer was couched in legal jargon.
couch.zh: 那份提议是用法律术语写的。

cough.en: Matthew coughed and cleared his throat.
cough.zh: 马修咳了一声清清喉咙。

cough.en: I think I’m getting a cold or flu – I’ve been coughing and sneezing all day.
cough.zh: 我想我是着凉了，或者得了流感——

could.en: By the time she was eight, she could read Greek and Latin.
could.zh: 她八岁时就会读希腊文和拉丁文了。

could.en: In those days you could buy a box of cigars for a dollar.
could.zh: 那时候，一美元能买一盒雪茄烟。

council.en: He sent a letter to the council to complain about the noise.
council.zh: 他给地方议会寄了封信去投诉噪音问题。

councillor.en: Write to your local councillor to complain.
councillor.zh: 写信给你们当地的市政议员投诉。

counsel.en: The judge asked counsel for the defence to explain.
counsel.zh: 法官要求被告的辩护律师作出解释。

counsel.en: She counselled them not to accept this settlement.
counsel.zh: 她建议他们不要接受这个解决方案。

counsellor.zh: 你是不是在看心理辅导员？

count.en: I was amazed at the number of plants – I counted 147.
count.zh: 我对植物的数量之多感到惊讶，我数了有147

count.en: Count up how many ticks are in each box.
count.zh: 数一下每个方格里有多少打记号。

countenance.en: All colour drained from her countenance.
I will not countenance you being rude to Dr Baxter.
countenance.zh: 我不赞同你粗鲁地对待巴克斯特博士。

counter.en: He wondered if the girl behind the counter recognised him.
counter.zh: 他在想柜台后面的那个女孩是否认出了他。

counter.en: It’s risky, but you can get alcohol under the counter.
counter.zh: 虽然有些冒险，但你可以通过秘密渠道买酒。

counteract.en: They gave him drugs to counteract his withdrawal symptoms.
counteract.zh: 他们给他服药以消除他的脱瘾症状。

counterbalance.en: Riskier investments tend to be counterbalanced by high rewards.
counterbalance.zh: 较高风险的投资往往报以高回报。

countermand.en: Terrorists tried to force him to countermand the order to attack.
countermand.zh: 恐怖分子企图迫使他撤销进攻的命令。

counterpart.en: Belgian officials are discussing this with their French counterparts.
counterpart.zh: 比利时官员与法国同级官员正在讨论此事。

countersign.en: The note must be countersigned by a doctor.
countersign.zh: 这张证明必须有一个医生连署。

country.en: I’ve always wanted to live in the country.
The president has the support of the country.
country.zh: 总统有全国人民的支持。

countryside.en: The house had lovely views over open countryside.
countryside.zh: 这房子望出去是开阔的乡村美景。

countryside.en: The walk takes you through some beautiful countryside.
countryside.zh: 这条步行道带你穿越一些美丽的乡村地区。

couple.en: There are a couple of girls waiting for you.
I just need to make a couple more calls.

coupon.en: The coupon entitles you to ten cents off your next purchase.
coupon.zh: 这张优惠券可以让你在下次购物时节省10

coupon.en: To order, fill in the coupon on page 154.

courage.en: Sue showed great courage throughout her illness.
courage.zh: 休在生病期间表现出了极大的勇气。

courage.en: Gradually I lost the courage to speak out about anything.
courage.zh: 我逐渐失去了表达自己意见的勇气。

courageous.en: He was wrong, and courageous enough to admit it.
courageous.zh: 他是错了，而且有勇气承认自己错了。

courageous.en: It was brave of you to tell him what you thought.
courageous.zh: 你很勇敢，把你的想法告诉了他。

course.en: You can pay by cheque, assuming of course you have a valid cheque card.
course.zh: 你可以用支票来支付，不过当然你必须有一张有效的支票保付卡。

course.en: Of course there are exceptions to every rule.
course.zh: 当然，每条规定都会有例外。

court.en: It could not be proved in a court of law.
The court case lasted six weeks.
court.zh: 这场诉讼持续了六个星期。

courteous.en: The staff are always courteous and helpful.
courteous.zh: 员工们总是彬彬有礼、乐于帮助。

courtesy.en: It’s a matter of common courtesy to acknowledge letters.
courtesy.zh: 确认收到来信是起码的礼貌。

courtesy.en: He didn’t even have the courtesy to call and say he couldn’t come.
courtesy.zh: 他甚至连打个电话来说一声他不能来的礼貌都没有。

cousin.en: The Alaskan brown bear is a close cousin of the grizzly bear.
cousin.zh: 阿拉斯加棕熊是这种灰熊的近亲。

cousin.en: His avant-garde music, sometime cousin to jazz, had limited appeal.
cousin.zh: 他那种有点接近爵士乐的前卫派音乐，喜欢的人有限。

cover.en: Cover the pot and bake for an hour.
She wore a low-cut dress, partly covered by a thin shawl.
cover.zh: 她穿了件低胸连衣裙，搭了一条薄薄的披肩。

coverage.en: The allegations received widespread media coverage.
coverage.zh: 这些指控被媒体作了广泛报道。

coverage.en: Prestel’s website provides good coverage of the subject.
coverage.zh: 普雷斯特尔的网站对这方面有很好的探讨。

cow.en: The protesters had been cowed into submission by the police.
cow.zh: 抗议者在警察的威胁下屈服了。

coward.en: Try it. Don’t be such a coward.

crack.en: Don’t put boiling water in the glass or it will crack.
crack.zh: 不要把沸水倒进这个玻璃杯里，否则它会破裂的。

crack.en: Concrete is liable to crack in very cold weather.
crack.zh: 在严寒的天气条件下混凝土可能会开裂。

cracker.en: That was a cracker of a goal.

cradle.en: She rocked the cradle to quieten the child.
cradle.zh: 她摇动摇篮，让宝宝安静下来。

cradle.en: Athens is often regarded as the cradle of democracy.
cradle.zh: 雅典常常被认为是民主的发源地。

craft.en: The musician spends years perfecting his craft.
craft.zh: 这位音乐家多年来不断提高自己的艺术造诣。

craft.en: Craft and cunning were necessary for the scheme to work.
craft.zh: 实施这个阴谋需要诡计和狡猾。

craftsmanship.en: The carving is a superb piece of craftsmanship.
craftsmanship.zh: 这件雕刻是出色的手工艺品。

cram.en: Jill crammed her clothes into the bag.
cram.zh: 吉尔把自己的衣服塞进袋子里。

cram.en: A lot of information has been crammed into this book.
cram.zh: 这本书包含大量的信息。

cramp.en: Several players were suffering from cramp.
One of the swimmers got cramp and had to drop out of the race.
cramp.zh: 有一名游泳选手抽筋了，只好退出比赛。

crane.en: The children craned forward to see what was happening.
crane.zh: 孩子们探头向前看发生了什么事。

crane.en: He craned his neck above the crowd to get a better view.
crane.zh: 他伸长脖子，把头探出人群，想看得更清楚些。

crash.zh: 这架喷气式飞机起飞后就坠毁了。

crash.en: The plane crashed into a mountain.

crawl.en: The baby crawled across the floor.
There’s a bug crawling up your leg.
crawl.zh: 有只小虫子爬到你腿上了。

craze.en: She started a craze for this type of jewellery.
craze.zh: 她为这类首饰掀起了一股时尚热潮。

craze.en: At that time, scooters were the latest craze.
craze.zh: 那时候，小型摩托车是最新的时尚。

crazy.en: The neighbours must think we’re crazy.
crazy.zh: 邻居一定会认为我们疯了。
那绝对是个荒唐的想法。

cream.en: The students at this college are the cream of the crop (=the best of all).
cream.zh: 这所学院的学生是天之骄子。

creamy.en: Beat the mixture until smooth and creamy.
creamy.zh: 把混合物搅拌到均匀平滑为止。

crease.en: She smoothed the creases from her skirt.
I’ll have to iron out the creases.

create.en: Some people believe the universe was created by a big explosion.
create.zh: 有些人认为宇宙是通过一次大爆炸创造出来的。

create.en: Her behaviour is creating a lot of problems.
create.zh: 她的行为引起了很多问题。

creation.en: The dress is a stunning creation in green, gold, and white.
creation.zh: 这件礼服以绿色、金色和白色搭配，是绝妙的设计。

creation.en: Most countries have systems of government that are relatively modern creations.
creation.zh: 大多数国家的政体都是比较现代的产物。

creative.en: This job is so boring. I wish I could do something more creative.
creative.zh: 这工作太单调了，我希望能做些更有创造性的事情。

creative.en: I teach creative writing at Trinity College.
creative.zh: 我在三一学院教创意写作。

creativity.en: Teachers have been attacked for stifling creativity in their pupils.
creativity.zh: 教师被批评压抑了学生的创造力。

creativity.en: Editors complain about the lack of creativity in the ideas put to them.
creativity.zh: 编辑们抱怨说交给他们的选题缺乏创意。

creator.en: Walt Disney, the creator of Mickey Mouse

creature.en: The poll tax was a creature of the government.
He was a creature of the military government.

credence.en: I don’t give any credence to these rumors.
credence.zh: 我一点都不相信这些谣言。

credence.en: His ideas quickly gained credence among economists.
credence.zh: 他的观点很快就得到了经济学家的认可。

credible.en: He was unable to give a credible explanation for his behaviour.
credible.zh: 他无法对自己的行为作出可信的解释。
她的借口无法让人信服。

credit.en: Most new cars are bought on credit.
credit.zh: 大多数新汽车都是贷款购买的。

credit.en: The store agreed to let him have credit.

creditable.en: The team produced a creditable performance.
She did a creditable job of impersonating the singer.
creditable.zh: 她把那位歌手模仿得惟妙惟肖。

creed.en: Marxism has never been weaker as a political creed.
creed.zh: 作为一种政治信条，它从来没有像现在这样衰微过。

creek.en: If I don’t get my passport by Friday, I’ll be up the creek.
creek.zh: 如果到星期五我还拿不到护照的话，那就完了。

creep.en: Johann would creep into the gallery to listen to the singers.
creep.zh: 约翰会悄悄溜进楼座去听歌手唱歌。

creep.en: He crept back up the stairs, trying to avoid the ones that creaked.
creep.zh: 他蹑手蹑脚地回楼上，尽量避开那些嘎吱作响的梯级。

crest.en: It took us over an hour to reach the crest of the hill.
crest.zh: 我们花了一个多小时到达山顶。

crest.en: They crested a wooded hill shortly before sunset.
crest.zh: 太阳就要落山之前，他们登上了一座树木茂盛的小山巅。

crew.en: The plane crashed, killing two of the crew and four passengers.
crew.zh: 飞机坠毁，造成两名机组人员和四名乘客死亡。

crew.en: He joined the crew of a large fishing boat.
crew.zh: 他加入一艘大渔船船员的行列。

crime.en: We moved here because there was very little crime.
crime.zh: 我们搬到这里来是因为这里的犯罪率很低。

crime.en: Police officers are being given new powers to help combat crime.
crime.zh: 警官们被赋予新的权力帮助他们打击犯罪。

criminal.en: Experts cannot agree on the causes of criminal behaviour.
criminal.zh: 专家对犯罪行为的原因不能取得一致意见。

criminal.en: I was sure he was involved in some kind of criminal activity.
criminal.zh: 我肯定他在从事某种犯罪活动。

crimp.en: Use a hot iron to crimp the edges.
crimp.zh: 用热熨斗把边烫出小褶子。

crimson.en: The leaves turn crimson in autumn.
crimson.zh: 树叶在秋天变成了深红色。

cripple.en: She was crippled in a car accident.
cripple.zh: 她在一次车祸中成了瘸子。

cripple.en: Industry is being crippled by high interest rates.
cripple.zh: 工业因为利率高而受到重创。

crisis.en: The country now faces an economic crisis.
crisis.zh: 该国目前正面临一场经济危机。

crisis.en: The prime minister was criticized for the way in which he handled the crisis.
crisis.zh: 首相处理危机的方式遭到了批评。

crisp.en: She kicked at the crisp leaves at her feet.
crisp.zh: 她踢着脚边松脆的树叶。

crisp.en: He stepped carefully through the crisp deep snow.
crisp.zh: 他小心地走在松脆的、厚厚的雪地里。

crisscross.en: They spent the next two years crisscrossing the country by bus.
crisscross.zh: 接下来的两年他们乘公共汽车在乡间来回奔波。

criterion.en: Academic ability is not the sole criterion for admission to the college.
criterion.zh: 学术能力不是大学招生的唯一标准。

criterion.en: To qualify for a grant, students must satisfy certain criteria.
criterion.zh: 要具备领取奖学金的资格，学生必须符合某些标准。

critic.en: Critics of the scheme have said that it will not solve the problem of teenage crime.
critic.zh: 此项计划的批评者说它解决不了青少年犯罪问题。

critical.en: Many economists are critical of the government’s economic policies.
critical.zh: 许多经济学家批评政府的经济政策。

critical.en: Many parents are strongly critical of the school.
critical.zh: 许多家长对这所学校提出了强烈的批评。

critically.en: Ten people died and thirty were critically injured in a rail crash yesterday.
critically.zh: 在昨天的火车相撞事故中，有十人死亡，三十人重伤。

critically.en: She is still critically ill in hospital.
critically.zh: 她在医院里，病情仍然危险。

criticism.en: My main criticism of the scheme is that it does nothing to help families on low incomes.
criticism.zh: 我对该计划的主要批评意见是，它对低收入家庭而言毫无帮助。

criticism.en: Despite strong criticism, the new system is still in place.
criticism.zh: 尽管遭到了猛烈的批评，新制度依然原封不动。

criticize.en: Ron does nothing but criticize and complain all the time.
criticize.zh: 罗恩什么也不干，只是一味指责和抱怨。

criticize.en: The decision has been strongly criticized by teachers.
criticize.zh: 这一决定遭到了教师的强烈批评。

crook.en: The crooks got away across the park.
crook.zh: 那些骗子穿过公园跑掉了。

crooked.en: His lips curled into a crooked smile.

crop.en: The main crops were oats and barley.
crop.zh: 主要作物是燕麦和大麦。

crop.en: Fruit growers are gathering in a bumper crop (=a very large amount of something produced in a season).
crop.zh: 果农正在采摘丰收的果实。

cross.en: It’s easy to have an accident just crossing the road.
cross.zh: 单是过马路也容易发生意外事故。

crossing.en: You must give way to any pedestrians on the crossing.
crossing.zh: 必须让人行横道上的行人先行。

crossing.en: Turn left at the first crossing.
crossing.zh: 在第一个十字路口左转。

crossroads.en: Turn left at the next crossroads.
crossroads.zh: 在下一个十字路口左转。

crossroads.en: The car was approaching the crossroads.

crouch.en: He crouched in the shadows near the doorway.
crouch.zh: 他蹲在门道近旁的阴暗处。

crouch.en: Paula crouched down and held her hands out to the fire.
crouch.zh: 葆拉蹲下来，把手伸向火堆。

crow.en: He was crowing over winning the bet.
crow.zh: 他在大吹自己打赌赢了。

crow.en: Ben rushed to his father, crowing with pleasure.

crowd.en: There were crowds of shoppers in the street.
crowd.zh: 街上有成群成群的购物者。

crowd.en: A vast crowd gathered in the main square.
crowd.zh: 主广场上聚集了一大群人。

crowded.en: The train was very crowded, and we had to stand.
crowded.zh: 火车很挤，我们只好站着。

crowded.en: The narrow roads were crowded with holiday traffic.
crowded.zh: 狭窄的道路上挤满了度假的车流。

crown.en: The treaty of Troyes made Henry V heir to the crown of France.
crown.zh: 特鲁瓦条约使亨利五世成了法国的王位继承人。

crown.en: He has retired from the service of the Crown.
crown.zh: 他已经从王国政府退职。

crucial.en: This aid money is crucial to the government’s economic policies.
crucial.zh: 这笔援助金对政府的经济政策至关重要。

crucial.en: The work of monks was crucial in spreading Christianity.
crucial.zh: 修道士的工作对传播基督教起了关键性的作用。

crude.en: Private morality, in crude terms, is not the law’s business.
crude.zh: 简单地说吧，个人道德不属于法律的范畴。

cruel.en: His death was a cruel blow.
cruel.zh: 他的死是个无情的打击。
有时候生活残酷得让人无法承受。

cruelty.en: The children had suffered cruelty and neglect.
cruelty.zh: 这些孩子遭受虐待，无人照管。

cruelty.en: There was a hint of cruelty in Brian’s smile.
cruelty.zh: 布赖恩的微笑里流露出一丝残暴。

cruise.en: We were cruising in the Caribbean all winter.
cruise.zh: 整个冬天我们都在加勒比海乘船游览。

cruise.en: We were cruising along at 50 miles per hour.

crumb.en: She stood up to brush the crumbs off her uniform.
crumb.zh: 她站起来拂去制服上的面包屑。

crumb.en: Coat with bread crumbs and bake.

crumble.en: The old stonework was crumbling away.
crumble.zh: 古老的石筑部分逐渐崩塌。

crumble.en: The fall leaves crumbled in my fingers.

crumple.en: Dan tore the page out, crumpled it, and threw it in the wastepaper basket.
crumple.zh: 丹把这一页撕下来揉成一团，扔进了废纸篓。

crumple.en: The blow hit him on the head and he crumpled to the ground.
crumple.zh: 这一击打中他的头部，他瘫倒在地上。

crunch.en: The only sound was the crunch of tyres on gravel.
crunch.zh: 唯一的声音是轮胎压在砂砾上的嘎吱声。

crunch.en: Three new teachers were hired to help ease the crunch.
crunch.zh: 雇了三名新的老师以助解困。

crush.en: His leg was crushed in the accident.
crush.zh: 他的腿在事故中被压断。

crush.en: Two people were crushed to death in the rush to escape.
crush.zh: 两个人在逃生过程中被踩死。

crust.en: A hard gray crust had formed on the bottom of the tea kettle.
crust.zh: 茶壶底部结了一层灰色的垢。

crutch.en: I was on crutches for three months after the operation.
crutch.zh: 手术后我拄了三个月的拐杖。

crutch.en: As things got worse at work, he began to use alcohol as a crutch.
crutch.zh: 工作每况愈下，他就开始借酒消愁。

cry.en: Don’t cry, Laura. It’ll be OK.
Upstairs, a baby began to cry.
cry.zh: 楼上有个婴儿开始哭起来。

cube.en: Cut the meat into small cubes.

cue.en: Our success was the cue for other companies to press ahead with new investment.
cue.zh: 我们的成功给了其他公司一个信号，就是一定要有新的投资。

cue.en: I think that’s my cue to explain why I’m here.
cue.zh: 我想那是要我解释一下为什么我在这里。

cuff.en: She cuffed him playfully on the side of the head.
cuff.zh: 她开玩笑地拍拍他的脑袋。

cuisine.en: Enjoy the delicious cuisine created by our award-winning chef.
cuisine.zh: 请享用我们获奖厨师烹制的佳肴。

culminate.en: A series of events for teachers and students will culminate in a Shakespeare festival next year.
culminate.zh: 明年的莎士比亚戏剧节将为师生们的一系列活动画上句号。

culprit.en: Police finally managed to catch the culprit.
High production costs are the main culprit.
culprit.zh: 生产成本高是主要原因。

cult.en: Diet, exercise ... It’s all part of this cult of self-improvement.
O'Brien has a cult of devoted readers.
cult.zh: 奥布赖恩有一批忠实的读者。

cultivate.en: The land was too rocky to cultivate.
cultivate.zh: 这块地石头太多，无法耕作。

cultivation.en: These fields have been under cultivation (=used for growing crops) for years.
cultivation.zh: 这些田地已耕作很多年了。

cultivation.en: Terraces for rice cultivation covered the hillsides.
cultivation.zh: 山坡上全是种植水稻的梯田。

cultural.en: It is important to look at the political and cultural context in which the novel was written.
cultural.zh: 要考虑小说创作时的政治和文化背景，这一点很重要。

culturally.en: Teaching materials need to be culturally appropriate.
culturally.zh: 教材从文化角度来看必须恰当。

culturally.en: Historically and culturally, Britain has always been linked to the continent.
culturally.zh: 英国在历史上和文化上历来都和欧洲大陆休戚相关。

culture.en: We speak Danish at home so that the boys don’t lose touch with their language and culture.
culture.zh: 我们在家说丹麦语，这样男孩子们就不会脱离他们的语言和文化。

culture.en: In our culture, it is rude to ask someone how much they earn.
culture.zh: 在我们的文化里，问别人收入多少是不礼貌的。

cumbersome.en: Doctors are complaining that the system is cumbersome and bureaucratic.
cumbersome.zh: 医生抱怨说该体制复杂繁琐，很官僚。

cumulative.zh: 学习是个逐渐积累的过程。

cumulative.en: Depression is often caused by the cumulative effects of stress and overwork.
cumulative.zh: 抑郁症通常是由压力和过度劳累日积月累引起的。

cunning.en: She would use low cunning (=unpleasant dishonest methods) to win people’s sympathy.
cunning.zh: 她会耍卑鄙的花招来博得别人的同情。

cup.en: Mathew picked up the cup and sipped his coffee.
cup.zh: 马修拿起杯子抿了口咖啡。

cup.en: She put her cup and saucer down on the table.

curator.en: He’s Curator of Prints at the Metropolitan.
curator.zh: 他是大都会艺术博物馆印刷品馆部的主管。

curb.en: We are trying to keep a curb on their activities.
curb.zh: 我们正设法控制他们的活动。

cure.en: There is still no cure for AIDS.
There is no easy cure for loneliness.

curiosity.en: I opened the packet just to satisfy my curiosity.
curiosity.zh: 我打开包裹只是为了满足我的好奇心。

curiosity.en: The news aroused a lot of curiosity among local people.

deflect.zh: 他用前臂挡开了打来的一拳。

degrade.zh: 你怎么能写这种垃圾作品来自贬身份呢？

delude.zh: 一个人很容易误以为自己坠入了爱河。

description.zh: 这本小册子对每一个地方都作了简短的介绍。

desert.zh: 该国的这一地区大部分是沙漠。

design.zh: 这种新型飞机正处于最后的设计阶段。

desolate.zh: 妻子的死使戴维悲痛万分。

despair.zh: 过去，邻居的噪音常常吵得他心烦意乱。

desperate.zh: 我身无分文，已经走投无路了。

desperate.zh: 时间越来越少，我们越来越感到绝望。

desperation.zh: 她走投无路，只好偷东西吃。

desperation.zh: 绝望之际，我们只得去借这笔钱。

despite.zh: 尽管我们竭力想保住这所学校，当局还是决定把它关闭。

despite.zh: 尽管医生叫她休息，她还是去了西班牙。

despondent.zh: 吉尔失业一年了，开始变得非常消沉。

despondent.zh: 他对事态的发展感到越来越绝望。

destination.zh: 要留出充裕的时间前往目的地。

destination.zh: 毛伊岛是很受欢迎的旅游目的地。

destined.zh: 她似乎注定能够事业成功。

destroy.zh: 学校被大火彻底烧毁了。

destroy.zh: 这桩丑闻毁了西蒙斯，终结了他的政治生涯。

destruction.zh: 洪水给该地区带来了死亡和破坏。

detail.zh: 她把旅行的所有细节都告诉了我。

detail.zh: 托德把这次旅行的细枝末节都安排好了。

detain.zh: 她因腿部疑似骨折而被留医。
