deter.zh: 该公司的财务困境令潜在的投资者望而却步。

deter.en: The security camera was installed to deter people from stealing.
deter.zh: 安装监控摄像机来防止偷窃。

deteriorate.zh: 埃塞尔的健康状况恶化了。

deteriorate.en: The argument deteriorated into a fight.

determinant.en: Social class is a major determinant of consumer spending patterns.
determinant.zh: 社会阶层是决定消费者消费模式的主要因素。

determination.en: Yuri shows great determination to learn English.
determination.zh: 尤里表现出很大的决心要学好英语。

determine.en: Investigators are still trying to determine the cause of the fire.
determine.zh: 调查人员仍在设法弄清失火的原因。

determine.en: The aim of the inquiry was to determine what had caused the accident.
determine.zh: 调查的目的是要找出事故的原因。

determined.en: Gwen is a very determined woman.
determined.zh: 格温是个意志很坚定的女性。

deterrent.en: The small fines for this type of crime do not act as much of a deterrent.
deterrent.zh: 对于这种罪行，小额罚金起不到多大的威慑作用。

deterrent.en: Window locks are an effective deterrent against burglars.
deterrent.zh: 窗锁可以有效地阻止窃贼。

detest.en: The two men detested each other.

detour.en: We took a detour to avoid the town centre.

detract.en: One mistake is not going to detract from your achievement.
detract.zh: 一个失误无损于你的成就。

detractor.en: Even the president’s detractors admit that the decision was the right one.
detractor.zh: 连那些抨击总统的人也承认这项决定是正确的。

detriment.en: He worked very long hours, to the detriment of his marriage.
detriment.zh: 他的工作时间很长，不利于他的婚姻。

detrimental.en: Smoking is detrimental to your health.

devalue.en: Nigeria has just devalued its currency.
devalue.zh: 尼日利亚刚刚令自己的货币贬值。

devalue.en: History has tended to devalue the contributions of women.
devalue.zh: 历史往往贬低女性的贡献。

devastate.en: Rob was devastated by the news of her death.
devastate.zh: 罗布听到她死去的消息悲痛欲绝。

devastate.en: The city centre was devastated by the bomb.
devastate.zh: 市中心被这枚炸弹摧毁了。

devastating.en: Acid rain has a devastating effect on the forest.
devastating.zh: 酸雨对森林的破坏力极大。

devastating.en: The oil spill had devastating consequences for wildlife.
devastating.zh: 这次石油泄漏事故对野生生物造成了毁灭性的后果。

develop.en: Knowledge in the field of genetics has been developing very rapidly.
develop.zh: 遗传学领域的知识发展非常迅速。

develop.en: Corsica has developed its economy around the tourist industry.
develop.zh: 科西嘉岛的经济是围绕旅游业发展起来的。

development.en: We will keep you informed of developments.
development.zh: 我们会把最新动态告诉你。

development.en: The funds will be used for marketing and product development.
development.zh: 这笔资金将用于市场营销和产品开发。

developmental.en: Higher education is a continuing developmental process.
developmental.zh: 高等教育是一个持续的发展过程。

deviate.en: The plane had to deviate from its normal flight path.
deviate.zh: 飞机不得不偏离正常的航线。

device.en: The company makes devices to detect carbon monoxide.
device.zh: 这家公司生产一氧化碳检测设备。

device.en: Testing yourself with information on cards is a useful device for studying.
device.zh: 用卡片上的信息做自我测试是一种有效的学习方法。

devil.en: The villagers believed a devil had taken control of his body.
devil.zh: 村民们认为他被邪魔附身了。

devil.en: What on earth is wrong with the poor devil?
devil.zh: 这可怜的家伙到底怎么了？

devise.en: She devised a method for quicker communications between offices.
devise.zh: 她想出一种加快办公室之间通信联络的方法。

devoid.en: His face was devoid of any warmth or humour.
devoid.zh: 他的脸冷若冰霜，没有一丝幽默的表情。

devote.en: He devoted his energies to writing films.
devote.zh: 他致力于电影剧本的创作。

devote.en: She devoted herself full-time to her business.
devote.zh: 她把全部时间都倾注在生意上。

devoted.en: Isabella was devoted to her brother.
devoted.zh: 伊莎贝拉对弟弟尽心尽力。

devoted.en: The journal had a devoted following of around 1,000 subscribers.

devotion.en: Alanna has always shown intense devotion to her children.
devotion.zh: 阿兰娜对她的孩子一直都表现出深切的爱。

devour.zh: 男孩子们狼吞虎咽地把薄煎饼吃了。
他如饥似渴地读科幻小说。

diagnose.en: Joe struggled in school before he was diagnosed as dyslexic.
diagnose.zh: 乔在学校里学习很吃力，后来被诊断出患有诵读困难症。

diagnose.en: The illness was diagnosed as mumps.
diagnose.zh: 这病经诊断是流行性腮腺炎。

diagnosis.en: An exact diagnosis can only be made by obtaining a blood sample.
diagnosis.zh: 只有抽取血样才能作出准确的诊断。

diagonal.en: The path goes diagonally across the field.

dial.en: The lighted dial of her watch said 1.20.
dial.zh: 她手表上的夜光表面显示时间为1

dial.en: She looked at the dial to check her speed.
dial.zh: 她看了看仪表盘，以确认自己的速度。

dialect.en: The people up there speak a Tibetan dialect.
dialect.zh: 那里的人讲的是一种藏语方言。

dialogue.en: Students were asked to read simple dialogues out loud.
dialogue.zh: 学生被要求大声朗读简单的对话。

dialogue.en: There is a need for constructive dialogue between leaders.
dialogue.zh: 领导人之间需要进行建设性的对话。

diameter.en: Draw a circle six centimetres in diameter.
diameter.zh: 画一个直径为六厘米的圆。

diameter.en: The diameter of the Earth is about 13,000 km.

diamond.en: Cut the cookie dough into diamonds.
diamond.zh: 把做曲奇饼干的面团切成菱形。

diamond.en: You have to play a diamond.

diary.en: Inge kept a diary (=wrote in a diary) during the war years.
diary.zh: 英奇在战争年代里一直写日记。

diary.en: Did you put the meeting date in your diary?
diary.zh: 你把开会日期写在工作日程簿上了吗？

dictate.en: She’s dictating a letter to her secretary right now.
dictate.zh: 她现在正在给秘书口授一封信。

dictate.en: The media cannot be allowed to dictate to the government.
dictate.zh: 不能让媒体对政府发号施令。

dictation.en: There were no secretaries available to take dictation (=write down what someone is saying).
dictation.zh: 身边没有秘书记录口授内容。

die.en: He died in 1985 at the age of 76.
Her father died suddenly in an accident when she was only ten.

diet.en: Lyn always seems to be on a diet.
Not all diets are good for you.
diet.zh: 不是所有的节食方法都适合你。

differ.en: The two systems differ in many respects.
differ.zh: 这两个系统在许多方面不同。

differ.en: People differ from one another in their ability to handle stress.
differ.zh: 各人应对压力的能力有所不同。

difference.en: There’s a big difference between knowing that something is true, and being able to prove it.
difference.zh: 知道什么正确与能够证明它正确，这之间有很大的不同。

difference.en: There is very little difference between the parties on green issues.
difference.zh: 各党派在环保问题上分歧很少。

different.en: Our sons are very different from each other.
different.zh: 我们家几个儿子大不相同。
她的上衣和我的不一样。

differentiate.en: It’s important to differentiate between fact and opinion.
differentiate.zh: 把事实和观点加以区别很重要。

differentiate.en: It’s sometimes hard to differentiate one sample from another.
differentiate.zh: 有时候很难把样品区分开来。

difficult.en: It’s difficult to see how more savings can be made.
difficult.zh: 想要进一步节约看来是很难了。

difficulty.en: They had great difficulty in finding a replacement.
difficulty.zh: 他们找接替的人费了很大劲。

difficulty.en: He got to his feet with difficulty.

diffuse.en: The pollutants diffuse into the soil.
Their ideas diffused quickly across Europe.
diffuse.zh: 他们的观点很快在欧洲传播开来。

dig.en: They dig a small hole in the sand to bury their eggs.
dig.zh: 它们在沙地里掘一个小洞，把蛋掩埋在里面。

digest.en: Most babies can digest a wide range of food easily.
digest.zh: 大多数婴儿能轻易地消化很多种食物。

digest.en: I struggled to digest the news.
digest.zh: 我费力地琢磨着那条新闻。

digestion.en: Too much tea is bad for your digestion.

dignify.en: I cannot dignify him with the name ‘physician’.

dignity.en: The family faced their ordeal with dignity.
dignity.zh: 这一家人在磨难面前不失尊严。

dignity.en: Old people need to retain their dignity and independence.
dignity.zh: 老年人需要保持自尊和独立。

dilate.zh: 他详述了他们的英勇行为。

dilemma.en: I’m in a dilemma about this job offer.
dilemma.zh: 对于是否接受这个工作，我左右为难。

dilemma.en: This placed Robert Kennedy in a dilemma.

diligent.zh: 他们卖力地干了一上午。

dilute.en: Dilute the paint with a little oil.
dilute.zh: 用少量油把颜料稀释一下。

dilute.en: Any dilution of standards must be resisted.
dilute.zh: 任何降低标准的行为都必须加以抵制。

dim.en: The dim outline of a building loomed up out of the mist.
dim.zh: 一座建筑物巨大而朦胧的轮廓在雾霭中隐现。

dim.en: Miss Watson took a dim view of Paul’s behaviour.
dim.zh: 沃森小姐对保罗的行为颇为不齿。

dime.en: PhDs are a dime a dozen nowadays.
dime.zh: 如今哲学博士学位不值钱了。

dimension.en: His coaching has added another dimension to my game.
dimension.zh: 他的指导使我的技巧更进了一层。

dimension.en: It is important to keep in mind the historical dimension to these issues.
dimension.zh: 一定要考虑到这些问题的历史背景。

diminish.en: The party’s share of the electorate has diminished steadily.
diminish.zh: 支持这个政党的选民比例持续下降。

diminish.en: These drugs diminish blood flow to the brain.
diminish.zh: 这些药物会减少流向脑部的血液量。

din.en: The din of the engines was deafening.
Ged was trying to make himself heard above the din.
din.zh: 格德试图让人们在嘈杂的声音中听到他说的话。

dine.en: He was dining with friends at the Ritz.
dine.zh: 他和朋友在里茨饭店一起进餐。

dine.en: We dined on lobster and strawberries.
dine.zh: 我们正餐吃的是龙虾和草莓。

dinner.en: What time do you usually have dinner?
We’re having fish for dinner tonight.

dip.en: He dipped his hand in the water.
dip.zh: 他把手在水中浸了一下。

dip.en: Dip the strawberries into melted chocolate.
dip.zh: 把草莓在熔化的巧克力中蘸一蘸。

diploma.en: I’m hoping to get my teaching diploma this year.
diploma.zh: 我希望今年能拿到教师证书。

diplomacy.en: The job requires tact and diplomacy.
diplomacy.zh: 这份工作需要有圆通练达的处事能力。

diplomatic.en: Diplomatic efforts to end the fighting began on October 25.
The two countries established diplomatic relations last year.
diplomatic.zh: 去年两国建立了外交关系。

dire.en: The country is in dire need of food aid.
dire.zh: 这个国家急需食品援助。

direct.en: Experienced users have direct access to the main data files.
direct.zh: 高级用户可直接浏览主数据文档。

direct.en: I’m not in direct contact with them.
direct.zh: 我和他们没有直接的联系。

direction.en: Which direction did they go in?
The suspects were last seen heading in the direction of Miami.
direction.zh: 最后一次有人看见嫌疑犯时，他们正向迈阿密方向逃跑。

directive.en: The team leader will have a less directive role.
directive.zh: 队长的指导作用将会减少。

directly.en: The new property tax law won’t directly affect us.
directly.zh: 新的财产税法不会直接影响到我们。

directly.en: We hope to bring together the countries directly involved in the conflict.
directly.zh: 我们希望让直接卷入冲突的各国重归于好。

director.en: The company is run by a board of directors (=a group of directors).
director.zh: 这家公司由董事会管理。

directory.en: I couldn’t find your number in the telephone directory.
directory.zh: 我在电话簿上找不到你的电话号码。

dirt.en: You should have seen the dirt on that car!
dirt.zh: 你没看见那车上沾了多少泥！

dirt.en: His face and hands were black with dirt.
dirt.zh: 他的脸和手黑乎乎的，全是泥。

dirty.en: How did you get so dirty?
She circled the bedroom, picking up dirty clothes.
dirty.zh: 她在卧室里转了一圈，把脏衣服收拾起来。

disability.en: Public places are becoming more accessible to people with disabilities.
disability.zh: 公共场所越来越方便残障人士出入了。

disability.en: Evans lives on disability because of an accident that left her paralyzed.
disability.zh: 埃文斯因为一次意外事故导致身体瘫痪，靠残障福利金生活。

disable.en: Carter was permanently disabled in the war.
disable.zh: 卡特在那场战争中成了终生残废。

disable.en: The virus will disable your computer.
disable.zh: 这种病毒会使你的电脑瘫痪。

disabled.en: If you are elderly or physically disabled, massage can be beneficial.
disabled.zh: 按摩对老年人或有残疾的人很有好处。

disabled.en: The theatre has good access for the disabled.
disabled.zh: 这家剧院里的残障人士出入通道很便捷。

disadvantage.en: The disadvantage of the material is that it fades in strong sunlight.
disadvantage.zh: 这种材料的缺点是在强烈的阳光下会褪色。

disadvantage.en: There are some big disadvantages to marriage – you do lose a lot of your freedom.
disadvantage.zh: 结婚有一些大的不利方面——

disagree.en: He is tolerant of those who disagree with him.
disagree.zh: 他对与自己有分歧的人持宽容态度。

disagree.en: Experts disagree on how much the program will cost.
disagree.zh: 专家们对该项目会花费多少意见不一。

disagreement.en: We’ve had a few disagreements, but we’re still good friends.
disagreement.zh: 虽然有过一些分歧，但我们仍是好朋友。

disagreement.en: There were disagreements among doctors about the best way to treat the disease.
disagreement.zh: 这种疾病用什么方法治疗最好，医生的意见有分歧。

disallow.en: Manchester United had a goal disallowed.
disallow.zh: 曼联队的一个入球被判无效。

disappear.en: The sun had disappeared behind a cloud.
disappear.zh: 太阳躲到云后面不见了。

disappear.en: David watched her car until it disappeared from view.
disappear.zh: 戴维一直望着她的车，直到它从视线中消失。

disappearance.en: Police are investigating the woman’s disappearance.
disappearance.zh: 警方正在调查这名女子的失踪。

disappoint.en: Great things were expected of this band, and they didn’t disappoint.
disappoint.zh: 大家对这支乐队的期望很高，而他们也不负众望。

disappointed.en: Dad seemed more disappointed than angry.
disappointed.zh: 与其说爸爸生气，倒不如说他失望。

disappointed.en: I was disappointed that we played so well yet still lost.
disappointed.zh: 我们打得这么好可还是输了，我很沮丧。

disappointing.en: The Lakers’ loss in the playoffs was very disappointing.
disappointing.zh: 湖人队在季后赛中的失利令人十分失望。

disappointment.en: He could see the disappointment in her eyes.
disappointment.zh: 他看到了她眼中的失望。

disappointment.en: To Edward’s disappointment, Gina never turned up at the party.
disappointment.zh: 让爱德华感到扫兴的是，吉娜始终没在聚会上出现。

disapproval.en: Baxter eyed our clothes with obvious disapproval.
disapproval.zh: 巴克斯特打量我们的衣着，显然不满意。

disapproval.en: Clarissa shook her head in disapproval.
disapproval.zh: 克拉丽莎摇摇头表示反对。

disapprove.en: I knew my parents would disapprove, but I went anyway.
disapprove.zh: 我知道父母会反对，但我还是去了。

disapprove.en: I disapprove of diets; it’s better to eat sensibly.
disapprove.zh: 我不赞成节食，最好还是合理饮食。

disarm.en: Getting the rebels to disarm will not be easy.
disarm.zh: 要让叛乱分子解除武装并非易事。

disarm.en: Captured soldiers were disarmed and put into camps.
disarm.zh: 俘获的士兵被缴械后关进了战俘营。

disarray.en: This left the Liberal Party in total disarray.
disarray.zh: 这让自由党陷入一片混乱。

disarray.en: The delay threw the entire timetable into disarray.
disarray.zh: 这一延误打乱了整个时间安排。

disaster.en: One hundred and twenty people died in China’s worst air disaster.
The oil spill was a disaster for Alaskan sea animals.
disaster.zh: 石油泄漏对阿拉斯加的海洋动物是一场灾难。

disastrous.en: Climate change could have disastrous effects on Earth.
disastrous.zh: 气候变化可能给地球带来灾难性的影响。

disastrous.en: The move proved disastrous (=was disastrous) for the company.
disastrous.zh: 这一行动对公司来说是一场灾难。

disc.en: The report form is available on disc from Personnel.
disc.zh: 人事部有该报表的磁盘。

disc.en: He retired early because of a slipped disc (=one that has moved out of its correct place).
disc.zh: 他因椎间盘突出提早退休了。

discard.zh: 把所有旧清洁用品都扔掉。

discern.en: Officials were keen to discern how much public support there was.
discern.zh: 官员们急切地想了解公众的支持率有多高。

discern.en: We could just discern a town in the distance.
discern.zh: 我们依稀看到远处有一座城镇。

discharge.en: Hospitals now tend to discharge patients earlier than in the past.
discharge.zh: 与过去相比，现在医院更趋向于让病人早些出院。

disciple.en: He was also an avid reader and a disciple of Tolstoy.
disciple.zh: 他也是托尔斯泰的热心读者和信徒。

disciplinary.en: The investigation led to disciplinary action (=things you do to punish someone) against two officers.
disciplinary.zh: 调查使两名军官受到了纪律处分。

discipline.en: The book gives parents advice on discipline.
discipline.zh: 这本书指导父母如何管教孩子。

discipline.en: Working from home requires a good deal of discipline.
discipline.zh: 在家上班要有很强的自制力。

disclaim.en: Martin disclaimed any responsibility for his son’s actions.
disclaim.zh: 马丁否认对儿子的行为负有任何责任。

disclose.en: Some companies have already voluntarily disclosed similar information.
disclose.zh: 一些公司已经主动透露了类似的信息。

disclose.en: He refused to disclose the identity of the politician.
disclose.zh: 他拒绝透露那位政治家的身份。

discomfort.en: If the exercise causes discomfort, stop immediately.
discomfort.zh: 如果这项锻炼引起不适，就立即停止。
他笑了起来，让她很不自在。

discontent.en: Discontent with the current government is strong.
discontent.zh: 对现任政府的不满情绪很强烈。

discontent.en: There is widespread discontent at the quality of education.
discontent.zh: 对教育质量的不满情绪普遍存在。

discount.zh: 会员可享受八五折优惠。

discount.en: Employees can buy books at a discount.

discourage.en: My father is a lawyer, and he discouraged me from entering the field.
discourage.zh: 我父亲是一名律师，他劝我别干这一行。

discourage.en: You should not let one failure discourage you.
discourage.zh: 你不该失败一次就灰心丧气。

discourse.en: Candidates should engage in serious political discourse.
discourse.zh: 候选人应该参加严肃的政治对话。

discover.en: The body was discovered in a field.
discover.zh: 尸体是在一块田地里找到的。

discover.en: Forest Service crews often discover campfires that have not been put out completely.
discover.zh: 林务局工作人员常常发现未完全熄灭的营火。

discovery.en: The Hubble Telescope allowed astronomers to make significant discoveries about our galaxy.
discovery.zh: 哈勃望远镜使天文学家对我们的银河系有了重大发现。

discovery.en: By making new discoveries we expand our understanding of the natural world.
discovery.zh: 新的发现使我们增进对自然界的了解。

discredit.en: The company’s lawyers tried to discredit her testimony.
discredit.zh: 公司的律师试图质疑她的证词。

discredit.en: His theories have now been discredited.
discredit.zh: 他的理论人们现在已经不相信了。

discreet.en: He assured her that he would be discreet.
discreet.zh: 他向她保证会谨慎行事。

discreet.en: I stood back at a discreet distance.
discreet.zh: 我谨慎地保持一段距离站在后面。

discrepancy.en: Police found discrepancies in the two men’s reports.
discrepancy.zh: 警方发现两名男子的叙述不一致。

discrepancy.en: There is a large discrepancy between the ideal image of motherhood and the reality.
discrepancy.zh: 理想的母亲形象与现实之间有很大的差异。

discrete.en: The change happens in a series of discrete steps.
discrete.zh: 这个变化在一系列分离的步骤中发生。

discretion.en: The awards are made at the discretion of the committee.
Promotions are left to the discretion of the supervisor.

discriminate.en: Under federal law, it is illegal to discriminate against minorities and women.
discriminate.zh: 联邦法律规定，歧视少数民族和妇女是违法的。

discriminate.en: It was found that the company still discriminated on the basis of race in promotions.
discriminate.zh: 据发现，这家公司在晋升方面仍然存在种族歧视。

discuss.en: Littman refused to discuss the case publicly.
discuss.zh: 利特曼拒绝公开讨论此案。

discuss.en: If you would like to discuss the matter further, please call me.
discuss.zh: 如果你想进一步讨论此事，请打电话给我。

discussion.en: The embassy will continue discussions with the Chinese government.
discussion.zh: 大使馆将继续与中国政府进行商讨。

discussion.en: We have had discussions about her legal situation.
discussion.zh: 我们就她的法律状况已进行了讨论。

disdain.en: Childcare was seen as women’s work, and men disdained it.
disdain.zh: 照看儿童被视为女人做的工作，男人对此很不屑。

disease.en: She suffers from a rare disease of the brain.
disease.zh: 她患上了一种罕见的脑病。

disease.en: His father died of heart disease.

disentangle.en: It’s very difficult to disentangle fact from fiction in what she’s saying.
disentangle.zh: 很难分清她说的话哪些是真、哪些是假。

disentangle.en: She had just disentangled herself from a long relationship.
disentangle.zh: 她刚从一段长久的感情中解脱出来。

disgrace.en: Smith faced total public disgrace after the incident.
disgrace.zh: 事情发生之后，史密斯声名狼藉。

disgrace.en: Toranaga sent us away in disgrace.
disgrace.zh: 寅寿把我们灰溜溜地打发走了。

disgraceful.en: It’s a disgraceful waste of taxpayers’ money.
disgraceful.zh: 这样浪费纳税人的钱真是可耻。

disguise.en: Maybe you could disguise yourself as a waiter and sneak in there.
disguise.zh: 或许你可以假扮成一个侍者混进去。

disguise.en: He escaped across the border disguised as a priest.
disguise.zh: 他装扮成神父越境逃走了。

disgust.en: Joan looked at him with disgust.
Sam threw his books down in disgust and stormed out of the room.
disgust.zh: 萨姆气愤地扔下书，冲出房间。

disgusting.en: Rubbish was piled everywhere – it was disgusting.
disgusting.zh: 垃圾堆得到处都是，很恶心。

disgusting.en: Smoking is a really disgusting habit.
disgusting.zh: 吸烟是一种十分令人讨厌的习惯。

dish.en: I’ll just do the dishes before we go.
The menu includes a wide selection of vegetarian dishes.
dish.zh: 菜单上有品种丰富的素食。

dishonest.en: People on welfare are wrongly seen as lazy or dishonest.
dishonest.zh: 靠福利救济的人被误以为懒惰或不老实。

dishonest.en: A person is guilty of theft if he or she dishonestly obtains property.
dishonest.zh: 一个人如果以不诚实的手段获取财物，那就是犯了偷盗罪。

dishonour.en: You’ve brought enough dishonour on your family already without causing any more trouble.
dishonour.zh: 你惹的麻烦已经让你的家人够丢脸的了，不用再添乱了。

dishonour.en: He dishonored the uniform and did not deserve to be a marine.
dishonour.zh: 他玷污了这身军服，不配当一名海军陆战队士兵。

disillusion.en: I hate to disillusion you, but I don’t think she’s coming back.
disillusion.zh: 我真不愿意让你失望，但我想她是不会回来了。

disinclined.en: I was disinclined to talk to Sam about it.
disinclined.zh: 我不愿与萨姆谈这件事。

disintegrate.en: The plane just disintegrated in mid-air.
disintegrate.zh: 飞机就在半空中解体了。

disinterest.en: The exception to Balfour’s disinterest in social issues was education.
disinterest.zh: 贝尔福对社会问题不感兴趣，教育则是例外。

dislike.en: Why do you dislike her so much?
I dislike being the centre of attention.
dislike.zh: 我不喜欢成为注目的焦点。

dislodge.en: Ian dislodged a few stones as he climbed up the rock.
dislodge.zh: 伊恩攀岩的时候敲掉了几块石头。

disloyal.en: He felt he had been disloyal to his friends.
disloyal.zh: 他觉得自己对朋友不忠诚。

dismal.en: The future looks pretty dismal right now.
dismal.zh: 目前前景似乎相当暗淡。

dismal.en: The team’s record so far is pretty dismal.
dismal.zh: 该队到目前为止的成绩很糟糕。

dismantle.en: Chris dismantled the bike in five minutes.
dismantle.zh: 克里斯五分钟内就把自行车拆掉了。

dismay.en: They stared at each other in dismay.
I found to my dismay that I had left my notes behind.
dismay.zh: 我沮丧地发现自己忘了拿笔记了。

dismiss.en: The government has dismissed criticisms that the country’s health policy is a mess.
dismiss.zh: 有人认为国家医疗政策一塌糊涂，政府对这种批评持否认态度。

dismiss.en: He just laughed and dismissed my proposal as unrealistic.
dismiss.zh: 他只是笑了笑，认为我的建议不切实际，拒绝考虑。

dismissal.en: Wilson was claiming compensation for unfair dismissal.
dismissal.zh: 威尔逊正在就无理解雇要求赔偿。

dismissal.en: No dismissals have been announced yet.

disobey.en: In the army, it is a crime to disobey a superior officer.

disorder.en: He suffers from a rare disorder of the liver.
disorder.zh: 他患有一种罕见的肝病。

disorder.en: A number of stadiums were closed because of crowd disorder.
disorder.zh: 因发生群众骚乱，一些体育场被关闭了。

dispatch.en: A reporter was dispatched to Naples to cover the riot.
dispatch.zh: 一名记者被派往那不勒斯报道这场骚乱。

dispatch.en: Goods are normally dispatched within 24 hours.

dispel.en: We want to dispel the myth that you cannot eat well in Britain.
dispel.zh: 我们要消除在英国吃不好的误解。

dispel.en: Light poured into the hall, dispelling the shadows.
dispel.zh: 阳光洒进大厅，驱散了阴影。

dispense.en: Ann suggested that they dispense with speeches altogether at the wedding.
dispense.zh: 安建议省去婚礼上的所有致辞。

disperse.en: Police used tear gas to disperse the crowd.
disperse.zh: 警察用催泪瓦斯驱散人群。

disperse.en: The clouds dispersed as quickly as they had gathered.

displace.en: Coal has been displaced by natural gas as a major source of energy.
displace.zh: 作为一种主要能源，煤的地位已为天然气所取代。

displace.en: Fifty thousand people have been displaced by the fighting.
displace.zh: 五万人因为战争背井离乡。

display.en: The window display caught her eye.
display.zh: 橱窗陈列吸引了她的目光。

display.en: Mapplethorpe’s photographs were first put on display in New York.
display.zh: 梅普尔索普的摄影作品首先在纽约展出。

displeasure.en: Their displeasure at being kept waiting was clear.
displeasure.zh: 他们明显很恼火，因为让他们久等了。

disposal.en: Tanner had a lot of cash at his disposal.
disposal.zh: 坦纳手头有很多现金可以动用。

disposal.en: The profit or loss on the disposal of an asset must be accounted for.
disposal.zh: 资产处置的盈亏情况必须说明。

dispose.en: Chinese vases are disposed around the gallery.
dispose.zh: 中国花瓶摆放在展馆四周。

dispose.en: I am still not sure how best to dispose of the shares.
dispose.zh: 我仍然不能确定这些股份怎样处置最好。

disposed.en: Management is favourably disposed to the idea of job-sharing.
Jon disagreed, but did not feel disposed to argue.
disposed.zh: 乔恩不赞成，但他并不想争辩。

disposition.en: The film is not suitable for people of a nervous disposition.
disposition.zh: 这部影片不适合神经质的人观看。

disposition.en: Neither side shows the slightest disposition to compromise.
disposition.zh: 双方都没有表露出丝毫妥协的意思。

disprove.zh: 这些数据证明史密斯的论点是错误的。

dispute.en: The firm is involved in a legal dispute with a rival company.
dispute.zh: 这家公司与一家竞争对手公司发生了法律纠纷。

dispute.en: He got into a dispute over a taxi fare.
dispute.zh: 他因出租车费和人发生了争执。

disregard.en: He ordered the jury to disregard the witness’s last statement.
disregard.zh: 他指示陪审团忽略证人的最后一句话。
马克完全不听我的建议。

disrepute.en: He faces six charges of bringing the game into disrepute.
disrepute.zh: 他面临六项破坏这项运动声誉的指控。

disrepute.en: This theory fell into disrepute in the fifties.

disrupt.en: Traffic was disrupted by a hoax bomb.
disrupt.zh: 有人虚报有炸弹，造成了交通混乱。

disrupt.en: Climate change could disrupt the agricultural economy.
disrupt.zh: 气候变化可能给农业经济带来不良影响。

disruption.zh: 罢工造成了大规模的混乱。

disruption.en: There will be some disruption to traffic while the work is in progress.
disruption.zh: 施工期间会对交通造成一些混乱。

disruptive.en: Night work can be very disruptive to home life.
disruptive.zh: 夜间工作会给家庭生活带来很大的麻烦。

disruptive.en: Mike’s parents thought I was a disruptive influence (=a person who causes disruption).
disruptive.zh: 迈克的父母认为我是个捣蛋分子。

disseminate.en: Her findings have been widely disseminated.

dissension.en: This move sowed dissension within the party ranks.
dissension.zh: 这一举动在党内成员中间播下了不和的种子。

dissension.en: The Labour Party was torn by internal dissensions.
dissension.zh: 工党因内部纷争产生分裂。

dissenter.zh: 持不同政见者遭到监禁。

dissimilar.en: Madonna’s career is not dissimilar to (=is quite similar to) Cher’s.
dissimilar.zh: 麦当娜的艺术生涯与雪儿不无类似。

dissipate.en: As he thought it over, his anger gradually dissipated.
dissipate.zh: 他想明白后，怒气就渐渐消了。

dissipate.en: Little by little, the smoke was dissipated by the breeze.
dissipate.zh: 在微风的吹拂下烟雾渐渐地消散了。

dissolution.en: The president announced the dissolution of the National Assembly.
dissolution.zh: 总统宣布解散国民议会。

distance.en: Measure the distance between the two points.
The cottage is some distance (=quite a long distance) from the road.
distance.zh: 小屋离开大路有些距离。

distant.en: Her honeymoon seemed a distant memory.
distant.zh: 她的蜜月似乎成了遥远的记忆。

distant.en: That affair was in the dim and distant past (=a long time ago).
distant.zh: 那件事已成为遥远的过去了。

distasteful.en: What follows is John’s story. Parts of it may seem distasteful, even shocking.
distasteful.zh: 接下来是约翰的叙述，其中有些部分也许令人不快，甚至令人震惊。

distill.en: The notes I had brought back were waiting to be distilled into a book.
distill.zh: 我带回来的笔记尚待整理成书。

distinct.zh: 有四种完全不同的类型。

distinct.en: The learning needs of the two groups are quite distinct from each other.
distinct.zh: 这两个组的学习需求区别很大。

distinction.en: There is often no clear distinction between an allergy and food intolerance.
distinction.zh: 过敏和食物不耐受之间往往没有明显的区别。

distinction.en: The Act makes no distinction between children and adults (=it treats them as if they were the same).
distinction.zh: 这条法令对儿童和成年人同等对待。

distinctly.en: He distinctly remembered the day his father left.
distinctly.zh: 他清晰地记得父亲离开的那一天。

distinguish.en: His attorney argued that Cope could not distinguish between right and wrong.
distinguish.zh: 他的辩护律师辩称科普无法分辨是非。

distinguish.en: He can’t tell the difference between right and wrong.

distinguishable.en: The fake was barely distinguishable from the original painting.
distinguishable.zh: 这幅赝品与原画几乎无法区别。

distinguishable.en: The cheese is easily distinguishable by its colour.
distinguishable.zh: 这种奶酪从颜色上很容易辨认。

distort.en: Tall buildings can distort radio signals.
distort.zh: 高大的建筑物会使无线电信号失真。

distort.en: His account was badly distorted by the press.
distort.zh: 他的话被报界严重歪曲。

distract.en: Try not to distract the other students.
distract.zh: 尽量不要让其他学生分心。

distract.en: Coverage of the war was used to distract attention from other matters.
distract.zh: 对战争的报道被用来分散对其他事情的注意力。

distraction.en: I study in the library as there are too many distractions at home.
distraction.zh: 我在图书馆学习，家里分心的事太多。

distraction.en: Demands for equality were seen as a distraction from more serious issues.
distraction.zh: 要求平等被视为分散了人们对更严重问题的注意力。

distress.en: Luke’s behaviour caused his parents great distress.
distress.zh: 卢克的行为使他的父母深感忧虑。

distress.en: The girl was crying and clearly in distress.
distress.zh: 那女孩哭着，显然很悲伤。

distribute.en: Clothes and blankets have been distributed among the refugees.
distribute.zh: 已经向难民分发了衣物和毯子。

distribute.en: Milk is distributed to the local shops by Herald’s Dairies.
distribute.zh: 牛奶由赫勒尔德乳品公司分销给当地商店。

distrust.en: Local people regard the police with suspicion and distrust.
distrust.zh: 当地人对警察持怀疑、不信任的态度。

distrust.en: Dylan’s deep distrust of journalists made him difficult to interview.
distrust.zh: 迪伦对记者的极度不信任使他们很难采访他。

disturb.en: Sorry to disturb you, but I have an urgent message.
disturb.zh: 对不起打扰一下，我有个紧急消息。

disturb.en: The thieves fled when they were disturbed by a neighbour.
disturb.zh: 窃贼们被一名邻居惊动后逃跑了。

disturbance.en: There were disturbances in the crowd as fans left the stadium.
disturbance.zh: 球迷离开体育场时，人群中发生了骚乱。

disturbance.en: We arrange the work so there’s as little disturbance as possible.
disturbance.zh: 我们把工作安排得尽量不引起干扰。

disuse.en: The building eventually fell into disuse.
disuse.zh: 该建筑物最终被废弃不用了。

ditch.en: The government has ditched plans to privatise the prison.
ditch.zh: 政府放弃了监狱私有化的计划。

ditch.en: Meg and Neil were due to marry, but she ditched him.
ditch.zh: 梅格与尼尔本来是要结婚的，可她把他给甩了。

ditto.en: Where should she go? Mississippi? Too hot. Ditto Alabama.
ditto.zh: 她应该去哪里呢？密西西比州？太热了。亚拉巴马州也一样。

dive.en: Diving off the cliffs is dangerous.
dive.zh: 从悬崖上跳水是很危险的。

diverge.en: The two species diverged millions of years ago.
diverge.zh: 这两个物种从数百万年前开始朝不同方向演变。

diverge.en: Global growth rates are diverging markedly.
diverge.zh: 世界各地的增长率在发生明显的分化。

diversify.en: The company is planning to diversify into other mining activities.
diversify.zh: 公司打算将经营范围扩大到其他采矿业务。

diversify.en: We need to diversify the economy.

diversion.en: Two prisoners created a diversion to give the men time to escape.
diversion.zh: 两名囚犯想办法分散了大家的注意力，使那些人有时间逃跑。

diversity.en: The curriculum will take account of the ethnic diversity of the population.
diversity.zh: 课程编排将考虑到人口中民族的多元化。

divert.en: The company should divert more resources into research.
divert.zh: 这家公司应该把更多的资源用于研究。

divert.en: Officials diverted revenue from arms sales to the rebels.
divert.zh: 官员们将军火销售的收益转到了叛乱分子手中。

divide.en: Scientists traditionally divide the oceans into zones.
divide.zh: 科学家传统上都把海洋划分成区。

divide.en: The book is divided into six sections.

dividend.en: Good eating habits will pay dividends later on in life.
dividend.zh: 保持良好的饮食习惯，将来会受益的。

divine.en: Somehow, the children had divined that he was lying.
divine.zh: 不知怎的，孩子们猜出了他在说谎。

division.en: Can he heal the deep divisions among Republican ranks?
division.zh: 他能够弥合共和党党员之间严重的分歧吗？

division.en: The old class divisions had begun to break down.
division.zh: 古老的阶级分化开始消失了。

divisive.en: The strike was a divisive issue in the community.
divisive.zh: 这场罢工导致社区内部分歧。

divorce.en: Why doesn’t she get a divorce?
One in three marriages ends in divorce.
divorce.zh: 有三分之一的婚姻以离婚告终。

dizzy.en: The heat and the champagne made him feel dizzy.
dizzy.zh: 高温和香槟酒使他感到眩晕。

dizzy.en: She started to suffer from dizzy spells (=a short period when you feel dizzy).
dizzy.zh: 她开始感到一阵阵的眩晕。

dna.en: A DNA test showed that he was not the baby's father.
dna.zh: 检测显示，他并非婴儿的父亲。

do.en: I don’t feel like going out tonight.

dock.en: A crowd was waiting at the dock to greet them.
dock.zh: 一群人在码头等着迎接他们。

dock.en: The ship is in dock for repairs.

doctor.en: She was treated by her local doctor.
doctor.zh: 她由她的本区医生治疗。

doctor.en: I’d like to make an appointment to see Dr Pugh.

doctorate.en: She received her doctorate in history in 1998.

document.en: His research documents how the crisis occurred.
document.zh: 他的研究记录了危机是如何发生的。

document.en: It is well documented that men die younger than women.
document.zh: 有充分文献证明男人比女人寿命短。

documentary.en: A local film crew is making a documentary about volcanoes.
documentary.zh: 当地的一批摄制人员正在拍摄关于火山的纪录片。

documentary.en: One of the most useful sources of documentary evidence is maps.
documentary.zh: 最有价值的文献证据之一就是地图。

documentation.zh: 申请人必须提供证明文件。

dodge.en: He ran across the courtyard, dodging a storm of bullets.
dodge.zh: 他跑过院子，躲避雨点般的子弹。

dodge.en: Helen clutched Edward’s arm as they dodged through the traffic.
dodge.zh: 海伦紧紧地抓住爱德华的胳膊，两人躲闪着穿行在车流中。

dog.en: I could hear a dog barking.
He's taken the dog for a walk.

dole.en: Too many young people are still on the dole.
dole.zh: 还在吃政府救济的年轻人太多了。

dole.en: The number claiming dole went up by 3,500.
dole.zh: 申请领取救济金者增加了3,500

doll.en: Hey, doll, why don’t you get me a cup of coffee?
doll.zh: 嗨，大美人，干吗不给我来杯咖啡？
谢谢，你可真是个大好人。

dollar.en: You can pay in dollars or euros at the airport.
dollar.zh: 在机场你可以使用美元或欧元。

domain.en: This problem is outside the domain of medical science.
domain.zh: 这个问题不属于医学范畴。

domain.en: Looking after the house was viewed as a woman’s domain.
domain.zh: 料理家务被认为是女性的份内之事。

domestic.zh: 美国的对外及对内政策

domestic.en: Domestic flights (=flights that stay inside a particular country) go from Terminal 1.
domestic.zh: 国内航班从一号航站楼出发。

dominant.en: The dominant male gorilla is the largest in the group.
dominant.zh: 领头的公猩猩是这群大猩猩中体形最大的一个。

dominant.en: Japan became dominant in the mass market during the 1980s.

dominate.en: The industry is dominated by five multinational companies.
dominate.zh: 这个行业受五家跨国公司控制。

dominate.en: New Orleans dominated throughout the game.
dominate.zh: 新奥尔良队自始至终都控制着这场比赛。

donate.en: Last year he donated $1,000 to cancer research.

donation.en: Would you like to make a donation (=give money) to our charity appeal?
donation.zh: 你愿意响应我们的慈善呼吁捐款吗？

donation.en: There have been generous donations from EEC funds.
donation.zh: 欧盟基金给予了慷慨的捐款。

donkey.en: I’ve had this jacket for donkey’s years.
donkey.zh: 这件夹克衫我穿了好多年了。

donor.en: We urgently need more assistance from donor countries (=countries that give money, food etc to help in poor countries or disaster areas).
donor.zh: 我们急需捐赠国的更多援助。

donor.en: An anonymous donor (=whose name is unknown) has given £500 towards the restoration fund.
donor.zh: 一位匿名捐赠者向重建基金捐了500

doom.en: Many species are doomed to extinction.
The plan was doomed from the start.
doom.zh: 这个计划一开始就注定要失败。

door.en: Could you open the door for me?
The door flew open and Ruth stormed in.
door.zh: 门一下子打开了，露丝气冲冲地跑了进来。

doorway.en: There was Paolo, standing in the doorway.
doorway.zh: 保罗就在那里，站在门口。

dormant.en: The seeds remain dormant until the spring.
dormant.zh: 春天到来之前这些种子呈休眠状态。

dosage.en: He was recommended a high dosage of morphine.
dosage.zh: 他被建议使用大剂量的吗啡。

dosage.en: The daily dosage is steadily reduced over several weeks.
dosage.zh: 几周之内逐渐减少每日剂量。

dose.en: Never exceed the recommended dose of painkillers.
dose.zh: 服用止痛药不可超过建议的剂量。

dose.en: Start with a low dose and increase it.
dose.zh: 从小剂量开始，然后再增加。

dot.en: I’ll be there on the dot.

doubt.en: The incident raises doubts about the safety of nuclear power.

downtown.zh: 她为迈阿密市中心的一家法律事务所工作。

downward.zh: 她又是酗酒又是吸毒，在这个旋涡中越陷越深。

doze.en: Grandad was dozing in his chair.

drab.en: The walls were painted a drab green.

draft.en: I read the first draft and thought it was very good.
draft.zh: 我读了第一稿，觉得非常好。

draft.en: All parties eventually approved the final draft (=finished form) of the peace treaty.
draft.zh: 各方最后都同意了和平条约的终稿。

drag.zh: 英奇费了很大劲把桌子拖进厨房里。

drag.zh: 他抓住她的手臂把她拖进房间。

drain.zh: 每年冬天这座游泳池都要排干清洗。

drain.zh: 布拉德将引擎中的润滑油全部放掉。

drainage.zh: 在花盆底下放一把鹅卵石能够帮助排水。

drama.zh: 他在喜剧片《潜伏特工》中扮演一名俄罗斯间谍。

drama.zh: 玛吉的生活总是充满了戏剧性。

dramatic.en: Computers have brought dramatic changes to the workplace.
dramatic.zh: 电脑给职场带来了巨大的变化。

dramatic.en: Universities have suffered a dramatic drop in student numbers.
dramatic.zh: 大学里学生的数量急剧减少。

dramatize.zh: 你为什么事事都要夸张呢？

dramatize.zh: 这一事件使得项目中的种种困难更为引人注目了。

drape.en: He took off his coat and draped it over a chair.
drape.zh: 他脱下外套搭在椅子上。

drape.zh: 米娜向后躺着，手臂懒懒地搁在靠垫上。

drastic.zh: 如果条件得不到满足，北约威胁将要采取严厉的行动。

drastic.zh: 要想避免环境灾难就需要重大的变革。

draw.zh: 凯蒂画了一间小茅舍，旁边流淌着一条小溪。

draw.zh: 她让小女孩把刚才和她说话的那个男人画出来。

drawback.zh: 这是座很不错的城市，唯一的不足就是天气。

drawback.zh: 这些产品的主要不足之处在于它们总是偏咸。

dread.zh: 明天我要去面试，我正担心呢。

dreamy.zh: 他是个艺术家，不修边幅，太爱幻想，和她不般配。

dredge.zh: 《新闻周刊》杂志翻出一些他去年讲过的话来。

drench.zh: 一大清早他们在草丛里弄得浑身湿透。

drowse.zh: 我正坐在电视机前打瞌睡，恰好你打电话来。

drug.en: A lot of young people start taking drugs at school.
drug.zh: 许多年轻人上学时开始吸毒。

drunk.zh: 戴维常会喝醉，我就得把他弄回家放到床上。

drunk.zh: 他喝啤酒和威士忌喝醉了。

drunken.zh: 她醉得神志不清，躺在人行道上。

dual.zh: 这座桥有双重用途，既作公路又作铁路。

dual.zh: 她有加拿大和英国双重国籍。

dubious.zh: 该公司被指控有不诚实的会计行为。

dubious.zh: 许多批评家认为这一论点靠不住，或者说至少有误导性。

duck.zh: 她学跳舞简直是易如反掌。

duct.zh: 空气加热后通过大管道循环输送到房子的各处。

due.zh: 他的新书预计明年出版。

dull.zh: 有伊丽莎白在这里生活绝不会无聊。

duly.zh: 这是你的旅行证件，都签好了。

duly.zh: 女王准时出现在阳台上，向人群招手。

dumb.zh: 她可不是那种没有头脑的金发女郎。

dummy.zh: 在演习中使用的导弹弹头将是仿制品。

dump.zh: 他们把成吨的盐撒到结冰的路面上使行车更安全。

dusk.en: The street lights go on at dusk.

dust.en: All the furniture was covered in dust.
dust.zh: 所有的家具都蒙上了灰尘。

duty.zh: 我们感到帮助她是我们的责任。

dwarf.zh: 周围的摩天大楼使得大教堂显得很矮小。

dwell.zh: 那不是我愿意多谈的话题。

dweller.en: City dwellers suffer higher pollution levels.
dweller.zh: 城市居民承受的污染程度更严重。

dye.zh: 普里希拉的头发染成了乌黑色。

dying.zh: 钱德勒的进球是在最后几分钟里打入的。

dying.zh: 她的临终遗愿是办个简朴的葬礼。

dynamic.zh: 他研究群体互动和领导风格。

dynamic.zh: 她把阶级冲突看成是历史变革的核心驱动力。

each.en: She had a bottle in each hand.
each.zh: 她两只手上各拿着一个瓶子。

eagle.zh: 他们在主人的严密注视下继续干活。

earmark.zh: 他被指定为未来的领袖。

earner.zh: 对普通工薪阶层来说，雇家庭保姆照顾孩子还是太贵。

earner.zh: 他是家里唯一挣工资的人。

earnest.zh: 马修斯在和一个年轻姑娘认真地谈话。

earnest.zh: 星期一你的训练就正式开始了！

earnings.zh: 他要求对工资的损失作出补偿。

earnings.zh: 公司第一季度的利润下降了5%

earth.zh: 他们望着风筝落回地面。

earthly.zh: 我不明白为什么他不该来。

ease.zh: 破译那些安全密码相对容易。

easily.en: We found the house easily enough.
easily.zh: 我们轻轻松松就找到了房子。

easter.en: We’ll probably go away at Easter.
easter.zh: 复活节我们可能会外出度假。

easter.zh: 我们在威尔士度过了复活节假期。

easy.zh: 完成这项任务并不容易。

eat.zh: 费利克斯一边吃一边兴奋地聊天。

eat.zh: 一个小女孩在吃冰激凌。

ebb.en: His confidence is at a low ebb.

eccentric.en: His eccentric behaviour lost him his job.
eccentric.zh: 他古怪的行为使他丢了工作。

eccentric.en: Aunt Nessy was always a bit eccentric.
eccentric.zh: 内西姑妈总是有点古怪。

eccentricity.zh: 凯特的母亲是个出了名的怪人。

eccentricity.zh: 我觉得他的怪癖挺好笑，并不烦人。

echo.zh: 从茂密的森林里传来引擎的回声。

echo.zh: 他听见恐怖的声响在走廊里回荡。

eclipse.zh: 许多人预计电视业的发展会使广播业黯然失色。

eclipse.zh: 博赞基特夫人的小说现在已经湮没无闻。

economically.zh: 在经济发达国家，女性结婚比较晚。

economize.zh: 较高的赋税促使人们节省燃料。

economy.en: The council must make economies to meet government spending targets.
economy.zh: 市政会必须采取节约措施以达到政府的开支指标。

economy.zh: 不给个人财产投保实际上并不划算。

edge.zh: 把鸡蛋放在盘子中间，盘边一圈放些蔬菜和香草。

edge.zh: 珍妮弗走到树林的边上。

edible.zh: 这些浆果可以吃，但那些有毒。

edifice.zh: 他们的总部大楼是一幢宏伟建筑。

edit.zh: 这家报社刊登读者来信前先作校订。

edit.zh: 她曾担任《观察家报》的主编。

educable.zh: 当时认为失聪的儿童无法教育。

educate.zh: 奥默罗德学校的教育对象为残疾儿童。

education.zh: 她也希望她的孩子可以受到良好的教育。

effect.zh: 父母离婚给我带来了很大的影响。

effect.zh: 我能感觉到山上稀薄空气产生的影响。

effective.zh: 较便宜的药品对治疗关节炎同样有效。

effective.zh: 训练的效果往往远低于预期。

effectively.zh: 小孩子应该学会有效地沟通。

effectively.zh: 事实上，我们已不可能帮忙了。

efficiency.zh: 公司正在采取措施提高效率，降低成本。

efficiency.en: In a search for greater efficiency, the two departments have merged.
efficiency.zh: 为了寻求高效，两个部门合并了。

efficient.en: Lighting is now more energy efficient.
efficient.zh: 如今的照明设备更加节能。

effort.en: Lou lifted the box easily, without using much effort.
effort.zh: 卢没费多大力气就把箱子搬了起来。

effort.en: Frank put a lot of effort into the party.
effort.zh: 弗兰克办这次聚会花了不少精力。

e.g..en: They might use local health care facilities, for example clinics and district hospitals.
e.g..zh: 他们可以使用当地的医疗保健设施，例如诊所和地区医院

egg.en: Blackbirds lay their eggs in March.
The eggs hatch (=break open to allow the baby out) in 26 days.

ego.en: Richard has the biggest ego (=thinks he is very clever and important) of anyone I’ve ever met.
ego.zh: 理查德是我所见过的最自负的人。

ego.en: That promotion really boosted her ego (=made her feel better about herself).
ego.zh: 那次晋升确实增强了她的自信心。

eight.en: It’s only eight days till Christmas.

eighteen.en: At least eighteen bullets were fired.

eighth.en: I’m planning to leave on the eighth (=the eighth day of the month).

eighty.en: The band was incredibly successful in the eighties.
Their troubles began in the mid eighties.

either.en: You add either one or two cloves of garlic.
She’s the kind of person you either love or hate.
either.zh: 她是那种让你非爱即恨的人。

eject.en: The demonstrators were ejected from the hall.
Two engines cut out and the plane started to eject fuel as it lost height.
eject.zh: 两个发动机突然熄火，飞机在下降的同时开始喷出燃料。

eke.en: They eke out a miserable existence in cardboard shacks.
eke.zh: 他们在纸板棚屋中凄惨度日。

eke.en: How did she manage to eke out the food?
eke.zh: 她是怎样想方设法节省食物的呢？

elaborate.en: He said he had new evidence, but refused to elaborate any further.
elaborate.zh: 他声称有新证据，但拒绝进一步详细说明。

elaborate.en: McDonald refused to elaborate on his reasons for resigning.
elaborate.zh: 麦克唐纳拒绝细说他辞职的原因。

elapse.en: Several months elapsed before his case was brought to trial.
elapse.zh: 过了几个月他的案子才开审。

elapse.en: The assignment must be completed within an overall elapsed time of one week.
elapse.zh: 这项任务总的时限为一周，必须按时完成。

elastic.en: Demand for this type of holiday will probably be fairly elastic.
elastic.zh: 对这类假期的需求可能有相当的弹性。

elated.en: He felt elated and mildly drunk.
elated.zh: 他感到欢欣鼓舞，而且喝得有点醉了。

elated.en: She was elated at the prospect of a holiday.
elated.zh: 她想到要度假就特别高兴。

elbow.en: There’s more elbow room in the restaurant since they extended it.
He elbowed his way to the bar and ordered a beer.
elbow.zh: 他挤到吧台前要了一杯啤酒。

elder.en: His elder son Liam became a lawyer.
elder.zh: 他的大儿子利亚姆当了律师。

elder.en: Sarah is the elder of the two.
elder.zh: 两人当中萨拉年纪较长。

elect.en: He was elected to a US state governorship.
In 1768, John Wilkes was elected as their Member of Parliament.

election.en: The Labour Party won the 2001 election by a huge majority.
Elections for the state governorship will be on November 25.

electric.en: The atmosphere in the courtroom was electric.
electric.zh: 法庭上的气氛十分紧张。

electrical.en: The fire was caused by an electrical fault.
electrical.zh: 大火是电力故障引起的。

electricity.en: The farm was very isolated, but it had electricity.
electricity.zh: 那个农场非常偏远，但有电力供应。

electricity.en: There was electricity in the air between the two of them.
electricity.zh: 能感觉到他俩之间来电。

electrify.en: She would sit at the piano and sing, electrifying us all.
electrify.zh: 她会边弹钢琴边唱歌，使我们大家兴奋不已。

electrify.en: The west coast main line has been electrified.
electrify.zh: 西海岸铁路干线已经电气化了。

elegant.en: You can dine in elegant surroundings.
elegant.zh: 你可以在雅致的环境中进餐。

element.en: Honesty is a vital element of her success.
element.zh: 诚实是她取得成功的一个重要因素。

element.en: Besides ability, the other essential element in political success is luck.
element.zh: 政治上的成功除能力以外，另一个必不可少的因素便是运气。

elemental.en: Love and fear are two of the most elemental human emotions.
elemental.zh: 爱和恐惧是人类最基本的两种情感。

elementary.en: You’ve made a very elementary mistake.
elementary.zh: 你犯了一个非常基本的错误。

elementary.en: I’m only familiar with the subject at an elementary level.
elementary.zh: 我对这门学科的了解只是初级水平。

elephant.en: The race issue is the elephant in the room in this election.
elephant.zh: 在这次选举中，重要的种族问题被刻意回避了。

elevate.en: Language has elevated humans above the other animals.
elevate.zh: 语言使人类高于其他动物。

elevate.en: Their purpose is to elevate AIDS to the top of government priorities.
elevate.zh: 他们的目的是使政府优先考虑艾滋病问题。

elevation.en: The road climbs steadily to an elevation of 1,400 feet.
elevation.zh: 公路缓缓地上升到海拔1,400

elevation.en: The cannon was fired at an elevation of 60 degrees.

elevator.en: We’ll have to take the elevator.

eleven.en: She was sent to jail for eleven months.
I never go to bed before eleven (=11 o'clock).

eleventh.en: At the eleventh hour the government decided that something had to be done.
eleventh.zh: 政府在最后一刻决定采取行动。

eleventh.en: I’m planning to leave on the eleventh (=the 11th day of the month).

elicit.en: When her knock elicited no response, she opened the door and peeped in.
elicit.zh: 敲门没有回应，她便推开门往里张望。

elicit.en: The test uses pictures to elicit words from the child.
elicit.zh: 这项测试用图片诱导孩子说话。

eligible.en: Students on a part-time course are not eligible for a loan.
eligible.zh: 非全日制课程的学生没有资格申请贷款。

eligible.en: Over 500,000 18-year-olds will become eligible to vote this year.

eliminate.en: The credit card eliminates the need for cash or cheques.
eliminate.zh: 有了信用卡就不需要使用现金或支票了。

eliminate.en: There is no solution that will totally eliminate the possibility of theft.
eliminate.zh: 没有办法可以完全杜绝盗窃案的发生。

elimination.en: The killings are part of a campaign of elimination of the political opposition.
elimination.zh: 这几起谋杀是铲除政敌行动的一部分。

elixir.en: The current new wave of technology should prove an economic elixir.
elixir.zh: 当前的新技术浪潮将成为解决经济问题的灵丹妙药。

elliptical.en: Kepler published his discovery of the elliptical orbits of planets in 1609.
elliptical.zh: 年开普勒公布他的发现，认为行星轨道为椭圆形。

elliptical.en: The language is often elliptical and ambiguous.
elliptical.zh: 语言经常是隐晦和模棱两可的。

elongate.en: Her legs were elongated by the very high heels which she wore.
elongate.zh: 她穿的高跟鞋非常高，使她的腿显得长了。

eloquent.en: The photographs are an eloquent reminder of the horrors of war.
eloquent.zh: 这些照片清楚地提醒人们不要忘记战争的恐怖。

else.en: There’s something else I’d like to talk about as well.
else.zh: 我还有其他事情要谈一谈。

else.en: I’d like you to come, and anyone else who’s free.
else.zh: 我想请你过来，其他人有空也可以来。

elsewhere.en: She is becoming famous in Australia and elsewhere.
elsewhere.zh: 她在澳大利亚和其他地方渐渐出名了。

elsewhere.en: Kerala has less crime and alcoholism than elsewhere in India.
elsewhere.zh: 喀拉拉邦的犯罪和酗酒现象少于印度的其他地区。

elusive.en: She managed to get an interview with that elusive man.
elusive.zh: 她设法采访到了那个行踪飘忽的人。

elusive.en: She enjoys a firm reputation in this country but wider international success has been elusive.
elusive.zh: 她在这个国家享有稳固的声誉，但却一直难以在国际上取得更大的成功。

email.en: It’s usually best to contact him by email.
email.zh: 一般最好是用电子邮件和他联络。

email.en: Send me an e-mail when you have any news.
email.zh: 你一有消息就发电子邮件给我。

emanate.en: Wonderful smells were emanating from the kitchen.
emanate.zh: 从厨房传来诱人的香味。

embargo.en: Many allies are pushing to lift the embargo.
embargo.zh: 许多盟国在努力推进取消贸易禁令。

embark.en: He embarked on a new career as a teacher.
embark.zh: 他开始了教书的新生涯。

embarrass.en: He didn’t want to embarrass her by asking questions.
The revelations in the press have embarrassed the government.
embarrass.zh: 报纸披露的事实让政府很难堪。

embarrassing.en: She asked a lot of embarrassing questions.
embarrassing.zh: 她问了许多令人尴尬的问题。

embarrassing.en: This incident is deeply embarrassing for the government.
embarrassing.zh: 这一事件让政府非常难堪。

embarrassment.en: She suffered extreme embarrassment at not knowing how to read.
embarrassment.zh: 她不识字，这让她难堪极了。

embarrassment.en: He could not hide his embarrassment at his children’s rudeness.
embarrassment.zh: 他无法掩饰自己孩子的无礼给他带来的难堪。

embed.en: A piece of glass was embedded in her hand.
embed.zh: 一块玻璃扎在她的手上。

embed.en: Feelings of guilt are deeply embedded in her personality.
embed.zh: 负罪感在她的性格里根深蒂固。

embellish.en: The dress was embellished with gold threads.
embellish.zh: 连衣裙用金线作了装饰。

embellish.en: She gave an embellished account of what had happened.
embellish.zh: 她添油加醋地把发生的事描述了一番。

emblem.en: The national emblem of Canada is a maple leaf.
emblem.zh: 加拿大的国家象征是枫叶。

emblem.en: Expensive cars are seen as an emblem of success.
emblem.zh: 豪华汽车被视为成功的标志。

embody.en: She embodies everything I admire in a teacher.
embody.zh: 她具备了我所钦佩的教师该具备的一切素质。

embody.en: The latest model embodies many new improvements.
embody.zh: 最新的款式包含了许多新的改进。

embrace.zh: 杰克热情拥抱他的儿子。
玛吉和劳拉拥抱在一起。

embroider.en: The dress was embroidered with flowers.
A colourful design was embroidered on the sleeve of the shirt.
embroider.zh: 衬衫的袖子上绣了一个色彩鲜艳的图案。

embryo.en: The system already exists in embryo.

embryonic.en: The plans are still only in embryonic form.
embryonic.zh: 计划还只是在酝酿之中。

emerge.en: The flowers emerge in the spring.
The sun emerged from behind the clouds.
emerge.zh: 太阳从云层后露了出来。

emergency.en: Lifeguards are trained to deal with emergencies.
emergency.zh: 救生员接受过应对紧急情况的训练。

emergency.en: The staff need to know what to do in an emergency.
emergency.zh: 员工需要了解紧急情况下该怎么办。

emigrate.en: He emigrated to Australia as a young man.
emigrate.zh: 他年轻时移居澳大利亚。

eminently.en: Woods is eminently suitable for the job.
eminently.zh: 伍兹完全适合做这份工作。

emission.en: Britain agreed to cut emissions of nitrogen oxide from power stations.
emission.zh: 英国同意减少发电站氮氧化物的排放量。

emit.en: The kettle emitted a shrill whistle.
emit.zh: 水壶发出了刺耳的鸣笛声。

emotion.en: Her voice was full of emotion.

emotional.en: She provided emotional support at a very distressing time for me.
emotional.zh: 在我非常痛苦的时候，她是我的情感支柱。

emotional.en: Ann suffered from depression and a number of other emotional problems.
emotional.zh: 安患了抑郁症，还遇到一些其他的情绪问题。

emotive.en: Child abuse is an emotive subject.
emotive.zh: 虐待儿童是一个容易引起大家强烈愤慨的话题。

empathy.en: She had great empathy with people.

emphasis.en: In Japan there is a lot of emphasis on politeness.
emphasis.zh: 在日本人们非常注重礼节。

emphasis.en: The course places emphasis on practical work.

emphasize.en: The report emphasizes the importance of improving safety standards.
emphasize.zh: 报告强调了改进安全标准的重要性。

emphasize.en: Logan made a speech emphasizing the need for more volunteers.
emphasize.zh: 罗根发表演讲，强调需要更多的志愿者。

emphatic.en: Wilde was emphatic that the event should go ahead.
emphatic.zh: 怀尔德强调活动应该继续进行。

emphatic.en: He was pretty emphatic about me leaving.

employ.en: Kelly is employed as a mechanic.

employer.en: The shoe factory is the largest employer in this area.
employer.zh: 这家制鞋厂是本地区最大的雇主。

employment.en: She was offered employment in the sales office.
The employment prospects for science graduates are excellent.
employment.zh: 理科毕业生的就业前景非常好。

empower.en: The Voting Rights Act was needed to empower minority groups.
empower.zh: 《选举权法案》对于赋予少数民族自主权是必不可少的。

empower.en: The president is empowered to appoint judges to the Supreme Court.
empower.zh: 总统有权任命最高法院的法官。

emptiness.en: She felt an emptiness in her heart when he left.
emptiness.zh: 他走后她心里感到空虚。

empty.en: I hate coming home to an empty house.
empty.zh: 我讨厌回家时屋子里空荡荡的。

enable.en: The loan enabled Jan to buy the house.
enable.zh: 贷款使简有能力买下这房子。

enable.en: There are plans to enlarge the runway to enable jumbo jets to land.
enable.zh: 有计划扩建飞机跑道，让大型客机可以降落。

enact.en: Congress refused to enact the bill.

encapsulate.en: The words of the song neatly encapsulate the mood of the country at that time.
encapsulate.zh: 这首歌的歌词言简意赅地表现出国家当时的氛围。

encapsulate.en: Her whole philosophy can be encapsulated in this one sentence.
encapsulate.zh: 她全部的人生哲学可以用这样一句话来概括。

encase.en: His broken leg was encased in plaster.
encase.zh: 他骨折的腿上打着石膏。

enchant.en: I was enchanted by the way she smiled.
enchant.zh: 她微笑时的样子让我着迷。

encircle.en: The island was encircled by a dusty road.
encircle.zh: 那座岛屿为一条尘土飞扬的公路所环绕。

enclose.en: Please enclose a cheque with your order.
Please find enclosed an agenda for the meeting.

encompass.en: The study encompasses the social, political, and economic aspects of the situation.
encompass.zh: 这项研究涵盖了这一局势的社会、政治和经济三方面。

encompass.en: The houses encompassed about 100 square metres.

encounter.en: They encountered serious problems when two members of the expedition were injured.
encounter.zh: 远征队遇到了严重的问题，两名队员受伤。

encounter.en: The government has encountered strong opposition to its plans to raise income tax.
encounter.zh: 政府欲提高所得税的方案遭到了强烈反对。

encourage.en: I want to thank everyone who has encouraged and supported me.
encourage.zh: 我要感谢每一位鼓励和支持过我的人。

encourage.en: Cooder was encouraged to begin playing the guitar by his father.
encourage.zh: 库德在他父亲的鼓励下开始弹吉他。

encouragement.en: With encouragement, Sally is starting to play with the other children.
encouragement.zh: 萨莉受到了鼓励，开始和其他孩子玩起来。

encouragement.en: She needed no encouragement to continue (=did not need any encouragement).
encouragement.zh: 她不需要鼓励也会继续做下去。

encouraging.en: The encouraging news is that typhoid is on the decrease.
encouraging.zh: 令人鼓舞的消息是伤寒发病率在下降。

encouraging.en: The signs are encouraging — but there’s a long way to go.
encouraging.zh: 这些迹象令人振奋，但是还有很长的路要走。

encroach.en: Bureaucratic power has encroached upon the freedom of the individual.
encroach.zh: 官僚权力已经侵犯了个人的自由。

end.en: Costs are expected to double by the end of 2012.
What would she find at the end of her journey?
end.zh: 她在旅程结束时会有些什么发现？

endanger.en: Smoking during pregnancy endangers your baby’s life.
endanger.zh: 孕期吸烟会危及胎儿生命。

endanger.en: The lizards are classed as an endangered species (= one that soon may no longer exist ).
endanger.zh: 这种蜥蜴被归为濒危物种。

endear.en: The emperor saw an opportunity to endear himself to the Athenians.
endear.zh: 皇帝看到一个能赢得雅典人民爱戴的机会。

endeavour.en: We always endeavor to please our customers.
endeavour.zh: 我们总是竭尽全力让顾客满意。

endeavour.en: They made every endeavour to find the two boys.
endeavour.zh: 他们竭尽全力寻找那两个男孩。

ending.en: Coffee is the perfect ending to a meal.
ending.zh: 咖啡是餐后的最佳饮品。

endless.en: He’s been in a lot of trouble – drugs, guns, blackmail – the list is endless.

endorse.en: The prime minister is unlikely to endorse this view.
endorse.zh: 首相不可能赞同这一观点。

endow.en: Her resistance to the Nationalists endowed her with legendary status.
endow.zh: 她对抗民族主义者的事迹使她享有盛名。

endow.en: She was endowed with good looks.

endurance.en: She was pushed beyond her powers of endurance.
The marathon is a test of endurance.
endurance.zh: 马拉松赛跑是对耐力的考验。

endure.en: It seemed impossible that anyone could endure such pain.
endure.zh: 似乎谁都不可能忍受这样的疼痛。

endure.en: He can’t endure being apart from me.

enemy.en: She’s a dangerous enemy to have.
Cats and dogs have always been natural enemies.

energetic.en: We need to be more energetic in promoting ourselves abroad.
energetic.zh: 我们需要更积极地向国外宣传自己。

energetic.en: If you’re feeling energetic, we could go out for a run.
energetic.zh: 你要是觉得有精力，我们可以出去跑步。

energy.en: The water is heated using energy from the sun.
energy.zh: 水是利用太阳能加热的。

energy.en: The problem with nuclear energy is dealing with the waste.
energy.zh: 核能的问题就是要处理核废料。

enforce.en: Governments make laws and the police enforce them.
enforce.zh: 政府制定法律，警察负责执行。

enforce.en: Parking restrictions will be strictly enforced.
enforce.zh: 停车限制将会严格执行。

engage.en: Only 10% of American adults engage in regular exercise.
The two parties engaged upon an escalating political struggle.
engage.zh: 两党之间的政治斗争日益加剧。

engaged.en: Have you heard? Sally and Ray are getting engaged.
engaged.zh: 你听说了吗？萨莉和雷要订婚了。

engaged.en: She is engaged to be married.

engagement.en: Their engagement was announced in the paper.
engagement.zh: 他们订婚的消息在报上公布了。

engagement.en: Tony was stunned when Lisa suddenly broke off their engagement (=finished it).
engagement.zh: 托尼对莉萨突然解除他俩的婚约感到震惊。

engine.en: He switched off the car’s engine and waited.
engine.zh: 他关掉汽车的发动机等着。

engineer.en: He trained as a civil engineer (=one who designs and builds roads, bridges etc).
engineer.zh: 他接受过土木工程师培训。

engineer.en: Perhaps she could engineer a meeting between them?
engineer.zh: 或许她可以好好安排一下让他们见一面？

english.en: She decided to major in English.

engrave.en: Their names are engraved on a stone tablet.
engrave.zh: 他们的名字刻在石匾上。

engross.en: The scene was stunning, and for a time engrossed all our attention.
engross.zh: 景色非常美丽，一时间把我们都完全吸引住了。

engross.en: Take your mind off it by engrossing yourself in a good book.
engross.zh: 弄本好书埋头去看，不要再想它了。

engulf.en: The building was engulfed in flames.

enhance.en: Good lighting will enhance any room.
enhance.zh: 良好的照明能给房间增色不少。

enhance.en: The publicity has enhanced his reputation.
enhance.zh: 这次宣传提高了他的声誉。

enigma.en: The neighbours regarded him as something of an enigma.
enigma.zh: 邻居们把他当成谜一样的人。

enjoy.en: Sandra enjoys her job in the city.
enjoy.zh: 桑德拉很喜欢她在城里的这份工作。

enjoy.en: I enjoyed every minute of it.

enjoyable.en: Games can make learning more enjoyable.

enjoyment.en: Acting has brought me enormous enjoyment.
enjoyment.zh: 演戏给我带来莫大的快乐。

enjoyment.en: Unfortunately, a small minority want to spoil everyone else’s enjoyment.
enjoyment.zh: 很遗憾，少数几个人想令其他所有人扫兴。

enlarge.en: Police will have the pictures enlarged in an attempt to identify the thief.
enlarge.zh: 为了确认窃贼的身份，警方会将这些照片放大。

enlarge.en: A good way to enlarge your vocabulary is to read a daily newspaper.
enlarge.zh: 一个扩大词汇量的好方法是阅读日报。

enlighten.en: Baldwin enlightened her as to the nature of the experiment.
enlighten.zh: 鲍德温给她讲解了这个实验的性质。

enlightenment.en: Isabel looked to Ron for enlightenment.
enlightenment.zh: 伊莎贝尔希望得到罗恩的启发。

enormous.en: The team made an enormous effort.
enormous.zh: 该队付出了巨大的努力。

enormously.en: The project has benefited enormously from Jan’s knowledge.
enormously.zh: 这个项目深深得益于简的学识。

enough.en: He just hadn’t thought enough about the possible consequences.

enterprise.zh: 这一计划是与伦敦商学院的合作项目。

enterprise.zh: 我们在寻找有事业心和创造力的年轻人。

enterprising.zh: 一些有创业精神的学生在设计软件。

entertain.zh: 她又讲故事又唱歌，还演戏，把孩子们逗得很开心。

entertain.zh: 博物馆应该致力于成为娱乐和教育功能并重的场所。

entertainer.zh: 西纳特拉一直是最著名的艺人之一。

entertaining.zh: 如今的儿童电视节目要比过去有趣多了。

entertainment.zh: 该镇提供各式各样的娱乐活动。

entertainment.zh: 现场表演将持续一整天。

enthusiasm.zh: 吉利恩和达伦非常热情地接待了演讲者。

enthusiasm.zh: 我们兴高采烈地去了当地的潜水俱乐部。

enthusiastic.zh: 全体员工对这个项目都很感兴趣。

enthusiastic.zh: 那位歌手受到了热烈欢迎。

entice.zh: 我们的特价优惠是为了吸引人们购买。

entire.zh: 那是我一生中最糟糕的一天。

entirely.zh: 这处山脊完全由火山岩构成。

entirety.zh: 这部电影是第一次完整地放映。

entirety.zh: 我们整个周末都待在酒店里。

entitle.zh: 全职雇员都有资格享受健康保险。

entitle.zh: 凭会员身份可以获取月刊。

entity.en: The mind exists as a separate entity.
entity.zh: 思想作为一个独立的实体存在。

entity.en: Good design brings a house and garden together as a single entity.
entity.zh: 优秀的设计能把一所房子和花园合为一体。

entreat.en: His friends entreated him not to go.
entreat.zh: 他的朋友们恳求他不要去。

entrenched.zh: 对老年人的歧视在我们这个社会根深蒂固。

entrust.zh: 她把儿子的教育托付给了一位私人教师。

envelope.zh: 他找了一份在竞选总部装信封的工作。

envious.en: Colleagues were envious of her success.

envisage.zh: 我想象不出有再和他共事的可能。

envision.zh: 我展望了一个有着优质教育的未来。

envy.zh: 我真是羡慕你和伊恩，你俩在一起看起来多幸福。

envy.en: She has a lifestyle which most people would envy.

epitome.zh: 她看上去像是优雅的典范。

epoch.zh: 这位国王的去世标志着一个时代的结束。

equal.zh: 两位候选人的得票数相等。

equal.en: They believe that all work is of equal value.
equal.zh: 他们认为一切工作都有同等价值。

equality.en: All people have the right to equality of opportunity.
equality.zh: 人人都有获得均等机会的权利。

equality.en: Women have yet to achieve full equality with men in the workplace.
equality.zh: 女性仍未在职场中实现与男性完全平等。

equally.en: You must have a good education, but practical training is equally important.
equally.zh: 你必须接受良好的教育，不过实际培训也同样重要。

equally.zh: 我们同意把钱平分给每个人。

equation.zh: 旅游业构成该地区经济总量中至关重要的一部分。

equilibrium.zh: 政府急切希望不要打乱经济平衡。

equilibrium.en: She struggled to recover her equilibrium.

equip.en: They spent a lot of money equipping the school with new computers.
equip.zh: 他们花了很多钱给学校配备新计算机。

equip.zh: 他带了一把锤子和一些钉子。

equipment.zh: 打网球的东西你带了吗？

equipment.zh: 务必正确标示所有设备。

equitable.zh: 这项工作应该更公平合理地分担。

equivalent.en: I had no dollars, but offered him an equivalent amount of sterling.
equivalent.zh: 我没有美金，但给了他等值的英镑。

equivocal.zh: 她谈到她的工作时有点含糊其词。

era.en: We live in an era of instant communication.
era.zh: 我们生活在一个信息即时交流的时代。

era.en: His death marked the end of an era.
era.zh: 他的去世标志着一个时代的终结。

eradicate.zh: 我们能把这种疾病从世界上根除。

eradicate.zh: 这个问题现已彻底杜绝。

erase.zh: 计算机瘫痪了，我们所有的记录都被删除了。

erode.zh: 悬崖正不断受到汹涌海浪的侵蚀。

erratic.zh: 他的呼吸越来越不均匀。

erupt.zh: 警察向示威人群中的一名学生开枪，暴乱随之发生。

escalate.zh: 她越来越害怕，最后变得惊慌失措。

escape.zh: 他砸开上锁的门，逃走了。

especially.zh: 我向来不喜欢长距离散步，尤其在冬天。

especially.zh: 美术类书籍制作成本很高，尤其是那些带彩色插图的。

essay.zh: 我得在星期五之前完成一篇3,000

essence.zh: 阿森纳队足球风格的精髓是强调速度。

essential.en: A good diet is essential for everyone.
essential.zh: 良好的饮食对于每个人都极为重要。

essential.zh: 我们的飞行员要受到最好的培训，这是必不可少的。

essentially.zh: 芭蕾舞基本上是中产阶级感兴趣的东西。

essentially.zh: 自杀率基本上保持不变。

establish.zh: 我们的目标是在北方建立一个新的研究中心。

established.zh: 来自老牌企业的竞争可能会异常激烈。

estate.zh: 该产业是死者遗产的一部分。

esteem.zh: 作为演员，他深受评论家敬重。

estimate.zh: 汽车修理厂说他们会给我寄来维修报价。

etc..zh: 信中说要立刻付款，他们以前已提醒过我们了，等等等等。

etc..zh: 他们询问我以往的经验、学历资格等等。

etch.zh: 激光器用于在光盘的光滑表面刻录图案。

etch.zh: 那座岛屿一直让我铭记在心。

eternal.zh: 她永远是个乐观主义者。

eternity.zh: 她在此等了似乎很漫长的一段时间。

eternity.zh: 那一周孤独和无聊的感觉无穷无尽。

ethic.zh: 旧有的崇尚勤勉的道德观已被及时行乐的新观念所取代。

ethnic.zh: 该校教授不同种族的小学生。

euro.zh: 价格用英镑和欧元标出。

evacuate.zh: 好几户人家从家里撤出。

evacuate.zh: 战争期间他被撤离到苏格兰。

evade.zh: 我看得出他在极力回避这个问题。

evaluate.en: You should be able to evaluate your own work.
evaluate.zh: 你应该能够评估自己的工作。

evaluate.zh: 我们要评估一下这次运动是否成功。

evaluation.zh: 我们要对新系统进行合理的评估。

evaluation.zh: 他们抽取了一些产品样本以作评估。

evaporate.en: Most of the water had evaporated.

evaporate.zh: 太阳会蒸发叶子上的水分。

even.en: Most companies have suffered a drop in their profits, even very large companies.
even.zh: 大多数公司的利润都出现下滑，甚至连很大的公司也不例外。

even.zh: 这很难看得见，即使开着灯也没有用。

evening.zh: 周五晚上我通常都不在家。

evenly.en: Make sure the surface is evenly covered with paint.
evenly.zh: 要确保表面的油漆涂刷均匀。

evenly.zh: 把黄油均匀地涂在烤面包上。

event.zh: 那次会议是一次重要的社交活动。

event.zh: 学校举办捐款活动来筹集资金。

eventual.en: Sweden were the eventual winners of the tournament.
eventual.zh: 瑞典队是锦标赛的最后赢家。

eventual.en: Both sides were happy with the eventual outcome of the talks.
eventual.zh: 双方对会谈的最终结果都感到满意。

eventuality.zh: 我们准备应付任何可能出现的情况。
那是不大可能发生的事情。

eventually.zh: 他终于逃脱并返回英格兰。

eventually.en: Eventually, she got a job and moved to London.
eventually.zh: 最终，她找到了工作并移居伦敦。

ever.en: Nothing ever seems to upset him.
ever.zh: 似乎从来没有什么事情会使他烦恼。

every.zh: 我们仔细地看着驶过的每一辆汽车。

every.zh: 课程结束时，每一个孩子都可以获得证书。

everyday.en: Describe it in ordinary everyday language.
everyday.zh: 用一般的日常语言把它描述一下。

everyone.zh: 如果大家都准备好了，我就开始。

everyone.zh: 请向全家人致以最美好的祝愿。

everything.en: Everything was covered in a thick layer of dust.
everything.zh: 所有东西上面都蒙着厚厚一层灰。

everything.zh: 我决定把一切都告诉她。

everywhere.zh: 我到处都找过了，但就是找不到地图。

evict.zh: 他们付不起房租，所以被赶出了门。

evict.zh: 他们拒绝离开，结果被强行赶走。

evidence.zh: 目前我们还没有其他行星上存在生命的证据。

evidence.en: There is no evidence for these claims.

evident.zh: 大家很快就明白她病得很重。

evidently.en: She was evidently a heavy smoker.

evil.zh: 他们谴责奴隶制是不道德的。

evil.en: He claimed to have the power of the evil eye.
evil.zh: 他声称自己能用邪恶眼光伤人。

evoke.zh: 那些照片勾起了我们到法国度假的深刻回忆。

evoke.zh: 他的外表肯定会引起人们的同情。

evolutionary.zh: 有些科学家拒绝接受进化论。

evolutionary.zh: 他支持渐进的社会变革。

evolve.zh: 鱼是从史前的海洋生物进化而来的。

evolve.zh: 动物进化形成了伪装，以保护自身不被捕食性动物所捕食。

ex.zh: 我在城里遇见了我以前的那位。

exacerbate.zh: 经济衰退使这个问题更加严重。
