exacerbate.zh: 我不想使情况变得更糟。

exact.en: Police are still investigating the exact cause of the accident.
exact.zh: 警方还在调查这起事故的确切原因。

exactly.en: The figures may not be exactly right, but they’re close enough.
exactly.zh: 那些数字可能不是非常精确，但也相当接近。

exaggerate.en: I couldn’t sleep for three days – I’m not exaggerating.
It’s difficult to exaggerate the importance of sleep.
exaggerate.zh: 睡眠的重要性怎么说也不为过。

exaggerated.en: The revenue figures may be slightly exaggerated.
exaggerated.zh: 收益数字可能有点夸大。

exaggerated.en: The danger had been greatly exaggerated.

exaggeration.en: It would be an exaggeration to say that we were close friends.
exaggeration.zh: 说我们是密友不免言过其实了。

exaggeration.en: It is no exaggeration to say that everyone will be affected by the new policy.
exaggeration.zh: 说人人都会受到新政策的影响一点也不夸张。

exalted.en: I felt shy in such exalted company.
exalted.zh: 我与如此显贵的人在一起觉得拘束。

exam.en: At the end of each level, there’s an exam.
exam.zh: 在每一级别结束时都有一次考试。

exam.en: How did you do in your exams?

examination.en: The examination results will be announced in September.
He’s already taken the entrance examination.
examination.zh: 他已经参加了入学考试。

examine.en: A team of divers was sent down to examine the wreck.
examine.zh: 一组潜水员被送到水下检查沉船。

examine.en: Hegel’s philosophy will be examined in detail in Chapter 4.

example.en: Can anyone give me an example of a transitive verb?
example.zh: 谁能给我举个及物动词的例子吗？

example.en: Many countries, for example Mexico and Japan, have a lot of earthquakes.
example.zh: 许多国家，例如墨西哥和日本，经常发生地震。

exasperate.en: It exasperates me to hear comments like that.
exasperate.zh: 听到那样的评论令我恼怒。

exasperation.zh: 卡罗尔恼怒地叹了口气。

excavate.en: Schliemann excavated the ancient city of Troy.
excavate.zh: 谢里曼发掘出特洛伊古城。

exceed.en: Working hours must not exceed 42 hours a week.
exceed.zh: 工作时间每周不得超过42
他的表现出乎我们的预料。

exceedingly.en: Thank you. You’ve been exceedingly kind.

excel.en: Rick has always excelled at foreign languages.
You have excelled yourself with the new exhibition.
excel.zh: 你新办的这次展览特别成功。

excellent.en: His car is in excellent condition.
Second-hand computers can be excellent value.
excellent.zh: 二手计算机买得好会非常合算。

except.en: The office is open every day except Sundays.
except.zh: 办事处除星期天之外天天开门。

except.en: You can have any of the cakes except this one.
except.zh: 你可以拿任何一块蛋糕，但这块除外。

exception.en: It’s been cold, but today’s an exception.
exception.zh: 天气一直寒冷，但今天是个例外。

exception.en: We all laughed, with the exception of Maggie.

exceptional.en: This is an exceptional case; I’ve never seen anything like it before.
exceptional.zh: 这是个不寻常的案例，我以前从没见过这样的事。

exceptional.en: Promotion in the first year is only given in exceptional circumstances.
exceptional.zh: 入职第一年就升职的事只有在特殊情况下才会发生。

exceptionally.en: She defended her position exceptionally well.
exceptionally.zh: 她出色地捍卫了自己的立场。

excerpt.en: An excerpt of the speech appeared in the Sunday paper.
excerpt.zh: 演讲的节录刊登在周日报纸上了。

excess.en: After you apply the oil, wait 20 minutes before wiping off any excess.
It was an excess of enthusiasm that caused the problem.
excess.zh: 是过度热情引起了这一问题。

exchange.en: I’ve offered to paint the kitchen in exchange for a week’s accommodation.
exchange.zh: 我提出愿意粉刷厨房，条件是让我免费住一周。

exchange.en: Four of my cassettes for your Madonna CD is a fair exchange.
exchange.zh: 我用四盒磁带换你的麦当娜激光唱片很公平。

excite.en: His playing is technically brilliant, but it doesn’t excite me.
excite.zh: 他的演奏技巧娴熟，但并不让我激动。

excite.en: The court case has excited a lot of public interest.
excite.zh: 这场官司引起了公众的极大兴趣。

excited.en: Steve flies home tomorrow – we’re all really excited.
excited.zh: 史蒂夫明天坐飞机回家——

excited.en: Maria’s starting to get pretty excited about the wedding.
excited.zh: 玛丽亚开始对婚礼感到十分兴奋。

excitement.en: The children were filled with excitement at the thought of visiting Disneyland.
excitement.zh: 想到要去迪士尼乐园，孩子们激动不已。

excitement.en: In all the excitement, I left my wallet behind.
excitement.zh: 我一时激动，忘了拿钱包。

exciting.en: I’ve got some very exciting news for you.
exciting.zh: 我给你带来了一些很激动人心的消息。
我们来做些让人振奋的事情吧。

exclude.en: The judges decided to exclude evidence which had been unfairly obtained.
exclude.zh: 法官裁决不接纳以不正当手段获取的证据。

exclude.en: Some of the data was specifically excluded from the report.
exclude.zh: 这篇报道特意不采用部分数据。

exclusion.en: Your essays tend to concentrate on one theme to the exclusion of everything else.
exclusion.zh: 你的文章往往会集中于一个主题而不顾及其他各个方面。

exclusion.en: You will be sent full details of the exclusions of your insurance policy.
exclusion.zh: 届时会将保险单不予承保的项目的具体说明给你寄去。

exclusive.en: Our figure skating club has exclusive use of the rink on Mondays.
exclusive.zh: 溜冰场每逢星期一专供我们的花样滑冰俱乐部使用。

exclusive.en: Tune in to our exclusive coverage of Wimbledon.
exclusive.zh: 请收看我们对温布尔登网球锦标赛的独家报道。

exclusively.en: This offer is available exclusively to people who call now.
exclusively.zh: 只有现在打来电话的人才能享有这个优惠。

excursion.en: Included in the tour is an excursion to the Grand Canyon.
excursion.zh: 这次旅游包括大峡谷观光。

excursion.en: We went on an excursion to the Pyramids.

excuse.en: Excuse me, can you tell me the way to the museum please?
excuse.zh: 劳驾，请问去博物馆怎么走？

excuse.en: Oh, excuse me. I didn’t know anyone was here.
excuse.zh: 噢，对不起，我不知道这里有人。

execute.en: Thousands have been executed for political crimes.
execute.zh: 数以千计的人因政治罪而被处死了。

execute.en: The job involves drawing up and executing a plan of nursing care.
execute.zh: 这项工作包括拟订和实施一个护理计划。

execution.en: The two men face execution (=they will be killed as a punishment).
Torture and summary execution (=execution without a trial or any legal process) are common.
execution.zh: 严刑拷打和不经审判就地处决相当普遍。

exemplify.en: The building exemplifies the style of architecture which was popular at the time.
exemplify.zh: 这栋大楼代表了当时流行的建筑风格。

exemplify.en: Problems are exemplified in the report.
exemplify.zh: 问题都在报告中作了举例说明。

exempt.en: The interest is exempt from income tax.
Children are exempt from the charges.

exercise.en: Try to fit some regular exercise into your daily routine.
exercise.zh: 尽量在日常生活中安排一些经常性的锻炼。

exercise.en: Working in an office, I don’t get much exercise.
exercise.zh: 由于在办公室工作，我很少运动。

exert.en: They exerted considerable influence within the school.
exert.zh: 他们在校内施加了很大的影响力。

exert.en: Environmental groups are exerting pressure on the government to tighten pollution laws.
exert.zh: 环境保护组织在向政府施加压力，要求从严执行环保法律法规。

exertion.en: The afternoon’s exertions had left us feeling exhausted.
exertion.zh: 下午太劳累了，我们感到精疲力竭。

exhale.en: Take a deep breath, then exhale slowly.
exhale.zh: 深吸一口气，然后慢慢呼出。

exhaust.en: A full day’s teaching exhausts me.
exhaust.zh: 讲一整天课令我精疲力竭。

exhaust.en: He’d exhausted himself carrying all the boxes upstairs.
exhaust.zh: 他把所有的箱子搬到楼上，把自己弄得精疲力竭。

exhausted.zh: 你看上去一副疲惫不堪的样子。

exhausted.en: I was exhausted by the journey.

exhaustion.en: Sheer exhaustion forced him to give up.

exhaustive.en: The list is by no means exhaustive.

exhibit.en: Her paintings have been exhibited all over the world.
exhibit.zh: 她的绘画作品在世界各地展出。

exhibit.en: The exhibits date from the 17th century.
exhibit.zh: 这些展品的历史可以追溯到17

exhibition.en: The museum is staging an exhibition of Picasso’s work.
exhibition.zh: 博物馆正举办毕加索画展。

exhibition.en: She never agreed to the public exhibition of her sculptures while she was still alive.
exhibition.zh: 她生前从未同意公开展出自己的雕塑作品。

exhort.en: Police exhorted the crowd to remain calm.
exhort.zh: 警察极力劝说群众保持镇静。

exile.en: He went into exile to escape political imprisonment.
exile.zh: 他为了逃避政治监禁而流亡国外。

exile.en: The house was raided and the family was forced into exile.
exile.zh: 房子被抄，全家人被迫流亡。

exist.en: The custom of arranged marriages still exists in many countries.
exist.zh: 许多国家仍存在包办婚姻的习俗。

exist.en: Opportunities exist for students to gain sponsorship.

existence.en: It is impossible to prove the existence of God.
The organization has been in existence for 25 years.

existing.en: The service is available to all existing customers.
existing.zh: 这项服务现有的客户均可享受。

exit.en: We made for the nearest exit.
Two men were blocking her exit.
exit.zh: 两个男人挡住了她出去的路。

exonerate.en: He was totally exonerated of any blame.

expand.en: Sydney’s population expanded rapidly in the 1960s.

expansion.en: The rapid expansion of cities can cause social and economic problems.
expansion.zh: 城市规模的迅速扩大会带来各种社会和经济问题。

expansion.en: The industry underwent a period of rapid expansion.
expansion.zh: 该产业经历了一轮快速扩张。

expansive.en: Hauser was in an expansive mood.
She flung her arms out in an expansive gesture.

expect.en: I expect to be back within a week.
The company expects to complete work in April.

expectancy.en: I saw the look of expectancy in the children’s eyes.
expectancy.zh: 我从孩子们的眼神中看到了期盼。

expectation.en: For some time he lived with the expectation that he was going to die.
expectation.zh: 有一段时间，他预料自己快要不行了。

expectation.en: Anne left Germany in the expectation of seeing her family again before very long.
expectation.zh: 安妮离开了德国，期待着很快就能与家人重逢。

expedient.en: This solution is politically expedient but may well cause long-term problems.
expedient.zh: 这种解决方法是政治上的权宜之计，但会引起长远的问题。

expedient.en: We think it is expedient to make a good-will gesture to the new administration.
expedient.zh: 我们认为向新一任政府示好是权宜之计。

expedition.en: He went on an expedition to Borneo.

expel.en: Two girls were expelled from school for taking drugs.
expel.zh: 两名女生因吸毒而被学校开除。

expel.en: The main opposition leader was expelled from her party.
expel.zh: 主要反对党的领导人被开除出其政党。

expend.en: People of different ages expend different amounts of energy.
expend.zh: 不同年龄的人消耗的能量有所不同。

expend.en: Manufacturers have expended a lot of time and effort trying to improve computer security.
expend.zh: 制造商花费了大量的时间和精力试图提高计算机的安全性。

expendable.en: It’s a sad moment when a man loses his job and discovers that he is expendable.
expendable.zh: 一个人丢掉工作并发现自己无足轻重的那一刻会很难过。

expense.en: He borrowed £150,000 and used the money for legal expenses.
Conference rooms were equipped at great expense.

expensive.en: Petrol is becoming more and more expensive.

expensive.zh: 摄影是一项很花钱的业余爱好。

experience.en: You’ve got a lot of experience of lecturing.
He had no previous experience of managing a farm.
experience.zh: 他以前没有经营农场的经验。

experienced.zh: 她经验丰富且充满自信。
布莱克在显微外科手术方面极富经验。

experiment.en: Many small birds guide themselves by the stars, as has been verified by experiment.
experiment.zh: 许多小鸟靠星星导航，这已被实验所证实。

experiment.en: They carried out a series of experiments to test the theory.
experiment.zh: 他们进行了一系列实验来验证这个理论。

experimental.en: A hypothesis is tested by finding experimental evidence for it.
experimental.zh: 假设经由实验证据检验。

experimentation.en: The issue of animal experimentation is an emotive subject.
experimentation.zh: 动物实验问题是个敏感的话题。

experimentation.en: There is often a period of sexual experimentation during adolescence.
experimentation.zh: 人在青春期常会经历一个体验性爱的阶段。

expert.en: He’s a world expert on marine mammals.
expert.zh: 他是研究海洋哺乳动物的世界权威。

expert.en: Tests should be administered by a medical expert.
expert.zh: 试验应该由一位医学专家来进行。

expertise.en: What he’s bringing to the company is financial expertise.
expertise.zh: 他给公司带来的是金融专业知识。

expire.zh: 我的护照下周就到期了。

expire.en: My driving licence expires in March.

expiry.en: Only seven minutes remained before the expiry of the noon deadline.
Check the expiry date on your passport.
expiry.zh: 看一下你的护照什么时候到期。

explain.en: The librarian will explain how to use the catalogue system.
explain.zh: 图书馆管理员将说明如何使用目录系统。

explanation.en: Can you think of any explanation for this failure?
explanation.zh: 对这次失败你能想出什么解释吗？

explanation.en: The concert was cancelled without explanation.

explanatory.en: There are explanatory notes at the end of each chapter.

explicit.en: The contrast could not have been made more explicit.
explicit.zh: 这个对比再清楚不过了。

explicit.en: The kidnappers gave us explicit instructions not to involve the police.
explicit.zh: 绑匪明确告诉我们不许报警。

explode.en: The device was thrown at an army patrol but failed to explode.
explode.zh: 炸弹投向了陆军巡逻队，但没有爆炸。

explode.en: Far sooner than anyone thought possible, the Russians exploded an atomic bomb.
explode.zh: 苏联引爆了一颗原子弹，大大早于任何人的预期。

exploit.en: Homeworkers can easily be exploited by employers.
exploit.zh: 在家工作的人容易被雇主剥削。

exploit.en: The violence was blamed on thugs exploiting the situation.
exploit.zh: 暴力事件归咎于这一局面被暴徒所利用。

exploitation.en: The film industry thrives on the sexual exploitation of women.
exploitation.zh: 电影业的繁荣是建立在对女性性剥削的基础之上的。

exploration.en: You can then use this hut as a base for explorations into the mountains around.
exploration.zh: 你到时可以把这间小屋当大本营，去周围的山里探险。

exploratory.en: He’s going to have exploratory surgery on his knee.
exploratory.zh: 他的膝盖要做探查性手术。

explore.en: Management need to explore ways of improving office security.
explore.zh: 管理层需要探讨如何加强办事处的安全措施。

explore.en: I’m going to explore the possibility of a part-time job.
explore.zh: 我要好好想想兼职工作的可能性。

explosion.en: Several people were injured in a bomb explosion.
explosion.zh: 有数人在炸弹爆炸中受伤。
我们听到一声巨大的爆炸声。

explosive.en: Because the gas is highly explosive, it needs to be kept in high-pressure containers.
explosive.zh: 由于这种气体极易爆炸，因此需要保存在高压容器内。

explosive.en: A small explosive device (=bomb) was set off outside the UN headquarters today.
explosive.zh: 今天有一枚小型炸弹在联合国总部外爆炸。

exponent.en: The most famous exponent of this approach to art was probably Charles Rennie Mackintosh.
exponent.zh: 运用这种艺术手法的最著名的大师恐怕当属查尔斯·

export.en: Wheat is one of the country’s main exports.
export.zh: 小麦是该国的主要出口商品之一。

export.en: The US is Scotland’s second largest export market after France.
export.zh: 美国是苏格兰的第二大出口市场，仅次于法国。

exporter.en: With the expanded production of North Sea oil and gas, the UK has become a net exporter of fuel (=it exports more fuel than it imports).
exporter.zh: 随着北海石油和天然气产量的扩大，英国已成为燃料的净出口国。

exporter.en: Japan is a leading exporter of textiles.
exporter.zh: 日本是纺织品的一大出口国。

expose.en: He lifted his T-shirt to expose a jagged scar across his chest.
Potatoes turn green when exposed to light.
expose.zh: 马铃薯在光照下会变绿。

exposure.en: Prolonged exposure to the sun can cause skin cancer.
exposure.zh: 长时间晒太阳会导致皮肤癌。

exposure.en: The failure of their marriage has got a lot of exposure recently.
exposure.zh: 他俩婚姻失败一事最近被频频曝光。

express.en: Bill’s not afraid to express his opinions.
express.zh: 比尔并不害怕表达自己的观点。

express.en: Parents have expressed their concerns about their children’s safety.
express.zh: 父母对自己孩子的安全表示忧虑。

expression.en: I decided to go to the meeting as an expression of support.
expression.zh: 我决定去参加会议以示支持。

expression.en: The letter was a genuine expression of sympathy.
expression.zh: 信中真诚地表达了同情。

expressive.en: Her poem is expressive of calm days and peace of mind.
expressive.zh: 她的诗歌描绘了静谧的时光以及平和的心境。

expressly.en: He was expressly forbidden to speak to the girl.
expressly.zh: 他被明确禁止与那个女孩说话。

expressly.en: The building is expressly designed to conserve energy.
expressly.zh: 这座建筑经特别设计以节约能源。

expulsion.en: The headmaster threatened the boys with expulsion.
expulsion.zh: 校长警告这几名男生说要开除他们。

exquisite.en: She has exquisite taste in art.
exquisite.zh: 她有敏锐的艺术鉴赏力。

extend.en: Management have agreed to extend the deadline.
extend.zh: 管理层已同意延长最后期限。

extend.en: Some of our courses extend over two years.
extend.zh: 我们有些课程修读期超过两年。

extended.en: If you are going abroad for an extended period of time, you should consider renting your house out.
extended.zh: 如果你要出国较长时间，应该考虑把房子租出去。

extension.en: Donald’s been given an extension to finish his thesis.
extension.zh: 唐纳德获准延期完成他的论文。

extension.en: The pub’s got an extension tonight (=it will stay open longer than usual).

extensive.en: The house stands in extensive grounds.
extensive.zh: 这栋房子占地面积很大。

extensive.en: Fire has caused extensive damage to the island’s forests.
extensive.zh: 大火严重毁坏了岛上的森林。

extent.en: We all to some extent remember the good times and forget the bad.
extent.zh: 我们在某种程度上都会记住美好时光而忘掉不愉快的事情。

extent.en: I do agree with him to an extent.
extent.zh: 我在一定程度上确实同意他的意见。

exterior.en: The dome is tiled on the exterior.
Beneath that calm exterior, he has a fierce will to win.
exterior.zh: 他表面镇定，其实求胜心切。

exterminate.en: Staff use the poison to exterminate moles and rabbits.
exterminate.zh: 员工用毒药来消灭鼹鼠和野兔。

external.en: The outside walls of the building were painted yellow.
Low birth weight may be caused by external factors, such as smoking during pregnancy.
external.zh: 新生儿体重不足可能是外在因素造成的，如怀孕期间吸烟等。

extinct.en: Dinosaurs have been extinct for millions of years.
extinct.zh: 恐龙已灭绝数千万年了。

extinct.en: Pandas could become extinct in the wild.
extinct.zh: 熊猫在野生环境中可能会绝种。

extinction.en: The breed was on the verge of extinction.
They were hunted almost to extinction.
extinction.zh: 它们遭受猎杀，几近灭绝。

extinguish.en: Firemen were called to extinguish the blaze.
extinguish.zh: 有人打电话叫消防队员来扑灭大火。

extort.en: Rebels extorted money from local villagers.
extort.zh: 叛乱分子向当地村民勒索钱财。

extort.en: He faces charges of kidnapping and extortion.
extort.zh: 他面临绑架和勒索的指控。

extra.en: Could you get an extra loaf of bread?
Allow extra time for your journey.
extra.zh: 要给你的旅程多留出点时间。

extract.en: You’ll have to have that tooth extracted.
He extracted an envelope from his inside pocket.
extract.zh: 他从里面的口袋里抽出一个信封。

extraordinarily.en: Why had James behaved so extraordinarily?
extraordinarily.zh: 为什么詹姆斯的行为那么古怪？

extraordinary.en: It took an extraordinary amount of work.
It’s extraordinary that he should make exactly the same mistake again.
extraordinary.zh: 真想不到他又犯了完全相同的错误。

extravagant.en: Would it be too extravagant to buy both?
extravagant.zh: 把两个都买下会不会太奢侈了？

extravagant.en: Don’t be too extravagant with the wine.

extreme.en: Extreme poverty still exists in many rural areas.
extreme.zh: 许多农村地区仍处于赤贫状态。

extreme.en: It is necessary to use extreme caution with chemicals.
extreme.zh: 接触化学品必须极其小心。

extremely.en: Earthquakes are extremely difficult to predict.
I’m extremely sorry to have troubled you.
extremely.zh: 给你添了麻烦，我十分抱歉。

extremity.en: The committee was uncomfortable about the extremity of the proposal.
extremity.zh: 委员会因该建议太极端而感到不安。

exuberant.en: She needs to try and control her natural exuberance.
exuberant.zh: 她需要尽力控制自己天生的旺盛精力。

eye.en: There were tears in her eyes as she listened to the story.
eye.zh: 她听故事时眼里噙着泪水。

eyeball.en: She’s up to her eyeballs in debt.

eyebrow.en: This decision caused a few raised eyebrows (=surprised some people).
eyebrow.zh: 这个决定令一些人感到惊讶。

eyebrow.en: I’m absolutely up to my eyebrows in work.
eyebrow.zh: 我的工作实在是忙得不可开交。

eyelid.en: His eyelids began to droop (=close, because he was sleepy).
The room spun. Her eyelids fluttered (=moved up and down quickly) and she fainted.
eyelid.zh: 房间快速旋转起来。她的眼皮上下翻动，然后便昏了过去。

eyesight.en: He had a problem with his eyesight.

eyewitness.en: According to eyewitness accounts, soldiers opened fire on the crowd.
eyewitness.zh: 据目击者描述，士兵向人群开了枪。

eyewitness.en: One eyewitness said he saw her talking to a man in a blue car.
eyewitness.zh: 一名目击者说他看见她在跟一个坐在蓝色汽车里的男子说话。

fabric.en: Drug abuse poses a major threat to the fabric of our society.
fabric.zh: 吸毒对我们的社会结构造成严重威胁。

fabric.en: The country’s social fabric is disintegrating.
fabric.zh: 该国的社会结构正在瓦解。

fabricate.en: The police were accused of fabricating evidence.
They accused him of making the whole thing up.
fabricate.zh: 他们指责他编造了整件事情。

fabrication.en: Of course, it might all be complete fabrication.
fabrication.zh: 当然，这也许全都是编造出来的。

fabulous.en: The room has fabulous views across the lake.
fabulous.zh: 那个房间可以看到美丽的湖景。

facade.en: Behind her cheerful facade, she’s a really lonely person.
facade.zh: 在开朗的外表下，她其实是个非常孤独的人。

facade.en: She managed to maintain a facade of bravery.
facade.zh: 她努力维持勇敢的表象。

face.en: Her face was white with fear.

facelift.en: The new owner had given the pub a facelift.
facelift.zh: 新老板对酒吧进行了翻修。

facet.en: He has travelled extensively in China, recording every facet of life.
facet.zh: 他在中国游历颇广，记录下了生活的方方面面。

facet.en: The issues are complex and multi-faceted.
facet.zh: 这些问题很复杂，涉及诸多方面。

facial.zh: 维克托脸上的表情没有变化。

facilitate.en: Computers can be used to facilitate language learning.
facilitate.zh: 用电脑可使语言学习更方便。

facility.en: All rooms have private facilities (=private bathroom and toilet).
facility.zh: 所有房间都有独立盥洗室。

facility.en: The hotel has its own pool and leisure facilities.
facility.zh: 这家酒店拥有自己的游泳池和休闲设施。

fact.en: The book is full of facts about the World Cup.
fact.zh: 这本书全是有关世界杯的真实信息。

fact.en: First of all, we need to know the facts of the case.
fact.zh: 首先，我们需要了解案子的相关事实。

factor.en: The rise in crime is mainly due to social and economic factors.
factor.zh: 犯罪率上升主要由社会和经济因素造成。

factor.en: The vaccination program has been a major factor in the improvement of health standards.
factor.zh: 接种疫苗计划是健康水平得以提高的一个主要因素。

factual.en: Try to keep your account of events as factual as possible.
factual.zh: 你要尽量如实地说明情况。

factual.en: Libraries are stores of factual information.
factual.zh: 图书馆是事实资料的宝库。

faculty.en: Both faculty and students oppose the measures.
faculty.zh: 教师和学生都反对这些措施。

faculty.en: She had a great faculty for absorbing information.
faculty.zh: 她吸收信息的能力很强。

fad.en: Interest in organic food is not a fad, it’s here to stay.
fad.zh: 对有机食品的兴趣不是一时的风尚，它是长久的喜好。

fade.en: Hopes of a peace settlement are beginning to fade.
fade.zh: 达成和平协议的希望日渐渺茫。

fade.en: Over the years her beauty had faded a little.
fade.zh: 岁月流逝，她的美貌已略逊当年。

fail.en: It looks likely that the peace talks will fail.
fail.zh: 看来和平谈判可能会失败。

fail.en: He failed in his attempt to regain the world title.
fail.zh: 他未能夺回世界冠军头衔。

failure.en: Successful people often aren’t very good at dealing with failure.
failure.zh: 一帆风顺的人往往不太擅长应对失败。

failure.en: I always felt a bit of a failure at school.
failure.zh: 我上学时总觉得自己有点失败。

faint.en: I don’t have the faintest idea what you’re talking about.
faint.zh: 我一点都不知道你在说什么。

fair.en: All we are asking for is a fair wage.
fair.zh: 我们所要求的只是一份合理的薪水。

fair.en: What do you think is the fairest solution?
fair.zh: 你认为最合理的解决方式是什么？

fairly.en: The house had a fairly large garden.
fairly.zh: 那幢房子有个不小的花园。

faith.en: I still have faith in him.
The public has lost faith in the government.
faith.zh: 公众已对政府失去信心。

faithful.en: He remained faithful to his principles to the last.
faithful.zh: 他至死忠于自己的原则。

faithful.en: Do you think Bob’s always been faithful to you?
faithful.zh: 你觉得鲍勃一直对你忠诚吗？

faithfully.en: He had served the family faithfully for 40 years.
faithfully.zh: 他已忠心耿耿地为这家人服务了40

faithfully.en: Ann faithfully promised never to tell my secret.
faithfully.zh: 安信誓旦旦地保证决不把我的秘密说出去。

fake.en: The painting was judged a fake.
Jones can spot a fake from 20 feet away.

fall.en: The tree was about to fall.
The book fell from his hands.

fallacy.en: It’s a common fallacy that a neutered dog will become fat and lazy.
fallacy.zh: 说阉割过的狗会变得又胖又懒，这是普遍的谬见。

fallible.en: These surveys are often a rather fallible guide to public opinion.
fallible.zh: 这些调查往往会对舆论产生误导。

fallout.en: The political fallout of the affair cost him his job.
fallout.zh: 这一事件的政治影响使他丢了工作。

false.en: Please decide whether the following statements are true or false.
false.zh: 请判断以下说法的对错。

false.en: I don’t want to give you any false hopes.
false.zh: 我不想让你有任何虚假的希望。

falsehood.en: Saunders is deliberately telling a falsehood.
No one had accused me of falsehood before.
falsehood.zh: 以前从没有人指责过我说谎。

falsify.en: The file was altered to falsify the evidence.
falsify.zh: 文件被动了手脚，以此伪造证据。

falter.en: The economy is showing signs of faltering.
My mother’s grip upon the household never faltered.
falter.zh: 我母亲对全家人的管束从没放松过。

fame.en: He claims he is not really interested in fame.
fame.zh: 他称自己对出名真的没有兴趣。

familiar.en: The voice on the phone sounded familiar.
The signs of drug addiction are familiar to most doctors.
familiar.zh: 毒瘾的症状大多数医生都熟悉。

familiarity.en: In fact his familiarity with the Bronx was pretty limited.
familiarity.zh: 事实上他对布朗克斯区的了解相当有限。

familiarity.en: I miss the familiarity of home.
familiarity.zh: 我怀念家的那种亲切感。

familiarize.en: Employees must familiarize themselves with the health and safety manual.
familiarize.zh: 雇员必须熟悉健康和安全手册。

family.en: Do you know the family next door?
The Webb family still has its farm over there.
family.zh: 韦伯家依然保留着那里的农场。

famine.en: Widespread famine had triggered a number of violent protests.
famine.zh: 大面积饥荒已引发数起暴力抗议事件。

famine.en: A million people are facing famine.

famous.en: Many famous people have stayed in the hotel.
famous.zh: 许多名人都曾下榻这家酒店。

famous.en: The Eiffel Tower is a famous landmark (=a famous place or building that is easy to recognize).
famous.zh: 埃菲尔铁塔是著名的地标。

fan.en: Groups of football fans began heading towards the ground.
fan.zh: 成群结队的球迷开始向球场走去。

fan.en: He’s a big fan of Elvis Presley.

fanciful.en: The suggestion that there was a conspiracy is not entirely fanciful.
fanciful.zh: 说有人在搞阴谋，这并不完全是臆想。

fancy.en: Sorry, but I don’t fancy going out tonight.
fancy.zh: 对不起，今晚我不想出去。

fantastic.en: It’s a fantastic place, really beautiful!
fantastic.zh: 这真是个好地方，漂亮极了！

fantastic.en: Kids spend fantastic amounts of money on CDs.
fantastic.zh: 孩子们花了好多钱买激光唱片。

fantasy.en: I used to have fantasies about living in Paris with an artist.
fantasy.zh: 我过去常幻想着在巴黎与一位艺术家同住。

fantasy.en: Young children sometimes can’t distinguish between fantasy and reality.
fantasy.zh: 小孩子有时不能区分幻想与现实。

far.en: Since I changed jobs, I have to travel further to get to work.
far.zh: 我换了工作，上班更远了。

faraway.en: She dreamed of flying away to exotic faraway places.
faraway.zh: 她梦想着飞到遥远的异国。

faraway.en: His eyes had a distant faraway look, like a sailor staring out to sea.
faraway.zh: 他的眼神若有所思，就像水手在眺望大海。

farce.en: She admitted that the interview had been a complete farce from start to finish.
farce.zh: 她承认，采访从头到尾完全是一场闹剧。

fare.en: Air fares have shot up by 20%.

farewell.en: Mourners gathered to bid farewell to the victims of the plane tragedy.
farewell.zh: 哀悼者来向空难受害者告别。

farm.en: Joe had worked on the farm all his life.
He runs a pig farm in Lincolnshire.
farm.zh: 他在林肯郡经营一个养猪场。

far-reaching.en: The country carried out far-reaching reforms to modernize its economy.
far-reaching.zh: 该国实行了意义深远的改革以实现经济现代化。

far-reaching.en: Tourism has had far-reaching effects on the island’s culture.
far-reaching.zh: 旅游业对该岛文化产生了深远的影响。

farther.en: We decided not to go any farther.
farther.zh: 我们决定不再往前走了。

farther.en: The boats were drifting farther and farther apart.
farther.zh: 那些小船顺水漂流，彼此距离越来越远。

fascination.en: Police knew of his fascination with guns.

fascist.en: The fascists came to power in 1933.
My last boss was a real fascist.
fascist.zh: 我的上一个老板是个十足的法西斯。

fashion.en: The emerging science of photography was already changing fashions in art.
fashion.zh: 摄影科学的兴起已在改变艺术的潮流。

fashion.en: Their music will never go out of fashion.

fashionable.en: Strong colours are very fashionable at the moment.
It suddenly became fashionable for politicians to talk about green issues.
fashionable.zh: 政客们大谈环保问题突然变成了一种时尚。

fast.en: He’s one of the fastest runners in the world.
fast.zh: 他是世界上跑得最快的人之一。

fast.en: The subway is the fastest way to get downtown.

fasten.en: I was so fat that my skirt wouldn’t fasten.
fasten.zh: 我胖得裙子都扣不上了。

fat.en: Are you suggesting I’m too fat?
fat.zh: 你是不是在说我太胖了？

fat.en: You’ll get fat if you eat all that chocolate.
fat.zh: 如果你把那些巧克力都吃了，就会变胖的。

fatal.en: If it is not treated correctly, the condition can prove fatal (=be fatal).
fatal.zh: 如果治疗不当，这种病可能会致命。

fatal.en: Disunity finally proved fatal to the rebels’ cause.
fatal.zh: 内部失和最终成为叛乱分子此番举事的致命弱点。

fatality.en: The most serious form of skin cancer has a 30 percent fatality rate.
fatality.zh: 最严重的皮肤癌致死率可达30%

fate.en: I wouldn’t wish such a fate on my worst enemy.
fate.zh: 就算是我不共戴天的仇敌，我也不希望他遭遇这样的命运。

fate.en: No one knows what the fate of the hostages will be.
fate.zh: 没有人知道这些人质的命运将会如何。

fateful.en: The goalkeeper on that fateful day in 1954 was Fred Martin.
When his rent was raised, he made the fateful decision to move north.
fateful.zh: 房租上涨，他作出重大决定，搬到北方去住。

father.en: Ask your father to help you.
Andrew was very excited about becoming a father.
father.zh: 安德鲁初为人父，非常激动。

fatherly.en: He took my arm in a fatherly way.
fatherly.zh: 他像父亲一般挽住我的胳膊。

fathom.en: I still can’t fathom out what she meant.
fathom.zh: 我还是弄不清她的意思。

fathom.en: Mark couldn’t fathom why she resented him so much.
fathom.zh: 马克不明白她为什么那么恨他。

fatigue.en: Sam’s face was grey with fatigue.
He’s suffering from physical and mental fatigue.

fatten.en: These projects simply serve to fatten the pockets of developers.
fatten.zh: 这些项目只会肥了开发商的腰包。

fatten.en: My parents are always trying to fatten me up.
fatten.zh: 我父母老是想把我喂得胖胖的。

fault.en: I’m really sorry – it’s all my fault.

faulty.en: Customers may ask for a refund if the goods are faulty.
faulty.zh: 商品有问题的话，顾客可以要求退货。

favour.en: Could you do me a favour and tell Kelly I can’t make it?
favour.zh: 你帮个忙告诉凯莉说我来不了好吗？

favour.en: He hired John as a favour to his father.
favour.zh: 他雇约翰是给他父亲一个面子。

favourable.en: The response has been overwhelmingly favorable.
The disease spreads quickly under favourable conditions.
favourable.zh: 这种病在合适的条件下会传播得很快。

favourite.en: Can we have strawberries? They’re my favourite.
favourite.zh: 给我们来点草莓好吗？我最爱吃了。

fear.en: There are fears that share prices could decrease still further.
fear.zh: 有人担心股价会继续下滑。

fear.en: The girl’s parents expressed fears for her safety.
fear.zh: 女孩的父母对她的安全表示担心。

fearful.en: People are fearful of rising crime in the area.
fearful.zh: 人们担心这个地区犯罪率上升。

fearful.en: Officials are fearful that the demonstrations will cause new violence.
fearful.zh: 官员们担心示威游行会引发新的暴力事件。

feasible.en: It was no longer financially feasible to keep the community centre open.
feasible.zh: 社区中心再开下去经济上无法承受。

feast.en: The king promised to hold a great feast for all his people.
feast.zh: 国王允诺为全体子民举行盛宴。

feast.en: Next week’s film festival should be a real feast for cinema-goers.
feast.zh: 下星期的电影节应该能让影迷大饱眼福。

feat.en: They climbed the mountain in 28 days, a remarkable feat.
It is no mean feat to perform such a difficult piece.
feat.zh: 演奏这么难的乐章可不是一般的成就。

feathery.zh: 这种植物长着羽状叶片。

feature.en: Air bags are a standard feature in most new cars.
feature.zh: 气囊是大多数新车的标准配置。

feature.en: An important feature of Van Gogh’s paintings is their bright colours.

february.zh: 妈妈去年二月份过世了。

february.en: We can do it in February.

federal.zh: 瑞士是一个联邦共和国。

fee.en: You can use the gym and pool for a fee of £35 a month.
Some companies will sell the items for you, for a small fee.
fee.zh: 有些公司可代你出售这些物品，只收取少量费用。

feeble.en: His voice sounded feeble and far away.
feeble.zh: 他的声音听上去既无力又遥远。

feeble.en: She was too feeble to leave her room.
feeble.zh: 她身体虚弱，无法走出自己的房间。

feed.en: She was too weak to feed herself.
feed.zh: 她虚弱极了，无法自己进食。

feedback.en: How can I provide feedback without making someone angry?
feedback.zh: 我怎样才能提出反馈意见又不会得罪人呢？

feedback.en: Try to give each student some feedback on the task.
feedback.zh: 尽量对每个学生的作业都提点意见。

feeder.en: The Shyok River is a major feeder of the Indus River.
feeder.zh: 什约克河是印度河的主要支流。

feeder.en: The length of the feeder pipe is 50m.

feel.en: You can never tell what he’s feeling.
feel.zh: 他的感受你永远说不准。

feeling.en: Knowing we'd won was a wonderful feeling.
feeling.zh: 得知我们赢了，感觉真好。

feeling.en: He’s considerate of other people’s feelings.

fell.en: More than 100 trees were felled in just over an hour.
The goalkeeper was felled by a coin thrown from the crowd.
fell.zh: 守门员被观众扔出的一枚硬币击倒。

fellow.en: We all have obligations to our fellow men.
fellow.zh: 我们每个人都对人类负有责任。

fellow.en: Paul’s an easy-going sort of fellow.

fellowship.en: Regular outings contribute to a sense of fellowship among co-workers.
fellowship.zh: 经常外出游玩可以增进同事之间的友谊。

fellowship.en: Florian came to the United States on a Fulbright fellowship.
fellowship.zh: 弗洛里安因获得富布赖特奖学金而得以来到美国。

female.en: Over half of the staff are female.
female.zh: 半数以上的员工是女性。

female.en: As a group, females performed better on the test than males.
female.zh: 整体来说，女性在这次测试中胜过男性。

feminine.zh: 黛安娜喜爱漂亮有女人味的东西。

feminine.en: Amelia’s report describes the experience from a feminine point of view.
feminine.zh: 阿梅莉亚的报道从女性角度描写了这种经历。

feminist.en: She’s been an outspoken feminist for over twenty years.

fence.en: The yard was fenced in to keep out wolves.
fence.zh: 院子用篱笆围起防止狼进来。

fence.en: Young mothers often feel fenced in at home.
fence.zh: 年轻母亲往往感觉自己被束缚在家里。

fend.en: The kids had to fend for themselves while their parents were away.
fend.zh: 父母不在家时，孩子们只好自己照料自己。

fend.en: Tabitha threw up an arm to fend her attacker off.
fend.zh: 塔比莎挥臂挡开行凶者。

ferocious.en: The storm grew more and more ferocious with each second.
ferocious.zh: 风暴每一秒钟都在加剧。

ferocious.en: The congressman is one of the president’s most ferocious critics.
ferocious.zh: 那位众议员是批评总统最激烈的人之一。

ferry.en: The ship was used to ferry supplies to Russia during the war.
ferry.zh: 这艘船在战时被用来往俄罗斯

fertile.en: Most men remain fertile into old age.
fertile.zh: 大多数男子直到老年还有生育能力。

fertilize.en: After the egg has been fertilized, it will hatch in about six weeks.
fertilize.zh: 蛋受精后六周左右孵化。

fester.en: The dispute can be traced back to resentments which have festered for centuries.
fester.zh: 这一争端可以追溯到积累了好几个世纪的仇怨。

festival.en: Christmas is one of the main festivals in the Christian calendar.
festival.zh: 圣诞节是基督教历的重大节日之一。

festival.en: Tucson had a film festival last month.
festival.zh: 上个月图森举办了电影节。

festive.en: The atmosphere was festive and jolly.
John was obviously in a festive mood.

festivity.en: The festivities started with a procession through the town.
festivity.zh: 庆祝活动以全城巡游开场。

festivity.en: There was an air of festivity in the village.

fetch.en: Quick! Go and fetch a doctor.
Shannon went upstairs to fetch some blankets.

feud.en: The neighboring states are feuding over the rights to the river.
feud.zh: 相邻各国在这条河的归属问题上结怨多年。

fever.en: Andy has a fever and won’t be coming into work today.
fever.zh: 安迪发烧了，今天不来上班。

fever.en: I woke up this morning with a fever and an upset stomach.
fever.zh: 今天早上醒来时我发烧了，胃也不舒服。

feverish.en: She lay in bed, too feverish to sleep.
feverish.zh: 她躺在床上，烧得太厉害难以入睡。

feverish.en: There was a feverish blush to his cheeks.

few.en: I have to buy a few things at the supermarket.
few.zh: 我得到超级市场买些东西。

few.en: Pam called to say she’s going to be a few minutes late.
few.zh: 帕姆打电话来说她要晚几分钟到。

fibre.en: Fruit and vegetables are high in fibre content.
fibre.zh: 水果和蔬菜的纤维素含量很高。

fibrous.en: The coconut has a fibrous outer covering.
fibrous.zh: 椰子有一个纤维质的外壳。

fictional.en: The novel is set in the fictional German town of Kreiswald.
fictional.zh: 这部小说以虚构的德国小镇克赖斯瓦尔德为背景。

fiddle.en: They suspected he was on the fiddle (=getting money dishonestly or illegally) all along.
fiddle.zh: 他们怀疑他一直在搞欺诈勾当。

fiddle.en: This blouse is a bit of a fiddle to do up.
fiddle.zh: 这件女衬衫扣起来有点费劲。

fidget.en: The kids had started to fidget.
fidget.zh: 孩子们开始坐立不安起来。

field.en: Peter’s an expert in his field.
field.zh: 彼得是他那个行业里的专家。

field.en: He’s the best-known American outside the field of (=not connected with) politics.
field.zh: 他是政治领域之外最出名的美国人。

fierce.en: The government’s policies came under fierce attack.
fierce.zh: 政府的政策遭到猛烈抨击。
她转过身，一副恶狠狠的样子。

fifteen.en: They met when she was fifteen (=15 years old).
I’m planning to leave on the fifteenth (=the 15th day of the month).

fifth.en: They’d made her feel like a fifth wheel.
fifth.zh: 他们让她感觉像个多余的人。

fifth.en: I’m planning to leave on the fifth (=the fifth day of the month).

fifty.en: Standards of living rose in the fifties.
The play was written in the late fifties.

fight.en: They fought for control of the islands.
fight.zh: 他们为争夺那些岛屿的控制权而战。

fight.en: Neither country is capable of fighting a long war.
fight.zh: 两个国家都没有能力打持久战。

fighter.en: He was shot down by enemy fighters.
James is a fighter – he never gives up.
fighter.zh: 詹姆斯是个顽强拼搏的人——

figurative.en: He’s my son, in the figurative sense of the word.
figurative.zh: 打个比方，他就像是我的儿子。

figurative.en: They have a taste – figuratively speaking – for excitement.
figurative.zh: 用个形象的说法，刺激合他们的“

figure.zh: 政府的数据对这一问题反映不足。

figurehead.en: The Queen is merely a figurehead.
figurehead.zh: 女王只是名义上的元首。

file.en: Mendoza read over the file on the murders.
file.zh: 门多萨阅读了这几起凶杀案的卷宗。

file.en: The FBI keeps files on former White House employees.
file.zh: 联邦调查局存有前白宫雇员的档案。

fill.en: He poured her a drink, then filled his own glass.
fill.zh: 他给她倒了一杯，然后将自己的杯子斟满。

fill.en: My job was filling the flour sacks.

filling.en: Pasta and rice are both very filling.
filling.zh: 意大利面食和米饭都很能填饱肚子。

film.en: Have you seen any good films recently?
film.zh: 你最近看过什么好的影片吗？

film.en: I’m interested in photography and film.
film.zh: 我对摄影和电影制作感兴趣。

filter.en: The firm uses electronic filters to prevent workers from accessing the Internet.
filter.zh: 该公司利用电子过滤器来防止员工上网。

filter.en: The water in the tank is constantly filtered.
filter.zh: 鱼缸里的水在不停地被过滤。

filth.en: I don’t know how you can watch that filth!
filth.zh: 我不知道你怎么会看那种淫秽的东西！

filth.en: Passing cars covered his shoes with filth.
filth.zh: 来往的车辆弄得他鞋子上全是脏东西。

filthy.en: The house was filthy, with clothes and newspapers strewn everywhere.
filthy.zh: 屋子里很脏，衣服和报纸扔得到处都是。

filthy.en: Your problem is you’ve got a filthy mind (=you are always thinking about sex).
filthy.zh: 你的问题是满脑子下流念头。

final.en: The final episode will be shown tonight.
final.zh: 最后一集将于今晚播出。

final.en: Stone is filming the final instalment of his Vietnam trilogy.
final.zh: 斯通正在拍摄越战三部曲的最后一部。

finalize.en: Jo flew out to Thailand to finalize the details of the deal.
finalize.zh: 乔乘飞机去往泰国，敲定这笔生意的具体事宜。

finally.en: After several delays we finally took off at six o'clock.
finally.zh: 几经耽搁后，我们终于在六点起飞了。

finally.en: Finally, Karpov cracked under the pressure.
finally.zh: 最后，卡尔波夫承受不住压力崩溃了。

finance.en: She refused to answer questions about her personal finances.
finance.zh: 她拒绝回答有关个人财务状况的问题。

finance.en: We need to raise finance for further research.
finance.zh: 我们需要为进一步研究筹资。

financial.en: Organic farmers should be encouraged with financial incentives.
financial.zh: 应对实行有机栽培的农民给予经济上的鼓励。

financial.en: It was a wonderful film, but not exactly a financial success (=something that makes a profit).
financial.zh: 这是一部出色的影片，但在票房上不是很成功。

find.en: I can’t find the car keys.
Hold on while I find a pen.

finding.en: Surveys conducted in other countries reported similar findings.
finding.zh: 在其他国家进行的调查也报告说有类似的结果。

fine.en: In theory, the scheme sounds fine.
fine.zh: 理论上，这个计划听起来不错。

fine.en: If you want to use cheese instead of chicken, that’s fine.
fine.zh: 要是你想用奶酪来替代鸡肉，也是可以的。

finely.zh: 桑德斯精心绘制的画作

finely.en: These instruments are very finely tuned.
finely.zh: 这些乐器都非常仔细地调过音。

finger.en: The woman had a ring on her finger, so I assumed she was married.
finger.zh: 那女人手指上戴着戒指，因此我猜想她已经结婚了。

fingerprint.en: His fingerprints were all over the gun.
He was careful not to leave any fingerprints.

finicky.en: She’s very finicky about what she eats.

finish.en: You can’t go anywhere until you’ve finished your homework.
finish.zh: 没完成家庭作业前你哪儿也不能去。

finish.en: Have you finished that book yet?

finished.en: Are you finished with my tools yet?
It took a long time to do, but the finished product was worth it.
finished.zh: 虽然花了很长时间，但从成品看是值得的。

fire.en: The warehouse was completely destroyed by fire.
Thirty people died in a fire in downtown Chicago.

firearm.en: He was charged with illegal possession of a firearm.

fireball.en: The jet exploded in midair and turned into a fireball.
fireball.zh: 那架喷气式飞机在半空爆炸，变成了一团火球。

firework.en: Jeff and David were in the back yard setting off fireworks.
firework.zh: 杰夫和戴维在后院放烟花。

firework.en: There’ll be fireworks if I get home late again.
firework.zh: 如果我再晚回家，有人会发火的。

firm.en: She works for an electronics firm.
firm.zh: 她在一家电子公司工作。

firm.en: Kevin is with a firm of accountants in Birmingham.
firm.zh: 凯文在伯明翰的一家会计师事务所工作。

first.en: The first time I flew on a plane I was really nervous.
first.zh: 我第一次乘飞机时确实很紧张。

firstly.en: Firstly, I would like to thank everyone who has contributed to this success.
firstly.zh: 首先，我要感谢对这次成功作出贡献的每一个人。

fish.en: Over 1,500 different species of fish inhabit the waters around the reef.
fish.zh: 那片礁石周围的水域生活着1,500

fish.en: The stonefish is the most deadly of all fishes.
fish.zh: 石鱼是所有鱼类中毒性最强的。

fishing.en: Fishing is one of his hobbies.
fishing.zh: 钓鱼是他的一项业余爱好。

fishing.en: Terry’s going fishing at Lake Arrowhead next weekend.
fishing.zh: 特里下周末要到阿罗黑德湖钓鱼。

fist.en: She held the money tightly in her fist.
fist.zh: 她把钱紧紧地攥在手中。

fist.en: Malcolm clenched his fist (=held his fist very tightly closed) angrily.
fist.zh: 马尔科姆愤怒地握紧拳头。

fit.en: His clothes did not fit him very well.

fit.zh: 这套制服她穿合身极了。

fitness.en: Running marathons requires a high level of physical fitness.
fitness.zh: 跑马拉松需要身体十分强健。

fitness.en: He questioned McNeil’s fitness for high office.
fitness.zh: 他质疑麦克尼尔是否适合身居高位。

fitting.en: I thought the memorial was a fitting tribute to the president.
fitting.zh: 我认为这座纪念碑恰如其分地表达了对总统的敬意。

fitting.en: It is only fitting that Simon should propose the first toast tonight.
fitting.zh: 今晚让西蒙第一个祝酒是最合适的。

five.en: There is also a golf course five miles away.
five.zh: 五英里外还有个高尔夫球场。

five.en: I’ll be back by five (=five o'clock).

fix.en: He’s outside fixing the brakes on the car.
fix.zh: 他在外面修理汽车的刹车。

fix.en: Ellis was able to quickly find and fix the problem.
fix.zh: 埃利斯马上就找到并解决了问题。

fixation.en: Carlo has an absolute fixation with the royal family.
fixation.zh: 卡洛对皇室有一种化不开的情结。

fixed.en: The classes begin and end at fixed times.
fixed.zh: 上下课的时间都是固定不变的。

fixed.en: My contract was for a fixed term of five years.
fixed.zh: 我的合同是五年固定期限的。

fixture.en: Gerrard soon became a permanent fixture in the Liverpool team.
fixture.zh: 杰拉德很快就成了利物浦队的固定成员。

flabby.en: The band’s performance was tired and flabby.

flag.en: Children waving flags greeted the Russian leader.
flag.zh: 孩子们挥舞着旗帜，欢迎俄罗斯领导人。

flag.en: Flags were flying at half-mast because of the death of the Premier.
flag.zh: 降半旗为总理的逝世志哀。

flair.en: Jo has a flair for languages.

flake.en: The paint is beginning to flake off.
Use a moisturising cream to stop your skin flaking.
flake.zh: 涂点润肤霜防止皮肤脱屑。

flamboyant.en: He lifted his arms in a flamboyant gesture.
flamboyant.zh: 他抬起胳膊，做了个炫耀的手势。

flamboyant.en: She has red hair and a rather flamboyant appearance.
flamboyant.zh: 她一头红发，外表相当艳丽。

flame.en: Flames poured out of the windows of the building.
flame.zh: 火焰从大楼窗口冒出来。

flame.en: They rushed past us with buckets of water and tried to douse the flames.
flame.zh: 他们提着一桶桶水跑过我们身边去灭火。

flaming.en: They seem to have a flaming row at least once a week.
flaming.zh: 他们好像每周至少大吵一次。

flaming.en: Residents panicked as flaming petrol poured down the street.
flaming.zh: 燃烧的汽油沿街流淌，居民惊慌失措。

flank.en: We were attacked on our left flank.
Lewis entered flanked by two bodyguards.
flank.zh: 刘易斯在左右两名保镖的陪同下走了进来。

flap.en: A loose flap of skin covered the wound.
flap.zh: 伤口上覆盖着一片快要脱落的皮。

flap.en: Rafi’s in a bit of a flap over the wedding plans.
flap.zh: 拉菲对婚礼的安排有点焦虑不安。

flare.en: Rioting has flared up in several towns.
flare.zh: 有几个小镇爆发了骚乱。

flash.en: Why is that guy flashing his headlights at me?
flash.zh: 那家伙为什么朝我闪前灯呢？

flash.en: Red warning lights flashed on and off (=shone for a short time and then stopped shining).

flat.en: The countryside near there is flat as a pancake (=very flat).
flat.zh: 那儿附近的乡间地势非常平坦。

flat.en: Work on a clean, flat surface.
flat.zh: 在干净、平整的台面上工作。

flatten.en: Use a rolling pin to flatten the dough.
The land flattened out as we neared the coast.
flatten.zh: 我们接近海岸时，地势变平坦了。

flatter.en: Perry would always flatter Mrs. Mitchell by praising her cooking.
flatter.zh: 佩里常常奉承米切尔太太，称赞她的烹调手艺。

flatter.en: That dress really flatters your figure.
flatter.zh: 那件连衣裙很显你的身材。

flaunt.en: The rich flaunted their wealth while the poor starved on the streets.
flaunt.zh: 富人摆阔，穷人却在大街上饿肚子。

flavour.en: Which flavour do you want – chocolate or vanilla?
flavour.zh: 你要哪种味道的，巧克力还是香草？

flavour.en: I prefer this one because it has more flavour.
flavour.zh: 我喜欢这种，因为它味道更好。

flaw.en: A design flaw (=a mistake or weakness in the way something was made) caused the engine to explode.
flaw.zh: 一个设计缺陷导致了引擎爆炸。

flaw.en: Beautiful scenery does not make up for the flaws of this film.
flaw.zh: 美丽的风光弥补不了此影片的不足。

flee.zh: 袭击他的人转身逃走了。

flee.en: Masaari spent six months in prison before fleeing the country.
flee.zh: 正有蹲了六个月监狱，然后逃出了该国。

fleet.en: Atalanta was fleet of foot (=able to run quickly).

fleeting.en: For one fleeting moment, Paula allowed herself to forget her troubles.
fleeting.zh: 就在这一片刻，葆拉让自己暂时忘却了烦恼。

fleeting.en: I caught a fleeting glimpse of them as they drove past.
fleeting.zh: 我瞥见他们驱车一闪而过。

flesh.en: His flesh was red and covered in sores.
flesh.zh: 他的皮肤发红，上面全是疮。

flesh.en: Cut the melon in half and scoop out the flesh.
flesh.zh: 把瓜切成两半，然后挖出瓜瓤。

flexibility.en: Employees expect flexibility in the workplace.
flexibility.zh: 员工们盼望工作安排有弹性。

flexibility.en: Stretching exercises will help your flexibility.
flexibility.zh: 伸展运动能增强身体柔韧性。

flexible.en: We can be flexible about your starting date.
flexible.zh: 你具体从哪天开始，我们可以灵活一点。

flexible.en: Our new computer software is extremely flexible.
flexible.zh: 我们的新电脑软件兼容性极好。

flick.en: Papa flicked the ash from his cigar.
flick.zh: 爸爸弹去雪茄上的烟灰。

flick.en: The cow’s tail flicked from side to side.

flicker.en: A puzzled smile flickered across the woman’s face.
flicker.zh: 那女人脸上掠过一丝困惑的微笑。

flight.en: He immediately booked a flight to Toulouse.
flight.zh: 他当即就订了去图卢兹的航班。

flight.en: There are only three flights a day to Logan Airport from Heathrow.
flight.zh: 希思罗机场每天只有三趟飞往洛根机场的航班。

flimsy.en: The evidence against him is extremely flimsy.
flimsy.zh: 指控他的证据根本站不住脚。

fling.en: He flung the box into the river.
People cheered and flung their hats into the air.
fling.zh: 民众欢呼着把帽子抛向空中。

flip.en: He flipped the top off the bottle and poured himself a drink.
flip.zh: 他一下子打开瓶盖，给自己倒了杯饮料。

flip.en: She flipped the lid of the box open and looked inside.
flip.zh: 她迅速打开盒盖，往里面看。

flirt.en: She accused him of flirting with other women.
flirt.zh: 她指责他与别的女人调情。

flirt.en: She was flirting outrageously (=a lot) with some of the managers.
flirt.zh: 她肆无忌惮地与一些经理调情。

float.en: I wasn’t sure if the raft would float.
float.zh: 我不能肯定这只木筏是否浮得起来。

float.en: She spent the afternoon floating on her back in the pool.
float.zh: 整个下午她都仰面浮在泳池里。

flock.en: People have been flocking to the exhibition.
Tourists flock to see the town’s medieval churches and buildings.
flock.zh: 游客蜂拥而至，参观该镇的中世纪教堂和建筑。

flood.en: Towns and cities all over the country have been flooded.
flood.zh: 全国各地的城镇都被淹没了。

flood.en: The houses down by the river flood quite regularly.

floor.en: Our office is on the top floor.
We are located on the seventh floor of the building.

flop.en: He flopped down onto the bed.
I got home and flopped in front of the TV.
flop.zh: 我回到家，一屁股坐在电视机前。

flora.en: Tourism is damaging the flora and fauna (=plants and animals) of the island.
flora.zh: 旅游业正在破坏该岛的动植物资源。

floral.en: There were floral tributes (=flowers sent as a sign of respect after someone has died) from his colleagues.

flotation.en: The company has decided to postpone its flotation on the stock market.
flotation.zh: 该公司决定暂缓股票上市。

flour.en: Roll the pastry out on a lightly floured board.
flour.zh: 把面团放在撒有少许面粉的案板上擀平。

flourish.en: The economy is booming and small businesses are flourishing.
flourish.zh: 经济繁荣，小企业蒸蒸日上。

flourish.en: Most plants will flourish in the rich deep soils here.
flourish.zh: 大多数植物在此处肥厚的土壤里都能茁壮成长。

flout.en: Some companies flout the rules and employ children as young as seven.
flout.zh: 有些公司无视规定，雇用年仅七岁的儿童。

flout.en: The union had openly flouted the law.

flow.en: He struggled to swim against the flow of the water.
flow.zh: 他逆着水流拼命地往前游。

flow.en: I tied a towel round his leg to try to stem the flow of blood.
flow.zh: 我在他腿上包扎了块毛巾止血。

flower.en: He wasn’t interested in growing flowers in the garden.
flower.zh: 他对在花园里种花没兴趣。

flower.en: She bent down and picked a flower.

flu.en: Steven’s still in bed with flu.
flu.zh: 史蒂文患了流感，仍卧病在床。

fluctuate.en: Prices were volatile, fluctuating between $20 and $40.
The number of children in the school fluctuates around 100.

fluent.en: She was fluent in English, French, and German.
fluent.zh: 她的英语、法语和德语都很流利。
他用流利的意大利语讲话。

fluff.en: He was picking bits of fluff off his trousers.
fluff.zh: 他在揪裤子上的绒毛球。

fluff.en: The chicks were just balls of yellow fluff.
fluff.zh: 那些小鸡还只是一个个黄色的绒毛球。

fluffy.en: Cream the butter and sugar until the mixture is light and fluffy.
fluffy.zh: 搅拌黄油和糖，直到混合物变得松软。

fluffy.en: Her new book is a fluffy romantic fantasy.
fluffy.zh: 她的新书是一本肤浅的爱情幻想小说。

fluid.en: He is not allowed solid food yet, only fluids.
fluid.zh: 他还不能吃固体食物，只能进流食。

fluke.en: He agreed that the second goal was a fluke.
fluke.zh: 他也认为第二个进球实属侥幸。

flush.en: Susan flushed deeply and looked away.
flush.zh: 苏珊脸涨得通红，目光转向别处。

flush.en: Robyn felt her cheeks flush scarlet.
flush.zh: 萝宾感觉自己的两颊涨得通红。

flutter.en: A small bird fluttered past the window.
flutter.zh: 一只小鸟拍打着翅膀飞过窗前。

flutter.en: Dead leaves fluttered slowly to the ground.

flux.en: Everything is in flux at the moment.
The education system is still in a state of flux.
flux.zh: 教育体制仍处于不断变化之中。

fly.en: She’s flying back to the States tomorrow.
Will you take the train there or fly?
fly.zh: 你去那里是坐火车还是坐飞机？

foam.en: The sea was covered in foam.
Firefighters using water and foam are still tackling the blaze.
foam.zh: 消防员还在利用水和灭火泡沫和大火搏斗。

fob.en: She fobbed him off with a promise to pay him the money next week.
fob.zh: 她答应下周付给他钱，把他敷衍了过去。

fob.en: They tried to fob me off with a cheap camera.
fob.zh: 他们试图用一台廉价相机打发我。

focus.en: He needs to focus more on his career.
focus.zh: 他需要更加关注自己的事业。

focus.en: She tried to focus her mind on her work.

fodder.en: The murders made prime fodder for newspapers.
fodder.zh: 这些凶杀案成了报纸的主要素材。

fog.en: We got lost in the thick fog.
It will be a cold night, and there may be fog patches.
fog.zh: 今夜天气寒冷，部分地区可能有雾。

foggy.en: None of us had the foggiest idea about how to put the tent up.
foggy.zh: 我们都对搭帐篷一窍不通。

foible.en: We all have our little foibles.
foible.zh: 我们大家都有各自的小毛病。

foil.en: Cover the chicken with silver foil and bake.
foil.zh: 用银箔把鸡肉包起来烘烤。

foil.en: The simple stone floor is the perfect foil for the brightly coloured furnishings.
foil.zh: 朴素的石材地板完美地衬托出色彩鲜艳的家具。

fold.en: Fold the paper along the dotted line.
It’ll fit in if you fold it in half.

folk.en: I’m sure there are some folk who would rather they weren’t here.
folk.zh: 我敢肯定有些人宁愿自己不在这里。

folk.en: Thanks to the folks at NBC.
folk.zh: 感谢全国广播公司的工作人员。

follow.en: The patrol car followed the BMW for a few miles and then lost it.
follow.zh: 巡逻车跟了那辆宝马几英里，后来就跟丢了。

follower.en: Marx and his followers were convinced that capitalism would destroy itself.
follower.zh: 马克思及其支持者确信资本主义将自我毁灭。

following.en: He was sick in the evening, but the following day he was better.
following.zh: 那天晚上他生病了，但第二天就好一些了。

following.en: Payment may be made in any of the following ways: cheque, cash, or credit card.
following.zh: 可用以下任意一种方式付款:

folly.en: Somerville bitterly regretted his folly at becoming involved.
folly.zh: 萨默维尔对于把自己牵涉进去的愚蠢行为后悔不迭。

folly.en: It would be sheer folly to reduce spending on health education.
folly.zh: 减少健康教育上的支出是再愚蠢不过的。

foment.en: They were accused of fomenting rebellion.

fond.en: Joe’s quite fond of her, isn’t he?

fringe.zh: 尼娜一直在人群的外围。

fringe.en: He used a party conference fringe meeting to defend terrorism.
fringe.zh: 他利用政党大会期间的分组会议为恐怖主义辩护。

frivolity.en: I don’t think such frivolity helps the organization’s public image.
frivolity.zh: 我认为这种愚蠢的行为无益于这个组织的公众形象。

frivolity.en: Try not to be distracted by the frivolities of the world.
frivolity.zh: 不要为凡尘俗事而分心。

from.en: How do you get from here to Colchester?
from.zh: 从这里到科尔切斯特怎么走？

from.en: The hotel is on the main road from Newport.
from.zh: 宾馆位于从纽波特出来的主路上。

front.en: Ricky stepped forward to the front of the stage and began to sing.
front.zh: 里基走到舞台的最前面，开始唱了起来。

front.en: It took ages to get to the front of the queue.
front.zh: 过了很长时间才排到队伍的最前面。

frontal.en: The minefields make an all-out frontal attack impossible.
frontal.zh: 雷区使得正面的全力进攻无法展开。

frontal.en: After the election, the party launched into a frontal assault on the British media.
frontal.zh: 大选过后，该党派开始正面抨击英国媒体。

frontier.en: Lille is close to the frontier between France and Belgium.
Troops established a road block on the frontier.
frontier.zh: 部队在边境设立了一个路障。

frost.en: Even in May we can sometimes get a late frost.
The grass and trees were white with frost.
frost.zh: 草上和树上结了一层白霜。

frosty.en: He gave me a frosty stare.
My words got a frosty reception.
frosty.zh: 大家对我的话反应冷淡。

frown.en: She frowned as she read the letter.

frown.zh: 马蒂不满地对他皱眉头。

frugal.en: As children we were taught to be frugal and hard-working.
frugal.zh: 我们小时候被教育要节俭和勤劳。

frugal.en: He led a remarkably frugal existence.
frugal.zh: 他过着极其节俭的生活。

fruit.en: Try to eat plenty of fresh fruit.

fruitful.en: Today’s meeting proved more fruitful than last week’s.
fruitful.zh: 事实证明今天的会议比上星期的更有成效。

fruition.en: His proposals only came to fruition after the war.
fruition.zh: 他的提议直到战后才得以实现。

fruition.en: Many people have worked together to bring this scheme to fruition.
fruition.zh: 在许多人的共同努力下，这一计划得以实现。

fruitless.en: So far, their search has been fruitless.
fruitless.zh: 到目前为止，他们的搜寻工作毫无结果。

frustrate.en: The fact that he’s working with amateurs really frustrates him.
frustrate.zh: 与生手共事着实让他沮丧。

frustrate.en: Their attempts to speak to him were frustrated by the guards.
frustrate.zh: 他们想跟他说话，但被警卫拦住了。

frustrating.en: My job can be very frustrating sometimes.
frustrating.zh: 有时候我的工作令人很沮丧。

frustrating.en: This is an immensely frustrating experience for the student.
frustrating.zh: 对于学生来说，这是非常令人沮丧的经历。

frustration.en: People often feel a sense of frustration that they are not being promoted quickly enough.
frustration.zh: 人们经常有一种挫折感，就是觉得自己升职不够快。

frustration.en: I was practically screaming with frustration.
frustration.zh: 我懊恼得几乎要大叫起来。

fry.en: Fry the potatoes, covered, for about 20 minutes.

fry.zh: 我闻到了煎洋葱的味道。

fuck.en: Well, fuck you then. I’ll go on my own.
fuck.zh: 哼，去你妈的，我一个人去。

fuck.en: Why don’t you go fuck yourself!

fuel.en: Coal is one of the cheapest fuels.
fuel.zh: 煤是最廉价的燃料之一。

fuel.en: Global warming may be caused by burning fossil fuels.
fuel.zh: 全球变暖可能是燃烧化石燃料引起的。

fulfil.en: Visiting Disneyland has fulfilled a boyhood dream.
fulfil.zh: 迪士尼乐园之游使童年梦想成真。

fulfil.en: Being deaf hasn’t stopped Karen fulfilling her ambition to be a hairdresser.
fulfil.zh: 失聪并没有阻止卡伦实现当美发师的抱负。

fulfilment.en: Are you looking for greater fulfillment and satisfaction in your work?
fulfilment.zh: 你在寻求工作上更大的成就感与满足感吗？

fulfilment.en: The real joy of the priesthood is helping people find personal fulfilment.
fulfilment.zh: 从事神职工作最大的快乐就在于帮助人们寻求个人的满足感。

full.en: Don’t talk with your mouth full.
full.zh: 嘴里塞满东西时不要说话。

fullness.en: I’m sure he’ll tell us what’s bothering him in the fullness of time.
fullness.zh: 我肯定他会在适当的时候把他的烦恼告诉我们。

fullness.en: Use a red gloss on your bottom lip to give it fullness.
fullness.zh: 下唇使用红色唇彩让它显得丰盈饱满。

fully.en: The restaurant is fully booked this evening.
Elisa has not fully recovered from the incident.
fully.zh: 埃莉莎还没有完全从这个事件中恢复过来。

fumble.en: She dressed, her cold fingers fumbling with the buttons.
fumble.zh: 她穿上衣服，冰冷的手指笨拙地扣着纽扣。

fumble.en: I fumbled around in my bag for a cigarette.

fume.en: She sat in the car, silently fuming about what he’d said.
fume.zh: 她坐在车里一声不响，为他刚才的话生着闷气。

fun.en: There’s plenty of fun for all the family.
fun.zh: 可以让全家人玩得很开心。

fun.en: The children were having so much fun, I hated to call them inside.
fun.zh: 小孩子玩得很开心，我不忍心把他们叫进来。

function.en: In your new job you will perform a variety of functions.
function.zh: 在新的工作岗位上，你将要履行许多不同的职责。

function.en: The church fulfils a valuable social function.
function.zh: 教会起着很重要的社会作用。

functional.en: By 2004, the Supertram is expected to be fully functional.
The two departments have slight functional differences.
functional.zh: 这两个部门功能稍有不同。

fund.en: The fund was set up to try to save the cathedral.
fund.zh: 设立基金以挽救大教堂。

fund.en: A sale is being held to raise funds for the school.
fund.zh: 正在举行拍卖为该校筹集资金。

fundamental.en: We have to tackle the fundamental cause of the problem.
fundamental.zh: 我们必须解决问题的根本原因。

fundamental.en: Novice programmers sometimes make fundamental errors.
fundamental.zh: 新手程序员有时会犯根本性的错误。

fundamentally.en: The conclusions of the report are fundamentally wrong.
fundamentally.zh: 这份报告的结论从根本上来说就是错误的。

fundamentally.en: The political culture of the US is fundamentally different.
fundamentally.zh: 美国的政治文化迥然不同。

funding.en: College directors have called for more government funding.
funding.zh: 学院董事呼吁增加政府拨款。

funeral.en: The funeral will be held at St. Martin’s Church.
funeral.zh: 葬礼将在圣马丁教堂举行。

funeral.en: Hundreds of mourners attended the funeral of the two boys.
funeral.zh: 数百名哀悼者参加了那两个男孩的葬礼。

funnel.en: Police at the barriers funnelled the crowd into the arena.
funnel.zh: 栅栏旁边的警察指挥着人流进入体育场。

funnel.en: Incoming tides funnel up the channel with enormous power.
funnel.zh: 涨起的潮水汹涌地冲进河槽。

funny.en: Do you remember any funny stories about work?
funny.zh: 你能想起工作上的什么趣事吗？

funny.en: If this is your idea of a joke, I don’t find it at all funny.
funny.zh: 如果你觉得这是个玩笑，那我认为它一点也不好笑。

fur.en: Lady Yolanda was swathed in elegant furs.
fur.zh: 约兰达夫人穿着一身雅致的毛皮大衣。

fur.en: If you’re both feeling frustrated, the fur may fly.
fur.zh: 如果你们俩都觉得不顺心，就有可能会发生争吵。

furious.en: Residents in the area are furious at the decision.
furious.zh: 该地区的居民对这一决定感到愤怒。

furious.en: She was furious with herself for letting things get out of hand.
furious.zh: 她生自己的气，怪自己把事情搞得不可收拾。

furnish.en: Having bought the house, they couldn’t afford to furnish it.
furnish.zh: 买下房子后，他们没有钱买家具了。

furnish.en: Will these finds furnish more information on prehistoric man?
furnish.zh: 这些发现是否能提供更多有关史前人类的资料？

furniture.en: I helped him choose the furniture for his house.
furniture.zh: 我帮他挑选房子里用的家具。

furniture.en: I can’t think of a single piece of furniture in my house that I bought new.
furniture.zh: 我想不出家里有哪件家具是新买的。

furrow.en: A deep furrow appeared between his brows.
furrow.zh: 他眉间出现了一道深深的皱纹。

furrow.en: The river cuts a long straight furrow between the hills.
furrow.zh: 那条河在山间冲刷出一条又长又直的沟壑。

further.en: A spokesman declined to comment until the evidence could be studied further.
further.zh: 一位发言人拒绝在证据得到进一步验证之前发表评论。

further.en: The flavour of the wine is further improved during the aging period.
further.zh: 葡萄酒口感在陈化过程中进一步提升。

furthermore.en: He is old and unpopular. Furthermore, he has at best only two years of political life ahead of him.
furthermore.zh: 他年纪已老，又不得人心，而且他最多也只有两年的政治生命了。

fury.en: Jo stepped forward, her eyes blazing with fury.
fury.zh: 乔满眼冒火地走上前来。

fuse.en: I taught him how to change a fuse.
The egg and sperm fuse together as one cell.
fuse.zh: 卵子和精子结合，形成一个细胞。

fusion.en: Her work is a fusion of several different styles.
fusion.zh: 她的作品是几种不同风格的融合。

fuss.en: James said he’d better be getting back or there’d be a fuss.
fuss.zh: 詹姆斯说他最好回来，否则就会有人小题大做了。

fuss.en: The Steamatic enables you to clean any carpet with the minimum of fuss.
fuss.zh: 蒸汽清洁器可以让你轻轻松松地清洁地毯。

fussy.en: Sue was fussy about her looks.
fussy.zh: 休对自己的外表很挑剔。

fussy.en: A lot of small children are fussy eaters (=they dislike many types of food).

futile.en: My efforts to go back to sleep proved futile.
futile.zh: 我努力想再次入睡，但怎么也睡不着。

futile.en: It was futile to continue the negotiations.
futile.zh: 继续谈判下去也是枉然。

future.en: We are now more able to predict future patterns of climate change.
future.zh: 我们现在更有能力预测未来气候的变化模式了。

future.en: We’ve been able to save this land from development and preserve it for future generations.
future.zh: 我们保全了这块土地，没有去开发，而是把它留给子孙后代。

gadgetry.en: I don’t understand how all this electronic gadgetry works.
gadgetry.zh: 我不懂这种电子玩意儿是怎么工作的。

gaily.en: They gaily went on talking after the film had started.
gaily.zh: 电影开演后他们继续毫无顾忌地说话。

gain.en: Radical left-wing parties gained control of local authorities.
gain.zh: 激进的左翼政党控制了地方当局。

gain.en: After gaining independence in 1957, it was renamed ‘Ghana’.

gale.en: The bar erupted into gales of laughter.
gale.zh: 酒吧里爆发出阵阵哄笑。

gallery.en: We could only afford seats up in the gallery.
gallery.zh: 我们只买得起楼座里的位子。

gallon.en: The car does about 50 miles per gallon.

gallop.en: A neighbour’s horse came galloping down the road, riderless.
gallop.zh: 一匹邻居家的马在路上飞奔，上面没人骑着。

gallop.en: I watched as Jan galloped away.
gallop.zh: 我看着简策马奔驰而去。

galvanize.en: The possibility of defeat finally galvanized us into action.
galvanize.zh: 可能到来的失败威胁最终促使我们采取行动。
这篇报道一出，世界舆论一片哗然。

gamble.en: Their religion forbids them to drink or gamble.
gamble.zh: 他们的宗教禁止饮酒和赌博。

gamble.en: Jack loves gambling on the horses.

game.en: We used to love playing games like chess or backgammon.
game.zh: 我们以前喜欢玩国际象棋或双陆棋这样的游戏。

game.en: Did you see the game on TV last night?
game.zh: 你昨晚看了电视转播的那场比赛吗？

gang.en: The parents have denied that their son is a gang member.
gang.zh: 那对父母否认自己的儿子是流氓团伙的成员。

gang.en: There were always gangs of kids hanging around the mall.
gang.zh: 购物中心一带总有一帮帮的年轻人在游荡。

gap.en: The neighbors’ dog got in through a gap in the hedge.
gap.zh: 邻居的狗从树篱的缺口钻了进来。

gap.en: There are huge gaps in my knowledge of history.
gap.zh: 我的历史知识有很大的欠缺。

gape.en: What are all these people gaping at?
gape.zh: 这些人目不转睛地都在看什么呀？

gape.en: Dan stood at the door, his shirt gaping open.

garage.en: I’ll just go and put the car in the garage.
Their house had a double garage.
garage.zh: 他们的房子有一个双车位车库。

garbage.en: Can you take out the garbage when you go?
garbage.zh: 你走的时候把垃圾带出去好吗？

garden.en: Grace brought us some flowers from her garden.
garden.zh: 格雷丝给我们送来一些她花园里的花。

gardener.en: Mom has always been a good gardener.
gardener.zh: 妈妈一直很擅长侍花弄草。

gardening.en: I might do a bit of gardening this afternoon.
gardening.zh: 今天下午我可能会干些园艺活。

garland.en: The tree was garlanded with strings of coloured lights.

garlic.en: Add a crushed clove of garlic (=single section of it).

garment.en: She pulled the garment on and zipped it up.
garment.zh: 她穿上衣服并拉好拉链。

garment.en: She works in the garment district of Manhattan.
garment.zh: 她在曼哈顿的服装加工区工作。

garrison.en: The garrison was called out when news of the enemy’s advance was received.
garrison.zh: 收到敌人推进的情报后，卫戍部队奉命出动。

garrison.en: Our regiment will garrison the town.
garrison.zh: 我们团将驻防在这个镇上。

gas.en: Can you light the gas for me?
The explosion was caused by a gas leak from the water heater.
gas.zh: 这次爆炸是热水器燃气泄漏造成的。

gasp.en: Ollie gasped with pain and slumped forward.
gasp.zh: 奥利疼得直抽气，往前栽倒下去。

gasp.en: The audience gasped at the splendour of the costumes.
gasp.zh: 华丽的服装令观众惊叹。

gate.en: We went through the gate into the orchard.
gate.zh: 我们穿过大门进了果园。

gate.en: I left the engine running and ran back to close the gate.
gate.zh: 我没让发动机熄火，跑回去关上了大门。

gateway.en: St. Louis is the gateway to the West.
gateway.zh: 圣路易斯是通往西部的门户。

gateway.en: To me a home in the country is a gateway to happiness.
gateway.zh: 对我来说，乡间有个家就是通往幸福之路。

gather.en: A crowd gathered to watch the fight.
gather.zh: 一群人聚拢来围观打架。

gather.en: Thousands of people gathered outside the embassy.
gather.zh: 大使馆外面聚集了数千人。

gauge.en: The petrol gauge is still on full.
gauge.zh: 汽油表显示油箱依然是满的。

gauge.en: Retail sales are a gauge of consumer spending.
gauge.zh: 零售额是衡量消费支出的一个标准。

gay.en: She felt excited and quite gay.

gaze.en: Nell was still gazing out of the window.
Patrick sat gazing into space (=looking straight in front, not at any particular person or thing).
gaze.zh: 帕特里克坐着，茫然地看着前方。

gear.en: Andy drove cautiously along in third gear.
gear.zh: 安迪挂着三挡小心地行驶。

gel.en: Don’t start writing until the idea has gelled in your mind.
gel.zh: 脑子里有了明确的想法后再动笔写。

gel.en: He did not gel with Chapman.
gel.zh: 他和查普曼没能顺利合作。

gem.en: Every single ad in the campaign has been a gem.
gem.zh: 这次活动中的每一个广告都是精品。

gem.en: The Fortune is a tiny gem of a theatre.
gem.zh: 时运剧院是一座小巧精致的剧院。

gender.en: Discrimination on grounds of race or gender is forbidden.
gender.zh: 严禁种族歧视和性别歧视。

gender.en: There may be gender differences in attitudes to paid work.
gender.zh: 对待有偿劳动的态度可能存在着性别差异。

general.en: I skimmed through it to get a general impression of the text.
general.zh: 我把文章浏览了一下，让自己有个大致的了解。

general.en: I have a general idea of what I want to express.
general.zh: 我对自己想要表达什么有个大致的想法。

generality.en: The Secretary of State has given us nothing today but bland generalities.
generality.zh: 国务卿今天只对我们讲了几句乏味的空话。

generality.en: Temporary workers are considerably younger than the generality of workers.
generality.zh: 临时工比大多数工人年轻不少。

generalization.en: You can’t make generalizations about what men and women are like.
generalization.zh: 男人什么样，女人什么样，不能一概而论。

generalize.en: She has a tendency to generalize from her husband to all men.
generalize.zh: 她总爱把自己对丈夫的看法推及所有的男人。

generalize.en: It is difficult to generalise about the kind of people who come on these courses.
generalize.zh: 很难笼统地说参加这些课程的都是什么类型的人。

generally.en: It was generally a positive conversation.
generally.zh: 总的来说，这是一次积极的谈话。

generally.en: She’s not really ill, just generally run-down.
generally.zh: 她并不是真的生病，只是感到全身疲惫。

generate.en: The program would generate a lot of new jobs.
generate.zh: 这个项目将创造许多新的就业岗位。

generate.en: Tourism generates income for local communities.
generate.zh: 旅游业为当地社区创造了收益。

generation.en: Like most of my generation, I had never known a war.
generation.zh: 和我们这一代的大多数人一样，我并没有经历过战争。

generation.en: In my generation the divorce rate is very high.
generation.zh: 我们这一代人离婚率很高。

generic.en: Fine Arts is a generic term for subjects such as painting, music, and sculpture.
generic.zh: 艺术是绘画、音乐、雕塑等学科的通称。

generosity.en: I shall never forget the generosity shown by the people of Bataisk.
generosity.zh: 我永远也不会忘记巴斯泰斯克人的慷慨大方。

generous.en: She’s always very generous to the kids.
Jim is very generous with his time.
generous.zh: 吉姆很不吝惜他的时间。

genius.zh: 这部影片展现了费里尼的天赋。

genius.en: Wynford was an architect of genius.
genius.zh: 温福德是一名天才建筑师。

genocide.en: The military leaders were accused of genocide.
genocide.zh: 军方领导人被指控实施种族大屠杀。

gentility.en: The hotel had an air of discreet gentility.
gentility.zh: 这家酒店有一种不露痕迹的典雅气派。

gentle.en: Arthur was a very gentle, caring person.
gentle.zh: 阿瑟是一个非常温柔体贴的人。

gentleman.en: Could you serve this gentleman please, Miss Bath?
gentleman.zh: 巴思小姐，请你接待一下这位先生好吗？

gently.en: She kissed me gently on the cheek.
gently.zh: 她温柔地亲吻我的脸颊。

gently.en: Gently cook the peppers for 10–15 minutes.

genuine.en: The reforms are motivated by a genuine concern for the disabled.
genuine.zh: 这些改革是出自对残疾人真切的关心。

genuine.en: We need laws that will protect genuine refugees.
genuine.zh: 我们需要有法律来保护真正的难民。

geography.en: The geography of the flats made it hard to get to know our neighbours.
geography.zh: 公寓的布局使得我们邻里之间很难认识。

germ.en: Put disinfectant down the toilet to kill any germs.
germ.zh: 在抽水马桶里投放消毒剂杀菌。

germ.en: The germ of a story began to form in his mind.
germ.zh: 一个故事开始在他的头脑里成形。

germinate.en: The idea of setting up his own company began to germinate in his mind.
germinate.zh: 他萌生了自己开公司的想法。

gesture.en: Jim raised his hands in a despairing gesture.
gesture.zh: 吉姆举起双手，做出绝望的手势。

gesture.en: Luke made an obscene gesture with his finger.
gesture.zh: 卢克用手指做了一个下流的手势。

get.en: What did you get for Christmas?
get.zh: 你圣诞节收到了什么礼物？

ghastly.en: The whole thing was a ghastly mistake.
ghastly.zh: 整件事情是个很糟糕的错误。

ghost.en: They say the young girl’s ghost still haunts (=often appears in) the house.
ghost.zh: 他们说那个少女的鬼魂依旧在那房子里出没。

ghost.en: He looked as if he’d seen a ghost (=he looked very frightened).
ghost.zh: 他看上去像见到了鬼似的。

giant.en: Miles Davis, truly one of the giants of jazz

gift.en: The earrings were a gift from my aunt.
gift.zh: 这副耳环是我姑姑送给我的礼物。

gift.en: The clock was given as a retirement gift when he left the police.
gift.zh: 这个钟表是他退休离开警局时收到的礼物。

gifted.en: She was an extremely gifted poet.
gifted.zh: 她是一位极具天赋的诗人。

gifted.en: Gifted with a superb voice, she became the Opera’s leading soprano.
gifted.zh: 她天生一副好嗓子，成了歌剧院的领衔女高音。

giggle.en: If you can’t stop giggling you’ll have to leave the room.
giggle.zh: 如果你再咯咯地笑个不停，就给我离开屋子。
薇姬忍住了她紧张的傻笑。

gild.en: The autumn sun gilded the lake.
gild.zh: 秋天的阳光把湖面染成了金色。

gill.en: The bar was packed to the gills on Monday.
gill.zh: 星期一，酒吧里人满为患。

girl.en: Both boys and girls can apply to join the choir.
girl.zh: 男孩和女孩均可申请加入合唱团。

girl.en: I’ve known Mollie ever since I was a little girl.
girl.zh: 我还是个小女孩的时候就认识莫莉了。

gist.en: The gist of his argument is that full employment is impossible.
gist.zh: 他论述的主旨是，全面就业是不可能的。

gist.en: Don’t worry about all the details as long as you get the gist (=understand the main meaning) of it.
gist.zh: 不要去管各个细节，只要理解主要意思就行了。

give.en: What did Bob give you for your birthday?
give.zh: 你生日鲍勃送了你什么？

give.en: Researchers were given a £10,000 grant to continue their work.
give.zh: 研究人员得到一万英镑的经费以继续他们的研究。

given.en: On any given day in the Houston area, half the hospital beds are empty.
given.zh: 在休斯敦地区，任何一天医院的床位都有一半是空的。

given.en: The rules are to be followed in any given situation.
given.zh: 这些规则在任何情况下都要遵守。

glacial.en: Change was coming, but at a glacial pace.
glacial.zh: 变化是有了，但是非常缓慢。

glad.en: I’m really glad I don’t have to go back there again.
glad.zh: 我真高兴我不用再回到那儿去了。

glamorous.en: She led an exciting and glamorous life.
On television, she looks so glamorous.
glamorous.zh: 她在电视里看上去光彩照人。

glamour.en: Forget all you read about the glamour of television.
glamour.zh: 不要去管书报上怎么说电视如何有魅力。

glamour.en: Designer clothes are not a passport to instant glamour.
glamour.zh: 名牌服装并不能让你转瞬之间身价倍增。

glance.en: The man glanced nervously at his watch.
glance.zh: 那人紧张地看了一眼手表。
怀亚特环视了一下餐馆。

glare.zh: 她用责备的目光瞪着他。

glare.en: He glared round the room as if expecting a challenge.
glare.zh: 他凶巴巴地环视房间，像是等待有人来挑战他。

glass.en: Nigel raised his glass in a toast to his son.
glass.zh: 奈杰尔举杯向儿子祝酒。

glass.en: She poured a glass of wine.

glaze.en: Sometimes his eyes would glaze over for a second or two.
glaze.zh: 有时候他会两眼发直地愣一两秒钟。

glaze.en: Glaze the rolls with egg white.

gleam.en: His teeth gleamed under his moustache.
gleam.zh: 他的八字须下面，牙齿晶莹发亮。

gleam.en: The wooden panelling was gleaming with wax polish.
gleam.zh: 木嵌板上过蜡显得很光亮。

glean.en: Additional information was gleaned from other sources.
glean.zh: 另外的信息都是从其他地方搜集来的。

glide.en: Kennedy seemed to glide through life.

glimpse.en: They caught a glimpse of a dark green car.
glimpse.zh: 他们瞥见一辆深绿色的汽车。

glimpse.en: We only had a fleeting glimpse of the river.
glimpse.zh: 我们只是匆匆地看了一眼那条河。

glisten.en: The boy’s back was glistening with sweat.
glisten.zh: 那个男孩背上的汗水闪闪发亮。

glitter.en: The river glittered in the sunlight.
His blue eyes glittered with anger.
glitter.zh: 他的蓝眼睛里燃烧着愤怒。

global.en: We are taking a global view of our business.
global.zh: 我们从全局来考虑我们的生意。

globe.en: We export our goods all over the globe.
globe.zh: 我们的商品出口到世界各地。

gloom.en: He peered into the gathering (=increasing) gloom.
gloom.zh: 他在渐深的暮色中眺望远方。

gloomy.en: The report paints a gloomy picture of the economy.
gloomy.zh: 这篇报告描绘了一幅惨淡的经济现状。

gloomy.en: Anne dismissed these gloomy thoughts from her mind.
gloomy.zh: 安妮抛开了心里这些沮丧的念头。

glorious.en: He’s got a great future ahead of him.

glorious.zh: 这房子可以看到非常美的景色。

glory.en: She dreamt of future glory as an Olympic champion.
glory.zh: 她梦想着将来能得到奥运冠军的荣誉。

glory.en: Goran’s moment of glory came when he defeated Rafter.
glory.zh: 戈兰击败拉夫特，迎来了荣耀的一刻。

gloss.en: This gel will add gloss to even the dullest hair.
gloss.zh: 用了这种发胶，即使最干枯的头发也会增添光泽。

gloss.en: The silverware had been polished to a high gloss.
gloss.zh: 那些银质器具被擦得锃亮。

glow.en: She had a healthy glow in her cheeks.
glow.zh: 她脸上泛着健康的红晕。

glow.en: Sophie felt a glow of pride.

glue.en: The sheets are glued together with strong adhesive.
glue.zh: 薄板用强力胶粘在一起。

glue.en: Check that you have glued everything in place properly.
glue.zh: 检查是否每一样东西都粘牢了。

gnaw.zh: 德克斯特若有所思地咬着钢笔。

gnaw.en: A rat had gnawed a hole in the box.
gnaw.zh: 老鼠在箱子上咬了一个洞。

go.en: There’s nothing more we can do here. Let’s go home.
go.zh: 这里没有我们的事了，咱们回家吧。

go.en: Have you ever been to (=have you ever travelled to) Japan?

goad.en: Kathy goaded him into telling her what he had done.
goad.zh: 凯茜逼着他把自己所干的事告诉了她。

goad.en: They goaded him on with insults.
goad.zh: 他们辱骂他，逼着他继续干。

goal.en: Your goal as a parent is to help your child become an independent adult.
goal.zh: 身为父母，你的目标就是要培养孩子成为独立的成年人。

god.en: Zeus was one of the most well-known Greek gods.
god.zh: 宙斯是最广为人知的希腊神之一。

gold.en: She came to the party dripping with gold (=wearing a lot of gold).
gold.zh: 她披金戴银地来参加派对。

gold.en: The room was decorated in golds and blues.
gold.zh: 房间的装修用了金色和蓝色。

golden.en: He wasted a golden opportunity when he missed from the penalty spot.
golden.zh: 他罚球没有命中，浪费了一个绝佳的机会。

golf.zh: 他星期天都去打高尔夫球。

good.en: The train service is not very good.
My French is better than my Spanish.
good.zh: 我的法语比西班牙语好。

goodbye.en: I just have to say goodbye to Jane.

goodness.en: My goodness, you have spent a lot!

goodness.zh: 看在老天爷的面上，别吵了！

goods.en: Britain’s leading exporter of manufactured goods (=things that are made, not grown)
goods.zh: 英国主要的工业制成品出口商

goods.en: There will be tax increases on a range of goods and services.
goods.zh: 有一些商品和服务将要增税。

goodwill.en: A fund was set up as a goodwill gesture to survivors and their families.
goodwill.zh: 成立了基金会，以向幸存者及其家属作出善意的表示。

goodwill.en: The sale price also covers the goodwill of the business.
goodwill.zh: 售价中还包含公司的商誉。

gorge.en: We gorged ourselves on ripe plums.
gorge.zh: 我们拼命地吃成熟的李子。

gorge.en: The insect sucks until it is gorged with blood.
gorge.zh: 那虫子直到吸饱了血才停下来。

gorgeous.zh: 你看上去非常漂亮，玛丽亚。

gorgeous.en: The hotel room had a gorgeous view.
gorgeous.zh: 那间客房窗外景色迷人。

gospel.en: Missionaries were sent to preach the Gospel.
gospel.zh: 传教士被派出去传福音。

gospel.en: Don’t take everything she says as gospel (=don’t believe everything she says).
gospel.zh: 别把她说的每句话都当真理。

gossip.en: Here’s an interesting piece of gossip about Mrs Smith.
gossip.zh: 这里有一则关于史密斯夫人的有趣传闻。

govern.en: The party had been governing for seven months.
govern.zh: 该党执政已经有七个月了。

govern.en: The universe is governed by the laws of physics.
govern.zh: 宇宙受到物理法则的支配。

government.en: The Government are planning further cuts in public spending.
government.zh: 政府正计划进一步削减公共支出。

government.en: The US government has tightened restrictions on firearms.
government.zh: 美国政府已经加强了对枪支的管制。

grab.en: I grabbed my bag and ran off.
Two men grabbed her and pushed her to the ground.
grab.zh: 两名男子抓住她，把她推倒在地上。

grace.en: Lena moved with the grace of a dancer.
grace.zh: 莉娜走路姿势有着舞者般的优美。

grace.en: The hotel maintains traditional standards of elegance, style, and grace.
grace.zh: 这家酒店保持着传统的优雅体面格调。

graceful.en: Her movements were graceful and elegant.
graceful.zh: 她举手投足优雅而高贵。

graceful.en: The branches formed a graceful curve.
graceful.zh: 那些树枝形成一条优美的曲线。

gracious.en: Sibyl was the most gracious, helpful, and generous person to work with.
gracious.zh: 西比尔非常和蔼，乐于助人，而且为人慷慨，和她共事最愉快。

gracious.en: Good gracious! What on earth has happened to your feet?
gracious.zh: 天哪！你的脚到底怎么了？

grade.en: The best grades of tea are expensive.
grade.zh: 最上等的茶叶价格很贵。

grade.en: There are lots of jobs in junior grades.

gradual.en: There has been a gradual change in climate.

gradual.zh: 教育是一个循序渐进的过程。

gradually.en: Jill gradually became aware of an awful smell.
gradually.zh: 吉尔渐渐地闻到了一股难闻的气味。

graduate.en: Kate graduated from medical school last year.
graduate.zh: 凯特去年从医学院毕业了。

graduation.en: After graduation, Neil returned to Ohio.
graduation.zh: 尼尔毕业以后回到了俄亥俄州。

graduation.en: On graduation (=after completing a first degree), Nancy became an art teacher.
graduation.zh: 南希毕业以后当了一名美术老师。

grain.en: Last year’s grain harvest was the biggest ever.
Cut along the grain of the wood.
grain.zh: 顺着木头的纹路劈下去。

gram.en: On his birthday we sent him a kissagram (=a woman who was paid to give him a message and kiss him).
gram.zh: 他生日那天我们请了一位女郎给他送上贺吻。

grammar.en: A dictionary lists the words, a grammar states the rules.
grammar.zh: 词典收列单词，语法书讲解语法规则。

grand.en: The party was a grand affair.
New Yorkers build on a grand scale.
grand.zh: 纽约人喜欢建高楼大厦。

grandfather.en: I used to stay at my grandpa’s house.

grandmother.en: My grandma used to make lovely cakes.
grandmother.zh: 我祖母以前常做很好吃的蛋糕。

grandparent.zh: 我的祖父母住在萨塞克斯郡。

grant.zh: 英国可能会同意西班牙的请求。

grant.en: I would love to be able to grant her wish.
grant.zh: 我很希望能够满足她的愿望。

granted.en: Granted, the music is not perfect, but the flaws are outweighed by the sheer joy of the piece.
granted.zh: 诚然，这音乐算不上完美，但曲中欢乐无穷，因而瑕不掩瑜。

graph.en: Martin showed me a graph of their recent sales.
graph.zh: 马丁给我看了他们最近销售情况的图表。

graphic.en: His illness is described in graphic detail.
graphic.zh: 他的病情被描述得非常详细。

grapple.en: Two men grappled with a guard at the door.
grapple.zh: 两个男人和一个门卫在门口扭打。

grapple.en: The Government has to grapple with the problem of unemployment.
grapple.zh: 政府必须尽力解决失业问题。

grasp.en: I grasped his arm firmly and led him away.
grasp.zh: 我紧紧抓住他的胳膊把他带走。

grasp.en: Alan grasped the handle and pulled it.

grass.en: She enjoyed the feel of grass beneath her feet.
grass.zh: 她喜欢踩在草上的感觉。

grass.en: All grasses need light to grow well.
grass.zh: 所有的草都需要光照才能生长得好。

grate.en: Mr Fen had a loud voice that grated on her ears.
grate.zh: 芬先生嗓门很大，直刺她的耳朵。

grateful.en: I’m so grateful for all your help.
I am very grateful to all those who took the trouble to write to me.

gratify.en: He was gratified by Lucy’s response.
gratify.zh: 他对露西的回答很满意。

gratify.en: John was gratified to see the improvement in his mother’s health.
gratify.zh: 约翰很高兴看到母亲的身体有所好转。

gratifying.en: It’s gratifying to note that already much has been achieved.
gratifying.zh: 得知已经完成了很多，真令人欣慰。

gratifying.en: The support was considerable and very gratifying.
gratifying.zh: 得到很多支持，让人感到很高兴。

gratis.zh: 医疗咨询是免费提供的。

gratitude.en: Tears of gratitude filled her eyes.
gratitude.zh: 她眼里充满感激的泪水。

gratitude.en: She had a deep gratitude towards David, but she did not love him.
gratitude.zh: 她对戴维深怀感激，但是并不爱他。

gratuitous.en: There is no point in gratuitously antagonizing people.
gratuitous.zh: 没有必要无故与人为敌。

grave.en: At the head of the grave there was a small wooden cross.
grave.zh: 坟头上有一个小小的木十字架。

grave.en: He took that secret to the grave.
grave.zh: 他把那个秘密带进了坟墓。

gravity.en: I could not hide from her the gravity of the situation.
gravity.zh: 我不能向她隐瞒情况的严重性。

gravity.en: The penalties should be proportionate to the gravity of the offence.

graze.en: Groups of cattle were grazing on the rich grass.
graze.zh: 牛群在肥美的青草地上吃草。

graze.en: I fell on the gravel, severely grazing my knee.
graze.zh: 我摔倒在砾石路上，膝盖擦伤得很严重。

grease.en: Grease the pan before you pour the batter in.
grease.zh: 先在锅底涂上油，然后倒入面糊。

grease.en: Joseph was able to grease a few palms, thus helping his brother to escape.
grease.zh: 约瑟夫买通了几个人，帮助他兄弟逃了出来。

great.en: The movie was a great success.
The news came as possibly the greatest shock of my life.
great.zh: 这个消息可能是我一生中最大的打击。

greatly.en: The cost of repairs has greatly increased in recent years.
greatly.zh: 近年来，修理费大幅上涨。

greatly.en: All offers of help will be greatly appreciated.

greedy.en: He looked at the gold with greedy eyes.
greedy.zh: 他贪婪地看着这些金子。

greedy.en: Have you eaten them all, you greedy pig?
greedy.zh: 你把那些全吃了？你这贪吃的猪！

green.en: Raw coffee beans are green in colour.

greet.en: Bill opened the door to Harold and greeted him with cries of welcome.
greet.zh: 比尔给哈罗德开了门，欢呼着迎接他。

greeting.en: She raised her hand in greeting.
I smiled a polite greeting, but the woman hardly acknowledged me.
greeting.zh: 我客气地笑着打了个招呼，可是那女人没有答理我。

grey.en: She was a tall thin woman who had gone grey early.
grey.zh: 她是一个高高瘦瘦的女人，头发早早地白了。

grey.en: As he listened, his face went grey with shock.

grid.en: Its streets were laid out in a grid pattern.
grid.zh: 那里的街道是棋盘式的布局。

grid.en: The pilots were just given a grid reference (=number referring to a point on a map) of the target.
grid.zh: 飞行员只有目标的坐标位置。

grief.en: The grief she felt over Helen’s death was almost unbearable.
grief.zh: 她因海伦的去世而悲痛难当。

grievance.en: There must be an opportunity for both sides to air their grievances.
grievance.zh: 一定要有一个机会让双方都说出心中的不满。

grievance.en: The teachers’ contract established a grievance procedure.
grievance.zh: 教师合同建立了一个申诉程序。

grieve.en: He died, and every day since then I have grieved for him.
grieve.zh: 他死了，从此我没有一天不在悲痛。

grieve.en: People need time to grieve after the death of a loved one.
grieve.zh: 人们在所爱之人去世后会有一段悲伤期。
