grievous.en: He was grievously hurt by their betrayal.
grievous.zh: 他们的背叛让他深受伤害。

grill.en: She never grilled her husband about his work.
grill.zh: 丈夫工作上的事她从不问长问短。

grim.en: When he lost his job, his future looked grim.
grim.zh: 他失业以后前途不容乐观。

grim.en: Millions of Britons face the grim prospect (=something bad that will probably happen) of dearer home loans.
grim.zh: 无数英国人面临着住房贷款更加沉重的暗淡前景。

grin.en: She grinned at me, her eyes sparkling.
grin.zh: 她咧嘴对我笑着，两眼放光。

grin.en: He walked out of the pool, grinning widely.
grin.zh: 他满面笑容地从游泳池里走上来。

grind.en: The lenses are ground to a high standard of precision.
grind.zh: 镜片被磨到很高的精确度。

grind.en: He dropped a cigar butt and ground it into the carpet with his heel.
grind.zh: 他扔下雪茄烟头，用脚后跟把它碾进地毯里。

grip.en: Hold the microphone in a firm grip and keep it still.
grip.zh: 紧紧握住麦克风不要让它动。

grip.en: She felt her wrist caught in a vice-like grip.
grip.zh: 她觉得手腕像是卡在铁钳里被牢牢地抓住了。

gripe.en: Joe came in griping about how cold it was.
gripe.zh: 乔走进来，抱怨天气太冷。

gripe.en: My main gripe was the price of refreshments.
gripe.zh: 我主要的不满是茶点太贵。

grit.en: Make sure both surfaces are free from dust and grit.
grit.zh: 要确保内外两面都没有灰尘和沙粒。

grit.en: The council is responsible for putting grit on icy roads.
grit.zh: 市政机构负责在结冰的道路上撒沙子。

groan.en: The kids all groaned when I switched off the TV.
groan.zh: 我关掉电视时，孩子们都发出不满的抱怨声。

groan.en: As she kissed him, Gary groaned with pleasure.
groan.zh: 在她的亲吻之下，加里愉快地哼哼着。

groom.en: Tim was being groomed for a managerial position.
groom.zh: 蒂姆正在接受培训，准备担任经理职位。

groom.en: Clare’s been groomed to take her father’s place when he retires.
groom.zh: 克莱尔一直作为父亲退休后的接班人受到培养。

groove.en: The bolt slid easily into the groove.
Our product range was stuck in a groove.
groove.zh: 我们的产品线一成不变。

grope.en: Ginny groped for her glasses on the bedside table.
grope.zh: 金尼在床头柜上摸着找眼镜。

grope.en: We groped around in the darkness.

gross.en: The company described reports of environmental disaster as gross exaggeration.
gross.zh: 该公司称，关于环境灾害的报道过于夸大其词。

ground.en: The leaves were slowly fluttering to the ground.
He lay on the ground and stared up at the sky.

grounding.en: A basic grounding in math is essential for the economics course.
grounding.zh: 对经济学这门课程来说，基本的数学功底是必不可少的。

grounding.en: Applicants must have a good grounding in human resources management.
grounding.zh: 申请者必须在人力资源管理方面具有良好的基础。

groundless.zh: 幸好我的猜疑后来证明是没有根据的。

groundless.en: Mr Kay’s lawyer said the accusations were groundless.
groundless.zh: 凯先生的律师说这是无端的指控。

groundwater.en: There are fears that groundwater might become contaminated.
groundwater.zh: 有人担心地下水可能会遭污染。

group.en: He was surrounded by a group of admirers.
group.zh: 他的身边围了一群仰慕者。

grove.en: He owns an orange grove near Tel Aviv.
grove.zh: 他在特拉维夫附近拥有一个橘园。

grow.en: Support for Mr Thompson is growing.
grow.zh: 汤普森先生的支持率在上升。

grow.en: Sales of new cars grew by 10% last year.
grow.zh: 去年新车的销量增长了10%

grower.en: Bamboo is a very vigorous grower.
grower.zh: 竹子是一种生命力非常强的植物。

growl.en: He heard a low growl behind him.

grown.en: Who ever heard of a grown man being scared of the dark?
grown.zh: 有谁听说过一个大男人还怕黑？

grown.en: I’ve got two grown daughters and a son.
grown.zh: 我有两个已经成年的女儿和一个儿子。

grown-up.en: Before you know it, the children will be grown-up and leaving home.
grown-up.zh: 转眼之间，孩子们就会长大成人离家而去。
我有两个已经成年的儿子。

growth.en: We’ve seen an enormous growth in the number of businesses using the Web.
growth.zh: 我们看到使用网络的公司数量剧增。

growth.en: The company is preparing for zero growth (=no growth) this year.
growth.zh: 公司今年准备面对零增长。

grudge.en: Is there anyone who might have had a grudge against her?
grudge.zh: 有没有谁可能对她怀恨在心？

grudge.en: Mr Gillis was not normally a man to bear grudges.
grudge.zh: 吉利斯先生通常不是那种会积怨的人。

grumble.en: Farmers are always grumbling about the weather.
A few passengers grumbled that their cabins were too small.
grumble.zh: 有几个乘客抱怨座舱太小。

grunt.en: He just grunted and carried on reading his book.
grunt.zh: 他只是哼了一声，继续看他的书。

grunt.en: Grunting with effort, she lifted me up.
grunt.zh: 她哼哧着费力地把我抱起来。

guarantee.en: I guarantee you’ll love this film.
guarantee.zh: 我保证你会喜欢这部电影。

guarantee.en: If you send the application form in straight away, I can guarantee you an interview.
guarantee.zh: 如果你马上把申请表寄过去，我可以保证你会有一个面试的机会。

guard.en: There were two security guards on duty outside the building.
guard.zh: 大楼外面有两名保安在值勤。

guard.en: We were stopped by border guards.
guard.zh: 我们被边防哨兵拦住了。

guardian.en: His aunt is his legal guardian.
guardian.zh: 他姑妈是他的法定监护人。

guardian.en: The US sees itself as the guardian of democracy.
guardian.zh: 美国以民主制度的捍卫者自居。

guess.en: I’d say he’s around 50, but I’m only guessing.
If you guess correctly, you have another turn.
guess.zh: 如果猜对了，还会有一次机会。

guest.en: You are here as my guests.
Most of the wedding guests had left.
guest.zh: 出席婚礼的宾客大部分都已离去。

guidance.en: I went to a counselor for guidance on my career.
guidance.zh: 我去找了一位顾问给我作职业指导。

guidance.en: I was looking forward to working under her expert guidance.
guidance.zh: 我期待着能在她的专业指导下工作。

guide.en: The polls are not a reliable guide of how people will vote.
guide.zh: 根据这些民意测验来判断人们将如何投票并不可靠。

guide.en: The figures are only a rough guide.
guide.zh: 这些数据只是一个大致的参考。

guideline.en: The hospital has issued new guidelines on the treatment of mentally ill patients.
guideline.zh: 医院就精神病患者的治疗发布了新的指导原则。

guideline.en: This chapter gives you some guidelines to help you in your work.
guideline.zh: 本章将介绍一些指导性原则，为你的工作提供帮助。

guilt.en: He used to buy them expensive presents, out of guilt.
guilt.zh: 出于内疚，他以前总是给他们买昂贵的礼物。

guilt.en: Don’t you have any feelings of guilt about leaving David?
guilt.zh: 你离开戴维难道就没有一点内疚吗？

guilty.en: I feel really guilty about forgetting her birthday again.
guilty.zh: 我又忘记了她的生日，心里非常内疚。
她看上去很不自然，很内疚的样子。

gullible.en: Plastic replicas of the Greek pottery are sold to gullible tourists.
gullible.zh: 仿古希腊陶器的塑料复制品被卖给易受骗的游客。

gulp.en: She gulped down her breakfast and ran for the bus.
gulp.zh: 她狼吞虎咽地吃完早饭，跑去赶公交车了。

gulp.en: I gulped when I saw the bill.
gulp.zh: 看到账单时我倒吸了一口气。

gum.en: A large label had been gummed to the back of the photograph.
gum.zh: 照片的背后贴了一张大标签。

gum.en: Dirt had got inside the watch and gummed up the works.
gum.zh: 手表里进了污垢，把机件卡住了。

gun.en: I could see he was carrying a gun.
I’ve never fired a gun in my life.
gun.zh: 我这辈子从来没开过枪。

gunfire.en: I heard a burst of distant gunfire.
Two men were shot in an exchange of gunfire with the police.
gunfire.zh: 两名男子在与警方的交火中被击中。

gush.en: Water gushed from the broken pipe.
gush.zh: 水从破裂的管子中喷涌而出。

gush.en: He opened the door and smoke gushed out.

gust.en: A sudden gust of wind blew the door shut.
gust.zh: 一阵狂风把门吹得关上了。

gust.en: Gusts of up to 200 kph may be experienced.

gut.en: He had a gut feeling that Sarah was lying.
gut.zh: 他凭直觉感到萨拉在撒谎。

gut.en: It takes guts to start a new business on your own.
gut.zh: 自己开公司是需要勇气的。

gutter.en: The gutters were blocked and overflowing.
gutter.zh: 排水沟堵住了，水都溢出来了。

gutter.en: Men like him usually ended up in jail – or the gutter.
gutter.zh: 像他这样的男人，下场通常是坐牢——

guy.en: Dave’s a nice guy when you get to know him.
guy.zh: 戴夫是个好人，你了解他后就知道了。
杰克是个很厉害的家伙。

gym.en: I try and work out at the local gym once a week.
gym.zh: 我尽量每星期到当地的体育馆去运动一次。

gym.en: I go to the gym as often as I can.
gym.zh: 我一有空就去健身房健身。

gymnastics.en: We don’t do gymnastics at school.
gymnastics.zh: 我们学校没有体操训练。

gymnastics.en: The girls went through their gymnastic routine.
gymnastics.zh: 女孩子们完成了她们整套的体操动作。

habit.en: Regular exercise is a good habit.
Thinking negatively can become a habit.
habit.zh: 消极的思维方式会成为一种习惯。

habitable.en: It would cost a fortune to make the place habitable.
habitable.zh: 要想让这个地方可以住人得花一大笔钱。

habitat.en: The grassland is an important habitat for many wild flowers.
habitat.zh: 这片草原是很多野花的重要生长地。

habitual.en: James took his habitual morning walk around the garden.
habitual.zh: 詹姆斯又像往常习惯的那样绕花园作晨间散步去了。

hack.en: She hacked away at the ice, trying to make a hole.
hack.zh: 她在冰上凿，想凿出一个洞来。

hack.en: Whole forests have been hacked down.
hack.zh: 整片整片的森林都已经被砍平。

hacker.en: A hacker had managed to get into the system.
hacker.zh: 一个黑客设法侵入了系统。

haggard.zh: 萨姆看起来疲惫而憔悴。

haggle.en: Ted was haggling with the street vendors.
haggle.zh: 特德正在和街边小贩讨价还价。

hail.en: Lang’s first film was immediately hailed as a masterpiece.
hail.zh: 朗的第一部电影立即就被誉为杰作。

hail.en: The new service has been hailed a success.
hail.zh: 新推出的服务被认为很成功。

hair.en: Her hair was short and dark.

hair.zh: 他是一个浅色头发的高个子。

haircut.en: I haven’t had a haircut for months!
Do you like my new haircut?

hairy.en: It was pretty hairy climbing down the cliff.

hale.en: She’s still hale and hearty at 74.

half.en: Over half of the children live in one-parent families.
half.zh: 这些孩子有一半多生活在单亲家庭。

half.en: Only half the guests had arrived by seven o’clock.

halfway.en: He chased Kevin halfway up the stairs.
halfway.zh: 他追凯文一直追到楼梯的中间。

halfway.en: It was a terrible film – I left halfway through.
halfway.zh: 这部电影太烂，我看到一半就离场了。

hall.en: We hung our coats in a cupboard in the hall.
hall.zh: 我们把外套挂在门厅的衣柜里。

hall.en: Each floor had ten rooms on both sides of the hall.
hall.zh: 每一层在走廊的两边都各有十个房间。

hallmark.en: These hotels still offer the sort of service which was the hallmark of the grand days of travel.
hallmark.zh: 这些酒店依然提供旅游黄金时期的特色服务。

hallmark.en: The explosion had all the hallmarks of a terrorist attack.
hallmark.zh: 这起爆炸事件具有恐怖袭击的所有特征。

halt.en: Heavy snowfalls brought traffic to a halt (=made it stop moving).
halt.zh: 大雪使得交通陷于停顿。

halt.en: The World Championship was brought to a temporary halt (=was stopped from continuing).

halve.en: Cash cuts have halved the number of places available on training courses.
halve.zh: 经费削减使培训名额减少了一半。
把马铃薯竖着切成两半。

hammer.en: The decision is a hammer blow for the coal industry.
hammer.zh: 这一决定对于煤炭业是一个沉重的打击。

hammer.en: Hammer the nails into the back of the frame.
hammer.zh: 把钉子锤入框子的背面。

hamper.en: She tried to run, but was hampered by her heavy suitcase.
hamper.zh: 她想跑，但沉重的旅行箱拖累了她。

hamper.en: An attempt to rescue the men has been hampered by bad weather.
hamper.zh: 对那几名男子的营救行动受到恶劣天气的阻碍。

hand.en: Steve gripped the steering wheel tightly with both hands.
hand.zh: 史蒂夫双手紧握方向盘。

hand.en: In her hand was a tattered old photograph.
hand.zh: 她手中拿着的是一张破旧的老照片。

handbag.en: Dennis looked like he threw a punch, but it was just handbags.
handbag.zh: 丹尼斯看似挥了一拳，其实只是装样子。

handful.en: The boy picked up a handful of stones and started throwing them at us.
handful.zh: 那男孩捡起一把石子，开始朝我们扔过来。

handful.en: There were only a handful of people there.

handicap.en: Not speaking the language is a real handicap.
handicap.zh: 不会讲这种语言的确是一个障碍。

handicap.en: He’s improved a lot, and his handicap has come down from 18 to 12.
handicap.zh: 他的球技大大进步，被让杆数已从18

handle.en: I handled most of the paperwork.
handle.zh: 大部分文书工作是我做的。

handle.en: The case is being handled by a top lawyer.
handle.zh: 此案正由一位顶尖律师负责处理。

handling.en: The president has been much criticized for his handling of the crisis.
handling.zh: 总统对这场危机的处理大受批评。

handling.en: Such a situation needs very careful handling.
handling.zh: 这种情况处理起来需要格外小心。

handout.zh: 请看一下发下来的材料。

handsome.en: Sam was tall, dark, and handsome.
handsome.zh: 萨姆高大黝黑，相貌堂堂。

handsome.en: Her new boyfriend is really good-looking.

handwriting.en: I recognised her handwriting on the envelope.
handwriting.zh: 我认出了信封上她的笔迹。

handwriting.en: My handwriting has never been very neat.
handwriting.zh: 我的字从来都写得不够工整。

handy.en: It’s quite a handy little tool.
It’s very handy having a light above your desk.
handy.zh: 书桌上方有盏灯很有用。

hang.en: Philip hung his coat on a hook behind the door.
hang.zh: 菲利普把自己的大衣挂在门后的钩子上。

hang.en: She hung the sheets on the washing line.
hang.zh: 她把床单晾在晒衣绳上。

hanger.en: She took off her jacket and hung it on a hanger.
hanger.zh: 她脱下夹克挂在衣架上。

hanker.en: She hankered for a new life in a different country.
hanker.zh: 她渴望在异国开始新的生活。

haphazard.en: I continued my studies in a rather haphazard way.
haphazard.zh: 我毫无计划地继续着学业。

haphazard.en: Educational provision in the country is haphazard.
haphazard.zh: 该国提供的教育毫无计划性。

happen.en: It’s impossible to predict what will happen next.
happen.zh: 不可能预测接下来会发生什么。

happening.en: There have been reports of strange happenings in the town.
happening.zh: 镇上不断传出有怪事发生。

happening.en: Brighton is definitely a happening place.
happening.zh: 布赖顿绝对是个时尚之地。

happily.zh: 我是个快乐的已婚男人。

happily.en: So she married the prince, and they lived happily ever after (=used at the end of children’s stories to say that someone was happy for the rest of their life).
happily.zh: 她嫁给了王子，他们从此过着幸福的生活。

happiness.zh: 朱丽叶的双眼闪耀着幸福的光芒。

happiness.en: We want our children to have the best possible chance of happiness.
happiness.zh: 我们希望自己的孩子得到追求幸福的最佳机会。

happy.en: It’s a lovely house and we’ve been very happy here.
happy.zh: 房子很漂亮，我们住在这里非常开心。

happy.en: I’ve never felt happier in my life.
happy.zh: 我一生从未感到如此快乐。

harangue.en: He stood on the street corner, haranguing passers-by about the stupidity of the forthcoming war.
harangue.zh: 他站在街角向路人慷慨陈词，痛诉这场即将爆发的战争是如何荒唐。

harass.en: A number of black youths have complained of being harassed by the police.
harass.zh: 一些黑人青年投诉称受到警察骚扰。

harass.en: One woman claimed that she had been sexually harassed by a male manager.
harass.zh: 一名女子声称曾遭到一名男经理性骚扰。

harassment.en: African-Americans have been complaining about police harassment for years.
harassment.zh: 美国黑人多年来一直抱怨受到警察的骚扰。

harassment.en: Political parties are banned, and harassment of dissidents is commonplace.
harassment.zh: 政党被取缔，而持不同政见者受到骚扰也是司空见惯的事。

harbour.en: I think he’s harbouring some sort of grudge against me.
harbour.zh: 我觉得他对我有点怀恨在心。

harbour.en: She began to harbour doubts over the wisdom of their journey.
harbour.zh: 她开始对他们的旅行是否明智产生了怀疑。

hard.en: After months without rain, the ground was too hard to plough.
hard.zh: 数月无雨，土地坚硬难犁。

hard.en: This year’s exam was much harder than last year’s.
hard.zh: 今年的考试比去年的难得多。

harden.en: It will take about 24 hours for the glue to harden.
Attitudes towards the terrorists have hardened even more since the attack.
harden.zh: 自从那次袭击后，对待恐怖分子的态度更加强硬了。

hardly.en: My parents divorced when I was six, and I hardly knew my father.
hardly.zh: 我六岁时父母离婚，我对父亲几乎一无所知。

hardly.en: The children were so excited they could hardly speak.
hardly.zh: 孩子们兴奋得几乎连话都说不出来了。

hardship.en: Many students are suffering severe financial hardship.
hardship.zh: 许多学生经济非常困难。

hare.en: He hared off down the road.
hare.zh: 他沿着马路飞快地跑掉了。

harm.en: The scandal did his career a lot of harm.
harm.zh: 丑闻对他的职业生涯造成很大损害。

harm.en: Our children deserve protection from harm.
harm.zh: 我们的儿童理应得到保护免受伤害。

harmful.en: Smoking is harmful to your health.
Everyone knows that too much alcohol is bad for you.
harmful.zh: 人人都知道饮酒过量对身体有害。

harmless.en: Her brother’s a bit simple, but he’s quite harmless.
harmless.zh: 她的弟弟有点愚钝，不过他决不会伤害别人。

harmless.en: It was just a bit of harmless fun.
harmless.zh: 这只是个没有恶意的玩笑。

harmonious.en: The decor is a harmonious blend of traditional and modern.
harmonious.zh: 这种装饰风格是传统与现代的和谐统一。

harmony.en: I do believe it is possible for different ethnic groups to live together in harmony.
harmony.zh: 我确信不同民族的人民可以融洽相处。

harmony.en: Your suggestions are not in harmony with the aims of this project.
harmony.zh: 你的建议与本项目的目标不符。

harness.en: I felt glad to be back in harness.
harness.zh: 我很高兴又回来正常工作了。

harness.en: We can harness the power of the wind to generate electricity.
harness.zh: 我们可以利用风力发电。

harsh.en: The hostages are being held in harsh conditions.
harsh.zh: 人质被拘押在恶劣环境中。

harsh.en: His theory met with harsh criticism from colleagues.
harsh.zh: 他的理论遭到了同事们的严厉批评。

harvest.en: It rained for the potato harvest.
harvest.zh: 收马铃薯的时节下起了雨。

harvest.en: Plum growers are expecting a bumper harvest this year.
harvest.zh: 种植李树的农民期盼着今年有个好收成。

haste.zh: 我很快就对自己的仓促感到后悔。

haste.en: In his haste to leave, he forgot his briefcase.
haste.zh: 他走得很匆忙，忘了带公文包。

hasten.en: Their departure was hastened by an abnormally cold winter.
hasten.zh: 那个冬天异常寒冷，所以他们提前走了。

hasten.en: I hastened to assure her that there was no danger.
hasten.zh: 我赶紧向她保证不会有什么危险。

hasty.en: He soon regretted his hasty decision.
hasty.zh: 他很快就对自己仓促作出的决定感到后悔了。

hasty.en: Let’s not be hasty – sit down for a moment.

hat.en: Maria was wearing a beautiful new hat.
hat.zh: 玛丽亚戴着一顶漂亮的新帽子。

hat.en: I’m a manager now and only put my salesman’s hat on when one of our sales reps is having real problems.
hat.zh: 我现在当经理了，只有当我们的销售代表遇到真正的难题时我才做销售工作。

hatch.en: The eggs take three days to hatch.
hatch.zh: 这些蛋要三天时间才能孵化。

hatch.en: All the chicks have hatched out.

hate.en: It’s the kind of movie you either love or hate.
hate.zh: 这是那种你要么喜欢要么讨厌的电影。

hateful.en: It was all the fault of that hateful man!
hateful.zh: 都是那个可恶的人造的孽！

hatred.en: A look of pure hatred flashed across her face.
hatred.zh: 她脸上闪过十足的仇恨表情。

hatred.en: Abby made no secret of her hatred for her father.
hatred.zh: 阿比并不掩饰她对父亲的仇恨。

haul.en: She hauled her backpack onto her back.
I hauled the door shut behind me.

haunt.en: The pub is said to be haunted by the ghost of a former landlord.
haunt.zh: 据说这个酒吧里经常有一位前任房主的鬼魂出没。

haunt.en: Clare was haunted by the fear that her husband was having an affair.
haunt.zh: 克莱尔总是担心丈夫有外遇。

have.en: We’ve been spending too much money.
have.zh: 我们已经花掉太多钱了。

haven.en: The riverbanks are a haven for wildlife.
haven.zh: 河的两岸是野生动植物的乐土。

haven.en: St Ives is a haven for artists.
haven.zh: 圣艾夫斯，艺术家和嬉皮士的天堂

havoc.en: A strike will cause havoc for commuters.
havoc.zh: 罢工将给乘车上下班的人造成混乱。

havoc.en: Rain has continued to play havoc with sporting events.
havoc.zh: 下雨一直影响着体育比赛的进行。

hazard.en: Polluted water sources are a hazard to wildlife.
hazard.zh: 受污染的水源会对野生生物构成危险。

hazard.en: That pile of rubbish is a fire hazard (=something that is likely to cause a fire).

hazardous.en: The chemicals in paint can be hazardous to health.
hazardous.zh: 油漆中的化学物质可能对健康有害。

haze.en: The sun was surrounded by a golden haze.
haze.zh: 太阳被一片金色烟霞笼罩。

hazy.en: My memories of the holiday are rather hazy.
hazy.zh: 我对那次假期的记忆十分模糊。

hazy.en: She was a little hazy about the details.

he.en: It was he who first suggested the idea.
he.zh: 是他先提出这个想法的。

he.en: Everyone should do what he considers best.
he.zh: 每个人都应按照自己认为最好的去做。

head.en: He kissed the top of her head.
Alan fell asleep as soon as he put his head on the pillow.
head.zh: 艾伦头一挨枕头就睡着了。

headache.en: If you have a headache, you should take some aspirin.
headache.zh: 要是头痛，你该吃点阿司匹林。

headache.en: Security is a big headache for airline operators.
headache.zh: 对航空公司来说安全问题是件很棘手的事。

headline.en: The former MP found himself back in the headlines again.
headline.zh: 那位前议员发现自己再次登上了新闻头条。

headlong.en: I fell headlong into a pool of icy water.
headlong.zh: 我一个倒栽葱跌入了冰冷的池水中。

headlong.en: Mortimer almost ran headlong into a patrol.
headlong.zh: 莫蒂默慌不择路，差点撞到巡逻队。

heal.en: It took three months for my arm to heal properly.
heal.zh: 我的胳膊三个月之后才痊愈。

heal.en: The trauma of divorce can often be healed by successful remarriage.
heal.zh: 离婚带来的创伤常常能通过后来的美满再婚治愈。

health.en: I’m worried about my husband’s health.
health.zh: 我担心我丈夫的健康状况。

health.en: The government has promised to spend more on health and education.
health.zh: 政府已经承诺增加医疗和教育经费。

healthy.en: I’ve always been perfectly healthy until now.
healthy.zh: 直到现在，我的身体一直非常健康。

healthy.en: Her face had a healthy glow.

heap.en: There was a heap of stones where the building used to be.
heap.zh: 那栋建筑物的原址上有一堆石头。

heap.en: The envelopes for posting lay in a heap on her desk.
heap.zh: 待寄信件杂乱地堆在她的书桌上。

hear.en: Did anyone see or hear anything last night?
hear.zh: 昨晚有没有人看见或听见什么？

hear.en: Jenny could hear them arguing outside.
hear.zh: 珍妮能听到他们在外面争论。

hearing.en: She has remarkable hearing for a lady of her age.
hearing.zh: 相对于她这样年纪的女性来说，她的听力很不一般。

hearing.en: Let’s give both sides a fair hearing.
hearing.zh: 让我们给双方公平的解释机会。

heart.en: Regular exercise is good for the heart.
heart.zh: 经常锻炼对心脏有好处。

heart.en: Can you hear my heart beating?

heartbeat.en: Things can change in a heartbeat.

heartily.en: Hugh laughed heartily at the joke.
heartily.zh: 休听了那个笑话开怀大笑。

heartily.en: This is a book I heartily recommend to all hill walkers.
heartily.zh: 我向所有山区健行者大力推荐这本书。

heat.en: Insulating the attic is a good way to reduce heat loss.
heat.zh: 为阁楼安装隔热层是减少热量流失的好方法。

heater.en: Did you turn the heater off?

heave.en: Alan heaved his suitcase onto his bed.
heave.zh: 艾伦把他的手提箱拖到床上。

heave.en: Mary heaved herself out of bed.

heaven.en: He believed that he and his wife would one day be together again in heaven.
heaven.zh: 他相信他和妻子有一天会在天国重聚。

heaven.en: Sitting by the pool with a good book is my idea of heaven.
heaven.zh: 坐在水池边看一本好书就是我心目中的极乐之事。

heavily.en: I became heavily involved in politics.
The report was heavily criticized in the press.
heavily.zh: 该报道遭到了新闻界的严厉批评。

heavy.en: The wardrobe was too heavy for me to move on my own.
heavy.zh: 衣橱太重，我一个人移不动。

heavy.en: The males are seven times heavier than the females.
heavy.zh: 雄性的重量是雌性的七倍。

hectic.en: I’ve had a pretty hectic day.

hedge.en: Buying a house will be a hedge against inflation.
hedge.zh: 买房子是应对通货膨胀的一种防范手段。

hedge.en: You’re hedging again – have you got the money or haven’t you?
hedge.zh: 你又在闪烁其词了，你究竟有没有钱？

heed.en: If she had only heeded my warnings, none of this would have happened.
heed.zh: 要是她当初听从我的警告，这一切都不会发生。

heed.en: The government was taking little heed of these threats.
heed.zh: 政府对这些威胁几乎不当回事。

heel.en: Using the heel of your hand, press the dough firmly into shape.
heel.zh: 用手掌根使劲把面团压成形。

heel.en: Whenever she wore heels she was taller than the men she worked with.
heel.zh: 她穿上高跟鞋就会比男同事都高。

height.en: Sam’s about the same height as his sister now.
height.zh: 萨姆现在身高和他姐姐差不多了。

height.en: State your age, height, and weight.
height.zh: 说出你的年龄、身高和体重。

heighten.en: There are fears that the march will heighten racial tension.
heighten.zh: 有人担心这次游行会加深种族间的紧张局势。

heighten.en: Increased levels of fat in the diet could heighten the risk of cancer.
heighten.zh: 饮食中脂肪摄入量的提升会增加患癌症的风险。

heir.en: John was the sole heir to a vast estate.
heir.zh: 约翰是一大笔遗产的唯一继承人。

heir.en: Jonson was his political heir as leader of the Nationalist Party.
heir.zh: 琼森是他的政治接班人，他将担任该党派的领袖。

hell.en: My mother made my life hell.
hell.zh: 母亲让我生活得很痛苦。

hell.en: These past few days have been a living hell.
hell.zh: 过去的几天简直是活受罪。

help.en: If there’s anything I can do to help, just give me a call.
help.zh: 如果需要我帮忙，就给我打个电话。

help.en: I helped her to carry her cases up the stairs.
help.zh: 我帮她把箱子拎上了楼。

helper.en: I was a classroom helper at the local primary school.
helper.zh: 我是当地小学的课室助理。

helpful.en: Thank you for your advice; it’s been very helpful.
helpful.zh: 谢谢你的建议，它非常有用。

helpful.en: It is helpful to discuss your problems with your friends.
helpful.zh: 和朋友商量自己的问题很有帮助。

helpless.en: He began to feel depressed and helpless.
Newman threw out a hand in a helpless gesture.
helpless.zh: 纽曼伸出手做了个无助的手势。

hem.en: They were hemmed in on all sides by the soldiers and the dogs.
hem.zh: 他们被士兵和狗团团围住。

hem.en: The market place is hemmed in by shops and banks.
hem.zh: 市场周边商店和银行林立。

hence.en: The cost of transport is a major expense for an industry. Hence factory location is an important consideration.
hence.zh: 运输成本是企业的一大支出，因此工厂选址是重要的考虑因素。

her.en: Her room was pleasant and airy.
her.zh: 她的房间既舒适又通风。

herald.en: A flash of lightning heralded torrential rain.
herald.zh: 一道闪电预示着暴雨即将来临。

herald.en: Flashing blue lights heralded the arrival of the police.
herald.zh: 闪烁的蓝色灯光预示警察就要到达。

herb.en: Sprinkle the dish with chopped fresh herbs.
herb.zh: 在菜肴上撒些切碎的新鲜香草。

herd.en: You have to be an individual; it’s no use running with the herd.
herd.zh: 你必须特立独行，随大溜没有用处。

hereafter.en: Do you believe in the hereafter?

hereby.en: I hereby agree to the conditions of this contract.
hereby.zh: 我同意此合同的条款，特此声明。

hereof.en: This Agreement commences on the date of signature hereof.
hereof.zh: 本协议自签字之日起生效。

heretic.en: Cranmer was put to death as a heretic.
heretic.zh: 克兰默被当成异教徒处死。

hereto.en: A copy of the document is hereto appended.
hereto.zh: 在此附上本文件的副本。

herewith.en: I enclose a copy of this report herewith for your information.
herewith.zh: 我随函附上这份报道以供参考。

heritage.en: We grow heritage varieties of vegetables.
heritage.zh: 我们种植各种稀有蔬菜。

hero.en: He had dared to speak out against injustice, and overnight he became a national hero.
hero.zh: 他敢于站出来抨击不公正的现象，一夜之间就成了国家英雄。

hero.en: His father was a war hero, a former fighter pilot.
hero.zh: 他父亲是一位战争英雄，曾经是战斗机飞行员。

heroic.en: Lawrence’s heroic struggle against his destiny
heroic.zh: 劳伦斯与命运的勇敢抗争

heroic.en: She portrayed him as a heroic figure.
heroic.zh: 她把他描述为英雄人物。

heroine.en: Mira, the fictional heroine of ‘The Women’s Room’
heroine.zh: 迈拉，小说《女厕》的女主人公

hers.en: He bent and touched his mouth to hers.
These are my gloves. Hers are in the drawer.
hers.zh: 这是我的手套，她的在抽屉里。

herself.en: She cut herself on some broken glass.
She made herself a cup of coffee.

hesitant.en: Gail gave me a hesitant little smile.
hesitant.zh: 盖尔迟疑地对我微微一笑。

hesitant.en: They seemed hesitant about coming in.
hesitant.zh: 他们似乎犹豫着该不该进来。

hesitate.en: Kay hesitated for a moment and then said ‘yes’.
He was still hesitating over whether to leave or not.
hesitate.zh: 他还在犹豫要不要离开。

hesitation.en: After some hesitation one of them began to speak.
hesitation.zh: 犹豫了一会儿之后，他们中有一个人开口了。

hey.en: I would have liked to go, but hey, it's no big deal.
hey.zh: 我本想去的，不过，咳，也没什么大不了。

hi.en: Hi there! I haven’t seen you for ages.

hiccup.en: Don’t drink so fast – you’ll get hiccups.

hide.en: Marcia hid the pictures in her desk drawer.
hide.zh: 马西娅把照片藏在她书桌的抽屉里。

hide.en: She keeps a bottle of gin hidden behind a stack of books.
hide.zh: 她在一堆书的后面藏了一瓶杜松子酒。

hideous.zh: 她脸上留下了丑陋的疤痕。

hiding.en: You’ll get a good hiding when you come home!
hiding.zh: 你到家后会挨一顿臭揍的！

hierarchy.en: She worked her way up through the corporate hierarchy to become president.
hierarchy.zh: 她在公司一步步升到了总裁的位置。

high.en: This is the highest mountain in Japan.
The camp was surrounded by a high fence.
high.zh: 营地四周围着高高的栅栏。

highlight.en: Your résumé should highlight your skills and achievements.
highlight.zh: 你的简历应该突出自己的技能和成绩。

highlight.en: Use the cursor to highlight the name of the document you want to print.
highlight.zh: 用光标将你要打印的文件的名称标出来。

highly.en: Tom’s mother was highly critical of the school’s approach.
highly.zh: 汤姆的母亲对学校的处理方法持强烈的批评态度。

highly.en: It’s highly unlikely that the project will be finished on time.
highly.zh: 这一项目很可能无法按时完工。

highway.en: It’s highway robbery, charging that much for gas!
highway.zh: 这简直就是抢钱，汽油竟然要这么贵！

hijack.en: The airliner was hijacked by a group of terrorists.
hijack.zh: 该航班被一帮恐怖分子劫持。

hijack.en: Some people think the party has been hijacked by right-wing extremists.
hijack.zh: 有人认为该党已经被右翼极端分子所把持。

hike.en: The president has proposed a hike in the minimum wage.
hike.zh: 总统提议大幅度提升最低工资。

hike.en: Several airlines have proposed fare hikes, effective October 1.
hike.zh: 有几家航空公司已打算大幅提高机票价格，自10

hill.en: Their house is on a hill overlooking the sea.
hill.zh: 他们的房子建在可以俯视大海的小山上。

hill.en: A cart was making its way up the hill.
hill.zh: 一辆马车正在爬上山丘。

him.en: Are you in love with him?
Why don’t you ask him yourself?

himself.en: In despair, the young boy had hanged himself.
His name is James but he calls himself Jim.
himself.zh: 他的名字叫詹姆斯，但他称自己为吉姆。

hinder.en: His career has been hindered by injury.
hinder.zh: 由于受伤，他的事业受到了阻碍。

hinder.en: This could get in the way of rescue attempts.
hinder.zh: 这可能会妨碍救援行动。

hindrance.en: The floods have been a major hindrance to relief efforts.
hindrance.zh: 洪水是救灾工作的一大障碍。

hindrance.en: A degree is more of a hindrance than a help in British industry.
hindrance.zh: 在英国工业界，学位反倒是个累赘。

hinge.en: His political future hinges on the outcome of this election.
hinge.zh: 他的政治前途取决于这次选举的结果。

hinge.en: The case against him hinged on Lewis’s evidence.
hinge.zh: 对他的指控是否成立，最终取决于刘易斯的证词。

hint.en: There have been hints that he may take up coaching.
hint.zh: 他暗示过可能会出任教练。

hint.en: Miles had been dropping heavy hints about the cost of petrol.
hint.zh: 迈尔斯一直在露骨地暗示汽油的费用。

hip.en: She stood there with her hands on her hips glaring at him.
hip.zh: 她站在那里，双手叉腰瞪着他。

hip.en: The old lady had fallen and broken her hip.
hip.zh: 那老妇人摔了一跤，髋部骨折。

hire.en: The best way to explore the island is to hire a car.
hire.zh: 在该岛寻幽访胜的最好方式就是租用一辆汽车。

hire.en: What does it cost to hire a boat for a week?
hire.zh: 一艘小船租用一星期的费用是多少？

his.en: Leo took off his coat and sat down.
his.zh: 利奥脱掉大衣坐了下来。

his.en: I love his sense of humour, don’t you?
his.zh: 我喜欢他的幽默感，你呢？

hispanic.en: In California, Hispanics make up 19.2 percent of the population.
hispanic.zh: 在加利福尼亚，西裔美国人占总人口的19.2%

hiss.en: She hissed at me to be quiet.
hiss.zh: 她生气地低声要我安静。
那只猫咝咝叫着退开了。

historic.en: It’s unlikely that the share price will exceed historic levels.
historic.zh: 股价不太可能超过历史水平。

historic.en: Extinct volcanoes are those that have not erupted in historic times.
historic.zh: 死火山指有史以来没有喷发过的火山。

historical.en: It is important to look at the novel in its historical context.
historical.zh: 在历史背景下看待这部小说很重要。

historical.en: Was King Arthur a real historical figure?
historical.zh: 亚瑟王是真实的历史人物吗？

history.en: Throughout history the achievements of women have been largely ignored.
history.zh: 从古至今，妇女的成就都被大大地忽视了。

history.en: No man in recent history has done more to rebuild the Democratic Party.
history.zh: 他对重建民主党的贡献在近代史上无人能及。

hit.en: He raised the hammer and hit the bell.
The robbers hit him over the head with a baseball bat.
hit.zh: 劫匪用棒球棒击打他的头部。

hitchhike.en: She spent her gap year hitchhiking around the world.
hitchhike.zh: 她在上大学前的空档年搭便车环游世界各地。

hitchhike.en: I picked up a hitchhiker on our way back.
hitchhike.zh: 我在回来的路上捎了一个搭便车的人。

hive.en: This marketplace was once a hive of activity.
hive.zh: 这个市场曾经熙熙攘攘。

hobby.en: Susan’s hobbies include reading, cooking, and drama.
hobby.zh: 苏珊的业余爱好包括阅读、烹饪和戏剧。

hoist.en: The crew hurried to hoist the flag.
hoist.zh: 船员们急忙把旗子升起来。

hoist.en: Give me a hoist onto your shoulders.

hold.en: Could you hold my bag for me?
He was holding a knife in one hand.

holder.en: Season-ticket holders are furious at the rise in rail fares.
holder.zh: 买季票的人对火车票价上涨极为愤怒。

holding.en: The government has decided to sell its 21% holding in the firm.
holding.zh: 政府决定出售其在该公司21%

hole.en: There was a huge hole in the road.
I began digging a hole for the plant.
hole.zh: 我开始挖洞种那棵植物。

holiday.en: I’m away on holiday until the 1st of June.

hollow.en: He was short and thin, with hollow eyes.
There was a hollow thump as the cars collided.
hollow.zh: 车辆相撞时发出了空洞的撞击声。

hollywood.en: She is one of Hollywood’s major stars.
hollywood.zh: 她是好莱坞的巨星之一。

home.en: They have a beautiful home in California.
home.zh: 他们在加州有个美丽的家。

home.en: Good luck in your new home!

homeless.en: Thousands of people have been made homeless.
homeless.zh: 成千上万人被逼得无家可归。

homely.en: Mrs Keane is a comfortable, homely person.
homely.zh: 基恩太太平易近人，亲切好客。

homework.en: For homework, finish the exercise on page 14.
It’s worth doing a bit of homework before buying a computer.
homework.zh: 买电脑之前做点准备工作是值得的。

hone.en: He set about honing his skills as a draughtsman.
hone.zh: 他着手提高自己的绘画技艺。

honest.en: He was a hard-working honest man.

honesty.en: It was not, in all honesty, a very good start.
honesty.zh: 说实话，开始并不很顺利。

honeymoon.en: We went to Italy on our honeymoon.
honeymoon.zh: 我们去了意大利度蜜月。

honorary.en: Brown received an honorary doctorate from Seoul University.
honorary.zh: 布朗获得了首尔大学的荣誉博士学位。

honour.en: Over 100 players competed for the honour of representing the county in the National Finals.
It is an honor to have you here, sir.
honour.zh: 先生，大驾光临，深感荣幸。

honourable.en: My father didn’t think acting was an honorable profession.
honourable.zh: 我父亲认为当演员不是受人尊敬的职业。

hook.en: Tom hung his coat on the hook behind the door.
hook.zh: 汤姆把外套挂在门后的衣钩上。

hook.en: I wasn’t prepared to let her off the hook that easily.
hook.zh: 我不愿意如此轻易地放过她。

hop.en: Hop in – I’ll drive you home.
Patrick hopped out of bed and quickly got dressed.
hop.zh: 帕特里克跳下床飞快地穿上衣服。

hope.en: We hope that more women will decide to join the course.
hope.zh: 我们希望更多的女性会决定参加这一课程。

hope.en: I do hope everything goes well.

hopeful.en: Everyone’s feeling pretty hopeful about the future.
hopeful.zh: 人人都对未来充满希望。

hopeful.en: I’m hopeful that we can find a solution.
hopeful.zh: 我对我们能找到解决方法感到乐观。

hopefully.en: Hopefully, I’ll be back home by ten o‘clock.
By then the problem will hopefully have been solved.
hopefully.zh: 届时该问题有望得到解决。

hopeless.en: We tried to stop the flames from spreading, but we knew it was hopeless.
hopeless.zh: 我们试图阻止火势蔓延，但我们知道这是不可能的。

hopeless.en: Getting your work published often seems a hopeless task.
hopeless.zh: 想让自己的作品出版似乎总是徒劳的。

horde.en: There were hordes of people inside the station.
horde.zh: 车站里有一群群乱哄哄的人。

horizon.en: We could see a ship on the horizon.
horizon.zh: 我们能看见地平线上有一艘船。

horizon.en: Business is good now, but there are a few problems on the horizon.
horizon.zh: 目前的生意很好，但有几个问题已初露端倪了。

horn.en: Don’t try and horn in on our fun.
horn.zh: 别想挤进来扫我们的兴。

horrible.en: The weather has been really horrible all week.
The food looked horrible, but it tasted OK.
horrible.zh: 那食物看上去很糟，可吃起来还不错。

horrify.en: Henry was horrified by what had happened.
horrify.zh: 亨利对所发生的事感到毛骨悚然。

horrify.en: She was horrified to discover that he loved Rose.
horrify.zh: 发现他爱罗丝，她感到很震惊。

horror.en: Staff watched in horror as he set himself alight.
horror.zh: 员工惊恐地看着他自焚。

horror.en: Many people recoil with horror when they see a big spider like this.
horror.zh: 很多人看到这样一只大蜘蛛时都会吓得往后退。

horse.en: Lee had never ridden a horse before.
Jim likes a bet on the horses.

hose.en: Would you hose down the car for me?
hose.zh: 你帮我冲洗一下汽车好吗？

hospitable.en: The local people were very kind and hospitable.
The Sahara is one of the world’s least hospitable regions.
hospitable.zh: 撒哈拉沙漠是世界上最不适宜植物生长的地区之一。

hospital.en: They are building a new hospital.
hospital.zh: 他们正在建一家新医院。

hospitality.en: Thanks for your hospitality over the past few weeks.
hospitality.zh: 感谢你几周来的热情款待。

hospitality.en: Thanks for having us. We had a great time.
hospitality.zh: 谢谢你（们）的款待，我们过得非常愉快。

host.en: Our host greeted us at the door.
The gallery is playing host to an exhibition of sculpture.
host.zh: 这家美术馆正在举办雕塑展。

hostage.en: The group are holding two tourists hostage (=keeping them as hostages).
hostage.zh: 这伙人挟持了两名游客作为人质。

hostage.en: Our country must not be held hostage to our past.
hostage.zh: 我们的国家决不要被过去所束缚。

hostile.en: Southampton fans gave their former coach a hostile reception.
hostile.zh: 南安普敦队的球迷对球队的前任教练很不友善。

hostile.en: Carr wouldn’t meet Feng’s stare, which was openly hostile.
hostile.zh: 卡尔不愿意面对冯公然敌视的目光。

hostility.en: They eyed each other with open hostility.
hostility.zh: 他们带着公然的敌意看着对方。

hostility.en: The reform program was greeted with hostility by conservatives.
hostility.zh: 改革方案遭到保守派人士的强烈反对。

hot.en: It’s so hot in here. Can I open the window?
hot.zh: 这里太热了，我开开窗好吗？

hot.en: Be careful, the water’s very hot.

hotel.en: I’ve booked the flights and the hotel.
We’ll be at the Hotel Ibis.
hotel.zh: 我们将住在宜必思酒店。

hound.en: After the court case, Lee was hounded relentlessly by the press.
hound.zh: 案件审结后，李不断受到新闻界的骚扰。

hound.en: The family were hounded out of their home by 18 months of abuse.

hour.en: The interview will last about two hours.
hour.zh: 面试大概要持续两小时。

hour.en: I study for an hour every night.

hourly.zh: 每小时有一班公共汽车开出。

hourly.en: They are paid an hourly rate.

house.zh: 我们是在艾利森家相识的。

house.en: Why don’t you all come over to our house for coffee?
house.zh: 你们全都上我们家来喝咖啡如何？

household.en: A growing number of households have at least one computer.
household.zh: 越来越多的家庭拥有至少一台电脑。

household.en: Families are classified by the occupation of the head of the household (=the person who earns the most money and is most respected in a house).
household.zh: 家庭按一家之主的职业来分类。

housework.en: I spent all morning doing the housework.
housework.zh: 我整个上午都在做家务。

hover.en: Her younger brother hovered in the background watching us.
hover.zh: 她的弟弟在后面走来走去，观察着我们。

hover.en: I noticed several reporters hovering around outside the courtroom.
hover.zh: 我发现几个记者在法庭外面徘徊。

how.en: How do you spell your name?

however.en: This is a cheap and simple process. However, there are dangers.
however.zh: 这是个花钱少而又简单的方法，不过有危险。

however.en: You should report any incident, however minor it is.
however.zh: 任何事件你都应该汇报，不管它多小。

howl.en: Upstairs, one of the twins began to howl (=cry).
howl.zh: 楼上，双胞胎中的一个开始大哭起来。

hub.en: Birmingham is at the hub of Britain’s motorway network.
hub.zh: 伯明翰地处英国高速公路网的枢纽位置。

huddle.en: We lay huddled together for warmth.
huddle.zh: 我们紧紧挤在一起取暖。

huddle.en: People huddled around the radio, waiting for news.
huddle.zh: 人们聚集在收音机旁，等候消息。

hug.en: We stood there crying and hugging each other.
hug.zh: 我们站在那里哭着互相拥抱。

hug.en: She went to her daughter and hugged her tightly.
hug.zh: 她走到女儿身边，紧紧地拥抱她。

huge.en: Your room’s huge compared to mine.
huge.zh: 你的房间跟我的比很大。

huge.en: These shoes make my feet look huge.
huge.zh: 这双鞋让我的脚看上去大极了。

hum.en: Tony was humming to himself as he drove along.
hum.zh: 托尼边开车边哼着曲子。

hum.en: He began to hum a tune.

human.en: There are many different cell types in the human body.
human.zh: 人体中有许多种不同的细胞类型。

human.en: The desire for joy lies deep within the human spirit.
human.zh: 对快乐的渴求藏在人类心灵深处。

humanitarian.en: Humanitarian aid is being sent to the refugees.
humanitarian.zh: 正向难民提供人道主义援助。

humanitarian.en: He was released from prison on humanitarian grounds.
humanitarian.zh: 出于人道主义原因，他获释出狱。

humanity.en: We want a clean healthy environment for all humanity.
humanity.zh: 我们希望全人类拥有一个干净健康的生存环境。

humanity.en: We must never forget our common humanity.
humanity.zh: 我们永远不要忘记共同的人性。

humble.en: He started his career as a humble peanut farmer.
humble.zh: 他从一个卑微的花生农起家。

humble.en: Iacocca rose from humble beginnings to become boss of Ford.
humble.zh: 亚科卡出身卑微，后来成了福特公司的总裁。

humid.en: Tokyo is extremely humid in midsummer.

humidity.en: The room is kept at 72 degrees and 50% relative humidity.

humiliate.en: Her boss humiliated her in front of all her colleagues.
humiliate.zh: 她的老板在所有同事面前羞辱了她。

humiliate.en: I’ve never felt so humiliated in all my life.
humiliate.zh: 我这辈子从未感到过如此丢人。

humiliation.en: The government suffered a series of political humiliations.
humiliation.zh: 该政府在政治上蒙受了一连串的羞辱。

humorous.en: The film has some mildly humorous moments.
humorous.zh: 那部电影中有些略显幽默的片段。

humorous.en: He told lots of funny stories.
humorous.zh: 他讲了很多有趣的故事。

humour.en: It’s vital to have a sense of humor in this job.
humour.zh: 做这份工作必须具备幽默感。

hump.en: I managed to hump the suitcases upstairs.
hump.zh: 我好不容易把那些箱子搬上了楼。

hundred.en: The tree was probably a hundred years old.
I make nine hundred dollars a week.

hunger.en: Thousands of people are dying from hunger every day.
hunger.zh: 每天都有成千上万的人死于饥饿。

hunger.en: Try to satisfy your hunger by eating some fruit.

hungry.en: I was cold, tired, and hungry.
If you get hungry, there’s some cold chicken in the fridge.
hungry.zh: 你要是饿了，冰箱里有些冷鸡肉。

hunt.en: Wolves tend to hunt in packs (=hunt in groups).
The kids were hunting for shells on the beach.
hunt.zh: 孩子们在海滩上寻找贝壳。

hurdle.en: Finding enough money for the project was the first hurdle.
hurdle.zh: 第一道难关是为该项目筹措足够的资金。

hurdle.en: He hurdled the fence and ran off down the street.
hurdle.zh: 他跨过围栏沿那条街逃走了。

hurl.en: Demonstrators were hurling bricks through the windows.
hurl.zh: 示威者在向窗里掷砖块。

hurl.en: He hurled a chair across the set, smashing lamps and vases.
hurl.zh: 他抓起一把椅子扔向片场的那头，把灯和花瓶都砸得粉碎。

hurry.en: If we hurry, we’ll get there in time.
hurry.zh: 要是赶紧的话，我们能及时到那里。

hurry.en: I hate having to hurry a meal.
hurry.zh: 我讨厌匆匆忙忙地吃饭。

hurt.en: Was anyone hurt in the accident?
Put that thing down – you might hurt someone with it.
hurt.zh: 快把那东西放下，你会伤着别人的。

hurtle.en: All of a sudden, a car came hurtling round the corner.
hurtle.zh: 突然，一辆汽车从拐角处冲了出来。

husband.en: Have you met my husband Roy?
husband.zh: 你见过我的丈夫罗伊吗？

hush.en: Ella asked them to hush their voices.
The audience hushed as he stepped onto the stage.
hush.zh: 他走上舞台，观众安静了下来。

husk.en: His drug addiction had turned him into a husk of his former self.
husk.zh: 毒瘾已经让他变得只剩下一副空皮囊。

hustle.en: I was hustled out of the building by a couple of security men.
hustle.zh: 我被几个保安人员推出了大楼。

hustle.en: He was hustled away by police officers.
hustle.zh: 他被警察推搡着带走了。

hygiene.en: The Consumers’ Association blames poor hygiene standards.
hygiene.zh: 消费者协会指责卫生标准低下。

hymn.en: He liked to sing hymns as he worked.
hymn.zh: 他工作时喜欢唱赞美诗。

hymn.en: Their first single was a hymn to selfishness called ‘Looking After Number One’.
hymn.zh: 他们的第一首单曲是颂扬利己的一首歌，名为《珍惜自我》。

hyper.en: No, don’t give Luke any candy – it’ll make him hyper.
hyper.zh: 不，别给卢克糖果，不然他会起劲折腾的。

hypersensitive.en: I discovered I was hypersensitive to caffeine.
hypersensitive.zh: 我发现我对咖啡因过敏。

hypersensitive.en: She’s hypersensitive to any form of criticism.

hypnosis.en: While under hypnosis, the victim was able to describe her attacker.
hypnosis.zh: 在催眠状态下，受害者能够描述袭击者的模样。

hypocrisy.en: It would be sheer hypocrisy to pray for success, since I’ve never believed in God.
hypocrisy.zh: 我从不相信上帝，因此为获成功而祈祷是纯粹的虚伪之举。

hypothesis.en: One hypothesis is that the victim fell asleep while driving.
hypothesis.zh: 一种假设是受害人开车时睡着了。

hypothesis.en: We hope that further research will confirm our hypothesis.
hypothesis.zh: 我们希望进一步的研究能证实我们的假设。

hypothesize.en: Scientists hypothesize that the dinosaurs were killed by a giant meteor.
hypothesize.zh: 科学家假设恐龙灭绝的原因是一颗巨大的流星撞击了地球。

hypothetical.en: Brennan brought up a hypothetical case to make his point.
hypothetical.zh: 布伦南提出一个假设的例子来说明他的观点。
这个问题完全基于假设。

hysteria.en: In a fit of hysteria, Silvia blamed me for causing her father’s death.
hysteria.zh: 西尔维娅一阵歇斯底里，指责我害死了她父亲。

hysteria.en: Since the general’s death, the population has been gripped by mass hysteria.
hysteria.zh: 自将军死后，民众群情激愤。

hysterical.en: Janet became hysterical and began screaming.
hysterical.zh: 珍妮特歇斯底里起来，开始尖叫。

hysterical.en: Everyone in the studio burst into hysterical laughter.
hysterical.zh: 演播室里的每个人都爆发出一阵狂笑。

i.en: I moved to this city six years ago.
i.zh: 六年前我搬到了这个城市。

i.en: I’m not late again, am I?

ice.en: Would you like some ice in your drink?
ice.zh: 你饮料中要放点冰块吗？

ice.en: Her hands were as cold as ice.

icon.en: To open a new file, click on the icon.
icon.zh: 要打开新文档，点击该图标。

icy.en: The bath water was icy cold.

id.en: I’ll need to see some ID.
Police are still looking for someone who can ID the body.
id.zh: 警方仍在寻找可辨认出死者身份的人。

idea.en: You should talk to Ken - he’s always full of good ideas.
idea.zh: 你应该和肯谈谈，他总是满脑子好主意。

idea.en: I knew it was a bad idea to leave him on his own.
idea.zh: 我知道把他独自留下不是个好主意。

ideal.en: The scheme offers an ideal opportunity for youngsters to get training.
ideal.zh: 该计划为年轻人提供了获得培训的极好机会。

ideal.en: With so much rain, conditions are far from ideal.
ideal.zh: 雨水这么多，天气情况很不理想。

idealize.en: Society continues to idealize the two-parent family.
idealize.zh: 社会依然把双亲家庭视为理想家庭。

identical.en: Nutritionally, infant formulas are almost identical to breast milk.
identical.zh: 从营养方面来说，婴儿配方奶粉和母乳几乎一样。

identical.en: The ingredients are identical with those of competing products.
identical.zh: 其成分和与之相竞争的产品相同。

identifiable.en: She looked young, and was immediately identifiable as a trainee.
identifiable.zh: 她看上去很年轻，一眼就可以看出是实习生。

identifiable.en: The police were identifiable by their uniform.
identifiable.zh: 警察可以从其制服辨认出来。

identification.zh: 你有什么身份证明文件吗？

identification.en: Bring some form of identification, preferably a passport.
identification.zh: 带上身份证明文件，最好是护照。

identify.en: He was too far away to be able to identify faces.
identify.zh: 他离得太远，没法看面孔认出谁是谁。

identify.en: The police took fingerprints and identified the body.
identify.zh: 警方采集了指纹，对尸体作了身份确认。

identity.en: The identity of the killer is still unknown.
Children need continuity, security, and a sense of identity.
identity.zh: 孩子们需要稳定感、安全感以及自我认同感。

ideological.en: The party is split by ideological differences.
ideological.zh: 意识形态上的差异造成该政党分裂。

idiomatic.en: He had the ability to write fluent and idiomatic English.
idiomatic.zh: 他能够写出流利地道的英语。

idiot.en: It was all your fault, you idiot.

idiot.zh: 不要再问这些愚蠢的问题了。

idle.en: I cannot afford to leave the land lying idle.
The whole team stood idle, waiting for the mechanic.
idle.zh: 整队人干站着等技工来。

idol.en: She is the idol of countless teenagers.
idol.zh: 她是无数青少年的偶像。

idol.en: She had made an idol of her husband.

idyllic.en: If you want old-world tradition in an idyllic setting, this is the hotel for you.
idyllic.zh: 如果你想找一处恬静宜人而又古色古香的环境，那么就是这家酒店了。

if.en: We’ll stay at home if it rains.
if.zh: 如果下雨，我们就待在家里。

if.en: If you need money, I can lend you some.
if.zh: 如果你需要钱，我能借给你一些。

ignorance.en: Excuse my ignorance, but how does it actually work?
ignorance.zh: 请原谅我的无知，它究竟是如何运作的？

ignorance.en: I would have remained in ignorance if Shaun hadn’t mentioned it.
ignorance.zh: 要不是肖恩提起这件事，我还蒙在鼓里呢。

ignorant.en: Political historians are often rather ignorant of economics.
ignorant.zh: 政治历史学家往往对经济学一窍不通。

ignorant.en: Many people remain blissfully ignorant about the dangers of too much sun (=happy because they do not know about the dangers).
ignorant.zh: 很多人对日晒过度的危害一无所知。

ignore.en: You can’t ignore the fact that many criminals never go to prison.
ignore.zh: 你不能无视很多罪犯从未获刑的事实。

ignore.en: The phone rang, but she ignored it.
ignore.zh: 电话铃响了，但她只当没听见。

ill.zh: 布里奇特不能来了，她生病了。

ill.en: I was feeling ill that day and decided to stay at home.
ill.zh: 我那天不太舒服，决定留在家里。

ill-conceived.en: The policy was ill-conceived and misguided.
ill-conceived.zh: 这项政策规划不周而且方向错误。

illegal.en: They were involved in illegal activities.
It is illegal to sell tobacco to someone under 16.

illegible.zh: 他的字迹完全无法辨认。

ill-equipped.en: The rebels were ill-equipped to cope with Western weapons and forces.
ill-equipped.zh: 叛军装备不足，不能和西方国家的武器和兵力相抗衡。

ill-equipped.en: Their army is ill-equipped for modern warfare.
ill-equipped.zh: 他们的军队装备很差，不符合现代化战争的要求。

illiterate.en: It was an illiterate letter, full of mistakes.
illiterate.zh: 这封信文笔拙劣，错误连篇。

illness.en: She had all the normal childhood illnesses.
illness.zh: 儿童的常见病她小时候都得过。

illness.en: Her mother was recovering from a serious illness.
illness.zh: 她母亲重病后正在逐渐康复。

illogical.en: It is illogical to assume you can do the work of three people.
illogical.zh: 认为你一个人能干三个人的活没有道理。

illuminate.en: A single candle illuminated his face.
illuminate.zh: 一支蜡烛照亮了他的脸。

illuminate.en: At night the canals are beautifully illuminated.
illuminate.zh: 晚上运河灯火辉煌，美景毕现。

illumination.en: White candles, the only illumination, burned on the table.
illumination.zh: 白蜡烛作为唯一的照明在桌子上燃烧着。

illusion.en: They suffer from the illusion that they cannot solve their problems.
illusion.zh: 他们误以为解决不了自己的问题。

illusion.en: She was under no illusion that he loved her.

illusory.en: First impressions can often prove illusory.
illusory.zh: 第一印象往往被证明是不真实的。

illustrate.en: Let me give an example to illustrate the point.
illustrate.zh: 让我举个例子来说明这一点。

illustrate.en: She illustrated her discussion with diagrams.
illustrate.zh: 她用图表来说明她的论述。

illustration.en: The book contains 62 pages of illustrations.
For the purposes of illustration, some of the more important symptoms are listed below.
illustration.zh: 下面列出一些更重要的症状作为例证。

illustrative.en: The case is illustrative of a common pattern.
illustrative.zh: 该事例是对常见模式的说明。

illustrative.en: For illustrative purposes, only a simple example is given here.
illustrative.zh: 这里只举个简单的例子来予以说明。

image.en: He had no visual image of her, only her name.
image.zh: 他记不得她的样子了，只记得她的名字。

image.en: He had the clearest image in his mind of his mother and father.
image.zh: 他脑海中对父母的印象极其清晰。

imagery.en: Their dreams commonly involved complex stories with visual imagery.
imagery.zh: 他们的梦里常常有很多复杂的情节，充满了生动的画面。

imaginary.en: As she listened, she played an imaginary piano on her knees.
imaginary.zh: 她边听边在膝盖上作弹钢琴状。

imaginary.en: We must protect older people from harm, whether it is real or imaginary.
imaginary.zh: 我们必须保护老人免受伤害，无论这伤害是真实的还是假想的。

imagination.en: It does not take much imagination to understand their grief.
imagination.zh: 不难想象他们是多么悲伤。

imagination.en: With a little imagination, you can find great inexpensive gifts.
imagination.zh: 稍微动点脑筋，你就会找到物美价廉的礼物。

imagine.en: Imagine that you have just won a million pounds.
imagine.zh: 设想你刚刚赢得一百万英镑。
想象一下没有热水的生活。

imaging.en: New imaging technologies mean that doctors are better able to screen for breast cancer.
imaging.zh: 新的成像技术意味着医生能更容易检测出乳腺癌。

imbalance.en: The government must redress the imbalance (=put it right) in spending on black and white children.
imbalance.zh: 政府必须纠正在黑人儿童和白人儿童方面开支的不平衡。

imbalance.en: Many pupils follow an imbalanced curriculum.
imbalance.zh: 很多学生所学的课程结构不平衡。

imbibe.en: Both men imbibed considerable quantities of gin.
imbibe.zh: 这两个男人都喝了大量的杜松子酒。

imbibe.en: She had imbibed the traditions of her family.
imbibe.zh: 她受到了自己家庭传统的影响。

imitate.en: She was a splendid mimic and loved to imitate Winston Churchill.
imitate.zh: 她是个出色的模仿者，喜欢模仿温斯顿·

imitate.en: The Japanese have no wish to imitate Western social customs and attitudes.
imitate.zh: 日本人无意仿效西方的社会习俗和处事态度。

imitation.en: Many people think that children learn language by imitation.
imitation.zh: 很多人认为儿童通过模仿学习语言。

imitation.en: The remake of ‘Casablanca’ was a pale imitation (=something that is much less good than the thing it imitates) of the original movie.
imitation.zh: 重拍的《卡萨布兰卡》远不如原版。

imitative.en: Young people might be provoked into imitative crime by the exploits they see on TV.
imitative.zh: 年轻人可能会从电视上看到的“

immaterial.en: If you sign a document, it is wholly immaterial whether you have read it carefully or not.
immaterial.zh: 文件一经签署，是否仔细阅读过文件就完全无关紧要了。

immature.en: He forgave his son’s immature behaviour.
immature.zh: 他原谅了儿子的幼稚行为。

immediate.en: Our immediate response to the attack was sheer horror.
immediate.zh: 我们对攻击的第一反应就是非常惊恐。

immediate.en: They promise immediate action to help the unemployed.
immediate.zh: 他们承诺立即采取行动帮助失业者。

immediately.en: Mix in the remaining ingredients and serve immediately.
immediately.zh: 拌入余下的食材，立即上桌。

immediately.en: The telephone rang, and he answered it immediately.
immediately.zh: 电话铃响了，他马上去接。

immense.en: People who travel by rail still read an immense amount.
immense.zh: 人们坐火车旅行时仍然会读很多书。

immense.en: Regular visits from a social worker can be of immense value to old people living alone.
immense.zh: 对于独居老人来说，社工的经常探望很重要。

immensely.en: Champagne wines became immensely popular in the 18th century.
Nationalism is an immensely powerful force.
immensely.zh: 民族主义是十分强大的力量。

immerse.en: Immerse your foot in ice-cold water to reduce the swelling.
immerse.zh: 把你的脚泡在冰凉的水中消肿。

immerse.en: He left school at 16 and immersed himself in the Labour Party.

immigrate.en: His father and mother immigrated when he was two.
immigrate.zh: 他的父母在他两岁时移民到这里。

immigration.en: He called for a common European policy on immigration.
immigration.zh: 他要求欧洲国家实施共同的移民政策。

imminent.en: He was in imminent danger of dying.
A new trade agreement is imminent.
imminent.zh: 一项新的贸易协定即将签署。

immobile.en: She could see a figure sitting immobile, facing the sea.
immobile.zh: 她看到一个人影面朝大海坐着，一动不动。

immobile.en: Kim’s illness had rendered her completely immobile.
immobile.zh: 金的病使她完全丧失了活动能力。

immobilize.en: The broken limb must be immobilized immediately.
immobilize.zh: 断肢必须立即加以固定。

immobilize.en: She was immobilized with a broken leg.

immoral.en: Deliberately making people suffer is immoral.
immoral.zh: 故意使人吃苦头是不道德的。

immoral.en: It’s immoral to be rich while people are starving and homeless.
immoral.zh: 不管别人忍饥挨饿、居无定所而自己发家致富是不道德的。

immortal.en: Plato believed that the soul is immortal.
In the immortal words of Henry Ford, ‘If it ain’t broke, don’t fix it.’

immune.en: Once we’ve had the disease, we’re immune for life.
immune.zh: 我们一旦得过这种病，就获得了终身免疫力。

immune.en: HIV is a progressive disease which the immune response ultimately fails to control.
immune.zh: 人类免疫缺陷病毒是一种进行性疾病，最终免疫反应无法将其控制。

immunity.en: They were granted immunity from prosecution.

immunize.en: There is still no vaccine to immunize people against the virus.
immunize.zh: 现在还没有针对这种病毒的疫苗。

immutable.en: This decision should not be seen as immutable.
immutable.zh: 不该把这个决定看成是不可改变的。

impact.en: We need to assess the impact on climate change.
impact.zh: 我们需要评估对气候变化的影响。

impact.en: Higher mortgage rates have already had a major impact on spending.
impact.zh: 提高的抵押借款利率已经对消费产生了重大影响。

impair.en: The illness had impaired his ability to think and concentrate.
impair.zh: 这种疾病损害了他的思维能力和注意力。

impart.en: Use a piece of fresh ginger to impart a Far Eastern flavour to simple ingredients.
impart.zh: 用一片鲜姜给简单的原料添上东亚的风味。

impart.en: She had information that she couldn’t wait to impart.
impart.zh: 她得到了消息，迫不及待地想告诉别人。

impartial.en: We offer impartial advice on tax and insurance.
impartial.zh: 我们就税收和保险问题提供公充的建议。

impatience.en: A note of impatience had entered his voice.
impatience.zh: 他的语气开始透出一丝不耐烦。

impatience.en: She was bursting with impatience to tell Natalia what had happened.
impatience.zh: 她急不可待地想要告诉纳塔利娅所发生的事情。

impatient.en: We are growing impatient with the lack of results.
impatient.zh: 我们因为没有取得成效而急躁起来。

impatient.en: He turned away with an impatient gesture.
impatient.zh: 他做了个不耐烦的手势转过身去。

impede.en: Storms at sea impeded our progress.
impede.zh: 海上风暴阻碍了我们的航程。

impediment.en: War is one of the greatest impediments to human progress.
impediment.zh: 战争是人类进步的一大绊脚石。

impenetrable.en: The trees formed a dark and impenetrable barrier.
impenetrable.zh: 这些树形成了一道无法通过的黑暗屏障。

imperative.en: It is imperative that politicians should be good communicators.
imperative.zh: 政治家应该是很好的沟通者，这很重要。

imperative.en: It is imperative to meet face to face with the client.

imperial.en: Britain’s imperial expansion in the 19th century

imperialism.en: Small nations resent Western cultural imperialism.
imperialism.zh: 小国家痛恨西方的文化扩张。

impermeable.en: No paint is impermeable to water vapour.
impermeable.zh: 没有哪种涂料是不透水汽的。

impersonal.en: Business letters do not have to be impersonal and formal.
impersonal.zh: 商业信函并非一定要刻板而缺乏人情味。

impersonal.en: Sometimes she seems a very impersonal, even unkind, mother.
impersonal.zh: 有时她看起来是一个非常冷漠的母亲，甚至有些刻薄。

impervious.en: His ego was impervious to self-doubt.

impetuous.en: She might live to regret this impetuous decision.
impetuous.zh: 她可能会一辈子为这个鲁莽的决定感到后悔。

impetus.en: The report may provide further impetus for reform.
impetus.zh: 这份报告可能会进一步推动改革。

impetus.en: The discovery gave fresh impetus to the research.
impetus.zh: 这个发现为研究带来新动力。

impinge.en: Personal problems experienced by students may impinge on their work.
impinge.zh: 学生遇到的个人问题可能会影响到他们的学业。

implant.en: A deep sense of patriotism had been implanted in him by his father.
implant.zh: 他父亲向他灌输了强烈的爱国主义思想。

implant.en: Surgeons successfully implanted an artificial hip.
implant.zh: 外科医生成功地植入了一个人工髋关节。

implausible.en: Margaret found his excuse somewhat implausible.
implausible.zh: 玛格丽特认为他的借口有些站不住脚。

implausible.en: It’s not entirely implausible that a galaxy could be identical to our own.
implausible.zh: 某个星系和我们这个星系完全相同并非完全不可能。

implement.en: We have decided to implement the committee’s recommendations in full.
implement.zh: 我们已决定全面实施委员会提出的建议。

implicate.en: The allegations implicated Abe to such an extent he was forced to resign.
implicate.zh: 安倍深受指控牵连，不得不辞职。

implicate.en: Three police officers are implicated in the cover-up.
implicate.zh: 三名警察涉嫌隐瞒事实。

implication.en: What are the implications of these proposals?
implication.zh: 这些提议会有什么后果？

implication.en: This election has profound implications for the future of U.S. democracy.
implication.zh: 对于美国民主的未来而言，这次选举影响深远。

implicit.en: Her words contained an implicit threat.
His statement is being seen as implicit criticism of the work of research laboratories.
implicit.zh: 部长的话被认为是对研究实验室工作的含蓄批评。

implore.en: She implored the soldiers to save her child.
implore.zh: 她恳求那些士兵救救她的孩子。

imply.en: Cleo blushed. She had not meant to imply that he was lying.
imply.zh: 克利奥脸红了。她不是故意暗指他在撒谎的。

imply.en: The high level of radiation in the rocks implies that they are volcanic in origin.
imply.zh: 这些岩石内的高辐射水平显示它们是由火山作用形成的。

import.en: American demand for Japanese imports (=goods from Japan)
import.zh: 美国人对日本进口产品的需求

import.en: The beetle is thought to be a European import.
import.zh: 这种甲虫被认为是从欧洲传入的。

importance.en: I agree about the importance of these proposals (=the reasons why they are important).
importance.zh: 我同意，这些建议十分重要。

importance.en: They make decisions about various matters of importance (=important matters).
importance.zh: 他们对各种各样的重要事情作出决定。

important.en: The accident taught him an important lesson.
important.zh: 那次事故给了他很大的教训。

important.en: Happiness is more important than money.

impose.en: The court can impose a fine.
impose.zh: 法庭可以强制执行罚款。

impose.en: The government imposed a ban on the sale of ivory.

imposing.en: He’s a tall, quietly spoken, but imposing figure.
imposing.zh: 他高高的个子，说话轻声细语，但气宇轩昂。

imposition.en: I know it’s an imposition, but could I use your bathroom?
imposition.zh: 实在不好意思，我可以借用你的浴室吗？

impossible.en: It’s impossible to be accurate about these things.
impossible.zh: 这些事情不可能准确无误。

impractical.en: The road toll scheme was dismissed as impractical.
impractical.zh: 公路收费计划由于不切实际而遭到否定。

impractical.en: James was a foolish man, full of impractical plans.
impractical.zh: 詹姆斯是个愚蠢的人，满脑子都是不切实际的计划。

imprecise.en: Alcohol affects the brain, making speech slurred and imprecise.
imprecise.zh: 酒精影响大脑，使言语含糊不清。

impregnate.en: The mats have to be impregnated with disinfectant.

impress.en: Steve borrowed his dad’s sports car to impress his girlfriend.
impress.zh: 史蒂夫借来他爸爸的跑车向女友炫耀。

impress.en: We were very impressed by the standard of work.
impress.zh: 工作水准之高给我们留下了深±

impression.en: When we looked around the school we got a very good impression.
impression.zh: 我们参观了学校，对它的印象很好。

impression.en: I got the impression that she wasn't very happy with her job.
impression.zh: 我有这样的印象，她的工作干得并不愉快。

impressionistic.en: The officers seemed to make only an impressionistic assessment.
impressionistic.zh: 官员们好像是仅凭印象便作出了评估。

impressive.zh: 这些数字看上去确实很可观。

impressive.en: Among the guests was an impressive array of authors and critics.
impressive.zh: 来宾中有不少出色的作家和评论家。

imprint.en: One snowy morning, footprints and tyre marks were imprinted in the snow.
imprint.zh: 一个下雪的早上，雪地上留下了脚印和轮胎印。

imprint.en: The sight of Joe’s dead body was imprinted on his mind forever.
imprint.zh: 看到乔尸体的景象一直留在他的脑海里。

imprison.en: The government imprisoned all opposition leaders.
imprison.zh: 政府把反对派领导人全部监禁起来。

imprison.en: She was imprisoned within his strong arms.
imprison.zh: 她被他强壮的手臂搂着。

imprisonment.en: They were sentenced to 6 years’ imprisonment.

improbable.en: It seems highly improbable that he had no knowledge of the affair.
improbable.zh: 他不知道这件事的可能性似乎极小。

impromptu.en: The band gave an impromptu concert.
impromptu.zh: 乐队开了一场即兴音乐会。

improper.en: He realised that it was improper for a police officer to accept gifts.
improper.zh: 他意识到作为警察收受礼物是不合法的。

improper.en: It would be improper of me to comment before the election outcome is known.
improper.zh: 在选举结果未知的情况下我作出评论是不恰当的。

improve.en: The doctors say she is improving (=after being ill).
You could use the money for improving your home.
improve.zh: 你可以用这笔钱改善家居。

improvement.en: There’s been a big improvement in the children’s behaviour.
improvement.zh: 孩子们的行为举止有了很大的进步。

improvement.en: We need to carry out some improvements to the system.
improvement.zh: 我们需要对系统进行一些改进。

improvise.en: I forgot to bring my notes, so I had to improvise.
improvise.zh: 我忘了带笔记，只好临时发挥。

improvise.en: There were no nappies, so we had to improvise with what we could find.
improvise.zh: 没有尿布，我们只好找到什么就凑合着用。

impulse.en: Marge’s first impulse was to run.
impulse.zh: 玛吉的第一个念头就是跑。

impulse.en: Gerry couldn’t resist the impulse to kiss her.
impulse.zh: 格里抑制不住想亲吻她的冲动。

impulsive.en: Rosa was impulsive and sometimes regretted things she’d done.
impulsive.zh: 罗莎性情鲁莽，有时会为做过的事感到后悔。

impulsive.en: In a burst of impulsive generosity, I offered to pay.
impulsive.zh: 因一时慷慨，我主动提出付款。

impurity.zh: 凡天然矿物都含有杂质。

impurity.en: Our oatmeal face mask absorbs impurities from your skin.
impurity.zh: 我们的燕麦面膜能够吸收皮肤上的杂质。

in.en: There’s some sugar in the cupboard.
My mother was in the kitchen.

inability.en: Alcoholism can result in an inability to cope.
inability.zh: 酒精中毒会导致行为能力丧失。

inaccessible.en: In winter, the villages are inaccessible by road.
inaccessible.zh: 冬天时，进入这些村子的路很难走。

inaccessible.en: A long flight of stairs made the center inaccessible to disabled visitors.
inaccessible.zh: 一段长长的楼梯使残疾的参观者难以到达中心。

inaccurate.en: A lot of what has been written about him is inaccurate.
inaccurate.zh: 关于他的文字描述有大量失实之处。

inaccurate.en: He was fined $300,000 for making inaccurate statements to Congress.
inaccurate.zh: 他对国会发表失实的陈述，被罚款30

inactive.en: The brain cells are inactive during sleep.
inactive.zh: 在睡觉时脑细胞不活跃。

inactive.en: Young people are becoming politically inactive.
inactive.zh: 年轻人变得不热衷政治了。

inactivity.en: Don’t suddenly take up violent exercise after years of inactivity.
inactivity.zh: 多年没锻炼不要突然进行剧烈运动。

inactivity.en: The time spent between jobs should not be a period of inactivity.
inactivity.zh: 工作之余不应无所事事。

inadequacy.en: Unemployment can cause feelings of inadequacy and low self-esteem.
inadequacy.zh: 失业会使人缺乏自信，产生自卑感。

inadequacy.en: I’m quite aware of my own inadequacies.
inadequacy.zh: 我很清楚自身的不足之处。

inadequate.en: The parking facilities are inadequate for a busy shopping centre.
inadequate.zh: 这些停车设施对于一个繁忙的购物中心来说是不够的。

inadequate.en: The building’s electrical system was completely inadequate.
inadequate.zh: 大楼的电力供应系统有严重缺陷。

inadvertently.en: Viruses can be spread inadvertently by email users.
inadvertently.zh: 病毒会被电子邮件用户无意中传播开来。

inadvertently.en: Robinson’s name was inadvertently omitted from the list.
inadvertently.zh: 鲁宾逊的名字被人无意之中从名单上漏掉了。

inappropriate.en: His comments were wholly inappropriate on such a solemn occasion.
inappropriate.zh: 他在这么严肃的场合中说这样的话完全不恰当。

inappropriate.en: It would be inappropriate for me to comment until we know more of the facts.
inappropriate.zh: 在我们了解更多的情况之前我不宜发表意见。

inaugural.en: More than 200,000 people attended Carter’s inaugural.
inaugural.zh: 二十多万人参加了卡特的就职典礼。

inaugurate.en: On 8 January 1959 de Gaulle was inaugurated as first president of the Fifth Republic.
The Turner Prize was inaugurated in 1984.

inborn.en: Mammals have an inborn fear of snakes.
Good taste is inborn and cannot be learned.
inborn.zh: 好的鉴赏力是与生俱来的，无法通过后天习得。

incandescent.en: The prince was said to be incandescent with rage.

incapable.en: He seemed incapable of understanding how she felt.
incapable.zh: 他似乎不能理解她的感受。

incapable.en: Seventy-five percent of the electorate believe his party is incapable of government.

incense.en: Spectators were incensed by the referee’s decision.
incense.zh: 观众对裁判的判罚极为愤怒。

incentive.en: As an added incentive, there’s a bottle of champagne for the best team.
incentive.zh: 给最优秀的队发一瓶香槟作为额外的鼓励。

incentive.en: Awards provide an incentive for young people to improve their skills.
incentive.zh: 奖励是一种激励手段，鼓励年轻人努力提高自己的技能。

incessant.en: The child’s incessant talking started to irritate her.
incessant.zh: 这孩子喋喋不休，她开始烦躁起来。

inch.en: The curtains were an inch too short.
Rainfall here is under 15 inches a year.

incidence.en: Why did the incidence of heroin use continue to climb?
incidence.zh: 为什么吸食海洛因的人数持续攀升？

incidence.en: Smokers had the highest incidence of colds.
incidence.zh: 吸烟者中感冒的发病率最高。

incident.en: Am I at risk because of some incident in my sexual past?
incident.zh: 我过去性生活中的某件事会使我处于危险境地吗？

incident.en: Roads were sealed off because of a major incident.
incident.zh: 因为发生重大事故，道路被封锁了。

incidental.en: Increased motivation is more than an incidental benefit of reward schemes.
incidental.zh: 积极性提高不仅仅是奖励计划附带的益处。

incidental.en: Drinking too much is almost incidental to bartending.
incidental.zh: 当酒吧侍者几乎免不了饮酒过度。

incidentally.zh: 顺便问一下，你在哪儿出生的？

incidentally.en: The wine, incidentally, goes very well with a mature cheese.
incidentally.zh: 顺便说一下，这种葡萄酒配熟干酪味道很好。

incinerate.en: All the infected clothing was incinerated.
incinerate.zh: 所有沾染了细菌的衣服都被焚化了。

incite.en: They were charged with inciting racial hatred.
incite.zh: 他们被指控煽动种族仇恨。

incite.en: There was no evidence that he had incited members of the group to violence.
incite.zh: 没有证据证明他唆使该团体成员使用暴力。

inclination.en: My natural inclination was to say no.
Neither of my children showed the slightest inclination to follow me into journalism.
inclination.zh: 我的两个孩子一点都没表现出要随我从事新闻业的意愿。

incline.en: The accident inclined him to reconsider his career.
incline.zh: 这次意外使他重新考虑他的职业。

incline.en: I incline to accept the official version of events.
incline.zh: 我倾向于接受官方对这些事件的说法。

inclined.en: Arthur has some strange ideas, but on this occasion I’m inclined to agree with him.
inclined.zh: 阿瑟是有一些奇怪的想法，但这次我倒是倾向于同意他的观点。

inclined.en: Commandos are inclined to shoot first and ask questions later.
inclined.zh: 突击队员往往会先开枪，然后再问话。

include.en: His job includes looking after under-21 teams.

including.en: The price is £25.50, including postage and packing.
You’ll need a variety of skills, including leadership and negotiating.
including.zh: 你将需要各种技巧，包括领导能力和协商能力。

inclusion.en: His inclusion in the team has caused controversy.
inclusion.zh: 他入选球队引起了争议。

inclusion.en: With the recent inclusions, there will be 28 delegates in all.
inclusion.zh: 连同新近加入的成员，总共将有28

inclusive.en: The fully inclusive fare for the trip is £22.
inclusive.zh: 这次出行的全部费用为22

inclusive.en: The rent is £120 a week, inclusive of heating.
inclusive.zh: 房租连暖气费在内是每星期120

income.en: People on higher incomes should pay more tax.
We have an income of over $100,000 a year.

incompatible.en: I don’t know why they ever got married. They’re totally incompatible.
incompatible.zh: 我不知道他们为什么结婚，他们根本合不来。

incompatible.en: Business interests are incompatible with public office.
incompatible.zh: 商业利益与公职不可兼得。

incomplete.en: Unfortunately, I do not have the information because our records are incomplete.
incomplete.zh: 很遗憾，由于我们的记录不完整，我无法提供有关资料。

incomplete.en: TV ads implied that a woman was incomplete without a man.
incomplete.zh: 电视广告暗示女人没有男人就不完整。

incomprehensible.en: I find your attitude quite incomprehensible.
incomprehensible.zh: 我觉得你的态度很难理解。

incomprehensible.en: His accent made his speech incomprehensible to me.
incomprehensible.zh: 他的口音使得很多听众听不懂他说的话。

inconclusive.en: The evidence against the two men was inconclusive.
inconclusive.zh: 针对这两个人的不利证据并不令人信服。

inconclusive.en: A coalition government was formed after inconclusive elections.
inconclusive.zh: 选举没有结果，于是成立了一个联合政府。

incongruity.en: The incongruity of her situation struck Gina with unpleasant force.
incongruity.zh: 吉娜猛然意识到自己处境尴尬，心里很不舒服。

incongruity.en: He didn’t see the slightest incongruity between the idealism of his plays and his own morals.
incongruity.zh: 他没看出他戏剧中的理想主义和他自己的道德观有丝毫不相称。

incongruous.en: The new theatre looks utterly incongruous in its setting.
incongruous.zh: 这座新剧院和周围的环境格格不入。

inconsistency.en: There were several glaring inconsistencies (=very noticeable differences) in his report.
inconsistency.zh: 他的报告中有几个明显的前后矛盾之处。

inconsistency.en: Defence counsel looks for inconsistency between witness statements.
inconsistency.zh: 被告律师在证人的证词中寻找有矛盾的地方。

inconsistent.en: The accounts of the witnesses are inconsistent.
inconsistent.zh: 几位目击者的说法不一致。

inconsistent.en: His results are inconsistent with our data.
inconsistent.zh: 他得到的结果和我们的数据不一致。

inconspicuous.en: She stood by the wall, trying to look inconspicuous.
inconspicuous.zh: 她贴墙站着，尽量不引人注目。

inconvenience.en: We apologise for the delay and any inconvenience caused.
inconvenience.zh: 我们对延误和由此造成的不便深感抱歉。

inconvenience.en: His early arrival was clearly an inconvenience to his host.
inconvenience.zh: 他早到显然给主人带来了不便。

inconvenient.en: Monday’s a bit inconvenient for me. How about Wednesday?
inconvenient.zh: 周一我不太方便，周三如何？

inconvenient.en: Am I calling at an inconvenient time?
inconvenient.zh: 我电话打得不是时候吧？

incorporate.en: We’ve incorporated many environmentally friendly features into the design of the building.
incorporate.zh: 我们在这座建筑的设计中加进了许多环保元素。

incorporate.en: Our original proposals were not incorporated in the new legislation.
incorporate.zh: 我们最初的提案没有写进新的法规。

incorrect.en: The information you gave us was incorrect.
incorrect.zh: 你给我们的信息不准确。

incorrect.en: It would be incorrect of me to comment.

increase.en: The population increased dramatically in the first half of the century.
increase.zh: 该世纪上半叶，人口大幅度增加。

increase.en: Visits to the site have increased threefold since May.

increasingly.en: Marketing techniques are becoming increasingly sophisticated.
increasingly.zh: 市场营销技巧越来越巧妙。

increasingly.en: Increasingly, young people distrust all forms of government.
increasingly.zh: 年轻人越来越不相信任何形式的政府。

incredible.en: There was blood everywhere and the pain was incredible.
incredible.zh: 到处都是血，疼得难以忍受。

incredibly.zh: 尼古丁很容易让人上瘾。

incredibly.en: The knife had pierced his heart, but incredibly he was still alive.
incredibly.zh: 刀插入了他的心脏，但他还活着，真令人难以置信。

incredulous.en: She shot him an incredulous look.
incredulous.zh: 她满腹狐疑地瞪了他一眼。

incubate.en: Hepatitis has a long incubation period.

incur.en: If the council loses the appeal, it will incur all the legal costs.
incur.zh: 如果委员会败诉，将承担所有诉讼费用。

incur.en: She wondered what she’d done to incur his displeasure this time.
incur.zh: 她奇怪她这次做了什么引起他的不悦。

incursion.en: The media was criticized for its thoughtless incursion into the domestic grief of the family.
incursion.zh: 媒体因不顾他人感受介入该家庭的不幸事件而遭到批评。

indebted.en: We are deeply indebted to Dr Allen.
indebted.zh: 我们非常感谢阿利安博士。

indeed.en: The blood tests prove that Vince is indeed the father.
indeed.zh: 验血证明文斯确实是父亲。

indeed.en: I didn’t mind at all. Indeed, I was pleased.
indeed.zh: 我一点也不介意，事实上我非常高兴。

indefinite.en: The next day the union voted to begin an indefinite strike.
indefinite.zh: 第二天工会投票表决决定开始无限期罢工。

indefinite.en: The picture has been loaned for an indefinite period to the National Gallery.
indefinite.zh: 那幅画长期出借给国家美术馆。

indefinitely.en: The project has been postponed indefinitely.
indefinitely.zh: 这项工程被无限期延期。

indelible.en: Her words left an indelible impression on me for years to come.
indelible.zh: 她的话多年来我都难以忘怀。

indent.en: Use the Tab key to indent the first line of the paragraph.
indent.zh: 用跳格键把该段的首行缩格。

indent.en: He cancelled the indent for silk scarves.
indent.zh: 他取消了真丝围巾的订单。

independence.en: Nigeria gained independence from Britain in 1960.
The country has made great advances since independence.
independence.zh: 该国自独立以来发展迅速。

index.en: The changing size of an infant’s head is considered an index of brain growth.
index.zh: 婴儿头围不断变大标志着大脑在发育。

index.en: The reports are indexed by subject and location.
index.zh: 报告按主题和位置编索引。

indian.en: Do you fancy going out for an Indian?

indicate.en: Research indicates that over 81% of teachers are dissatisfied with their salary.
Long skid marks on the pavement indicated the driver had attempted to brake.
indicate.zh: 人行道上长长的滑行痕迹表明司机曾试图车。

indication.en: Dark green leaves are a good indication of healthy roots.
indication.zh: 深绿色的树叶充分表明树根长势良好。

indication.en: He gave no indication at all of his own feelings.
indication.zh: 他一点也没有显露自己的感情。

indicative.en: This behaviour is indicative of her whole attitude, I’m afraid.
indicative.zh: 这一行为恐怕已表明了她的总体态度。

indicator.en: All the main economic indicators suggest that trade is improving.
indicator.zh: 所有主要的经济指标都表明贸易情况正在改善。

indifference.en: Whether you stay or leave is a matter of total indifference to me (=I do not care).
indifference.zh: 你是留是走我根本无所谓。

indifferent.en: Sarah was absolutely indifferent to him, and it hurt.
indifferent.zh: 萨拉对他漠不关心，这令他伤心。

indignant.en: Liz was indignant at the way her child had been treated.
indignant.zh: 利兹对自己孩子受到的待遇非常气愤。

indignation.en: To his indignation, Charles found that his name was not on the list.
indignation.zh: 查尔斯发现他的名字没有出现在名单上，这让他深感愤慨。
洛乌气得说话声都颤抖了。

indirect.en: Losing weight is an indirect result of smoking cigarettes.
indirect.zh: 吸烟间接导致体重减轻。

indirect.en: The indirect effects of climate change may be profound.
indirect.zh: 气候变化造成的间接影响可能是深远的。

indiscernible.en: The path was almost indiscernible in the mist.

indispensable.en: This book is indispensable to anyone interested in space exploration.
indispensable.zh: 本书是任何对太空探险感兴趣的人必读的。

indispensable.en: Meat is not indispensable for maintaining a healthy diet.
indispensable.zh: 要想健康饮食，肉食并不是不可或缺的。

individual.en: Each individual leaf on the tree is different.
individual.zh: 树上每片叶子都不相同。

individual.en: Children get more individual attention in small classes.
individual.zh: 小班上课的孩子得到较多的个别关注。

individualism.zh: 资本主义鼓励竞争，提倡个人主义。

individuality.en: We like our staff to show their individuality rather than wear a uniform.
individuality.zh: 我们喜欢员工穿出个性，而不是穿制服。

individually.en: The bridegroom thanked them all individually.

indoor.en: Too much central heating can harm indoor plants.
indoor.zh: 中央供暖系统温度太高对室内植物有害。

indoors.en: Let’s go indoors and have something to eat.
It rained all day so we had to stay indoors.
indoors.zh: 雨下了整整一天，我们只好留在屋里。

induce.en: Nothing would induce me to vote for him again.
induce.zh: 没有什么能诱使我再投他的票了。

induce.en: She had to be induced because the baby was four weeks late.
induce.zh: 她的孩子晚了四星期仍未出生，因此要给她引产。

inducement.en: Businesses were offered inducements to move to the area.
inducement.zh: 企业被吸引搬迁到该地区。

induct.en: Eighteen new junior ministers were inducted into the government.
Barry was inducted into the Basketball Hall of Fame in 1987.

induction.en: Mrs Simpson is responsible for the induction of new library staff.
induction.zh: 辛普森太太负责图书馆新职员的入职培训。

indulge.en: Most of us were too busy to indulge in heavy lunchtime drinking.
indulge.zh: 我们大多数人都忙得不能在午饭时尽情饮酒。

indulge.en: Eva had never been one to indulge in self-pity.
indulge.zh: 伊娃从不是那种沉湎于自怜自哀的人。

industrial.en: Industrial production has risen by 0.5% since November.
Last year 1.3 million workers took part in industrial disputes.

industry.en: This type of software is widely used in industry.
industry.zh: 这种软件广泛应用于工业。

industry.en: I work in the oil industry.

inedible.en: The meat was so burnt that it was inedible.
inedible.zh: 肉烧得那么焦，不能吃了。

ineffective.en: The chemical was almost totally ineffective in killing the weeds.
ineffective.zh: 这种化学品除杂草几乎一点用也没有。

ineffective.en: Various drugs have proved ineffective against the virus.
ineffective.zh: 许多药物经证明都对这种病毒无效。

inept.en: He was criticized for his inept handling of the problem.
inept.zh: 他因处理这个问题不力而遭到批评。

inept.en: Blake was intellectually able but politically inept.
inept.zh: 布莱克头脑很聪明，但在政治上却十分愚钝。

inequality.en: There are inequalities in wealth distribution.

inert.en: He lay, inert, in his bed.
inert.zh: 他一动不动地躺在床上。

inert.en: The government was inert and inefficient.
inert.zh: 政府毫无活力，效率低下。

inevitable.en: A further escalation of the crisis now seems inevitable.
inevitable.zh: 危机的进一步升级现在看来已不可避免。

inevitable.en: It’s inevitable that doctors will make the occasional mistake.
inevitable.zh: 医生偶尔犯错是难免的。

inevitably.en: The decision will inevitably lead to political tensions.
inevitably.zh: 该决定必然导致政治局势的紧张。

inevitably.en: Inevitably, the situation did not please everyone.
inevitably.zh: 这种状况必定不能让所有人都感到满意。

inexpensive.en: Painting is a relatively inexpensive way to enhance your home.
inexpensive.zh: 粉刷是美化居室的一种相对较便宜的方式。

inexplicable.en: For some inexplicable reason, he felt depressed.

inextricably.en: Physical health is inextricably linked to mental health.
inextricably.zh: 身体健康和精神健康有着密不可分的联系。

inextricably.en: Economic and social history are inextricably bound up with each other.
inextricably.zh: 经济发展史和社会发展史紧密相关。

infancy.en: In the past, many children died in infancy.
infancy.zh: 过去很多孩子尚在襁褓之中便夭折了。

infancy.en: Genetic engineering is still in its infancy.
infancy.zh: 基因工程学仍处于起步阶段。

infant.en: An infant’s skin is very sensitive.

infect.en: People with the virus may feel perfectly well, but they can still infect others.
infect.zh: 带有这种病毒的人可能毫无症状，却仍可能传染他人。

infect.en: Eggs known to be infected with salmonella were allowed to go on sale.
infect.zh: 已知带有沙门氏菌的鸡蛋被允许销售。

infection.en: The baby had an ear infection.
Always sterilize the needle to prevent infection.
infection.zh: 注射针头每次都要消毒，以防感染。

infer.en: A lot can be inferred from these statistics.
infer.zh: 根据这些统计资料可以推断出很多事情。

infer.en: From the evidence, we can infer that the victim knew her killer.
infer.zh: 根据证据我们可以推断出受害者认识凶手。

inference.en: What inferences have you drawn from this evidence?
inference.zh: 你从这个证据中推论出了什么结果？

inference.en: He was portrayed as a hero and, by inference, Thompson as the villain.
inference.zh: 他被描写成英雄，由此推论，汤普森则成了恶棍。

inferior.en: I felt very inferior among all those academics.
inferior.zh: 与那些大学教师在一起，我自惭形秽。

inferior.en: I always felt slightly inferior to her.
inferior.zh: 我总感觉比她稍逊一筹。

inferiority.en: He had a deep-rooted feeling of inferiority.
inferiority.zh: 他有一种根深蒂固的自卑感。

infernal.en: I wish the children would stop that infernal noise.
infernal.zh: 我真希望孩子们别再那么吵闹了。

infest.en: The kitchen was infested with cockroaches.

infinite.en: There was an infinite variety of drinks to choose from.
infinite.zh: 有各种各样的饮料可以选择。

infinitely.en: This school is infinitely better than the last one I went to.
infinitely.zh: 这所学校比我之前上的那一所好太多了。

infinity.en: In the equation below, as E goes to zero, n approaches infinity.
There is an infinity of possible solutions.
infinity.zh: 有无数可行的解决方法。

inflate.en: It took us half an hour to inflate the dinghy.
inflate.zh: 我们用了半小时给橡皮筏充好气。

inflate.en: Her life jacket failed to inflate.
inflate.zh: 她的救生衣未能充进去气。

inflation.en: France had achieved low inflation and steady growth.
inflation.zh: 法国实现了低通胀率和经济稳定增长。

inflexible.en: This approach is too inflexible and too costly.
inflexible.zh: 这个方法太死板，而且花费也太高。

inflict.en: The strikes inflicted serious damage on the economy.
inflict.zh: 罢工给经济造成了巨大损失。

inflict.en: Detectives warned that the men could inflict serious injury.
inflict.zh: 警探提醒说这些人可能会造成严重伤害。

influence.en: As a scientist, his influence was immense.
influence.zh: 身为一名科学家，他的影响力极大。

influence.en: Gayle’s mother said I was a bad influence on her daughter.
influence.zh: 盖尔的母亲说我对她女儿产生了坏影响。

influential.zh: 他有一些有影响力的朋友。

influential.en: Dewey was influential in shaping economic policy.
influential.zh: 杜威对制定经济政策有影响力。

inform.en: They decided to inform the police
Please inform us of any change of address as soon as possible.
inform.zh: 地址如有变更，请尽早通知我们。

informal.en: The atmosphere at work is fairly informal.
The two groups met for informal talks.
informal.zh: 两个团体会面举行非正式会谈。

informant.en: One of the witnesses was a paid informant for the FBI.
informant.zh: 目击者之一是联邦调查局出钱雇用的线人。

information.en: We have received information that Grant may have left the country.
information.zh: 我们得到消息，格兰特可能已经离开了这个国家。

infrastructure.en: Some countries lack a suitable economic infrastructure.
infrastructure.zh: 一些国家缺乏适当的经济基础设施。

infrequent.en: They would make infrequent visits to the house.
infrequent.zh: 他们偶尔去看一看那所房子。

infrequently.en: Jeremy does play cricket, but very infrequently.
infrequently.zh: 杰里米确实玩板球，但次数很少。

infrequently.en: The censors changed some names and dialogue and, not infrequently, banned controversial films.
infrequently.zh: 审查官对电影里的一些名字和对话进行修改，并常常禁止有争议的电影发行。

infringe.en: A backup copy of a computer program does not infringe copyright.
infringe.zh: 计算机程序的备份不侵犯版权。

infringe.en: Some students argued that the rule infringed on their right to free speech.
infringe.zh: 一些学生争辩说，这一规定侵犯了他们言论自由的权利。

infusion.en: Further education badly needs the infusion of more resources.
infusion.zh: 进修教育非常需要更多资源的注入。

ingenious.en: Many fish have ingenious ways of protecting their eggs from predators.
ingenious.zh: 很多鱼都有绝妙的方法来保护它们产的卵不被捕食者吃掉。

ingredient.en: Combine all the ingredients in a large bowl.
ingredient.zh: 把所有食材都放在一个大碗里。

ingredient.en: The food is home-cooked using fresh ingredients.
ingredient.zh: 这种食物是用新鲜的食材在家里烹制的。

inhabit.en: The woods are inhabited by many wild animals.
inhabit.zh: 很多野生动物栖居在这片森林里。

inhabit.en: Millions of people live in these shantytowns.
inhabit.zh: 数百万人居住在这些贫民区内。

inhale.en: It is dangerous to inhale ammonia fumes.
Myra lit another cigarette and inhaled deeply (=breathed in a lot of smoke).
inhale.zh: 迈拉又点上一支烟，深深地吸了一口。
