inherent.en: I’m afraid the problems you mention are inherent in the system.
inherent.zh: 你提及的这些问题恐怕本来就存在于这个体制中。

inherent.en: Every business has its own inherent risks.
inherent.zh: 每笔生意本身都有风险。

inherit.en: He inherited a fortune from his grandmother.
inherit.zh: 他从祖母那儿继承了一大笔财产。

inherit.en: The present government inherited a closed, state-dominated economy.
inherit.zh: 现任政府接手了一个封闭的、由政府主导的经济制度。

inheritance.en: Lucinda has to fight for her life and her inheritance in this gripping novel.
inheritance.zh: 在这部扣人心弦的小说里，露辛达不得不为自己的生命与所继承的遗产进行抗争。

inheritance.en: Our genetic inheritance cannot be changed.
inheritance.zh: 我们的基因遗传特征是无法改变的。

inhibit.en: An unhappy family life may inhibit children’s learning.
inhibit.zh: 不幸福的家庭生活可能会阻碍儿童的学习。

inhibit.en: Recording the meeting may inhibit people from expressing their real views.
inhibit.zh: 对会议进行录音记录可能会使人们不敢表达他们的真实想法。

inhibition.en: She had no inhibitions about saying what she felt.
inhibition.zh: 她毫不顾忌地说出自己的感觉。

inhibition.en: People tend to lose their inhibitions when they’ve drunk a lot of alcohol.
inhibition.zh: 人们在喝多了酒之后往往会无所顾忌。

inhospitable.en: He trekked across some of the most inhospitable terrain in the world.
inhospitable.zh: 他长途跋涉，穿越了世界上一些最荒凉的地带。

inhospitable.en: Some governments are inhospitable to aid workers.
inhospitable.zh: 有些政府不欢迎救援人员。

initial.en: The initial response has been encouraging.
initial.zh: 最初的反应情况很乐观。

initial.en: His initials are DPH: they stand for David Perry Hallworth.
initial.zh: 他姓名的首字母是 DPH

initially.en: Stan initially wanted to go to medical school.
Initially, I thought I would only stay there a year.
initially.zh: 起初，我以为我只会在那儿待一年。

initiate.en: They have decided to initiate legal proceedings against the newspaper.
initiate.zh: 他们决定向该报提起法律诉讼。

initiate.en: Intellectuals have initiated a debate on terrorism.
initiate.zh: 知识分子就恐怖主义发起了辩论。

initiation.en: The club has an initiation ceremony for new members.
initiation.zh: 该俱乐部会为新成员举行入会仪式。

initiative.en: I wish my son would show more initiative.
initiative.zh: 我希望我的儿子能表现得再主动一些。

initiative.en: Don’t keep asking me for advice. Use your initiative.
initiative.zh: 别老是要我给你出主意，发挥一下你自己的决断能力吧。

inject.en: The drug is injected directly into the base of the spine.
inject.zh: 药物被直接注射入脊柱末端。

inject.en: I have to inject myself with insulin.
inject.zh: 我必须给自己注射胰岛素。

injection.en: The nurse gave me a tetanus injection.
injection.zh: 护士给我打了破伤风预防针。

injure.en: Angus injured his leg playing rugby.
injure.zh: 安格斯在打橄榄球时弄伤了腿。

injure.en: Two people have been critically injured in an accident.
injure.zh: 在一次事故中，有两个人身受重伤。

injury.en: She was taken to hospital with serious head injuries.
injury.zh: 她头部受重伤被送到医院。

injury.en: The driver of the truck suffered injuries to his legs and arms.
injury.zh: 卡车司机的腿和手臂受了伤。

injustice.en: The movie deals with injustices suffered by Native Americans.
injustice.zh: 这部电影讲述印第安人受到的不公正待遇。

injustice.en: He had developed a deep sense of social injustice.
injustice.zh: 他深深感到社会的不公。

ink.en: The two companies have inked a deal.
ink.zh: 这两家公司签署了一项协议。

inland.en: The mountains are five miles inland.
inland.zh: 这些山位于内陆五英里处。

inlet.en: There are several sheltered inlets along the coast.
inlet.zh: 沿着海岸线有几处有天然屏障的水湾。

inn.en: We’re staying at the Holiday Inn.

innate.en: Children have an innate ability to learn language.
innate.zh: 儿童学习语言的能力是与生俱来的。

inner.en: Yoga gives me a sense of inner calm.
inner.zh: 练习瑜伽使我感到内心平和。

inner.en: She’ll need great inner strength to get over the tragedy.
inner.zh: 她需要强大的精神力量来摆脱这一不幸带来的痛苦。

innocence.en: The prisoners continued to protest their innocence.
innocence.zh: 犯人们一再申明他们无罪。

innocent.en: Nobody would believe that I was innocent.
innocent.zh: 没人肯相信我是清白的。

innocuous.en: He’s a perfectly innocuous young man.
innocuous.zh: 他是个毫无恶意的年轻人。

innovate.en: The company has successfully innovated new products and services.
innovate.zh: 公司成功地创出了新产品和服务。

innovation.en: We must encourage innovation if the company is to remain competitive.
innovation.zh: 公司要想保持竞争力，就必须鼓励革新。

innovation.en: We need to encourage innovation in industry.
innovation.zh: 我们需要鼓励工业创新。

innumerable.zh: 她在多个委员会担任委员。

inoffensive.en: Her husband was a small, inoffensive-looking man.
inoffensive.zh: 她丈夫个子不高，看上去很随和。

input.en: If the input data specified it, the file will close and the process terminates.
input.zh: 如果输入数据指定，该文件就会关闭，数据处理终止。

input.en: Farmers contributed most of the input into the survey.
input.zh: 这次调查收集的意见大都是农场主提供的。

inquire.en: I am writing to inquire about your advertisement in ‘The Times’.
inquire.zh: 贵方在《泰晤士报》刊登广告，特此致函问询。

inquire.en: The waiter inquired whether we would like to sit near the window.
inquire.zh: 侍者问我们是否想靠窗坐。

inquiry.en: We’re getting a lot of inquiries about our new London–Rio service.
inquiry.zh: 许多人来打听我们新开设的伦敦－里约热内卢的航班情况。

inquiry.en: I don’t know who sent the gift, but I’ll make some inquiries.
inquiry.zh: 我不知道礼物是谁送的，但我会打听一下。

inquisitive.en: I’d have asked more questions, but I didn’t want to seem inquisitive.
inquisitive.zh: 我本想问更多的问题，但我不想看上去那么爱打听。

inquisitive.en: He peeped inquisitively into the drawer.
inquisitive.zh: 他好奇地往抽屉里窥视。

insane.en: The whole idea sounds absolutely insane to me.
insane.zh: 整个主意在我看来荒谬至极。

insanity.en: The court acquitted Campbell on the grounds of temporary insanity.
insanity.zh: 法庭以坎贝尔一时精神错乱为由判他无罪释放。

insanity.en: Can’t they see the insanity of dumping radioactive waste in the sea?
insanity.zh: 难道他们看不出把放射性废弃物倾倒进海里是十分愚蠢的行为吗？

inscribe.en: Inside the cover someone had inscribed the words ‘To Thomas, with love’.
inscribe.zh: 在书的内封上，有人题写了“

inscribe.en: The team’s name is inscribed on the base of the trophy.
inscribe.zh: 球队的名字刻在奖杯的底座上。

insect.en: Don’t forget to bring insect repellent (=a chemical to keep insects away).

insecure.en: She’s very insecure about her appearance.
insecure.zh: 她对自己的外表很不自信。

insecure.en: She felt lonely and insecure away from her family.
insecure.zh: 远离家人使她觉得孤独，没有安全感。

insert.en: His hand shook slightly as he inserted the key into the lock.
insert.zh: 他把钥匙插进锁里，手微微颤抖。

insert.en: His manager inserted a new clause into his contract.
insert.zh: 经理把一项新的条款加进他的合同里。

inshore.en: The fishing boats usually stay close inshore.
inshore.zh: 渔船通常停留在近岸海域。

inside.en: The jewels were locked away inside the safe.
I sent the money inside an envelope addressed to Ann.
inside.zh: 我把钱装在写有安的名字和地址的信封内寄出。

insight.en: The article gives us a real insight into the causes of the present economic crisis.
insight.zh: 这篇文章分析了目前经济危机的原因，发人深省。

insight.en: The research provides new insights into the way we process language.
insight.zh: 该研究对我们处理语言的方式提出了新的深刻见解。

insignificant.en: You realize that your problems are insignificant in comparison.
insignificant.zh: 要知道，你的问题相对来说微不足道。

insist.en: Mike insisted that he was right.
insist.zh: 迈克坚决认为自己是对的。

insist.en: His friends insisted he had no connection with drugs.
insist.zh: 他的朋友坚持说他和毒品无关。

insistence.en: At her father’s insistence, she joined them for a drink.
insistence.zh: 在父亲的坚持下，她和他们一起喝了一杯。

insistent.en: She was insistent that they should all meet for dinner.
insistent.zh: 她坚持要大家聚在一起吃晚餐。

insistent.en: They were insistent on good manners.
insistent.zh: 他们坚持举止要有礼貌。

insolvent.en: The company was later declared insolvent (=officially said to be insolvent).

inspect.en: I got out of the car to inspect the damage.
Police inspected the scene and interviewed all the staff.
inspect.zh: 警察仔细检查了现场并询问了所有员工。

inspection.en: An inspection was carried out at the school.
inspection.zh: 有人来学校视察了一遍。

inspection.en: Copies of the documents are available for inspection (=people can look at them) at local libraries.
inspection.zh: 当地图书馆里有文件可供查阅。

inspector.en: Standards of discipline at the school were strongly criticized in the inspector’s report.
inspector.zh: 督察员在报告里狠狠地批评了这所学校的纪律水准。

inspiration.en: The Malvern Hills have provided inspiration for many artists and musicians over the decades.
inspiration.zh: 几十年来，莫尔文丘陵为很多艺术家和音乐家提供了灵感。

inspiration.en: He raised his eyes to the altar as if seeking inspiration.
inspiration.zh: 他抬头看看祭坛，似乎在寻求灵感。

inspirational.en: Jones proved an inspirational figure in Welsh rugby.
inspirational.zh: 事实证明，琼斯是威尔士橄榄球运动中有感召力的人物。

inspire.en: We need someone who can inspire the team.
inspire.zh: 我们需要一个能鼓舞团队士气的人。

inspire.en: He inspired many young people to take up the sport.
inspire.zh: 他激励了很多年轻人参与这项运动。

inspiring.en: King was a great orator and an inspiring leader.
inspiring.zh: 金是伟大的演说家和鼓舞人心的领袖。

install.en: They’ve installed the new computer network at last.
install.zh: 他们终于安装了新电脑网络。

install.en: Security cameras have been installed in the city centre.
install.zh: 在市中心已安装了一些监控摄像机。

installation.en: The whole computer installation was nearly new.
installation.zh: 整套电脑设备几乎是全新的。

instalment.en: They’re letting me pay for the washing machine by monthly instalments.
instalment.zh: 他们允许我以每月分期付款的方式买下这台洗衣机。

instance.en: We need to rethink the way we consume energy. Take, for instance, our approach to transport.
instance.zh: 我们需要重新考虑我们使用能源的方式，例如我们的运输方式。

instance.en: They came across many instances of discrimination.
instance.zh: 他们遇到很多歧视的事例。

instant.en: The women took an instant dislike to one another.
instant.zh: 这些女人立刻就彼此厌恶起来。

instant.en: The programme brought an instant response.

instantly.zh: 四名受害人全部当即死亡。

instead.en: You probably picked up my keys instead of yours.
instead.zh: 你可能没拿你的钥匙而错拿了我的。

instead.en: Could I have tuna instead of ham?
instead.zh: 我可否要金枪鱼来代替火腿？

instigate.en: Charles instigated a programme of reforms.
He accused union leaders of instigating the disturbances.
instigate.zh: 他指责工会领导人煽动骚乱。

instinct.en: Animals have a natural instinct for survival.
instinct.zh: 动物有求生的自然本能。

institute.en: We had no choice but to institute court proceedings against the airline.
institute.zh: 我们别无选择，只能对航空公司提起诉讼。

institution.en: The scandal threatened to undermine the institution of the presidency.
I was determined not to put my mother in an institution.
institution.zh: 我决意不送母亲去养老院。

instruct.en: His secretary was instructed to cancel all his engagements.
instruct.zh: 他的秘书接到通知，取消他所有的预约。

instruct.en: The judge immediately instructed that Beattie be released.
instruct.zh: 法官立即宣布释放贝蒂。

instruction.en: Press ‘Enter’ and follow the on-screen instructions.
instruction.zh: 按回车键，然后按照电脑屏幕上的指示来操作。

instruction.en: Both products come with instructions for use.
instruction.zh: 两个产品都附有使用指南。

instructive.en: Thank you, that was very instructive.

instrument.en: Interest rates are an important instrument of economic policy.
instrument.zh: 利率是经济政策的重要调控手段。

instrument.en: Good management should be an instrument for innovation.
instrument.zh: 良好的管理应当是创新所必需的手段。

instrumental.en: He was instrumental in developing links with European organizations.
instrumental.zh: 他在建立与欧洲各组织之间的联系中起了重要作用。

insufficient.en: Insufficient resources have been devoted to the health service.
insufficient.zh: 用于医疗保健服务的资源不足。

insufficient.en: His salary was insufficient for their needs.
insufficient.zh: 他的薪水不足以满足他们的需求。

insulate.en: Pipes may need insulating against the cold.
insulate.zh: 管道可能需要隔温以防冰冻。

insulate.en: The royal family tried to insulate him from the prying eyes of the media.
insulate.zh: 王室想使他避开媒体窥视的目光。

insulation.en: Good insulation can save you money on heating bills.
insulation.zh: 好的隔热效果能节省暖气费。

insult.en: Nobody insults my family and gets away with it!
insult.zh: 谁也别想侮辱了我的家人之后就这么算了！

insult.en: I hope Andy won’t be insulted if I don’t come.
insult.zh: 如果我不来，希望安迪不要介意。

insurance.en: Your father took out insurance to cover the mortgage.
insurance.zh: 你父亲购买了抵押借款保险。

insurance.en: Do you have insurance on your house and its contents?
insurance.zh: 你买住房和家庭财产险了吗？

insure.en: Have you insured the contents of your home?
insure.zh: 你给家庭财产投保了吗？

insure.en: It is wise to insure your property against storm damage.
insure.zh: 为防风暴造成损毁而给财产买保险是明智之举。

insurmountable.en: The language difference proved an insurmountable barrier.
insurmountable.zh: 语言差异是难以克服的障碍。

intact.en: Only the medieval tower had remained intact.
intact.zh: 只有这座中世纪塔楼保存完好。
他的声望丝毫未受影响。

intake.en: Try to reduce your intake of fat.
intake.zh: 尽量减少脂肪的摄入量。

intake.en: Sickness may develop from inadequate fluid intake.
intake.zh: 液体摄入不足会诱发疾病。

intangible.en: The island has an intangible quality of holiness.
intangible.zh: 该岛屿有一种难以形容的神圣感。

integral.en: Vegetables are an integral part of our diet.
integral.zh: 蔬菜是我们膳食中不可缺少的一部分。

integral.en: Statistics are integral to medical research.
integral.zh: 统计数字是医学研究中不可或缺的。

integrate.en: Colourful illustrations are integrated into the text.
Transport planning should be integrated with energy policy.
integrate.zh: 运输计划应与能源政策结合起来。

integration.en: The family unit is supported by its integration into a wider social network.
integration.zh: 这个家庭由于融入更广阔的社会关系网而得到帮助。

intellect.en: He combined a formidable intellect with a talent for speaking.
intellect.zh: 他不但智力超群，而且口才出众。

intelligence.en: To be good at the game, you need a reasonable level of intelligence.
intelligence.zh: 要想把这种游戏玩好，需要一定的智力水平。

intelligence.en: John showed high intelligence from an early age.
intelligence.zh: 约翰很早就显现出高智力。

intelligent.en: Sontag was once famously described as the most intelligent woman in America.
intelligent.zh: 桑塔格曾被称为美国最聪明的女人，这是众人皆知的事。

intelligent.en: You can’t have an intelligent conversation with him.
intelligent.zh: 你不可能和他进行有见地的谈话。

intelligible.zh: 他的回复几乎让人听不懂。

intelligible.en: The report needs to be intelligible to the client.

intend.en: I intend to spend the night there.
I didn’t intend her to see the painting until it was finished.
intend.zh: 我不打算在画没完成时就让她看。

intense.en: Young people today are under intense pressure to succeed.
intense.zh: 如今的年轻人面临要出人头地的巨大压力。

intense.en: The pain was so intense I couldn’t sleep.

intensify.en: In June the civil war intensified.
His mother’s death intensified his loneliness.
intensify.zh: 母亲的过世使他感到更加孤单。

intensity.en: The intensity of the hurricane was frightening.
intensity.zh: 飓风的猛烈程度令人恐惧。

intent.en: She was intent on pursuing a career in business.
intent.zh: 她决意要在商界谋求一职。

intent.en: Intent upon her work, she didn’t notice the cold.
intent.zh: 她专注于工作，忘记了寒冷。

intention.en: I have no intention of retiring just yet.
They went into town with the intention of visiting the library.
intention.zh: 他们进了城，打算参观图书馆。

intentional.en: I did trip him, but it wasn’t intentional.
intentional.zh: 我的确把他绊倒了，但不是故意的。

interact.en: Lucy interacts well with other children in the class.
interact.zh: 露西和班里的其他孩子相处得很好。

interact.en: The immune system interacts with both the nervous system and the hormones.
interact.zh: 免疫系统与神经系统及激素相互影响。

interaction.en: Price is determined through the interaction of demand and supply.
interaction.zh: 价格是通过供需消长而定的。

interchangeable.en: These two words are almost interchangeable.
interchangeable.zh: 这两个单词几乎可以互换使用。

interconnect.en: Our operating system can now interconnect with other networks.
interconnect.zh: 我们的操作系统现在能和其他网络相连。

interconnect.en: In Freud’s theory, the two areas of sexuality and violence are interconnected.
interconnect.zh: 按照弗洛伊德的理论，性和暴力这两个方面是相互关联的。

interest.en: My parents encouraged my interest in science.
interest.zh: 父母激励了我在自然科学方面的兴趣。

interest.en: I’d recommend this book to anyone who has an interest in jazz.
interest.zh: 我向所有喜欢爵士乐的人推荐这本书。

interested.en: I’ve always been interested in music.
All she’s interested in is clothes.

interesting.en: I found his talk very interesting.
interesting.zh: 我觉得他的讲话很引人入胜。

interestingly.en: Interestingly, none of their three children ever married.
interestingly.zh: 有趣的是，他们的三个孩子都一直没有结婚。

interestingly.en: Interestingly enough, Pearson made no attempt to deny the rumour.
interestingly.zh: 很有趣的是，皮尔逊没有试图否认谣传。

interface.en: The book deals with the interface between accountancy and law.
interface.zh: 本书论及会计工作和法律的关系。

interfere.en: My daughter-in-law said that I was interfering, but I was only trying to help.
interfere.zh: 我的儿媳说我多管闲事，但我只是想帮忙。

interfere.en: It’s not the church’s job to interfere in politics.
interfere.zh: 干预政治不是教会应做的事。

interference.en: I resent his interference in my work.
interference.zh: 我讨厌他干预我的工作。

interference.en: Industrial relations should be free from state interference.
interference.zh: 劳资关系应不受政府干预。

interim.en: He received an interim payment of £10,000.
interim.zh: 他收到暂时支付的一万英镑。

interior.en: The interior of the church was dark.
The interior of the country is mainly desert.
interior.zh: 这个国家的内陆地带主要是沙漠。

intermediary.en: Jackson acted as an intermediary between the two parties.
intermediary.zh: 杰克逊充当双方的调解人。

intermittent.en: The weather forecast is for sun, with intermittent showers.

internal.en: We have no interest in interfering in the internal affairs of other countries.
internal.zh: 我们对干涉其他国家内政不感兴趣。

internal.en: There’s to be an internal inquiry into the whole affair.
internal.zh: 对整个事件将进行内部调查。

internationally.en: These days businesses have to be able to compete internationally.
internationally.zh: 如今，企业必须要有实力参与国际竞争。

internet.en: Do you have access to the Internet?
You can find all kinds of information on the internet.
internet.zh: 在因特网上你可以找到各种信息。

interpret.en: They spoke good Spanish, and promised to interpret for me.
interpret.zh: 他们西班牙语说得很好，答应替我翻译。

interpret.en: His refusal to work late was interpreted as a lack of commitment to the company.
interpret.zh: 他拒绝加班被认为是对公司缺少奉献精神。

interpretation.en: One possible interpretation is that they want you to resign.
interpretation.zh: 一种可能的解释是，他们想要你辞职。

interpretation.en: It’s difficult to put an accurate interpretation on (=explain) the survey results.
interpretation.zh: 对调查结果难以作出确切的解释。

interpreter.en: Speaking through an interpreter (=using an interpreter), Ahmed said, ‘I’m very worried about my wife and children.’
interpreter.zh: 艾哈迈德通过口译者说:“

interrogate.en: The police interrogated the suspect for several hours.
interrogate.zh: 警察盘问了这名嫌疑犯好几个小时。

interrogate.en: He refused to tell his interrogators anything.
interrogate.zh: 他拒绝向审问者透露任何信息。

interrupt.en: Sorry to interrupt, but I need to ask you to come downstairs.
interrupt.zh: 很抱歉打扰了，我得请你下楼来。

intersect.en: The plain is intersected by a network of canals.
intersect.zh: 这个平原布满纵横交错的运河。

intertwine.en: The problems of crime and unemployment are closely intertwined.
intertwine.zh: 犯罪问题与失业问题密切相关。

interval.en: He left the room, returning after a short interval with a message.
interval.zh: 他离开房间，过了一会儿就带回来一条消息。

interval.en: The interval between arrest and trial can be up to six months.
interval.zh: 从逮捕到审判之间的间隔时间可达六个月。

intervene.en: The police don’t usually like to intervene in disputes between husbands and wives.
intervene.zh: 警方通常不愿意介入夫妻之间的争吵。

intervene.en: The army will have to intervene to prevent further fighting.
intervene.zh: 军队将不得不干预以阻止进一步的战斗。

interview.en: Elton John gave an interview to Barbara Walters (=he answered her questions).
She has an interview next week for a teaching job in Paris.
interview.zh: 下周她要参加巴黎一份教职的面试。

intimacy.en: She thought back over the intimacies they’d shared and the plans they’d made.
intimacy.zh: 她回想起他们之间曾经有过的亲密言行以及他们设想的计划。

intimate.en: The collection has been moved from its intimate setting to the British Museum.
intimate.zh: 这些收藏品已从私人藏处移到了大英博物馆。

intimate.en: She’s on intimate terms with people in government.
intimate.zh: 她与政府官员关系密切。

intimation.en: Without early intimation of the dates of the training sessions, enthusiasm for training could decrease.
intimation.zh: 如果不提早通知训练班的开班日期，人们对培训的热情可能会减弱。

intimidate.en: They tried to intimidate the young people into voting for them.
intimidate.zh: 他们试图胁迫年轻人投票给他们。

into.en: He thrust his hand into his coat pocket.
into.zh: 他把手插进大衣口袋里。

intolerant.en: A number of patients were intolerant of the diet.
intolerant.zh: 有些病人对这些食物过敏。

intolerant.en: She’s lactose-intolerant (=unable to drink particular types of milk).

intransigent.en: He accused the government of intransigence.

intrigue.en: Other people’s houses always intrigued her.
intrigue.zh: 别人的房子总令她好奇。

intrigue.en: While King Richard was abroad, the barons had been intriguing against him.
intrigue.zh: 理查王在国外时，贵族们一直在密谋反对他。

intrinsic.en: There is nothing in the intrinsic nature of the work that makes it more suitable for women.
intrinsic.zh: 这项工作本质上并没有什么使得它更适合女性来做。

intrinsic.en: Flexibility is intrinsic to creative management.
intrinsic.zh: 灵活变通是创新管理的基本特质。

introduce.en: Have you two been introduced? Tom, this is Greg.
introduce.zh: 有人给你们俩互相介绍了吗？汤姆，这位是格雷格。

introduce.en: June, let me introduce you to Bob.
introduce.zh: 琼，我来把你介绍给鲍勃。

introduction.en: With the introduction of independent taxation, a married woman’s position is much clearer.
introduction.zh: 独立税收制度的推行使已婚妇女的地位更为明晰。

introductory.zh: 不要错过我们的试销优惠！

intrude.en: Would I be intruding if I came with you?
intrude.zh: 我要是和你一起去，会不会打扰你？

intrude.en: Employers should not intrude into the private lives of their employees.
intrude.zh: 雇主不应干涉雇员的私生活。

intruder.en: The police think the intruder got in through an unlocked window.
intruder.zh: 警察认为闯入者是从一扇没上锁的窗子进入的。

intruder.en: At first I felt like an intruder in their family.
intruder.zh: 起初我觉得自己是他们家的不速之客。

intrusion.en: I resented this intrusion into my domestic affairs.
intrusion.zh: 我讨厌这种干涉我家事的行为。

intuition.en: Intuition told her it was unwise to argue.
intuition.zh: 直觉告诉她争吵是不理智的。

intuition.en: He had an intuition there was trouble brewing.
intuition.zh: 他凭直觉感到要有麻烦了。

intuitive.en: He seemed to have an intuitive awareness of how I felt.
intuitive.zh: 他好像凭直觉就知道我的感受。

inundate.en: After the broadcast, we were inundated with requests for more information.
inundate.zh: 节目播出之后，太多人来询问详情，令我们应接不暇。

inundate.en: The tidal wave inundated vast areas of cropland.

invade.en: The Romans invaded Britain 2,000 years ago.
Every summer, the town is invaded by tourists.
invade.zh: 每年夏天，大量游客涌入这个小镇。

invalid.en: Without the right date stamped on it, your ticket will be invalid.
invalid.zh: 票上若没有加盖正确日期就是废票。

invalidate.en: Failure to disclose all relevant changes may invalidate your policy.
invalidate.zh: 未能披露所有的相关变化会令保单无效。
后来的发现推翻了这一理论。

invaluable.en: Your advice has been invaluable to us.
invaluable.zh: 你的建议对我们非常宝贵。

invaluable.en: This help was invaluable in focussing my ideas.
invaluable.zh: 这一帮助对于整理我的思绪很有益处。

invariable.en: His invariable answer was ‘Wait and see.’

invariable.zh: 与重量不同，质量是不变的。

invariably.en: It invariably rains when I go there.
The security guards were invariably ex-servicemen.
invariably.zh: 保安人员毫无例外地都是退伍军人。

invent.en: Alexander Graham Bell invented the telephone in 1876.
They invented a very convincing alibi.
invent.zh: 他们编造了很有说服力的不在犯罪现场的证据。

invention.en: The dishwasher is a wonderful invention.
invention.zh: 洗碗机是一项奇妙的发明。

invention.en: The invention of the computer has revolutionized the business world.
invention.zh: 电脑的发明使商界发生了根本变化。

inventory.en: We made an inventory of everything in the apartment.
inventory.zh: 我们把这公寓里的所有东西开列了一份详细清单。

inverse.en: Clearly, the amount of money people save increases in inverse proportion to the amount they spend.
inverse.zh: 显然，人们储蓄的增加与消费成反比。

invest.en: I’ve got a few thousand dollars I’m looking to invest.
invest.zh: 我有几千美元想作投资。

invest.en: Oliver made a fortune by investing in antique furniture.
invest.zh: 奥利弗投资古董家具发了财。

investigate.en: The state police are investigating the incident.
The study investigates the impact of violent TV programming on children.
investigate.zh: 该研究调查暴力电视节目对儿童的影响。

investigation.en: The investigation continued for nearly three years.
The authorities are planning to launch a full-scale investigation into the crash.
investigation.zh: 当局计划对这桩坠机事件展开全面调查。

investment.en: We plan to buy some property as an investment.
investment.zh: 我们打算买些房地产作为投资。

investment.en: That year, Japanese investment in American real estate totaled $13.06 billion.
investment.zh: 那年，日本投资美国房地产的总额达到了130.6

invigorate.en: At my age, the walk into town is enough to invigorate me.
invigorate.zh: 在我这个年龄，走路进城足以让我感到精神振作。

invigorate.en: He felt invigorated after a day in the country.
invigorate.zh: 他在乡村待了一天后感觉精神焕发。

invincible.en: Young athletes think of themselves as invincible.
invincible.zh: 年轻的运动员自认为是战无不胜的。

invisible.en: The house was surrounded by trees, and invisible from the road.
invisible.zh: 这所房子树木环绕，从路上是看不见的。

invisible.en: The plane is meant to be invisible to radar.
invisible.zh: 这飞机在雷达上应该监测不到。

invitation.en: Roger never turns down an invitation to dinner.
invitation.zh: 有人请吃饭罗杰从不拒绝。

invitation.en: Attendance at the seminars is by invitation only (=only those people who have been invited can attend).
invitation.zh: 研讨会凭邀请函方可参加。

invite.en: Who should we invite to the party?
invite.zh: 我们该邀请谁来参加聚会？

invite.en: Gail invited me to stay with her while her husband was out of town.
invite.zh: 盖尔邀请我在她丈夫出城时住在她家。

inviting.en: The log fire looked warm and inviting.

invoke.en: The UN threatened to invoke economic sanctions if the talks were broken off.
invoke.zh: 联合国威胁说，如果谈判破裂将采取经济制裁。

invoke.en: During his speech, he invoked the memory of Harry Truman.
invoke.zh: 他演讲时使人想起哈里 ·

involved.zh: 三十多家软件公司参与了这项工程。

irony.zh: 可悲的讽刺在于，这药本来是用来挽救生命的。

irrational.zh: 他变得越来越不可理喻了。

irregular.zh: 它的外形极不规则，满是凸起和凹陷的地方。

irregular.zh: 他因心律不齐正在接受药物治疗。

irrelevant.en: We’re focussing too much on irrelevant details.
irrelevant.zh: 我们过于关注不相干的细节。

irrelevant.zh: 学生认为拉丁语无聊且无关紧要。

irreparable.zh: 大量采矿会对该地区造成无法弥补的损害。

irresponsible.zh: 说到钱，丹完全不负责任。

irresponsible.zh: 不打电话说一声就不去上班是不负责任的。

irreverent.zh: 她对婚姻有一种不当回事的态度。

irreversible.zh: 矿物燃料已对环境造成了不可挽回的破坏。

irrigate.zh: 包尔湖的水被用来灌溉该地区。

irritate.zh: 这种润肤霜对敏感性皮肤可能有刺激。

justice.zh: 这些杀人犯将被绳之以法。

justification.zh: 霍加特觉得同事令他失望，这是有理由的。

justify.zh: 大臣们必须就自己的行为向议会作出解释。

justify.zh: 我们怎么才能解释花那么多钱购买武器是正当的呢？

keel.zh: 既然危机已过去，我们必须设法使一切都恢复稳定。

keel.zh: 几名士兵在烈日下晕倒了。

keeping.zh: 按照传统，所有人都身着黑色的衣服。

kill.zh: 默里拿枪指着他的头并威胁要杀了他。

kin.zh: 我们得把他去世的消息通知他的直系亲属。

kind.en: They sell all kinds of things.
kind.zh: 他们出售各种各样的东西。

kind.en: The flowers attract several different kinds of insects.
kind.zh: 这些花吸引几种不同的昆虫。

kindle.zh: 他的母亲激发了他对诗歌的兴趣。

kindly.zh: 纳恩先生慷慨地允许我们借用他的谷仓举行舞会。

kindness.zh: 把真相告诉他对他有好处。

kink.zh: 这么大的一个任务，出些小问题在所难免。

kinship.zh: 这两个男人之间的密切关系令人吃惊。

labyrinth.zh: 白厅各委员会关系错综复杂，决策经常一拖再拖。

lace.en: Lace up your shoes or you’ll trip over.
lace.zh: 把鞋带系好，否则你会绊倒的。

lace.en: The canvas was laced to a steel frame.
lace.zh: 帆布用绳子系在钢架上。

lack.en: Too many teachers are treated with a lack of respect.
lack.zh: 有太多老师得不到尊重。

lack.en: Does their apparent lack of progress mean they are not doing their job properly?
lack.zh: 他们看来没有什么进展，是不是说明他们没有做好本职工作？

lad.en: Things were different when I was a lad.
lad.zh: 我年轻的时候，情况可不大相同。

lad.en: That Chris is a bit of a lad, isn’t he?
lad.zh: 那个克里斯是个花花公子，对不对？

ladder.en: He hurt himself falling off a ladder.
ladder.zh: 他从梯子上摔下来受了伤。

laden.en: The tables were laden with food.
laden.zh: 那些桌子上摆满了食物。

lady.en: The young lady at reception sent me up here.
lady.zh: 接待小姐让我来这里的。

lady.en: Give your coat to the lady over there.
lady.zh: 把你的外衣交给那边的女士吧。

lag.en: She stopped to wait for Ian who was lagging behind.
lag.zh: 她停下来等落在后面的伊恩。

lag.en: Britain is lagging behind the rest of Europe.
lag.zh: 英国被欧洲其他国家落在了后面。

lake.en: We went for a swim in the lake.
The reservoirs supply water to Greater Manchester.
lake.zh: 这些水库为大曼彻斯特郡供水。

lamb.en: Ben’s asleep now, the little lamb.
lamb.zh: 本正在睡觉，像可爱的小羔羊。

lamb.en: Suzie went off to school like a lamb today.
lamb.zh: 苏齐今天乖乖地去上学了。

lament.en: The nation lamented the death of its great war leader.
lament.zh: 举国上下都在哀悼他们伟大的战时领袖。

lament.en: He lamented that people had expected too much of him too soon.
lament.zh: 他抱怨大家一下子对他期望过高。

land.en: They own a lot of land.
He bought a piece of land.

landmark.en: One of Belfast’s most famous landmarks, the Grosvenor Hall, has been demolished.
landmark.zh: 贝尔法斯特最著名的地标之一格罗夫纳大厦已被拆毁了。

landmark.en: The discovery of penicillin was a landmark in the history of medicine.
landmark.zh: 青霉素的发现是医药史上的里程碑。

landscape.en: Recent electoral shocks have shaken the European political landscape.
landscape.zh: 最近的选举风波撼动了欧洲政坛。

landscape.en: The area around the mill pond has also been landscaped.
landscape.zh: 磨坊水池周围也作了景观美化。

landslide.en: The SNP candidate won by a landslide.
landslide.zh: 苏格兰民族党候选人以压倒性多数获胜。

lane.en: That idiot changed lanes without signalling.
lane.zh: 那个白痴没打灯就变道。

lane.en: Use the outside lane for overtaking only.
lane.zh: 外侧车道仅限超车使用。

language.en: How many languages do you speak?
The letter was written in complicated legal language.
language.zh: 这封信是用复杂的法律术语写的。

languid.en: He greeted Charles with a languid wave of his hand.
languid.zh: 他无精打采地挥挥手，算是和查尔斯打招呼。

languid.en: We spent a languid afternoon by the pool.
languid.zh: 我们在游泳池边懒洋洋地过了一个下午。

languish.en: Shaw languished in jail for fifteen years.
The housing market continues to languish.

lap.en: Shannon sat on her mother’s lap.
lap.zh: 香农坐在她妈妈的腿上。

lap.en: His hands were folded in his lap.

lapse.en: Despite the occasional lapse, this was a fine performance by the young saxophonist.
lapse.zh: 除了这处偶然失误，这位年轻萨克斯手的表演堪称精彩。

lapse.en: A defensive lapse by Keown allowed Tottenham to score.
lapse.zh: 基翁的防守失误让托特纳姆队踢进一球。

large.en: Los Angeles is the second largest city in the US.
large.zh: 洛杉矶是美国的第二大城市。

large.en: The T-shirt comes in Small, Medium and Large.

largely.en: The state of Nevada is largely desert.
largely.zh: 内华达州大部分是沙漠。

largely.en: It had been a tiring day, largely because of all the tedious waiting.
largely.zh: 那一天真累人，主要是因为等得无聊。

lark.en: I only went along for a lark.
lark.zh: 我跟着一起去只是为了好玩。

lark.en: Paint the whole room? Sod that for a lark!

lash.en: The oars were lashed to the sides of the boat.
Giant waves lashed the sea wall.

last.en: I hadn’t seen him since the last meeting.
last.zh: 自从上次会面后，我再没有见到他。

last.en: Did you see the game on TV last night?
last.zh: 昨晚你看电视播出的比赛了没有？

lasting.en: The reforms will bring lasting benefits.
lasting.zh: 改革将带来长久的利益。

lasting.en: Their generosity made a lasting impression on me.
lasting.zh: 他们的慷慨给我留下了难忘的印象。

lastly.en: Lastly, could I ask all of you to keep this information secret.
lastly.zh: 最后，我请求各位对这一消息保密。

lately.en: What have you been doing lately?

latent.en: The virus remains latent in the body for many years.
latent.zh: 这种病毒会在体内潜伏许多年。

later.en: I’m going out for a bit – I’ll see you later.
He became Senator two years later.

lateral.en: The wall is weak and requires lateral support.
lateral.zh: 墙体不坚固，需要从侧面加以支撑。

lateral.en: Employees can expect lateral moves to different departments, to gain experience.
lateral.zh: 雇员可以要求平级调动到不同部门，以增加经验。

latest.en: His latest film is one of the funniest he’s ever made.
latest.zh: 最新的这部影片是他最搞笑的电影之一。

latest.en: Wednesday’s session was the latest in a series of planning meetings.
latest.zh: 星期三的会议是最近的一次策划会议。

latitude.en: The birds breed in northern latitudes.
latitude.zh: 这些鸟在北纬地区繁殖。

latitude.en: Pupils enjoy considerable latitude in deciding what they want to study.
latitude.zh: 小学生们有相当大的自由度来选择想学的内容。

latter.en: Where unemployment and crime are high, it can be assumed that the latter is due to the former.
latter.zh: 如果某地失业率和犯罪率都很高，可以认为后者是前者造成的。

latter.en: In the latter case, buyers pay a 15% commission.
latter.zh: 在后一种情况下，买家付15%

laugh.en: Maria looked at him and laughed.
laugh.zh: 玛丽亚看着他大笑起来。

laugh.en: Tony was laughing so hard he had to steady himself on the table.
laugh.zh: 托尼笑得太厉害了，靠着桌子才能让自己站稳。

laughter.zh: 福斯特也跟着笑了起来。

laughter.en: He looked shocked, then burst into laughter (=started laughing).
laughter.zh: 他一脸的震惊，接着便放声大笑起来。

launch.en: The organization has launched a campaign to raise $150,000.
The Canadian police plan to launch an investigation into the deal.
launch.zh: 加拿大警方计划对这宗交易进行调查。

laundry.en: She did the laundry (=washed the clothes etc) and hung it out to dry.
laundry.zh: 她洗了衣服，然后挂出去晾干。

lavish.en: We were always lavish with financial aid in times of crisis.
lavish.zh: 危难时刻我们总是慷慨解囊。

law.en: Elected officials ought to obey the law.
law.zh: 民选官员理应遵守法律。

law.en: By law, seat belts must be worn by all passengers.
law.zh: 按照法律规定，所有乘客都必须系安全带。

lawful.en: It is not lawful to kill or injure a pet animal.
lawful.zh: 杀死或伤害宠物是犯法的。

lawn.en: I spent all morning mowing the lawn (=cutting the grass).
lawn.zh: 我整个上午都在修剪草坪。

lax.en: The company has been lax in carrying out its duties.
lax.zh: 公司没有严格履行义务。

lay.en: He laid his hand on my shoulder.
lay.zh: 他把一只手搭在我的肩上。

lay.en: They laid a wreath at the place where so many people died.
lay.zh: 他们在这么多人丧生的地方放了一个花圈。

layer.en: A thick layer of dust lay on the furniture.
layer.zh: 家具上蒙了一层厚厚的灰尘。

layer.en: The moon was shining through a thin layer of cloud.
layer.zh: 月光透过薄薄的云层照射下来。

layman.en: To the layman (=laymen in general) all these plants look pretty similar.
layman.zh: 对外行的人来说，这些植物看起来都很相似。

layman.en: If you don’t understand what the doctor says, ask to have it explained in layman’s terms (=in simple language).
layman.zh: 如果你听不懂医生的话，就请他用通俗易懂的语言来解释一下。

layout.en: All the flats in the building had the same layout.
layout.zh: 大楼里所有的公寓布局都是一样的。

lazy.en: He felt too lazy to get out of bed.
We spent lazy days relaxing on the beach.
lazy.zh: 我们在海滩上放松休息，过着慵懒惬意的日子。

lead.en: A nurse took her arm and led her to a chair.
lead.zh: 有位护士搀扶她坐到椅子上。

lead.en: The horses were led to safety.
lead.zh: 马匹被牵到安全的地方。

leader.en: His air of confidence makes him a natural leader.
leader.zh: 他那自信的神态显得他天生就是一个领导者。
汉普郡的郡锦标赛优胜者

leadership.en: Our prospects of winning an election will be better under his leadership.
leadership.zh: 在他的领导下，我们赢得选举的希望将会更大。

leadership.en: The US must now take a firm leadership role.
leadership.zh: 美国现在必须扮演一个强有力的领导人角色。

leading.en: The army played a leading role in organizing the attempted coup.
leading.zh: 军队在策划这场未遂政变的过程中起了最主要的作用。

leading.en: This is the leading edge of medical technology.

leaf.en: Add a few leaves of fresh basil to the salad.
leaf.zh: 在色拉中加入一些新鲜的罗勒叶。

leaf.en: The forest was just coming into leaf.
leaf.zh: 森林里的树木刚开始长叶。

leaflet.en: Students were handing out election leaflets at the station.
leaflet.zh: 学生在车站分发选举传单。
他在向街区居民散发传单。

league.en: He makes his football league debut tomorrow.
league.zh: 明天他将在足球联赛中首次出战。

league.en: They’re not in the same league as the French at making wine.
league.zh: 他们的葡萄酒酿造水平远不及法国人。

leak.en: A tanker is leaking oil off the coast of Scotland.
leak.zh: 苏格兰海岸附近有一艘油轮漏油。

leaky.en: The house had a leaky roof.

lean.en: They were leaning forward, facing each other.
Lean back and enjoy the ride.
lean.zh: 身体往后靠，尽情享受乘车旅行的乐趣吧。

leap.en: The smaller animals can easily leap from tree to tree.
leap.zh: 体形较小的动物可以在树丛间轻巧地跳来跳去。

learn.en: What’s the best way to learn a language?
learn.zh: 学习语言的最佳方法是什么？

learn.en: I learnt to drive when I was 17.

lease.en: They took out a lease on a seven-acre field.
lease.zh: 他们租下了一块七英亩的土地。

lease.en: The landlord refused to renew his lease.
lease.zh: 房东拒绝和他续签租约。

least.en: It will take you at least 20 minutes to get there.
He had at least £100,000 in savings.

leather.en: The inside of the bag was lined with soft leather.

leave.en: My baby gets upset when I leave the room.
leave.zh: 我一离开房间宝宝就会不安。

leave.en: Before leaving the train, make sure you have all your belongings with you.
leave.zh: 下火车前一定要带好随身物品。

lecture.en: He regularly gives lectures on modern French literature.
lecture.zh: 他经常讲授法国现代文学课程。

lecture.en: My father caught me and gave me a long lecture about the dangers of drink.
lecture.zh: 父亲拉住我，长篇大论地告诫我喝酒的种种危害。

ledge.en: We crept carefully along the narrow ledge.
ledge.zh: 我们小心翼翼地沿着狭窄的岩架爬行。

ledge.en: He leapt onto a ledge of rock.

leeway.en: The government does not have much leeway in foreign policy.
leeway.zh: 政府在外交政策上没有多少回旋余地。

leeway.en: Try to give teenagers more leeway to make their own decisions.
leeway.zh: 尽量给青少年更多的自由，让他们自己作决定。

left.en: She held out her left hand.

left-hand.en: We live about halfway down the street on the left-hand side.
left-hand.zh: 我们住在这条街中间靠左边的地方。

leftover.en: Give the leftovers to the dog.
The headmaster was a leftover from the Victorian era.
leftover.zh: 校长是维多利亚时代的遗老。

leg.en: She fell and broke her leg.
One of the legs on the table was a bit wobbly.
leg.zh: 桌子的一条腿有点不稳。

legacy.en: The invasion left a legacy of hatred and fear.
legacy.zh: 这次入侵留下的是仇恨和恐惧。

legacy.en: She received a small legacy from her aunt.
legacy.zh: 她从姨妈那里继承了一小笔遗产。

legal.en: What the company has done is perfectly legal.
legal.zh: 公司所做的这一切完全合法。

legal.en: He had twice the legal limit of alcohol in his bloodstream.
legal.zh: 他血液中的酒精含量是法定限度的两倍。

legally.zh: 他们在法律上仍然是夫妻。

legally.en: Which of them is legally responsible for the accident?
legally.zh: 他们中谁应该对这起事故负法律责任？

legend.en: According to legend, he escaped by leaping from the cliffs into the sea.
legend.zh: 据传，他是跳崖入海逃生的。

legend.en: Local legend has it that (=says that) the island was the original Garden of Eden.
legend.zh: 当地传说这个岛就是伊甸园的原型。

legendary.en: Lonnie Johnson, the legendary blues guitarist

legible.en: Her handwriting was so tiny it was barely legible.
legible.zh: 她的字写得这么小，简直都看不清楚。

legion.en: The stories of her adventures were legion.
legion.zh: 她的历险故事数不胜数。

legislate.en: Only Parliament has the power to legislate on national matters.
legislate.zh: 只有议会才有权就宪法问题立法。

legislate.en: The government has promised to legislate against discrimination.
legislate.zh: 政府已经承诺制定反歧视的法律。

legislation.en: It is a very important piece of legislation.
legislation.zh: 这是一条非常重要的法规。

legislation.en: The government has promised to bring in new legislation to combat this problem.
legislation.zh: 政府承诺颁行新法规来防止这个问题。

legislative.en: The new assemblies will have no legislative power.
legislative.zh: 新的议会将没有立法权。

legitimate.zh: 那个问题完全合乎情理。

legitimate.en: Most scientists believe it is legitimate to use animals in medical research.
legitimate.zh: 大多数科学家认为用动物作医学研究是正当的。

leisure.en: Most people now enjoy shorter working hours and more leisure time.
leisure.zh: 现在大多数人都喜欢工作时间短些，闲暇时间多些。

leisure.en: Watching television is now the nation’s most popular leisure activity.
leisure.zh: 看电视是当前国民最普遍的消遣活动。

leisurely.en: After lunch we went for a leisurely stroll.
leisurely.zh: 吃过午饭，我们慢悠悠地散了个步。

leisurely.en: He sipped leisurely at his drink.

lemon.en: Add a few drops of lemon juice.
I soon realized the van was a lemon.
lemon.zh: 不久我便发现，这辆小货车根本就不中用。

lemonade.zh: 你要来一杯柠檬汽水吗？

lend.en: I lent my CD player to Dave and I haven’t got it back yet.
The hospital agreed to lend us a wheelchair.
lend.zh: 医院同意借给我们一把轮椅。

length.en: We measured the length and width of the living room.
length.zh: 我们量了客厅的长和宽。

length.en: Some fish can grow to a length of four feet.

lengthen.en: Can you lengthen this skirt for me?
lengthen.zh: 你能不能帮我把这条裙子改长？

lengthen.en: The days lengthened as summer approached.
lengthen.zh: 随着夏天来临，白天变长了。

lengthy.en: A lengthy period of training is required.
lengthy.zh: 需要很长一段时间的培训。

lengthy.en: An accident is causing some lengthy delays.
lengthy.zh: 一起事故造成长时间的延误。

lenient.en: School examiners say that marking has become more lenient in recent years.
lenient.zh: 学校的阅卷人称近年来评分标准放宽了。

less.en: Maybe he would worry less if he understood the situation.
less.zh: 他要是了解情况，也许就不会那么担心了。

less.en: In recent years she has appeared in public less frequently.
less.zh: 近年来她在公开场合露面的次数少了。

lessen.en: Exercise lessens the risk of heart disease.
lessen.zh: 运动可降低患心脏疾病的风险。

lessen.en: The new project will lessen the effects of car pollution.
lessen.zh: 这个新项目将减少汽车污染的影响。

lesser.en: They originally asked for $5 million, but finally settled for a lesser sum.
lesser.zh: 他们原先要五百万美元，但最后同意少要一些。

lesser.en: This was true in Madrid and, to a lesser extent, Valencia and Seville.
lesser.zh: 马德里是这样，巴伦西亚和塞维利亚也这样，只是程度轻一些罢了。

lest.en: She turned away from the window lest anyone see them.
lest.zh: 她转身离开窗边，免得有人看见他们。

lest.en: He paused, afraid lest he say too much.
lest.zh: 他停顿下来，唯恐说得太多。

let.en: I can’t come out tonight – my dad won’t let me.
let.zh: 今天晚上我不能出来，我爸爸不允许。

let.en: Let Johnny have a go on the computer now.
let.zh: 现在让约翰尼来玩玩电脑吧。

lethal.en: These chemicals are lethal to fish.
lethal.zh: 这些化学品对鱼类是致命的。

lethal.en: They were all drinking lethal amounts of tequila!
lethal.zh: 他们都在不要命地喝特奎拉酒！

lethargic.en: The hot weather was making us all lethargic.
lethargic.zh: 炎热的天气使我们所有人都昏昏欲睡。

lethargy.en: New mothers often complain of lethargy and mild depression.
lethargy.zh: 初为人母者经常抱怨说身体疲倦乏力，有轻微的抑郁。

letter.en: I got a letter from Melanie today.
letter.zh: 今天我收到梅拉妮的一封信。

letter.en: Bart’s writing a letter to his parents.
letter.zh: 巴特正在给他父母写信。

level.en: Inflation fell to its lowest level in 30 years.
Increased supplies are needed to meet the level of demand.
level.zh: 要增加供应以满足需求量。

lever.en: Pull this lever to open the gate.
Rich countries use foreign aid as a lever to achieve political aims.
lever.zh: 富国利用对外援助作为达到政治目的的手段。

levy.en: He wants to impose a levy on landfill waste.
levy.zh: 他想对填埋的废弃物征税。

liability.en: Tenants have legal liability for any damage they cause.
liability.zh: 承租人造成任何损坏都要负法律责任。

liability.en: The court ruled there was no liability to pay any refund.

liable.en: The car is liable to overheat on long trips.
liable.zh: 这辆汽车跑长途容易过热。

liable.en: He was liable to just show up without warning.
liable.zh: 他总是不预先通知一声就来了。

liaison.en: The project has been set up in liaison with the art department.
liaison.zh: 该项目是和艺术系联合设立的。

liaison.en: Renee Ball, liaison to the State Parks Authority
liaison.zh: 州立公园管理处联络员勒妮·

liar.en: Are you calling me a liar?

liberal.en: If only they were as liberal with their cash.
liberal.zh: 要是他们花钱也一样大方就好了。

liberate.en: A few days later, our armies liberated the city.
liberate.zh: 几天以后，我军解放了这座城市。

liberty.en: I took the liberty of cancelling your reservation.
liberty.zh: 我自作主张取消了你的预订。

liberty.en: I am not at liberty to discuss these matters.

licence.en: The dealers applied for an export licence.
licence.zh: 经销商申请了出口许可证。

licence.en: He was arrested for driving without a license.

license.en: The vaccine has been licensed by the US Food and Drug Administration.
license.zh: 这种疫苗已经得到美国食品与药物管理局的批准。

lick.en: The dog jumped up and licked her face.
lick.zh: 那只狗跳起来舔她的脸。

lick.en: A cat licked up the drops spilt on the floor.
lick.zh: 一只猫把溅在地板上的东西舔光了。

lid.en: He carefully lifted the lid of the box.
lid.zh: 他小心翼翼地打开盒盖。

lid.en: Kline keeps a very tight lid on his private life.
lid.zh: 克兰把他的私生活隐藏得很严实。

lie.en: He was lying on the bed smoking a cigarette.
Don’t lie in the sun for too long.
lie.zh: 不要在日光下躺太长时间。

life.en: You have your whole life ahead of you.
life.zh: 你前面还有漫长的人生呢。

lifeblood.en: Communication is the lifeblood of a good marriage.
lifeblood.zh: 沟通是美满婚姻的根本保证。

lifelong.en: She became a lifelong friend of ours.
lifelong.zh: 她成了我们一辈子的朋友。

lifelong.en: David finally realized his lifelong ambition.
lifelong.zh: 戴维终于实现了他毕生的抱负。

lifestyle.en: Regular exercise is part of a healthy lifestyle.
lifestyle.zh: 经常锻炼身体是健康生活方式的一部分。

lifestyle.en: They lead an extremely lavish lifestyle.

lifetime.en: During her lifetime she had witnessed two world wars.
lifetime.zh: 她一生亲历了两次世界大战。

lifetime.en: It’s the sort of opportunity you see only once in a lifetime.
lifetime.zh: 这种机会你一辈子也只能碰到一次。

lift.en: Sophie lifted the phone before the second ring.
lift.zh: 铃响了一下苏菲就接起了电话。

lift.en: He lifted the lid on the pot of soup.

light.en: We saw a flash of light.
Everything looked grey in the dim light of the oil lamp.
light.zh: 在昏暗的油灯下，所有的东西看上去都是灰蒙蒙的。

lighten.en: We should hire another secretary to lighten Barbara’s workload.
lighten.zh: 我们应该再招聘一位秘书，减轻芭芭拉的工作量。

lighten.en: As the sky lightened, we were able to see where we were.
lighten.zh: 天色渐亮，我们能看清楚身处何地了。

lighting.en: Better street lighting might help to reduce crime.
lighting.zh: 改善街道照明或许有助于减少犯罪。

lighting.en: Fluorescent lighting is much cheaper to use than light bulbs.
lighting.zh: 使用荧光灯照明比用普通灯泡便宜得多。

lightly.en: I knocked lightly on the door.
Divorce is not a matter you can afford to take lightly.

lightning.en: Two farm workers were struck by lightning (=hit by lightning).
Mitch moved like lightning and caught the little girl before she fell.
lightning.zh: 米奇眼疾手快，一把抓住了小女孩，没有让她摔倒。

like.en: Her hair is dark brown like mine.
like.zh: 她的头发是深褐色的，和我的一样。

like.en: A club should be like a big family.
like.zh: 俱乐部就应该像一个大家庭。

likelihood.en: Using a seatbelt will reduce the likelihood of serious injury in a car accident.
likelihood.zh: 系安全带可以降低在车祸中受重伤的可能性。

likelihood.en: There was very little likelihood of her getting the job.
likelihood.zh: 她得到这份工作的可能性很小。

likely.en: What are the likely effects of the law going to be?
likely.zh: 这条法规可能会产生什么样的影响？

likeness.en: Hugh’s uncanny likeness to his father
I can see the family likeness.
likeness.zh: 我看出这一家人都长得很像。

likewise.en: Nanny put on a shawl and told the girls to do likewise.
likewise.zh: 南妮披上披肩，并叫女孩们也这样做。

likewise.en: The clams were delicious. Likewise, the eggplant was excellent.
likewise.zh: 蛤蜊味道鲜美，茄子也同样美味。

liking.en: Jim and Keith had a liking and respect for each other.
liking.zh: 吉姆和基思互相喜欢、互相尊重。

liking.en: She’s developed a liking for theatre.

limb.en: All the other countries signed the agreement, leaving Britain out on a limb.
limb.zh: 其他国家都签署了协议，使英国处于孤立无援的境地。

limb.en: He’d gone out on a limb (=taken a risk) to help us.

limit.en: There’s no age limit for applicants.
My wife and I set a limit on how much we spend on clothes.
limit.zh: 我和妻子给服装的开支设定了一个限额。

limitation.en: Any limitation to the king’s power could be permanent.
limitation.zh: 对国王权力的任何限制都有可能是永久性的。

limitation.en: Despite the limitations of the survey, it did suggest some general trends.
limitation.zh: 这次调查尽管有局限性，但也确实说明了一些普遍的倾向。

limited.en: There are only a limited number of tickets available.
My knowledge of the business is limited.

line.en: Draw a straight line across the top of the page.
line.zh: 在这一页的上方画一条直线。

line.en: Sign your name on the dotted line (=line made up of a series of dots).

linger.en: Unfortunately the tax will linger on until April.
linger.zh: 不幸的是，这项税收要持续到4

linger.en: They lingered over coffee and missed the last bus.
linger.zh: 他们多喝了一会儿咖啡，错过了末班公共汽车。

link.en: Police think the murders are linked.
link.zh: 警方认为这些谋杀案互有关联。

link.en: Some birth defects are linked to smoking during pregnancy.
link.zh: 有些先天缺陷与孕期吸烟有关。

lion.en: The firm has captured the lion’s share of the UK market.
lion.zh: 这家公司已经占有英国市场最大的份额。

lip.en: She had big eyes and full lips (=large and round lips).
lip.zh: 她眼睛大大的，嘴唇很丰满。

liquid.en: Add a little more liquid to the sauce.
Children take antibiotics in liquid form.

list.en: Make a list of all the things you have to do.
list.zh: 把你必须做的所有事情列一个清单。

list.en: The first person on my list is Mrs Gilling.
list.zh: 我的名单上排在第一位的是吉林夫人。

listen.en: Listen! There’s a strange noise in the engine.
listen.zh: 听！引擎发出奇怪的声音。

listen.en: We sat around listening to music.

listless.en: The heat was making me listless.
listless.zh: 炎热的天气使我懒洋洋的。

literal.en: A trade war is not a war in the literal sense.
literal.zh: 贸易战不是字面意义上的战争。

literally.en: The name of the cheese is Dolcelatte, literally meaning ‘sweet milk’.
I said I felt like quitting, but I didn’t mean it literally (=I did not mean exactly what I said)!
literally.zh: 我是说我不想干了，但并不是真的不干了！

literature.en: He has read many of the major works of literature.
literature.zh: 他读过许多重要的文学作品。

literature.en: Several cases of mercury poisoning have been recorded in the literature.
literature.zh: 文献上记载了几宗汞中毒事件。

litter.en: People who drop litter can be fined in some cities.
litter.zh: 在有些城市，乱扔垃圾的人会被罚款。

little.en: She was cutting the meat up into little bits.
I’d like to buy him a little something to thank him.
little.zh: 我想给他买样小东西谢谢他。

live.en: They lived in Holland for ten years.
He lives just across the street from me.

livelihood.en: Fishing is the main source of livelihood for many people in the area.
livelihood.zh: 打鱼是这一地区许多人的主要生活来源。

livelihood.en: It’s difficult to earn a livelihood as an artist.

lively.en: The hotel is situated next to the lively bustling port.
lively.zh: 酒店位于那个熙熙攘攘的港口旁。

lively.en: The book offers a lively account of her travels.
lively.zh: 书中生动地描绘了她的旅行见闻。

living.en: He’s one of the greatest living composers.
living.zh: 他是仍然健在的最伟大的作曲家之一。

living.en: The sun affects all living things (=people, animals, and plants).
living.zh: 太阳与一切生物息息相关。

load.en: The lorry had shed its load (=the load had fallen off).
The plane was carrying a full load of fuel.

loaf.en: They spend all day loafing around on street corners.

loan.en: I had to take out a loan to buy my car.
It’ll be years before we’ve paid off the loan.
loan.zh: 我们要过好几年才能还清贷款。

loath.en: Sarah was loath to tell her mother what had happened.
loath.zh: 萨拉不愿意告诉母亲所发生的事。

lobby.en: I’ll meet you in the entrance lobby.
The group is lobbying for a reduction in defence spending.
lobby.zh: 该团体正在游说政府削减国防开支。

local.en: We asked one of the locals to recommend a restaurant.
local.zh: 我们请一位当地人推荐一家餐馆。

local.en: I usually have a pint or two at my local on Friday nights.
local.zh: 星期五晚上我通常在邻近的小酒馆里喝上一两品脱。

locality.en: Both sea fishing and freshwater angling are available in the locality.
locality.zh: 这个地区既有海钓，又有淡水垂钓。

localize.en: A mechanic is trying to localize the fault.
localize.zh: 技工正在寻找故障所在。

localize.en: They hoped to localize the fighting.
localize.zh: 他们希望把战事控制在局部范围之内。

locally.en: I live locally, so it’s easy to get to the office.
locally.zh: 我就住在附近，所以上班很方便。

locally.en: Most of the country will be dry, but there will be some rain locally.
locally.zh: 全国大部分地区天气干燥，但局部地区有雨。

locate.en: The business is located right in the center of town.
We couldn’t locate the source of the radio signal.
locate.zh: 我们无法确定无线电信号的来源。

location.en: His apartment is in a really good location.
It can be stressful moving to a new place.

lock.en: I can’t get this drawer to lock.
lock.zh: 我没法把这个抽屉锁上。

lodge.en: He lodged an appeal with the High Court.
lodge.zh: 他向高等法院提出上诉。

lodge.en: They lodged a complaint against the doctor for negligence.

lodging.en: It’s £90 a week for board and lodging (=meals and a room).
Paul found lodgings in the Marylebone Road.
lodging.zh: 保罗在玛丽勒本路找到了出租的房间。

loft.en: Our neighbours have just done a loft conversion (=changed the loft into bedrooms).
loft.zh: 我们的邻居刚刚完成阁楼改建。

loft.en: She’s just bought a loft in Manhattan.
loft.zh: 她刚在曼哈顿买了一间改建的阁楼居室。

lofty.en: He stayed at the Four Seasons Hotel, from whose lofty heights he could see across New York.
lofty.zh: 他住在四季酒店，从酒店高处可以看到纽约的全景。

lofty.en: He had set himself the lofty goal of reaching the world’s top five.
lofty.zh: 他给自己定下了一个伟大的目标，要进入世界排名前五位。

log.en: The captain always keeps a log.

logic.en: The logic behind this statement is faulty.
logic.zh: 这种说法的逻辑是错误的。

logic.en: What’s the logic of your argument?

logical.en: It’s a logical site for a new supermarket, with the housing development nearby.
logical.zh: 附近有住宅区，新的超级市场选址在此是合情合理的。

logical.en: The detective has to discover the murderer by logical deduction.
logical.zh: 那位侦探得通过逻辑推理来找出凶手。

loll.en: He lolled back in his chair.
loll.zh: 他懒洋洋地靠椅背坐着。

lone.en: A lone figure was standing at the bus stop.
lone.zh: 公交车站上站着一个孤单的身影。

lone.en: He was by no means a lone voice criticizing the government.
lone.zh: 批评政府的绝不止他一个人。

lonely.en: Don’t you get lonely being on your own all day?
lonely.zh: 你整天独自一人不感到寂寞吗？

lonely.en: He led a lonely life with few friends.

lonesome.en: Beth is lonesome without the children.
lonesome.zh: 孩子们不在身边，贝丝很孤单。

long.en: He stretched out his long legs.
Springfield is a long way from Chicago.
long.zh: 斯普林菲尔德离芝加哥很远。

longevity.en: The worms have a longevity of about two years.
longevity.zh: 这些虫子大约能活两年。

longevity.en: The ancient Chinese claimed that garlic promoted longevity.

longing.en: She looked back with longing on the good old days.
longing.zh: 她回首往事，怀念着过去的美好时光。

longing.en: His heart was filled with longing for Cynthia.
longing.zh: 他心中对辛西娅充满渴望。

longitude.en: The town lies at longitude 12° east.

long-lasting.en: The impact of divorce on children can be long-lasting.
long-lasting.zh: 离婚对于孩子的影响会持续很长时间。

long-range.en: He scored with a long-range shot.

long-standing.en: I have a long-standing arrangement with the bank.

look.en: We sneaked out while Jessie’s mom wasn’t looking.
look.zh: 我们趁杰茜的妈妈没有看到，偷偷地溜了出去。

look.en: If you look carefully you can see that the painting represents a human figure.
look.zh: 如果仔细看，就会看出画上是一个人形。

loom.en: Suddenly a mountain loomed up in front of them.
loom.zh: 一座大山赫然耸立在他们面前。

loom.en: An economic crisis is looming on the horizon.

loop.en: A loop of wire held the gate shut.
loop.zh: 一圈铁丝把大门扣上了。

loop.en: He looped the rope over the post.
loop.zh: 他把绳子在柱子上绕了一圈。

loose.zh: 这颗牙感觉松动得厉害。

loose.en: The screw has come loose (=became loose).

loosen.en: You’ll need a spanner to loosen that bolt.
loosen.zh: 你需要扳手来拧开那个螺栓。

lop.en: Workmen have lopped off more branches in an effort to save the tree.
lop.zh: 为了救活这棵树，工人们砍下了更多的树枝。

lord.en: He didn’t use his position on the council to lord it over people.
lord.zh: 他并没有利用自己在市政会的地位在人前逞威风。

lord.en: Thank you, Lord, for your blessings.

lore.en: According to local lore, a ghost still haunts the castle.
lore.zh: 根据当地人的传说，城堡里至今仍然闹鬼。

lose.en: The business community has lost confidence in the government.
lose.zh: 商界已经对政府失去了信心。

loss.en: The court awarded Ms Dixon £7,000 for damages and loss of earnings.
This did not explain his apparent loss of interest in his wife.
loss.zh: 这不能解释他为什么明显对妻子失去了兴趣。

lost.en: I got thoroughly lost on the way here.
lost.zh: 我来这里时完全迷了路。

lost.en: It’ll be impossible to make up the lost time.
lost.zh: 失去的时间不可能追回。

lot.en: We’ve spent a lot on the children’s education.
lot.zh: 我们在孩子的教育上花费甚多。

lot.en: They paid a lot of money for that house.
lot.zh: 他们花了很多钱买下那幢房子。

lottery.en: Do you really think winning the lottery would make you happy?
lottery.zh: 你真的认为彩票中奖会带给你幸福吗？

lottery.en: The State Department issues 55,000 visas each year by lottery.

loud.en: The book fell to the floor with a loud bang.
loud.zh: 书砰的一声掉落到地上。

loud.en: The music was so loud that I had to shout.
loud.zh: 音乐太响了，我只得大声地喊。

loudspeaker.en: The voice over the loudspeaker (=using the loudspeaker) said the flight was delayed.
loudspeaker.zh: 喇叭里传来声音说航班误点了。

lounge.en: Nathan was lounging on the grass bank outside the cottage.
lounge.zh: 内森正懒洋洋地躺在小屋外的草堤上。

lounge.en: James does nothing but lounge around the apartment.
lounge.zh: 詹姆斯在公寓里转来转去，无所事事。

love.en: He was the only man she had ever loved.
love.zh: 他是她唯一爱过的男人。

lover.zh: 我和尼古拉以前是情人。

low.en: In May, the price of cocoa fell to its lowest level since 1975–76.
Morale has been low since the latest round of job cuts.
low.zh: 自最近一轮裁员以来，士气一直很低落。

lower.en: Nina chewed her lower lip anxiously.
lower.zh: 尼娜焦虑不安地咬着下唇。

lower.en: Ruth went down to the lower deck (=lower level on a ship).

low-lying.en: Vast areas of low-lying land have been flooded.
low-lying.zh: 大片的低洼地都被淹了。

loyal.en: The army has remained loyal to the government.
He has always loyally defended the president.
loyal.zh: 他一向忠实地捍卫总统。

loyalty.en: Elizabeth understood her husband’s loyalty to his sister.
loyalty.zh: 伊丽莎白理解丈夫对他姐姐的一片忠心。

loyalty.en: In the rural areas, family and tribal loyalties continue to be important.
loyalty.zh: 在乡村地区，对家庭和部落的忠心依然很重要。

lubricate.en: Lubricate all moving parts with grease.
lubricate.zh: 给所有活动部件加润滑油。

lubricate.en: Vic’s working day is lubricated by endless cups of coffee.
lubricate.zh: 维克上班的时候要靠不断地喝咖啡才能把工作干好。

lucid.en: You must write in a clear and lucid style.
lucid.zh: 你的写作风格一定要清楚易懂。

lucid.en: In her more lucid moments the old lady would talk about her past.
lucid.zh: 在头脑较清醒的时候，老太太会谈起往事。

luck.en: You’re not having much luck today, are you?
luck.zh: 你今天运气不太好，是不是？

luck.en: He’s had good luck with his roses this year.
luck.zh: 今年他种玫瑰的运气不错。

luckily.en: Luckily the museum was not damaged by the earthquake.
luckily.zh: 幸好，博物馆没有在地震中遭到破坏。

luckily.en: Luckily for them, he braked in time.
luckily.zh: 他们很走运，他及时刹车了。

lucky.en: The children were lucky to survive the fire which destroyed their home.
lucky.zh: 孩子们的家毁于大火，但是他们得以幸存。

lucky.en: I’ll be lucky if I get any of my money back.
lucky.zh: 我要是能拿回一点钱就算我运气好了。

lucrative.en: He inherited a lucrative business from his father.
lucrative.zh: 他从父亲那里继承了一家赚大钱的公司。

ludicrous.en: It is ludicrous to suggest that I was driving under the influence of alcohol.
ludicrous.zh: 说我酒后驾车，这真是太荒唐了。

ludicrous.en: The court granted him the ludicrous sum of £100 in damages.

lug.en: It’s a huge book, not something you’d like to lug around.
lug.zh: 这是一本厚重的书，不是你想搬来搬去的东西。

lug.en: She began to lug her suitcase up the stairs.
lug.zh: 她开始把她的行李箱拖上楼。

luggage.en: They searched his luggage for illegal drugs.
luggage.zh: 他们搜查他的行李看是否藏有毒品。

lukewarm.en: She sipped some lukewarm coffee from her mug.
lukewarm.zh: 她抿了几口杯子里温热的咖啡。

lukewarm.en: His idea got only a lukewarm response from the committee.
lukewarm.zh: 他的想法只得到了委员会冷淡的反应。

lull.en: The hum of the tyres on the road lulled her to sleep.
lull.zh: 一路上滚滚的车轮声使她昏昏欲睡。

lull.en: The police lulled me into believing that they did not suspect us.
lull.zh: 警察诱使我以为他们没有怀疑我们。

lumber.zh: 一辆蓝色公共汽车慢吞吞地驶过。

luminous.en: Her large dark eyes were almost luminous.
luminous.zh: 她那双黑色的大眼睛几乎是亮闪闪的。

lump.en: Strain the custard to remove lumps.
lump.zh: 滤去牛奶蛋糊里的面块。

lump.en: Melt a lump of butter in your frying-pan.
lump.zh: 把一块黄油放入煎锅里化开。

lump sum.en: When you retire you’ll get a lump sum of £80,000.
lump sum.zh: 你退休的时候，可以一次性得到8

lunch.en: I’m afraid he’s at lunch until two.
lunch.zh: 他去吃午饭了，恐怕得到两点钟才回来。

lunch.en: A dozen senators met over lunch with the Chinese ambassador.
lunch.zh: 十几名参议员在午餐会上和中国大使会面。

lure.en: People may be lured into buying tickets by clever advertising.
lure.zh: 人们可能会受巧妙广告的诱惑去买票。

lure.en: Computer games are luring youngsters away from their lessons.
lure.zh: 电脑游戏诱惑着青少年，分散了他们的学习注意力。

lurk.en: She didn’t see the figure lurking behind the bushes.
lurk.zh: 她没有看到躲在树丛后的那个身影。

lurk.en: I think it’s sort of creepy how people lurk in chat rooms.
lurk.zh: 我觉得人们在聊天室里隐身不语有点可怕。

lush.en: The fields were lush with grass and flowers.
He looks so lush in this pic!

lust.en: My feelings for Lauren were pure lust.
lust.zh: 我对劳伦的感觉纯粹是肉欲。
希特勒对权力的强烈欲望

luxury.en: She stole to keep her boyfriend in luxury.
luxury.zh: 她靠行窃让男友享受奢侈的生活。

luxury.en: He was leading a life of luxury in Australia.
luxury.zh: 他在澳大利亚过着豪华舒适的生活。

lyric.en: He wrote some great music, but the lyrics weren’t that good.
lyric.zh: 他创作过一些不错的曲子，但歌词不是很好。

lyric.en: Wordsworth was one of the greatest lyric poets of his time.
lyric.zh: 华兹华斯是他那个时代最伟大的抒情诗人之一。

lyrical.en: One fisherman waxed lyrical about the variety of fish in the river.
lyrical.zh: 一个渔夫兴高采烈地谈论河里各种各样的鱼。

lyrically.en: The album is musically unexciting but lyrically superb.
lyrically.zh: 这张专辑的音乐平淡无奇，歌词却很出色。

lyrically.en: He lyrically described the countryside around his home.
lyrically.zh: 他以抒情的笔调描绘了住宅周围的乡村景致。

machine.en: Is the washing machine working now?
Could you get me a coffee from the drinks machine?
machine.zh: 给我从自动饮料机里买一罐咖啡好吗？

machinery.en: The use of heavy machinery has damaged the site.
machinery.zh: 工地因使用重型机械而受到了破坏。

machinery.en: The company has no effective machinery for resolving disputes.
machinery.zh: 公司没有解决争端的有效机制。

mad.en: Are you still mad at me?
We get mad at each other sometimes, like any family.
mad.zh: 我们有时也会红脸，和任何家庭一样。

madden.en: The unfortunate animal was maddened with pain.
madden.zh: 那可怜的动物痛得发狂。

madness.en: It would be madness to drive all that way on your own.
madness.zh: 这么长的路要全程自己一个人开车，那真是疯了。

madness.en: Cutting down the forest is sheer madness (=completely crazy).
madness.zh: 砍伐森林是愚蠢至极的行为。

magazine.en: She’s the editor of a popular women’s magazine.
magazine.zh: 她是一本流行女性杂志的主编。

magazine.en: She glanced over the magazine racks.

magic.en: Paris has lost some of its magic for me over the years.
magic.zh: 这些年来巴黎对我来说已不如从前那么有魅力了。

magnet.en: The region has become a magnet for small businesses.
magnet.zh: 该地区已成为小企业落户的热点区域。

magnet.en: She drew men to her like a magnet.
magnet.zh: 她像吸铁石一样吸引着男人。

magnetize.en: His dark flashing eyes seemed to magnetize her.
magnetize.zh: 他那双炯炯有神的黑眼睛好像把她给迷住了。

magnification.en: When viewed at high magnification, it is clear that the crystals are quite different.
magnification.zh: 高倍放大来看，这些水晶之间明显有着很大差异。

magnification.en: The colour is evident even under low magnification.
magnification.zh: 即使在低放大率情况下这颜色也十分明显。

magnificent.en: The twelve-mile coastline has magnificent scenery.
She looked magnificent in a long red dress.
magnificent.zh: 她穿着红色长裙，看起来美极了。

magnify.en: At the Sheffield arena, the speakers were magnified ten times on a giant screen.
magnify.zh: 在谢菲尔德体育馆，演讲者在一个巨大的屏幕上被放大了十倍。

magnify.en: A public address system magnifies all the little noises and coughs.
magnify.zh: 扩音系统会放大任何细小的噪音和咳嗽声。

magnitude.en: They didn’t seem to appreciate the magnitude of the problem.
magnitude.zh: 他们似乎没有意识到这个问题的重要性。

magnitude.en: We did not think the cuts would be of this magnitude.
magnitude.zh: 我们没想到削减幅度会这么大。

mail.en: You shouldn't read other people's mail.
mail.zh: 你不应该看别人的信件。

mail.en: He found a mountain of mail waiting for him.
mail.zh: 他发现有堆积如山的邮件等着他处理。

maim.en: Landmines still kill or maim about 300 people every month.

main.en: The main reason for living in Spain is the weather.
main.zh: 居住在西班牙的主要原因是天气。

main.en: What do you consider to be the main problem?
main.zh: 你认为最主要的问题是什么？

mainly.en: Her illness was caused mainly by stress.
mainly.zh: 她的病主要是由精神压力引起的。

mainly.en: The workforce is mainly made up of women.

mainstay.en: Agriculture is still the mainstay of the country’s economy.
mainstay.zh: 农业仍然是这个国家经济的支柱。

mainstay.en: She was the mainstay of the team.

mainstream.en: Environmental ideas have been absorbed into the mainstream of European politics.
mainstream.zh: 环境保护的观点已被纳入欧洲政治的主流。

mainstream.en: Genet started as a rebel, but soon became part of the literary mainstream.
mainstream.zh: 热内起初很叛逆，但不久就回归了文学主流。

maintain.en: Careers Officers maintain contact with young people when they have left school.
maintain.zh: 年轻人离开学校以后，职业指导员和他们保持联系。

maintain.en: Britain wants to maintain its position as a world power.
maintain.zh: 英国想保持其世界强国的地位。

maintenance.en: The caretaker is responsible for the maintenance of the school buildings.
maintenance.zh: 管理员负责校舍的保养维护。

maintenance.en: The theatres were closed on Saturday and Sunday for routine maintenance.
maintenance.zh: 戏院周六和周日关闭进行例行维护。

majestic.en: This lovely village is surrounded by majestic mountain scenery.
majestic.zh: 这座美丽的村庄四周山色壮丽。

majesty.en: The prime minister is here to see you, Your Majesty.

major.en: There is a major problem with parking in London.
major.zh: 在伦敦，停车是个很大的问题。

major.en: The loss of their goalkeeper through injury was a major setback for the team.
major.zh: 守门员因伤缺阵使该队的实力大打折扣。

majority.en: The majority of workers find it quite hard to live on the amount of money they earn.
majority.zh: 大多数职工都觉得很难靠他们挣的那点钱生活。

majority.en: In the vast majority of cases the disease is fatal.
majority.zh: 这种疾病绝大多数病例都是致命的。

make.en: I’m going to show you how to make a box for your tools.
make.zh: 我来教你怎么做一个箱子存放工具。

make.en: A family of mice had made their nest in the roof.
make.zh: 一窝老鼠在屋顶上安了家。

maker.en: The makers of the car claim that it uses up to 50% less fuel than other similar cars.
maker.zh: 生产商称，这款汽车比其他同类汽车省油多达50%

maker.en: Grind the beans to suit your coffee maker.
maker.zh: 研磨咖啡豆，使其能在你的咖啡机中使用。

makeshift.en: The refugees slept in makeshift tents at the side of the road.
makeshift.zh: 逃难者睡在路边临时搭建的帐篷里。

making.en: You’ll see – a couple of years abroad will be the making of him.
making.zh: 你看着好了，去国外待几年会令他大有所成。

making.en: He has the makings of a world-class footballer.
making.zh: 他具有世界一流足球运动员的素质。

male.en: Motor-racing has largely been a male preserve (=something that only men have been involved with).
male.zh: 赛车基本上是男人的专利。

male.en: Many women earn less than their male colleagues.
male.zh: 许多女性挣钱比她们的男性同事少。

malfunction.en: A warning light seems to have malfunctioned.
malfunction.zh: 有个预警灯好像出现故障了。

malice.en: She did it out of sheer malice.
malice.zh: 她这么做纯粹是出于恶意。

malicious.en: Who is responsible for these malicious rumours?
malicious.zh: 是谁制造了这些恶毒的谣言？

malignant.en: She developed a malignant tumour in her breast.
malignant.zh: 她的乳房长了个恶性肿瘤。

mall.en: Let’s meet at the mall and go see a movie.
mall.zh: 我们在购物中心碰头，然后去看电影吧。

malpractice.en: Her doctor was found guilty of malpractice.
malpractice.zh: 她的医生被裁定犯有渎职罪。

maltreat.en: The hostages said they were hungry but had not been maltreated.
maltreat.zh: 人质说他们挨了饿，但没有受到虐待。

mammoth.en: Reforming the prison system would be a mammoth task.
mammoth.zh: 改革监狱制度将是一项巨大的任务。

man.en: There were two men and a woman in the car.

manage.en: He was asked to manage a new department.
manage.zh: 他被要求去管理一个新的部门。

manage.en: Managing a football team is harder than you think.
manage.zh: 管理一支足球队比你想象的要难。

manageable.en: Divide the task into manageable sections.
manageable.zh: 把工作分成几个部分，方便处理。

management.en: The management has agreed to the policy.
management.zh: 管理层同意了这项政策。

management.en: The shareholders demanded a change in management.

manager.en: She’s now assistant marketing manager for the southeast area.
manager.zh: 她现在是东南地区的助理营销经理。

mandate.en: The president was elected with a clear mandate to tackle violent crime.
mandate.zh: 总统当选时获得明确的授权解决暴力犯罪问题。

mandate.en: I sought a mandate from my constituents to oppose this tax.
mandate.zh: 我请求我的选民授权，来反对这项税收。

mandatory.en: Crash helmets are mandatory for motorcyclists.
mandatory.zh: 摩托车手必须佩戴头盔。

mandatory.en: Murder carries a mandatory life sentence.
mandatory.zh: 谋杀罪依照法律要判无期徒刑。

manhood.en: Why did he feel he had to prove his manhood in the company of women?
manhood.zh: 他为什么觉得必须在女人面前证明他的男子气概呢？

manhood.en: He had barely reached manhood when he married.

mania.en: Keep-fit mania has hit some of the girls in the office.
mania.zh: 办公室部分女孩中兴起了健身热。

maniac.en: He drove like a maniac to the hospital.
maniac.zh: 他像个疯子似的开车去医院。

maniac.en: Suddenly this maniac ran out into the middle of the road.
maniac.zh: 突然这个疯子跑到路当中。

manifest.en: The shareholders have manifested their intention to sell the shares.
manifest.zh: 股东们表明了要出售股票的意图。

manifest.en: A dog’s protective instincts are manifested in increased alertness.
manifest.zh: 狗的自我保护本能表现在它的警觉性越来越高。

manifestation.en: These latest riots are a clear manifestation of growing discontent.
manifestation.zh: 最近发生的这些骚乱是不满情绪日益增长的明显表现。

manifestation.en: Manifestation of the disease often doesn’t occur until middle age.
manifestation.zh: 这种疾病的症状通常到中年才显现出来。

manifesto.en: The Tories are due to publish their manifesto tomorrow.
manifesto.zh: 保守党将于明天发表他们的宣言。

manifold.en: The reasons for this situation are manifold.
manifold.zh: 出现这种情况原因是多方面的。

manipulate.en: He was one of those men who manipulated people.
manipulate.zh: 他是那种要摆布别人的人。

manipulate.en: You have the constant feeling you are being manipulated.
manipulate.zh: 你总感觉自己是被人控制着的。

manipulative.en: She was sly, selfish, and manipulative.
manipulative.zh: 她狡猾、自私，善于摆布别人。

manipulative.en: Before a child can learn a musical instrument, he or she first needs to acquire the necessary manipulative skills.
manipulative.zh: 儿童先要掌握一些必需的操作技能，然后才能学习演奏一种乐器。

mankind.en: Since earliest times, mankind has been fascinated by fire.
mankind.zh: 人类自远古以来就对火很感兴趣。

manner.en: It seemed rather an odd manner of deciding things.
manner.zh: 这样决定事情好像很奇怪。

manner.en: He felt some guilt over the manner of her death.
manner.zh: 她以这种方式死去，他心里有些内疚。

mannerism.en: He has the same mannerisms as his father.
mannerism.zh: 他举手投足跟他父亲一样。

manoeuvre.en: A careful driver will often stop talking before carrying out a complex manoeuvre.
manoeuvre.zh: 谨慎的司机在进行复杂的操作之前往往会停止说话。

manoeuvre.en: They tried by diplomatic maneuvers to obtain an agreement.
manoeuvre.zh: 他们利用了外交手段试图达成协议。

mantle.en: It is up to Europe to take on the mantle of leadership in environmental issues.
mantle.zh: 在环境问题上欧洲应该担当起领导责任。

mantle.en: A mantle of snow lay on the trees.

manual.en: People in manual occupations have a lower life expectancy.
manual.zh: 干体力活的人预期寿命较短。

manual.en: It would take too long to do a manual search of all the data.
manual.zh: 手动搜寻所有的资料太费时。

manufacture.en: If the media can manufacture stories like this, who are we supposed to believe?
manufacture.zh: 如果媒体可以编出这样的故事，我们还能相信谁呢？

manufacture.en: Cost will determine the methods of manufacture.

manufacturer.en: Read the manufacturer’s instructions before using your new dishwasher.
manufacturer.zh: 使用新洗碗机之前，请先阅读厂家的说明书。

manufacturer.en: The fridge was sent back to the manufacturers.
manufacturer.zh: 那台冰箱被退还给厂家了。

manuscript.en: I read his novel in manuscript.
Unfortunately, parts of the original manuscript have been lost.
manuscript.zh: 遗憾的是，部分原始手稿丢失了。

many.en: Many people have to use a car to travel to work.
many.zh: 许多人不得不开车上班。

map.en: According to the map we should turn left.
map.zh: 从地图上看，我们应该左拐。

map.en: I’m just trying to find Vancouver on the map.
map.zh: 我正设法在地图上找温哥华。

mar.en: Their wedding was marred by the death of Jenny’s mother a week earlier.
mar.zh: 一周之前珍妮母亲的过世使他们的婚礼蒙上了一层阴影。

mar.en: A frown marred his handsome features.
mar.zh: 紧锁的眉头破坏了他俊美的面容。

marathon.en: Garcia ran the marathon in just under three hours.
marathon.zh: 加西亚用了不到三小时就跑完了马拉松。

marathon.en: We finished the job but it was quite a marathon.
marathon.zh: 我们完成了那项工作，不过那简直就是一场马拉松。

marble.en: The columns were of white marble.

march.en: On 29 August the royal army marched into Inverness.
We marched 50 km across the foothills.
march.zh: 我们穿过山麓丘陵行进了50

margin.en: Someone had scribbled a note in the margin.
margin.zh: 有人在页边写了条批注。

margin.en: Use double spacing and wide margins to leave room for comments.
margin.zh: 采用双倍行距和宽阔的页边空白，以便留出地方写评注。

marginal.en: The album contains too many songs by marginal bands.
marginal.zh: 这张专辑中收入太多非主流乐队演唱的歌曲。

maritime.en: San Francisco has lost nearly all of its maritime industry.
maritime.zh: 旧金山几乎失去了所有海运业。

mark.en: I’ve marked the pages you need to look at.
mark.zh: 我把你需要看的几页做了记号。

mark.en: When you’re done, put your sheet in the envelope marked with your name.
mark.zh: 做完后将纸放进写有你名字的信封里。

marked.en: The patient showed a marked improvement in her condition after changing medication.
marked.zh: 换药治疗后病人的病情明显好转。

marked.en: Miller’s organized desk stood in marked contrast to the rest of the office.
marked.zh: 米勒的桌子上整理得井井有条，和办公室里的其他桌子形成明显的对比。

market.en: I usually buy all my vegetables at the market.
market.zh: 我通常都是在菜市场里购买蔬菜。

market.en: There’s a good antiques market here on Sundays.
market.zh: 每逢周日这里都会有一个不错的古玩集市。

marketable.en: The program is designed to provide students with real, marketable skills.
marketable.zh: 本计划旨在让学生掌握符合市场需求的真正技能。

marketing.en: Company sales improved dramatically following a $2 million marketing campaign.
marketing.zh: 公司投入两百万美元搞了一个营销活动之后，销售额显著提高。

marketing.en: Cushman is director of marketing for a chain of Italian restaurants.
marketing.zh: 库什曼是一家意大利连锁饭店的营销经理。

marketplace.en: Some retailers worry that new regulations will hurt their ability to compete in the marketplace.
marketplace.zh: 有些零售商担心新规定会削弱他们的市场竞争力。

marking.en: The marking on the road is unclear.
This dolphin is noted for its distinctive black and white markings.
marking.zh: 这种海豚以其独特的黑白斑纹著称。

maroon.en: The car broke down and left us marooned in the middle of nowhere.
maroon.zh: 汽车抛锚，把我们困在了荒郊野外。

marriage.en: She has three daughters from a previous marriage.
marriage.zh: 她前一次婚姻生了三个女儿。

marriage.en: In Denmark they have legalized marriage between gay couples.
marriage.zh: 丹麦已经将同性婚姻合法化。

married.en: They’ve been married for eight years.

marry.en: I’m going to ask her to marry me on St Valentine’s Day.
marry.zh: 我打算在情人节向她求婚。

marsh.en: The crane lives in marshy habitats.

marshal.en: Heston has been named grand marshal of the parade.
marshal.zh: 赫斯顿被任命为这次游行的司礼官。

marshal.en: I could see a marshal on the finish line waving a yellow flag.
marshal.zh: 我看到一名主事官在终点线摇动黄旗。

martyr.en: St Stephen, the first Christian martyr
martyr.zh: 圣司提反，第一个基督教殉道者

martyr.en: He was a martyr to the cause of racial harmony.
martyr.zh: 他是为种族和谐事业献身的烈士。

marvel.en: I marvelled at my mother’s ability to remain calm in a crisis.
marvel.zh: 我佩服母亲处变不惊的本领。

marvel.en: Visitors to Rome marvel over the beauty of the city.
marvel.zh: 到罗马的游客都对这座城市的美丽赞叹不已。

marvellous.zh: 我们度过了美好的时光。

marvellous.en: I can’t stand him, but my wife thinks he’s marvellous.
marvellous.zh: 我受不了他，但我的妻子认为他很了不起。

masculine.en: They’re nice curtains, but I’d prefer something a little more masculine.
masculine.zh: 这些窗帘很好，但我更喜欢男性化一点的。

masculine.en: She has a very masculine voice.

masculinity.en: Children’s ideas of masculinity tend to come from their fathers.
masculinity.zh: 儿童的男性观念往往来自他们的父亲。

mask.en: He was attacked and robbed by two people wearing masks.
mask.zh: 他被两个蒙面人袭击并抢劫。

mask.en: Her sarcasm is a mask for her insecurity.
mask.zh: 她讽刺挖苦是为了掩饰她的不安全感。

masonry.en: Several people were buried under falling masonry.
masonry.zh: 好几个人被埋在倒塌的砖石下面。

masquerade.en: She didn’t really love him, but she kept up the masquerade for the children’s sake.
masquerade.zh: 她并不真的爱他，但为了孩子她一直在伪装。

masquerade.en: A number of police officers masqueraded as demonstrators.
masquerade.zh: 一些警察伪装成游行示威者。

mass.en: The food had congealed into a sticky mass.
mass.zh: 那食物结成了黏糊糊的一团。

mass.en: Masses of books covered every surface in the room.
mass.zh: 许多许多的书摊满了整个房间。

massacre.en: The army massacred more than 150 unarmed civilians.

massage.en: Why don’t you have a massage?

massive.en: The bell is massive, weighing over 40 tons.
My phone bill was massive last month.
massive.zh: 上个月我的电话费数额巨大。

mass media.en: The crime received heavy coverage in the mass media.
mass media.zh: 这桩罪案受到大众传媒的广泛报道。

master.en: Runyon was a master of the short story.
master.zh: 鲁尼恩是一位短篇小说大师。

master.en: Hitchcock was an acknowledged master of suspense.
master.zh: 希区柯克是公认的悬疑大师。

masterpiece.en: Mary Shelley was just 18 when she wrote the horror masterpiece ‘Frankenstein’.
The shark is a masterpiece of evolution.
masterpiece.zh: 鲨鱼是进化的典型例子。

mastery.en: She possesses complete technical mastery of her instrument.
mastery.zh: 她能非常娴熟地演奏她的乐器。

mat.en: Wipe your feet on the mat.
mat.zh: 在地垫上蹭蹭你的鞋底。

mat.en: The mayor is willing to go to the mat on this issue.
mat.zh: 市长决心在这件事上全力以赴。

match.en: It’s our last match of the season.
match.zh: 这是我们本赛季最后一场比赛。

match.en: They’re preparing for a big (=important) match tomorrow.
match.zh: 他们在为明天的一场大赛做准备。

mate.en: Dad’s office mates are throwing a party for him.
mate.zh: 爸爸的同事要为他办个聚会。

mate.en: I’m going out with my mates tonight.
mate.zh: 今天晚上我要跟朋友们出去。

material.en: Animals depend on plant material for food.
Videos often make good teaching material.
material.zh: 录像常常可用作很好的教学材料。

materialism.en: We confess to being hopeless materialists, surrounded by our own cool stuff.
materialism.zh: 我们承认自己是无可救药的物质主义者，四周都是我们自己的精美物品。

materialize.en: Problems were expected, but they never materialized.
materialize.zh: 估计会有问题，但一直没有发生。

materialize.en: The money we had been promised failed to materialize.
materialize.zh: 答应给我们的钱并没有兑现。

maternal.en: Annie was wonderfully warm and maternal.
She seems to have a strong maternal instinct (=desire to have babies and take care of them).

mathematical.en: The whole trip was planned with mathematical precision.
mathematical.zh: 整个旅行计划得十分周密。

maths.en: She got top marks in maths and chemistry.
maths.zh: 她数学和化学得了最高分。

matriculate.en: Aged only 15, he matriculated at the University of Leipzig.

matrimony.en: They were joined together in holy matrimony.
matrimony.zh: 他们通过神圣的婚姻结合在一起。

matter.en: There are important matters we need to discuss.
matter.zh: 我们有更重要的事情需要讨论。

matter.en: The legal arrangements for the sale are a matter for negotiation.
matter.zh: 这笔买卖在法律上的安排需要经过谈判商定。

mature.en: Laura is very mature for her age.
mature.zh: 相对她的年龄来说劳拉是很成熟的。

mature.en: We’re mature enough to disagree on this issue but still respect each other.
mature.zh: 我们都很成熟，尽管我们对此事意见不同，但还是彼此尊重。

maturity.en: Beth shows a maturity way beyond her 16 years.
maturity.zh: 贝丝表现出一种远远超出她16

maturity.en: One day you’ll have the maturity to understand.
maturity.zh: 有一天等你长大后你就明白了。

maverick.en: He’s always been a bit of a maverick.

maw.en: Millions of dollars were poured into the maw of defense spending.
maw.zh: 数百万美元投进了国防开支这个无底洞。

maximize.en: The company’s main function is to maximize profit.
maximize.zh: 该公司的主要目的是要把利润最大化。

maximize.en: We need to maximize the space.

maximum.en: The car has a maximum speed of 120 mph.
maximum.zh: 这辆汽车的最高时速为120

maximum.en: They made maximum use of the resources available.
maximum.zh: 他们充分利用可获取的资源。

may.en: I may be late, so don’t wait for me.
may.zh: 我可能会迟到，所以别等我。

may.en: Some chemicals may cause environmental damage.
may.zh: 有些化学物品可能会给环境造成破坏。

maybe.en: Maybe it’s all just a big misunderstanding.
maybe.zh: 也许这只是一个很大的误会。

maybe.en: Maybe they’re right, but maybe not.
maybe.zh: 也许他们是对的，但也许不是。

meagre.en: He supplements his meager income by working on Saturdays.
meagre.zh: 他靠周六做工来补贴他微薄的收入。

meal.en: We must have a meal together some time.
meal.zh: 我们一定要找个时间一起吃顿饭。

meal.en: Dinner is the main meal of the day for most people.
meal.zh: 晚饭是大多数人一天中的主餐。

meander.en: The river meandered gently along the valley floor.
meander.zh: 那条河沿着谷底缓缓地蜿蜒而行。

meander.en: Cows still meander through these villages.
meander.zh: 奶牛依然在这些村庄里缓步穿行。

meaning.en: I don’t know the precise meaning of the word ‘gleaned’.
The meaning of her words was clear. We’d lost our jobs.
meaning.zh: 她的话意思很清楚，我们失业了。

meaningful.en: Without more data we cannot make a meaningful comparison of the two systems.
meaningful.zh: 如果没有更多的数据，我们就无法对这两个体系作有意义的比较。

meaningful.en: Teaching history to five-year-olds in a meaningful way can be very difficult.
meaningful.zh: 给五岁的孩子用他们能够明白的方式讲授历史很难。

meaningless.en: He said a few meaningless words to his hostess and looked around the room.
meaningless.zh: 他向女主人说了几句无关紧要的话，又环视了一下房间。

meaningless.en: Chinese characters are just meaningless symbols to me.
meaningless.zh: 汉字对我来说只是些无法理解的符号。

means.en: For most people, the car is still their main means of transport.
means.zh: 对大多数人来说汽车仍是他们主要的交通工具。

means.en: The only means of communication was sign language.
means.zh: 唯一的交流方法是手语。

meantime.en: The doctor will be here soon. In the meantime, try and relax.
meantime.zh: 医生很快就来，现在尽量放松一下。

meantime.en: I didn’t see her for another five years, and in the meantime she had got married and had a couple of kids.
meantime.zh: 我又有五年没见到她，在此期间她结了婚并生了几个孩子。

meanwhile.en: Cook the sauce over a medium heat until it thickens. Meanwhile start boiling the water for the pasta.
meanwhile.zh: 用中火把调味汁煮到变稠，同时烧水准备煮意大利面。

meanwhile.en: The flight will be announced soon. Meanwhile, please remain seated.
meanwhile.zh: 很快就要广播通知登机，在此期间请继续留在座位上。

measurable.en: The law has had little measurable effect since it was introduced two years ago.
measurable.zh: 这条法规自两年前推行以来收效甚微。

measurable.en: The company is working to make its environmental performance measurably better.
measurable.zh: 该公司正在努力使自己在环境保护方面的表现有较大进步。

measure.en: The rainfall was measured over a three-month period.
measure.zh: 对三个月内的降雨量进行了测量。

measure.en: She was being measured for her wedding dress.
measure.zh: 正在给她量尺寸做结婚礼服。

measurement.en: Take measurements of the room before you buy any new furniture.
measurement.zh: 买新家具之前要先量好房间的尺寸。

meat.en: I gave up eating meat a few months ago.
meat.zh: 我几个月以前开始不吃肉了。

meat.en: There’s no meat to their arguments.
meat.zh: 他们的论据里没有实质性的内容。

mechanic.en: The mechanics of the process are quite complex.
He is studying mechanics at college.
mechanic.zh: 他在大学里修读机械学。

mechanical.en: The flight has been cancelled due to mechanical failure.
mechanical.zh: 因机械故障航班被取消了。

mechanical.en: The plane had to make an emergency landing because of mechanical problems.
mechanical.zh: 飞机因机械故障不得不紧急降落。

mechanism.en: The Army has set up mechanisms to help jobless ex-soldiers get work.
mechanism.zh: 军队建立了帮助无工作的退伍军人找到工作的机制。

mechanism.en: When a person is ill, the body’s natural defence mechanisms come into operation.
mechanism.zh: 生病时，人体内的自然防御机制就会开始工作。

medal.en: She won a gold medal at the last Olympics.
medal.zh: 她在上届奥运会上赢得一枚金牌。

medal.en: The two boys were awarded medals for bravery.
medal.zh: 这两个男孩因勇敢而获得勋章。

meddle.en: I don’t like other people meddling in the way I run this prison.
meddle.zh: 我不喜欢别人干涉我怎么管理这个监狱。

meddle.en: He accused the US of meddling in China’s internal affairs.
meddle.zh: 他指责美国干涉中国内政。

media.en: The scandal was widely reported in the national media.
media.zh: 这一丑闻在全国媒体上被广泛报道。
