media.en: The role of the news media in forming public opinion is very important.
media.zh: 新闻媒体对于社会舆论的形成具有非常重要的作用。

mediate.en: UN officials mediated between the rebel fighters and the government.
mediate.zh: 联合国官员在叛军和政府之间进行了调解。

mediate.en: The former president has agreed to mediate the peace talks.
mediate.zh: 前总统同意就和谈进行斡旋。

medical.en: The injury required urgent medical attention.

medication.en: He’s on medication for high blood pressure.
medication.zh: 他正在服用治疗高血压的药。

medicinal.en: Garlic is believed to have medicinal properties (=contain things that can cure medical problems).
medicinal.zh: 大蒜被认为具有药用功效。

medicinal.en: I keep a bottle of brandy handy – purely for medicinal purposes.
medicinal.zh: 我手头经常备一瓶白兰地——

medicine.en: Medicines should be kept out of the reach of children.
medicine.zh: 药应放在孩子够不到的地方。

medicine.en: Have you been taking your medicine?

medieval.en: These spices were first brought to Italy from the East in medieval times.
medieval.zh: 这些香料最早是在中世纪时从东方被带到了意大利。

medieval.en: The plumbing in this house is positively medieval!
medieval.zh: 这座房子里的水管实在太陈旧了！

mediocre.en: I thought the book was pretty mediocre.
mediocre.zh: 我认为这本书非常一般。

meditate.en: She sat quietly, meditating on the day’s events.
meditate.zh: 她静静地坐着，思考着这一天发生的事。

meditate.en: I try to meditate for half an hour every evening.
meditate.zh: 我每天晚上尽量默想半小时。

meditation.en: Yoga involves breathing exercises, stretching, and meditation.
meditation.zh: 瑜伽包括呼吸训练、伸展和冥想。

meditation.en: She found him sitting alone, deep in meditation.
meditation.zh: 她发现他独自坐着，陷入沉思。

medium.en: What size shirt does he wear – small, medium or large?

meek.en: He was always so meek and mild.

meet.en: I’ll meet you by the main reception desk.

meeting.en: We’re having a meeting next week to discuss the matter.
meeting.zh: 我们下周将开会讨论此事。

meeting.en: I’ll raise the matter at the next meeting.
meeting.zh: 我会在下次会上提出这个问题。

melancholy.en: The music suited her melancholy mood.
melancholy.zh: 这音乐很适合她的伤感情绪。
他陷入深深的忧郁之中。

melange.en: The population is a melange of different cultures.
melange.zh: 这里的人口是各种不同文化群体的混合。

melodic.en: Their music is loud and not very melodic.
melodic.zh: 他们的音乐很响，而且不大悦耳。

melodic.en: There is very little melodic variation in the piece.
melodic.zh: 这首乐曲旋律变化不多。

melodious.en: He spoke in a quiet melodious voice.
melodious.zh: 他说话的声音轻柔悦耳。

melodrama.en: He was behaving like a character in a Victorian melodrama.
melodrama.zh: 他表现得就像维多利亚时代情节剧里的角色。

melodrama.en: Come on, there’s no need for all this melodrama.
melodrama.zh: 好了，没必要闹成这种样子。

melody.zh: 他们演奏了一些动听的曲子。

melt.en: It was warmer now, and the snow was beginning to melt.
melt.zh: 现在天气暖和了，雪开始融化。

melt.en: Melt the butter in a saucepan.
melt.zh: 把黄油放在深平底锅里化开。

meltdown.en: The stock market crash might lead to financial meltdown.
meltdown.zh: 证券市场狂跌可能会引发金融灾难。

member.en: The majority of union members voted in favour of a strike.
member.zh: 大多数工会成员投票赞成罢工。

member.en: You can also invite members of your family.

membership.en: Greece first applied for membership of the EU in 1975.
I forgot to renew my membership in the sailing club.
membership.zh: 我忘了去续办一下自己的航海俱乐部会员资格。

membrane.en: Loud noise can damage the delicate membrane in the ear.
membrane.zh: 很响的噪声会损伤脆弱的耳膜。

memento.en: I kept the bottle as a memento of my time in Spain.
memento.zh: 我留着这个瓶子是为了纪念我在西班牙度过的时光。

memo.en: I sent him a memo reminding him about the meeting.
memo.zh: 我发给他一个通知，提醒他开会的事。

memoir.en: Lady Thatcher had just published her memoirs.
memoir.zh: 撒切尔夫人刚刚出版了她的回忆录。

memorable.en: We want to make this a truly memorable day for the children.
memorable.zh: 我们想让今天成为孩子们永远难忘的日子。

memorial.en: The hospital was built as a memorial to King Edward VII.
memorial.zh: 该医院是为了纪念国王爱德华七世而建的。

memorial.en: An appeal has been launched to build a lasting memorial to the composer.
memorial.zh: 已经发出呼吁为这位作曲家建一座永久纪念碑。

memory.en: She has a terrible memory for names.
The pianist played the whole piece from memory.
memory.zh: 这位钢琴师凭记忆演奏了整首乐曲。

menace.en: It’s the only way to deal with the menace of drug dealing.
menace.zh: 对付毒品交易的威胁，这是唯一的方法。

menace.en: That man’s a menace to society. He should be locked away.
menace.zh: 那个男人对社会有威胁，他应该被锁起来。

mend.en: My father used to mend our shoes.
mend.zh: 我父亲过去常为我们修补鞋子。

mend.en: When are you going to mend that light in the hall?
mend.zh: 你打算什么时候修一修门厅里的那盏灯？

mental.en: The centre provides help for people suffering from mental illness.
mental.zh: 该中心对精神病患者提供帮助。

mental.en: Stress has an effect on both your physical and mental health.
mental.zh: 压力对身体健康和心理健康都有影响。

mentality.en: I can’t understand the mentality of the people who are behind this kind of violence.
mentality.zh: 我不能理解这种暴力行为的幕后指使者是什么心态。

mention.en: Was my name mentioned at all?
Some of the problems were mentioned in his report.
mention.zh: 其中的一些问题在他的报告里提到了。

menu.en: Could we have the menu, please?
Is there any fish on the menu?

mercenary.en: She did it for purely mercenary reasons.
mercenary.zh: 她这么做纯粹是为了钱。

merchandise.en: A range of official Disney merchandise was on sale.
merchandise.zh: 一系列正版的迪士尼商品在出售。
他们仔细地检查了商品。

merchant.en: He had a job with an Edinburgh wine merchant.
merchant.zh: 他在爱丁堡的一个葡萄酒商那里做过事。

merciful.en: I think my uncle’s death was a merciful release for my poor aunt.
merciful.zh: 我认为我叔叔的死对我可怜的婶婶来说是幸运的解脱。
仁慈的上帝，救救我们吧。

merciless.en: It brings some relief from the merciless summer heat.
merciless.zh: 它给夏天的酷热带来些许凉意。
他无情地戏弄他的姐姐。

mercury.en: Temperatures on Mercury reach as high as 700 K.

mercy.en: He showed no mercy to his enemies.
God have mercy on his soul.

mere.en: She lost the election by a mere 20 votes.

merely.en: He’s merely a boy – you can’t expect him to understand.

merge.en: The bank announced that it was to merge with another of the high street banks.
merge.zh: 这家银行宣布将要和另一家大银行合并。

merge.en: The company plans to merge its subsidiaries in the US.
merge.zh: 该公司计划合并其在美国的几家子公司。

merit.en: The film has the merit of being short.
merit.zh: 这部电影很短，这是个优点。

merit.en: The merit of the report is its realistic assessment of the changes required.
merit.zh: 这份报告的优点就是它对所要求的变动进行了实事求是的评估。

merriment.zh: 她的眼里闪现出愉快的神情。

merry.en: He marched off, whistling a merry tune.
merry.zh: 他吹着一首欢快的曲子大步走了。

merry.en: He’s a lovely man with merry eyes and a wide smile.
merry.zh: 他是个讨人喜欢的人，眼睛喜盈盈的，笑容满面。

mesh.en: The windows were covered in wire mesh to keep out flies.
mesh.zh: 窗户上装了铁丝纱网，防止苍蝇飞入。

mesh.en: She had felt trapped by the old mesh of loyalty and shame.
mesh.zh: 她感觉自己被忠贞和廉耻这张传统的网束缚住了。

mesmerize.en: The first time I saw Diana I was mesmerized by her beauty.
mesmerize.zh: 我第一次见到戴安娜就被她的美貌迷住了。

mess.en: Sorry – the place is a bit of a mess.
When I got home, the house was a complete mess.
mess.zh: 我回到家时，屋子里一片狼藉。

message.en: There’s a message from Karen on the answerphone.
message.zh: 电话答录机里有卡伦的留言。

message.en: I have an urgent message for you.
message.zh: 我有一条紧急消息要告诉你。

messy.en: Sorry the place is so messy, I haven’t had time to clear up.
messy.zh: 对不起，这地方又脏又乱，我一直没时间打扫。

messy.en: He’s just been through a particularly messy divorce.
messy.zh: 他刚刚经历了一场特别难办的离婚。

metabolic.en: Fish normally have a high metabolic rate.
metabolic.zh: 鱼类的新陈代谢速度一般都很快。

metabolic.en: Exercise can increase your metabolic rate.
metabolic.zh: 运动可以提高新陈代谢率。

metabolism.en: This drug speeds up your metabolism.
metabolism.zh: 这种药物会加快你的新陈代谢。

metabolism.en: The vast majority of alcohol metabolism occurs in the liver.
metabolism.zh: 酒精的代谢主要在肝脏进行。

metal.en: The gate is made of metal.
metal.zh: 这扇大门是用金属做成的。

metal.en: They traded in gold and other precious metals (=valuable metals used especially for making jewellery).
metal.zh: 他们做黄金和其他贵金属的交易。

metallic.en: The key turned in the lock with a loud metallic click.
metallic.zh: 钥匙在锁里转动发出金属撞击的咔嗒声。

metallic.en: The pans made a metallic clatter as they crashed to the floor.
metallic.zh: 那些锅哐啷一声摔到地上。

metalwork.en: Students can study woodwork or metalwork.
metalwork.zh: 学生可以学木工或金属加工。

metamorphic.en: This metamorphic rock has been compressed for millions of years.
metamorphic.zh: 这种变质岩已经过数百万年的压缩。

metaphor.en: She uses some wonderful images and metaphors in her writing.
metaphor.zh: 她在作品中用了一些绝妙的比喻和暗喻。

metaphor.en: Their relationship is a metaphor for the failure of communication in the modern world.
metaphor.zh: 他们的关系象征现代社会中存在的沟通障碍。

metaphysical.en: A lot of scientists don’t like discussing metaphysical matters.
metaphysical.zh: 很多科学家不喜欢讨论形而上学的东西。

meteor.en: Astronomers track large meteors using radar.
meteor.zh: 天文学家使用雷达跟踪大型流星。

meteoric.en: The company has experienced meteoric growth.
The scandal ended his meteoric political career.
meteoric.zh: 这桩丑闻结束了他平步青云的政治生涯。

meteorology.en: The storms have baffled meteorologists in the United States.
meteorology.zh: 这几场风暴难倒了美国气象学家。

meter.en: A man came to read the electricity meter.
The taxi driver left the meter running while I ran in to pick up my bags.
meter.zh: 我跑进去拿行李时，出租车司机让计价器继续走字。

methane.en: Methane is one of the principal gases contributing to the greenhouse effect.
methane.zh: 甲烷是造成温室效应的主要气体之一。

method.en: I think we should try again using a different method.
method.zh: 我想我们应该用不同的方法再试一次。

method.en: Today’s methods of birth control make it possible for a couple to choose whether or not to have a child.
method.zh: 现在的节育方法可以让夫妻自己选择是否要孩子。

methodical.en: He always checked every detail in a methodical way.
methodical.zh: 他总是有条不紊地检查每一个细节。
她是个办事很有条理的人。

methodology.en: We’ve been developing a new methodology for assessing new products.
methodology.zh: 我们一直在研究评估新产品的新方法。

methodology.en: There are some differences in methodology between the two studies.
methodology.zh: 这两项研究在方法上有些差异。

meticulous.en: Their planning and preparation were meticulous.
meticulous.zh: 他们的计划和准备工作都很周密。

metric.en: The parts all come in metric sizes now.
metric.zh: 现在配件都采用公制规格。

metro.en: It’ll be quicker to go on the metro.

metropolis.en: The city has become a huge, bustling metropolis.
metropolis.zh: 这座城市已变成繁忙的大都市。

microcosm.en: New York’s mix of people is a microcosm of America.
microcosm.zh: 纽约多元化的人口组成是美国社会的缩影。

microcosm.en: All the problems of society can be seen here in microcosm.
microcosm.zh: 所有社会问题在这里都有它的缩影。

microfilm.en: Most of the daily newspapers are available on microfilm.
microfilm.zh: 大多数日报可以通过缩微胶卷查阅。

microphone.en: She spoke confidently into the microphone.
microphone.zh: 她自信地对着麦克风说话。

microphone.en: They searched the room for hidden microphones.
microphone.zh: 他们在屋里翻找隐藏的话筒。

microscope.en: Abnormalities in the cells can be seen quite clearly under a microscope.
microscope.zh: 在显微镜下能非常清楚地观测到细胞的变异。

microscope.en: Each sample was examined through a microscope.
microscope.zh: 每个样本都用显微镜进行了检测。

microscopic.en: Inspectors discovered microscopic cracks in the hull of the submarine.
microscopic.zh: 检测人员发现潜艇的船身有细微的裂缝。

microscopic.en: The cells were identified through microscopic analysis.
microscopic.zh: 那些细胞通过显微镜分析被识别出来。

microwave.en: I’ll heat it up in the microwave.
microwave.zh: 我来把它用微波炉热一热。

microwave.en: You can heat it up under the grill or microwave it.
microwave.zh: 你可以用烤架或微波炉把它热一热。

midday.zh: 我是中午前后到那里的。

middle.en: We rowed out towards the middle of the lake.
Jo was standing in the middle of the room.

middleman.en: He acts as a middleman for British companies seeking contracts in the Gulf.
middleman.zh: 他给在海湾地区寻找商机的英国公司当中间人。

middleman.en: Buy direct from the manufacturer and cut out the middleman (=avoid using a middleman).
middleman.zh: 从厂家直接进货，绕开中间商。

midnight.en: The train is due in at midnight.
We stayed there until way after midnight.
midnight.zh: 我们在那里一直待到午夜过后很久。

midst.en: The government is in the midst of a major crisis.
midst.zh: 政府正处于重大危机时期。

midst.en: We were sitting in the midst of an elegant and well-dressed audience.
midst.zh: 我们坐在一群举止优雅、衣着考究的观众中间。

midway.en: The city is midway between Edinburgh and London.
midway.zh: 这座城市位于爱丁堡和伦敦中间。

midway.en: Leeds scored midway through the first half.
midway.zh: 利兹队在上半场进行到一半时得分。

might.en: I might be a few minutes late.
She might not want to come with us.
might.zh: 她可能不想和我们一起去。

mighty.en: You seem mighty sure of your facts.
mighty.zh: 你好像对自己掌握的事实非常肯定。

mighty.en: They got out of there mighty fast, I can tell you.
mighty.zh: 我告诉你，他们很快就离开了那里。

migrant.en: A lot of factory work is done by migrant workers.
migrant.zh: 许多工厂的工作都是流动工人干的。

mild.en: We had an exceptionally mild winter last year.
mild.zh: 去年冬天我们这里异常暖和。

mild.en: He suffered a mild heart attack.
mild.zh: 他心脏病轻度发作了一次。

mildly.en: The drug is only mildly addictive.
mildly.zh: 这种药物只会轻度致瘾。

mile.en: It’s forty miles from here to the Polish border.
We walked about half a mile.

mileage.en: Always check the mileage before you buy a secondhand car.
mileage.zh: 买二手车时一定要先查看行驶里程。

mileage.en: Look for a car hire agreement that offers unlimited mileage.
mileage.zh: 找一份能提供不限里程数的租车协议。

milestone.en: The treatment of diabetes reached a significant milestone in the 1970s.

milieu.en: Proust’s work reflected his own social and cultural milieu.
milieu.zh: 普鲁斯特的作品反映了其所在的社会和文化背景。

milieu.en: She never felt happy in a student milieu.
milieu.zh: 在学生中间她从不觉得快乐。

militant.en: After the assassination of Martin Luther King, black leaders became more militant.

military.en: The government has threatened to take military action if the rebels do not withdraw from the area.
military.zh: 政府警告说，如果叛乱分子不从该地区撤出，就要采取军事行动。

military.en: The United States is prepared to use military force to achieve its aims.
military.zh: 美国准备动用武力达成目的。

militia.en: He joined the local militia as soon as he was 16.

milk.en: Would you like some milk in your tea?
The tiny fox cubs drink nothing but their mother’s milk.

milky.en: His eyes were a pale milky blue.

mill.en: He’s really been through the mill recently.
It was a three-day course and they really put us through the mill.
mill.zh: 课程为期三天，他们对我们进行了非常严格的考查。

million.en: The book sold more than a million copies.
million.zh: 这本书售出了一百多万册。

million.en: Millions of pounds were lost in Western aid.
million.zh: 西方援助少了数百万英镑。

mime.en: The children learn through role-play, dance and mime.
mime.zh: 儿童通过角色表演、舞蹈和哑剧来学习。

mime.en: They will perform a short mime later.
mime.zh: 稍后他们将表演一个哑剧小品。

mimic.en: He could mimic all the teachers’ accents.
mimic.zh: 他能模仿所有老师的口音。

mimic.en: Europe should not try to mimic Japan: we have to find our own path to successful modernisation.
mimic.zh: 欧洲不应该试图模仿日本:

mince.en: Mince the meat up with some onion and garlic.
mince.zh: 把肉和些许洋葱、大蒜混合在一起剁碎。

mince.en: She was mincing about in her high-heeled shoes.
mince.zh: 她穿着高跟鞋扭扭捏捏地走着。

mind.en: It is impossible to understand the complex nature of the human mind.
mind.zh: 要想了解人类思维复杂的特性是不可能的。

mind.en: Mind and body are closely related.

mine.en: It was Glen’s idea, not mine.
mine.zh: 这是格伦的主意，不是我的。

mine.en: You’ve got good legs – mine are too thin.

mineral.en: The area is very rich in minerals.
Fish is a rich source of vitamins and minerals.
mineral.zh: 鱼富含维生素和矿物质。

mingle.en: Add the mint and allow the flavours to mingle.
mingle.zh: 加入薄荷，把各种味道混合起来。

mingle.en: Her perfume mingled with the smell of wood smoke from the fire.
mingle.zh: 她的香水味和炉火里木柴的烟味混合在一起。

miniature.en: He looked like a miniature version of his father.
miniature.zh: 他看上去像是他父亲的微缩版。

minimal.en: The storm caused only minimal damage
minimal.zh: 暴风雨只造成了轻微破坏。

minimal.en: The cost to taxpayers would be minimal.
minimal.zh: 纳税人的支出将是最少的。

minimize.en: Every effort is being made to minimize civilian casualties.
minimize.zh: 正在尽最大努力减少平民伤亡。

minimize.en: The rail company is bringing in more trains in an effort to minimize disruption to travellers.
minimize.zh: 铁路公司正投入更多的列车来减少旅客的不便。

minimum.en: The minimum number of students we need to run the course is fifteen.
minimum.zh: 我们开这门课程最少要有15

minimum.en: The minimum age for retirement is 55.

minister.en: Rev Wilson spent 20 years ministering in some of New York’s poorest areas.
minister.zh: 威尔逊牧师在纽约最贫困的一些地区当了20

minister.en: She spent much time ministering to the sick.
minister.zh: 她很多时间都在照顾病人。

ministerial.en: The project was approved at ministerial level.
ministerial.zh: 这一项目得到了部长级领导的批准。

ministry.en: Converted in his early teens, he entered the ministry (=started working as a church leader) in 1855.
ministry.zh: 他十三四岁皈依基督教，1855

minor.en: We have made some minor changes to the program.
minor.zh: 我们对那个程序做了一些小改动。

minor.en: They played only a minor role in local government.
minor.zh: 他们在当地政府里只是扮演次要角色。

minority.en: Gaelic is still spoken in Ireland by a minority.
minority.zh: 爱尔兰仍有极少数人在说盖尔语。

minority.en: Only a minority of people supported these new laws.
minority.zh: 只有少数人支持这些新法令。

mint.en: Decorate with a sprig of mint.
We sat in the back row, sucking mints.
mint.zh: 我们坐在后排，嘴里吮着薄荷糖。

minus.en: The payment will be refunded to you minus a small service charge.
minus.zh: 这笔款项扣除一小笔服务费后将退还给你。

minus.en: He came back minus a couple of front teeth.
minus.zh: 他回来时少了两颗门牙。

minute.en: It takes me ten minutes to walk to work.
minute.zh: 我步行上班要用十分钟。

minute.en: The train arrived at four minutes past eight.
minute.zh: 火车于八点零四分到达。

miracle.en: It’s a miracle you weren’t killed!
By some miracle, we managed to catch the plane.
miracle.zh: 我们奇迹般地赶上了飞机。

miraculous.en: She made a miraculous recovery from her injuries.
miraculous.zh: 她受伤后奇迹般地康复了。

miraculous.en: They had a miraculous escape when their car plunged into a river.
miraculous.zh: 他们的车冲入河里，而他们却奇迹般地逃生了。

mirage.en: Perhaps we are just chasing a mirage.
mirage.zh: 也许我们只是在追逐一个梦。

mire.en: The wheels got stuck in the mire.
The Party sank deeper into the mire of conflict.
mire.zh: 该党在冲突的泥潭里陷得更深了。

mirror.en: She was studying her reflection in the mirror.
mirror.zh: 她正在端详镜子中的自己。

mirror.en: He spends hours in front of the mirror!

misappropriate.en: He claimed the finance manager had misappropriated company funds.
misappropriate.zh: 他声称财务经理挪用了公司资金。

miscarriage.en: She had two miscarriages before she had her first child.
miscarriage.zh: 她生第一个孩子之前流产了两次。

miscarriage.en: One in five pregnancies ends in miscarriage.
miscarriage.zh: 有五分之一的妊娠以流产告终。

miscarry.en: She miscarried when she was 10 weeks pregnant.
Many babies with serious disabilities are miscarried.
miscarry.zh: 很多有严重缺陷的胎儿都会被流掉。

miscellaneous.en: They receive a grant of £1,094 to cover the cost of miscellaneous expenses.

mischance.en: If by some mischance the government get elected again, I think taxes will rise.
mischance.zh: 如果不幸这届政府再次当选，我想税收会提高。

mischief.en: Now run along, and don’t get into mischief.
They’ve got enough toys to keep them out of mischief for a while.
mischief.zh: 他们有足够的玩具玩，暂时不会捣蛋。

misconception.en: There is a popular misconception that too much exercise is bad for you.
misconception.zh: 很多人都有一种误解，认为锻炼太多对身体有害。

misconception.en: Refugees have the misconception that life is great over here.
misconception.zh: 难民误以为这里的生活很美好。

misdeed.en: He now repents of his past misdeeds.
misdeed.zh: 他现在对自己过去犯下的种种恶行感到懊悔。

miserable.en: I’ve been so miserable since Pat left me.
miserable.zh: 自从帕特离我而去后，我十分痛苦。

miserable.en: I spent the weekend feeling miserable.
miserable.zh: 我那个周末心情很糟糕。

misery.en: What we are witnessing here is human misery on a vast scale.
misery.zh: 我们在这里所目睹的情景是许许多多的人都生活困苦。

misery.en: She looked away so that Tom wouldn’t see her misery.
misery.zh: 她扭过头去，不让汤姆看到自己的痛苦。

misfortune.en: It seems the banks always profit from farmers’ misfortunes.
misfortune.zh: 银行似乎总是从农民的不幸中获益。

misfortune.en: The French soldiers had the misfortune to be caught in the crossfire.
misfortune.zh: 法军不幸陷入了交叉火力网。

misgiving.en: Despite her misgivings about leaving the baby, she decided to accompany her husband.
misgiving.zh: 尽管对于离开宝宝有所顾虑，但她还是决定陪伴丈夫。

misgiving.en: Some politicians have expressed grave misgivings about the scheme.
misgiving.zh: 一些政治家对这个计划表示了极大的疑虑。

misguided.en: He described the government’s economic policy as misguided.
misguided.zh: 他说政府的经济政策反而帮了倒忙。

misguided.en: His parents still clung to the misguided belief that his common sense would keep him out of serious trouble.
misguided.zh: 他的父母依然错误地认为他的常识能让他远离大的麻烦。

mishandle.en: The prime minister admitted that the crisis had been mishandled.
mishandle.zh: 首相承认此次危机处理不当。

mishandle.en: Some of the goods had been mishandled and damaged.
mishandle.zh: 有些货物因搬运不当受到了损坏。

mishap.en: I had a slight mishap with one of the glasses.
mishap.zh: 我犯了一个小小的错误，把其中的一个玻璃杯打破了。

mishap.en: Only one horse finished the course without mishap.
mishap.zh: 只有一匹马顺利地跑完全程。

misinterpret.en: Some parts of the report could be misinterpreted.
misinterpret.zh: 报告的某些部分可能会被误解。

misinterpret.en: She had misinterpreted his silence as anger.
misinterpret.zh: 她把他的沉默误解成生气。

mislead.en: Politicians have misled the public over the dangers of these chemicals.
mislead.zh: 政客们在这些化学品的危险性问题上误导了民众。

mislead.en: Don’t be misled by appearances, he’s a good worker.
mislead.zh: 不要被表象迷惑，他工作干得挺不错的。

misleading.en: The article was misleading, and the newspaper has apologized.
misleading.zh: 那篇文章具有误导性，那家报纸已致歉。
这些数据具有很大的误导性。

misrepresent.en: These statistics grossly misrepresent the reality.
misrepresent.zh: 这些统计资料严重歪曲了实际情况。

miss.en: I’m absolutely starving – I missed lunch.
He missed 20 games after breaking a bone in his wrist.
miss.zh: 由于手腕骨折，他错过了20

missile.en: Demonstrators threw missiles at the police.
missile.zh: 游行示威者向警察投掷杂物。

missing.en: We found the missing piece of the jigsaw under the chair.
missing.zh: 我们在椅子下面找到了那块丢失的拼图。

missing.en: The keys have been missing for ages.

mission.en: He was sent on over 200 missions before being killed in action.
mission.zh: 在阵亡之前他奉命执行过200

mission.en: US troops taking part in the peacekeeping mission

mist.en: We could just see the outline of the house through the mist.
mist.zh: 薄雾中我们只能看到房子的轮廓。

mistake.en: We may have made a mistake in our calculations.
mistake.zh: 我们的计算中可能有一处算错了。

mistake.en: The most common mistake is to plant them too deep.
mistake.zh: 最常见的错误就是把它们种得太深了。

mistaken.en: It can’t have been my car. You must be mistaken.
mistaken.zh: 那不可能是我的车，你一定弄错了。

mistaken.en: I thought he said 12 o'clock, but I might have been mistaken.

mistress.en: The prince had shocked society by living openly with his mistress.
mistress.zh: 王子和他的情妇公开同居，让社会大为震惊。

mistress.en: The maid looked nervously at her mistress.
mistress.zh: 女仆紧张地看着女主人。

mistrust.en: He had a deep mistrust of the legal profession.
As a very small child she had learned to mistrust adults.
mistrust.zh: 她很小的时候就学会了不相信大人。

misty.en: He paused, his eyes growing misty.
misty.zh: 他停顿了一下，双眼变得模糊起来。

misty.en: Whenever Maria sees a picture of her mother, she gets misty-eyed.
misty.zh: 玛丽亚每次看到她母亲的照片都会泪眼模糊。

misunderstand.en: Rachel, you must have misunderstood her! Ellie would never say something like that.
misunderstand.zh: 雷切尔，你一定是误会她了！埃莉绝不会说那样的话。

misunderstand.en: Don’t misunderstand me. She’s a very nice person when you get to know her.
misunderstand.zh: 不要误解我的意思。你了解她后就会知道她是个很好的人。

misunderstanding.en: There must have been some misunderstanding. I didn’t order all these books.
misunderstanding.zh: 一定是弄错了，这些书不全是我订的。

misunderstanding.en: Terry had a little misunderstanding with the police last night.
misunderstanding.zh: 昨晚特里和警察有个小小的误会。

misuse.en: Even harmless drugs can be misused.
misuse.zh: 即使是无毒副作用的药物也有使用不当的时候。

mite.en: Poor mite! You must be starving!
mite.zh: 可怜的小家伙！你一定是饿坏了！

mitigate.en: Measures need to be taken to mitigate the environmental effects of burning more coal.
mitigate.zh: 需要采取措施来减轻燃煤增加对环境造成的影响。

mix.en: Shake the bottle well so that the oil mixes with the vinegar.
mix.zh: 充分摇动瓶子使油和醋混合。

mixer.en: We can use tonic water or orange juice as mixers.
mixer.zh: 我们可以用奎宁水或橙汁来调酒。

mixer.en: Media people need to be good mixers and good talkers.
mixer.zh: 传媒工作者要善于交际、能说会道。

mixture.en: The town is a mixture of the old and the new.
She felt a strange mixture of excitement and fear.
mixture.zh: 她有一种既兴奋又害怕的奇怪感觉。

moan.en: A lot of people moaned about the parking problems.
moan.zh: 很多人抱怨停车难的问题。

moan.en: My mum never stops moaning at me.
moan.zh: 我妈总是没完没了地对我发牢骚。

mob.en: They were immediately surrounded by the mob.
mob.zh: 他们立刻被那帮暴民包围了。

mob.en: The leadership had been criticized for giving in to mob rule (=when a mob controls the situation rather than the government or the law).
mob.zh: 领导层被批评屈服于暴民统治。

mobile.en: Give me a call on my mobile.
Have you got my mobile number?

mobility.en: There is greater mobility of labour (=movement of workers) between jobs and areas.
mobility.zh: 工作岗位之间和地区之间的劳动力流动性更大了。

mobility.en: It improves the strength and mobility of joints.
mobility.zh: 它能提高关节的力量和灵活性。

mobilize.en: They failed to mobilize their resources effectively.
mobilize.zh: 他们没有有效地调动资源。

mobilize.en: The physiotherapist mobilizes the patient’s shoulder.
mobilize.zh: 物理治疗师帮助病人活动肩膀。

mock.en: Opposition MPs mocked the government’s decision.
mock.zh: 反对党议员讥笑政府的这一决策。

mock.en: It’s easy for you to mock, but we put a lot of work into this play.
mock.zh: 你讲风凉话是很轻松，但我们这出戏可是费了很大力气的。

mode.en: They have a relaxed mode of life that suits them well.
mode.zh: 他们过着悠闲的生活，很适合他们。

model.en: They showed us a model of the building.
model.zh: 他们向我们展示了大楼的模型。

model.en: Renault are introducing three new models at the show.
model.zh: 雷诺公司将在这次展会上推出三款新车型。

moderate.en: Even moderate amounts of alcohol can be dangerous.
moderate.zh: 喝酒即使不多也会有危险。

moderate.en: Moderate exercise, such as walking, is recommended.
moderate.zh: 建议适度锻炼，比如散步。

moderately.en: He did moderately well in the exams.

moderation.en: Some people think drinking in moderation can prevent heart disease.
moderation.zh: 有些人认为适量饮酒可以预防心脏病。

moderation.en: Moderation in diet is the way to good health.

modern.en: Such companies must change if they are to compete in the modern world.
modern.zh: 此类公司如果想在现代社会中与别人竞争，就必须有所改变。

modern.en: They are the youngest children in modern times to face murder charges.
modern.zh: 他们是近代面临谋杀指控儿童中年龄最小的。

modern-day.en: She’s a modern-day Joan of Arc.
The modern-day diet has too little fiber in it.
modern-day.zh: 现代人的饮食中纤维含量太少。

modernize.en: They need more funds to modernize the country’s telephone system.
modernize.zh: 他们需要更多的资金将本国的电话系统现代化。

modernize.en: The business will lose money if it doesn’t modernize.
modernize.zh: 这家企业如果不实行现代化就要赔钱。

modest.en: He was always modest about his role in the Everest expedition.
modest.zh: 他对自己在那次珠峰探险中所起的作用总是很谦虚。

modest.en: You’re too modest! You’ve been a huge help to us.
modest.zh: 你太谦虚了！你帮了我们大忙呢。

modesty.en: I think in all modesty that I can take some small credit for the team’s success.
modesty.zh: 不是我自夸，我想团队的成功有我一份小小的功劳。

modification.en: We’ve made one or two modifications to the original design.
modification.zh: 我们对原先的设计做了一两处修改。

modification.en: They have used the same process for almost 50 years with only minor modifications.
modification.zh: 同样的工序他们用了将近50

modify.en: The feedback will be used to modify the course for next year.
modify.zh: 这些反馈意见将用于修改明年的课程。

modify.en: The regulations can only be modified by a special committee.
modify.zh: 这些法规只能由特别委员会来修改。

modulate.en: These drugs modulate the disease process.
modulate.zh: 这些药物能控制病情的发展。

module.en: You choose five modules in the first year.
module.zh: 第一年你要选择五个单元。

moist.en: Make sure the soil is moist before planting the seeds.
moist.zh: 播种之前要确保土壤湿润。

moist.en: Her eyes were moist (=she was almost crying).

moisten.en: Moisten the clay if it seems too dry.
moisten.zh: 如果黏土太干，就把它润润湿。

moisten.en: She moistened her lips (=made her lips wet with her tongue).

moisture.en: Plants use their roots to absorb moisture from the soil.
moisture.zh: 植物利用根从土壤中吸收水分。

moisture.en: Your skin’s moisture content varies according to weather conditions.
moisture.zh: 皮肤的水分含量随着天气状况而变化。

molecule.en: The molecules of oxygen gas contain just two atoms.
molecule.zh: 氧分子中只有两个原子。

mom.en: Mom, can I go over to Lisa’s house?
mom.zh: 妈妈，我能到莉萨家去吗？

mom.en: My mom says I have to stay home tonight.
mom.zh: 我妈说我今晚得待在家里。

moment.en: It was one of the most exciting moments in his life.
moment.zh: 这是他一生中最激动人心的时刻之一。

moment.en: Just at that moment there was a knock on the door.

momentarily.en: She was momentarily lost for words.
Mr Johnson will be with you momentarily.

momentous.en: Momentous events are taking place in the US.
momentous.zh: 美国正在发生重大事件。

momentous.en: His colleagues all recognized that this was a momentous occasion.
momentous.zh: 他的同事都认识到这是一个重要时刻。

momentum.en: The campaign for reform should start to gather momentum in the new year.
momentum.zh: 要求进行改革的运动在新的一年里声势应该会壮大。

momentum.en: Governments often lose momentum in their second term of office.
momentum.zh: 政府往往会在第二届任期中丧失冲劲。

monarchy.en: People are going to be questioning the role of the monarchy more and more.
monarchy.zh: 人们会越来越质疑君主和王室的作用。

monday.en: The president announced Monday that he would cancel the debt.
monday.zh: 总统周一宣布他会取消这笔债务。

money.en: Don’t spend all your money on the first day of your holiday!
money.zh: 别在度假的第一天就把钱都花完了！

money.en: The repairs will cost quite a lot of money.

monitor.en: Patients who are given the new drug will be asked to monitor their progress.
monitor.zh: 使用这种新药的病人将被要求监测病情进展。

monitor.en: The government is monitoring the situation closely.
monitor.zh: 政府正密切关注着局势。

monkey.zh: 别这样，你这个小淘气鬼！

monkey.en: To be honest I don’t give a monkey’s what they do.
monkey.zh: 说实话，我一点都不在乎他们做什么。

monochrome.en: We looked out over the grey, monochrome landscape.
monochrome.zh: 我们向外面那一片灰蒙蒙的大地望去。

monologue.en: Henry looked up, then continued his monologue.
monologue.zh: 亨利抬起头，然后继续他的长篇独白。

monopolize.en: The company has monopolized the soft drinks market.
monopolize.zh: 该公司垄断了软饮料市场。

monopolize.en: He monopolized the conversation all evening.
monopolize.zh: 整个晚上都是他一个人在说话。

monopoly.en: They are demanding an end to the Communist Party’s monopoly of power.
monopoly.zh: 他们要求结束工党的一党专政。

monopoly.en: For years Bell Telephone had a monopoly on telephone services in the US.
monopoly.zh: 贝尔电话公司曾多年垄断美国的电话业务。

monotonous.en: The rain poured monotonously out of the grey sky.
monotonous.zh: 灰色的天空中，大雨没完没了地下着。

monotony.en: She wanted to escape the monotony of her everyday life.
monotony.zh: 她想摆脱每天一成不变的单调生活。

monotony.en: He suggested a card game to relieve the monotony of the journey.
monotony.zh: 他建议在旅途中打纸牌解闷。

monster.en: Only a monster could kill all those women.
monster.zh: 只有恶魔才会杀害那些妇女。

monster.en: I’ve got to get home and feed this little monster.
monster.zh: 我得回家喂这个小捣蛋了。

monstrous.en: It’s monstrous to charge that much for a hotel room.
monstrous.zh: 一间宾馆客房要收那么多钱真是太过分了。

monstrous.en: Such monstrous injustice is hard to understand.
monstrous.zh: 如此骇人听闻的枉法不公让人难以理解。

month.en: Phil is coming home for a visit next month.
month.zh: 菲尔下个月要回家来看看。

monthly.en: The mortgage is payable in monthly instalments.
monthly.zh: 抵押贷款每月分期偿还。

monthly.en: They meet monthly to discuss progress.
monthly.zh: 他们每月碰一次头讨论进展情况。

monument.en: He erected a monument on the spot where his daughter was killed.
monument.zh: 他在女儿遇难的地方立了块纪念碑。

monument.en: Ancient monuments are protected by law.

monumental.en: Charles Darwin’s monumental study, ‘The Origin of Species’
Banks and building societies were yesterday accused of monumental incompetence.
monumental.zh: 银行和购房互助协会昨天被指责极其不称职。

mood.en: You’re in a good mood this morning!
mood.zh: 你今天早晨心情不错啊！

mood.en: He’s been in a real mood all day.
mood.zh: 他一整天心情都很不好。

moody.en: Keith had seemed moody all morning.
moody.zh: 基思好像整个早上都不高兴。

moody.en: Lewis was moody and brilliantly clever.
moody.zh: 刘易斯喜怒无常，但是非常聪明。

moon.en: The Americans landed on the Moon in 1969.
The moon appeared from behind a cloud.

moonlight.en: The water looked silver in the moonlight.
moonlight.zh: 月光下，水面一片银白色。

moonlight.en: The hills were bathed in pale moonlight.
moonlight.zh: 群山沐浴在淡淡的月光中。

moor.en: They went grouse shooting up on the moors.
Two or three fishing boats were moored alongside the pier.
moor.zh: 有两三艘渔船停泊在码头边。

mop.en: He ran a hand through his mop of fair hair.
mop.zh: 他用手拢了拢他那浓密的金发。

mop.en: She carried on mopping the floor.

moral.en: It is easy to have an opinion on a moral issue like the death penalty for murder.
moral.zh: 对于判谋杀犯死刑这种涉及伦理道德的问题，有个观点并非难事。

moral.en: I think you can run a business to the highest moral standards.
moral.zh: 我想你可以用最高的道德标准来经营公司。

morale.en: A win is always good for morale.
morale.zh: 胜利总是可以鼓舞士气。

morale.en: The failed coup caused a loss of morale within the army.
morale.zh: 政变未遂挫伤了军队的士气。

moralistic.en: It’s difficult to talk to teenagers about drugs without sounding too moralistic.
moralistic.zh: 跟青少年谈论毒品，又不能有太重的说教味道，这是很难的。

morality.en: The authorities are protectors of public morality.
morality.zh: 当权者是公众道德的捍卫者。

morally.en: What you did wasn’t illegal, but it was morally wrong.
morally.zh: 你做的事并不违法，但从道义上讲是不对的。

morally.en: There is a belief that village life is somehow morally superior to city life.
morally.zh: 有些人认为乡村生活在道德方面从某种程度上说高于城市生活。

morbid.en: The trip was made all the worse by Frankie’s morbid fear of flying.
morbid.zh: 弗朗基对坐飞机有种病态的恐惧，使得旅途变得更加糟糕。

morbid.en: His head was full of morbid thoughts.
morbid.zh: 他的脑袋里全是不健康的思想。

more.en: You’ll have to be more careful next time.
Can’t it be done more quickly?

moreover.en: The rent is reasonable and, moreover, the location is perfect.
moreover.zh: 租金合理，而且位置也非常好。

moreover.en: The source of the information is irrelevant. Moreover, the information need not be confidential.
moreover.zh: 信息来源无关紧要，而且也不一定必须是机密的。

morning.en: I hated those cold winter mornings.
morning.zh: 我讨厌冬天里寒冷的早晨。

morning.en: I’m not feeling very well this morning.
morning.zh: 今天早上我觉得不大舒服。

mortal.en: Her father’s death reminded her that she was mortal.
mortal.zh: 父亲的去世让她认识到终有一天她也会死去。

mortal.en: The computer has dealt a mortal blow to traditional printing methods.

mortar.en: A cameraman was killed when his vehicle came under mortar fire.
mortar.zh: 一名摄影师因所乘坐的汽车遭到迫击炮袭击而丧生。

mortar.en: You’ll need a pestle and mortar to grind the spices.
mortar.zh: 你需要杵和臼来研磨香料。

mortgage.en: Your building society or bank will help arrange a mortgage.
mortgage.zh: 你加入的购房互助协会或银行将会给你安排抵押贷款。

mortgage.en: They’ve taken out a 30-year mortgage (=they will pay for their house over a period of 30 years).

mosaic.en: The forest floor was a mosaic of autumn colours.
mosaic.zh: 森林的地面上秋色斑斓，犹如一幅马赛克拼图。

most.en: She’s one of the most experienced teachers in the district.
most.zh: 她是该地区最有经验的教师之一。

most.en: The most important thing is to stay calm.

mostly.en: Green teas are mostly from China or Japan.
mostly.zh: 绿茶主要来自中国或日本。

mostly.en: There were about fifteen people in the lounge, mostly women.

mother.en: His mother and father are both doctors.
Janet is a full-time teacher and a mother of two.
mother.zh: 珍妮特是全职教师，还是两个孩子的母亲。

motherly.en: She was a plump, motherly woman in her fifties.
motherly.zh: 她五十多岁，身材丰满，是个慈母般的女人。

motif.en: The theme of creation is a recurrent motif in Celtic mythology.
motif.zh: 天地万物的创造是凯尔特神话中反复出现的主题。

motion.en: The rocking motion of the boat made Sylvia feel sick.
motion.zh: 小船晃来晃去，使西尔维娅感到恶心。

motionless.en: The men stood motionless as Weir held his finger to his lips.
motionless.zh: 韦尔用手指按住嘴唇，那些人便一动不动地站住了。

motivate.en: Was he motivated solely by a desire for power?
motivate.zh: 他只是受到权欲的驱使吗？

motivate.en: We may never know what motivated him to kill his wife.
motivate.zh: 我们也许永远不会知道他谋杀妻子的动机是什么。

motivation.en: Jack is an intelligent pupil, but he lacks motivation.
motivation.zh: 杰克是一个很聪明的学生，但学习不够主动。

motivation.en: What was your motivation for becoming a teacher?

motive.en: What do you suppose the killer’s motive was?
motive.zh: 你认为凶手的动机是什么？

motive.en: The police believe the motive for this murder was jealousy.
motive.zh: 警方认为这宗谋杀案的动机是嫉妒。

motor.en: That’s a nice motor you’ve got, Dave.
Bertie is motoring down from London.

mould.en: Another method, used especially for figures, was to pour the clay into a mould.
mould.zh: 另一个方法是把黏土倒入模具中，尤其用于铸造人像。

mould.en: She didn’t quite fit into the standard ‘high-flying businesswoman’ mould.
mould.zh: 她并不完全属于商场女强人的类型。

mound.en: There’s a mound of papers on my desk.
The waiter appeared with a huge mound of spaghetti.
mound.zh: 服务生端着满满一大盘意大利面出现了。

mount.en: The National Gallery mounted an exhibition of Danish painting.
mount.zh: 国家美术馆举办了丹麦画展。

mount.en: Friends of the Earth are mounting a campaign to monitor the illegal logging of trees.

mountain.en: She was the first British woman to climb the mountain.
mountain.zh: 她是攀登这座山峰的第一位英国女子。

mountain.en: I’ve got mountains of paperwork to deal with.
mountain.zh: 我有大量文案工作要做。

mountainous.en: They were struggling with mountainous debts.
mountainous.zh: 他们背负着沉重的债务艰难打拼。

mountainside.en: Great rocks rolled down the mountainside.
mountainside.zh: 巨大的岩石顺着山坡滚落下来。

mounting.en: There was mounting pressure on him to resign.
mounting.zh: 要求他辞职的压力越来越大。

mounting.en: The government has come under mounting criticism in the press.
mounting.zh: 政府受到新闻界越来越多的批评。

mourn.en: Hundreds of people gathered to mourn the slain president.
mourn.zh: 成百上千人聚集在一起悼念遇刺的总统。

mourn.en: They mourned for their children, killed in the war.
mourn.zh: 他们悼念在战争中死去的孩子。

mournful.en: Durant was thin, mournful and silent.
mournful.zh: 杜兰特很消瘦，神情悲伤，沉默不语。

mourning.en: The Armenian authorities declared May 29 a national day of mourning.
It was the custom to visit those in mourning and sit quietly with them.
mourning.zh: 按习俗要去看望服丧者，陪他们静坐。

mouse.en: The cat laid a dead mouse at my feet.
mouse.zh: 猫把一只死老鼠放在我的脚边。

mouse.en: Select the printer icon and then click the left mouse button.
mouse.zh: 选择打印机图标，然后点击鼠标左键。

mouth.en: He lifted his glass to his mouth.
Liam was fast asleep with his mouth wide open.
mouth.zh: 利亚姆大张着嘴，睡得很熟。

mouthful.en: Michael told his story between mouthfuls.
mouthful.zh: 迈克尔边吃边讲他的故事。

mouthful.en: Betty drank a mouthful of beer.

move.en: Please keep the doors closed while the train is moving.
move.zh: 火车行驶时请保持车门关闭。

move.en: Could you move your car, please? It’s blocking the road.
move.zh: 你能把车挪一下吗？挡着路了。

movement.en: Mendes led a movement to stop destruction of the rain forest.
movement.zh: 门德斯领导一个阻止破坏雨林的运动。

movement.en: A slight movement of the curtains showed where she was hiding.
movement.zh: 窗帘稍微动了一下，暴露了她藏身的位置。

movie.en: It was like one of those old John Wayne movies.
She once played the innocent victim in a horror movie.
movie.zh: 她曾在一部恐怖电影里扮演无辜的受害人。

mow.en: It’s time to mow the lawn again.
The soldiers were mown down by machine-gun fire.

much.en: Henry’s room is much bigger than mine.
much.zh: 亨利的房间比我的大得多。

much.en: These shoes are much more comfortable.

mud.en: By the end of the game, all the kids were covered in mud.
mud.zh: 到了比赛快结束的时候，所有的孩子都浑身是泥。

mud.en: The path beside the river was slippery with mud.

muddle.en: I’m in such a muddle, I’d completely forgotten you were coming today.
muddle.zh: 我真糊涂透了，我完全忘了你今天要来。

muddle.en: My grandmother tends to get into a muddle over names.
muddle.zh: 我祖母总是记不清名字。

muddy.en: Take your boots off outside if they’re muddy.
muddy.zh: 要是靴子上都是泥，你就脱在门外吧。

muddy.en: On the issue of education, the difference between the two parties is muddy.
muddy.zh: 在教育问题上，两个政党的差别不明显。

muffle.en: The falling snow muffled the sound of our footsteps.
muffle.zh: 飘落的雪使我们的脚步声变得低沉。

muffle.en: Her voice was muffled by the pillow in which she had hidden her face.
muffle.zh: 她把脸埋在枕头里，声音闷闷的。

mug.en: Only a mug would pay that much for a meal.
mug.zh: 只有傻瓜才会为一顿饭花那么多钱。

multiple.en: Baxter was rushed to the hospital with multiple stab wounds.
multiple.zh: 巴克斯特因多处刺伤被紧急送往医院。

multiple.en: Having multiple partners increases your risk of sexual diseases.
multiple.zh: 性伴侣多会增加得性病的风险。

multiply.en: Children will learn to multiply in the second grade.
multiply.zh: 儿童在二年级学习乘法。

multitude.en: I had never seen such a multitude of stars before.
multitude.zh: 我以前从未见过这么多的星星。

multitude.en: Political power has been placed in the hands of the multitude.
multitude.zh: 政治权力已交到民众手中。

mumble.en: He bumped into someone and mumbled an apology.
mumble.zh: 他撞到一个人，咕哝着道了歉。

mumble.en: A woman on the corner was mumbling to herself.
mumble.zh: 角落里有个女人在喃喃自语。

mundane.en: Initially, the work was pretty mundane.
mundane.zh: 刚开始，这工作非常乏味。

mundane.en: The mundane task of setting the table can be fun on holidays.
mundane.zh: 摆放餐具这种无趣的事情在假日里也会变得有意思起来。

murder.en: On the night the murder was committed, he was out of the country.
murder.zh: 凶案发生当晚他不在国内。

murder.en: The man accused of her murder will appear in court today.
murder.zh: 被指控谋杀她的那名男子将于今天出庭。

murmur.en: The girl murmured something polite, and smiled.
murmur.zh: 那个女孩低声说了些客套话，并且笑了笑。

murmur.en: Julie turned over and murmured in her sleep.
murmur.zh: 朱莉翻了个身，叽里咕噜地说着梦话。

muscle.en: Relax your stomach muscles, then stretch again.
muscle.zh: 放松腹部肌肉，然后再绷紧。

muscle.en: Regular exercise will help to strengthen your muscles.
muscle.zh: 经常锻炼有助于强健肌肉。

muscular.en: She was fast and strong, with a slender, muscular body.
muscular.zh: 她动作敏捷，身体强壮，身材苗条，肌肉结实。

muse.en: He mused on how different his life would have been, had he not met Louisa.
muse.zh: 他默默地想，如果没有遇到路易莎，他的人生会有多么不同。
罗塞蒂的妻子，他的创作灵感源泉

museum.en: The museum has an extensive collection of early photographs.
museum.zh: 这座博物馆藏有大量早期的照片。

mushroom.en: New housing developments mushroomed on the edge of town.
mushroom.zh: 城郊新住宅区雨后春笋般地冒出来。

music.en: I often listen to classical music when I’m in the car.
music.zh: 我在车上经常听古典音乐。

music.en: A new piece of music was specially written for the occasion.
music.zh: 为了这个活动专门写了一首新曲子。

musical.en: When he began his musical career, King played only for black audiences.
musical.zh: 金在音乐事业的开始阶段只为黑人观众演奏。

musical.en: She’s very musical and loves to sing.
musical.zh: 她很有乐感，而且喜欢唱歌。

must.en: All passengers must wear seat belts.
must.zh: 所有乘客都必须系安全带。

must.en: It’s getting late. I really must go.
must.zh: 天晚了，我真的必须走了。

mustard.en: Other magazines have tried to copy ZAPP, but have never quite cut the mustard.

muster.en: Finally I mustered up the courage to ask her out.
muster.zh: 最后我鼓起勇气约她出来。

muster.en: Senator Newbolt has been trying to muster support for his proposals.
muster.zh: 纽博尔特参议员一直在努力争取让人们支持他的提议。

mute.en: Billy continued to stand there, mute and defiant.
mute.zh: 比利还是站在那儿一声不吭，一副不服气的样子。

mute.en: Excess noise can be reduced by muting alarms and telephones.
mute.zh: 减弱警报声和电话声可以降低过度的噪音。

mutter.en: Elsie muttered something I couldn’t catch and walked off.
mutter.zh: 埃尔茜咕哝了一句什么，我也没有听懂，她就走掉了。

mutter.en: What are you two muttering about?
mutter.zh: 你们两个在嘀咕些什么？

mutual.en: Mutual respect is necessary for any partnership to work.
mutual.zh: 互相尊重是任何一种伙伴关系成功建立的必要条件。

mutual.en: European nations can live together in a spirit of mutual trust.
mutual.zh: 欧洲国家能以相互信任的态度共处。

mutually.en: We eventually arrived at a figure that was mutually acceptable.
mutually.zh: 我们最后商定了一个大家都能接受的数目。

my.en: Have you seen my car keys?
my.zh: 你看到我的汽车钥匙了吗？

myriad.en: We were plagued by a myriad tiny flies.
myriad.zh: 我们被许许多多的小苍蝇骚扰。

myriad.en: We’re still studying a myriad of options.
myriad.zh: 我们仍在研究各种备选方案。

myself.en: I blame myself for what has happened.
myself.zh: 发生这一切都怪我自己。

mysterious.en: The police are investigating the mysterious deaths of children at the hospital.
mysterious.zh: 警察正在调查这家医院的儿童神秘死亡事件。

mysterious.en: Benson later disappeared in mysterious circumstances.
mysterious.zh: 本森后来就神秘地失踪了。

mystery.en: Twenty years after the event, his death remains a mystery.
mystery.zh: 事情过去二十年了，他的死仍然是个谜。

mystery.en: The way her mind worked was always a mystery to him.
mystery.zh: 她脑子里在想些什么对他来说始终是个谜。

mystify.en: Her disappearance has mystified her friends and neighbors.
mystify.zh: 她的失踪使她的朋友和邻居迷惑不解。

mystify.en: Snake charming is always fascinating and at times mystifying.
mystify.zh: 耍蛇总是那么有趣，有时还很神秘。

mystique.en: Some of the mystique surrounding the presidency has gone forever.
mystique.zh: 总统职位的某些神秘性已经永远消失了。

myth.en: It was important to dispel the myth that AIDS was a gay disease.
myth.zh: 一定要消除艾滋病是同性恋疾病的错误认识。

myth.en: Stalin created a lot of myths about himself.
myth.zh: 他制造了大量关于自己的神话。

mythology.en: According to popular mythology, school days are the best days of your life.
mythology.zh: 一种很流行的错误看法是，学生时代是人生中最美好的时期。

mythology.en: The walls are painted with mythological scenes.
mythology.zh: 墙上绘有展现神话故事中场景的壁画。

nail.en: The key was hanging on a nail by the door.
nail.zh: 钥匙挂在门边的一颗钉子上。

nail.en: She hammered a nail into the wall.
nail.zh: 她往墙上敲进一颗钉子。

naive.en: Jim can be so naive sometimes.
It would be naive to think that this could solve all the area’s problems straight away.
naive.zh: 认为这样就可以马上解决该地区的所有问题也太天真了。

naked.en: The children ran naked through the yard.
naked.zh: 孩子们光着身子跑过院子。

naked.en: They found the body lying half naked in the grass.
naked.zh: 他们发现尸体半裸着躺在草丛中。

name.en: He married a young lady by the name of Sarah Hunt.

nameless.en: A certain person, who shall remain nameless, forgot to lock the front door.
nameless.zh: 某人忘了锁前门，名字我就不说了。

nameless.en: He lay in a nameless grave.
nameless.zh: 他安息在无名的墓冢里。

namely.en: Three students were mentioned, namely John, Sarah and Sylvia.
namely.zh: 有三名学生被提到，即约翰、萨拉和西尔维娅。

namesake.en: Like his famous namesake, young Washington had a brave, adventurous spirit.
namesake.zh: 像和他同名的那位名人一样，小华盛顿也有勇敢的冒险精神。

nap.en: I usually take a nap after lunch.
nap.zh: 我午饭后通常要小睡一会儿。

nap.en: The German team were caught napping and Lampard scored the winning goal.
nap.zh: 趁德国队一不留神，兰帕德攻入了制胜的一球。

narrate.en: The main character narrates the story.

narrative.en: At several points in the narrative the two stories cross.
narrative.zh: 叙述中两条故事线多次交织在一起。

narrow.en: A woman had a narrow escape yesterday when her car left the road.
narrow.zh: 昨天一名女子驾车时冲出公路，险些丢了性命。

narrowly.en: He was narrowly defeated in the election.
narrowly.zh: 他在选举中以微弱差距败北。

narrowly.en: One bullet struck his car, narrowly missing him.
narrowly.zh: 一颗子弹击中了他的汽车，差点打中他。

nasal.en: He spoke in a high nasal voice.

nasty.en: There’s a nasty streak in her character.
nasty.zh: 她性格中有令人讨厌的一面。

nasty.en: Drivers often have a nasty habit of driving too close to cyclists.
nasty.zh: 司机常有一个坏习惯，就是车开得离骑自行车的人太近。

natal.en: Green turtles return to their natal island to breed.
natal.zh: 绿毛龟回到它们出生的岛上繁殖。

national.en: Religion matters very much at a national level.
national.zh: 宗教事务在全国都非常重要。

national.en: Between 1929 and 1933 America’s national income fell by more than half.

nationalism.en: Under his leadership, a strong sense of nationalism emerged.
nationalism.zh: 在他的领导下，人们心中涌出强烈的民族自豪感。

nationalistic.en: They were encouraging nationalistic sentiment among the students.
nationalistic.zh: 他们在鼓动学生们的民族主义情绪。

nationally.en: The programme will be broadcast nationally.

native.en: They never saw their native land again.
He spent most of his professional life outside his native Poland.
native.zh: 他大部分的职业生涯都没在祖国波兰度过。

natural.en: At the time, accepting his offer had seemed the most natural thing in the world.
natural.zh: 当时，接受他的提议似乎是再自然不过的事了。

natural.en: It’s not natural for a child of his age to be so quiet.
natural.zh: 像他这个年纪的孩子如此安静不正常。

naturally.en: Naturally, you’ll want to discuss this with your wife.
naturally.zh: 当然，你一定想和你妻子商量一下这件事。

naturally.en: Naturally enough, she wanted her child to grow up fit and strong.
naturally.zh: 很自然，她希望自己的孩子健康茁壮地成长。

nature.en: We grew up in the countryside, surrounded by the beauties of nature.
nature.zh: 我们在乡村长大，周围是美丽的大自然。

nature.en: The inhabitants of the island fight a constant battle against the forces of nature.
nature.zh: 那座岛上的居民经常和大自然的力量抗争。

naughty.en: You’re a very naughty boy! Look what you’ve done!
naughty.zh: 你真是个淘气鬼！瞧你干了些什么！

naughty.en: I felt a bit naughty going off on my own, leaving the children behind.
naughty.zh: 我把孩子们留下，自己走开了，觉得有点不妥当。

nausea.en: A feeling of nausea suddenly came over me.
nausea.zh: 我突然有一种恶心的感觉。

navigate.en: I’ll drive, you take the map and navigate.
navigate.zh: 我来开车，你拿着地图指路。

navigate.en: Early explorers used to navigate by the stars.
navigate.zh: 早期的探险家往往靠星辰确定方向。

navigation.en: Navigation becomes more difficult further up the river.
navigation.zh: 越往河的上游，航行越困难。

navy.en: Is your brother still in the navy?
navy.zh: 你弟弟还在海军服役吗？

navy.en: He joined the navy during the war.
navy.zh: 他在战争期间参加了海军。

near.en: I’m sure they live somewhere near here.
near.zh: 我肯定他们就住在这附近。

nearby.en: Lucy was staying in the nearby town of Hamilton.
nearby.zh: 露西当时住在附近的汉密尔顿镇。

nearby.en: Dan found work on one of the farms nearby.
nearby.zh: 丹在附近的一个农场里找到了工作。

nearly.en: It took nearly two hours to get here.
nearly.zh: 到这里花了将近两小时。

neat.en: His clothes were always neat and clean.
Everything in the house was neat and tidy.
neat.zh: 房子里的每样物品都干净整齐。

necessarily.en: Expensive restaurants aren’t necessarily the best.
necessarily.zh: 昂贵的餐馆不一定是最好的。

necessary.en: The booklet provides all the necessary information about the college.
necessary.zh: 这本小册子提供了关于那所学院的所有必需信息。

necessary.en: No further changes were considered necessary.
necessary.zh: 没有必要作出进一步的改变。

necessitate.en: Lack of money necessitated a change of plan.
necessitate.zh: 由于缺乏资金，只能改变计划。

necessitate.en: This would necessitate interviewing all the staff.
necessitate.zh: 这样一来，就得和所有员工面谈。

necessity.en: She saw books as a necessity, not a luxury.
necessity.zh: 她视书籍为必需品而非奢侈品。

necessity.en: A car is an absolute necessity if you live in the country.
necessity.zh: 你要是住在乡下，绝对需要有辆汽车。

neck.en: Jean wore a string of pearls around her neck.
neck.zh: 琼脖子上戴了一串珍珠。

neck.en: Mike rubbed the back of his neck.

necklace.en: She was wearing a coral necklace.

need.en: You don’t really need a car.
need.zh: 你其实并不需要一辆车。

need.en: Plants need light in order to survive.

needle.en: She carried hypodermic needles and syringes in her bag.
needle.zh: 她包里带着皮下注射针和针筒。

needle.en: Drug users are at risk when they share needles.
needle.zh: 吸毒者共用注射针很危险。

needless.en: Needless to say, any contributions of money will be gratefully received.
needless.zh: 不用说，收到任何一笔捐款我们都将很感激。

needless.en: The report caused needless anxiety to women who have attended the clinic.
needless.zh: 那份报告让去那家诊所就诊过的妇女产生了不必要的忧虑。

negate.en: Efforts to expand the tourist industry could be negated by reports that the sea is highly polluted.
negate.zh: 有关海洋受到严重污染的报道可能会使拓展旅游业的努力完全白费。

negation.en: Much of what passes for Christianity is a negation of Christ’s teachings.
negation.zh: 许多被认为是基督教的东西，和基督的教诲是相悖的。

negation.en: He shook his head in silent negation.
negation.zh: 他摇摇头，默默地表示反对。

negative.en: My drinking was starting to have a negative effect on my work.
negative.zh: 喝酒开始对我的工作产生不良影响。

negative.en: On the negative side, it will cost a lot.
negative.zh: 从坏的方面讲，它要花很多钱。

neglect.en: She smoked and drank, neglected the children, and left the clothes unmended.
neglect.zh: 她抽烟喝酒，既不照顾孩子，也不缝补衣服。

neglect.en: The building has been badly neglected.
neglect.zh: 这栋大楼严重疏于维护。

neglectful.en: She became more and more neglectful of her responsibilities.
neglectful.zh: 她越来越无视自己的责任。

negligence.en: The bridge’s architect was sued for criminal negligence.
negligence.zh: 那座桥梁的建筑师被控犯有玩忽职守罪。

negligent.en: The report stated that Dr Brady had been negligent in not giving the patient a full examination.
negligent.zh: 该报告称布雷迪医生失职，未给病人作全面的身体检查。

negligent.en: Mr Brown was found guilty of negligent driving.
negligent.zh: 布朗先生被判疏忽驾驶罪。

negligible.en: The damage done to his property was negligible.
negligible.zh: 对他财产造成的损失微不足道。

negotiable.en: Part-time barman required. Hours and salary negotiable.
negotiable.zh: 招聘兼职酒吧男服务员，工作时间及薪金面议。

negotiate.en: The government refuses to negotiate with terrorists.
negotiate.zh: 政府拒绝和恐怖分子谈判。

negotiate.en: Union leaders have negotiated an agreement for a shorter working week.
negotiate.zh: 工会领袖已经商定了一份缩短每周工作时间的协议。

negotiation.en: The negotiations with the company had reached a crucial stage.
negotiation.zh: 和那家公司的谈判到了关键阶段。

negotiation.en: This follows private negotiations between the landowner and the leisure centre.
negotiation.zh: 这依照的是土地拥有人和休闲中心私下达成的协议。

neighbour.en: One of the neighbors complained about the noise from the party.
neighbour.zh: 有位邻居抱怨聚会太吵。

neighbour.en: FBI agents were interviewing all their friends and neighbors.
neighbour.zh: 联邦调查局人员正在向他们所有的朋友和邻居问话。

neighbourhood.en: She grew up in a quiet neighborhood of Boston.
neighbourhood.zh: 她是在波士顿一个清静的街区里长大的。

neighbourhood.en: The hotel is situated in a peaceful residential neighbourhood (=area where there are houses rather than factories or shops).
neighbourhood.zh: 这家宾馆坐落在一个宁静的住宅区里。

neither.en: It was a game in which neither team deserved to win.
neither.zh: 那场比赛两个队都不该赢。

neon.en: A neon sign flashed on and off above the door.
neon.zh: 门上方的霓虹灯广告牌一闪一闪。

nerve.en: Sean drank a large glass of brandy to calm his nerves.
nerve.zh: 肖恩喝了一大杯白兰地，好让自己定定神。

nerve.en: I remember you were a bundle of nerves on your wedding day.
nerve.zh: 我记得你在婚礼那天紧张极了。

nervous.en: She was so nervous about her exams that she couldn’t sleep.
nervous.zh: 考试让她紧张得睡不着觉。

nervous.en: I wish you’d stop looking at me like that. You’re making me nervous.
nervous.zh: 我希望你不要再那样看着我了，你让我紧张。

nest.en: In May the females build a nest and lay their eggs.
Young eagles leave the nest after only two months.
nest.zh: 雏鹰仅仅两个月以后就会飞离鸟巢。

nestle.en: Sarah lay there peacefully, the child nestling by her side.
nestle.zh: 萨拉安静地躺在那儿，孩子偎依在她身边。

nestle.en: He nestled his head against her shoulder.
nestle.zh: 他把头靠在她的肩膀上。

net.en: Bruce spends most evenings surfing the Net (=looking at information in different places on the Internet).
net.zh: 布鲁斯晚上大多在网上浏览信息。

net.en: You might find something on the Net.
net.zh: 你也许能从网上找到些什么。

network.en: You’re listening to the American Armed Forces Network.
network.zh: 您正在收听的是美军广播电台。

network.en: It’s important to build up a network of professional contacts.
network.zh: 建立同行人脉关系是很重要的。

networking.en: I’m hoping to do some networking at the conference next week in London.
networking.zh: 我希望下周在伦敦召开的会议上能结交一些同行。

neurotic.en: He seemed a neurotic, self-obsessed man.
neurotic.zh: 他似乎是个神经过敏又自恋的人。

neurotic.en: She accused him of being a neurotic.

neutral.en: I always tried to remain neutral when they started arguing.
neutral.zh: 他们争论起来的时候我总是努力保持中立。

neutral.en: Clive decided to adopt a neutral position.
neutral.zh: 克莱夫决定采取中立立场。

neutralize.zh: 不断上涨的物价会抵消工资的增长。

never.en: I’m never going back there again, not as long as I live.
never.zh: 只要我活着，我再也不会回到那儿去。

nevertheless.en: What you said was true. It was, nevertheless, a little unkind.
nevertheless.zh: 你说的都是实话，只不过有点刻薄。

new.en: The hardest part of this job is understanding the new technology.
new.zh: 这项工作最难的地方是理解新技术。

new.en: Do you like my new dress?
new.zh: 你喜欢我新买的连衣裙吗？

newcomer.en: I’m a relative newcomer to the retail business.
newcomer.zh: 我在零售行业相对来说还是个新手。

newcomer.en: The most glamorous newcomer to the Volkswagen Golf range is the revamped GTi 16 valve.
newcomer.zh: 大众高尔夫系列最具魅力的新车型是经改良的GTi 16

news.en: I hope to have some good news for you soon.
news.zh: 我希望很快就能给你好消息。

news.en: We are delighted at the news that our daughter is expecting a baby.
news.zh: 听到女儿就要生宝宝的消息，我们很高兴。

newspaper.en: She had read about it in the newspaper.
newspaper.zh: 关于这件事她已经在报纸上看到了。

newspaper.en: Wrap the plates in newspaper to stop them from breaking.
newspaper.zh: 用旧报纸把盘子包起来，免得打碎。

next.en: I just missed my flight to Chicago. When’s the next one?
next.zh: 我刚错过去芝加哥的航班。下一班是几点钟？

next.en: We’ll look at the proposals at the next meeting.
next.zh: 下一次会议我们要研究一下这些提议。

nibble.en: There’s a fish nibbling at my bait.
nibble.zh: 有条鱼正在咬我的鱼饵。

nice.en: They’ve got a very nice house.
Did you have a nice time?

niche.en: Amanda soon found her niche at the club.
niche.zh: 阿曼达很快就在俱乐部里找到了一份理想的工作。

niche.en: He’s managed to create a niche for himself in local politics.
niche.zh: 他终于在当地政坛闯出了一方天地。

nick.en: Luckily, help arrived in the nick of time.
nick.zh: 幸运的是援兵及时到来。

nick.en: It’s an old car but it’s still in good nick.
nick.zh: 这是辆旧车，但性能仍然不错。

nickname.en: We had nicknames for all the teachers.
nickname.zh: 我们给所有老师都起了外号。

nickname.en: Stephen earned himself the nickname Hawkeye.

night.en: It was a cold moonlit night.
I didn’t sleep too well last night.

nightly.en: The band plays twice nightly in the bar.
nightly.zh: 那支乐队每晚在该酒吧表演两场。

nightmare.en: Years after the accident I still have nightmares about it.
nightmare.zh: 事故发生很多年后，我依然会做噩梦。

nil.en: The new machine reduced labour costs to almost nil.
nil.zh: 新机器把劳动成本几乎降到零。

nil.en: Our team won by two goals to nil.

nine.en: He’s only been in this job for nine months.
nine.zh: 他干这份工作才九个月。

nineteen.en: It was nineteen minutes past seven.
I was only nineteen (=19 years old).

ninety.en: America was far richer in the nineties.
The industry received a lot of bad publicity in the early nineties.

ninth.en: I’m planning to leave on the ninth (=ninth day of the month).

no.en: He wanted to take me to a disco but I said no.
no.zh: 他想带我去迪斯科舞厅，但是我拒绝了。

no.en: Sixty percent of people voted no.

noble.en: It’s very noble of you to spend all your weekends helping the old folk.
noble.zh: 你心地真好，周末的时间全都用来帮助老人。

noble.en: The Marquis would have to marry a woman of noble blood.
noble.zh: 那位侯爵必须和有贵族血统的女子结婚。

nobody.en: I knocked on the door but nobody answered.
nobody.zh: 我敲了敲门，但没人应门。

nobody.en: We get along like nobody’s business.

nod.en: I asked her if she was ready to go, and she nodded.
nod.zh: 我问她是否已准备好出发，她点了点头。

noise.en: Try not to make a noise when you go upstairs.
noise.zh: 上楼时尽量不要弄出声。

noise.en: There was a strange whistling noise in his ears.

noisy.en: The kids have been really noisy today.

nomadic.en: The son of an air force pilot, he had a somewhat nomadic childhood.
nomadic.zh: 因为是空军飞行员的儿子，他童年的生活有点漂泊不定。

nominal.en: A nominal charge is made for use of the tennis courts.
nominal.zh: 使用这些网球场只是象征性地收取费用。

nominal.en: Their conversion to Christianity was only nominal.
nominal.zh: 他们只是名义上皈依了基督教。

nominate.en: Ferraro was the first woman to be nominated for the job of vice president.
nominate.zh: 费拉罗是第一位获得副总统职位提名的女性。

nominate.en: She has been nominated as Best Actress for her part in the film ‘Forever Together’.
nominate.zh: 她因在电影《相遇》中扮演的角色而获最佳女演员提名。

nomination.en: Who will get the Republican nomination for president?
nomination.zh: 谁会获得共和党总统候选人提名？

nomination.en: All the committee’s nominations were approved.
nomination.zh: 该委员会的所有提名均获得批准。

none.en: I wish I could offer you some cake but there’s none left.
none.zh: 我真想能请你吃些蛋糕，但一点也没剩的了。

none.en: Although these were good students, none had a score above 60.
none.zh: 虽然这些都是好学生，但是没有一个考到60

nonetheless.en: The region was extremely beautiful. Nonetheless Gerard could not imagine spending the rest of his life there.
nonetheless.zh: 那个地区非常漂亮，然而杰拉德却无法想象自己要在那里度过余生。

nonetheless.en: The paintings are complex, but have plenty of appeal nonetheless.
nonetheless.zh: 这些画复杂难懂，不过还是不乏吸引力。

nonsense.en: If you ask me, these modern teaching methods are a load of nonsense (=a lot of nonsense).
nonsense.zh: 要我说，这些现代教学方法全是一派胡言。

nonsense.en: He was talking utter nonsense as usual.
nonsense.zh: 他像平常一样又在胡说八道了。

nonstop.en: She talked nonstop for over an hour.
nonstop.zh: 她一刻不停地讲了一个多小时。

noodle.en: Serve the meat with rice or noodles.
noodle.zh: 肉配米饭或面条一起上。

noon.en: He rarely gets up before noon.
noon.zh: 他很少在中午之前起床。

nor.en: He can neither read nor write (=he cannot read or write).
Hilary was neither shocked nor surprised by the news.
nor.zh: 希拉里对这个消息既没有感到震惊，也没有觉得意外。

norm.en: Short term contracts are now the norm with some big companies.
norm.zh: 签订短期合同是目前一些大公司的惯常做法。

norm.en: Joyce’s style of writing was a striking departure from the literary norm.
norm.zh: 乔伊斯的写作风格与传统的文学风格大相径庭。

normal.en: A normal working week is 40 hours.
It’s normal to feel nervous before an exam.
normal.zh: 考试之前觉得紧张是正常的。

normalize.en: Journalists are reporting that the situation has now normalized.
normalize.zh: 新闻记者报道说，局势现已恢复正常。

normalize.en: Relations between the countries were formally normalized in 1997.

normally.en: The journey normally takes about two hours.
normally.zh: 这段旅程通常需要大约两小时。

normally.en: Normally, I park behind the theatre.
normally.zh: 通常我把车停在剧院后面。

north.en: Cheshunt is a few miles to the north of London.
north.zh: 切森特位于伦敦以北几英里。

northeast.en: He headed northeast across the open sea.
northeast.zh: 他朝东北方向穿越公海。

northwest.zh: 她乘车前往西北部的博尔德。

nose.en: Someone punched him on the nose.
nose.zh: 有人一拳打在他的鼻子上。

nose.en: The drugs were smuggled in right under the noses of the security guards.
nose.zh: 毒品就在保安人员的眼皮底下走私进来。

nostalgia.en: He looked back on his university days with a certain amount of nostalgia.
nostalgia.zh: 他带着一点留恋，回忆起大学时光。

nostalgic.en: Seeing those old school photographs has made me feel quite nostalgic.
nostalgic.zh: 看到那些学生时代的旧照片，我不禁产生了怀旧之情。

nostalgic.en: He remained nostalgic about his days as a young actor.
nostalgic.zh: 他一直怀念自己还是名年轻演员时的岁月。

nostril.en: The smell of gunpowder filled his nostrils.

nosy.en: I’d love to have a good old nosy in Josey’s room!
nosy.zh: 我想好好看看乔西的房间！

not.en: Most of the stores do not open until 10 am.
She’s not a very nice person.

notable.en: A notable feature of the church is its unusual bell tower.
notable.zh: 这座教堂的一个特别之处就是它那座与众不同的钟楼。

notable.en: Every country in the world signed the treaty, with one notable exception – the United States.
notable.zh: 全世界每个国家都签署了那份条约，只有一个国家反其道而行之，就是美国。

notably.en: Some early doctors, notably Hippocrates, thought that diet was important.
notably.zh: 早期的一些医生，尤其是希波克拉底，认为饮食很重要。

notably.en: Emigration has notably increased over the past five years.
notably.zh: 在过去五年中，移居国外的人明显增加。

notch.en: Her new book is several notches above anything else she has written.
notch.zh: 她的新书比她的其他作品高出了好几个等级。

notch.en: Jackson raised his voice by a notch.
notch.zh: 杰克逊将嗓音提高了一度。

note.en: Dave made a note of her address and phone number.
note.zh: 戴夫记下了她的地址和电话号码。

note.en: Keep a careful note of any problems you have with the software.
note.zh: 仔细记录使用这个软件时碰到的任何问题。

noted.en: The city is noted for its 18th-century architecture.

nothing.en: Nothing ever happens in this town.
nothing.zh: 这镇上从来都不会发生什么特别的事。

notice.en: He noticed a woman in a black dress sitting across from him.
notice.zh: 他看到有位黑衣女子坐在他的对面。

noticeable.en: Alcohol has a noticeable effect on the body.
noticeable.zh: 酒精对身体有明显的影响。

noticeable.en: It was noticeable that many of them avoided answering the question.
noticeable.zh: 显而易见，他们中的许多人对这个问题都避而不答。

notification.en: I was given no prior notification.
You should receive notification of the results within a week.
notification.zh: 你应该会在一周内接到有关结果的通知。

notify.en: You will be notified of any changes in the system.
notify.zh: 系统中有任何变化都会通知你。

notify.en: In August we were notified that our article had been rejected.

notion.en: The traditional notion of marriage goes back thousands of years.
notion.zh: 传统的婚姻观念可追溯到几千年以前。

notion.en: She had only a vague notion of what she wanted to do.
notion.zh: 她对自己想做什么只有一个模糊的概念。

notional.en: Their calculations were based on a notional minimum wage.
notional.zh: 他们的计算是以假定的最低工资为基础的。

notoriety.en: John is already a writer of some notoriety.
notoriety.zh: 约翰已经是名声不好的作家了。

notoriety.en: The local church has gained notoriety for being different.
notoriety.zh: 那座当地的教堂因与众不同而臭名远扬。

notorious.zh: 统计数据有时也不可靠，这是人所共知的。

notorious.en: The program is notoriously difficult to learn.
notorious.zh: 众所周知这个程序很难掌握。

notwithstanding.en: Notwithstanding differences, there are clear similarities in all of the world’s religions.
notwithstanding.zh: 世界上的宗教尽管各不相同，但都有明显的相似之处。

notwithstanding.en: Fame and fortune notwithstanding, Donna never forgot her hometown.
notwithstanding.zh: 尽管名利双收，但唐娜从未忘记自己的家乡。

nought.en: A billion is 1 with 9 noughts after it.
Peace negotiations came to nought (=were not successful).

nourish.en: The cream contains vitamin A to nourish the skin.
nourish.zh: 这种护肤霜含有滋养肌肤的维生素A

nourish.en: We need to nourish our hopes and dreams.
nourish.zh: 我们应该怀有希望和梦想。

nourishment.en: The soil provides nourishment for plant roots.
nourishment.zh: 土壤为植物根部提供养分。

novel.en: It took Vikram Seth three years to write his 1,349-page novel ‘A Suitable Boy’.

novelty.en: Many toys have no attraction beyond their novelty value.
novelty.zh: 许多玩具除了有些新奇感之外，别无吸引力。

novelty.en: It was fun for a while, but the novelty wore off (=it became boring).
novelty.zh: 开始有一阵很好玩，可是新鲜感随后便消失了。

november.en: He started work here last November.

novice.en: The computer course is ideal for novices.
novice.zh: 这门计算机课程非常适合初学者。

novice.en: I’m still a complete novice at the sport.
novice.zh: 对于这项运动而言我还完全是个新手。

now.en: They now live in the city centre.
There’s nothing I can do about this right now (=exactly now).
now.zh: 这事我现在也没有办法。

nowadays.en: Nowadays people are rarely shocked by the sex they see on television.
nowadays.zh: 如今人们在电视上看见性爱镜头不太会感到吃惊了。

nowadays.en: Most people nowadays are aware of the importance of a healthy diet.
nowadays.zh: 现在大多数人都明白健康饮食的重要性。

nowhere.en: I have no job and nowhere to live.
nowhere.zh: 我没有工作，也没有地方住。

nowhere.en: Nowhere is drug abuse more of a problem than in the US.
nowhere.zh: 没有什么地方的吸毒问题比美国更严重。

nuance.en: He was aware of every nuance in her voice.
nuance.zh: 他听得出她声音中的每一个细微变化。

nuclear.en: With the collapse of the former Soviet Union, the possibility of a nuclear holocaust (=a nuclear war that destroys much of the Earth) was greatly reduced.
nuclear.zh: 随着苏联的解体，核浩劫爆发的可能性大大降低。

nucleus.en: Marantz and Grohl form the nucleus of the Atlanta operation.
nucleus.zh: 马兰茨和格勒构成了亚特兰大公司的核心。

nude.en: I did some work as a nude model when I was in college.
nude.zh: 我上大学的时候当过裸体模特。

nude.en: Have you ever posed nude (=been photographed or painted while nude)?

nudity.en: The play contains scenes of nudity.

nuisance.en: The dogs next door are a real nuisance.
nuisance.zh: 隔壁的那几只狗实在是讨厌。

nuisance.en: What a nuisance! I’ve forgotten my ticket.

null.en: The contract was declared null and void.

nullify.en: The election results were nullified because of voter fraud.
nullify.zh: 由于选票造假，选举结果被宣布无效。

nullify.en: Recent inflation could nullify the economic growth of the last several years.
nullify.zh: 最近的通货膨胀可能会抵消过去数年的经济增长。

numb.en: My fingers were so numb I could hardly write.
numb.zh: 我的手指麻木得几乎没法写字。

numb.en: The anaesthetic made his whole face go numb.
numb.zh: 麻醉剂使他整个脸都失去了知觉。

number.en: They wrote various numbers on a large sheet of paper.
number.zh: 他们在一张大纸上写下了很多不同的数字。

numerical.en: The home team tried to utilize their numerical advantage (=the fact that they had more players than the other team).
numerical.zh: 主队试图利用他们在人数上的优势。

numerical.en: Make sure the files are organized in numerical order.
numerical.zh: 务必把这些档案按数字顺序排列。

numerous.en: Numerous attempts have been made to hide the truth.
numerous.zh: 为掩盖事实作了很多尝试。

numerous.en: The two leaders have worked together on numerous occasions.
numerous.zh: 那两位领导人已经多次合作。

nurse.en: The nurse is coming to give you an injection.
The school nurse sent Sara home.
nurse.zh: 学校的护士送萨拉回家。

nursing.en: I’d love to go into nursing.
nursing.zh: 我很乐意从事护理行业。

nurture.en: European union is an ideal that has been nurtured since the post-war years.
nurture.zh: 建立欧盟是战后多年来人们一直争取实现的理想。

nut.en: We were sitting round the fire cracking nuts (=opening them).
nut.zh: 我们围坐在火炉边夹碎坚果。

nut.en: Use a wrench to loosen the nut.
nut.zh: 用活动扳手将螺帽拧松。

nutrient.en: The plant absorbs nutrients from the soil.
nutrient.zh: 植物从土壤中吸取养分。

nutrition.en: Nutrition and exercise are essential to fitness and health.
nutrition.zh: 营养和运动是保持健康所必不可少的。

nutrition.en: Poor nutrition can cause heart disease in later life.
nutrition.zh: 营养不良可能会在晚年引发心脏病。

nutritional.en: Cooking vegetables for too long lessens their nutritional value.
nutritional.zh: 烹饪蔬菜时间过长有损其营养价值。

nutritious.en: Wholemeal bread is more nutritious than white bread.
nutritious.zh: 全麦面包比白面包更有营养。

nutritious.en: Nuts and fruit make nutritious snacks.
nutritious.zh: 坚果和水果是有营养价值的零食。

nylon.en: The tent was made of nylon.

oar.en: We were getting along fine until you stuck your oar in.
oar.zh: 在你掺和进来之前，我们一直好好的。

oasis.en: The park was an oasis of peace.
oasis.zh: 这座公园是个宁静宜人的去处。

oath.en: Servicemen have to swear an oath of loyalty to their country.
oath.zh: 军人必须宣誓效忠祖国。

oath.en: The president took the oath of office (=made the official public promises that every president makes when starting their job).

obedience.en: He lived in obedience to the church’s teachings.
obedience.zh: 他的个人生活一直严格遵从教规。

obedience.en: With blind obedience, I allowed my father to organize my life.
obedience.zh: 我对父亲盲目地顺从，听凭他来安排我的生活。

obedient.en: The children were all very good.

obey.en: The little boy made no effort to obey.
Soldiers are expected to obey orders without questioning them.
obey.zh: 军人必须毫无异议地服从命令。

object.en: The object of the game is to improve children’s math skills.
object.zh: 这项游戏旨在提高儿童的数学技能。

object.en: My object was to explain the decision simply.
object.zh: 我的目的是要简单明了地解释这一决定。

objection.en: Her objection was that he was too young.
objection.zh: 她反对的理由是他太小。

objection.en: He had moral objections to killing animals for food.
objection.zh: 他从道义上反对宰食动物。

objective.en: He vowed to achieve certain objectives before the end of his presidency.
objective.zh: 他立誓要在他的总统任期结束之前实现某些目标。

objective.en: The degree program has two main objectives.
objective.zh: 该学位课程有两个主要目标。

objectively.en: Look at your skills objectively when deciding on a career change.
objectively.zh: 在决定改行时要客观地考虑自己的技能。

obligate.en: Tenants are obligated to pay their rent on time.
obligate.zh: 房客有义务按时缴纳房租。

obligate.en: Ava felt obligated to help her mother, even if it meant leaving college.
obligate.zh: 阿娃感到有义务帮助母亲，即使这样做意味着要离开大学。

obligation.en: Employers have an obligation to treat all employees equally.
obligation.zh: 雇主有责任对所有员工一视同仁。

obligatory.en: It is obligatory for companies to provide details of their industrial processes.
obligatory.zh: 公司必须提供其工业流程的详细情况。

obligatory.en: She offered him the obligatory cup of tea.
obligatory.zh: 她照例给他端来一杯茶。

oblige.en: The minister was obliged to report at least once every six months.
oblige.zh: 这位大臣必须至少每六个月作一次汇报。

oblige.en: Circumstances had obliged him to sell the business.
oblige.zh: 客观情况迫使他出售公司。

obliging.en: The shop assistant was very obliging.

obliterate.en: Hiroshima was nearly obliterated by the atomic bomb.
obliterate.zh: 广岛几乎被原子弹夷为平地。

obliterate.en: Nothing could obliterate the memory of those tragic events.
obliterate.zh: 那些悲惨事件的记忆是无法抹去的。

oblivious.en: He seemed oblivious to the fact that he had hurt her.
oblivious.zh: 他似乎没有察觉自己伤害了她。

oblivious.en: Congress was seemingly oblivious to these events.
oblivious.zh: 国会对这些事件似乎毫不知情。

obscene.zh: 布拉德福德做了个下流手势。

obscene.en: Some players earn obscene amounts of money.
obscene.zh: 有些运动员的收入高得离谱。

obscure.en: The details of his life remain obscure.
For some obscure reason, the group is very popular.
obscure.zh: 这个组合莫名其妙地很受欢迎。

observant.en: Supervisors are trained to be observant.
observant.zh: 主管被训练得敏锐机警。

observation.en: Bloomfield’s approach to linguistics was based on observation of the language.
observation.zh: 布龙菲尔德的语言学研究方法以对语言的观察为基础。

observation.en: He spent two nights under close observation in hospital.
observation.zh: 他在医院接受了两个晚上的严密观察。

observe.en: Scientists have observed a drop in ozone levels over the Antarctic.
observe.zh: 科学家已经观察到南极洲上方的臭氧浓度有所下降。

observe.en: It was observed that 40 percent of patients had high blood pressure.

observer.en: Observers are predicting a fall in interest rates.
observer.zh: 观察员预测利率会下降。

observer.en: The UN sent observers to the peace talks.
observer.zh: 联合国派遣观察员参加和谈。

obsess.en: A lot of young girls are obsessed by their weight.
obsess.zh: 许多年轻女孩都过于担心自己的体重。

obsess.en: Jody’s been obsessed with some lifeguard for months.
obsess.zh: 乔迪几个月来一直迷恋着某个救生员。

obsession.en: Gambling became an obsession, and he eventually lost everything.
obsession.zh: 他迷上赌博，最后失去了一切。

obsession.en: The current obsession with exam results is actually harming children’s education.
obsession.zh: 目前一味追求考试成绩的做法实际上对儿童教育有害。

obsolete.zh: 计算机会把书籍淘汰掉吗？

obstacle.en: Fear of change is an obstacle to progress.
obstacle.zh: 惧怕变革是进步的一大障碍。

obstacle.en: The tax puts obstacles in the way of companies trying to develop trade overseas.
obstacle.zh: 这项税收为想在海外发展贸易的公司设置了障碍。

obstinate.en: He was the most obstinate man I’ve ever met.
obstinate.zh: 他是我遇到过的最固执的人。

obstruct.en: A small aircraft was obstructing the runway.
obstruct.zh: 一架小型飞机堵住了跑道。

obstruct.en: The column obstructed our view of the stage.
obstruct.zh: 柱子挡着，我们看不见舞台。

obstruction.en: Police can remove a vehicle that is causing an obstruction.
obstruction.zh: 警察有权把造成阻塞的车辆移走。

obstruction.en: He was found guilty of obstruction of justice.
obstruction.zh: 他因妨碍司法公正而被判有罪。

obtain.en: Further information can be obtained from head office.
obtain.zh: 详细资料可向总公司索取。

obtain.en: You will need to obtain permission from the principal.
obtain.zh: 你需要得到校长的同意。

obtainable.en: The form is obtainable at your local post office.
obtainable.zh: 该表格可向当地邮局索取。

obvious.en: The obvious way of reducing pollution is to use cars less.
obvious.zh: 减少污染显而易见的办法就是少用汽车。

obvious.en: It was obvious that Gina was lying.

obviously.en: We’re obviously going to need more help.
obviously.zh: 显然我们将需要更多的帮助。

obviously.en: Your research has obviously been very thorough.
obviously.zh: 你的研究工作显然做得很透彻。

occasion.en: I’ve seen Jana with them on several occasions.
occasion.zh: 我几次看见贾娜和他们在一起。

occasion.en: On this occasion we were sitting in a park in Madrid.
occasion.zh: 这一次我们是坐在马德里的一座公园里。

occasional.en: He made occasional visits to London.
They had an occasional coffee together after shopping.
occasional.zh: 他们偶尔会在购物后一起喝杯咖啡。

occasionally.en: Occasionally Alice would look up from her books.
occasionally.zh: 艾丽斯偶尔会从书中抬起头来。

occasionally.en: We only see each other very occasionally (=rarely).
occasionally.zh: 我们只是难得见一次面。

occupancy.en: Hotels in Tokyo enjoy over 90% occupancy.
occupancy.zh: 东京的宾馆入住率高达90%

occupancy.en: The day for changing from one occupancy to the next was on a Saturday.
occupancy.zh: 租户变更是在某个星期六。

occupant.en: The furniture had been left by the previous occupants.
occupant.zh: 家具是先前的住户留下的。

occupant.en: Police are still trying to trace the occupants of the house which was destroyed by fire.
occupant.zh: 警方仍在查找被焚房子里的住户。

occupation.en: Please state your name, address and occupation.
occupation.zh: 请写明你的姓名、地址和职业。

occupation.en: The area is under occupation (=controlled by a foreign army).

occupational.en: Getting injured is an occupational hazard (=a risk that always exists in a particular job or activity) of the sport.
occupational.zh: 受伤是这项运动的职业性危害。

occupy.en: He occupies the house without paying any rent.
occupy.zh: 他住在这幢房子里，没有付一分钱房租。

occupy.en: The building was purchased and occupied by its new owners last year.
occupy.zh: 这幢房屋去年被新业主买下入住了。

occur.en: A third of accidental deaths occur in the home.
occur.zh: 有三分之一的意外死亡发生在家里。

occurrence.en: Laughter was a rare occurrence in his classroom.
occurrence.zh: 他的课堂上难得有笑声。

occurrence.en: Flooding in the area is a common occurrence.

ocean.en: She stood on the beach, gazing at the ocean.
ocean.zh: 她站在海滩上，凝视着大海。

ocean.en: I like to swim in the ocean when it’s warm enough.
ocean.zh: 海水足够暖的时候，我喜欢在海里游泳。

october.en: You’re going to be busy in October.

odd.en: It was an odd thing to say.

oddity.en: In a class of 120 students there were four women including myself, and I still felt rather an oddity.

odds.en: The odds are (=it is likely) that he will commit the same crime again.
odds.zh: 他可能还会犯同样的罪行。

odds.en: You can narrow the odds of a nasty accident happening in your home by being more safety-conscious.
odds.zh: 增强安全意识可以减少家中发生意外危险的可能性。

odyssey.en: They departed Texas on a three-year odyssey that took them as far as Japan.
odyssey.zh: 他们离开得克萨斯，踏上了历时三年的艰险旅程，最远到达了日本。

of.en: Avocado salad is a favourite of mine.
of.zh: 鳄梨色拉是我的最爱之一。

of.en: Product inspection is the responsibility of the employees themselves.
of.zh: 检验产品是员工自己的责任。

off.en: He got into his car and drove off.
off.zh: 他上了车，随即开车走了。

off.en: Suddenly they turned off and parked in a side road.
off.zh: 突然他们拐出去停在一条岔路上。

off-duty.en: I shall be off-duty on Thursday.

offence.en: His solicitor said he committed the offence because he was heavily in debt.
offence.zh: 他的律师说他犯罪是因为欠下巨债。

offence.en: The problem was how to say ‘no’ to her without causing offence.
offence.zh: 问题是怎样拒绝她而又不得罪她。

offend.en: His remarks deeply offended many Scottish people.
offend.zh: 他的话严重冒犯了许多苏格兰人。

offend.en: Liddy was offended by such a personal question.
offend.zh: 提这样私人的问题让利迪很生气。

offender.en: Community punishment is used for less serious offenders.
offender.zh: 社区服务刑被用来处罚犯罪情节较轻者。

offender.en: At 16, Scott was already a persistent offender (=someone who has been caught several times for committing crimes).

offense.en: The Bears are going to have to work on their offense this season.
offense.zh: 本赛季熊队必须要加强进攻了。

offensive.en: I found her remarks deeply offensive.
offensive.zh: 我觉得她的话令人非常恼火。

offensive.en: Jan was convicted of possessing an offensive weapon.
offensive.zh: 简因为持有攻击性武器而被定罪。

offer.en: Can I offer you something to drink?
They offered him a very good job, but he turned it down.
offer.zh: 他们给他提供了一份很好的工作，但他拒绝了。

office.en: The department occupies an office just a mile from the White House.
office.zh: 该部门就在离白宫一英里远的地方有个办公楼。

office.en: The head office is in Edinburgh.

official.en: You will have to get official permission first.
official.zh: 你必须先得到正式许可。

official.en: Finally the letter of appointment came, making it all official.
official.zh: 任命书终于来了，这样一切都名正言顺了。

officially.en: The new church was officially opened on July 5th.
Nothing has yet been officially announced.
officially.zh: 一切都还没有正式宣布。

offset.en: Cuts in prices for milk, butter, and cheese will be offset by direct payments to farmers.
offset.zh: 食品降价将通过直接付款给农民的方式进行补偿。

offset.en: He was able to offset his travel expenses against tax.

offshoot.en: The company was originally an offshoot of Bell Telephones.
offshoot.zh: 该公司原本是贝尔电话公司的一家分支机构。

often.en: She often works at the weekend.
If you wash your hair too often, it can get too dry.
often.zh: 如果洗头过勤，头发会变得干枯。

oftentimes.en: Oftentimes I have to wait more than 20 minutes for a bus.
oftentimes.zh: 我经常得花二十多分钟才等到一辆公共汽车。

oh.en: Oh, look, I think that’s Harry over there.
oh.zh: 噢，你看，我想那边那个人是哈里。

oh.en: Milk, cereal, juice – oh, and put lettuce on the list too.

oil.en: Check the oil level in your car every week.
oil.zh: 每周都要检查一下汽车的机油量。

oil.en: The heating system runs on oil.

oily.en: He wiped his hands on an oily rag.
oily.zh: 他在一块油腻的抹布上擦了擦手。

old.en: Some of the houses around here are very old.
old.zh: 这里有些房子年代已经很久远了。

old.en: The car’s getting old now, and things are starting to go wrong with it.
old.zh: 这辆汽车现在越来越旧，已经开始出毛病了。

old-fashioned.en: The idea seems rather old-fashioned now.
old-fashioned.zh: 这种观念现在看来似乎相当落伍了。

omen.en: The car won’t start. Do you think it’s an omen?
omen.zh: 汽车发动不起来。你觉得这是某种预兆吗？

omen.en: The mist seemed like a bad omen and Sara’s heart sank a little.
omen.zh: 这薄雾就像是个不好的兆头，萨拉的心往下一沉。

ominous.en: The car is making an ominous rattling sound.
ominous.zh: 汽车在发出一种不妙的咔嗒声。
天空看上去黑沉沉的，好像要变天。

omission.en: The omission of her name was not a deliberate act.
omission.zh: 她的名字不是故意遗漏的。

omission.en: Copies of the lists were posted so that omissions could be corrected.
omission.zh: 多份名单被张贴出来，以便更正遗漏之处。

omit.en: Please don’t omit any details, no matter how trivial they may seem.
omit.zh: 请不要忽略任何细节，不管它多细小。

omit.en: Lisa’s name had been omitted from the list of honor students.
omit.zh: 莉萨的名字不在优秀学生名单上。

omnibus.en: Omnibus editions of novels tend to be too heavy to be read with comfort.
omnibus.zh: 小说选集往往分量太重，读起来不方便。

on.en: Leave your things on the table over there.
on.zh: 把你的东西放在那边的桌子上。

on.en: People were sunbathing on the grass.
on.zh: 人们在草地上晒日光浴。

once.en: Paul’s been to Wexford once before.
once.zh: 保罗曾去过韦克斯福德一次。

oncoming.en: He crashed into an oncoming car.
oncoming.zh: 他撞上了一辆迎面驶来的汽车。

oneself.en: It is only through study that one really begins to know oneself.
oneself.zh: 只有通过学习，一个人才能真正了解自己。

online.en: All the city’s schools will be online by the end of the year.
online.zh: 到年底，市里的所有学校都会连接因特网。

online.en: The reports are not available online yet.
online.zh: 这些报道还没有在网上发布。

onlooker.en: A crowd of onlookers had gathered at the scene of the accident.
onlooker.zh: 一群旁观者围聚在事故现场。

only.en: Naomi was only 17 when she got married.
There are only a few cars on the island.
only.zh: 这个岛上只有几辆汽车。

onslaught.en: In December they launched a full-scale onslaught on the capital.
He praised his wife for her dignity under the onslaught of the tabloid press.
onslaught.zh: 他称赞妻子在遭到低级小报的攻击时保持了尊严。
