predicament.en: Other married couples are in a similar predicament.
predicament.zh: 其他夫妻也面临相似的困境。

predict.en: Sales were five percent lower than predicted.
Newspapers predicted that Davis would be re-elected.
predict.zh: 报纸预测戴维斯将再次当选。

predictable.en: The snow had a predictable effect on traffic.
predictable.zh: 这场雪对交通造成的影响可以预见。

prediction.en: The data can be used to make useful economic predictions.
prediction.zh: 这些数据可用于进行有用的经济预测。

predispose.zh: 糖尿病患者容易受感染。

predispose.en: Parents who smoke predispose children to smoking.
predispose.zh: 父母吸烟的话，孩子也很可能会吸烟。

predominant.en: In this painting, the predominant colour is black.
predominant.zh: 这幅画的主色调是黑色。

predominantly.en: The city’s population is predominantly Irish.
predominantly.zh: 该城市的人口绝大多数是爱尔兰人。

predominate.en: Pine trees predominate in this area of forest.
In this type of case, the rights of the parent predominate.
predominate.zh: 像这样的案例，要首先考虑父母的权利。

preen.en: He enjoyed the applause, preening himself like a pop star.
preen.zh: 他享受着掌声，像流行歌星一样得意扬扬。

preface.en: The book is prefaced by a quotation from Faulkner.
preface.zh: 这本书引用了福克纳的一段话作为开场白。

prefer.en: This type of owl prefers a desert habitat.
prefer.zh: 这种猫头鹰更喜欢沙漠的生活环境。

preferable.en: For this dish, fresh herbs and garlic are preferable.
preferable.zh: 做这道菜，用新鲜香草和大蒜更好。

preferable.en: In warm weather, clothes made of natural fabrics are infinitely preferable (=much better).
preferable.zh: 天气暖和的时候，穿天然织物的衣服要舒适得多。

preferably.en: Students must take two years of a foreign language, preferably Spanish.
preferably.zh: 学生们必须花两年时间学一门外语，最好是西班牙语。

preference.en: Do you have a colour preference?
preference.zh: 你有什么颜色上的偏好吗？

preference.en: Parents may be able to express a preference as to the school their child will attend.
preference.zh: 家长也许可以表明愿意让孩子就读哪所学校。

pregnancy.en: This drug should not be taken during pregnancy.
pregnancy.zh: 这种药妊娠期间不得服用。

pregnant.en: I knew right away that I was pregnant.
I thought I was too old to get pregnant.
pregnant.zh: 我觉得自己年龄太大，已经不能怀孕了。

prejudice.en: Women still face prejudice in the workplace.
prejudice.zh: 女性在职场中仍然面临歧视。

prejudice.en: It takes a long time to overcome these kinds of prejudices.
prejudice.zh: 战胜这些偏见需要假以时日。

preliminary.en: The discussions were preliminary to preparing a policy paper.
preliminary.zh: 这些讨论是在为制定政策文件做准备。

preliminary.en: Pilot studies are a useful preliminary to large research projects.
preliminary.zh: 试验性研究为大型研究项目做有效的初步准备。

prelude.en: Living together as a prelude to marriage is now considered acceptable in many countries.
prelude.zh: 婚前同居如今在许多国家都已被接受。

premature.en: The baby was six weeks premature.
premature.zh: 那个婴儿早产了六个星期。

premature.en: Any talk of a deal is premature.
premature.zh: 现在谈论协议还为时过早。

premiere.en: Rossini’s work had its premiere at the Paris Opera.
premiere.zh: 罗西尼的作品在巴黎歌剧院首演。

premise.en: Schools may earn extra money by renting out their premises.
premise.zh: 学校通过出租房屋场地可以获取额外收入。

premise.en: The manager escorted him off the premises.

premium.en: Consumers are prepared to pay a premium for organically grown vegetables.
premium.zh: 消费者愿意多花钱购买有机蔬菜。

premium.en: Top quality cigars are being sold at a premium.

preoccupation.en: The management’s preoccupation with costs and profits resulted in a drop in quality and customer service.
preoccupation.zh: 管理层过于追求成本效益和利润，导致产品质量和客户服务水平有所下降。

preoccupation.en: Their main preoccupation was how to feed their families.
preoccupation.zh: 他们主要关心的是如何养家糊口。

preparation.en: This dish is good for dinner parties because much of the preparation can be done ahead of time.
preparation.zh: 这道菜适合宴会，因为很多准备工作可以事先做好。

preparation.en: Business training is a good preparation for any career.
preparation.zh: 业务培训对任何职业都是良好的基础。

preparatory.en: A lot of preparatory work still needs to be done.
preparatory.zh: 还有很多准备工作要做。

preparatory.en: The partners held several meetings preparatory to signing the agreement.
preparatory.zh: 合伙人在签订协议之前举行了几次会议。

prepare.en: Prepare the sauce while the pasta is cooking.
prepare.zh: 煮面的同时准备调味汁。

prepare.en: When we got home, Stephano was busy preparing dinner.
prepare.zh: 我们到家时斯特凡诺正忙着准备晚餐。

prepared.en: You have to be prepared to take risks in this kind of work.
prepared.zh: 做这种工作你必须准备好承担风险。

prepared.en: How much is she prepared to pay?

preponderance.en: There is a preponderance of female students in the music department.
preponderance.zh: 在音乐系里女学生占大多数。

preposterous.en: The whole idea sounds absolutely preposterous!
preposterous.zh: 整个想法听起来荒谬透顶！

prerequisite.en: A reasonable proficiency in English is a prerequisite for the course.
prerequisite.zh: 不错的英语水平是上这门课程的前提。

prerogative.en: Education was once the prerogative of the elite.
prerogative.zh: 受教育曾是上等阶层的特权。

prerogative.en: Arriving late is a woman’s prerogative.

presage.en: The large number of moderate earthquakes that have occurred recently could presage a larger quake soon.
presage.zh: 最近多次发生中等强度的地震，这预示着可能很快就会发生更强烈的地震。

prescribe.en: If these don’t work I may have to prescribe you something stronger.
prescribe.zh: 如果这些药无效，我也许得给你开一些药效更强的。

prescribe.en: What punishment does the law prescribe for this crime?
prescribe.zh: 法律规定这种罪行应受何处罚？

prescribed.en: All schools must follow the prescribed curriculum.
prescribed.zh: 所有学校都必须按规定课程上课。

prescription.en: We are trying to cut the price of prescription drugs.
prescription.zh: 我们正努力降低处方药的价格。

prescription.en: I got the prescription filled on the way home.
prescription.zh: 回家的路上我买了医生开给我的药。

presence.en: Your presence is requested at the club meeting on Friday.
presence.zh: 敬请出席于周五举行的俱乐部会议。

presence.en: Tests revealed the presence of poison in the blood.
presence.zh: 化验显示血液中含有毒素。

present.en: Foreign observers were present at the elections.
present.zh: 外国观察员出席了选举。

present.en: The memory of her brother’s death is still present in her mind.
present.zh: 哥哥去世时的情景她仍记忆犹新。

presentation.en: Dr Evans thanked him for coming to make the presentations.
presentation.zh: 埃文斯博士感谢他来颁奖。

presentation.en: We will begin a series of presentations to help the public fully understand our system.
presentation.zh: 我们将进行一系列的说明，帮助公众充分了解我们的制度。

presently.en: The doctor will be here presently.

preservation.en: Eliot campaigned for the preservation of London’s churches.
preservation.zh: 埃利奥特发起了保护伦敦各教堂的运动。

preservation.en: We are working for the preservation of the environment.
preservation.zh: 我们正致力于环境保护工作。

preserve.en: We must encourage the planting of new trees and preserve our existing woodlands.
preserve.zh: 我们必须鼓励栽种新树木，同时也要保护现有的林地。

preserve.en: Norma tried to preserve a normal family life in difficult circumstances.
preserve.zh: 诺尔玛努力在艰苦的条件下维持正常的家庭生活。

preside.en: I shall be pleased to preside at your meetings.
preside.zh: 我很高兴主持你们的会议。

preside.en: Mr Justice Waller, presiding judge for the north east
preside.zh: 沃勒法官，东北地区的首席法官

presidency.en: Roosevelt was elected four times to the presidency of the US.
presidency.zh: 罗斯福四次当选美国总统。

presidency.en: There were few real improvements during his presidency.
presidency.zh: 在他的总统任期内几乎没有什么真正的改善。

press.en: The press has been very nasty about him.
To judge from the press, the concert was a great success.
press.zh: 从新闻报道来看，这次音乐会非常成功。

pressing.en: Poverty is a more pressing problem than pollution.
pressing.zh: 贫穷是比污染更紧迫的问题。

pressing.en: The CD, released in October, sold out a first pressing of 1,500 in just four months.

pressure.en: They are putting pressure on people to vote yes.
pressure.zh: 他们正在向民众施加压力，要求他们投赞成票。

pressure.en: The minister was under pressure to resign.
pressure.zh: 部长面临被迫辞职的压力。

pressurize.en: It is not a good idea to pressurize children into playing a musical instrument.
pressurize.zh: 强迫孩子学习乐器不好。

pressurize.en: Everyone is being pressurized to vote.

prestige.en: The king wanted to enhance his prestige through war.
prestige.zh: 国王想通过战争来提高自己的威信。

prestige.en: This little-known British firm has now gained considerable prestige.
prestige.zh: 这家名不见经传的英国公司如今已经声名鹊起。

presumably.en: It’s raining, which presumably means that your football match will be cancelled.
presumably.zh: 下雨了，这可能意味着你们的足球比赛要取消。

presume.en: Each of you will make a speech, I presume?
presume.zh: 我想你们每个人都会发言，是吗？

presume.en: I presume we’ll be there by six o'clock.

presumption.en: On the presumption that the doctor knows best, I took the medicine.
presumption.zh: 我想医生是最清楚的，所以就把这药吃了。

presumption.en: She was enraged by his presumption.

pretence.en: Tollitt made no pretense of being surprised.
pretence.zh: 托利特没有装出吃惊的样子来。

pretence.en: How long are you going to keep up the pretence of being ill?

pretend.en: We can’t go on pretending that everything is OK.
pretend.zh: 我们不能继续佯装一切都没问题。

pretend.en: Let’s pretend we’re on the Moon.
pretend.zh: 我们假装自己是在月球上吧。

pretension.en: Lilith resented Adam’s pretensions to superiority.
pretension.zh: 利莉思十分厌恶亚当自命不凡的架势。

pretension.en: The group don’t have any pretensions to be pop stars.
pretension.zh: 这个组合从未标榜自己是流行乐坛的明星。

pretext.en: The incident provided the pretext for war.
pretext.zh: 那个事件成了战争的借口。

pretext.en: Tom called at her apartment on the pretext of asking for a book.
pretext.zh: 汤姆借口要一本书去了她的公寓。

pretty.en: I’m pretty sure he’ll say yes.
pretty.zh: 我相当肯定他会同意的。
她看上去还是非常痛苦。

prevail.en: I admired the creativity which prevailed among the young writers.
prevail.zh: 我钦佩青年作家普遍具有的那种创造力。

prevail.en: He considered lying, but then common sense prevailed.
prevail.zh: 他想过要说谎，不过后来理智还是占了上风。

prevailing.en: The prevailing mood of public opinion remained hostile.
prevailing.zh: 公众仍普遍持敌对情绪。

prevalent.en: Solvent abuse is especially prevalent among younger teenagers.
prevalent.zh: 吸胶毒在十三四岁的少年中尤其普遍。

prevent.en: The rules are intended to prevent accidents.
prevent.zh: 这些规定旨在预防事故。

prevent.en: His back injury may prevent him from playing in tomorrow’s game.
prevent.zh: 背伤可能让他明天不能参赛。

prevention.en: Educating new drivers is important for the prevention of accidents.
prevention.zh: 教育新司机对于预防事故很重要。

prevention.en: Effective crime prevention must be our main goal.
prevention.zh: 有效预防犯罪必须是我们的主要目标。

preventive.en: While travelling abroad, take preventive measures to avoid illness.
preventive.zh: 在国外旅行时，要采取预防措施以免患病。

preview.en: Journalists will be able to preview the exhibition tomorrow.
preview.zh: 新闻记者明天将可以参观预展。

preview.en: The band will preview their new album on 2nd March.

previous.en: I’ve met him before on two previous occasions.
She has two children from a previous marriage.
previous.zh: 她在前一次婚姻中生了两个孩子。

previously.en: Almost half the group had previously been heavy smokers.
previously.zh: 该群体中近一半人以前烟瘾都很大。

previously.en: Six months previously he had smashed up his car.
previously.zh: 六个月以前他撞毁了自己的汽车。

prey.en: Street children in this part of the world often fall prey to drug dealers.
prey.zh: 这个地方的街头流浪儿童常常落入毒贩的魔掌。

prey.en: They are prey to nameless fears.
prey.zh: 他们陷入莫名的恐惧中。

price.en: The price of fuel keeps going up.
We agreed a price for the bike.
price.zh: 我们谈妥了那辆自行车的价格。

priceless.en: The ability to motivate people is a priceless asset.
priceless.zh: 能够激励人们是难能可贵的优点。

priceless.en: The look on his face was priceless.
priceless.zh: 他脸上的表情极为可笑。

prick.en: Prick the sausages before you grill them.
She had pricked her finger on a rose thorn.
prick.zh: 她被玫瑰花刺扎破了手指。

prickly.en: His skin felt painful and prickly.
The base of my neck was prickly with sweat.
prickly.zh: 我的脖子根出了汗，觉得刺痛。

pride.en: He wore his medals with pride.
He takes great pride in his children’s achievements.
pride.zh: 他为儿女的成就感到非常骄傲。

primacy.en: We must give primacy to education.

primarily.en: The advertisement is aimed primarily at children.
primarily.zh: 这则广告的对象主要是儿童。

primary.en: Our primary concern is to provide the refugees with food and health care.
primary.zh: 我们的头等大事是向难民提供食品和医疗。

primary.en: Many of the villagers rely on fishing as their primary source of income.
primary.zh: 很多村民以打鱼作为他们的主要收入来源。

prime.en: Smoking is the prime cause of lung disease.
prime.zh: 抽烟是引发肺部疾病的首要原因。

prime.en: Our prime concern is providing jobs for all young school leavers.
prime.zh: 我们的头等大事是为所有的年轻毕业生提供工作。

primeval.en: Primeval clouds of gas formed themselves into stars.

primitive.en: The first station buildings were quite primitive.
primitive.zh: 最初的车站建筑很简陋。

primitive.en: The local hospital care is primitive and unreliable.
primitive.zh: 当地医院的治疗水平落后，靠不住。

primordial.en: He was driven on by a primordial terror.
primordial.zh: 他被本能的恐惧所驱使。

principal.en: His principal reason for making the journey was to visit his family.
principal.zh: 他那次旅程的首要目的是探访家人。

principal.en: Teaching is her principal source of income.
principal.zh: 教书是她主要的收入来源。

principally.en: The money is principally invested in stocks and shares.
principally.zh: 这笔钱主要投资于股票。

principally.en: He was principally a landscape painter.

principle.en: Schools try to teach children a set of principles.
principle.zh: 学校设法教给孩子们一套道德准则。

principle.en: He’s got no principles at all!

print.en: I need to make a few changes before I print the document.
print.zh: 打印文件之前我要作些修改。

print.en: The company’s name was printed in bold letters across the top of the page.
print.zh: 公司的名称用黑体字印在页面的顶端。

printing.en: The first printing of her book was 10,000 copies.

prior.en: You do not need any prior knowledge of the subject.
prior.zh: 你无需事先具备该方面的知识。

prior.en: Changes may not be made without the prior approval of the council.
prior.zh: 未经委员会事先同意，不得作出改变。

priority.en: The club’s priority is to win the League.
priority.zh: 该俱乐部首先考虑的是要赢得联赛。

priority.en: The children are our first priority.
priority.zh: 孩子是我们的头等大事。

prison.en: He visits his dad in prison every week.
prison.zh: 他每周都去探望狱中的父亲。

prison.en: Ricky has been out of prison for three years now.

prisoner.en: Relationships between the staff and the prisoners are good.
Prisoners here only serve short sentences.
prisoner.zh: 这里的犯人只是短期服刑。

pristine.en: The car has been restored to pristine condition.

privacy.en: With seven people squashed in one house, you don’t get much privacy.
privacy.zh: 七个人挤在一间房子里，想要独处不大可能。

private.zh: 莫里斯拥有一架私人喷气式飞机。

private.en: He made some notes for his private use.
private.zh: 他记了些笔记供自己所用。

privately.en: I must talk to you privately.
Laura praised the pictures, though she privately thought they were rather ordinary.
privately.zh: 劳拉称赞了那些照片，虽然她心里觉得它们相当普通。

privilege.en: He had no special privileges and was treated just like every other prisoner.
privilege.zh: 他不享受特权，待遇和任何其他犯人一样。

privilege.en: Today, we have the privilege of listening to two very unusual men.
privilege.zh: 今天我们有幸聆听两位非常与众不同的男嘉宾讲话。

privileged.en: Students from a privileged background have an advantage at university.
privileged.zh: 出身于特权阶层的学生在大学里具有优势。

privileged.en: Only the privileged few can afford private education.
privileged.zh: 只有享有特权的少数人才能上得起私立学校。

prize.en: In this month’s competition you could win a prize worth £3,000.
prize.zh: 在本月的竞赛中您可以赢得价值3,000

prize.en: The first prize has gone to Dr John Gentle.

probability.en: The probability of winning the lottery is really very low.
probability.zh: 彩票的中奖几率是非常低的。

probability.en: There is a 95% probability that she will not have the disease.

probable.en: The probable cause of the fire was faulty wiring.
probable.zh: 起火的原因很可能是电路故障。

probably.en: It will probably take about a week.
probably.zh: 很可能需要一星期左右。

probably.en: This would probably be a good time to take a break.
probably.zh: 这很可能会是休息一下的好机会。

probation.en: The judge sentenced Jennings to three years’ probation.
probation.zh: 法官判詹宁斯三年缓刑。

probation.en: He pleaded guilty and was placed on probation.

probe.en: I don’t want to probe too deeply into your personal affairs.
probe.zh: 我不想过分打探你的私事。

probe.en: Police probed claims that he had sold drugs.
probe.zh: 警方就有人称他贩卖毒品一事进行了调查。

problem.en: She was older than me, but that wasn’t really a problem.
problem.zh: 她比我年长，不过那不算什么问题。

problem.en: The problem of street crime is getting worse every year.
problem.zh: 街头犯罪的问题一年比一年严重。

problematic.en: The reforms could turn out to be highly problematic.
problematic.zh: 改革最终可能会困难重重。

procedure.en: What’s the procedure for applying for a visa?
procedure.zh: 申请签证需要怎样的手续？

procedure.en: This is standard procedure for getting rid of toxic waste.
procedure.zh: 这是清除有毒废料的标准步骤。

proceed.en: The government was determined to proceed with the election.
proceed.zh: 政府决心继续进行选举。

proceed.en: Before proceeding further, we must define our terms.
proceed.zh: 我们必须先定义术语，然后再往下展开。

proceeding.en: We watched the proceedings in the street below.
proceeding.zh: 我们留心看下面街道上发生的事。

proceeding.en: At this point in the proceedings, my doctor offered me a choice.
proceeding.zh: 治疗进行到此时，医生给了我一个选择。

proceeds.en: We sold the business and bought a villa in Spain with the proceeds.
proceeds.zh: 我们卖了公司，用所得的钱在西班牙买了一幢别墅。

proceeds.en: The proceeds of the concert will go to charity.
proceeds.zh: 音乐会的收入将捐献给慈善机构。

process.en: Repetition can help the learning process.
process.zh: 重复对学习过程会有帮助。

process.en: Getting fit again has been a long slow process.
process.zh: 恢复健康是个漫长的过程。

procession.en: They marched in procession to the Capitol building.
procession.zh: 他们列队向国会大厦行进。

proclaim.en: The president proclaimed the republic’s independence.
Protesters proclaimed that the girl was innocent.
proclaim.zh: 抗议者宣称那个女孩是无辜的。

proclamation.en: The authorities issued a proclamation forbidding public meetings.
proclamation.zh: 当局发布了公告，禁止公开集会。

proclivity.en: The child showed no proclivity towards aggression.
proclivity.zh: 这孩子没有表现出攻击性倾向。

procure.en: He was accused of procuring weapons for terrorists.
procure.zh: 他被控为恐怖分子采办武器。

prod.en: Theo prodded at the dead snake.
It had prodded Ben into doing something about it.
prod.zh: 那件事促使本要做点什么。

prodigious.en: Some galaxies seem to release prodigious amounts of energy.
prodigious.zh: 一些星系似乎释放出巨大的能量。

produce.en: New drugs are producing remarkable results.
produce.zh: 新药正在产生显著的效果。

produce.en: As a policy, it did not produce the desired effect.
produce.zh: 作为一项政策，它并未产生预期的效果。

producer.zh: 好莱坞的制片人和影星

producer.en: South Carolina is the fourth largest producer of tobacco.
producer.zh: 南卡罗来纳是第四大烟草出产地。

product.en: The London factory assembles the finished product.
He works in marketing and product development.
product.zh: 他从事营销和产品开发。

production.en: By September, the new motors were in production.
The new model will go into production next year.

productive.en: Most of us are more productive in the morning.
productive.zh: 我们大多数人在早上更有效率。

productive.en: The meeting was productive of several good ideas.
productive.zh: 那次会议产生了几个好想法。

productivity.en: It cost the country $4 million in lost productivity.

profess.en: The government professes to care about the poor.
He professed to be an expert on Islamic art.
profess.zh: 他自称是伊斯兰艺术的专家。

profession.en: Some students enter other professions such as arts administration.
profession.zh: 有些学生加入了艺术管理等其他行业。

profession.en: Johnson was a barrister by profession.
profession.zh: 约翰逊的职业是讼务律师。

professional.en: What professional qualifications does he have?
It is essential to get good professional advice.
professional.zh: 获得有用的专业指导非常重要。

professionalism.en: Professionalism has raised the standard of rugby immensely.
professionalism.zh: 职业化大大提高了橄榄球运动的水平。

professor.en: She’s been named the professor of English.

proficiency.en: Nick’s proficiency with computers is well known.
proficiency.zh: 尼克对电脑很在行是出了名的。

proficient.en: There’s only one way to become proficient at anything – practice!
proficient.zh: 不管什么事，要想熟练只有一种方法——

profile.zh: 达尼的侧面轮廓很好看。

profile.en: I only saw her face in profile.

profit.en: The shop’s daily profit is usually around $500.
profit.zh: 这家商店每天的利润一般在500

profit.en: She sold the business and bought a farm with the profits.
profit.zh: 她卖了公司，用所得利润买下了一座农场。

profitable.en: The advertising campaign proved very profitable.
profitable.zh: 事实证明，这次广告宣传活动卓有成效。

profound.en: Tolstoy’s experiences of war had a profound effect on his work.
profound.zh: 托尔斯泰的战争经历深刻影响了他的作品。

profound.en: The mother’s behaviour has a profound impact on the developing child.
profound.zh: 母亲的行为对于正在成长的孩子有极大的影响。

profuse.en: Profuse sweating is one of the symptoms of heat exhaustion.
profuse.zh: 大量出汗是中暑虚脱的症状之一。

profusion.en: The house was overflowing with a profusion of strange ornaments.
profusion.zh: 这房子里摆满了奇特的装饰品。

profusion.en: Cornflowers grow in profusion in the fields.

program.en: Any large high-speed computer can be programmed to learn.
program.zh: 任何大型高速计算机都可以通过编程获得学习能力。

programme.zh: 你最喜欢的电视节目是什么？

programme.en: There’s a programme about killer whales next.
programme.zh: 接下来要播放一个关于虎鲸的节目。

progress.en: The police are disappointed by the slow progress of the investigation.
progress.zh: 警方对调查进度缓慢感到失望。

progress.en: There has been significant progress in controlling heart disease.
progress.zh: 在控制心脏病方面取得了很大的进展。

progression.en: Europe’s progression towards economic and monetary union
progression.zh: 欧洲经济和货币统一的进程

progressive.en: Britain’s progressive decline as a world power
progressive.zh: 英国作为世界强国的逐步衰落

progressive.en: The economic situation became progressively worse.
progressive.zh: 经济形势变得越来越糟。

prohibit.en: Smoking is strictly prohibited inside the factory.
They are prohibited from revealing details about the candidates.
prohibit.zh: 他们被禁止透露候选人的详情。

prohibitive.en: The cost of land in Tokyo is prohibitive.
prohibitive.zh: 东京地价令人望而却步。

prohibitive.en: Moving house would be prohibitively expensive.
prohibitive.zh: 搬家的费用可能会高得惊人。

project.en: The project aims to provide an analysis of children’s emotions.
project.zh: 该计划旨在对儿童情绪作出分析。

project.en: The scheme will now be extended after a successful pilot project (=a small trial to test if an idea will be successful).
project.zh: 试行成功后，该方案现在将得到推广。

projection.en: He declined to make projections about fourth quarter earnings.
projection.zh: 他拒绝估算第四季度的收入。

projection.en: Early projections show a three-point lead for the Socialists.
projection.zh: 早期的预测表明社会党人领先三个百分点。

prolific.zh: 韩德尔丰富的歌剧作品

prolong.en: I was trying to think of some way to prolong the conversation.
prolong.zh: 我在想方设法拖长这次谈话。

prolong.en: There’s no point in prolonging the agony any longer.
prolong.zh: 没有必要再拖着不说，让人等得这么着急。

prominence.en: She first came to prominence as an artist in 1989.
Every newspaper gave prominence to the success of England’s cricketers.
prominence.zh: 每家报纸都对英格兰板球运动员的成功大加报道。

prominent.en: Mandela played a prominent role in the early years of the ANC.
prominent.zh: 曼德拉在非国大创立初期起了重要的作用。

prominent.en: The World Cup will have a prominent place on the agenda.
prominent.zh: 世界杯赛将占据议程表的重要位置。

promise.en: Last night the headmaster promised a full investigation.
promise.zh: 校长昨晚允诺进行全面调查。

promise.en: She’s promised to do all she can to help.

promote.en: Helen was promoted to senior manager.
promote.zh: 海伦被提升为高级经理。

promotion.en: I want a job with good prospects for promotion.
promotion.zh: 我想要一份有良好晋升机会的工作。

promotion.en: Your promotion to Senior Editor is now official.
promotion.zh: 现在你被正式提升为高级编辑。

prompt.en: What prompted you to buy that suit?
prompt.zh: 什么原因让你买下了那套西装？

prompt.en: The decision prompted an outcry among prominent US campaigners.
prompt.zh: 那项决定激起了美国著名活动家的强烈抗议。

promptly.en: She turned off the alarm and promptly went back to sleep.
promptly.zh: 她关掉闹钟，马上又睡着了。

prone.en: Some plants are very prone to disease.
Kids are all prone to eat junk food.
prone.zh: 孩子往往都会吃垃圾食品。

pronounce.en: How do you pronounce your name?
The victim was pronounced dead on arrival.
pronounce.zh: 受害人送到时被宣布死亡。

pronunciation.en: Do you know the correct pronunciation of these Gaelic names?
pronunciation.zh: 你知道这些盖尔语名字的正确发音吗？

proof.en: This latest interview was further proof of how good at her job Cara was.
proof.zh: 最近的这次面谈进一步证明了卡拉的工作有多出色。

proof.en: Do you have any proof that this man stole your bag?
proof.zh: 你有什么证据证明这个男人偷了你的包吗？

propaganda.en: They have mounted a propaganda campaign against Western governments.
propaganda.zh: 他们发起了一场反西方政府的宣传运动。

propagate.en: The group launched a website to propagate its ideas.
propagate.zh: 这个团体建了一个网站来宣扬他们的主张。

propagate.en: Propagate your plants in fresh soil.
propagate.zh: 让你的植物在新鲜土壤中繁殖。

propel.en: One of our students was unable to propel her wheelchair up the ramp.
propel.zh: 我们有名学生无法把她的轮椅推上坡道。

propel.en: She used the sticks to propel herself along.

propensity.en: He seems to have a propensity for breaking things.

proper.en: Everything was in its proper place (=where it should be).
proper.zh: 每样东西都放在恰当的位置。

proper.en: The proper name for Matthew’s condition is hyperkinetic syndrome.
proper.zh: 马修的病的恰当名称是多动症。

properly.en: The brakes don’t seem to be working properly.
Then he’s not doing his job properly.
properly.zh: 那么他没把分内事做好。

property.en: The hotel is not responsible for any loss or damage to guests’ personal property.
property.zh: 宾馆对住客个人财物的丢失和损坏概不负责。

property.en: Some of the stolen property was found in Mason’s house.
property.zh: 在梅森家里找到了部分被盗财物。

prophecy.en: The prophecy that David would become king was fulfilled.
prophecy.zh: 大卫将成为国王的预言应验了。

prophecy.en: She had the gift of prophecy.

prophesy.en: He prophesied that a flood would cover the earth.
prophesy.zh: 他预言洪水将淹没大地。

prophesy.en: There was a great war between the countries, just as the elders had prophesied.
prophesy.zh: 正像长者们所预言的，那些国家之间爆发了一场大规模战争。

prophet.en: Gandhi was the prophet of non-violent protest.
prophet.zh: 甘地是非暴力抗议的倡导者。

proponent.en: Steinem has always been a strong proponent of women’s rights.
proponent.zh: 斯泰纳姆一向是妇女权利的坚决支持者。

proponent.en: Dr George is one of the leading proponents of this view.
proponent.zh: 乔治博士是这种观点的主要拥护者。

proportion.en: The proportion of women graduates has increased in recent years.
proportion.zh: 近年来女大学毕业生的比例有所上升。

proportion.en: Every parent is asked to contribute a proportion of the total cost.
proportion.zh: 每位家长都被要求认捐一部分费用。

proportional.en: The punishment should be proportional to the crime.
The fee charged by the realtor is directly proportional to the price of the property.
proportional.zh: 房产代理人收取的费用和房产价格是成正比的。

proposal.en: The committee put forward a proposal to reduce the time limit.
proposal.zh: 该委员会提出了一个缩短时限的建议。

proposal.en: They rejected proposals that the president should be directly elected.
proposal.zh: 他们拒绝了直接选举总统的提议。

propose.en: In his speech he proposed that the UN should set up an emergency centre for the environment.
propose.zh: 在演讲中他建议联合国建立一个环境应急中心。

propose.en: The report also proposes extending the motorway.
propose.zh: 那份报告还建议扩建这条高速公路。

proposition.en: Most people accept the proposition that we have a duty to protect endangered animals.
proposition.zh: 大多数人都认同我们有义务保护濒危动物的观点。

proposition.en: The theory is founded on two basic propositions.
proposition.zh: 这个理论是建立在两个基本观点之上的。

propriety.en: They discussed the propriety of treating ill children against the wishes of the parents.
propriety.zh: 他们讨论了违背父母意愿治疗患病儿童的做法是否妥当。

prosaic.en: The reality, however, is probably more prosaic.
prosaic.zh: 然而，事实很可能更平淡无奇。

prosecute.zh: 在商店行窃者将被起诉。

prosecute.en: Buxton is being prosecuted for assault.
prosecute.zh: 巴克斯顿由于袭击罪而被起诉。

prosecution.en: Walters could face prosecution for his role in the robbery.
prosecution.zh: 沃尔特斯可能因参与抢劫而面临起诉。

prosecution.en: The evidence is not sufficient to bring a prosecution against him.
prosecution.zh: 现有证据不足以对他提出起诉。

prospect.en: I see no prospect of things improving here.
prospect.zh: 我看这里的情况不可能改善。

prospect.en: There is every prospect (=a strong possibility) of the weather remaining dry this week.
prospect.zh: 本周天气很有可能持续干燥。

prosper.en: Businesses across the state are prospering.
prosper.zh: 整个州的企业都很景气。

prostitute.en: Friends from the theater criticized him for prostituting his talent in the movies.
prostitute.zh: 戏剧界的朋友批评他从事电影业是糟蹋自己的才华。

prostrate.en: They found him lying prostrate on the floor.
prostrate.zh: 他们发现他趴在地板上。

prostrate.en: Julie was prostrate with grief after her father’s death.
prostrate.zh: 父亲死后，朱莉悲痛不已。

protect.en: Are we doing enough to protect the environment?
protect.zh: 我们在保护环境方面做得够吗？

protect.en: The cover protects the machine from dust.
protect.zh: 罩子可以防止灰尘落进机器。

protection.en: This law provides protection for threatened animals and plants.
protection.zh: 这项法律保护了濒危动植物。

protection.en: The police were issued with body armour for extra protection.
protection.zh: 警察配发了防弹衣以加强保护。

protective.en: Sunscreen provides a protective layer against the sun’s harmful rays.
protective.zh: 防晒霜提供了一层抵挡阳光中有害光线的防护层。

protective.en: I can’t help feeling protective towards my kids.

protest.en: Students held a protest march against the war.
protest.zh: 学生举行了反战抗议游行。

protest.en: Five thousand employees came out on strike in protest at the poor working conditions.
protest.zh: 五千名雇员公开罢工，抗议恶劣的工作条件。

protrude.en: The envelope was protruding from her bag.
protrude.zh: 信封从她的包里露了出来。

protrude.en: The envelope was sticking out of her bag.
protrude.zh: 信封从她包里露了出来。

proud.en: Her parents are very proud of her.
You should be proud of yourself.

prove.en: You’re wrong, and I can prove it.
Tests have proved that the system works.
prove.zh: 实验证实该体系行得通。

proverbial.en: The store had everything including the proverbial kitchen sink.
proverbial.zh: 那家商店应有尽有，包括常说的厨房洗涤池。

provide.en: Tea and biscuits will be provided.
The hotel provides a shoe-cleaning service for guests.
provide.zh: 该宾馆为客人提供擦鞋服务。

provided.en: He can come with us, provided he pays for his own meals.
provided.zh: 只要他付自己的饭钱，就可以跟我们一起来。

province.en: Computers were once the exclusive province of scientists and mathematicians.
province.zh: 计算机一度为科学家和数学家专用。

provision.en: He made provisions for his wife and his children in his will.
provision.zh: 在遗嘱里他为妻子和孩子都做好了安排。

provision.en: We had enough provisions for two weeks.
provision.zh: 我们的粮食足够应付两星期。

provisional.en: We accept provisional bookings by phone.
provisional.zh: 我们接受电话临时预约。

provisional.en: The meeting has been provisionally arranged for the end of May.

provocation.en: She claims that Graham attacked her without any provocation.
provocation.zh: 她声称格雷厄姆无故攻击她。

provocation.en: He was accused of deliberate provocation.

provocative.en: The minister’s provocative remarks were widely reported in the press.
provocative.zh: 部长的煽动性言论被媒体广为报道。

provocative.en: She was accused of being deliberately provocative.

provoke.zh: 那项提议引起了广泛的批评。

provoke.en: The decision to invade provoked storms of protest.
provoke.zh: 入侵决定激起了抗议的风暴。

prowl.en: Irene prowled restlessly around the room.
prowl.zh: 艾琳不安地在房间里踱来踱去。

prowl.en: She’s always on the prowl for bargains.
prowl.zh: 她总是到处搜寻便宜货。

proximity.en: We chose the house for its proximity to the school.
proximity.zh: 我们选中这所房子是因为它离学校近。

proximity.en: Here the rich and the poor live in close proximity (=very near to each other).
proximity.zh: 在这里，富人和穷人比邻而居。

prudent.en: It might be prudent to get a virus detector for the network.
prudent.zh: 装个网络病毒检测软件也许是一种慎重的做法。

pry.en: I don’t want to pry, but I need to ask you one or two questions.
pry.zh: 我不想唐突，不过我需要问你一两个问题。

pry.en: We finally managed to pry the door open with a screwdriver.
pry.zh: 我们最后设法用螺丝刀把门撬开了。

pseudonym.zh: 他就是那位使用笔名的作者。

psychological.en: Sleep disorders are a serious psychological problem.
psychological.zh: 睡眠障碍是严重的心理疾病。

psychological.en: What was the patient’s psychological state?

psychology.en: You have to use psychology to get people to stop smoking.
psychology.zh: 让人戒烟必须利用烟民的心理。

pub.en: Do you fancy going to the pub?

public.en: We have to show that publishing this story is in the public interest (=helpful or useful to ordinary people).
public.zh: 我们必须证明刊登这篇报道有利于公众。

public.en: Public opinion is gradually shifting in favor of the imprisoned men.
public.zh: 舆论渐渐倾向于同情入狱的男子。

publication.en: She was in England for the publication of her new book.
publication.zh: 她到英国是为了出版她的新书。

publication.en: He spent his holiday writing reviews for publication.
publication.zh: 假期里他写了几篇评论准备发表。

publicity.en: Standards in education have received much publicity over the last few years.
publicity.zh: 最近几年来教育水平受到了很大的关注。

publicity.en: It’s important to gain good publicity for the school.
publicity.zh: 对学校来说，获得正面的报道很重要。

publicize.zh: 他的来访受到广泛报道。

publicly.en: She and her family agreed never to discuss the matter publicly.
publicly.zh: 她和家人一致同意，绝不公开讨论那件事。

publish.en: The first edition was published in 1765.
They are publishing the dictionary on CD-ROM.
publish.zh: 那部词典他们将以光盘版的形式推出。

puddle.zh: 孩子们噼噼啪啪地踩过一个个小水坑。

puddle.en: He had fallen asleep, his head resting in a puddle of beer.
puddle.zh: 他睡着了，脑袋耷拉在一摊啤酒中。

puff.en: George puffed and panted as he tried to keep up.
An old man puffed up to them.
puff.zh: 一位老人气喘吁吁地走向他们。

pull.en: He pulled her down into her seat.

pulp.en: Mash the bananas to a pulp.
Halve the melon and scoop out the pulp.
pulp.zh: 把瓜切成两半，挖出瓜瓤。

pulse.en: His breathing was shallow and his pulse was weak.
The doctor listened to his breathing and checked his pulse.
pulse.zh: 医生听他的呼吸并检查了他的脉搏。

pump.en: The fire department is still pumping floodwater out of the cellars.
pump.zh: 消防人员仍在用水泵从地下室里往外抽积水。

pump.en: We were able to pump clean water from several of the wells.
pump.zh: 我们能从几口井里抽出干净的水来。

punch.en: He punched me and knocked my teeth out.
punch.zh: 他朝我一拳，打落了我的牙齿。

punch.en: He punched Jack in the face.
punch.zh: 他一拳打在杰克的脸上。

punctual.en: She’s always very punctual for appointments.

puncture.en: She was cycling home when she had a puncture.
puncture.zh: 她骑车回家途中轮胎被扎破了。

puncture.en: A piece of glass punctured the back tyre.
puncture.zh: 一块玻璃把后轮胎戳破了。

pungent.en: He expressed some fairly pungent criticisms.
pungent.zh: 他提出了一针见血的批评。

punish.en: Smacking is not an acceptable way of punishing a child.
punish.zh: 要惩罚孩子，不应该用打的方式。

punish.en: He promised to punish severely any officials found guilty of electoral fraud.
punish.zh: 他承诺要严惩任何在选举中有欺诈行为的官员。

punishment.en: The punishment for treason is death.
I was sent to bed as a punishment.
punishment.zh: 作为惩罚，我被打发上床睡觉。

puppet.en: The government is in danger of becoming a mere puppet of the military.
puppet.zh: 政府面临沦为军方傀儡的危险。

puppy.en: How do you turn this puppy off?

purchase.en: Where did you purchase the car?

pure.en: My mother’s life was pure hell.
pure.zh: 我母亲的生活简直糟透了。

purely.en: The building was closed purely on the grounds of safety.
purely.zh: 那座大楼被关闭完全是出于安全考虑。

purge.en: He sought to purge the Democrat party of conservatives.
purge.zh: 他试图清除民主党内的保守派党员。

purge.en: Local languages were purged of Russian words.
purge.zh: 当地语言中的俄语词汇被清除了。

purify.en: They prayed to God to purify them.
purify.zh: 他们祈求上帝为自己涤罪。

purple.en: His face turned purple with rage.
Steve’s purple patch continued with a second victory on Tuesday.
purple.zh: 史蒂夫继续一帆风顺，周二获得了第二次胜利。

purpose.en: The purpose of this meeting is to elect a new chairman.
purpose.zh: 这次会议的目的是选出一位新主席。

purpose.en: What is the purpose of your visit?

purposeful.en: He walked purposefully to his desk.
purposeful.zh: 他径直走向自己的书桌。

purposely.en: A clause in the contract had been left purposely vague.
purposely.zh: 合同中有一个条款被故意定得模棱两可。

purse.en: Julie opened her handbag and took out her purse.
purse.zh: 朱莉打开手袋，拿出钱包。

purse.en: I locked the door and dropped the keys in my purse.
purse.zh: 我锁上门，然后把钥匙丢进手提包里。

pursuance.en: In pursuance of this objective, 8,000 letters were sent.
pursuance.zh: 为了实现这个目标，寄出了8,000

pursuant.en: The boy was provided with an interpreter, pursuant to the Individuals with Disabilities Act.
pursuant.zh: 依据《残疾人法》，为那个男孩配备了一名翻译。

pursue.en: She plans to pursue a career in politics.
Students should pursue their own interests, as well as do their school work.
pursue.zh: 除了完成课业之外，学生也应该追求自己的兴趣。

pursuit.en: People are having to move to other areas in pursuit of work.
pursuit.zh: 为了找工作，人们不得不移居他处。

pursuit.en: There were four police cars in pursuit.

push.en: It didn’t move, so she pushed harder.
push.zh: 它一动不动，因此她加力去推。

push.en: I promised to push him on the swings for as long as he wanted.
push.zh: 我答应他想在秋千上荡多久我就推多久。

put.en: He put the coffee on the table.
Where did you put the programmes?
put.zh: 你把节目单放在哪里了？

puzzle.en: The meaning of the poem has always been a puzzle.
puzzle.zh: 那首诗的含义始终是个谜。

puzzle.en: He thought he had solved the puzzle.
puzzle.zh: 他认为他已经解开了那个谜。

pyramid.en: At the bottom of the pyramid are the poor.
pyramid.zh: 位于社会金字塔最底层的是穷人。

quagmire.en: In the rainy season the roads become a quagmire.
quagmire.zh: 在雨季，道路变得一片泥泞。

quagmire.en: The Balkan situation became a political and military quagmire.
quagmire.zh: 巴尔干半岛局势成了政治和军事上的一大难题。

quake.en: The explosion made the whole house quake.
quake.zh: 爆炸使整个房子都晃动起来。

qualification.en: He left school without any qualifications.
qualification.zh: 他离校时没有拿到任何文凭。

qualification.en: We are looking for graduates with qualifications in maths or science.
qualification.zh: 我们需要具备数学或理科学历的毕业生。

qualified.en: Dawn is well qualified for her new role.
qualified.zh: 唐十分胜任她的新角色。

qualified.en: The guides are qualified to lead groups into the mountains.
qualified.zh: 这些导游有资格带团进山。

qualify.en: Free school lunches are given to children who qualify.
qualify.zh: 符合条件的儿童可获得免费的学生午餐。

qualify.en: You may qualify for unemployment benefit.
qualify.zh: 你也许有资格领取失业救济金。

qualitative.en: Women’s experiences are qualitatively different from men’s.
qualitative.zh: 女性的经历与男性的经历有实质上的差别。

quality.en: Much of the land was of poor quality.

quandary.en: Kate was in a quandary over whether to go or not.
quandary.zh: 走还是不走，凯特左右为难。

quantify.en: The damage caused to the tourist industry is difficult to quantify.
quantify.zh: 对旅游业所造成的损失难以量化。

quantify.en: The cost of unemployment to the government is quite easily quantifiable.
quantify.zh: 失业对政府造成的损失很容易量化。

quantitative.en: We need to do a proper quantitative analysis of this problem.
quantitative.zh: 我们需要对这个问题作一个正确的定量分析。

quantity.en: The police also found a quantity of ammunition in the flat.
quantity.zh: 警方还在公寓里发现了一些弹药。

quantity.en: Add 50 grams of butter, and the same quantity of sugar.

quarantine.en: The monkeys were kept in quarantine for 31 days.

quarrel.en: Jacob left after a quarrel with his wife.
quarrel.zh: 雅各布和妻子吵了一架后走了。

quarrel.en: They had a quarrel about some girl.
quarrel.zh: 他们为某个女孩吵了一架。

quarrelsome.en: He became quarrelsome after drinking too much.
quarrelsome.zh: 他喝多了就爱找人吵架。

quarry.en: Briefly, the hunter and his quarry glared at each other.
quarry.zh: 一时间，猎手和他的猎物四目相对。

quarry.en: The rock here is quarried for building stones.
quarry.zh: 这儿的岩石被开采出来用作建筑石材。

quarter.en: It’s about a page and a quarter.
quarter.zh: 大概是一又四分之一页。

quash.en: The High Court later quashed his conviction for murder.
quash.zh: 高等法院后来撤销了他犯有谋杀罪的判决。

quash.en: The decision was quashed by the House of Lords.
quash.zh: 这个决议被上议院推翻了。

queen.zh: 埃及女王克里奥帕特拉

queen.en: At 18, Victoria was crowned queen (=officially became ruler).

queer.en: Hank was beginning to feel a little queer.
queer.zh: 汉克开始感觉有点不对头。

quench.en: We stopped at a small bar to quench our thirst.
quench.zh: 我们在一家小酒吧停下来喝点东西解渴。

query.en: Give us a ring if you have any queries about the contract.
query.zh: 如对合同有任何疑问，请给我们打电话。

query.en: Staff are always available to answer your queries.
query.zh: 员工随时为您解答疑问。

quest.en: World leaders are now united in their quest for peace.
quest.zh: 世界各国领导人现在一致寻求实现和平。

quest.en: They journeyed to the distant Molucca islands in quest of spices.
quest.zh: 他们远赴摩鹿加群岛寻找香料。

question.en: Can I ask you a question?
I’m afraid I can’t answer that question.
question.zh: 我恐怕无法回答那个问题。

questionable.zh: 这个统计数据大有问题。

questionable.en: It is questionable whether the taxpayer receives value for money.
questionable.zh: 纳税人的钱是否用得物有所值是个问题。

questionnaire.en: All staff were asked to fill in a questionnaire about their jobs.
questionnaire.zh: 所有员工都被要求填写一张有关他们工作情况的调查表。

queue.en: We stood in a queue for half an hour.
queue.zh: 我们排了半个小时的队。

queue.en: You’ll have to join the queue.

quick.en: That was quick! I thought you’d be another hour.
quick.zh: 很快啊！我以为你还要一个小时呢。

quicken.en: Ray glanced at his watch and quickened his pace (=began to walk faster).
quicken.zh: 雷瞥了一眼手表，加快了步伐。

quicken.en: Companies are finding it hard to cope with the quickening pace of technological change.
quicken.zh: 各家公司都发现科技的日新月异让他们难以应付。

quickly.en: We need to get this finished as quickly as possible.
quickly.zh: 我们必须尽快完成此事。

quickly.en: Kids grow up so quickly these days.
quickly.zh: 现在的孩子长得真快啊。

quiet.en: We’ll have to be quiet so as not to wake the baby.
quiet.zh: 我们得安静点，免得吵醒宝宝。

quiet.en: It’s a nice car. The engine’s really quiet.
quiet.zh: 这车真好，发动机声音很小。

quietly.en: The mayor had been aiming to quietly turn over control of the city’s water to private business interests.
quietly.zh: 市长一直想悄悄地把该市的供水控制权交给私营企业。

quirk.en: Years later, by a strange quirk of fate, she found herself sitting next to him on a plane.
quirk.zh: 许多年以后，真是机缘巧合，她在飞机上发现自己就坐在他旁边。

quirk.en: Like every computer, this one has its little quirks.
quirk.zh: 就像所有电脑一样，这台也有它的小毛病。

quit.en: He quit his job after an argument with a colleague.
quit.zh: 他和一个同事争吵后就辞职了。

quite.en: The food in the cafeteria is usually quite good.
quite.zh: 食堂的饭菜通常很不错。

quite.en: His hair is quite thin on top now.
quite.zh: 他头顶的头发现在很稀疏了。

quiver.en: The child was quivering in her arms.
Her mouth quivered slightly as she turned away.
quiver.zh: 她嘴唇微微哆嗦着，转过头去。

quiz.en: I get fed up with television quiz shows.
quiz.zh: 我十分厌烦电视上的智力游戏节目。

quiz.en: Four men have been quizzed about the murder, but no one has yet been charged.
quiz.zh: 四名男子就这桩谋杀案接受了盘问，但目前尚无人被起诉。

quota.en: The government has imposed quotas on the export of timber.
quota.zh: 政府已对木材出口实行配额制。

quota.en: The government has decided to scrap quotas on car imports.
quota.zh: 政府决定取消汽车进口配额。

quotation.en: The following quotation is taken from a nineteenth century travel diary.
Ask the builder to give you a written quotation for the job.
quotation.zh: 叫建筑商给你一份这项工作的书面报价。

quote.en: She quoted from a newspaper article.
quote.zh: 她引用了报纸上一篇文章的内容。

quote.en: He quoted a short passage from the Bible.
quote.zh: 他引用了《圣经》里的一小段。

rabbit.en: He kept rabbiting on about the environment.
rabbit.zh: 他没完没了地唠叨环境问题。

race.en: He will be the youngest runner in the race.
race.zh: 他将是比赛中最年轻的选手。

race.en: Over 80 cars will take part in the race.

racial.en: This part of the community needs to be protected from racial prejudice.
racial.zh: 需保护社区里的这一部分人，使其免受种族偏见的伤害。

racial.en: They live in a racially mixed area.
racial.zh: 他们居住在一个种族混杂的地区。

racism.en: The government has promised to continue the fight against racism.
racism.zh: 政府已承诺继续打击种族歧视。

racist.zh: 他否认自己是种族主义者。

rack.en: Thousands of people were tortured on the rack.
rack.zh: 曾有数千人受过拉肢酷刑。

rack.en: The company is now well and truly on the rack.
rack.zh: 公司现在彻底陷入危机。

racket.en: The old machine used to make an awful racket.
racket.zh: 这台旧机器以前噪音大得吓人。

racket.en: Police believe he is involved in an international smuggling racket.
racket.zh: 警方认为他参与了国际走私的勾当。

radar.en: The coastline can now be monitored by radar.
radar.zh: 现在能用雷达监测海岸线了。

radar.en: We could see the plane quite clearly on the radar screen.
radar.zh: 我们在雷达屏幕上可清晰地看到飞机。

radiant.en: She looked radiant in a white silk dress.
radiant.zh: 她身穿白色真丝礼服，看上去光彩照人。

radiant.en: They were both radiant with happiness.

radiate.zh: 他身上散发着沉稳自信的气质。

radiation.en: An accident at the power station could result in large amounts of radiation being released.
radiation.zh: 发电站事故会造成大量核辐射泄漏。

radiation.en: Sun creams work by blocking harmful ultraviolet radiation.
radiation.zh: 防晒霜可隔离有害的紫外线辐射。

radical.en: They are proposing radical changes to the way the company is run.
radical.zh: 他们建议对公司经营模式进行重大改革。

radical.en: There are radical differences between the two organizations.
radical.zh: 这两个组织有着根本差异。

radio.en: I sat down and turned on the radio.
I don’t really listen to the radio very much.

radius.en: The shock of the explosion was felt over a radius of forty miles.
radius.zh: 爆炸引起的剧烈震动在方圆40

radius.en: There are more than a dozen golf courses within a 15-mile radius of St Andrews.

raft.en: The company has launched a whole raft of new software products.
raft.zh: 公司推出了大量新软件产品。

rag.en: He wiped his boots dry with an old rag.
rag.zh: 他用一块旧布把他的靴子擦干。

rag.en: He writes for the local rag.

rage.en: Sobbing with rage, Carol was taken to the hospital.
rage.zh: 卡罗尔气得呜呜哭，被送往医院。

rage.en: Sam became quite frightening when he was in a rage.
rage.zh: 萨姆发火的时候很吓人。

ragged.en: Crowds of ragged children played among the rocks.
ragged.zh: 一群群破衣烂衫的孩子在岩石间玩耍。

ragged.en: The old photograph looked a little ragged at the edges.
ragged.zh: 这张旧相片的边缘有点磨破了。

raging.en: I was in a raging temper.
The show was a raging success.
raging.zh: 这个节目获得了巨大的成功。

raid.en: The colonel led a successful raid against a rebel base.
raid.zh: 上校成功指挥了对叛军基地的一次袭击。

raid.en: The army launched several cross-border raids last night.
raid.zh: 昨晚军队发动了数次越境袭击。

rail.en: Passengers want a better rail service.
rail.zh: 乘客希望有更好的铁路服务。

rail.en: We continued our journey by rail.

railroad.en: The supplies were sent on the railroad.
The workers were railroaded into signing the agreement.
railroad.zh: 工人们被迫匆匆签下这个协议。

rain.en: There will be heavy rain in most parts of the country.
rain.zh: 全国大部分地区将有大雨。

rain.en: I left my bicycle out in the rain.
rain.zh: 我把自行车放在外边雨地里了。

rainfall.en: We’ve had a long period of low rainfall.
rainfall.zh: 我们已有很长一段时间雨量偏低。

rainfall.en: The city has received only half its average rainfall of four inches.
rainfall.zh: 该市目前的降雨只有往常四英寸平均雨量的一半。

raise.en: Can you raise the lamp so I can see?
raise.zh: 你能把灯举高点好让我看清吗？

raise.en: William raised his hat and smiled at her.
raise.zh: 威廉抬一抬帽子，朝她笑了笑。

rake.en: She raked the soil over to loosen the weeds.
rake.zh: 她用耙子翻土，把杂草弄松。

rake.en: I’ve been raking through my drawers looking for those tickets.
rake.zh: 我一直在翻抽屉找那些票。

rally.en: About 1,000 people attended the rally in Hyde Park.
We decided to hold a rally to put pressure on the government.
rally.zh: 我们决定举行集会来对政府施压。

ramble.en: She’s getting old and she tends to ramble a bit.
ramble.zh: 她上年纪了，说话有点颠三倒四的。

ramble.en: There’s plenty to discover as you ramble around this little island.
ramble.zh: 漫步这个小岛，你会有很多新发现。

rampant.en: Pickpocketing is rampant in the downtown area.

random.en: The company has introduced random drug testing of its employees.
random.zh: 公司已实行对雇员的随机毒品测试。

random.en: A few random shots were fired.

range.en: The drug is effective against a range of bacteria.
range.zh: 这种药对一系列细菌有效。

range.en: A fairly narrow range of people are responsible for key decisions.
range.zh: 只有少数人负责重大决定。

rank.en: He held (=had) the rank of Chief Inspector.
During the war Harold had risen to the rank of major.
rank.zh: 战争期间哈罗德晋升为少校。

ranking.en: She is now fifth in the world rankings.
He’s the ship’s ranking officer (=the one with the highest rank).
ranking.zh: 他是船上级别最高的船员。

ransom.en: The kidnappers were demanding a ransom of $250,000.
The government refused to pay the ransom.

rap.en: She was woken by a sharp rap on the door.
rap.zh: 她被一阵急促的敲门声惊醒。

rap.en: The kid’s been cited twice on drunk-driving raps.
rap.zh: 这个年轻人已经两次因醉酒驾车被传讯了。

rape.en: She had been raped and stabbed.
rape.zh: 她遭到强奸，还被刀捅了。

rape.en: Police are investigating a series of violent rapes in the town.
rape.zh: 警察在调查镇上发生的一连串暴力强奸案。

rapid.en: The patient made a rapid recovery.
He fired three times in rapid succession (=one after another).

rapidly.en: The disease was spreading more rapidly than expected.
rapidly.zh: 疾病的蔓延比预期的要快。

rapport.en: He had an excellent rapport with his patients.
rapport.zh: 他和他病人的关系极为融洽。

rapport.en: He built up a good rapport with the children.
rapport.zh: 他和孩子们建立了融洽的关系。

rapture.en: The boys gazed up at him in rapture.
rapture.zh: 男孩们欣喜若狂地抬头注视着他。

rapture.en: She went into raptures about the climate, the food, the spring flowers.
rapture.zh: 她陶醉于那里的气候、美食和春天的花儿。

rare.en: This species of plant is becoming increasingly rare.
I only saw Helen on the rare occasions when I went into her shop.
rare.zh: 我只有偶尔去海伦店里时才会见到她。

rarely.en: This method is rarely used in modern laboratories.
rarely.zh: 现代实验室里很少使用这种方法。

rarity.en: Visitors were a rarity in the village.
Some of these plants are national rarities.
rarity.zh: 这些植物中有些是国家珍品。

rash.en: Please Jessie, don’t do anything rash.
rash.zh: 求你了，杰西，不要草率行事。

rash.en: Don’t go making any rash decisions about your future!
rash.zh: 不要对你的未来贸然作决定！

rat.en: But you promised to help us, you rat!
rat.zh: 可你答应过要帮我们的，你这小人！

rat.en: They’ll kill you if they find out you’ve ratted on them!
rat.zh: 假如他们发现是你告发了他们，会杀掉你的！

ratchet.en: Raising the minimum wage would ratchet up real incomes in general.
ratchet.zh: 提高最低工资将普遍提高实际收入。

ratchet.en: The debate will ratchet up a notch on Wednesday when the Commission publishes its report.
ratchet.zh: 星期三委员会发表报告后，辩论还将升级。

rate.en: Australia’s unemployment rate rose to 6.5% in February.
It’s a new technique and the failure rate is quite high.
rate.zh: 这是一项新技术，失败率很高。

rather.en: I was rather surprised to see him with his ex-wife.
rather.zh: 我看到他和前妻在一起，感到相当惊讶。

ratify.en: We hope that the republics will be willing to ratify the treaty.
ratify.zh: 我们希望各共和国愿意签署这个条约。

rating.en: By the end of the year the prime minister’s approval rating (=how many people agreed with his policies) had fallen as low as 12 percent.
rating.zh: 到年底时，首相的支持率跌到了12%

rating.en: CBS will end the series if it continues to drop in the ratings.
rating.zh: 这部电视连续剧如果收视率排名继续下降，哥伦比亚广播公司就会停播该剧。

ratio.en: The ratio of nursing staff to doctors is 2:1.
ratio.zh: 护理人员与医生的比例为2

ration.en: Even wool was on ration in the war.
ration.zh: 战时甚至毛线都是定量配给的。

ration.en: The prisoners were queuing for their meagre rations (=small rations).
ration.zh: 犯人排队领取他们微薄的口粮。

rational.en: Parents need to be fully informed so they can make a rational decision.
rational.zh: 父母需要充分了解情况，这样才可以作出合理的决定。

rational.en: I’m sure there’s a rational explanation for all this.
rational.zh: 我相信这一切都有合理的解释。

rationale.en: The rationale behind the changes is not at all evident.
rationale.zh: 根本看不出这些变革依据何在。

rationale.en: The rationale for using this teaching method is to encourage student confidence.
rationale.zh: 采用这种教学方法的理由是要激发学生的自信心。

rattle.en: Dan banged on her door and rattled the handle.
rattle.zh: 丹砰砰地敲她的门，还把门把手拽得咯吱作响。

rattle.en: The window rattled in the wind.
rattle.zh: 窗户被风吹得咯吱作响。

raucous.zh: 他突然发出沙哑的笑声。

raucous.en: A group of raucous students spilled out of the bar.
raucous.zh: 一群吵闹的学生从酒吧里蜂拥而出。

ravage.en: His health was gradually ravaged by drink and drugs.
ravage.zh: 酗酒和吸毒渐渐毁了他的健康。

rave.en: Now I understand why travelers rave about Lapland.
rave.zh: 我现在明白为什么游客会对拉普兰交口称赞了。

rave.en: The customers were raving over our homemade chili.
rave.zh: 顾客对我们自制的辣椒粉赞不绝口。

raw.en: In its raw state, cocoa is very bitter.
raw.zh: 未经加工的可可豆味道很苦。

ray.en: The room darkened as a cloud hid the sun’s rays.
ray.zh: 一朵云挡住了阳光，房间暗了下来。

ray.en: Rays of light filtered through the trees.
ray.zh: 一束束光线透过树丛照射下来。

razor.en: Politically we are on a razor edge.
razor.zh: 我们在政治上处于险境。

reach.en: Chelsea could reach the final of the European Cup.
reach.zh: 切尔西队会进入欧洲杯决赛。

reach.en: I had reached the point where I was earning a good salary.

react.en: How did Wilson react to your idea?
react.zh: 威尔逊对你的想法有什么反应？

react.en: He reacted angrily to the suggestion that he had lied.

reaction.en: What was Jeff’s reaction when you told him about the job?
reaction.zh: 你告诉杰夫这个工作时，他是什么反应？

reaction.en: An emergency fund was set up in reaction to the famine.
reaction.zh: 针对这次饥荒设立了一个应急基金。

read.en: She picked up the letter and read it.

reader.en: The book will appeal to young readers.
reader.zh: 这本书会吸引年轻读者。

reader.en: I’ve always been an avid reader (=someone who reads a lot).
reader.zh: 我向来是一个嗜书如命的人。

readership.en: They are hoping that the paper will have quite a wide readership.
readership.zh: 他们希望这份报纸会有很多读者。

readily.en: Boats are readily available to visitors.
readily.zh: 游客可以很方便地租到船只。

readily.en: The information is readily accessible on the Internet.
readily.zh: 这些信息在因特网上一查就能找到。

reading.en: Reading is taught using a combination of several methods.
reading.zh: 综合运用多种方法进行阅读教学。

reading.en: Her main reading seems to be mystery novels.
reading.zh: 她好像主要就是看悬疑小说。

readjust.en: It takes time to readjust after a divorce.
readjust.zh: 离婚后需要时间重新适应。

readjust.en: Former soldiers often struggle to readjust to life outside the army.
readjust.zh: 退伍军人往往要努力去重新适应部队外的生活。

ready.en: Come on. Aren’t you ready yet?
When the doorbell rang he was ready and waiting.
ready.zh: 门铃响的时候，他已经准备好在等着了。

real.en: There is a real danger that the disease might spread.
real.zh: 这种疾病确实有蔓延的危险。

real.en: We need to tackle the real problems of unemployment and poverty.
real.zh: 我们需要解决失业和贫穷这两个实际问题。

realism.en: He has hope, but also a scientist’s sense of realism.
realism.zh: 他抱着希望，但同时又有着一个科学家的务实感。

realist.en: She had always been a realist, not a dreamer.
realist.zh: 她一向是现实主义者，不是梦想家。

realistic.en: It’s just not realistic to expect a promotion so soon.
realistic.zh: 这么快就想升职根本不现实。

realistic.en: You need to be realistic about the amount you can do in a day.
realistic.zh: 你对自己一天能完成多少工作量要现实一点。

realistically.en: You can’t realistically expect to win the whole competition.
realistically.zh: 你指望场场比赛都赢是不现实的。

realistically.en: Realistically, we’re not going to get this finished this week.
realistically.zh: 说实在的，这个星期我们完成不了这事。

reality.en: TV is used as an escape from reality.
reality.zh: 电视成了逃避现实的一种方式。

reality.en: I think the government has lost touch with reality (=no longer understands what is real or true).
reality.zh: 我认为政府已经脱离了现实。

realization.en: I was shocked by the realization of what I had done.
realization.zh: 我意识到自己干了什么后大为震惊。

realization.en: There is a growing realization that we must manage the Earth’s resources more carefully.
realization.zh: 越来越多的人认识到我们必须更加谨慎地使用地球资源。

realize.en: I suddenly realized that the boy was crying.
realize.zh: 我突然意识到那男孩在哭。

realize.en: Do you realize you’re an hour late?
realize.zh: 知不知道你迟到了一个小时？

really.en: It was really cold last night.

realm.en: I suppose it’s not beyond the realms of possibility.
realm.zh: 我认为这并非没有可能。

reap.en: Those who do take risks often reap the rewards.
reap.zh: 那些真去冒险的人往往会得到回报。

reappear.en: Many of these ideas reappear in his later books.
reappear.zh: 这些观点有许多都在他后来的书里再次出现。

rear.en: The hotel overlooks the river to the rear.

rearrange.en: She set about rearranging the furniture in the living room.
rearrange.zh: 她开始重新摆放起居室的家具。

rearrange.en: My secretary will phone to rearrange the appointment.
rearrange.zh: 我的秘书会打电话重新预约。

reason.en: People give different reasons for wanting to change jobs.
reason.zh: 人们想换工作的理由各不相同。

reason.en: We’d like to know the reason why she didn’t accept the job.
reason.zh: 我们想知道她不接受这份工作的原因。

reasonable.en: Be reasonable – you can’t expect her to do all the work on her own!
reasonable.zh: 要讲道理，你不能指望她一个人干所有的工作！

reasonable.en: I thought it was a perfectly reasonable (=completely reasonable) question.
reasonable.zh: 我认为这个问题问得很有道理。

reasonably.en: The car is in reasonably good condition.
He’s doing reasonably well at school.
reasonably.zh: 他在学校表现还算不错。

reassure.zh: 老师们安慰焦急的父母。

reassure.en: He tried to reassure me that my mother would be okay.
reassure.zh: 他试图安慰我，说我母亲不会有事的。

rebate.en: You may be entitled to a tax rebate.

rebel.zh: 反政府的叛乱分子攻击该镇。

rebel.en: Alex has always been a bit of a rebel.
rebel.zh: 亚历克斯向来有点叛逆。

rebellion.en: The Bretons rose in rebellion against the King.
rebellion.zh: 布列塔尼人发动起义，反对国王。

rebellious.en: He’s always had a rebellious streak (=a tendency to rebel).

rebound.en: His shot on goal rebounded off the post.
rebound.zh: 他的射门被球门柱弹出。

rebound.en: Share prices rebounded today after last week’s losses.
rebound.zh: 股票价格在上周下跌之后，今天出现了反弹。

rebuild.en: The church was completely rebuilt in the last century.
rebuild.zh: 这座教堂在上个世纪全面重建。

rebuild.en: The first priority is to rebuild the area’s manufacturing industry.
rebuild.zh: 当务之急是恢复该地区的制造业。

rebuke.en: Members of the jury were sharply rebuked for speaking to the press.
rebuke.zh: 陪审团成员因向媒体发表言论而受到严厉指责。

recall.en: You don’t happen to recall his name, do you?
recall.zh: 你不会恰巧还想得起他的名字吧？

recall.en: I seem to recall I’ve met him before somewhere.
recall.zh: 我好像记得以前在哪儿见过他。

recapture.en: The film really recaptures the atmosphere of those days.
recapture.zh: 影片确实重现了那个年代的氛围。

recapture.en: He was recaptured after nearly two weeks on the run.
recapture.zh: 他逃亡将近两周后再次被抓获。

recede.en: The pain in his head gradually receded.
The flood waters finally began to recede in November.

receipt.en: Keep your receipt in case you want to bring it back.
receipt.zh: 保留收据以备退货之需。

receipt.en: Make sure you get receipts for everything.
receipt.zh: 每件东西都一定要拿收据。

receive.en: All the children will receive a small gift.
receive.zh: 每个孩子都会收到一份小礼物。

receive.en: She received an honorary degree from Harvard.
receive.zh: 她获得了哈佛大学的荣誉学位。

receiver.en: She picked up the receiver and dialled his number.
receiver.zh: 她拿起听筒，拨了他的电话号码。

receiver.en: The business is in the hands of the receivers.
receiver.zh: 公司现在由破产管理人接管。

recent.en: The situation has improved in recent years.

recently.en: He has recently been promoted to Assistant Manager.
recently.zh: 他最近晋升为经理助理。

recently.en: Jerry lived in Cairo until quite recently.
recently.zh: 直至不久之前杰里一直住在开罗。

reception.en: She was unsure of her reception after everything that had happened.
reception.zh: 发生了这些事后，她对自己是否还受欢迎没把握。

reception.en: The delegates gave him a warm reception.

receptive.en: You might find them in a more receptive mood tomorrow.
receptive.zh: 也许他们明天会更乐于接受意见。

recess.en: Her favorite things at school are music and recess.
recess.zh: 她在学校最喜欢的是音乐课和课间休息。

recession.en: There is deep recession in the UK.
recession.zh: 英国处于严重的经济衰退之中。

recharge.en: I’m going to spend a week in the mountains to recharge my batteries.
recharge.zh: 我准备去山里待一个星期，恢复一下精力。

recipe.en: She said that five small boys on skis was a recipe for disaster, not a holiday.
recipe.zh: 她说五个来滑雪的小男孩就不是来度假的，而是来闯祸的。

reciprocal.en: He spoke of the necessity for a reciprocal relationship that would be useful for all sides.
reciprocal.zh: 他谈及需要建立对各方都有益的互惠关系。

reciprocal.en: Such treaties provide reciprocal rights and obligations.
reciprocal.zh: 此类协议规定了相互之间的权利与义务。

reciprocate.en: When he spoke I was expected to reciprocate with some remark of my own.
reciprocate.zh: 他在说话时，我也应该说点什么回应他。

reciprocate.en: It was a hopeless love that could not possibly be reciprocated.
reciprocate.zh: 那是一种无望的爱，不可能得到回报。

recitation.en: He went into a recitation of his life from the earliest years.
recitation.zh: 他从早年生活开始，逐一述说他的经历。

recite.en: She recited a poem that she had learnt at school.
recite.zh: 她背诵了一首学校里学的诗。

recite.en: Len recited the breakfast menu – cereal, bacon and eggs, and toast.

reckless.en: He was accused of causing death by reckless driving.
reckless.zh: 他被控因鲁莽驾驶致人死亡。

reckless.en: He ran into the burning house with reckless abandon (=without caring about the danger).
reckless.zh: 他不顾危险冲入着火的房子里。

reckon.en: Do you reckon he’ll agree to see us?
reckon.zh: 你认为他会同意见我们吗？

reckon.en: The police reckon that whoever killed Dad was with him earlier that day.
reckon.zh: 警方认为杀害爸爸的人那天早些时候就和他在一起。

reclaim.en: You may be entitled to reclaim some tax.
reclaim.zh: 你也许可以享受一定额度的退税。

reclaim.en: This land will be reclaimed for a new airport.
reclaim.zh: 这块土地将被开发用来建新机场。

recline.en: I spent Sunday reclining in a deckchair.
recline.zh: 我星期天一整天都躺在帆布折椅里。

recline.en: A solitary figure was reclining on the grass.
recline.zh: 一个孤零零的人斜躺在草地上。

recognition.en: Don’s recognition of the importance of Suzy in his life
recognition.zh: 唐认识到苏济在他生命中的重要性

recognition.en: There is general recognition that the study techniques of many students are weak.
recognition.zh: 人们普遍认识到很多学生学习技巧薄弱。

recognize.en: I didn’t recognize you in your uniform.
recognize.zh: 你穿上制服我认不出你了。

recognize.en: It was malaria, but Dr Lee hadn’t recognized the symptoms.
recognize.zh: 这是疟疾，但李医生没有认出症状。

recoil.en: She recoiled from his touch as if she had been slapped.
recoil.zh: 他一碰她，她便往后缩，仿佛被打了一巴掌。

recoil.en: He recoils from everything in life that demands hard work.
recoil.zh: 生活中凡是需要付出努力的事，他都踌躇不前。

recollect.en: All I recollect is a grey sky.
recollect.zh: 我只记得一片灰色的天空。

recollect.en: She recollected sadly that she and Ben used to laugh a lot.
recollect.zh: 她伤心地回忆起以前她和本经常笑声不断。

recollection.en: My earliest recollections are of my mother bending over my cot.
recollection.zh: 我最早的记忆是母亲俯身站在我的小床前。

recollection.en: I have no recollection of how I found my way there in the dark.
recollection.zh: 我不记得自己是怎样在黑暗中找到那里的。

recommend.en: I recommend that you get some professional advice.
recommend.zh: 我建议你咨询专家的意见。

recommend.en: Doctors strongly recommend that fathers should be present at their baby’s birth.
recommend.zh: 医生极力建议孩子出生时父亲应该在场。

recommendation.en: We will review the case and make a recommendation to the client.
recommendation.zh: 我们将审查此案，然后向当事人提出建议。

recommendation.en: We are making no recommendation that children should use Standard English.
recommendation.zh: 我们并不是建议儿童一定要使用标准英语。

recompense.en: The charge recompenses the bank for the costs involved.
recompense.zh: 这项收费填补了银行的相关费用。

reconcile.en: The possibility remains that the two theories may be reconciled.
reconcile.zh: 这两种理论仍是有可能协调的。

reconcile.en: Bevan tried to reconcile British socialism with a wider international vision.
reconcile.zh: 比万试图用更广阔的国际视野来协调英国的社会主义。

reconsider.en: He should reconsider his decision to resign.
reconsider.zh: 他应该重新考虑辞职的决定。

reconsider.en: We want you to come. Please reconsider.
reconsider.zh: 我们希望你来，请你重新考虑一下。

reconstitute.en: The committees will be reconstituted after the election.
reconstitute.zh: 委员会将在选举后改组。

reconstitute.en: In 1832 the firm was reconstituted as Mills and Co.

reconstruct.en: Police were reconstructing the movements of the murdered couple.
reconstruct.zh: 警方正在重现这对被害夫妇的行为活动。

reconstruct.en: The task ahead is to reconstruct the building.
reconstruct.zh: 眼前的任务是要重建这栋大楼。

reconstruction.en: Detectives want to stage a reconstruction of events.
reconstruction.zh: 警探想要再现事件的经过。

record.en: I try to keep a record of everything I spend.
record.zh: 我尽量把所有的花销都记录下来。

record.en: According to official records, five people were killed last year near that road junction.
record.zh: 据官方记录，去年有五人在那个路口附近丧生。

recording.en: Have you heard the new recording of Mozart’s Requiem?
recording.zh: 你听过莫扎特《安魂曲》的新录制版本吗？

recount.en: Alan recounted how he and Joyce had met.
recount.zh: 艾伦讲述了他和乔伊丝相识的经过。

recourse.en: We may conclude that he never had recourse to this simple experiment.
recourse.zh: 我们也许可以断定，他根本就没有试过这个简单的实验。

recourse.en: Surgery may be the only recourse.
recourse.zh: 手术可能是唯一的办法。

recover.en: After a few days of fever, she began to recover.
recover.zh: 发烧几天之后，她开始恢复。

recover.en: He’s in hospital, recovering from a heart attack.
recover.zh: 他心脏病发作住院了，正在康复之中。

recovery.en: Doctors expect him to make a full recovery.
recovery.zh: 医生预计他能完全康复。

recovery.en: Ann made a quick recovery from her operation.

recreate.en: You can never recreate the feeling of winning for the first time.
recreate.zh: 你永远无法再次体会第一次获胜时的心情。

recreation.en: His only recreations are drinking beer and watching football.
recreation.zh: 他唯一的消遣就是喝啤酒和看足球比赛。

recruit.en: We’re having difficulty recruiting enough qualified staff.
recruit.zh: 我们难以招聘到足够的合格职员。

recruit.en: Many government officials were recruited from private industry.
recruit.zh: 很多政府官员是从私营企业招募来的。

rectify.en: I did my best to rectify the situation, but the damage was already done.
rectify.zh: 我竭尽全力去挽回局面，但损害已经造成了。

recur.en: There is a danger that the disease may recur.
Love is a recurring theme in the book.
recur.zh: 爱情是这本书中反复出现的主题。

recurrence.en: Measures must be taken to stop a recurrence of last night’s violence.
recurrence.zh: 必须采取措施防止昨晚的暴力事件再次发生。

recurrent.en: Political revolution is a recurrent theme in Riley’s books.
recurrent.zh: 政治革命是赖利书里一再出现的主题。

recycle.en: We take all our bottles to be recycled.
recycle.zh: 我们把我们所有的瓶子都回收利用。

recycle.en: The fashion world just keeps recycling old ideas.
recycle.zh: 时装界就是不停地翻新旧观念。

red.en: We painted the door bright red.
Every time you mention his name, she goes bright red.
red.zh: 每次你提到他的名字，她的脸都会涨得通红。

redeem.en: Olivier’s performance redeemed an otherwise second-rate play.
redeem.zh: 奥利维尔的表演补救了一出本是二流水平的戏。

redeem.en: The hotel had a single redeeming feature – it was cheap.
redeem.zh: 这家宾馆只有一个可取之处——

reduce.en: The governor announced a new plan to reduce crime.
reduce.zh: 州长宣布了一项降低犯罪率的新计划。

reduce.en: The helmet law should reduce injuries in motorcycle accidents.
reduce.zh: 头盔法的实施应该能减少摩托车事故的受伤率。

reduction.en: The company promised they would make no staff reductions for at least two years.
reduction.zh: 公司承诺至少两年不裁员。

redundancy.en: The closure of the export department resulted in over 100 redundancies.
redundancy.zh: 出口部关闭导致一百多人被解雇。

redundancy.en: Two thousand workers now face redundancy.

redundant.en: Seventy factory workers were made redundant in the resulting cuts.
As the economy weakens, more and more jobs will be made redundant.
redundant.zh: 随着经济疲弱，越来越多的工作岗位将被裁撤。

reed.en: Reeds grew in clumps all along the river bank.
reed.zh: 沿河岸长着一丛丛芦苇。

reel.en: Norman’s brain was reeling, but he did his best to appear calm.
reel.zh: 诺曼头都晕了，但他尽量显得平静。

reel.en: The party is still reeling from its recent election defeat.
reel.zh: 这个政党仍被最近的选举失利弄得晕头转向。

refer.en: We agreed never to refer to the matter again.
refer.zh: 我们说定永远不再提这件事。

refer.en: Although she didn’t mention any names, everyone knew who she was referring to.
refer.zh: 尽管她没有提任何人的名字，但大家都知道她指的是谁。

referee.en: His headmaster agreed to act as his referee.
referee.zh: 他的校长同意做他的推荐人。

reference.en: There is no direct reference to her own childhood in the novel.
reference.zh: 小说里没有直接提及她自己的童年。

reference.en: The article made no reference to previous research on the subject.
reference.zh: 文章没有提及此前对该课题的研究情况。

referendum.en: The city council agreed to hold a referendum on the issue in November.

refill.en: The waitress refilled our coffee cups.
refill.zh: 女服务员又把我们的咖啡杯斟满。

refine.en: Car makers are constantly refining their designs.
refine.zh: 汽车制造商在不断完善他们的设计。

refined.en: Laser surgery has become much more refined over the last decade.
refined.zh: 在过去十年间，激光手术已日臻完善。

refinement.en: The new model has a number of refinements.
refinement.zh: 新型号有一些细微的改进。

refinement.en: The new theory is a refinement of Corbin’s theory of personality development.
refinement.zh: 这个新理论是对科尔宾人格发展理论的改良。

reflect.en: She could see her face reflected in the car’s windshield.
reflect.zh: 她看到自己的脸映照在汽车的挡风玻璃上。

reflect.en: The drop in consumer spending reflects concern about the economy.
reflect.zh: 消费支出的下降反映出人们对经济的担忧。

reflection.en: Can you see your reflection in the glass?
reflection.zh: 你能看到玻璃里你的影像吗？

reflection.en: A moment’s reflection will show the stupidity of this argument.
reflection.zh: 只需认真想一下便可看出这种观点多么愚蠢。

reflective.en: Stick reflective tape on your school bag.
reflective.zh: 给你的书包贴上反光带。

reflective.en: She was in a reflective mood.

reform.en: The government announced a much-needed programme of economic reform.
reform.zh: 政府宣布了一套极为必要的经济改革方案。

reform.en: Reforms were made to revive the economy.
reform.zh: 为复苏经济而进行了改革。

refrain.en: Please refrain from smoking in this area.
Our proposal met with the constant refrain that the company could not afford it.
refrain.zh: 我们的提议所得到的答复就是那句说了一遍又一遍的老话——“

refresh.en: He refreshed himself with a glass of iced tea.
refresh.zh: 他喝了杯冰茶提了提神。

refreshing.en: It made a refreshing change to talk to someone new.
refreshing.zh: 和刚认识的人谈话感觉很新鲜。

refreshment.en: Refreshments will be served after the meeting.
We worked all day without refreshment.
refreshment.zh: 我们不吃不喝地工作了一整天。

refuge.en: During the frequent air-raids, people took refuge in their cellars.
refuge.zh: 在频繁的空袭中，人们躲在地窖里避难。

refuge.en: A huge oak tree provided a refuge from the storm.
refuge.zh: 一棵巨大的橡树成了躲避暴风雨的地方。

refugee.en: Refugees were streaming across the border.

refund.en: They refused to give me a refund.
Return your purchase within 14 days for a full refund.

refurbish.en: The Grand Hotel has been completely refurbished.
refurbish.zh: 格兰德酒店已彻底整修。

refusal.en: His refusal to pay the fine got him into even more trouble.
refusal.zh: 他拒付罚金，这下麻烦更大了。

refusal.en: His request was met with a blunt refusal.
refusal.zh: 他的要求遭到断然拒绝。

refuse.en: She asked him to leave, but he refused.
I absolutely refuse to take part in anything illegal.
refuse.zh: 我绝不愿意参加任何违法活动。

refute.en: She refuted any allegations of malpractice.
refute.zh: 她否认任何有关玩忽职守的指控。

regain.en: The family never quite regained its former influence.
regain.zh: 这个家族再也没有恢复往昔的影响力。

regain.en: He somehow managed to regain his balance.

regard.en: Jan’s regard for his great talent
regard.zh: 简对他卓越才能的敬佩

regard.en: Burt had high regard for his old law professor, Dr. Finch (=he respected him a lot).
regard.zh: 伯特对他以前的法律教授芬奇博士非常敬重。

regarding.en: Regarding your recent inquiry, I have enclosed a copy of our new brochure.
regarding.zh: 关于你最近的咨询，我随信附上一本我们最新的手册。

regardless.en: The law requires equal treatment for all, regardless of race, religion, or sex.
regardless.zh: 法律规定人人平等，无论种族、宗教或性别。

regardless.en: You get a lot of criticism, but you just have to carry on regardless.
regardless.zh: 你受到许多批评，但无论如何你只能继续下去。

regenerate.en: The Marshall Plan sought to regenerate the shattered Europe of 1947.
Small nodules form as the liver cells regenerate.
regenerate.zh: 肝细胞再生时会形成一些小结节。

regime.en: The regime got rid of most of its opponents.
regime.zh: 该政权清除了大多数反对者。

regime.en: Under the new regime, all sheep and cattle will be regularly tested for disease.
regime.zh: 根据新制度，所有牛羊都要定期接受疾病检测。

region.en: Flooding is likely in some coastal regions of the Northeast during the early part of the week.
region.zh: 本周初东北部一些沿海地区可能出现水患。

register.en: Have you signed the hotel register?
register.zh: 你在酒店登记簿上签名了吗？

register.en: Police want a national register of DNA samples.
register.zh: 警方想要一个全国范围的DNA

registration.en: Student registration (=for a course of study) starts the first week in September.

regret.en: Don’t do anything you might regret.
regret.zh: 不要做自己会后悔的事。

regret.en: I regret leaving school so young.

regretful.en: She apologized and sounded genuinely regretful.
regretful.zh: 她道歉了，听语气是真心觉得后悔。

regretfully.en: Regretfully, we do not have time to continue this discussion now.
regretfully.zh: 很抱歉，我们现在没有时间继续这一讨论。

regrettable.en: This was a very regrettable error.
regrettable.zh: 这是个令人很遗憾的错误。

regrettable.en: It’s regrettable that classical music receives so little attention.
regrettable.zh: 遗憾的是，人们对古典音乐关注甚少。

regular.en: The company holds regular meetings with employees.
regular.zh: 公司定期召集雇员开会。

regular.en: His breathing was slow and regular.

regularity.en: Climate change is disrupting the regularity of the seasons.
regularity.zh: 气候的变化正在打乱季节的规律性。

regularity.en: Our team kept losing with monotonous regularity (=in a way that seems boring or annoying).
regularity.zh: 我们球队一次又一次地输掉比赛，让人感到厌烦。

regularly.en: We meet regularly, once a month.
regularly.zh: 我们定期见面，每月一次。

regulate.en: People sweat to regulate their body heat.

regulation.en: There seem to be so many rules and regulations these days.
regulation.zh: 如今好像条条框框很多。

regulation.en: The local authority is introducing new planning regulations.
regulation.zh: 地方政府正在实施新的规划条例。

regulatory.en: New drugs have been approved by the regulatory authority.
regulatory.zh: 新药已经得到监管机构的批准。

regurgitate.en: Some birds and animals regurgitate food to feed their young.
regurgitate.zh: 有些鸟兽会回吐食物以喂哺幼崽。

regurgitate.en: She tries to get students to think critically, not just regurgitate facts.
regurgitate.zh: 她试图让学生进行批判性的思考，而不仅仅是照本宣科。

rehabilitate.en: The prime minister seems to be trying to rehabilitate the former defence secretary.
rehabilitate.zh: 首相似乎在努力为前国防大臣恢复名誉。

rehabilitate.en: A lot of the older houses have now been rehabilitated.
rehabilitate.zh: 很多老房子现在都进行了修葺。

rehearsal.en: The dialogue was worked out by actors in rehearsal.
rehearsal.zh: 这段对白是演员在排练的时候想出来的。

rehearse.en: I think we need to rehearse the first scene again.
rehearse.zh: 我想我们需要把第一场再排练一次。

rehearse.en: The band was rehearsing for their world tour.
rehearse.zh: 乐队正在为他们的世界巡回演出排练。

reheat.en: I reheated some soup for lunch.
reheat.zh: 我把汤重新热了一下，午饭时喝。

reign.en: Pharaohs reigned over Egypt for centuries.
reign.zh: 法老在埃及统治了几个世纪。

reimburse.en: The company will reimburse you for travel expenses.
reimburse.zh: 你的旅费可向公司报销。

rein.en: He gave free rein to his imagination.
The finance director keeps a tight rein on spending.
rein.zh: 财务主管严格控制开支。

reinforce.en: The film reinforces the idea that women should be pretty and dumb.
reinforce.zh: 这部影片强化了这个观点——

reinforcement.en: We need to give students plenty of positive reinforcement.
reinforcement.zh: 我们需要给学生足够的正面鼓励。

reiterate.en: Let me reiterate the most important points.
reiterate.zh: 我来把最重要的几点重申一遍。

reiterate.en: Lawyers reiterated that there was no direct evidence against Mr Evans.
reiterate.zh: 律师重申没有对埃文斯先生不利的直接证据。

reject.en: Sarah rejected her brother’s offer of help.
reject.zh: 萨拉拒绝了她弟弟的帮助。
吉布森拒绝了这个想法，说它“

rejection.en: What are the reasons for his rejection of the theory?
rejection.zh: 他不接受这个理论的原因是什么？

rejection.en: They sent me a rejection letter.
rejection.zh: 他们给我发了一封回绝信。

rejoice.en: His family rejoiced at the news.
rejoice.zh: 听到这个消息，他全家都欢欣鼓舞。

rejoice.en: We rejoiced in our good fortune.

rejoin.en: She rejoined her friends in the lounge.
rejoin.zh: 她回到休息室和朋友们待在一起。

relapse.en: We were afraid he might relapse into a coma.
relapse.zh: 我们担心他会再次昏迷。

relapse.en: Clara soon relapsed into her old ways.
relapse.zh: 克拉拉很快又重蹈过去的恶习。

relate.en: I don’t understand how the two ideas relate.
relate.zh: 我不明白这两个观点有什么联系。

relate.en: The charges of fraud relate to events that took place over ten years ago.
relate.zh: 这些欺诈指控涉及十多年前发生的事件。

related.en: Police now believe that the three crimes could be related.
related.zh: 目前警方认为三宗案件可能互相关联。

related.en: He suffers with memory loss related to his disease.

relation.en: Britain threatened to break off diplomatic relations with the regime.
relation.zh: 英国威胁要和该政权断绝外交关系。

relation.en: Relations between the two countries have improved recently.
relation.zh: 最近两国关系有所改善。

relationship.en: I have quite a good relationship with my parents.
He’s studying politics and its relationship to the media.
relationship.zh: 他在研究政治及其与媒体的关系。

relative.en: Her boyfriend is a distant relative of mine.
relative.zh: 她的男朋友是我的远房亲戚。

relative.en: Most of her relatives were able to come to the wedding.
relative.zh: 她的大部分亲戚都能来参加婚礼。

relatively.en: The system is relatively easy to use.
relatively.zh: 这个系统使用起来相对容易。

relatively.en: E-commerce is a relatively recent phenomenon.
relatively.zh: 电子商务相对而言是新兴事物。

relax.en: I just want to sit down and relax.
relax.zh: 我只想坐下来休息一下。

relax.en: What Robyn needed was a drink to relax her.
relax.zh: 萝宾需要的是喝一杯放松放松。

relaxation.en: I play the piano for relaxation.
Meditation allows you to enter a state of deep relaxation.
relaxation.zh: 冥想能使你进入完全放松的状态。

relay.en: He quickly relayed this news to the other members of staff.
relay.zh: 他马上就把这个消息转告给了其他员工。

relay.en: The broadcasts were relayed by satellite.
relay.zh: 这些电视节目通过卫星进行转播。

release.en: Police arrested several men, who were later released.
release.zh: 警察逮捕了几个人，后来都释放了。

release.en: The bears are eventually released into the wild.
release.zh: 这些熊最后被放回野生环境中。

relevant.en: Relevant documents were presented in court.
relevant.zh: 法庭上出示了相关的文件。

relevant.en: We received all the relevant information.
relevant.zh: 我们收到了所有相关信息。

reliable.en: Miller was a quiet and reliable man.
reliable.zh: 米勒是个话不多且可靠的人。

reliant.en: Most companies are now reliant on computer technology.
reliant.zh: 大多数公司现在依赖计算机技术。

relic.en: Roman relics found in a field
relic.zh: 在野外发现的古罗马遗迹

relic.en: Everything in the house seemed old and untouched, like relics of an ancient time.
relic.zh: 屋里的一切似乎都很古老，没有人动过，就像是古时的遗迹。

relief.en: I felt a huge surge of relief and happiness.
He watched with relief as the girl nodded.
relief.zh: 他看到女孩点头，就放心了。

relieve.en: Drugs helped to relieve the pain.
Some people eat for comfort, to relieve their anxieties.
relieve.zh: 有些人进食是为了寻找安慰，缓解焦虑。

religion.en: The U.S. Constitution promises freedom of religion.
religion.zh: 美国宪法保证宗教信仰自由。

religion.en: The tribe practised a religion that mixed native beliefs and Christianity.
religion.zh: 这个部落信奉一种融合本地信仰和基督教信仰的宗教。

religious.en: I don’t share her religious beliefs.
religious.zh: 她的宗教信仰和我的不同。

religious.en: We tend to ignore people's spiritual needs, and focus too much on material things.
religious.zh: 我们往往忽视人们的精神需求，而过多注重物质。

religiously.zh: 他每天早上都非常认真地锻炼。

relinquish.en: No one wants to relinquish power once they have it.
relinquish.zh: 人一旦有了权就不想放弃。

relinquish.en: Stultz relinquished control to his subordinate.
relinquish.zh: 斯塔尔茨把控制权交给了他的下属。

relish.en: I don’t relish the thought of you walking home alone.
relish.zh: 我可不想让你一个人走回家。

relish.en: He relishes the chance to play Hamlet.
relish.zh: 他很高兴能有机会扮演哈姆雷特。

relocate.en: A lot of firms are relocating to the North of England.
relocate.zh: 许多公司正在迁往英格兰北部。

relocate.en: The residents were relocated to temporary accommodation while the work was being done.
relocate.zh: 施工期间，居民被安置在临时住处。

reluctance.en: Wells finally agreed, but with reluctance.
reluctance.zh: 韦尔斯最终同意了，但很勉强。

reluctant.en: Maddox was reluctant to talk about it.
reluctant.zh: 马多克斯不愿意谈论此事。

rely.en: I knew I could rely on David.
rely.zh: 我知道我可以信赖戴维。

rely.en: Many working women rely on relatives to help take care of their children.
rely.zh: 许多职业妇女都靠亲属来帮忙照看孩子。

remain.en: Please remain seated until all the lights are on.
remain.zh: 请留在座位上，直到灯全都亮起。

remainder.en: The remainder must be paid by the end of June.
He spent the remainder of his police career behind a desk.
remainder.zh: 他警察生涯的剩余时间都是在办公桌前度过的。

remains.en: On the table were the remains of the evening meal.
Her remains are buried in Westminster.
remains.zh: 她的遗体葬在威斯敏斯特。

remark.en: Unfortunately, a local journalist overheard the remark.
remark.zh: 不巧一名当地记者无意中听到了这些话。

remark.en: Caldwell, in his remarks, emphasized the need for cooperation.
remark.zh: 考德威尔发言时强调了合作的必要性。

remarkable.en: It’s a remarkable achievement for the company.
remarkable.zh: 这对公司来说是一个非凡的成就。

remarkably.en: She plays the violin remarkably well.
remarkably.zh: 她的小提琴拉得特别好。

remarkably.en: Remarkably, all of the passengers survived the crash.
remarkably.zh: 令人称奇的是，这次事故中所有乘客都幸免于难。

remedial.en: Some remedial work needs to be done on the foundations.

remedy.en: The problems in our schools do not have a simple remedy.
remedy.zh: 我们学校的问题没有简单的解决办法。

remedy.en: The program is one remedy for discrimination.
remedy.zh: 这个方案是解决歧视问题的一个办法。

remember.en: I can’t remember her exact words.

remind.en: Yes, I’ll be there. Thanks for reminding me.
The girls constantly had to be reminded about their chores.
remind.zh: 不得不经常提醒那些女孩子料理好自己的事情。

reminder.en: Occasional bursts of gunfire are a reminder that the rebels are still active.
reminder.zh: 零星的炮火声提醒人们，叛军仍在活动。

reminder.en: The damaged church was preserved as a stark reminder of the horrors of war.
reminder.zh: 这座被毁的教堂被保留下来，无情地提醒人们战争的恐怖。

reminiscent.en: Her face wore a reminiscent smile.
reminiscent.zh: 她面带微笑，沉浸在往事之中。

remission.en: The chemotherapy was successful, and she is now in remission.
remission.zh: 化疗很成功，现在她的症状有所缓解。

remission.en: The cancer has gone into remission.

remit.en: The court remitted the matter to the agency for reconsideration.
remit.zh: 法庭将此事发回该机构作重新考虑。

remittance.en: We will forward the goods on remittance of £10.

remnant.en: The remnants of a meal stood on the table.

remodel.en: The airport terminals have been extensively remodelled.
remodel.zh: 航站楼已作了大规模的改建。

remorse.en: Throughout the trial, he had shown no remorse.
remorse.zh: 整个审判过程中，他没有表示出一丝悔意。

remorse.en: She felt a pang of remorse for what she had done.
remorse.zh: 她为自己所做的事感到一阵悔恨。

remote.en: There’s a remote chance that you can catch him before he leaves.
remote.zh: 你不大可能在他离开前赶上他。

remote.en: The prospect of peace seems remote.
remote.zh: 实现和平的希望似乎很渺茫。

removal.en: The removal men have been in and out all day.
removal.zh: 搬家工人一整天都在进进出出。

remove.en: Remove the old wallpaper and fill any holes in the walls.
remove.zh: 撕下旧墙纸，把墙上的洞都填平。

remove.en: Reference books may not be removed from the library.
remove.zh: 参考书不得带出图书馆。

rename.en: Myddleton Way was renamed Allende Avenue.
rename.zh: 米德尔顿路已改名为阿连德大街。

render.en: He was rendered almost speechless by the news.
render.zh: 听到这个消息他几乎说不出话来。

render.en: The blow to his head was strong enough to render him unconscious.
