render.zh: 他头上挨了重重的一击，昏了过去。

rendezvous.en: He made a rendezvous with her in Times Square.
rendezvous.zh: 他和她相约在时代广场见面。

rendezvous.en: Boats picked us up at pre-arranged rendezvous.
rendezvous.zh: 船在预先约定的地点接我们。

renew.en: I need to renew my passport this year.
renew.zh: 今年我需要办理护照换发。

renew.en: Local people have renewed their efforts to save the school.
renew.zh: 当地居民再一次作出努力，挽救这所学校。

renewable.en: It’s a six-month lease but it’s renewable.
renewable.zh: 租期六个月，但是可以续签。

renewal.en: Spring is a time of renewal.
renewal.zh: 春天是万物复苏的时节。

renewal.en: Mark’s contract comes up for renewal at the end of this year.
renewal.zh: 马克的合同将在今年年末到期，需要续签。

renounce.en: Edward renounced his claim to the French throne.
renounce.zh: 爱德华宣布放弃对法国王位的继承权。

renovate.en: The hotel has been renovated and redecorated.
renovate.zh: 酒店已经翻新，并重新装饰。

renowned.en: He’s renowned as a brilliant speaker.

rent.en: Most students rent rooms in their second year.
rent.zh: 大多数学生到二年级时租房居住。

rent.en: I’d rather have my own house than rent.
rent.zh: 我更想有自己的房子，不想租房。

rental.en: The price includes accommodation and car rental.
rental.zh: 这个价格包括住宿和租车的费用。

reopen.en: The swimming pool will reopen in May.

reorganize.en: Our office is being completely reorganized.
reorganize.zh: 我们办公室正在彻底改组。

repair.en: Dad was up the ladder, repairing the roof.
repair.zh: 爸爸在梯子上修补屋顶。

repair.en: Where can I get my shoes repaired?

repatriate.en: After the war, prisoners were repatriated.

repay.en: Your mortgage will be repaid over 25 years.
I’ll repay you the money you lent me next week.
repay.zh: 你借给我的钱我下星期还你。

repayment.en: Do you worry about meeting (=paying) your loan repayments?
repayment.zh: 你是否在为支付每一期还款而发愁？

repeat.zh: 你能重复一遍你的问题吗？

repeatedly.en: Graham was repeatedly warned not to work so hard.
repeatedly.zh: 格雷厄姆一再被提醒工作不要这么拼命。

repel.en: The army was ready to repel an attack.
repel.zh: 军队已准备好击退进攻。

repent.en: He repented of his sins before he died.
repent.zh: 他临死前为自己的罪过忏悔。

repertoire.en: The group include some techno in their repertoire.
repertoire.zh: 这个组合的常备表演项目里包括高科技舞曲。

repetition.en: The job involved the constant repetition of the same movements.
repetition.zh: 这份活儿需要不断重复同样的动作。

repetition.en: Children used to learn by repetition.
repetition.zh: 过去小孩子是通过背诵来学习的。

repetitive.en: The song was dreary and repetitive.

rephrase.en: OK. Let me rephrase the question.
rephrase.zh: 好吧，让我换个说法来提这个问题。

replace.en: I’m replacing Sue on the team.
Lectures have replaced the old tutorial system.
replace.zh: 课堂授课取代了旧式的导师制。

replacement.en: Our old car is badly in need of replacement.
It was difficult to find a replacement for Ted.
replacement.zh: 很难找到人来接替特德。

replenish.en: More vaccines are needed to replenish our stocks.
replenish.zh: 还需要更多的疫苗来补充我们的储备。

replicate.en: There is a need for further research to replicate these findings.
replicate.zh: 需要进一步的研究来验证这些结果。

reply.en: I asked Clive where he was going, but he didn’t reply.
reply.zh: 我问克莱夫到哪儿去，但他没有回答。

reply.en: Sorry it took me so long to reply.
reply.zh: 抱歉，我过了这么久才回复。

report.en: Colleges have to provide a written report on the progress of each student during the year.
report.zh: 学院必须出具每名学生一年学业进展的书面报告。

report.en: According to recent news reports, two of the victims are Americans.
report.zh: 根据近期的新闻报道，受害者中有两名是美国人。

reportedly.en: Her husband’s assets are reportedly worth over $15 million.
reportedly.zh: 她丈夫的资产据传超过1,500

represent.en: Mr Kobayashi was chosen to represent the company at the conference.
represent.zh: 小林先生被选中代表公司出席会议。

represent.en: She decided to represent herself (=speak for herself without a lawyer) during the trial.
represent.zh: 她决定在审判中作自我辩护。

representation.en: Minority groups need more effective parliamentary representation.
representation.zh: 少数族群需要办事更为高效的议会代表。

representation.en: There has been a decline in union representation in the auto industry.
representation.zh: 汽车行业中工会代表有所减少。

representative.en: The latest incident is representative of a wider trend.
representative.zh: 最近发生的事件代表了一个更大的趋势。

representative.en: The pollsters asked a representative sample of New York residents for their opinions.
representative.zh: 民意调查员向一些有代表性的纽约居民征询了意见。

repress.en: Brenda repressed the urge to shout at him.
repress.zh: 布伦达克制住想对他吼的冲动。

reprieve.en: Shoppers will get a temporary reprieve from the new sales tax.
reprieve.zh: 购物者将可暂时免交新的销售税。

reprieve.en: The US Supreme Court voted against granting Smith a reprieve (=against giving him one).
reprieve.zh: 美国最高法院投票反对给史密斯死刑暂缓令。

reproach.en: He argued that the reproaches were unfair.
reproach.zh: 他争辩说这些批评不公正。

reproach.en: His behaviour throughout this affair has been beyond reproach.
reproach.zh: 在这一事件中，他的行为自始至终都无可非议。

reproduce.en: The turtles return to the coast to reproduce.
Klimt’s artwork is reproduced in this exquisite book.
reproduce.zh: 这本精美的书里翻印了克里木特的艺术作品。

reproduction.en: Scientists studied the reproduction, diet, and health of the dolphins.
reproduction.zh: 科学家研究了海豚的繁殖情况、进食规律和健康状况。

reproduction.en: Unauthorized reproduction of this publication is strictly forbidden.

republic.en: Nine republics took part in the referendum.
republic.zh: 有九个共和国参加了全民公决。

repudiate.en: He repudiated all offers of friendship.
repudiate.zh: 他拒绝任何人给他的友谊。

repudiate.en: The book repudiates the racist stereotypes about black women.
repudiate.zh: 书中驳斥了种族主义者眼中黑人妇女的模式化形象。

reputable.en: If you have a burglar alarm fitted, make sure it is done by a reputable company.
reputable.zh: 如果你想安装防盗报警器，一定要找一家声誉好的公司来做。

reputation.en: Judge Kelso has a reputation for being strict but fair.
reputation.zh: 凯尔索法官以严格公正著称。

reputation.en: In her last job she gained a reputation as a hard worker.
reputation.zh: 她做上一份工作时赢得了勤奋的好口碑。

request.en: They have made an urgent request for international aid.
request.zh: 他们紧急请求国际援助。

request.en: Anderson repeated his request that we postpone the meeting.
request.zh: 安德森再次要求我们把会议延期。

require.en: Campbell’s broken leg will probably require surgery.
require.zh: 坎贝尔的一条腿骨折，可能需要手术。

require.en: What’s required is a complete reorganization of the system.
require.zh: 需要做的是彻底整顿整个系统。

requirement.en: The refugees’ main requirements are food and shelter.
requirement.zh: 难民的主要需求是食物和住所。

requirement.en: Potatoes can provide one-third of our daily requirement of vitamin C.
requirement.zh: 马铃薯所提供的维生素C

requisite.en: He lacked the moral requisites for marriage.
requisite.zh: 他缺乏婚姻所需要的道德素质。

requisition.en: The building was requisitioned as a military hospital for the duration of the war.
requisition.zh: 这座大楼在战争期间被征用为军用医院。

rescue.en: Survivors of the crash were rescued by helicopter.
rescue.zh: 空难的生还者被直升机救了出来。

rescue.en: She died trying to rescue her children from the blaze.
rescue.zh: 她试图从大火中救出自己的孩子，却不幸身亡。

research.en: Gould was helped in his researches by local naturalists.
research.zh: 古尔德在研究过程中得到了当地博物学家的帮助。

research.en: It’s a good idea to do some research before you buy a house.
research.zh: 买房子之前作些了解，这想法很对。

resemblance.en: The resemblance between Susan and her sister was remarkable.
resemblance.zh: 苏珊和她的姐姐十分相像。

resemblance.en: Tina bears a striking resemblance to her mother.

resemble.en: It’s amazing how closely Brian and Steve resemble each other.
resemble.zh: 布赖恩和史蒂夫真是惊人地相像。

resemble.en: He grew up to resemble his father.

resent.en: I resented having to work such long hours.
resent.zh: 工作时间这么长，我很有怨气。

resent.en: She bitterly resented his mother’s influence over him.
resent.zh: 她十分讨厌他母亲对他的影响。

resentful.en: She felt resentful at not being promoted.
resentful.zh: 对于没有升职她感到愤愤不平。

resentment.en: She was filled with deep resentment at being passed over for promotion.
resentment.zh: 没被考虑升职，她感到很气愤。

resentment.en: He felt considerable resentment towards Sheila for making him work late.
resentment.zh: 希拉让他工作到这么晚，他很不满。

reservation.en: Customers are advised to make seat reservations well in advance.
I had serious reservations about his appointment as captain.
reservation.zh: 我对任命他为船长持郑重的保留态度。

reserve.en: I’d like to reserve a table for two.
reserve.zh: 我想预订一张两人的餐桌。

reserve.en: Do you have to reserve tickets in advance?

reserved.en: Ellen was a shy, reserved girl.
reserved.zh: 埃伦是个腼腆、寡言的姑娘。

reservoir.en: She found she had reservoirs of unexpected strength.
reservoir.zh: 她发现自己潜藏着意想不到的力量。

resettle.en: The tribesmen were forcibly resettled by the government.
resettle.zh: 部落成员被政府强行安置到别的地方。

resettle.en: The area was resettled in the latter half of the century.
resettle.zh: 在该世纪下半叶这个地区重新有人定居。

reside.en: He spent most of his time in Rutherglen, where his family resided.
reside.zh: 他大部分时间都在拉瑟格伦度过，他的家人就在那里居住。

reside.en: Joe’s talent resides in his storytelling abilities.
reside.zh: 乔的天赋在于他讲故事的能力。

residence.en: Jeff has permanent residence in Canada, but is still a US citizen.
residence.zh: 杰夫有加拿大的永久居留权，但仍然是美国公民。

residence.en: Rome was his main place of residence.
residence.zh: 罗马是他的主要居住地。

resident.en: Many retired British people are now resident in Spain.
resident.zh: 许多退休的英国人现在住在西班牙。

resident.en: The resident population of mental hospitals has fallen by 20%.
resident.zh: 精神病院的住院人数减少了20%

residue.en: The flies leave a sticky residue on crops.
residue.zh: 苍蝇在庄稼上留下黏糊糊的分泌物。

resign.en: She resigned from the government last week.
resign.zh: 上星期她辞去了政府部门的工作。

resign.en: He resigned as governor of Punjab in August.

resignation.en: Further resignations are expected later this week.
resignation.zh: 本周后半周会有更多人辞职。

resilience.en: People showed remarkable resilience during the war.
resilience.zh: 战争期间人们表现得特别坚韧。

resilient.zh: 儿童的适应力一般都很强。

resilient.en: The company proved remarkably resilient during the recession.
resilient.zh: 公司在经济衰退期间表现出惊人的耐挫力。

resist.zh: 我就是抵挡不住巧克力的诱惑。

resist.en: She can never resist buying new shoes.
resist.zh: 她永远抵挡不住买新鞋子的诱惑。

resistance.en: The no-smoking policy was introduced with little resistance from staff.
resistance.zh: 禁烟政策的推行几乎没有受到员工的反对。

resistance.en: Rebel gunmen have put up strong resistance.
resistance.zh: 持枪的叛乱分子负隅顽抗。

resistant.en: Many managers are resistant to change.

resolute.en: She remained resolute in her belief that the situation would improve.
resolute.zh: 她依然坚信情况将会好转。

resolute.en: Mia resolutely refused to talk about her illness.
resolute.zh: 米娅坚决不肯谈她的病情。

resolution.en: The resolution was passed by a two-thirds majority.
resolution.zh: 这项决议以三分之二多数票通过。

resolution.en: They have failed to comply with the resolution.

resolve.en: The crisis was resolved by negotiations.
resolve.zh: 危机通过谈判得到解决。

resolve.en: Barnet was desperate for money to resolve his financial problems.
resolve.zh: 巴尼特急需钱来解决他的经济问题。

resonance.en: His words will have resonance for many musicians.
resonance.zh: 他的话将在很多音乐家心里产生共鸣。

resort.en: Aspen, a ski resort in Colorado
resort.zh: 阿斯彭，科罗拉多的一处滑雪胜地

resort.en: Lagoon Reef is one of the best resort hotels.
resort.zh: 潟湖礁是最好的度假酒店之一。

resource.zh: 加拿大丰富的矿产资源

respect.en: I have the greatest respect for Jane’s work.
respect.zh: 我非常钦佩简的工作成绩。

respect.en: Out of respect for the wishes of her family, the affair was not reported in the media.
respect.zh: 基于对她家人意愿的尊重，媒体没有报道这件事。

respectable.en: Put a tie on – it’ll make you look more respectable.
respectable.zh: 戴上领带，这样显得更体面。

respectable.en: Her exam results were respectable enough.
respectable.zh: 她的考试成绩还算不错。

respectful.en: He was always respectful of my independence.

respective.en: We all went back to our respective homes to wait for news.
respective.zh: 我们都各自回家等待消息。

respectively.en: The cups and saucers cost £5 and £3 respectively.
respectively.zh: 茶杯和茶碟的价钱分别为5

respond.en: Responding to the news, Mr Watt appealed for calm.
respond.zh: 面对这个消息，瓦特先生呼吁要保持冷静。

respond.en: The US responded by sending troops into Laos.
respond.zh: 美国的反应是派遣军队进入老挝。

respondent.en: Only 62 percent of respondents said they were satisfied.

response.en: The law was passed in response to public pressure.
response.zh: 迫于公众压力，法律得以通过。

response.en: The exhibition has received a positive response from visitors.
response.zh: 展览得到参观者的好评。

responsibility.en: Kelly’s promotion means more money and more responsibility.
responsibility.zh: 凯利获得提升，这意味着钱多了，责任也更大了。

responsibility.en: The Minister has responsibility for the National Health Service.
responsibility.zh: 该大臣负责国民医疗服务体系。

responsible.en: Police believe that the same man is responsible for three other murders in the area.
responsible.zh: 警方认为该地区其他三宗谋杀案也是此人所为。

responsible.en: If anything goes wrong, I will hold you personally responsible.
responsible.zh: 要是哪里有问题，我唯你是问。

responsive.en: We try to be responsive to the needs of the customer.
responsive.zh: 我们尽量积极满足顾客的需求。

responsive.en: Her condition is not responsive to drug therapy.
responsive.zh: 她的病药物治疗没有效果。

rest.en: You look exhausted! Why don’t you take a rest?
You carry these two bags, and I’ll bring the rest.
rest.zh: 你拿这两个包，剩下的我来拿。

restaurant.en: We went to a little Italian restaurant near Leicester Square.
restaurant.zh: 我们去了莱斯特广场附近的一家意大利小饭馆。

restaurant.en: He took her out for a five-course dinner in a fancy restaurant.
restaurant.zh: 他带她到一家豪华餐厅吃了一顿有五道菜的晚餐。

restless.en: The children had been indoors all day, and were getting restless.
restless.zh: 孩子们在屋里待了一整天，开始不耐烦了。

restless.en: After a few weeks in Marseille, I grew restless and decided to move on.
restless.zh: 在马赛住了几星期后，我开始待不住了，决定换个地方。

restoration.en: Major restoration work will begin in May.
restoration.zh: 大规模的修复工作将在5

restoration.en: They’re fighting for the restoration of democratic rights.
restoration.zh: 他们正在为恢复民主权利而斗争。

restore.en: The government promises to restore the economy to full strength.
restore.zh: 政府承诺使经济完全复苏。

restore.en: She was hoping that the Mediterranean climate would restore her to full health.
restore.zh: 她希望地中海的气候能使她的身体完全复原。

restrain.en: I had to restrain her from running out into the street.
restrain.zh: 我只得阻止她跑到街上去。

restrain.en: He had to be restrained from using violence.
restrain.zh: 不得不制止他使用暴力。

restraint.en: The police were praised for their restraint in handling the demonstrators.
restraint.zh: 警方因对待示威者时所表现出的克制而受到赞扬。

restraint.en: He urged the millions of protesters to exercise restraint.
restraint.zh: 他呼吁数百万抗议者保持克制。

restrict.en: The new law restricts the sale of hand guns.
restrict.zh: 新法规限制手枪的销售。

restrict.en: You may need to restrict access to certain files (=limit the number of people who can read them).
restrict.zh: 某些档案可能需要限制查阅。

restriction.en: The law imposed new financial restrictions on private companies.
restriction.zh: 该法规对私营公司实施新的金融限制。

restrictive.en: Many members thought the rules were too restrictive.
restrictive.zh: 很多会员认为这些规定限制条件太多。

result.en: Accidents are the inevitable result of driving too fast.
result.zh: 开车过快的必然后果就是车祸。

result.en: High unemployment is a direct result of the recession.
result.zh: 高失业率是经济衰退的直接后果。

resultant.en: She is still trying to get over the attack and the resultant injuries.
resultant.zh: 她仍在努力从袭击以及由此造成的伤害中恢复过来。

resume.en: She hopes to resume work after the baby is born.
resume.zh: 她想生完孩子后继续工作。

resume.en: The rebels have resumed hostilities against government troops.
resume.zh: 叛乱分子继续与政府军发生冲突。

resumption.en: Both countries are now hoping for a quick resumption of diplomatic relations.
resumption.zh: 现在两国都希望尽快恢复外交关系。

retail.en: We are looking for more retail outlets for our products.
retail.zh: 我们在为产品寻找更多的零售店。

retail.en: The retail value would be around $500.

retain.en: You have the right to retain possession of the goods.
The state wants to retain control of food imports.
retain.zh: 政府想保留对食品进口的控制权。

retard.en: Cold weather retards the growth of many plants.
retard.zh: 寒冷的天气使许多植物生长滞缓。

retention.en: The UN will vote on the retention of sanctions against Iraq.
retention.zh: 联合国将投票决定是否继续制裁伊拉克。

retention.en: Many people with heart problems suffer from fluid retention.
retention.zh: 很多有心脏病的人都有体液潴留。

reticent.en: She’s strangely reticent about her son.
reticent.zh: 很奇怪，她不愿意多谈自己的儿子。

retire.en: He was forced to retire early because of poor health.
retire.zh: 他因为身体不好被迫提前退休。

retired.en: Both my parents are retired now.

retirement.en: He became a keen golfer after his retirement from politics.
retirement.zh: 他从政坛退下后，热衷于打高尔夫球。

retirement.en: He announced his retirement as chief executive of the company.
retirement.zh: 他宣布从公司总裁的职位上退休。

retool.en: The College Board has retooled the admission exams.
retool.zh: 大学委员会重新调整入学考试。

retort.en: He was about to make a sharp retort.

retract.en: He confessed to the murder but later retracted his statement.
retract.zh: 他承认谋杀，但后来又翻供了。

retract.en: The sea otter can retract the claws on its front feet.
retract.zh: 海獭能缩回前掌上的爪子。

retrain.en: One solution is to retrain the long-term unemployed.
retrain.zh: 一个解决办法是对长期失业的人进行再培训。

retrain.en: She’s hoping to retrain as a teacher.
retrain.zh: 她希望接受再培训当老师。

retreat.en: The rebels retreated to the mountains.
They were attacked and forced to retreat.
retreat.zh: 他们受到攻击，被迫撤退。

retrial.en: The jury was dismissed and the judge ordered a retrial.
retrial.zh: 陪审团被解散，法官下令复审案件。

retrieve.en: She bent down to retrieve her earring.
It took four days to retrieve all the bodies from the crash.
retrieve.zh: 花了四天时间才找回所有遇难者的尸体。

retroactive.en: The legislation is retroactive to 1st June.

retrospect.en: In retrospect, I wonder if we should have done more.
retrospect.zh: 回过头看，我在想我们是否应该做得更多些。

return.en: It was forty five minutes before she returned.
Are you planning to return to Spain?

reunion.en: Joseph’s eventual reunion with his brother
reunion.zh: 约瑟夫和他弟弟的最终团聚

reunite.en: The children were finally reunited with their families.
reunite.zh: 孩子们终于和家人重聚了。

reunite.en: The band will reunite for a US tour.
reunite.zh: 乐队将重聚作美国巡演。

reuse.en: The bottles are designed to be reused up to 20 times.
reuse.zh: 这些瓶子最多可供重复使用20

reveal.en: He may be prosecuted for revealing secrets about the security agency.
reveal.zh: 他可能因泄露安全部门的机密而被起诉。

reveal.en: He revealed that he had been in prison twice before.
reveal.zh: 他透露自己曾两次入狱。

revelation.en: He resigned after revelations about his affair.
revelation.zh: 他因私情被揭发而辞职。

revelation.en: Alice Walker’s novel was a real revelation to me.

revenge.en: She wanted revenge for the insult.
At his wife’s funeral, he vowed revenge against her killer.
revenge.zh: 在妻子的葬礼上，他发誓要报复杀害她的凶手。

revenue.en: Strikes have cost £20 million in lost revenues.
revenue.zh: 罢工造成的收入损失达到2,000

revere.en: He is revered as a national hero.

reversal.en: Some Internet firms have suffered a painful reversal of fortune (=they were successful but now they are not).
reversal.zh: 一些网络公司遭逢厄运。

reversal.en: Some carers and dependants find it difficult to adapt to a role reversal.
reversal.zh: 有些照料者和被照料者觉得难以适应角色对换。

reverse.en: The decision was reversed on appeal.
reverse.zh: 这个判决上诉后被撤销了。

reverse.en: More changes are required to reverse the trend towards centralised power.
reverse.zh: 要想扭转权力集中的趋势就得进行更多的改革。

reversible.en: A lot of chemical reactions are reversible.
reversible.zh: 很多化学反应都是可逆的。

revert.en: The city reverted to its former name of St Petersburg.
revert.zh: 该市恢复了原名圣彼得堡。

revert.en: After a few weeks, everything reverted to normal.
revert.zh: 几个星期后，一切恢复正常。

review.en: She sent us her review of the research.
review.zh: 她把她对这个研究所作的审查结果送交给我们。

review.en: The company hired Bob to conduct an independent review of their workplace procedures.
review.zh: 公司聘请鲍勃对他们的工作规程进行独立审查。

revise.en: The college has revised its plans because of local objections.
revise.zh: 由于地方上的反对，学院已经修改了计划。

revise.en: We have revised our estimates of population growth.
revise.zh: 我们已修正了对人口增长的估计。

revision.en: The judge wants to see a revision of the procedures.
revision.zh: 法官希望对程序进行修改。

revision.en: I’m making some revisions to the book for the new edition.
revision.zh: 我正在对这本书进行修订，准备出新版。

revitalize.en: They hope to revitalize the neighborhood by providing better housing.
revitalize.zh: 他们希望通过提供更好的住房条件使这个社区恢复活力。

revival.en: The US and the UK have expectations of economic revival.
revival.zh: 美国和英国对经济复苏有所期待。

revival.en: A revival of the timber industry is needed.

revive.en: Local people have decided to revive this centuries-old tradition.
revive.zh: 当地人决定复兴这一延续了数个世纪的传统。

revive.en: The economy is beginning to revive.

revoke.en: Their work permits have been revoked.
revoke.zh: 他们的工作许可证被吊销了。

revolt.en: The prime minister is now facing a revolt by members of his own party.
revolt.zh: 首相现在面临着党内倒戈。

revolt.en: French farmers are in revolt over cheap imports.
revolt.zh: 法国农场主正在抵制廉价的进口产品。

revolution.en: In the last ten years there has been a revolution in education.
revolution.zh: 近十年来，教育发生了巨大的变化。

revolution.en: The role of women has changed since the revolution.
revolution.zh: 革命以后妇女的角色已有改变。

revolutionary.en: The new cancer drug is a revolutionary breakthrough.
revolutionary.zh: 这种抗癌新药是一个革命性突破。

revolve.en: The restaurant slowly revolves, giving excellent views of the city.
revolve.zh: 餐厅缓缓旋转，城市美景尽收眼底。

reward.en: The school has a system of rewards and punishments to encourage good behaviour.
reward.zh: 学校有奖惩制度以鼓励良好行为。

reward.en: Parents often give their children rewards for passing exams.
reward.zh: 孩子通过考试，父母常会给他们奖励。

rewarding.en: Teaching can be a very rewarding career.
rewarding.zh: 教书可以是一种很有意义的职业。

rewrite.en: I’ll have to rewrite most of the essay.
rewrite.zh: 这篇论文大部分我都得重写。

rewrite.en: Software packages may need complete rewrites to match new hardware.
rewrite.zh: 软件包可能需要全部重写以便与新的硬件相配。

rhetoric.en: The speech was dismissed by some people as merely political rhetoric.
rhetoric.zh: 有些人认为这场演讲只是华而不实的政治空谈。

rheumatic.en: He’s old and rheumatic and can’t manage the stairs any longer.
rheumatic.zh: 他年纪大，又有风湿病，再也爬不动楼梯了。

rhyme.en: Can you think of a rhyme for ‘bicycle’?
I love his use of rhyme and rhythm.
rhyme.zh: 我喜欢他对韵律和节奏的运用。

rhythm.en: Drums are basic to African rhythm.
rhythm.zh: 非洲音乐节奏少不了鼓。

rhythm.en: She started moving to the rhythm of the music.
rhythm.zh: 她开始随着音乐的节奏舞动。

rib.en: She was taken to hospital with a broken arm and ribs.
rib.zh: 她胳膊和肋骨断了，被送进医院。

rib.en: He was punched and kicked in the ribs.
rib.zh: 他的肋部遭到拳打脚踢。

ribbon.en: The ribbon was cut and the new station was officially open.
ribbon.zh: 剪彩后，新车站正式开始运营。

ribbon.en: For the second time she won the blue ribbon (=first prize).
ribbon.zh: 这是她第二次赢得一等奖。

rice.en: Rice is the main crop grown in the area.
rice.zh: 水稻是这个地区的主要作物。

rich.en: She found herself a rich husband.
rich.zh: 她找了一个有钱的丈夫。

rich.en: He thought this was the easiest way to get rich.
rich.zh: 他以为这是最容易的致富办法。

richly.en: They got the punishment they so richly deserved.
It was a richly rewarding relationship.
richly.zh: 这是一种令人非常愉快的关系。

rid.en: It’s time we got rid of all these old toys.
rid.zh: 我们该把这些旧玩具全部丢掉了。

rid.en: Governments should be encouraged to get rid of all nuclear weapons.
rid.zh: 应该鼓励各国政府销毁所有核武器。

riddle.en: See if you can solve this riddle.
riddle.zh: 看看你能不能猜出这个谜语。

riddle.en: The police have been unable to solve the riddle of her disappearance.
riddle.zh: 警方至今未能解开她的失踪之谜。

ride.en: She learned to ride when she was seven.
He was riding a large grey mare.
ride.zh: 他骑着一匹灰色的大母马。

ridge.en: We made our way carefully along the ridge.
ridge.zh: 我们沿着山脊小心前行。

ridge.en: A small ridge of sand separated the field from the beach.
ridge.zh: 一条小小的沙脊把田野和海滩分隔开来。

ridicule.en: The government’s proposals were held up to ridicule (=suffered ridicule) by opposition ministers.
ridicule.zh: 政府的提案遭到反对党部长们的嘲笑。

ridicule.en: He had become an object of ridicule among the other teachers.
ridicule.zh: 他成了其他教师嘲笑的对象。

ridiculous.en: I’d look ridiculous in a dress like that.
ridiculous.zh: 我穿那样的裙子会显得很可笑。

rifle.en: Sally rifled through her wardrobe looking for a dress.
rifle.zh: 萨莉翻遍衣橱找一件连衣裙。

rifle.en: The killer had rifled his wallet and stolen £200.
rifle.zh: 凶手翻了他的钱包，偷走200

rift.en: Party officials have denied that there is any rift between ministers.
rift.zh: 政党官员否认部长之间存在不和。

rift.en: Today’s announcement could lead to a further rift over public spending.
rift.zh: 今天的公告有可能导致公共开支方面的更大分歧。

rig.en: Some international observers have claimed the election was rigged.
rig.zh: 一些国际观察员声称选举受到操纵。

rig.en: Two of the largest oil companies have been accused of rigging prices.
rig.zh: 两大石油公司被指控操纵价格。

righteous.en: He was full of righteous indignation about the attack.
righteous.zh: 他对这次袭击事件义愤填膺。

rigid.en: She maintained rigid control over her emotional and sexual life.
rigid.zh: 她对自己的情感生活和性生活一直严加克制。

rigid.en: I heard a noise and woke up rigid with terror.
rigid.zh: 我听到一个声音后惊醒过来，吓得身子都僵了。

rim.en: His eyes were rimmed with fatigue.

ring.en: She left a dirty ring around the bath.
ring.zh: 她在浴缸里留下了一圈污渍。

ring.en: A ring of armed troops surrounded the building.
ring.zh: 武装士兵围成一圈包围了大楼。

rinse.en: Let me just rinse my hands.
Rinse the vegetables under a cold tap.
rinse.zh: 把蔬菜放在冷水龙头下冲洗。

riot.en: His murder triggered vicious race riots (=caused by a problem between different races).
riot.zh: 他的被杀引发了严重的种族骚乱。

riot.en: Manufacturers have let their imaginations run riot to create new computer games.
riot.zh: 生产商极尽想象之能事，开发设计新的电脑游戏。

riotous.en: Their riotous behaviour led to their arrest.

rip.en: Her clothes had all been ripped.
The sails ripped under the force of the wind.

ripe.en: The police forces are ripe for reform.
ripe.zh: 改革警察队伍的时机已经成熟。

ripen.en: The apples were ripening on the trees.

ripple.en: I could see the muscles rippling under his shirt.
ripple.zh: 我看到他衬衫下面的肌肉一起一伏。

ripple.en: Panic rippled through Hollywood as the murders were discovered.
ripple.zh: 数起凶杀案被揭露以后，好莱坞一片恐慌。

rise.en: Sales rose by 20% over the Christmas period.
rise.zh: 圣诞节期间销售量增加了20%

rise.en: The research budget rose from £175,000 in 1999 to £22.5 million in 2001.

risk.en: Skiers always face the risk of serious injury.
risk.zh: 滑雪者始终面临着受重伤的风险。

risk.en: There is a risk that the disease may spread further.
risk.zh: 这种疾病存在进一步扩散的危险。

risky.en: Doctors say it’s too risky to try and operate.
risky.zh: 医生说动手术风险太大。

risky.en: Buying a secondhand car is a risky business.
risky.zh: 买二手汽车是有风险的。

rite.en: These traditional rites are performed only by the women of the village.
rite.zh: 这些传统仪式只由村里的女人来进行。

rite.en: A priest came to give him the last rites.
rite.zh: 一位神父来为他做临终祷告。

ritual.en: The lady of the house performs the sacred ritual of lighting two candles.
ritual.zh: 由女主人来完成点燃两根蜡烛的神圣仪式。

ritual.en: He went through the ritual of lighting his cigar.
ritual.zh: 他按照老习惯点燃雪茄。

rival.en: This gives the company a competitive advantage over its rivals.
rival.zh: 这使该公司与其对手相比具有一项竞争优势。

rival.en: He finished 39 seconds ahead of his main rival.

rivalry.en: There has always been intense rivalry between New Zealand and Australia.
rivalry.zh: 新西兰和澳大利亚之间总是存在激烈的竞争。

rivalry.en: The two players have developed a friendly rivalry.
rivalry.zh: 这两名选手之间已形成一种友好的竞争关系。

river.en: There were several boats on the river.
We went for a walk along the river.

rivet.en: All eyes were riveted on her in horror.
rivet.zh: 所有人都恐惧地盯着她看。

road.en: I was driving along the road when a kid suddenly stepped out in front of me.
road.zh: 我正在路上开着车，突然一个小孩冲到我车前。

road.en: You’ll see the library a bit further up the road.
road.zh: 沿这条路再往前走一点就能看到图书馆。

roam.en: The dogs are allowed to roam around.
Chickens and geese roam freely in the back yard.
roam.zh: 鸡和鹅在后院随意溜达。

roast.en: Are you going to roast the chicken?
We caught a rabbit and roasted it over an open fire.
roast.zh: 我们捉到一只兔子，放在火上烧烤。

rob.en: They killed four policemen while robbing a bank.
rob.zh: 他们抢劫一家银行的时候杀了4

rob.en: A 77-year-old woman was robbed at knifepoint.

robber.en: Armed robbers broke into the shop and demanded money from the till.
robber.zh: 持枪劫匪闯进商店，索要现金出纳机里的钱。

robbery.en: Police are investigating a series of bank robberies in South Wales.
robbery.zh: 警方正在调查发生在南威尔士的连环银行抢劫案。

robbery.en: He received a 10 year prison sentence for armed robbery (=robbery using a gun).
robbery.zh: 他因持枪抢劫被判十年监禁。

robust.en: The formerly robust economy has begun to weaken.
robust.zh: 原本强劲的经济开始疲软。

rock.en: To build the tunnel, they had to cut through 500 feet of solid rock.
rock.zh: 为了建这条隧道，他们不得不凿穿500

rock.en: Most of the country is desert and bare rock.
rock.zh: 这个国家大部分地区都是沙漠和裸露的岩石。

rocket.en: The rocket was launched from a space research base.
rocket.zh: 火箭从一个太空研究基地发射升空。

rocky.en: They hurried over the rough rocky ground.
rocky.zh: 他们匆匆穿过那崎岖不平的石头地。

rocky.en: Rangers got off to a rocky start this season.
rocky.zh: 流浪者队本赛季出师不利。

rod.en: The walls are reinforced with steel rods.

role.en: They want to limit the role of government.
role.zh: 他们想限制政府的作用。

role.en: Matthews plays the role of a young doctor suspected of murder.
role.zh: 马修斯扮演一名涉嫌谋杀的年轻医生。

roll.en: The ball rolled into the street.
One of the eggs rolled off the counter.
roll.zh: 其中一只鸡蛋滚下了柜台。

roller.en: The boats are taken down to the sea on rollers.

romance.en: Hemingway’s romance with his nurse inspired him to write ‘A Farewell to Arms’.
romance.zh: 海明威和他护士之间的罗曼史赋予他灵感写出《永别了，武器》。

romance.en: Michelle married him after a whirlwind romance (=one that happens very suddenly and quickly).
romance.zh: 经过一场旋风式的恋爱，米歇尔嫁给了他。

romantic.en: After dinner, they took a romantic stroll by the sea.
romantic.zh: 晚饭后，他们浪漫地沿着海边散步。

romantic.en: I’m not ready for a romantic relationship.

roof.en: They finally found the cat up on the roof.
roof.zh: 他们最后在屋顶上找到了那只猫。

roof.en: We can probably strap the cases to the roof of her car.
roof.zh: 我们也许可以把箱子捆在她的车顶上。

rooftop.en: Spectators stood on rooftops to watch the parade.
rooftop.zh: 观众站在屋顶上观看庆祝游行。

room.en: She nodded toward a man who was standing across the room (=on the other side of the room).
room.zh: 她朝站在屋子另一头的一个男人点点头。

roost.en: After years of overspending, the chickens have come home to roost.
roost.zh: 年复一年地超支，现在终于尝到苦果了。

root.en: These plants produce a number of thin roots.
root.zh: 这些植物会长出一些细根。

root.en: Allergies are at the root of a lot of health problems.
root.zh: 过敏是许多健康问题的根源。

rope.en: They tied a rope around my waist and pulled me up.
rope.zh: 他们在我腰间系了一根粗绳子，把我拉了上去。

rope.en: The man was coiling a length of rope.

rosy.en: Letters to relatives in Europe painted a rosy picture of life in the United States.
rosy.zh: 写给欧洲亲戚的信把美国的生活描绘得如花似锦。

rot.en: The trees were cut and left to rot.

rotate.en: The Earth rotates on its axis once every 24 hours.
Rotate the pan halfway through the baking time.
rotate.zh: 烘烤到一半时把盘子转一下。

rotation.en: The blades spin at 100 rotations per minute.
Three plays will be performed in rotation during the drama festival.
rotation.zh: 戏剧节期间将有三个剧目轮流上演。

rote.en: In old-fashioned schools, much learning was by rote.
rote.zh: 在旧式学校里，很多学习都是靠死记硬背。

rotten.en: Some of the wood was completely rotten.
The apples went rotten very quickly.

rough.en: Her hands were rough from hard work.
rough.zh: 她的双手因为干重活而变得很粗糙。

rough.en: We were bumping over the rough ground.
rough.zh: 我们在崎岖的地面上颠簸而行。

roughly.en: Azaleas flower at roughly the same time each year.
roughly.zh: 杜鹃花每年的开花时间大致相同。

round.en: We sat round the table playing cards.
Gather round! I have an important announcement to make.
round.zh: 大家围拢来！我有重要事情要宣布。

roundabout.en: Turn left at the first roundabout.
It was a roundabout way of telling us to leave.
roundabout.zh: 这是转弯抹角地要我们走。

rouse.zh: 他重重的关门声把邻居都吵醒了。

rouse.en: A persistent ringing roused Christina from a pleasant dream.
rouse.zh: 电话铃响个不停，把克里斯蒂娜从美梦中吵醒。

route.en: What’s the best route to Cambridge?
route.zh: 到剑桥的最佳路线怎么走？

route.en: We weren’t sure about which route we should take.
route.zh: 我们拿不准应该走哪条路线。

routine.en: John’s departure had upset their daily routine.
routine.zh: 约翰的离去打乱了他们的日常生活。

routine.en: Try to get into a routine (=develop a fixed order of doing things).

routinely.en: This vaccine is already routinely used.
routinely.zh: 这种疫苗的使用已经常规化。

row.en: The children were asked to stand in a row.
row.zh: 孩子们被要求站成一列。

row.en: We sat in the front row.

royalty.en: At school the other children treated them like royalty.
royalty.zh: 在学校里，其他孩子将他们奉若王族。

rub.en: She yawned and rubbed her eyes.
rub.zh: 她打了个呵欠，揉了揉眼睛。

rub.en: She began rubbing her hair with a towel.

rubbish.en: I’ve got so much rubbish on my desk it’s unbelievable.
rubbish.zh: 我桌上有那么多垃圾，真是让人难以相信。
你有时候确实胡说八道。

rubric.en: The names were listed under the rubric ‘Contributors’.

rude.en: I didn’t mean to be rude, but I had to leave early.
rude.zh: 我并不想显得无礼，但我不得不早走。

rude.en: Why are you so rude to her?

rudimentary.en: Gradually, I acquired a rudimentary knowledge of music.
rudimentary.zh: 我逐渐掌握了基本的音乐知识。

rudimentary.en: The classroom equipment is pretty rudimentary.
rudimentary.zh: 教室里的设备相当简陋。

ruffle.zh: 他亲昵地拨弄她的头发。

ruffle.en: A light wind ruffled the water.

ruin.en: This illness has ruined my life.
ruin.zh: 这个病毁掉了我的生活。

rule.en: Under the rules, the company must publish its annual accounts.
rule.zh: 根据规定，该公司必须公布年度账目。

rule.en: There are no hard and fast rules (=clear and definite rules) about what to wear to classes.
rule.zh: 对于上课着装并没有硬性规定。

ruling.zh: 统治阶级显然是存在的。

ruling.en: Football remains the ruling passion of many men.
ruling.zh: 足球仍是许多男人最大的爱好。

rumble.en: We could hear thunder rumbling in the distance.
rumble.zh: 我们听见远处雷声隆隆。

rumble.en: We watched the tanks rumbling past the window.
rumble.zh: 我们看着坦克从窗前隆隆驶过。

ruminate.en: He sat alone, ruminating on the injustice of the world.
ruminate.zh: 他独自坐着，思考世事的不公。

rumour.en: I’ve heard all sorts of rumours about him and his secretary.
rumour.zh: 我听说了有关他和他秘书的种种传闻。

rumour.en: There’s an unsubstantiated rumour that Eddie is bankrupt.
rumour.zh: 有个未经证实的传言，说埃迪破产了。

run.en: I ran down the stairs as fast as I could.
run.zh: 我尽可能快地跑下楼梯。

run.en: He was running towards the door.

runner.en: The runners and riders appear in Friday’s Racing Post.
runner.zh: 赛马和骑师都会上星期五的《赛马邮报》。

runner.en: By the time the police got there, the boys had done a runner.
runner.zh: 警察到达那里时，那些男孩子已经溜掉了。

running.en: Did you go running this morning?
running.zh: 你今天早上去跑步了吗？

running.en: New facilities include a pool and a running track.
running.zh: 新设施包括一个游泳池和一条跑道。

rupture.en: The eleventh century saw the formal rupture between East and West.
The rupture with his father was absolute.
rupture.zh: 他和他父亲一刀两断，没有和好的余地。

rural.en: It’s very rural round here, isn’t it?
rural.zh: 这周围很像乡村，对不对？

rush.en: A small girl rushed past her.
rush.zh: 一个小女孩从她身边匆匆经过。

rush.en: Mo rushed off down the corridor.

rust.en: There were large patches of rust on the car.
The metal had begun to rust.

rusty.en: My French is a bit rusty.

rut.en: I was stuck in a rut and decided to look for a new job.
rut.zh: 我的生活一成不变，所以我决定找一份新工作。

ruthless.en: They have shown a ruthless disregard for basic human rights.
ruthless.zh: 他们冷酷地无视基本人权。

ruthless.en: He ran the company with ruthless efficiency.
ruthless.zh: 他以铁面无情的高效率经营这家公司。

sabotage.en: Every single plane had been sabotaged.
sabotage.zh: 每架飞机都遭到了破坏。
游行示威者破坏了这次大会。

sack.en: We need about a sack of rice.
They’ve never actually given anyone the sack.
sack.zh: 他们从未真的辞退过什么人。

sacred.zh: 有些动物被认为是神圣的。

sacred.en: The land is sacred to these tribesmen.
sacred.zh: 这块土地对这些部落成员而言是神圣的。

sacrifice.en: The minister stressed the need for economic sacrifice.
sacrifice.zh: 部长强调了在经济上作出牺牲的必要性。

sacrifice.en: The workforce were willing to make sacrifices in order to preserve jobs.
sacrifice.zh: 雇员为了保住饭碗情愿作出牺牲。

sad.en: Dad looked sad and worried as he read the letter.
sad.zh: 爸爸读着信，看上去又难过又担心。

sad.en: I was very sad to hear that he had died.
sad.zh: 听说他去世我非常难过。

sadden.en: Those who knew him are saddened by his death.
sadden.zh: 认识他的那些人都为他的去世感到难过。

sadden.en: It saddened him that they no longer trusted him.
sadden.zh: 他们不再信任他了，这让他很伤心。

saddle.en: We did six or eight hours in the saddle every day.
saddle.zh: 我们每天有六或八个小时骑在马背上。

saddle.en: He always has to be in the saddle, controlling everything.
saddle.zh: 他总是一定要掌握大权，控制一切。

sadly.zh: 很遗憾，这家企业经营失败了。

sadness.zh: 她感觉到了贝丝深深的哀痛。

sadness.en: It was with great sadness that we learned of his death.
sadness.zh: 我们听到他去世的消息，感到极为悲痛。

safe.en: She doesn’t feel safe in the house on her own.
safe.zh: 她独自一人在家感到不安全。

safe.en: The birds’ nests are high up, safe from predators.
safe.zh: 鸟巢筑在高处，安全地避开了捕食者。

safeguard.en: The industry has a duty to safeguard consumers.
safeguard.zh: 这个行业有责任保护消费者。

safeguard.en: International safeguards prevent the increase of nuclear weapons.
safeguard.zh: 国际安全条约防止核武器数量增加。

safely.en: I think we can safely assume that she will pass the exam.
safely.zh: 我想我们可以确信她会通过考试。

safety.en: We were able to watch the lions in complete safety.
safety.zh: 我们可以绝对安全地观看狮子。

safety.en: For safety, always climb with a partner.
safety.zh: 为安全起见，登山一定要有同伴。

sag.en: The branch sagged under the weight of the apples.
The skin around my eyes is starting to sag.
sag.zh: 我眼睛周围的皮肤开始下垂了。

said.en: The said weapon was later found in the defendant’s home.
said.zh: 上述武器后来在被告家中发现。

sail.en: She always wanted to sail around the world.
sail.zh: 她一直想要乘船环游世界。

sailing.en: Bud has invited us to go sailing this weekend.
sailing.zh: 巴德邀请我们这个周末驾船出游。

sailing.en: Luckily, there was another sailing at 2 o'clock.
sailing.zh: 幸好两点钟还有一班船。

sailor.zh: 六名英国海员溺水身亡。
我们两个都是经验丰富的水手。

saint.en: Statues of saints lined the walls of the church.
saint.zh: 教堂的墙边立着一排圣徒像。

saint.en: His wife must have been a saint to put up with him for all those years.
saint.zh: 他妻子容忍了他那么多年，一定是个圣人。

sake.en: He moved to the seaside for the sake of his health.
sake.zh: 他为了健康而迁居海滨。

sake.en: I only went for Kay’s sake.

salad.en: Would you like some salad with your pasta?
salad.zh: 你的意大利面要配些色拉吗？

salary.en: The average salary for a teacher is $39,000 a year.
She’s now earning a good salary as an interpreter.
salary.zh: 她现在当口译薪酬很高。

sale.en: The use and sale of marijuana remains illegal.
sale.zh: 吸食和贩卖大麻一直是违法的。

sale.en: Harvey gets a $50 commission every time he makes a sale (=sells something as part of his job).
sale.zh: 哈维每做成一笔生意可得到50

salt.en: This might need some salt and pepper.
salt.zh: 这里面也许要加点盐和胡椒粉。

salute.en: The two soldiers saluted Lieutenant Cecil.
salute.zh: 那两名士兵向塞西尔中尉行了礼。

salute.en: The men jumped to their feet and saluted.

salvage.en: Divers hope to salvage some of the ship’s cargo.
salvage.zh: 潜水员希望能够抢救出船上部分货物。

salvage.en: They managed to salvage only a few of their belongings from the fire.
salvage.zh: 他们从大火中只抢救出几样自己的东西。

salvation.en: A drug treatment program was Ron’s salvation.
salvation.zh: 戒毒治疗计划拯救了罗恩。

salvation.en: The Internet turned out to be the salvation of the company.
salvation.zh: 最终因特网挽救了这家公司。

same.en: He sits in the same chair every night.
same.zh: 他每天晚上都坐在同一把椅子上。

same.en: They went to the same school.
same.zh: 他们上的是同一所学校。

sample.en: I’d like to see some samples of your work.
sample.zh: 我想看看你做的一些样品。

sample.en: They took a blood sample to test for hepatitis.
sample.zh: 他们取了血样做肝炎化验。

sanction.en: The UN Security Council may impose economic sanctions.
sanction.zh: 联合国安理会可能会实施经济制裁。

sanctuary.en: The park is the largest wildlife sanctuary in the US.
sanctuary.zh: 这座公园是美国最大的野生生物保护区。

sanctuary.en: Fleeing refugees found sanctuary in Geneva.
sanctuary.zh: 出逃的难民在日内瓦找到了避难所。

sand.en: I have sand in my shoe.
We were just sitting on the sand.

sandwich.en: A layer of transparent material is sandwiched between the pieces of glass.
sandwich.zh: 一层透明材料夹在玻璃中间。

sane.en: He seems perfectly sane (=completely sane) to me.
sane.zh: 在我看来他神志完全正常。

sane.en: No sane person would want to kill a baby.
sane.zh: 神志正常的人不会去杀一个婴儿。

sanitary.en: Diseases were spread through poor sanitary conditions.
sanitary.zh: 疾病因卫生条件很差而传播开来。

sanitary.en: Often, the camps were not very sanitary.

sanitation.en: Overcrowding and poor sanitation are common problems in prisons.
sanitation.zh: 过度拥挤和卫生状况差是监狱里的普遍问题。

sanity.en: I began to doubt his sanity.
sanity.zh: 我开始怀疑他是否神志正常。

sanity.en: She wondered if she was losing her sanity.
sanity.zh: 她怀疑自己是否精神有问题。

sap.en: Her long illness was gradually sapping Charlotte’s strength.
sap.zh: 长期生病正逐渐消耗着夏洛特的元气。

sarcasm.en: There was just a touch of sarcasm in her voice.
sarcasm.zh: 她的话音里含有一丝挖苦。

sarcastic.en: He can’t help making sarcastic comments.
sarcastic.zh: 他忍不住要说些嘲讽的话。

satellite.en: This broadcast comes live via satellite from New York.
satellite.zh: 本节目通过卫星从纽约现场直播。

satellite.en: The Moon is a satellite of the Earth.

satisfaction.en: She got great satisfaction from helping people to learn.
satisfaction.zh: 她在帮助人们学习的过程中得到很大的满足。

satisfaction.en: Finance officials expressed satisfaction with the recovery of the dollar.
satisfaction.zh: 财政官员对美元价格的回升表示满意。

satisfactory.en: His progress this term has been satisfactory.
satisfactory.zh: 他这学期的进步令人满意。

satisfactory.en: There seems to be no satisfactory explanation.
satisfactory.zh: 似乎没有令人满意的解释。

satisfy.en: Nothing I did would ever satisfy my father.
satisfy.zh: 我做什么都不能让父亲满意。

satisfy.en: The program is designed to satisfy the needs of adult learners.
satisfy.zh: 这一课程是为满足成年学习者的需要而设计的。

saturate.en: Water poured through the hole, saturating the carpet.
saturate.zh: 水从洞里流进来，浸湿了地毯。

saturate.en: Our culture is saturated with television and advertising.
saturate.zh: 我们的文化里充斥着电视和广告。

saturation.en: The trial was given saturation coverage by the press.
saturation.zh: 报刊对这次审讯进行了连篇累牍的报道。

saturday.en: We went for a picnic on Saturday.

saturday.zh: 庆祝活动从星期六开始。

sauce.en: Less of your sauce, my girl!

savage.en: The government has announced savage cuts in spending.
savage.zh: 政府宣布大幅度削减开支。

savage.en: He was savagely attacked and beaten.
savage.zh: 他遭到了野蛮的袭击和殴打。

save.en: Emergency aid could save millions threatened with starvation.
save.zh: 紧急援助可以拯救数百万受到饥饿威胁的人。

save.en: She was determined to save her marriage.
save.zh: 她决心挽救自己的婚姻。

saving.en: Buying a house had taken all their savings.
saving.zh: 买房子花掉了他们所有的积蓄。

saving.en: The new engines will lead to savings in fuel.
saving.zh: 这种新引擎能节省燃油。

saw.en: That reminds me of the old saw about being careful about what you wish for.
saw.zh: 这使我想起了许愿需谨慎的那条古训。

saw.en: She was in the backyard sawing logs.

say.en: A spokesman said that the company had improved its safety standards.
say.zh: 一名发言人说公司已经提高了安全标准。

saying.en: You can’t judge a book by its cover, as the old saying goes.
saying.zh: 老话说得好，人不可貌相。

scale.en: We had underestimated the scale of the problem.
scale.zh: 我们低估了问题的严重性。

scale.en: There has been housing development on a massive scale since 1980.

scam.en: He got involved in a credit card scam.
scam.zh: 他卷入了一桩信用卡诈骗事件。

scan.en: He scanned the horizon, but there was no sign of the ship.
scan.zh: 他朝地平线处仔细眺望，但是找不到那艘船的踪影。

scan.en: She scanned his face, looking for signs of what he was thinking.
scan.zh: 她端详着他的脸，想知道他在想些什么。

scandal.en: It caused quite a scandal when he left his wife.
scandal.zh: 他离开妻子成了一大丑闻。

scandal.en: The college has recently been involved in a drugs scandal.
scandal.zh: 这所大学最近卷入了毒品丑闻。

scant.en: The story has received scant attention in the press.
scant.zh: 这件事没在报界引起多少注意。

scant.en: They produce goods with scant regard for quality.
scant.zh: 他们的产品不够重视质量。

scanty.en: There is only scanty evidence of his involvement.
scanty.zh: 显示他牵涉其中的证据不足。

scapegoat.en: She believed she had been made a scapegoat for what happened.
scapegoat.zh: 她认为自己成了所发生之事的替罪羊。

scar.en: He had a long, curved scar on his right cheek.
scar.zh: 他的右脸上有一道弯弯的长疤。

scar.en: Her mental scars will take time to heal.
scar.zh: 她的精神创伤需要时间来治愈。

scarce.en: Food was often scarce in the winter.
There was fierce competition for the scarce resources.
scarce.zh: 对这些紧缺资源的争夺非常激烈。

scarcely.en: The city had scarcely changed in 20 years.
The country had scarcely any industry.

scare.en: Loud noises can scare animals or birds.
scare.zh: 噪声太大会惊吓到鸟兽。

scare.en: The alarm scared the hell out of me.
scare.zh: 警报声把我的魂都吓没了。

scared.en: At first, he was really scared.
I’ve always been scared of dogs.

scarf.en: She scarfed down a bagel on her way to work.
scarf.zh: 她在上班的路上匆匆地吃了个面包圈。

scarlet.en: Eileen blushed scarlet at the joke.
scarlet.zh: 听了这个笑话，艾琳的脸涨得通红。

scary.en: The book is both scary and funny.

scatter.en: Scatter the onions over the fish.
The flowers fell and scattered on the ground.

scavenge.en: There are people who live in the dump and scavenge garbage for a living.
scavenge.zh: 有些人生活在垃圾场，以捡破烂为生。

scenario.en: Imagine a scenario where only 20% of people have a job.
Under a likely scenario, world population will double by 2050.

scene.en: The film contains some violent scenes.
scene.zh: 这部影片有几处暴力场面。

scenery.en: The best part of the trip was the fantastic scenery.
scenery.zh: 此次旅行最精彩之处就是那美妙绝伦的风景。

scenic.en: Let’s take the scenic route home.
scenic.zh: 我们走这条风景优美的路回家吧。

scent.en: Was he trying to put me off the scent because I had come too close to the truth?
scent.zh: 是不是因为我快要发现真相了，他就想法儿误导我？

scent.en: Honeysuckle and roses scented the air.
scent.zh: 空气中弥漫着忍冬和玫瑰的花香。

sceptical.en: I’m extremely sceptical about what I read in the press.
sceptical.zh: 我对报纸上读到的东西极度怀疑。

sceptical.en: Environmental groups are sceptical of the government’s claims.
sceptical.zh: 环境保护组织对政府的声明持怀疑态度。

schedule.en: The majority of holiday flights depart and arrive on schedule.
schedule.zh: 大部分假日航班都能按时起降。

schedule.en: Meg’s new book is still well ahead of schedule.
schedule.zh: 梅格的新书在进度上时间仍很充裕。

scheme.en: The money will be used for teacher training schemes.
scheme.zh: 这笔钱将用于教师培训计划。

scheme.en: The pilot scheme proved to be a great success.
scheme.zh: 这个试点项目非常成功。

scholar.en: He was a King’s scholar at Eton College.
scholar.zh: 他是伊顿公学的国王奖学金获得者。

scholarship.en: She won a scholarship to Iowa State University.
scholarship.zh: 她获得了艾奥瓦州立大学的奖学金。

scholarship.en: He attended college on a drama scholarship.
scholarship.zh: 他靠一份戏剧奖学金上了大学。

school.en: His mother always used to pick him up from school.
school.zh: 他母亲以前一直去学校接他。

schooling.en: Al’s dad had only a few years of schooling.
schooling.zh: 阿尔的爸爸只受过几年的学校教育。

science.en: Many leading scientists do not consider that science can give absolutely reliable knowledge.
science.zh: 许多杰出科学家都不认为科学能够提供绝对可靠的知识。

science.en: What did you do in science class today?
science.zh: 今天你们自然科学课做什么？

scientific.en: We believe in investing in scientific research.
scientific.zh: 我们相信科学研究的投资价值。

scientific.en: I keep accounts for the business, but I’m not scientific about it.
scientific.zh: 业务往来我留有账目，但不是很精细。

scoff.zh: 官员们都嘲笑这个想法。

scold.en: Do not scold the puppy, but simply and firmly say ‘no’.
scold.zh: 不要责骂小狗，但要干脆利落地说“

scold.en: Her father scolded her for upsetting her mother.
scold.zh: 父亲斥责她惹母亲生气。

scoop.en: She bent down and scooped up the little dog.
Cut the tomato in half and scoop out the seeds with a teaspoon.
scoop.zh: 把番茄切成两半，用茶匙把籽挖出。

scope.en: A full discussion of that issue is beyond the scope of this book.
scope.zh: 全面讨论那个问题不在本书论述范围之内。

scope.en: Let us extend the scope of the study to examine more factors.
scope.zh: 让我们把研究范围扩大一下，对更多的因素进行考查。

scorch.en: The walls had been blackened and scorched by fire.
Direct sunlight will scorch the plant’s leaves.
scorch.zh: 直射的阳光会使这种植物的叶子枯萎。

score.en: At half-time the score was one all.
score.zh: 半场时的比分是一比一。

score.en: Is anybody keeping score (=making a record of the score)?

scorn.en: He felt scorn for his working-class parents.
scorn.zh: 他鄙视自己工薪阶层的父母。

scorn.en: Rachel looked at me with scorn.
scorn.zh: 蕾切尔神情蔑视地看着我。

scornful.en: He was scornful of the women’s movement.
scornful.zh: 他对妇女运动嗤之以鼻。

scotch.en: He issued an announcement to scotch rumours of his death.
scotch.zh: 他发表了一项声明，驳斥有关他已经死亡的谣言。

scour.en: Her family began to scour the countryside for a suitable house.
scour.zh: 她的家人开始在乡下寻找合适的房子。

scour.en: Ada was scouring out the pans.

scout.en: He sent three scouts ahead to take a look at the bridge.
scout.zh: 他派出三名侦察兵到前面侦察大桥的情况。

scout.en: He was spotted by a scout at the age of 13.

scowl.en: Patrick scowled, but did as he was told.
scowl.zh: 帕特里克一脸不悦，但还是照办了。

scowl.en: Mum scowled at him and refused to say anything.
scowl.zh: 妈妈瞪着他，一句话也不肯说。

scramble.en: They tried to scramble up the cliff.
She scrambled down the tree as quickly as she could.
scramble.zh: 她以最快的速度爬下树。

scrap.en: He wrote his address on a scrap of paper.
scrap.zh: 他把住址写在一张小纸片上。

scrap.en: The equipment was sold for scrap.
scrap.zh: 这件设备被当成废品卖了。

scrape.en: Scrape the carrots and slice them thinly.
scrape.zh: 把这些胡萝卜去皮切成薄片。

scrape.en: The earth was scraped away to uncover a trapdoor.
scrape.zh: 把土刮掉后露出了活板门。

scratch.en: John yawned and scratched his leg.
scratch.zh: 约翰打了个呵欠，挠了挠腿。

scream.en: After the first few shots, people started screaming.
scream.zh: 几声枪响过后，人们开始尖叫起来。

scream.en: She jumped to her feet, screaming in terror.
scream.zh: 她吓得尖叫一声，跳了起来。

screech.en: She screeched at me to take off my muddy shoes.
screech.zh: 她尖叫着要我脱掉沾满泥污的鞋子。

screen.en: He went on staring at the TV screen.
screen.zh: 他继续盯着电视屏幕看。

screen.en: Her picture appeared on the screen.
screen.zh: 她的照片出现在屏幕上。

screw.en: Fix the frame in position and tighten the screws.
screw.zh: 把框子固定在正确位置上，拧紧螺丝。

screw.en: The government has started to tighten the screws on illegal share dealers.
screw.zh: 政府开始打压不法证券商。

script.en: They write all their own scripts.
script.zh: 他们所有的剧本都是自己写的。

scroll.zh: 他在屏幕上把这份文件从头到尾滚动读了一遍。

scroll.en: Could you scroll down a few lines?
scroll.zh: 请你往下滚动几行好吗？

scrub.en: She was on her hands and knees scrubbing the floor.
He scrubbed the dirt off his boots.
scrub.zh: 他把靴子上的脏土擦掉。

scruple.en: He had no scruples about selling faulty goods to people.
scruple.zh: 他卖次货给人，心里没有丝毫不安。

scruple.en: They made thousands of families homeless without scruple.
scruple.zh: 他们肆无忌惮，令成千上万的家庭流离失所。

scrupulous.en: Not all lawyers are as scrupulous as she is.
scrupulous.zh: 并不是所有的律师都像她那样正直。

scrupulous.en: The organization will be scrupulous in maintaining the highest moral standards.
scrupulous.zh: 本组织将力求保持最高的道德标准。

scrutiny.en: Careful scrutiny of the company’s accounts revealed a whole series of errors.
scrutiny.zh: 仔细查看公司的账目，有一连串的错误被发现。

scrutiny.en: Their activities have come under police scrutiny.
scrutiny.zh: 他们的活动受到警方的严密监视。

scum.en: Scum like that should be locked away!
scum.zh: 像这种人渣应该关起来！

scum.en: People like that are the scum of the earth.

scurry.en: People were scurrying off to work.
scurry.zh: 人们急匆匆赶着去上班。

sea.en: Jay stripped his clothes off and ran into the sea.
sea.zh: 杰伊脱光衣服奔入海里。

sea.en: Most exports went by sea (=on a ship).
sea.zh: 大部分出口商品都走海路。

seal.en: The document carried the seal of the governor’s office.
seal.zh: 文件上盖有州长办公室的章。

seal.en: A number of employers have already given their seal of approval to the scheme.
seal.zh: 一些雇主已经对这项计划表示认可。

seam.en: She was repairing Billy’s trousers, where the seam had come undone.
seam.zh: 她在补比利裤子的开线处。

sear.zh: 高温灼伤了他们的皮肤。

search.en: Bad weather is hampering the search for survivors.
search.zh: 恶劣的天气妨碍了对幸存者的搜寻。

search.en: Two more bodies were found after a search of the woods.
search.zh: 搜寻树林以后，又找到了两具尸体。

season.en: The racing season starts in June.
Some footpaths are closed during the shooting season.
season.zh: 在狩猎季节，一些人行小道会被封闭。

seat.en: I was in the back seat and Jo was driving.
People were shifting in their seats, looking uncomfortable.
seat.zh: 人们在座位上动来动去，看上去不大自在。

secluded.en: We sunbathed on a small secluded beach.
secluded.zh: 我们在一小片僻静的海滩上晒日光浴。

secluded.en: He’s 80 years old now and lives a very secluded life.

seclusion.en: They enjoyed ten days of peace and seclusion.
seclusion.zh: 他们享受了十天与世隔绝的宁静生活。

seclusion.en: He preferred to stay at home in seclusion.
seclusion.zh: 他更喜欢安安静静地在家里待着。

secondary.en: Writing was always secondary to spending time with my family.
secondary.zh: 与和我的家人共度时光相比，写作总是排在第二位。

secondary.en: Cost is the important thing – any benefits for the user are a secondary consideration.

secondly.en: Firstly, they are not efficient, and secondly, they are expensive to make.
secondly.zh: 首先，它们效率不高，其次，它们的制作成本很高。

secrecy.en: I must stress the need for absolute secrecy about the project.
secrecy.zh: 我必须强调这项计划一定要绝对保密。

secrecy.en: His work was shrouded in secrecy.

secret.en: They kept their relationship secret from their parents.
secret.zh: 他们俩的关系瞒着父母。

secret.en: The drugs were found in a secret compartment in Campbell’s suitcase.
secret.zh: 毒品是在坎贝尔手提箱的一个秘密夹层里找到的。

secretary.en: My secretary will fax you all the details.
secretary.zh: 我的秘书会把所有的细节发传真给你。

secrete.en: The toad’s skin secretes a deadly poison.
secrete.zh: 蟾蜍的皮肤会分泌一种致命毒素。

secrete.en: The money had been secreted in a Swiss bank account.
secrete.zh: 这笔钱藏匿在一个瑞士银行账户里。

secretion.en: These secretions are used by the caterpillar as a defence.
secretion.zh: 这些分泌物被毛虫用作自卫武器。

secretive.en: The government has been accused of being secretive and undemocratic.
secretive.zh: 该政府被指责政务不公开、缺乏民主。

secretive.en: Carla was always very secretive about her work.
secretive.zh: 卡拉对自己的工作总是讳莫如深。

section.en: The plane’s tail section was found in a cornfield.
section.zh: 飞机的尾部在玉米田里找到了。

section.en: The boats were built in Scotland, and transported to Egypt in sections.
section.zh: 船只在苏格兰建造，各部分分装运往埃及。

secure.en: Boyd’s goal secured his team’s place in the Cup Final.
secure.zh: 博伊德的进球确保了球队进入足总杯决赛。

secure.en: The company secured a $20 million contract.
secure.zh: 这家公司争取到了一份2,000

securely.en: All firearms should be kept securely locked in a cabinet.
securely.zh: 所有的枪支都应该安全稳妥地锁到柜子里。

securely.en: Customers can now buy products securely over the Internet.
securely.zh: 如今顾客可以安全放心地在网上购物了。

security.en: The trial was held under tight security.
security.zh: 这场审讯是在戒备森严的情况下进行的。

security.en: The prison was ordered to tighten security after a prisoner escaped yesterday.
security.zh: 昨天一名囚犯越狱后，该监狱被勒令加强安全措施。

seduce.en: The professor was sacked for seducing female students.
seduce.zh: 这个首席讲师因诱奸女学生而被解雇。

seduce.en: Are you trying to seduce me?

seductive.en: She used all of her seductive charm to try and persuade him.
seductive.zh: 她使出浑身魅力来说服他。

seductive.en: She smiled seductively at him across the table.
seductive.zh: 她坐在桌子对面，朝他迷人地笑了笑。

see.en: The moment we saw the house, we knew we wanted to buy it.
see.zh: 我们一看到这房子就知道我们要买。

see.en: He crouched down so he couldn’t be seen.
see.zh: 他蹲下来好让别人看不见他。

seed.en: Sow the seeds one inch deep in the soil.
seed.zh: 把种子种到一英寸深的土里。

seed.en: We grew all our tomatoes from seed.
seed.zh: 我们所有的番茄都是从种子开始种的。

seek.en: Do you think the president will seek re-election?
seek.zh: 你认为总统会谋求连任吗？

seek.en: Thousands of people crossed the border, seeking refuge from the war.
seek.zh: 成千上万的人穿过边境寻求庇护，躲避战争。

seem.en: It seems a foolish decision now.
seem.zh: 现在看来这是一个愚蠢的决定。

seemingly.en: The new minister was faced with a seemingly impossible task.
seemingly.zh: 这位新上任的大臣面临一项似乎不可能完成的工作。

seemingly.en: Alice was standing in the street, seemingly oblivious to the rain.
seemingly.zh: 艾丽斯站在街上，似乎没有注意到天在下雨。

seep.zh: 他的紧张感逐渐消失了。

segregate.en: Blacks were segregated from whites in schools.
segregate.zh: 在学校里，黑人与白人是分开的。

segregate.en: The coffee room had been segregated into smoking and non-smoking areas.
segregate.zh: 咖啡室分隔成吸烟区和非吸烟区。

seize.en: Maggie seized the letter from her.
seize.zh: 玛吉从她手上把信抢过去。

seldom.en: Karen had seldom seen him so angry.
seldom.zh: 卡伦很少见他这么生气过。

seldom.en: Seldom have I read an article that was so full of lies.
seldom.zh: 我很少读到这样满纸谎言的文章。

select.en: He had hopes of being selected for the national team.
York was selected as the site for the research centre.
select.zh: 约克被选定为研究中心所在地。

selection.en: The judges have made their final selection.
selection.zh: 评委已经作出最后的评选。

selection.en: He had narrowly missed selection for the team.
selection.zh: 他只差一点就入选球队了。

selective.en: We’re very selective about what we let the children watch.
selective.zh: 让孩子们看什么节目，我们挑选得很仔细。

selective.en: He has a very selective memory (=he chooses what he wants to remember and what to forget).

self.en: Sid was not his usual smiling self.
self.zh: 锡德不是平常那个笑容满面的样子。

self.en: Jim was beginning to feel like his old self again.
self.zh: 吉姆开始感觉自己又恢复老样子了。

self-expression.en: Corporate dress codes don’t give workers much room for self-expression.
self-expression.zh: 公司的着装规定没有给员工多少自我表现的余地。

self-image.en: Depression affects people with a poor self-image.
self-image.zh: 自我印象差的人易得抑郁症。

selfish.en: How can you be so selfish?

self-taught.en: She received some education at night school, but was largely self-taught.
self-taught.zh: 她在夜校接受过一些教育，但主要是靠自学成材。

sell.en: If you offer him another hundred, I think he’ll sell.
sell.zh: 如果你再加一百元钱，我想他会卖的。

sell.en: He regrets selling all his old records.
sell.zh: 他后悔把所有的老唱片都卖掉了。

seller.en: The album ‘Thriller’ remains one of the biggest sellers of all time.
seller.zh: 专辑《颤栗》依然是有史以来最畅销的唱片之一。

semblance.en: She was trying to get her thoughts back into some semblance of order.
semblance.zh: 她想稍微理出个头绪来。

semblance.en: After the war, life returned to a semblance of normality.
semblance.zh: 战后，生活稍微恢复了正常。

seminar.en: Publishers and writers from 13 countries attended the seminar.

senate.zh: 参议院批准了这项议案。

send.en: Lyn sent some pictures of the wedding.
send.zh: 琳恩寄了几张婚礼照片。

send.en: We sent Mom flowers for Mother’s Day.
send.zh: 我们在母亲节给妈妈送去了一些花。

senior.en: White men hold most of the jobs in senior management.
senior.zh: 白人占据高级管理层的大部分职位。

senior.en: He is also a diplomat, but senior to me.
senior.zh: 他也是一名外交官，但级别比我高。

seniority.en: I had 15 years seniority, and they couldn’t fire me.

sensation.en: One sign of a heart attack is a tingling sensation in the left arm.
sensation.zh: 心脏病发作的一个征兆是左臂有刺痛感。

sensation.en: Caroline had the sensation that she was being watched.
sensation.zh: 卡罗琳有种感觉，有人在监视她。

sensational.en: The show was a sensational success.
sensational.zh: 这次演出取得了轰动性的成功。

sense.en: Afterwards, I felt a great sense of relief.
A sense of panic has spread over the country.

senseless.en: Her death seemed such a senseless waste of life.
senseless.zh: 她的死真是无谓地浪费生命。

sensibility.en: Avoid using words that might offend someone’s racial or moral sensibilities.
sensibility.zh: 要避免使用可能会伤害种族或道德感情的词语。

sensible.en: It’s sensible to keep a note of your passport number.
sensible.zh: 把你的护照号码记下来是明智的。

sensitive.en: It’s made me much more sensitive to the needs of the disabled.
sensitive.zh: 它使我更加能够理解残疾人的需要。
劳拉对自己的体重很敏感。

sensitivity.en: His comments show a lack of sensitivity.
Interviewing victims of crime must be done with sensitivity.
sensitivity.zh: 与犯罪受害人谈话一定要非常小心。

sentence.en: His voice dropped at the end of the sentence.
sentence.zh: 到句子结尾处，他压低了嗓音。

sentence.en: It’s difficult to sum it up in one sentence.

sentiment.en: Similar sentiments were expressed by many politicians.
sentiment.zh: 许多政治家都表达了相同的观点。

sentiment.en: He was more in touch with public sentiment than many of his critics.
sentiment.zh: 比起许多批评他的人，他更了解公众的意见。

sentimental.en: People can be very sentimental about animals.
sentimental.zh: 人有时候会非常怜爱动物。

separable.en: Physical health is not always easily separable from mental health.
separable.zh: 身体健康和精神健康并不总是可以简单分开。

separate.en: Use separate knives for raw and cooked meat.
separate.zh: 切生肉和熟肉要用不同的刀。

separate.en: My wife and I have separate bank accounts.
separate.zh: 我和妻子有各自的银行账户。

september.en: I haven’t heard from him since last September.

sequence.en: The questions should be asked in a logical sequence.
sequence.zh: 应该按逻辑顺序来提问。

sequence.en: Be careful to perform the actions in the correct sequence.
sequence.zh: 注意要按正确的顺序来完成动作。

sequester.en: The jury were sequestered during the trial.
sequester.zh: 审判期间，陪审团被隔离开来。

serene.en: The child’s face was serene and beautiful.
serene.zh: 这孩子的神情宁静可爱。

serial.en: Keep the questions in the same serial order.
serial.zh: 让这些问题保持原来的顺序。

series.en: The police are investigating a series of attacks in the area.
series.zh: 警方在调查该地区发生的一连串袭击事件。

series.en: There’s been a whole series of accidents on this road.
series.zh: 这条路上发生了一连串的交通事故。

serious.en: Luckily, the damage was not serious.

serious.zh: 重大犯罪案件大幅度增加了。

seriousness.en: In all seriousness, if Tom does resign, a lot of other people will start leaving too.
seriousness.zh: 说正经的，如果汤姆真的辞职，其他许多人也会走的。

sermon.en: The vicar gave a sermon on charity.
sermon.zh: 牧师作了一次关于仁爱的布道。

servant.en: Many young girls became domestic servants.
servant.zh: 许多年轻姑娘成了家仆。

servant.en: Are we the servants of computers?

serve.en: The waiter was serving another table.
serve.zh: 那名侍应生在接待另一桌客人。

serve.en: Sprinkle with cheese and serve immediately.

server.en: All data is stored on a central file server.
server.zh: 所有数据资料都储存在中央文件服务器里。

service.en: Workers in the emergency services (=the police, hospital, and the fire service) are forbidden from striking.
service.zh: 紧急服务机构的工作人员是禁止罢工的。

service.en: There has been a decline in public services in recent years.
service.zh: 近年来公共服务减少了。

serviceable.en: Some of these old tools are still serviceable.
serviceable.zh: 这些旧工具有些仍可使用。

serving.en: This should make enough for four servings.
serving.zh: 这些应该够四个人吃的。

session.en: The court is now in session.
Board members met in closed session (=with nobody else present).
session.zh: 委员会成员举行了闭门会议。

set.en: She set the tray down on a table next to his bed.
set.zh: 她把盘子放在他床边的桌子上。

set.en: Mark filled the pan and set it on the stove.
set.zh: 马克把平底锅装满后放到火炉上。

setback.en: The December elections were a major setback for the party.
The team’s hopes of playing in Europe suffered a setback last night.
setback.zh: 球队赴欧洲参加比赛的希望昨晚遇到了阻碍。

setting.en: Cyprus is the perfect setting for a beach holiday.
setting.zh: 塞浦路斯是海滨度假的绝佳去处。

setting.en: I’ve worked with children in various settings, mainly in secondary school.
setting.zh: 我在许多地方教过孩子，主要是在中学。

settle.en: Rodman met with Kreeger to try and settle the dispute over his contract.
settle.zh: 罗德曼与克里格见了面，试图解决有关他合同的分歧。

settle.en: We hope the factions will be able to settle their differences (=agree to stop arguing) by peaceful means.
settle.zh: 我们希望各派系能以和平方式解决分歧。

settlement.en: Union leaders and company bosses will meet tomorrow in an attempt to reach a settlement.
settlement.zh: 工会领导人和公司老板将于明天举行会议以期达成协议。

settlement.en: His lawyers are understood to be negotiating a settlement.
settlement.zh: 据说他的律师正在商谈一个协议。

seven.en: The women visited cities in seven states.
seven.zh: 这些女性访问了七个州的城市。

seven.en: We close the store at seven (=seven o'clock).

seventeen.en: I left home when I was seventeen (=17 years old).
I’m planning to leave on the seventeenth (=the 17th day of the month).

seventh.en: I’m planning to leave on the seventh (=the seventh day of the month).

seventy.en: We lost touch during the seventies.
In the early seventies, Sag Harbor was still a peaceful village.

several.en: I visited him in Kansas several times.
several.zh: 我去堪萨斯州看过他几次。

several.en: Several people have volunteered to go.

severely.en: The town was severely damaged in the war.
severely.zh: 这座城镇在战争中遭到了严重破坏。

sew.en: I learned to sew at school.
Can you sew a patch on my jeans?
sew.zh: 你能帮我在牛仔裤上打个补丁吗？

sewage.en: Chlorine is used in sewage treatment.
The factory secretly dumped millions of gallons of raw sewage (=sewage that had not been treated) into the Ohio river.
sewage.zh: 这家工厂偷偷地把几百万加仑未经处理的污水排放进了俄亥俄河。

sex.en: All you see on TV is sex and violence these days.
sex.zh: 如今在电视上看到的尽是性和暴力。

sex.en: They had sex in the back seat of his car.
sex.zh: 他们在他的汽车后座上做了爱。

sexual.en: Many elderly people continue to have satisfying sexual relationships.
sexual.zh: 许多老年人仍然有满意的性关系。

sexual.en: I no longer found her sexually attractive.

shabby.en: Hugh’s jacket was old and shabby.

shack.en: She had shacked up with some guy from Florida.
shack.zh: 她和一个佛罗里达人同居了。

shack.en: Is she shacked up with anyone?

shade.en: She was sitting in the shade of a large oak tree.
shade.zh: 她坐在一棵大橡树的树荫下。

shade.en: The temperature was over 90 degrees in the shade.

shadow.en: It was hot, and we decided to walk in the shadow of the wall (=along the wall, where its shadow would fall).
shadow.zh: 天气很热，我们决定沿着墙的阴影走。

shadow.en: The room was half in shadow.

shady.en: It was nice and shady under the trees.
She’s been involved in some shady deals.
shady.zh: 她参与了一些不正当的事情。

shaft.en: I can’t believe you paid that much. You got shafted.
shaft.zh: 你怎么给了那么多钱，你上当了。

shake.en: She shook him to wake him up.
Shake the bottle before you open it.
shake.zh: 打开瓶子之前先摇一摇。

shaky.en: Grandad was a little shaky on his feet (=not able to walk very well).
shaky.zh: 爷爷走路有点晃晃悠悠。

shaky.en: My knowledge of history is a little shaky.
shaky.zh: 我的历史知识有点靠不住。

shallow.en: Place the meat in a shallow dish.

sham.en: The elections were a complete sham.
sham.zh: 这次大选完全是一场骗局。

sham.en: It all turned out to be sham and hypocrisy.
sham.zh: 这一切原来都是虚情假意。

shamble.en: The old man shambled out of the room muttering to himself.
shamble.zh: 那个老人蹒跚地走出房间，口中喃喃自语。

shame.en: It’s a shame that you have to leave so soon.
shame.zh: 你这么快就要走了，真遗憾。

shame.en: What a shame we missed the wedding.
shame.zh: 我们错过了这场婚礼，太可惜了。

shameful.en: It’s shameful the way some people treat their pets.
shameful.zh: 有些人如此对待自己的宠物，真

shameless.en: She shamelessly took advantage of him.

shampoo.en: What kind of shampoo do you use?
She showered and shampooed her short dark hair.
shampoo.zh: 她冲了淋浴，用洗发液洗了洗乌黑的短发。

shanty.en: Workers were living in tents and shanties.
shanty.zh: 工人们住在帐篷和棚屋里。

shape.zh: 那张桌子是什么形状的？

shape.en: You can recognize a tree by the shape of its leaves.
shape.zh: 可以根据树叶的形状辨认出是什么树。

share.en: We don’t have enough books, so you’ll have to share.
share.zh: 我们书不够，所以你们得合着用。

share.en: The three of us shared a taxi.
share.zh: 我们三个人合乘一辆计程车。

shark.en: Sharks were circling around our boat.
shark.zh: 鲨鱼在我们的小船周围游弋。

sharp.en: Make sure you use a good sharp knife.
sharp.zh: 你一定要用锋利的好刀。

sharp.en: Its teeth are razor sharp (=very sharp).

sharpen.en: Anne sharpened her pencil and got out her homework.
sharpen.zh: 安妮把铅笔削尖，然后拿出家庭作业来。

sharpen.en: A series of attacks have sharpened fears of more violence.
sharpen.zh: 一连串的袭击事件使人们愈发担心会发生更多暴力事件。

sharply.en: Prices have risen sharply over the last few months.
sharply.zh: 过去几个月里物价大幅度上涨。

sharply.en: His politics have moved sharply to the right.
sharply.zh: 他的政治观点突然转向了右翼。

shatter.en: The plate hit the floor, and shattered into tiny bits.
shatter.zh: 盘子掉到地板上，摔得粉碎。
这次爆炸把大楼炸成一片废墟。

shave.zh: 他已经好几天没刮脸了。
布赖恩刮胡子时割破了脸。

she.en: You could always ask Beth – she’s got plenty of money.
I saw you talking to that girl. Who is she?
she.zh: 我看见你和那个女孩子说话。

shear.en: Her long fair hair had been shorn.
shear.zh: 她长长的金发已经剪掉了。

shear.en: Though shorn of some of its powers, the party remains in control.
shear.zh: 虽然被削去了一些权力，该党仍然掌握着控制权。

shed.en: The company is planning to shed about a quarter of its workforce.
shed.zh: 这家公司正计划裁减约四分之一的人员。

shed.en: The magazine is desperately trying to shed its old-fashioned image.
shed.zh: 这份杂志急于摆脱其过时的形象。

sheep.en: Sheep were grazing on the hillside.
Tourists were led around like sheep, from shrine to souvenir shop.
sheep.zh: 游客就像羊群一般被领着一会儿到神庙，一会儿到纪念品商店。

sheepish.zh: 萨姆看上去有些局促不安。

sheer.en: The sheer size of the country makes communications difficult.
sheer.zh: 该国幅员辽阔，造成了通信的困难。

sheer.en: I’ll never forget the look of sheer joy on her face.
sheer.zh: 我永远也不会忘记她满脸喜悦的神情。

sheet.en: I’ll go and find you some clean sheets and blankets.
sheet.zh: 我去给你们找些干净的床单和毯子。

sheet.en: A sheet of ice covered the lake.

shelf.en: Put it back on the top shelf.
shelf.zh: 把它放回顶层的搁板上。

shelf.en: The album stayed on the shelf for several years, until it was finally released.
shelf.zh: 这张专辑被搁置了几年，最后终于得以发行。

shell.en: Never buy eggs with cracked shells.
The children were collecting shells on the beach.
shell.zh: 孩子们在海滩上捡贝壳。

shelter.en: They are in need of food and shelter.
We reached the shelter of the caves.
shelter.zh: 我们到了可以躲避的山洞里。

shelve.en: Plans to reopen the school have been shelved.
shelve.zh: 重新开办这所学校的计划被搁置了。

shelve.en: The garden shelves gently towards the sea.
shelve.zh: 这座花园微微向海的方向倾斜。

shepherd.en: The tour guides shepherded the rest of the group onto the bus.
shepherd.zh: 导游把团中的其他人带上了巴士。

shield.en: The immune system is our body’s shield against infection.
shield.zh: 免疫系统是我们人体抵抗感染的屏障。

shield.en: Women will often lie to shield even the most abusive partner.
shield.zh: 哪怕是再暴力的伴侣，女性也往往会撒谎保护他。

shift.en: Joe listened, shifting uncomfortably from one foot to another.
shift.zh: 乔听着，不安地把重心从一只脚转移到另一只脚。

shift.en: She shifted her gaze from me to Bobby.
shift.zh: 她把目光从我身上移到博比身上。

shimmer.en: The lake shimmered in the moonlight.

shin.zh: 他噌的一下爬到了一棵树上。

shine.en: The moon shone brightly in the sky.

shiny.en: Her hair was thick and shiny.
shiny.zh: 她的头发浓密且有光泽。

ship.en: A new engine was shipped over from the US.
ship.zh: 从美国运来一台新的引擎。

ship.en: They’re now shipping their long-awaited new anti-virus software.
ship.zh: 他们现正推出大家期待已久的新杀毒软件。

shipment.en: The goods are ready for shipment.

shipping.en: The port is closed to all shipping.
The jewelry can be yours for $15 plus shipping and handling.

shipwreck.en: Beatty was shipwrecked off the coast of Africa.
shipwreck.zh: 贝蒂在非洲海岸附近遭遇了海难。

shirt.en: I have to wear a shirt and tie to work.
shirt.zh: 我上班要穿衬衫打领带。

shit.en: Shit! I’ve left my purse at home.
shit.zh: 妈的！我把钱包忘在家里了。
那种垃圾食品我可不吃！

shiver.en: Jake stood shivering in the cold air.
shiver.zh: 大冷天里，杰克站着冻得瑟瑟发抖。

shiver.en: She shivered with fear and anger.
shiver.zh: 她又是害怕，又是气愤，身体直发抖。

shock.en: The news of his death came as a great shock to everyone.
shock.zh: 他去世的消息让所有人都非常震惊。

shock.en: It was a real shock to hear that the factory would have to close.
shock.zh: 听说工厂将被迫关闭，真是很震惊。

shoe.en: I sat down and took off my shoes and socks.
shoe.zh: 我坐下来脱掉鞋子和袜子。

shoe.en: What size shoe do you take?

shoot.en: Police shot one suspect when he pulled a gun on them.
shoot.zh: 警方在一名嫌疑人拔枪指着他们时击毙了他。

shoot.en: Smith killed his wife, and then shot himself.
shoot.zh: 史密斯杀死妻子，然后开枪自杀。

shop.en: Her brother runs a record shop in Chester.
shop.zh: 她弟弟在切斯特开了一家唱片店。

shop.en: Shirley saw her reflection in the shop window.
shop.zh: 雪莉在商店橱窗里看到了自己的影像。

shopper.en: The streets were crowded with shoppers.

shopping.en: Late-night shopping is becoming very popular.
shopping.zh: 深夜购物越来越普遍了。

shopping.en: She’s gone on a shopping trip to New York.

shore.en: We could see a boat about a mile from shore.
shore.zh: 我们看见离岸边大约一英里的地方有一艘船。

shore.en: Only a few survivors reached the shore.
shore.zh: 仅有几个生还者到达岸边。

short.en: Winter is coming and the days are getting shorter.

shortage.en: There is no shortage of funds.
There is a serious shortage of food in some areas.
shortage.zh: 有些地区食物严重短缺。

shortcoming.en: Peter was painfully aware of his own shortcomings.
shortcoming.zh: 彼得痛苦地认识到了自己的短处。

shortcoming.en: The report suggested that there were severe shortcomings in police tactics.
shortcoming.zh: 报告暗示警方的策略存在严重缺陷。

shorten.en: His name is often shortened to Pat.
shorten.zh: 他的名字常被简称为帕特。

shorthand.en: The reporter took notes in shorthand.
shorthand.zh: 这名记者用速记做记录。

shorthand.en: He’s been ‘relocated’, which is shorthand for ‘given a worse job a long way away’.

shortly.en: Ms Jones will be back shortly.
shortly.zh: 琼斯女士很快就会回来。

shortly.en: The accident happened shortly before midday.
shortly.zh: 事故是在正午前不久发生的。

short-term.en: The treatment may bring short-term benefits to AIDS sufferers.
short-term.zh: 这种疗法对艾滋病患者可能会有短期效果。

short-term.en: Most of the staff are on short-term contracts.
short-term.zh: 大部分职员签的都是短期合同。

shot.en: He pulled out his rifle and fired three shots.
She was killed by a single shot to the head.
shot.zh: 她被人击中头部一枪打死。

should.en: Children shouldn’t be allowed to play in the street.
should.zh: 不应该让儿童在街上玩。

shoulder.en: She tapped the driver on the shoulder.
He put his arm around her shoulders.

shout.en: There’s no need to shout! I can hear you!
shout.zh: 用不着大声喊叫！我听得见！

shout.en: I wish you’d stop shouting at the children.
shout.zh: 我希望你别再对孩子们大声嚷嚷了。

shove.en: He shoved her towards the car.
Everyone was pushing and shoving to see the prince.
shove.zh: 大家都推着挤着要看王子。

shovel.en: The workmen shovelled gravel onto the road.
shovel.zh: 工人们把碎石铲到路面上。

shovel.en: They were out in freezing conditions shovelling snow off the pitch.
shovel.zh: 他们在外面冒着严寒铲掉球场上的雪。

show.en: The children proudly showed me their presents.
show.zh: 孩子们自豪地给我看他们的礼物。

show.en: Show your ticket to the woman at the entrance.
show.zh: 向入口处的那位女士出示你的门票。

shower.en: Why does the phone always ring when I’m in the shower?
shower.zh: 为什么电话铃总是在我洗澡的时候响？

shower.en: I’d like to use the shower if that’s all right.
shower.zh: 如果可以的话，我想用一下这里的淋浴。

showman.en: He is the band’s best showman.
showman.zh: 他是这支乐队中风头最盛的人。

shred.en: The clothes were ripped to shreds and covered in blood.
shred.zh: 衣服被撕成了碎片，上面血迹斑斑。

shred.en: Within a year, other researchers had torn the theory to shreds.
shred.zh: 不到一年，其他研究者就把这一理论批驳得体无完肤。

shrewd.zh: 马尔科姆是个精明的商人。

shrewd.en: She was shrewd enough to guess who was responsible.
shrewd.zh: 她很精明，一猜就知道是谁干的。

shriek.en: They were dragged from their homes, shrieking and weeping.
shriek.zh: 他们哭喊着被人从家里拖出去。

shrill.en: He hated the shrill demands of the children.
shrill.zh: 他对孩子们吵个不休要这要那感到很讨厌。

shrine.en: Elvis’ home has become a shrine for his fans.
shrine.zh: 猫王的故居成了歌迷的朝圣地。

shrine.en: The museum is a shrine to the great Spanish artist.
shrine.zh: 这座博物馆是瞻仰这位伟大西班牙画家的圣地。

shrink.en: I’m worried about washing that shirt in case it shrinks.
shrink.zh: 我不太敢洗那件衬衫，怕它会缩水。

shrinkage.en: Pollution led to a shrinkage of grasslands.
shrinkage.zh: 污染导致草原面积缩小。

shroud.en: The fog rolled in, and a grey shroud covered the city.
shroud.zh: 大雾滚滚而来，一张灰色的天幕笼罩着这个城市。

shroud.en: A shroud of silence surrounded the general’s death.
shroud.zh: 将军的去世让周围一片死寂。

shrug.en: I just shrugged my shoulders and ignored him.
shrug.zh: 我只是耸耸肩，没有理睬他。

shudder.en: Maria shuddered as she stepped outside.
shudder.zh: 玛丽亚一走到外面就打了个冷战。

shudder.en: I shudder with embarrassment whenever I think about it.
shudder.zh: 每当我想到这件事就会尴尬得直打哆嗦。

shuffle.en: The official signaled to one of the waiters, who shuffled forward.
shuffle.zh: 这名官员向其中一名侍者打了个手势，那个侍者便拖着脚步走上前来。

shuffle.en: With sore legs and aching chest, he shuffled over to the bathroom.
shuffle.zh: 他腿酸，胸口痛，拖着步子走向浴室。

shun.en: Victims of the disease found themselves shunned by society.
shun.zh: 患这种病的人发现，社会上的人都躲着

shut.en: I heard his bedroom door shut.
shut.zh: 我听到他的卧室门关上了。

shutter.en: The company shuttered its Hong Kong business a year ago.
shutter.zh: 这家公司一年前停止了在香港的业务。

shuttle.en: He took the Washington–New York shuttle.
shuttle.zh: 他乘坐华盛顿－纽约的往返班机。

shuttle.en: A shuttle bus operates to and from the beach of San Benedetto.
shuttle.zh: 有穿梭巴士往返于圣贝内代托海滩。

shy.en: He was a quiet shy man.
shy.zh: 他是个话不多、害羞的男人。

shy.en: She was very shy with strangers.
shy.zh: 她在陌生人面前很害羞。

sibling.en: Most young smokers are influenced by their friends’ and older siblings’ smoking habits.
sibling.zh: 大多数年轻的吸烟者都是因为他们的朋友或者哥哥姐姐有吸烟习惯而受影响的。

sick.en: Maria can’t come in today because she’s sick.
sick.zh: 玛丽亚因为生病今天不能来了。

sicken.en: The thought of such cruelty sickened her.
sicken.zh: 想到如此残忍的行为，她就很愤慨。

sicken.en: All decent people should be sickened by such a pointless waste of life.
sicken.zh: 凡正派的人都会痛恨这样无谓地浪费生命。

sickness.en: Liam had suffered violent sickness and diarrhoea.
He said the idea of ‘success’ was part of the sickness of Western cultures.

side.en: The south side of town is pretty run down.
side.zh: 这个镇的南边相当破败。

side.en: Fuel is cheaper on the French side of the border.
side.zh: 燃料在边境那边的法国要便宜些。

sideline.en: Zoë does a bit of freelance photography as a sideline.
sideline.zh: 佐薇兼职做点自由摄影。

sideline.en: You can’t stay on the sidelines for ever; it’s time you got involved.
sideline.zh: 你不能一直袖手旁观，是时候参与进来了。

sideways.en: A strong gust of wind blew the car sideways into the ditch.
sideways.zh: 一阵狂风把汽车横着掀进了沟里。

sideways.en: They brought the piano sideways through the front door.
sideways.zh: 他们把钢琴侧着从前门抬进来。

siege.en: The siege lasted almost four months.
siege.zh: 这次封锁历时近四个月。

siege.en: In June 1176, King Richard laid siege to Limoges.

sieve.en: Sieve the flour and cocoa powder into a bowl.
sieve.zh: 把面粉和可可粉筛进碗里。

sift.en: Police are sifting through the evidence.
It’s hard to sift out the truth from the lies in this case.
sift.zh: 这种情况下真相和谎言难以分辨。

sigh.en: Frankie stared out of the window and sighed deeply.
sigh.zh: 弗朗基凝望着窗外，深深地叹了口气。

sigh.en: He sighed with despair at the thought of all the opportunities he had missed.
sigh.zh: 想到自己错过的一个个机会，他绝望地叹了口气。

sight.en: Anne’s sight is very good for someone of her age.
sight.zh: 安妮的视力对于她这个年龄的人来说算是非常好的。

sight.en: He began to lose his sight six years ago.
sight.zh: 六年前他开始视力衰退。

sightseeing.en: She swam and sunbathed, went sightseeing, and relaxed.
sightseeing.zh: 她游泳，晒日光浴，观光，放松。

sign.en: Don’t ignore the fog warning signs.
A red morning sky is a sign of an impending storm.
sign.zh: 早晨的红霞预示着暴风雨即将来临。

signal.en: When she got up from the table, it was obviously the signal for us to leave.
signal.zh: 她从桌边站起来，这显然是要我们离开。

signal.en: At a prearranged signal the lights went out.
signal.zh: 预定的信号一发出，灯就全灭了。

signature.en: Her signature is totally illegible (=cannot be read).
signature.zh: 她的签字完全无法辨认。

signature.en: The school collected 4,000 signatures for the petition.
signature.zh: 学校为这份请愿书收集到了四千个签名。

significance.en: Stella didn’t attach any significance to Doug’s query.
significance.zh: 斯特拉没有在意道格的提问。

significance.en: The book assesses the significance of Stalin’s policies between 1927 and 1939.

significant.en: His most significant political achievement was the abolition of the death penalty.
significant.zh: 他政治上最重大的成就是废除了死刑。

significant.en: Please inform us if there are any significant changes in your plans.
significant.zh: 你们的计划如有重大变动，请通知我们。

signify.en: Some tribes use special facial markings to signify status.
signify.zh: 有些部落使用特殊的面部标记来表示地位。

signify.en: The image of the lion signified power and strength.
signify.zh: 狮子的形象代表权力和力量。

signpost.en: I’m sure that signpost is pointing the wrong way.
signpost.zh: 我敢肯定那块路标指错了方向。

signpost.en: Just follow the signposts to the city centre.
signpost.zh: 就按路标所指的方向去市中心。

silence.en: Nothing disturbed the silence of the night.
silence.zh: 没有任何声音打破这夜晚的寂静。

silence.en: After the explosion, an eerie silence fell upon the scene.
silence.zh: 爆炸之后，现场陷入一片可怕的寂静。

silent.en: She kept silent, forcing Buchanan to continue.
silent.zh: 她保持沉默，逼着布坎南继续下去。

silent.en: The crowd fell silent (=became silent) when the president appeared.
silent.zh: 总统出现时，人群安静了下来。

silhouette.en: Soon the bombers would return, black silhouettes against a pale sky.
silhouette.zh: 轰炸机很快会再来，灰蒙蒙的天空又会出现一个个黑色的轮廓。

silhouette.en: The old windmill stood out in silhouette.
silhouette.zh: 那架古老风车的轮廓映衬出来。

silk.en: His practice quickly grew and he took silk (=became a QC) in 1988.

silly.en: You made a lot of silly mistakes.
silly.zh: 你犯了许多愚蠢的错误。

silt.en: The old harbour silted up years ago.
silt.zh: 这个老港湾在许多年前就淤塞了。

silver.en: It was my job to polish the silver.
silver.zh: 我的工作是擦亮银餐具。

silver.en: The lake sparkled with shades of blue and silver.
silver.zh: 湖面上泛着蓝色和银白色的波光。

silvery.en: Clara gave a small, silvery laugh.
silvery.zh: 克拉拉发出一声银铃般的轻笑。

similar.en: We have similar tastes in music.
similar.zh: 我们对音乐的品位相近。

similar.en: Both approaches seem to achieve similar results.
similar.zh: 两种方法都得出了相似的结果。

similarity.en: There are some striking similarities between the two plays.
similarity.zh: 这两出戏有一些异常相似之处。

similarity.en: The present crisis bears some similarity to the oil crisis of the 1970s.

similarly.en: The first letter she wrote me was less than a page long, and her second letter was similarly brief.
similarly.zh: 她写给我的第一封信不到一页，第二封信也一样简短。

similarly.en: The cost of food and clothing has come down in recent years. Similarly, fuel prices have fallen quite considerably.
similarly.zh: 吃穿的费用近年来下降了。

simple.en: There is no simple answer to this question.
simple.zh: 这个问题没有简单的答案。

simple.en: I’m sure there’s a perfectly simple explanation.
simple.zh: 我相信一定有一个很简单的解释。

simplicity.en: Mona wrote with a beautiful simplicity of style.
For the sake of simplicity, the tax form is divided into three sections.
simplicity.zh: 为简明起见，税单分成三个部分。

simplify.en: The law needs to be simplified.
These figures are a simplification. The real situation is much more complicated than this.
simplify.zh: 这些数据是简化过的，实际情况要比这复杂得多。

simplistic.en: This is a very simplistic approach to the problem.
simplistic.zh: 这应该对该问题过分简单化的处理办法。

simply.en: This work is simply not good enough.
simply.zh: 这工作做得实在不够好。

simply.en: He simply won’t accept the committee’s decision.
simply.zh: 他根本不接受委员会的决定。

simulate.en: Interviews can be simulated in the classroom.
simulate.zh: 可以在教室里模拟面试。

simulate.en: He found it impossible to simulate grief.
simulate.zh: 他无法装出悲伤的样子。

simultaneous.en: They grabbed each other’s hands in simultaneous panic.
