technology.en: Modern technology makes moving money around much easier than it used to be.
technology.zh: 现代科技使货币流动比以前便捷得多。

technology.en: Advances in technology have improved crop yields by over 30%.
technology.zh: 科技的进步使庄稼产量提高了30%

tedious.en: The work was tiring and tedious.

tedium.en: We sang while we worked, to relieve the tedium.
tedium.zh: 我们边唱歌边干活来排遣无聊。

teem.en: It’s been teeming down all day.
The island was teeming with tourists.

teen.en: She was in her teens when she met him.
We moved to York when I was in my early teens.
teen.zh: 我十三四岁时我们搬到了约克。

telegraph.en: Once he knew where we were, Lewis telegraphed every few hours.
telegraph.zh: 一知道我们在哪里，刘易斯就每隔几小时发一份电报来。

telegraph.en: A slight movement of the hand telegraphed his intention to shoot.
telegraph.zh: 手微微一动就暴露了他想要开枪的意图。

telephone.en: Reservations can be made by telephone.
I’ve never met him, but I’ve spoken to him on the telephone.
telephone.zh: 我从来没见过他，但我和他通过电话。

telescope.en: Details on the Moon’s surface can only be seen through a telescope.
telescope.zh: 月球表面的细节只有通过望远镜才能看到。

telescope.en: The whole legal process was telescoped into a few weeks.
telescope.zh: 整个法律程序被缩短到几个星期。

televise.en: The game was televised live on ABC.
televise.zh: 这场比赛由美国广播公司进行电视现场直播。

television.en: Lucy turned on the television to watch the evening news.
television.zh: 露西打开电视收看晚间新闻。

television.en: They have a television in every room.
television.zh: 他们每个房间都配有电视。

tell.en: I wish someone had told me the meeting was canceled.
tell.zh: 要是有人告诉过我会议已取消就好了。

tell.en: The Chief of Police told reporters that two people were killed in the blast.
tell.zh: 警察局长告诉记者有两个人在爆炸中丧生。

telling.en: The story gets better with each telling.
telling.zh: 这个故事每一次讲述精彩程度都会增添几分。

telling.en: There’s no telling who is going to show up tonight.

telltale.en: They examined the child carefully, looking for telltale signs of abuse.
telltale.zh: 他们仔细检查了那个孩子，寻找被虐待的痕迹。

temper.en: That temper of hers will get her into trouble one of these days.
temper.zh: 她那种脾气早晚会让她惹麻烦的。

temper.en: According to Nathan, Robin has quite a temper.
temper.zh: 据内森讲，罗宾脾气很大。

temperament.en: Jill has such a lovely relaxed temperament.
temperament.zh: 吉尔性格随和从容，非常讨人喜欢。

temperament.en: Tolkien was, by temperament, a very different man from Lewis.
temperament.zh: 从性情来说，托尔金和刘易斯是完全不同的人。

temperature.en: The temperature of the water was just right for swimming.
Water boils at a temperature of 100ºC.

temporal.en: Edgar ruled over the Church as well as his temporal kingdom.
temporal.zh: 埃德加除了统治世俗王国之外，还掌控着教会。

temporary.en: I’m living with my parents, but it’s only temporary.
temporary.zh: 我和父母住在一起，但这只是暂时的。

temporary.en: You might want to consider temporary work until you decide what you want to do.
temporary.zh: 在你定下来想做什么之前，也许可以考虑干点临时性工作。

tempt.en: The new program is designed to tempt young people into studying engineering.
tempt.zh: 这项新计划旨在吸引年轻人学工科。

tempt.en: It would take a lot of money to tempt me to quit this job.
tempt.zh: 得要很多钱才会让我动心放弃这份工作。

temptation.en: There might be a temptation to cheat if students sit too close together.
temptation.zh: 学生如果坐得太近可能会产生作弊的念头。

temptation.en: Resist the temptation to buy the item until you’re certain you need it.
temptation.zh: 要抵挡住购买的诱惑，除非你确有需要。

ten.en: Snow had been falling steadily for ten days.
I need to be home by ten (=ten o'clock).

tenant.en: The desk was left by the previous tenant.
tenant.zh: 书桌是上一个房客留下来的。

tend.en: People tend to need less sleep as they get older.
tend.zh: 随着年龄的增长，人需要的睡眠通常会减少。

tend.en: My car tends to overheat in the summer.
tend.zh: 我的车夏天经常会变得过热。

tendency.en: Greg’s tendency to be critical made him unpopular with his co-workers.
tendency.zh: 格雷格爱挑剔的性格使他的同事都不喜欢他。

tendency.en: The drug is effective but has a tendency to cause headaches.
tendency.zh: 这种药很有效，但可能会引起头疼。

tender.en: Continue cooking until the meat is tender.
tender.zh: 把肉一直烧到松软为止。

tender.en: My arm is still tender where I bruised it.
tender.zh: 我手臂撞伤的地方仍然一碰就疼。

tenfold.en: Business has increased tenfold in the past two years.
tenfold.zh: 在过去两年里，业务扩展了十倍。

tenor.en: Arthur Davies sings the tenor solo.
Many voters admitted being disturbed by the tenor of the election campaign.
tenor.zh: 许多选民承认选举活动的发展趋势让他们感到担忧。

tense.en: Marion spoke, eager to break the tense silence.
tense.zh: 玛丽昂说话了，急于打破这令人紧张的沉默。

tense.en: Is anything wrong? You look a little tense.
tense.zh: 有什么不对劲吗？你看起来有点紧张。

tension.en: The tension was becoming unbearable, and I wanted to scream.
tension.zh: 这种紧张变得难以忍受，我真想大声尖叫。

tension.en: Exercise is the ideal way to relieve tension after a hard day.
tension.zh: 运动锻炼是劳累一天后最理想的减压方法。

tent.en: We looked for a flat spot where we could pitch our tent (=put up our tent).
tent.zh: 我们寻找一个平缓的地方搭帐篷。

tentacle.en: The company’s tentacles spread from car manufacturing to railways.
tentacle.zh: 这家公司的扩张触角从汽车制造业伸向了铁路运输业。

tentative.en: I passed on my tentative conclusions to the police.
tentative.zh: 我把我的初步结论递交给了警方。

tentative.en: The government is taking tentative steps towards tackling the country’s economic problems.
tentative.zh: 政府正在采取临时性措施来解决国家的经济问题。

tenth.en: I’m planning to leave on the tenth (=the tenth day of the month).

tenuous.en: For now, the band’s travel plans are tenuous.
tenuous.zh: 乐队的巡演计划暂时还没确定。

tenuous.en: The United Peace Alliance had only a tenuous connection with the organized Labour movement.
tenuous.zh: 联合和平协会和有组织的劳工运动关联甚微。

term.en: Femininity is still defined in terms of beauty.
term.zh: 女性美仍然以美貌来界定。

term.en: It’s a mistake to think of Florida only in terms of its tourist attractions.
term.zh: 谈到佛罗里达只想到它是旅游胜地是不对的。

terminal.en: The once great industry is now in terminal decline.
terminal.zh: 这个曾经十分兴旺的行业现在已日薄西山。

terminate.en: The court ruled that the contract must be terminated.
terminate.zh: 法庭裁决该合同必须终止。

terminate.en: The train from Paris terminates at St Pancras International.
terminate.zh: 这趟从巴黎发出的火车终点站是圣潘克拉斯国际火车站。

termination.en: You may face a reduction or termination of benefits.
termination.zh: 你的津贴可能会减少或取消。

terrible.en: Their son had been injured in a terrible accident.
terrible.zh: 他们的儿子在一次严重事故中受过伤。

terrible.en: We’re worried that something terrible might have happened to Greg.
terrible.zh: 我们担心格雷格有可能遇到了什么可怕的事情。

terribly.en: I’m terribly sorry to have kept you waiting.
The coach was not terribly worried about his team’s poor performance.
terribly.zh: 教练对他所执教球队的糟糕表现并不是十分担忧。

terrific.en: The actress who played the lawyer was terrific.
terrific.zh: 扮演律师的女演员表演十分出色。

terrify.zh: 丈夫的暴力行为让她感到害怕。

territory.en: The plane was flying over enemy territory.
territory.zh: 这架飞机当时在敌区上空飞行。

territory.en: A tiger has a large territory to defend.
territory.zh: 老虎要守护的地盘很广。

terror.en: People fled in terror as fire tore through the building.
terror.zh: 大楼里火势迅速蔓延，人们惊慌失措，纷纷逃离。

terror.en: Shots rang out, and I screamed in terror.
terror.zh: 枪声响起，我惊恐地尖叫起来。

terrorism.en: The government is doing everything possible to combat terrorism.
terrorism.zh: 政府正在尽其所能打击恐怖主义。

terrorist.en: We refuse to talk to terrorists.
terrorist.zh: 我们拒绝和恐怖分子对话。

terrorist.en: Twenty people were killed in the latest terrorist attack.

terse.en: Derek’s terse reply ended the conversation.
terse.zh: 德里克的简短回答结束了谈话。

test.en: We have a test on irregular verbs tomorrow.
test.zh: 明天我们要测验，考不规则动词。

test.en: Did you get a good mark in the test?

testify.en: Mr Molto has agreed to testify at the trial.
testify.zh: 莫尔托先生已经同意出庭作证。

testify.en: Later, the witness who had testified against Muawad withdrew his allegation.
testify.zh: 后来，举证指控穆瓦瓦德的那位证人撤回了证词。

testimony.en: Barker’s testimony is crucial to the prosecution’s case.
testimony.zh: 巴克的证词对控方的指控起到了关键作用。

testimony.en: In his testimony, he denied that the company had ignored safety procedures.
testimony.zh: 他在证词中否认公司忽视了安全程序。

text.en: One disk can store the equivalent of 500 pages of text.
text.zh: 一张磁盘可以储存相当于500

text.en: There should not be too much text in children’s books.
text.zh: 儿童书籍里不应该有太多的文字。

textbook.en: The advertising campaign was a textbook example of how to sell a product.
textbook.zh: 这个广告活动是产品营销的一个范本案例。

textile.en: Their main exports are textiles, especially silk and cotton.
textile.zh: 他们的主要出口商品是纺织品，尤其是丝绸和棉布。

texture.en: This soup has a lovely creamy texture.
texture.zh: 这汤喝起来有奶油的口感，挺不错的。

than.en: Natalie was prettier than her sister.
You need that money more than I do.

thank.en: I haven’t had a chance to thank him yet.
thank.zh: 我还没有机会向他表示谢意。

thank.en: Did you thank Uncle Ron for the present?
thank.zh: 你谢过罗恩叔叔给你礼物吗？

thankful.en: I’ll be thankful for a good night’s sleep after the week I’ve had.
thankful.zh: 一个星期下来，我要能好好地睡上一个晚上就感激不尽了。

thankful.en: She was thankful that Chantal was there.

thanks.en: Thanks a lot for the drink.
Thanks very much for your help.

that.en: I wish you wouldn’t say things like that.
What did you do with those sandwiches?
that.zh: 那些三明治你怎么处理了？

thaw.en: Thaw frozen meat in its packet and then cook as soon as possible.
thaw.zh: 先将冻肉连包装解冻，然后尽快烹煮。

the.en: I ordered a pizza and salad. The pizza was nice but the salad was disgusting.

theatre.en: He’s really interested in literature and the theatre.
theatre.zh: 他对文学和戏剧很感兴趣。

theft.en: Car theft is on the increase.
Three men were charged with attempted theft.
theft.zh: 三名男子被指控企图行窃。

their.en: They washed their faces and went to bed.
their.zh: 他们洗过脸后上床睡觉去了。

their.en: The twins spend all their time together.
their.zh: 这对双胞胎总是待在一起。

theirs.en: When our washing machine broke, our neighbours let us use theirs.
theirs.zh: 我们的洗衣机坏了的时候，邻居就让我们用他们的。

theirs.en: Our house is number 25, and theirs is just opposite.

them.en: Has anyone seen my keys? I can’t find them anywhere.
them.zh: 有人见到我的钥匙吗？我哪儿都找不到。

them.en: The police were very helpful when I spoke to them.
them.zh: 我和警察说了，他们很帮忙。

theme.en: The book’s theme is the conflict between love and duty.
theme.zh: 本书的主题是爱与责任之间的冲突。

theme.en: Campbell has made health care a central theme in his campaign.
theme.zh: 坎贝尔在竞选活动中把医疗保健作为中心主题。

themselves.en: Teachers have no choice but to take measures to protect themselves.
themselves.zh: 教师们别无选择，只能采取措施来保护自己。

themselves.en: Our neighbours have just bought themselves a jacuzzi.
themselves.zh: 我们邻居刚刚买了一个按摩浴缸。

then.en: I wish I had known then what I know now.
then.zh: 我真希望那时我就知道现在所知道的一切。

then.en: It was then that I realised she’d tricked me.
then.zh: 直到那时我才知道她骗了我。

theoretical.en: Aristotle’s theoretical model of the universe
theoretical.zh: 亚里士多德有关宇宙的理论模型

theoretical.en: She has theoretical knowledge of teaching, but no practical experience.
theoretical.zh: 她有教学方面的理论知识，但没有实际经验。

theorize.en: Researchers theorize that there was once a common language for all humanity.
theorize.zh: 研究者提出一种理论，称人类曾使用同一种语言。

theorize.en: They have been theorizing about what may have caused the fire.
theorize.zh: 他们一直在推测是什么造成了这场火灾。

theory.en: Freudian theory has had a great influence on psychology.
theory.zh: 弗洛伊德理论对心理学产生过巨大影响。

therapeutic.zh: 我觉得游泳能让人很放松。

therapeutic.en: Some claim that the herb has therapeutic value for treating pain.
therapeutic.zh: 有些人称这种草药具有止痛的疗效。

therapy.en: Rob was in therapy for several years.
therapy.zh: 罗布接受过几年的心理治疗。

there.en: There are a few things we need to discuss.
there.zh: 有些事情我们需要讨论。

thereafter.en: Sophie was born in France, but shortly thereafter her family moved to the United States.
thereafter.zh: 索菲出生在法国，但不久以后她全家就移居到了美国。

thereby.en: He became a citizen in 1978, thereby gaining the right to vote.

therefore.en: Their car was bigger and therefore more comfortable.
therefore.zh: 他们的车大些，所以更舒适些。

therefore.en: Progress so far has been very good. We are, therefore, confident that the work will be completed on time.
therefore.zh: 到目前为止进展十分顺利，所以我们有把握按时完成工作。

therein.en: See Thompson, 1983, and the references cited therein.
The treaty was imposed by force, and therein lay the cause of its ineffectiveness.
therein.zh: 该条约是通过武力强制执行的，它之所以没有起到作用，原因就在于此。

thereof.en: States differ in standards for products and the labelling thereof.
thereof.zh: 各州的产品标准不同，标签的标注也不同。

thereof.en: Money, or the lack thereof, played a major role in their marital problems.
thereof.zh: 钱，或者说没钱，是他们婚姻出现问题的主要原因。

thesis.en: Cynthia’s still working on her thesis.
He wrote his doctoral thesis on contemporary French literature.
thesis.zh: 他写的博士论文是关于法国当代文学的。

they.en: Bob and Sue said they wouldn’t be able to come.
they.zh: 鲍勃和休说他们来不了。

they.en: Ken gave me some flowers. Aren’t they beautiful?
they.zh: 肯送给我一些花。很漂亮吧？

thick.en: If you want a thicker blanket, there are more here in the closet.
thick.zh: 如果你想要更厚的毯子，这个柜子里还有。

thicken.en: The fog was beginning to thicken.
Thicken the soup by adding potatoes.

thickness.en: The thickness of the walls is 5 feet.
Wrap the cake in a double thickness of foil.
thickness.zh: 用两层箔纸把蛋糕包好。

thief.en: Thieves broke into the offices and stole some computer equipment.
thief.zh: 小偷破门进入办公室，偷走了价值15

thief.en: They were nothing but petty thieves (=thieves who steal small things).

thin.en: She’s only wearing a thin summer jacket (=a jacket made of light material).
thin.zh: 她只穿了一件薄薄的夏装外套。

thin.en: The road was covered with a thin layer of ice.
thin.zh: 路面上覆盖着一层薄薄的冰。

thing.en: People say things they don’t mean when they are angry.
thing.zh: 人生气时就会口不择言。

thing.en: It was a horrible thing to happen.
thing.zh: 发生这样的事情太糟糕了。

think.en: I think that you’re being unfair.
think.zh: 我认为你这么做不公平。
我觉得我听到了什么声音。

thinking.en: The Administration’s thinking changed as the war progressed.
thinking.zh: 随着战事的发展，政府的态度改变了。

thinking.en: Well, to my way of thinking (=in my opinion), they should have done that years ago.
thinking.zh: 唉，依我看来，他们早就应该做那件事了。

thinly.zh: 把萝卜籽撒播得稀一些。

thinly.en: The mountain regions are more thinly populated than the lowlands.

third.en: I’m planning to leave on the third (=the third day of the month).

thirst.en: Ice water is the only thing that really quenches my thirst (=gets rid of it).
thirst.zh: 只有冰水才能让我真正解渴。

thirst.en: We had worked up a thirst (=done something that made us thirsty), and so we decided to stop for a beer.
thirst.zh: 我们干得口渴了，因此决定停下来喝杯啤酒。

thirsty.en: Can I have a glass of water? I’m really thirsty.
He’d been working in the garden and was very hot and thirsty.
thirsty.zh: 他一直在花园里干活，又热又渴。

thirteen.en: They’ve only sold thirteen tickets so far.
thirteen.zh: 到目前为止他们仅仅售出13

thirteen.en: When it happened, I was thirteen (=13 years old).

thirty.en: In the thirties, air travel really began to take off.
The family sold the house in the early thirties.

this.en: We must make sure this doesn’t happen again.
this.zh: 我们必须确保此事不会再次发生。

this.en: Is there any way of solving these problems?
this.zh: 有什么方法能解决这些问题吗？

thorn.en: He’s been a thorn in the side of the party leadership for years.
thorn.zh: 他多年来一直是该党领导人心头的一根刺。

thorough.en: The doctor gave him a thorough check-up.
thorough.zh: 医生给他做了一次全面的体检。

thorough.en: The police investigation was very thorough.

thoroughly.en: The room had been thoroughly cleaned.

though.en: Though she’s almost 40, she still plans to compete.
Pascal went ahead with the experiment even though he knew it was dangerous.
though.zh: 虽然帕斯卡知道这个试验很危险，但他仍然进行下去。

thought.en: The thought that I might not have a job next year is a bit troubling.
thought.zh: 想到明年可能失业我有点心烦。

thoughtful.en: It was really thoughtful of you to remember my birthday.
thoughtful.zh: 你真是细心，还记得我的生日。

thoughtless.en: It was thoughtless of her not to tell you where she was going.
thoughtless.zh: 她没告诉你她要去哪儿，这有点欠考虑。

thousand.en: The company employs thirty thousand people.
I’ve been this route a thousand times before.
thousand.zh: 这条路线我以前走过无数次了。

thrash.en: The girl was thrashing about in the water.
thrash.zh: 女孩在水里拼命地挣扎。

thrash.en: Salmon thrash their tails and leap from the water.
thrash.zh: 鲑鱼甩动着尾巴跃出水面。

thread.en: I’m looking for a needle and thread.
His mind wandered, and he lost the thread of what she was saying (=was no longer able to understand it).
thread.zh: 他走神了，跟不上她的思路。

threat.zh: 你的那些威胁吓不倒我。

threat.en: He says his family received phone threats from the group.
threat.zh: 他说他的家人接到过这个组织的恐吓电话。

threaten.en: Postal workers are threatening a strike if they don’t receive a pay increase.
threaten.zh: 邮政工人威胁如果不加薪，他们就要罢工。

threaten.en: He threatened to take them to court.
threaten.zh: 他扬言要把他们告上法庭。

three.en: They’ve won their last three games.
three.zh: 他们赢了最近三场比赛。

three.en: We’d better go. It’s almost three (=three o'clock).

threshold.en: She opened the door and stepped across the threshold.
Eighty percent of the vote was the threshold for approval of the plan.

thrill.en: Winning first place must have been quite a thrill.
thrill.zh: 赢得第一名肯定让人非常激动。

thrill.en: Even though I’ve been acting for years, I still get a thrill out of going on stage.
thrill.zh: 尽管我演了多年戏，走上舞台我仍然感到十分激动。

thrive.en: The whole family seems to be doing well.
thrive.zh: 全家人似乎都干得不错。

thrive.en: I wouldn’t want that much pressure, but she seems to thrive on it.
thrive.zh: 我是不希望有那么多的压力，但她却好像乐在其中。

throat.en: The singer complained of a sore throat after Wednesday’s show.
throat.zh: 星期三演出后，这位歌手说喉咙痛。

throat.en: She fingered the pearls at her throat.
throat.zh: 她用手指拨弄脖子上的珍珠。

throne.en: He is next in line to the throne (=will become king when the present ruler dies).
In 1913, George V was on the throne (=was ruling).

throng.en: She got lost in the throng.
Tourists thronged the bars and restaurants.
throng.zh: 游客挤满了酒吧和餐馆。

through.en: She smiled at him as he walked through the door.
through.zh: 他从门口进来时，她朝他笑了。

through.en: Water will be pumped through a pipe.

throughout.en: The disease spread rapidly throughout Europe.
throughout.zh: 疾病迅速在整个欧洲蔓延开来。

throughout.en: The house is in excellent condition, with fitted carpets throughout.
throughout.zh: 这幢房子状况极好，全部铺着地毯。

throw.en: He threw his shirt to someone in the crowd.
throw.zh: 他把他的衬衫扔给了人群中的一个人。

throw.en: Someone threw a stone at the car.
throw.zh: 有人朝汽车扔了一块石头。

thrust.en: She thrust a letter into my hand.
thrust.zh: 她把一封信往我手里一塞。

thrust.en: He thrust me roughly towards the door.
thrust.zh: 他粗暴地把我推到门口。

thumb.en: She held the coin carefully between finger and thumb.
thumb.zh: 她小心翼翼地把那枚硬币捏在食指和拇指之间。

thumb.en: Would you do up these buttons for me? I seem to be all thumbs today.
thumb.zh: 帮我扣上这些纽扣好吗？今天我感觉自己笨手笨脚的。

thunder.en: We were woken in the night by thunder.
She heard the thunder of hooves behind her.
thunder.zh: 她听到身后隆隆的马蹄声。

thunderous.en: His speech was greeted with thunderous applause.
thunderous.zh: 他的演讲赢得雷鸣般的掌声。

thursday.en: I went to Edinburgh on Thursday.
She was working Thursday. American English

thus.en: Most of the evidence was destroyed in the fire. Thus it would be almost impossible to prove him guilty.
thus.zh: 大多数证据已在大火中烧毁，因而要证明他有罪几乎是不可能的。

thus.en: They diluted the drug, thus reducing its effectiveness.
thus.zh: 他们把药稀释，这样就减轻了它的药效。

thwart.en: Fierce opposition thwarted the government’s plans.
thwart.zh: 激烈的反对阻碍了政府计划的实施。

tick.zh: 那只古老的钟大声地嘀嗒着。

tick.en: Tick the description that best fits you.
tick.zh: 给最符合你的描述打钩。

ticket.en: How much are tickets for the concert?
I’d like two tickets to Berlin.
ticket.zh: 我想买两张去柏林的票。

tickle.en: Mazie’s fur collar was tickling her neck.
tickle.zh: 马齐耶的毛领子扎得她脖子痒痒的。

tide.en: Is the tide going out or coming in?
We went for a walk and got cut off by the tide.
tide.zh: 我们去散步，结果被潮水困住了。

tidy.en: I try to keep the garden tidy.
Ellen’s room is always neat and tidy.
tidy.zh: 埃伦的房间总是非常整洁。

tie.en: Tie this label to your suitcase.
tie.zh: 把这个标签系在手提箱上。

tie.en: They tied him to a tree and beat him up.
tie.zh: 他们把他绑在树上狠狠地打。

tight.en: My shoes were so tight that I could hardly walk.
tight.zh: 鞋子很紧，我几乎不能走路。

tight.en: The jacket is rather a tight fit (=it fits too tightly).

tighten.en: I’d put the new tyre on, but I hadn’t tightened up the wheel.
tighten.zh: 我把新轮胎装上了，但没有上紧轮子。

till.en: I didn’t have a boyfriend till I was 17.
The shop’s open till nine o'clock on Fridays.

tilt.en: My mother tilted her head and smiled.
Ned’s mouth tilted upwards slightly at the corners.

time.en: Einstein changed the way we think about space and time.
time.zh: 爱因斯坦改变了我们的时空概念。

time.en: Customers have only a limited amount of time to examine the goods.
time.zh: 顾客只有有限的时间可以检查商品。

timely.en: The fight ended only with the timely arrival of the police.
timely.zh: 幸亏警察及时赶到，打斗总算停止。

timely.en: We aim to settle all valid claims in a timely manner.
timely.zh: 我们力求做到及时处理所有有效索赔。

timer.en: Set the timer on the cooker for three minutes.
timer.zh: 把炉子上的定时器设定为三分钟。

timescale.en: The timescale for completing the work would be fairly tight.
timescale.zh: 完成这项工作的时间很紧。

timetable.en: The Council has set out a timetable for returning to civilian rule.
timetable.zh: 委员会已制订出恢复文官统治的时间表。

timetable.en: The carnival parade is timetabled for 12.00 on both days.
timetable.zh: 狂欢节游行两天都定在12

timing.en: He was just walking into the restaurant when we got there. Perfect timing.
timing.zh: 我们到的时候他正好走进饭店，时间算得好准。

timing.en: He told jokes with an exquisite sense of timing.
timing.zh: 他讲笑话时很会把握时机。

tinge.en: There was a tinge of sadness in her voice.
tinge.zh: 她的声音里带着一丝哀愁。

tinge.en: This glass has a greenish tinge.
tinge.zh: 这块玻璃带点淡淡的绿色。

tingle.en: My body tingled all over and I had a terrible headache.
Graham felt a tingling sensation in his hand.
tingle.zh: 格雷厄姆感到手上一阵刺痛。

tinker.en: Congress has been tinkering with the legislation.
tinker.zh: 国会一直在对这项立法做些小修小补。

tinker.en: Dad was always tinkering around with engines.
tinker.zh: 爸爸总是在摆弄发动机。

tiny.en: She always felt a tiny bit sad.

tip.en: He kissed the tip of her nose.

tiptoe.en: She stood on tiptoe to kiss him.
His mother tiptoed into the room.
tiptoe.zh: 他母亲踮着脚走进了房间。

tire.en: As we neared the summit, we were tiring fast.
tire.zh: 接近山顶时，我们感到越来越累了。

tire.en: The climbers were starting to get tired.

tired.en: I’m so tired I could sleep for a week.
tired.zh: 我累得一觉能睡一个星期。

tired.en: He was too tired to argue.

tiring.en: We’ve all had a long tiring day.
tiring.zh: 我们大家都经历了漫长而劳累的一天。

title.en: The title of this play is ‘Othello’.
title.zh: 这部剧的剧名是《奥赛罗》。

toast.en: I had a piece of toast for breakfast.
I’d like to propose a toast (=ask people to drink a toast) to the bride and groom.
toast.zh: 我提议为新郎新娘干杯。

today.en: I couldn’t go shopping yesterday so I’ll have to go today.
today.zh: 我昨天没能去买东西，所以今天我必须去。

today.en: Ed has his music lesson today.

toddle.en: Every afternoon, Marge would toddle down to the library.
toddle.zh: 每天下午，玛吉都会溜达到图书馆。

toe.en: He stubbed his toe (=hurt it by kicking it against something) on a rock.
toe.zh: 他的脚趾踢到一块石头上受了伤。

toe.en: They do random checks to keep workers on their toes.
toe.zh: 他们进行随机抽查，让工人不懈怠。

toehold.en: The company has gained a toehold in the competitive computer market.
toehold.zh: 该公司在竞争激烈的电脑市场初步站稳了脚跟。

together.en: We’ve very much enjoyed working together.
together.zh: 我们在一起工作非常开心。

together.en: They’ve decided to spend more time together.
together.zh: 他们决定要花更多时间在一起。

toil.en: I’ve been toiling away at this essay all weekend.
toil.zh: 我整个周末都在埋头写这篇文章。

toil.en: They toiled slowly up the hill.
toil.zh: 他们吃力地慢慢爬上了山。

toilet.en: He flushed the toilet (=pulled the handle so that water ran into the toilet to clean it).
Mummy, I need to go to the toilet!

token.en: Please accept this gift as a small token of our appreciation.
token.zh: 区区薄礼，略表谢意，还请笑纳。

token.en: The government thinks it can get away with token gestures on environmental issues.
token.zh: 政府以为它在环境问题上做个样子就能敷衍过去。

tolerable.en: The apartment is really too small, but it’s tolerable for the time being.
tolerable.zh: 这套公寓实在太小，不过暂时还能凑合。

tolerable.en: The heat in this room is barely tolerable.
tolerable.zh: 这房间里热得让人要受不了了。

tolerance.en: Many old people have a very limited tolerance to cold.
tolerance.zh: 许多老年人御寒能力很差。

tolerant.en: Luckily, my parents were tolerant of my choice of music.
tolerant.zh: 幸运的是，我的父母对我选择听什么音乐持宽容态度。

tolerate.en: We simply will not tolerate vigilante groups on our streets.
tolerate.zh: 我们决不容许有自行惩办犯罪的组织出现在我们的街头。

tolerate.en: I couldn’t tolerate the long hours.
tolerate.zh: 我受不了这种长时间工作。

toll.en: The death toll has risen to 83.
The bombings took a heavy toll, killing hundreds of Londoners.
toll.zh: 轰炸造成严重伤亡，有几百名伦敦人丧生。

tomorrow.en: Our class is going to London tomorrow.
Terry’s new job starts a week tomorrow.
tomorrow.zh: 特里的新工作从明天算起一个星期后开始。

ton.en: I’ve got tons of work to do.

tonal.en: The tonal range she uses is wide and varied.
tonal.zh: 她使用的色调丰富多彩。

tone.en: There was urgency in his tone.
Her tone was sharp with anger.

tongue.en: Joe ran his tongue over his dry lips.
The taste of the chocolate was still on her tongue.
tongue.zh: 巧克力的余味依然留在她的舌尖。

tonic.en: She sat and sipped a gin and tonic.
tonic.zh: 她坐着，小口小口地喝着一杯加奎宁水的杜松子酒。

tonic.en: A lot of people need a tonic at the end of the winter.

tonight.en: I think I’ll go to bed early tonight.
tonight.zh: 我想今晚我会早点上床睡觉。

tonight.en: We’re meeting him at 9 o'clock tonight.

tonnage.en: A huge tonnage of bombs has already been dropped on the area.
tonnage.zh: 巨大吨数的炸弹已被投到该地区。

too.en: Do you think the music’s too loud?
You’ve put too much salt in the soup.

tool.en: I don’t have the right tools to start fiddling around with the engine.
tool.zh: 我没有合适的工具来摆弄发动机。

tool.en: Television is an important tool for the modern teacher.
tool.zh: 电视是现代教师重要的工具。

tooth.en: Sugar is bad for your teeth.
We need an Environment Agency that really has teeth.
tooth.zh: 我们需要一个强有力的环境保护机构。

toothache.en: I had terrible toothache all last night.
toothache.zh: 昨晚我一整夜牙疼得厉害。

top.en: The tops of the mountains were still covered with snow.
She could only just see over the tops of their heads.
top.zh: 她从他们的头顶上望过去，勉强才能看到。

topic.en: The environment is a popular topic these days.
topic.zh: 如今环境是一个热门话题。

topic.en: We shall return to the topic of education in Chapter 7.

topmost.en: The topmost branches were still bathed in sunlight.
topmost.zh: 树梢的枝丫仍然沐浴在阳光下。

topple.en: A stack of plates swayed, and began to topple over.
topple.zh: 一大摞盘子摇摇晃晃，接着就倒了下来。

topple.en: This scandal could topple the government.
topple.zh: 这一丑闻可能使政府倒台。

torch.en: We shone our torches around the cavern.
torch.zh: 我们用手电筒照着山洞。
暴徒纵火烧毁了几辆废弃的汽车。

torment.en: She lay awake all night in torment.
torment.zh: 她一晚上都醒着，在痛苦中煎熬。

torment.en: The journey must have been a torment for them.
torment.zh: 这次旅途对他们来说一定十分痛苦。

torpedo.en: New threats of violence have effectively torpedoed the peace talks.
torpedo.zh: 新的暴力威胁实际上已经破坏了和平谈判。

torpor.en: She tried to rouse him from the torpor into which he had sunk.
torpor.zh: 她试图把他从迷迷糊糊的状态中唤醒。

torrent.en: After five days of heavy rain the Telle river was a raging torrent (=a very violent torrent).
torrent.zh: 下了五天的大雨之后，泰勒河急流汹涌。

torrent.en: The rain came down in torrents.

torrid.en: He had a torrid time out there on the racetrack.
torrid.zh: 他在跑道上经历了一场苦战。

torture.en: He died after five days of excruciating torture.
torture.zh: 遭受了五天的严刑拷打之后，他死了。

torture.en: The waiting must be torture for you.
torture.zh: 这样的等待对你来说肯定是一种煎熬。

toss.en: She crumpled the letter and tossed it into the fire.
toss.zh: 她把信揉成一团，扔进了火里。

toss.en: Toss that book over, will you?

total.en: The sales campaign was a total disaster.
total.zh: 那次促销活动彻底搞砸了。

total.en: He looked at her with a total lack of comprehension.

totality.en: It’s essential that we look at the problem in its totality.
totality.zh: 最重要的是，我们应整体看待这个问题。

totally.en: It’s like learning a totally new language.
totally.zh: 这像是在学一门全新的语言。

touch.en: She reached out to touch his arm.
If your house has been burgled, you shouldn’t touch anything until the police arrive.
touch.zh: 如果家中被盗，在警察赶到之前不要动任何物品。

touchy.en: She is very touchy about her past.
touchy.zh: 她对她的过去十分敏感。

touchy.en: Asking about a reporter’s sources can be a touchy business.
touchy.zh: 询问一名记者的消息来源有时是个敏感问题。

tour.en: We met on a coach tour in Italy.
tour.zh: 我们是在意大利乘长途客车旅游时相识的。

tour.en: Kim worked as a tour guide in Cambridge last summer.
tour.zh: 金去年夏天在剑桥当导游。

tourism.en: The country depends on tourism for much of its income.
tourism.zh: 该国的大部分收入依靠旅游业。

tourist.en: Cambridge is always full of tourists in the summer.
tourist.zh: 剑桥在夏季总是挤满了游客。

tourist.en: The Statue of Liberty is a major tourist attraction.
tourist.zh: 自由女神像是主要的旅游景点。

tournament.en: I feel I can win this tournament.
tournament.zh: 我觉得我能打赢这次锦标赛。

tow.en: The ship had to be towed into the harbor.
tow.zh: 那艘轮船不得不被拖进港口。

tow.en: Our car had been towed away.

towards.en: He noticed two policemen coming towards him.
towards.zh: 他注意到两名警察正朝他走来。

towards.en: All the windows face toward the river.

towel.en: Have you got a clean towel I could use?
towel.zh: 你有没有干净毛巾给我用？

towel.en: She dried her hands on the kitchen towel.

tower.en: The bell tower was added to the church in 1848.
Her father was a tower of strength to her when her marriage broke up.
tower.zh: 在她婚姻破裂的时候，父亲是她的支柱。

town.en: I walked to the nearest town.
We’re going into town tonight to see a film.
town.zh: 我们今晚要去市中心看电影。

toxic.en: Toxic chemicals were spilled into the river.
toxic.zh: 有毒化学品流入了河里。

toxic.en: The metal has a relatively low toxicity to humans.
toxic.zh: 这种金属对人类毒性相对较低。

toy.en: Annie was playing happily with her toys.
toy.zh: 安妮正高兴地玩着玩具。

toy.en: The food mixer is her latest toy.
toy.zh: 这个食品搅拌器是她最近的“

trace.en: She had given up all hope of tracing her missing daughter.
trace.zh: 她已经完全放弃了寻找失踪女儿的希望。

trace.en: Police are trying to trace a young woman who was seen near the accident.
trace.zh: 警方在设法寻找被目击出现在事故现场附近的一名年轻女子。

track.en: The road leading to the farm was little more than a dirt track.
track.zh: 只有一条烂泥小路通往农场。

track.en: The track led through dense forest.

traction.en: He was in traction (=receiving this kind of treatment) for weeks after the accident.
traction.zh: 事故后他接受了几个星期的牵引治疗。

traction.en: The tires were bald (=completely worn) and lost traction on the wet road.
traction.zh: 轮胎已磨平，在这种湿的路面上没有了摩擦力。

trade.en: There has been a marked increase in trade between East and West.
trade.zh: 东西方贸易已有显著增长。

trade.en: Trade in ivory has been banned since 1990.

trademark.en: The striped T-shirt became the comedian’s trademark.

trader.en: To the surprise of many Wall Street traders, the dollar rose yesterday.
trader.zh: 使很多华尔街经纪人意外的是，昨天美元上涨了。

tradition.en: By tradition, it’s the bride’s parents who pay for the wedding.
tradition.zh: 根据传统习俗，婚礼的费用由新娘的父母承担。

tradition.en: His paintings are very much in the tradition of Picasso and Matisse.
tradition.zh: 他的绘画在很大程度上秉承了毕加索的传统。

traditional.en: It is traditional not to eat meat on Good Friday.
traditional.zh: 耶稣受难日当天不吃肉是一个传统。

traditional.en: He has a traditional view of women.
traditional.zh: 他对女性的看法很传统。

traffic.en: There wasn’t much traffic on the roads.
The sound of the traffic kept me awake.
traffic.zh: 车辆来往的嘈杂声令我无法入睡。

tragedy.en: The tragedy happened as they were returning home from a night out.
tragedy.zh: 悲剧发生在他们夜里外出归来的路上。

tragedy.en: Tragedy struck the family when their two-year-old son was killed in an accident.
tragedy.zh: 悲剧降临到这个家庭，他们两岁的儿子在一次事故中丧生。

tragic.en: The parents were not to blame for the tragic death of their son.
tragic.zh: 儿子的惨死不是他父母的错。

tragic.en: Lillian Board’s death at 22 was a tragic loss for British athletics.

tragically.en: She was tragically killed in a car accident.
tragically.zh: 她在一场交通事故中不幸丧生。

tragically.en: Tragically, her dancing career ended only six months later.
tragically.zh: 很不幸，她的舞蹈生涯仅六个月后就结束了。

trail.en: A plane trailing a banner was circling overhead.
trail.zh: 一架飞机拖着横幅标语在上空盘旋。

trail.en: She walked slowly along the path, her skirt trailing in the mud.
trail.zh: 她沿着小径缓步行走，裙子拖在泥里。

train.en: We went all the way to Inverness by train.
train.zh: 我们一路坐火车到因弗内斯。

train.en: The decision set off a train of events which led to his resignation.
train.zh: 这一决定引发了一连串事件，最终导致了他的辞职。

training.en: On the course we received training in every aspect of the job.
training.zh: 在课程中我们接受了全面的岗位培训。

training.en: Police drivers have to undergo intensive training.
training.zh: 警察驾驶员都得接受强化训练。

tramp.en: He tramped the streets looking for work.
tramp.zh: 他在街上四处奔走，寻找工作。

tramp.en: The walk involved tramping through mud.
tramp.zh: 走这段路要在泥地中跋涉。

trample.en: There was a small fence to stop people trampling on the flowers.
trample.zh: 有一道小小的围栏，防止人们践踏花草。

trample.en: The children were in danger of being trampled underfoot in the crowd.
trample.zh: 孩子们在人群里有被踩踏的危险。

trance.en: She went into a deep hypnotic trance.
trance.zh: 她陷入了催眠后的恍惚状态。

trance.en: What’s the matter with you? You’ve been in a trance all day.
trance.zh: 你怎么啦？一整天都恍恍惚惚的。

transact.en: Most deals are transacted over the phone.
transact.zh: 大多数生意都是在电话里成交的。

transaction.en: The bank charges a fixed rate for each transaction.
transaction.zh: 银行对每一笔业务收取固定费用。

transcend.en: The desire for peace transcended political differences.
transcend.zh: 对和平的渴望超越了政治分歧。

transcript.en: A transcript of the tapes was presented in court.
transcript.zh: 在法庭上出示了这些磁带的转录本。

transfer.en: Swod transferred from MI6 to the Security Service.
transfer.zh: 斯沃德从军情六处调到了安全局。

transfer.en: They’re transferring him to a special unit at Great Ormond Street Hospital.
transfer.zh: 他们要把他转到大奥蒙德街医院的一个特殊病区去。

transform.en: Increased population has transformed the landscape.
transform.zh: 人口的增加使景观发生了变化。

transform.en: The movie transformed her almost overnight from an unknown schoolgirl into a megastar.
transform.zh: 这部电影几乎在一夜之间将她从一个默默无闻的女学生变成一位超级巨星。

transformation.en: In recent years, the movie industry has undergone a dramatic transformation.
transformation.zh: 近些年，电影业经历了巨大的变革。

transformation.en: What leads to the transformation of one economic system to another?
transformation.zh: 是什么导致一种经济体制转变为另一种经济体制？

transgress.en: Orton’s plays transgress accepted social norms.
transgress.zh: 奥顿的戏剧违背了公认的社会准则。

transition.en: Making the transition from youth to adulthood can be very painful.
transition.zh: 从青少年过渡到成年有时是一个非常痛苦的过程。

transition.en: He will transition to his new role next month.
transition.zh: 下个月他将转换成新角色。

translate.en: Translate the text from Italian into English.
translate.zh: 把这篇文章从意大利语翻译成英语。

translation.en: She read the letter and gave us a rough translation (=she did not translate everything exactly).
translation.zh: 她看了信，给我们大概翻译了一下。

translation.en: I’ve only read ‘Madame Bovary’ in translation (=not in its original language).
translation.zh: 我只读过《包法利夫人》的翻译本。

translucent.en: Blue veins showed through her translucent skin.
translucent.zh: 她半透明的皮肤下青筋显现。

transmit.en: The US Open will be transmitted live via satellite.
transmit.zh: 美国公开赛将通过卫星现场直播。

transmit.en: The system transmits information over digital phone lines.
transmit.zh: 这一系统通过数字电话线路传输信息。

transmitter.en: What is the main transmitter of the virus?
transmitter.zh: 这种病毒的主要传播媒介是什么？

transparent.en: The way the system works will be transparent to the user.
transparent.zh: 这个系统的运行方式对使用者来说清楚易懂。

transport.en: Improved rail transport is essential for business.
transport.zh: 铁路运输的改善对商业发展极其重要。

transport.en: It’s easier to get to the college if you have your own transport (=a car, bicycle etc).
transport.zh: 如果你有自己的交通工具，去学院就会更方便。

transportation.en: The city needs to improve its public transportation (=buses, trains etc).
transportation.zh: 这座城市需要改善公共交通。

transportation.en: People need to get out of their cars and use other modes of transportation.
transportation.zh: 人们应该走出自己的汽车，使用其他的交通方式。

trap.en: The only way to catch mice is to set a trap.
trap.zh: 抓老鼠的唯一办法就是放置捕鼠器。

trap.en: He stepped into a bear trap covered in snow.
trap.zh: 他踩到了埋在雪里的一个捕熊夹。

trash.en: Will someone take out the trash (=take it outside the house)?
Just put it in the trash.
trash.zh: 就把它扔到垃圾桶里吧。

travel.en: Someday I’d like to travel abroad.
We’re planning to travel across America this summer.
travel.zh: 我们计划今年夏天横穿美国旅行。

tray.en: The waiter brought drinks on a tray.
tray.zh: 服务员用托盘端来饮料。

tread.en: Sorry, did I tread on your foot?
tread.zh: 对不起，我踩到你的脚了吗？

tread.en: She trod barefoot on the soft grass.
tread.zh: 她光脚踩在柔软的草地上。

treason.en: Richter is accused of committing treason against the state.
treason.zh: 里克特被控犯有叛国罪。

treason.en: The defendant was convicted of high treason (=treason of the worst kind) and sentenced to death.
treason.zh: 被告被判犯有严重叛国罪，并处以死刑。

treasure.en: The Book of Kells is Trinity College’s greatest treasure.
treasure.zh: 《凯尔经》是三一学院的镇院之宝。

treasure.en: Our housekeeper is a real treasure.
treasure.zh: 我们的管家真是一个宝。

treat.en: She treats me like one of the family.
Penny doesn’t think her co-workers treat her as an equal.
treat.zh: 彭妮认为她的同事没有平等地对待她。

treatment.en: There have been great advances in the treatment of cancer.
treatment.zh: 癌症治疗有了很大的进展。

treatment.en: The best treatment for a cold is to rest and drink lots of fluids.
treatment.zh: 治疗感冒的最佳方法是休息和多喝水。

treaty.en: Both sides have agreed to sign the treaty.
treaty.zh: 双方都同意签署该条约。

treaty.en: The peace treaty ends nearly four years of violence.
treaty.zh: 该和平条约结束了将近四年的暴力。

treble.en: They sold the house for treble the amount they paid for it.
treble.zh: 他们以买进时三倍的价格卖掉了房子。

treble.en: Their profits have trebled in the last two years.
treble.zh: 他们的利润在最近两年里达到了之前的三倍。

tree.en: As a kid, I loved to climb trees.
We planted a peach tree in the backyard.
tree.zh: 我们在后院种了一棵桃树。

trek.en: I’m afraid it’s a bit of a trek to the station.
The elevator was broken, so we had to trek up six flights of stairs.
trek.zh: 电梯坏了，所以我们只好爬了六层楼梯。

tremble.en: His lip started to tremble and then he started to cry.
tremble.zh: 他的嘴唇开始颤抖，接着就哭了起来。

tremble.en: Greene was on his feet now, his body trembling with rage.
tremble.zh: 格林这会儿站了起来，气得全身直哆嗦。

tremendous.en: Suddenly, there was a tremendous bang, and the whole station shook.
tremendous.zh: 突然一声巨响，整个车站都晃动了。

tremendous.en: She was making a tremendous effort to appear calm.
tremendous.zh: 她竭力表现出平静的样子。

trench.en: Workers dug a trench for gas lines.
trench.zh: 工人们挖了一条沟来铺设煤气管道。

trench.en: Lane left teaching after 30 years in the trenches.

trend.en: Lately there has been a trend towards hiring younger, cheaper employees.
trend.zh: 近来的趋势是雇用较年轻、薪酬较低的雇员。

trend.en: The current trend is towards more part-time employment.
trend.zh: 当前的趋势是雇用更多的兼职人员。

trespass.en: She was arrested for trespassing on government property.
trespass.zh: 她因擅闯政府属地而被逮捕。

trespass.en: It would be trespassing on their hospitality to accept any more from them.
trespass.zh: 再接受他们的给予就是滥用他们的好意了。

trial.en: The trial is due to start next week.
Brady was on trial for assault.
trial.zh: 布拉迪因侵犯他人而受审。

tribe.en: We were only expecting Jack and his wife, but the whole tribe turned up.
tribe.zh: 我们以为只是杰克和他的妻子会来，但结果他们一大家子都来了。

tribute.en: The players wore black armbands as a tribute to their late teammate.
tribute.zh: 球员们戴着黑纱悼念已故的队友。

tribute.en: I’d like to pay tribute to (=praise and admire publicly) the party workers for all their hard work.
tribute.zh: 我谨向党内工作人员致敬，感谢他们的辛苦努力。

trick.en: Pretending he doesn’t remember is an old trick of his.
trick.zh: 假装不记得是他的老花招了。

trick.en: He didn’t really lose his wallet – that’s just a trick.
trick.zh: 他并没有真的丢了钱包——

trickle.en: The tears trickled down her cheeks.
trickle.zh: 泪水顺着她的面颊流了下来。

trickle.en: The first few fans started to trickle into the stadium.

tricky.en: I can get you tickets for the show but it’ll be tricky.
tricky.zh: 我能给你弄到演出的票，但会很费事。

trifle.en: There’s no point in arguing over trifles.
He’s not a man to be trifled with.

trigger.en: The assassination triggered off a wave of rioting.
trigger.zh: 这次暗杀事件引发了一阵骚乱。

trigger.en: Certain forms of mental illness can be triggered by food allergies.
trigger.zh: 某些精神疾病可能由食物过敏引发。

trillion.en: In a short time the number of cells is more than a trillion.
trillion.zh: 不久细胞的数量就超过了一万亿。

trillion.en: Japan’s exports were worth $43 trillion last year.
trillion.zh: 去年日本的出口商品价值43

trim.en: Pete was trimming the lawn around the roses.
trim.zh: 皮特在修剪玫瑰丛周围的草坪。

trim.en: I have my hair trimmed every six weeks.

trip.en: Did you enjoy your trip to Disneyland?
trip.zh: 你去迪士尼乐园玩得开心吗？

trip.en: The Palace is only a short trip from here.
trip.zh: 皇宫离这里只有很短的路程。

triple.en: The rail system has triple the average number of accidents.
triple.zh: 铁路系统事故是事故平均数量的三倍。

triple.en: The company has tripled in size.
triple.zh: 这家公司的规模已扩大了两倍。

triplicate.en: Is it really necessary to complete the forms in triplicate?
triplicate.zh: 这些表格真有必要一式三份填写吗？

trite.en: Her remarks sounded trite and ill-informed.
trite.zh: 她的话听起来没有新意，信息匮乏。

triumph.en: In the end, good shall triumph over evil.
Winning the championship is a great personal triumph.
triumph.zh: 赢得冠军是伟大的个人成就。

triumphant.en: I feel exhausted, but also triumphant.
triumphant.zh: 我感到很疲倦，但也很得意。

triumphant.en: The Nationalists emerged triumphant from the political crisis.
triumphant.zh: 民族主义政党成功地渡过政治危机。

trivial.en: We were punished for the most trivial offences.
trivial.zh: 我们稍有过错就会受到惩罚。

trivial.en: Her feelings for Simon seemed trivial by comparison.
trivial.zh: 相比之下，她对西蒙的感情就显得微不足道了。

troop.en: Both countries agreed to withdraw their troops.
Johnson took the popular step of sending in American troops.
troop.zh: 约翰逊采取了通常的做法，即派遣美国军队。

trophy.en: A lion’s head was among the trophies of his African trip.
trophy.zh: 他非洲之行的战利品之一是个狮头。

trot.en: She came trotting down the steps from the library.
trot.zh: 她从图书馆出来，小跑着下台阶。

trot.en: He trotted off and came back a couple of minutes later, holding a parcel.
trot.zh: 他跑掉了，几分钟以后又拿着一个包裹回来了。

trouble.en: We’re having a lot of trouble with the new computer system.
trouble.zh: 我们新的电脑系统有许多问题。

trouble.en: Recent stock market losses point to trouble ahead.
trouble.zh: 最近股市的下跌预示着未来将有麻烦。

trousers.en: His trousers were slightly too short.
I need a new pair of trousers for work.
trousers.zh: 我需要一条上班穿的新裤子。

truant.en: Nick was truant seven days this month.

truce.en: They agreed to call a truce.
There was an uneasy truce between Alex and Dave over dinner.
truce.zh: 晚饭时，亚历克斯和戴夫暂时休战。

truck.en: His car was taken away on the back of a breakdown truck.
truck.zh: 他的车被装在牵引车后面运走了。

truck.en: They ordered sand to be trucked in from the desert.
truck.zh: 他们命人从沙漠运来沙子。

true.en: It’s not true that I’m going to marry him.
true.zh: 说我要嫁给他，这不是真的。

true.en: No, honestly, it’s a true story.
true.zh: 不，真的，这是一个真实的故事。

truly.zh: 他的作品确实十分独特。

truly.en: Fawcett was a truly remarkable man.
truly.zh: 福西特是一位真正不同凡响的人。

trumpet.en: They are proudly trumpeting the fact that they are creating more jobs.
trumpet.zh: 他们得意地宣扬他们是在创造更多的工作岗位。

trunk.en: He left his bicycle leaning against a tree trunk.
trunk.zh: 他把他的自行车斜靠在树干上。

trunk.en: Put your suitcase in the trunk.
trunk.zh: 把你的手提箱放在后备箱里。

trust.en: At first there was a lack of trust between them.
trust.zh: 起初，他们之间缺乏信任。

trust.en: You shouldn’t put your trust in a man like that.
trust.zh: 你不应该相信那样的男人。

truth.en: How do we know you’re telling us the truth?
truth.zh: 我们怎么知道你告诉我们的是真话？

truth.en: She hoped to find out the truth about her family.

truthful.en: You and I must be truthful with each other.
truthful.zh: 我们俩一定要坦诚相待。

truthful.en: I have only one question to ask you, and I want a truthful answer.
truthful.zh: 我只有一个问题要问你，希望你如实回答。

try.en: Let’s have a rest and then we’ll try again.
try.zh: 我们休息一下，然后再试。

try.en: He tried to control his voice.
try.zh: 他尽量控制自己的声音。

trying.en: The beginning of the show is often a trying time because of latecomers.
trying.zh: 演出刚开始常常是最难熬的时期，因为总会有人迟到。

tub.en: We ate a tub of ice cream.
I had a long soak in the tub.

tube.en: It’s best to travel by tube.

tuck.zh: 杰克把衬衫掖进裤腰里。

tuck.en: She tucked an unruly lock of hair behind her ear.
tuck.zh: 她把一缕不听话的头发撩到耳后。

tuesday.en: I’ll see you Tuesday. American English

tug.en: The woman gently tugged his arm.
tug.zh: 那女人轻轻拽了拽他的胳膊。

tug.en: Joe was tugging at her sleeve.

tuition.en: I had to have extra tuition in maths.
tuition.zh: 我不得不上数学补习课。

tuition.en: When I started college, tuition was $350 a quarter.
tuition.zh: 我开始念大学的时候，学费是每学季350

tumble.en: She lost her balance and tumbled backwards.
tumble.zh: 她失去了平衡，身体朝后倒去。

tumble.en: A few stones came tumbling down the cliff.
tumble.zh: 几块石头从悬崖上滚落下来。

tumult.en: I could simply not be heard in the tumult.
tumult.zh: 一片嘈杂声中别人根本听不到我说话。

tumult.en: The whole country is in tumult.

tune.en: She sang some old classics and a few new tunes.
tune.zh: 她唱了几首经典老歌和一些新曲。

turbulence.en: A period of political turbulence followed the civil war.
turbulence.zh: 内战结束之后紧接着的是一段政治动荡时期。

turbulent.en: He has had a turbulent political career.
turbulent.zh: 他的政治生涯动荡不定。

turf.en: How vigorously will the local companies defend their turf?
turf.zh: 当地公司会以怎样的力度保卫他们的地盘？

turf.en: We beat Canada on their home turf.
turf.zh: 我们在加拿大队的主场将其打败。

turmoil.en: Ashley gazed at him, her thoughts in turmoil.
turmoil.zh: 阿什利注视着他，思绪起伏。

turn.en: She turned her head in surprise.

turning.en: He must have taken a wrong turning in the dark.
turning.zh: 他准是在黑暗中拐错弯了。

turning.en: Take the first turning on the left.
turning.zh: 到第一个拐弯处就向左拐。

turnover.en: The illicit drugs industry has an annual turnover of some £200 billion.

turnover.zh: 三星公司快速的库存周转

tutelage.en: You can attend embroidery classes under the tutelage of Jocelyn James.

tutor.en: The children were educated at home by a succession of tutors.
tutor.zh: 这些孩子在家接受教育，连续请过几任家庭教师。

tutor.en: She was my tutor at Durham.
tutor.zh: 她是我在达勒姆大学时的导师。

tv.en: I watched the film on TV.
tv.zh: 这部电影我是在电视上看的。

tv.en: He’s the top TV presenter for children’s programmes.
tv.zh: 他是最优秀的儿童电视节目主持人。

tweezers.en: She was plucking her eyebrows with a pair of tweezers.
tweezers.zh: 她正拿着一把小镊子在拔眉毛。

twelve.en: He received a twelve-month jail sentence.

twenty.en: In the twenties the business expanded.

twice.en: He was questioned by police twice yesterday.
twice.zh: 他昨天被警察审问了两次。

twice.en: Letters were delivered twice a week only.

twig.en: It took ages before he twigged.
twig.zh: 过了好长时间他才突然明白过来。

twilight.en: The end of the cigarette glowed in the twilight.
twilight.zh: 烟头在暮色中发着幽幽的红光。

twilight.en: Depression in the twilight years (=the last years of your life) is usually related to illness.
twilight.zh: 晚年的精神抑郁通常与疾病有关。

twin.en: The twins are now eight months old.
twin.zh: 这对双胞胎现在已经八个月大了。

twine.en: She twined her arms round him and kissed his cheek.
twine.zh: 她两手环抱着他，亲吻他的脸颊。

twine.en: A dark green ivy plant twined around the pole.
twine.zh: 一株深绿色的常春藤缠绕着柱子。

twinkle.en: I saw lights twinkling in the little town below us.
twinkle.zh: 我看到我们下面的小镇灯火闪烁。
她的双眼闪耀着愉悦的光芒。

twist.en: He twisted his head slightly, and looked up at her.
twist.zh: 他微微扭过头，抬眼看着她。

twist.en: She twisted round, so that she could see the dog better.
twist.zh: 她转过身子，以便更清楚地看到那条狗。

two.en: I’ll be away for almost two weeks.
two.zh: 我要离开差不多两周时间。

two.en: We have to be there by two (=two o'clock).
two.zh: 我们得在两点之前到那里。

type.en: I’ve already seen a few movies of this type.
type.zh: 我已经看过几部这种类型的影片了。

type.en: What type of music do you like?
type.zh: 你喜欢什么类型的音乐？

typical.en: This painting is typical of his work.
typical.zh: 这幅画是他的典型作品。

typical.en: This advertisement is a typical example of their marketing strategy.
typical.zh: 这则广告是他们营销策略的一个典型例子。

tyranny.en: Gorky was often the victim of his grandfather’s tyranny.
tyranny.zh: 高尔基经常是他祖父专横管制的受害者。

tyrant.en: The country had long been ruled by tyrants.
tyrant.zh: 这个国家长期受暴君统治。

tyrant.en: My headmaster was a real tyrant.

tyre.en: I had a flat tyre (=all the air went out of it) on the way home.
tyre.zh: 回家的路上我的轮胎瘪了。

tyre.en: The spare tyre's in the boot.

ubiquitous.en: Coffee shops are ubiquitous these days.
ubiquitous.zh: 如今好像到处都是咖啡馆。

ugly.en: Nick’s dog is as ugly as sin (=very ugly).
There were ugly scenes as rival gangs started attacking each other.
ugly.zh: 敌对帮派之间开始相互攻击，出现了很可怕的场面。

ultimate.en: Complete disarmament was the ultimate goal of the conference.
ultimate.zh: 全面裁军是这次会议的最终目标。

ultimate.en: Our ultimate objective is to have as many female members of parliament as there are male.
ultimate.zh: 我们的最终目标是要让女性议员人数和男性议员一样多。

ultimately.en: Ultimately, the decision rests with the child’s parents.
ultimately.zh: 最终，决定权在这孩子的父母手中。

ultimatum.en: The club gave him an ultimatum - either he apologized, or he would be expelled from the team.
ultimatum.zh: 俱乐部给他下了最后通牒——

ultimatum.en: The army issued an ultimatum for all weapons in the city to be surrendered by October 26th.
ultimatum.zh: 军队发出最后通牒，必须于 10

umbrella.en: It started to rain, so Tricia stopped to put up her umbrella.
umbrella.zh: 开始下雨了，所以特里西娅停下来撑起雨伞。

umbrella.en: I spent the day on the beach, lying under a beach umbrella, reading.
umbrella.zh: 那天我就在海滩上度过，躺在海滩遮阳伞下面看书。

unable.en: Lucy was unable to find out what had happened.
unable.zh: 露西无法知道发生了什么事。

unable.en: Unable to sleep, I got up and made myself a drink.
unable.zh: 我睡不着，于是起来给自己倒了杯酒。

unacceptable.en: I found her attitude totally unacceptable.
unacceptable.zh: 我觉得她的态度让人完全不能接受。

unacceptable.en: The recommendations from this report are unacceptable to many black people.
unacceptable.zh: 这份报告中提出的建议让很多黑人无法接受。

unadorned.en: They liked their churches to be unadorned.
unadorned.zh: 他们希望他们的教堂朴素无华。

unaided.en: She can no longer walk unaided.
unaided.zh: 她再也不能独力行走了。

unanimous.en: It was decided by a unanimous vote that the school should close.
unanimous.zh: 关闭学校是大家一致通过的决定。

unanimous.en: The decision to appoint Matt was almost unanimous.
unanimous.zh: 任命马特的决定几乎是一致通过的。

unanswered.zh: 还有许多其他问题没有得到解答。

unanswered.en: The children’s cries for help went unanswered.
unanswered.zh: 孩子们的呼救没有得到回应。

unavailable.en: Funding for the new school is unavailable.
Officials were unavailable for comment (=not able or willing to talk to reporters).
unavailable.zh: 官员们未能接受访问作出评论。

unavoidable.en: There are now fears that war is unavoidable.
unavoidable.zh: 人们现在担心战争不可避免。

unaware.en: Mike seems unaware of the trouble he’s causing.
unaware.zh: 迈克似乎没意识到他所惹的麻烦。

unaware.en: She was totally unaware that she was being watched.
unaware.zh: 她完全没有察觉到自己正在被监视。

unbalance.en: Having children can often unbalance even the closest of relationships.
unbalance.zh: 有了孩子，即使最亲密的关系也常常会失衡。

unbalance.en: He banged against the cupboard, unbalancing a pile a books.
unbalance.zh: 他砰的一声撞到橱柜上，撞翻了一堆书。

unbearable.en: He was making life unbearable for his parents.
unbearable.zh: 他把父母的生活弄得不堪忍受。

unbelievable.zh: 机会好得令人难以相信。

unbiased.en: We aim to provide a service that is balanced and unbiased.
unbiased.zh: 我们的目标是提供一种公平公正的服务。

uncertain.en: He was uncertain how much further he could walk.
uncertain.zh: 他不清楚自己还能走多远。

uncertain.en: I was uncertain about what to do next.
uncertain.zh: 我拿不定主意接下来要做什么。

uncertainty.en: Times of great change are also times of uncertainty.
uncertainty.zh: 发生巨大变革的时期也是动荡的时期。

uncertainty.en: There is a great deal of uncertainty about the company’s future.
uncertainty.zh: 公司的前景有很多未知因素。

uncharted.en: This new project will take us into uncharted territory.
uncharted.zh: 这个新项目将把我们带入未知的领域。

uncle.en: I went to stay with my uncle and aunt for a few days.
uncle.zh: 我去和叔叔婶婶住了几天。

uncle.en: I was very excited about becoming an uncle (=your sister or your brother’s wife has a child).

unclear.en: The terms of the contract are very unclear.
I’m rather unclear about what I’m supposed to be doing here.
unclear.zh: 我不太明白我在这儿该做些什么。

uncomfortable.en: She always felt slightly uncomfortable in a hat.
uncomfortable.zh: 她戴帽子总是觉得有点不自在。

uncommon.en: Violent crimes against the elderly are fortunately very uncommon.
uncommon.zh: 幸好针对老年人的暴力犯罪非常罕见。

uncommon.en: It is not uncommon for students to have bank loans.
uncommon.zh: 学生有银行贷款并不少见。

unconscious.en: She was found alive but unconscious.
unconscious.zh: 她被找到时还活着，但已不省人事。

unconscious.en: Levin was knocked unconscious by the impact.
unconscious.zh: 莱文被那记猛击打昏了。

uncontested.en: After an uncontested divorce, Peggy married Charlie.
uncontested.zh: 和平离婚之后，佩姬嫁给了查利。

uncooked.en: Always wash your hands after handling uncooked meat.
uncooked.zh: 碰过生肉后一定要洗手。

uncover.en: Customs officials uncovered a plot to smuggle weapons into the country.
uncover.zh: 海关官员侦破了一个走私武器入境的阴谋。

uncritical.en: John’s mother is totally uncritical of his behaviour.
uncritical.zh: 约翰的母亲对他的行为完全不加批评。

undecided.en: I’m still undecided about how I’ll vote.
undecided.zh: 我还没有决定如何投票。

undecided.en: Nadine was undecided whether or not to go to college.
undecided.zh: 娜丁尚未决定是否去上大学。

under.en: Wendy had hidden the box under her bed.
under.zh: 温迪把盒子藏在了自己的床底下。

under.en: We sailed under the Golden Gate Bridge.
under.zh: 我们在金门大桥下航行。

undercharge.en: The city is grossly undercharging (=charging far too little) companies to use the land.
undercharge.zh: 那座城市对公司用地收取很少的费用。

underestimate.en: We underestimated how long it would take to get there.
underestimate.zh: 我们低估了到那里所需的时间。

underestimate.en: Never underestimate the power of the press.
underestimate.zh: 绝不要低估新闻界的力量。

underfoot.en: The wet wood is very slippery underfoot.

undergo.en: The country has undergone massive changes recently.
undergo.zh: 这个国家最近经历了巨大的变化。

undergo.en: He has been released from prison to undergo medical treatment in the United States.
undergo.zh: 他获释出狱去美国接受治疗。

underground.en: This animal spends most of its life underground.
underground.zh: 这种动物一生中的大部分时间都待在地下。

underline.en: This tragic incident underlines the need for immediate action.
underline.zh: 这一悲剧事件突显了立即采取行动的必要性。

underlying.en: There is an underlying assumption that younger workers are easier to train.
underlying.zh: 有一种潜在的假设，认为年轻一些的雇员容易培训。

undermine.en: The constant criticism was beginning to undermine her confidence.
undermine.zh: 不断的批评开始削弱她的信心了。

underneath.en: He got out of the car and looked underneath.
It’s near where the railway goes underneath the road.
underneath.zh: 它靠近铁路从公路下方穿过的地方。

understand.en: I’m sorry, I don’t understand. Can you explain that again?
understand.zh: 对不起，我不明白。你能再解释一遍吗？

understandable.en: It is understandable that parents are angry, and looking for someone to blame.
understandable.zh: 父母生气了想找个人出气，这是可以理解的。

understandable.en: He just can’t face anyone at the moment, which is perfectly understandable.
understandable.zh: 他现在就是无法面对任何人，这完全可以理解。

understanding.en: How does this add to our understanding of the problem?
understanding.zh: 这对我们理解这个问题有何益处？

understanding.en: If you know the neighbourhood, you have an understanding of what the children are like.
understanding.zh: 假如你熟悉这个街区，你就会知道这里的孩子是什么样子的了。

understate.en: The press have tended to understate the extent of the problem.
understate.zh: 媒体想淡化问题的严重程度。

undertake.en: Dr Johnson undertook the task of writing a comprehensive English dictionary.
undertake.zh: 约翰逊博士担负起编写一本综合性英语词典的工作。

undertake.en: He undertook to pay the money back in six months.
undertake.zh: 他保证在六个月之内还钱。

undertaking.en: Starting a new business can be a risky undertaking.
undertaking.zh: 创办新企业有时是一件有风险的事情。

undertaking.en: Both organizations gave an undertaking to curb violence among their members.
undertaking.zh: 两个组织都作出承诺要约束其成员的暴力行为。

underwater.en: He dived underwater and swam away.

underwear.en: You just need to take a change of underwear.
underwear.zh: 你只需带一套换洗的内衣。

underwrite.en: The government has agreed to underwrite the project with a grant of £5 million.

undesirable.en: The drug may have other undesirable effects.
undesirable.zh: 这种药可能会有其他负作用。

undifferentiated.en: Colonial officials tended to see Indian society as an undifferentiated whole.
undifferentiated.zh: 殖民地官员往往把印度社会看成一个统一整体。

undisputed.en: Doctors found undisputed evidence of nerve damage.
undisputed.zh: 医生发现了神经受损的确凿证据。

undisturbed.en: At last I was able to work undisturbed.
undisturbed.zh: 我终于可以安安静静地工作了。

undisturbed.en: The land is to be left undisturbed as a nature reserve.
undisturbed.zh: 这块土地将作为自然保护区原封不动地保留下来。

undo.en: The screws can be undone by hand.
undo.zh: 这些螺丝可以用手拧开。

undue.en: De Gaulle felt that America had undue influence in Europe.
undue.zh: 戴高乐感到美国在欧洲影响力过大。

undue.en: Exercise gently and avoid putting yourself under undue strain.
undue.zh: 做些和缓的运动，不要让身体负荷过多。

unduly.en: She doesn’t seem unduly concerned about her exams.
unduly.zh: 她似乎对考试并未过分担忧。
这事并没有让我太烦恼。

unearth.en: Farmers still sometimes unearth human bones here.
unearth.zh: 农民们有时仍然能在这里挖到人骨。

unearth.en: In one shop, I unearthed a wonderful collection of 1920s toys.
unearth.zh: 在一家商店，我发现了一套非常好玩的 20

uneasy.en: Ninety percent of those questioned felt uneasy about nuclear power.
The treaty restored an uneasy peace to the country.
uneasy.zh: 这个条约让该国恢复了暂时的和平。

unemployed.en: I’ve only been unemployed for a few weeks.
Fifty percent of the men in this town are unemployed.

unemployment.en: Closure of the plant means 80 workers are facing unemployment.
unemployment.zh: 这家工厂的关闭意味着 80

unemployment.en: He’s been on unemployment for two months.
unemployment.zh: 他已经领了两个月的失业救济金。

uneven.en: She walked back carefully over the uneven ground.
uneven.zh: 她小心翼翼地从凹凸不平的地面上走回来。

unexpected.en: The experiment produced some unexpected results.
unexpected.zh: 这次试验产生了一些意想不到的结果。

unexplored.en: The study looks at a relatively unexplored area of human relationships.
unexplored.zh: 这项研究考察人类关系中较少探讨的领域。

unfair.en: Many employers have recognized that age discrimination is unfair.
unfair.zh: 许多雇主已经认识到年龄歧视是不公平的。

unfair.en: She won £20,000 for unfair dismissal (=being illegally made to leave your job).
unfair.zh: 她因被不公平解雇而得到两万英镑的赔偿。

unfamiliar.en: She stood on deck to gaze at the unfamiliar surroundings.
unfamiliar.zh: 她站在甲板上凝视着四下陌生的一切。

unfamiliar.en: Some of the technical vocabulary may be unfamiliar to you.
unfamiliar.zh: 有些专业词汇你可能不熟悉。

unfit.en: She never gets any exercise – she must be really unfit.
Jenkins is unfit for public office.
unfit.zh: 詹金斯不适合担任公职。

unfocused.zh: 讨论的焦点越来越分散。

unfocused.en: He gave her an unfocused look.

unfold.en: As the story unfolds, we learn more about Max’s childhood.
unfold.zh: 随着故事的展开，我们对马克斯的童年有了更多的了解。

unfold.en: He had watched the drama unfold from a nearby ship.
unfold.zh: 他从附近的一艘船上目睹了这一戏剧性事件的发生。

unforeseen.en: Due to unforeseen circumstances, the play has been cancelled.
unforeseen.zh: 由于突发情况，比赛被取消。

unfortunate.en: When we entered the room, the teacher was yelling at some unfortunate student.
unfortunate.zh: 我们进教室的时候，老师正在对着一个倒霉的学生吼叫。

unfortunate.en: He has an unfortunate habit of repeating himself.
unfortunate.zh: 他有一个讨厌的习惯，总是重复自己说过的话。

unfortunately.en: Unfortunately, you were out when we called.
unfortunately.zh: 很遗憾，我们来的时候你出去了。

unhappy.en: If you’re so unhappy, why don’t you change jobs?
unhappy.zh: 你要是那么不开心，为什么不换个工作呢？

uniform.en: He was still wearing his school uniform.
He was on duty and in uniform.

uniformity.en: There seems to be no uniformity among the various systems.
uniformity.zh: 各系统之间似乎没有统一性。

unify.en: Strong support for the war has unified the nation.
unify.zh: 对战争的坚决支持使这个国家团结了起来。

unify.en: His music unifies traditional and modern themes.
unify.zh: 他的音乐结合了传统和现代的主题。

unimportant.en: Girls' education was seen as unimportant.

uninhabitable.en: Much of the country is uninhabitable because it is desert.
uninhabitable.zh: 由于地处沙漠，这个国家的许多地区不适宜居住。

uninhabitable.en: Many houses were so badly damaged in the war that they were made permanently uninhabitable.
uninhabitable.zh: 很多房屋在战争中严重受损，再也不能居住了。

union.en: Are you planning to join the union?
The artist’s work shows the perfect union of craftsmanship and imagination.
union.zh: 这位艺术家的作品体现了工艺和想象力的完美结合。

unique.en: This is a unique opportunity to study these rare creatures.
unique.zh: 研究这些珍稀动物的难得机会
每个人的指纹都是独一无二的。

unit.en: The man is in the hospital’s intensive care unit.
unit.zh: 那名男子在医院的重症监护室。

unit.en: The watt is a unit of electrical power.

unite.en: Our goal is to unite the opposition parties and defeat the president.
unite.zh: 我们的目标是联合各反对党挫败总统。

unite.en: Party members united behind their leader.
unite.zh: 党员们联合起来支持他们的领袖。

united.en: The two countries were united against a common enemy.
united.zh: 这两个国家联合起来对付共同的敌人。

unity.zh: 他的文章往往缺乏整体感。

university.en: Her daughter was about to go to university.

unkind.en: A lot of unkind things were said.
Her husband is very unkind to her.

unknowing.en: She became ill after unknowingly taking an illegal drug.
unknowing.zh: 她在不知情的情况下服用了一种违禁药品，身体感到不适。

unknown.zh: 杀人凶手身份仍然不明。

unknown.en: For some unknown reason, Mark quit his job and moved to Greece.
unknown.zh: 不知何故，马克辞掉工作移居希腊了。

unlawful.en: The jury returned a verdict of unlawful killing.
unlawful.zh: 陪审团作出了非法杀害的裁决。

unless.en: Unless some extra money is found, the theatre will close.
unless.zh: 要是不能找到更多资金，剧院将要关闭。

unless.en: I think you should complain – unless, of course, you are happy with the way things are.
unless.zh: 我觉得你应该发发牢骚——

unlike.en: Tammy was unlike any other woman I have ever known.
unlike.zh: 塔米和我认识的其他女人都不一样。

unlike.en: It’s unlike Greg to be late.
unlike.zh: 迟到可不是格雷格的作风。

unlikely.en: Donna might be able to come tomorrow, but it’s very unlikely.
unlikely.zh: 唐娜明天也许能来，不过这可能性很小。

unlikely.en: The weather is unlikely to improve over the next few days.
unlikely.zh: 接下来的几天天气不大可能好转。

unlimited.en: The system can support an unlimited number of users.
unlimited.zh: 该系统可以支持无限多的用户。

unlimited.en: The ticket offers unlimited travel on the London underground for seven days.
unlimited.zh: 凭本票可在七日内无限次乘坐伦敦地铁。

unload.en: The driver unloaded some boxes from the back of the truck.
unload.zh: 司机从卡车后部卸下了一些箱子。

unload.en: Investors continued to unload technology stocks on Thursday.
unload.zh: 星期四投资者继续抛售科技股。

unlucky.en: Inter Milan were unlucky to lose the match.
unlucky.zh: 国际米兰队真不走运，输掉了比赛。

unlucky.en: We were unlucky with the weather this weekend. It rained constantly.
unlucky.zh: 我们真不走运，这个周末天一直在下雨。

unnatural.en: It was very cold, which seemed unnatural for late spring.
unnatural.zh: 天很冷，对于晚春来说似乎不正常。

unnatural.en: Julia’s laugh seemed forced and unnatural.
unnatural.zh: 朱莉娅的笑容看上去勉强而不自然。

unnecessary.en: There’s no point in taking unnecessary risks.
unnecessary.zh: 冒不必要的风险没什么意义。

unnecessary.en: We can’t afford any unnecessary delays.
unnecessary.zh: 我们经不起无谓的耽搁。

unnoticed.en: Elsa stood unnoticed at the edge of the crowd.
unnoticed.zh: 埃尔莎悄悄地站在人群边上。

unnoticed.en: His remark went unnoticed by everyone except me.
unnoticed.zh: 他的话除了我别人都没注意到。

unobtainable.en: Fresh fruit was unobtainable in the winter.
unobtainable.zh: 新鲜水果在冬季是买不到的。

unofficial.en: Hodges wrote an unofficial biography of the artist.
unofficial.zh: 霍奇斯写了一部这位艺术家的非正式传记。

unofficial.en: The president made an unofficial visit to the Senator’s house.
unofficial.zh: 总统到那位参议员的家作了一次私人访问。

unpalatable.en: The unpalatable truth is that the team isn’t getting any better.
unpalatable.zh: 让人难以接受的事实是这个队没有任何进步。

unpleasant.en: He said some very unpleasant things.
unpleasant.zh: 他说了一些很不客气的话。

unprecedented.en: He took the unprecedented step of stating that the rumours were false.
unprecedented.zh: 他史无前例地声明那些谣言实属子虚乌有。

unprecedented.en: Crime has increased on an unprecedented scale.
unprecedented.zh: 犯罪率增幅之大前所未有。

unprofitable.en: It would be unprofitable to pursue this argument any further.
unprofitable.zh: 这个争论再继续下去也是徒劳。

unpromising.en: Sales improved after an unpromising start.
unpromising.zh: 销售在经历了一个不容乐观的开端之后出现了好转。

unprotected.zh: 窃贼常常瞄准未采取防护措施的车辆。

unprotected.en: Part-time workers are unprotected by this law.
unprotected.zh: 兼职职员不受这条法规保护。

unquestionably.en: The Eiffel Tower is unquestionably one of Paris’s most familiar landmarks.
unquestionably.zh: 埃菲尔铁塔无疑是巴黎最为人熟知的地标之一。

unravel.en: Detectives are still trying to unravel the mystery surrounding his death.
unravel.zh: 侦探们仍在试图解开他的死亡之谜。

unravel.en: The company started to unravel when two of the directors were arrested.
unravel.zh: 两名董事被捕以后，公司开始分崩离析。

unreal.en: It seemed unreal to be sitting and talking to someone so famous.
unreal.zh: 和这么一位大名鼎鼎的人坐在一起谈话似乎很不真实。

unreal.en: Many people go into marriage with unreal expectations.
unreal.zh: 许多人都是怀着不切实际的憧憬步入婚姻的。

unreasonable.zh: 我认为他是在无理取闹。

unreasonable.en: Don’t let your boss make unreasonable demands on you.
unreasonable.zh: 别让你的老板对你提无理的要求。

unrecognizable.en: I hadn’t been to the city for 20 years and it was almost unrecognizable.

unreliable.zh: 这辆汽车的性能变得非常不稳定。

unrest.en: There is growing unrest throughout the country.
unrest.zh: 全国各地日益动荡不安。

unrest.en: The protests were the biggest show of social unrest since the government came to power.
unrest.zh: 这些抗议活动是这届政府上台以来最大的一次社会动荡。

unsafe.en: Many people feel unsafe walking alone at night.
unsafe.zh: 很多人觉得一个人走夜路不安全。

unseen.en: Raj crept out of the house unseen.
unseen.zh: 拉杰悄悄地溜出了房子。

unsettle.zh: 突如其来的变化弄得朱迪心神不宁。

unspecified.en: The meeting will take place at an unspecified date in the future.
unspecified.zh: 会议将于日后召开，具体日期不确定。

unspoiled.en: She remained unspoilt by her success.
unspoiled.zh: 她虽然事业有成，却依然保持本色。

unstable.en: The political situation is still very unstable.

unsuccessful.en: We have been unsuccessful in finding a new manager.
unsuccessful.zh: 我们没能找到一位新的经理。

unsuccessful.en: He tried unsuccessfully to make them change their decision.
unsuccessful.zh: 他试图让他们改变决定，但是没能成功。

unsuitable.en: The book is unsuitable for children.
unsuitable.zh: 这本书不适合儿童阅读。

unsure.en: I was unsure of the reaction I would get.
unsure.zh: 我不清楚将会得到何种反应。

unsure.en: If you are unsure about anything, just ask.
unsure.zh: 如果你有什么地方不明白，尽管问。

untapped.en: Older people are an untapped resource in the employment market.
untapped.zh: 年龄较大的人是就业市场中有待利用的资源。

untapped.en: We believe there is untapped potential.
untapped.zh: 我们相信还有潜力没有挖掘出来。

unthinkable.en: It is unthinkable that a mistake like this could have happened.
unthinkable.zh: 竟然发生了这样的错误，真是令人难以置信。

unthinkable.en: It would be unthinkable for me to stay anywhere but with the family.
unthinkable.zh: 对我来说不和家人在一起是难以想象的。

until.en: The ticket is valid until March.
until.zh: 这张票的有效期一直到 3

until.en: He waited until she had finished speaking.

untimely.en: The announcement brought the meeting to an untimely end.
untimely.zh: 这事的公布使会议早早地就结束了。

untold.en: The rumours will do untold damage to his reputation.
untold.zh: 这些谣言会给他的名声造成无法估计的损害。

untold.en: The floods have caused untold misery to hundreds of homeowners.
untold.zh: 洪水给数以百计的房主带来了不可估量的痛苦。

untouched.en: Several papers lay untouched on the desk.
untouched.zh: 有几份文件原封不动地放在书桌上。

untrue.en: It’s untrue to say that the situation has not changed.
untrue.zh: 说情况没有改变，这是没有根据的。

untrue.en: It’s not true to say nothing has changed.

unused.en: Maggie was unused to being told what to do.
unused.zh: 玛吉不习惯有人对她指手画脚。

unusual.en: It’s unusual for Dave to be late.
It’s not unusual (=it is quite common) to feel very angry in a situation like this.
unusual.zh: 遇到这样的情况觉得非常生气是很正常的。

unusually.en: Unusually for me, I fell asleep very quickly.

unwell.en: He didn’t come to school because he wasn’t well.
unwell.zh: 他不舒服，所以没来上学。

unwilling.en: He was unwilling or unable to pay the fine.
unwilling.zh: 他是不愿意付这罚款，不然就是付不起。

up.en: We walked slowly up the hill.
She picked her jacket up off the floor.

upbringing.en: Mike had had a strict upbringing.

update.en: Can you update me on what’s been happening?
update.zh: 你能不能告诉我最新情况？

upgrade.en: You’ll need to upgrade your hard drive to 120Mb before running this software.
upgrade.zh: 运行这个软件之前你需要把硬盘升级到 120

upgrade.en: The hotel has recently been refurbished and upgraded.
upgrade.zh: 这家酒店最近重新装修过，设施更加完善了。

upheaval.en: Moving house is a major upheaval.

uphold.en: The conviction was upheld by the Court of Appeal.

upkeep.en: Most of the money is spent on the upkeep of the building.
upkeep.zh: 这笔钱大部分用于大楼的维护。

upkeep.en: Poorer people find it hard to pay for their pet’s upkeep.
upkeep.zh: 经济不宽裕的人难以负担养宠物的开销。

upload.en: It might take a while for this to upload.
upload.zh: 上载这个可能要花些时间。

upon.en: We are completely dependent upon your help.
upon.zh: 我们完全依赖你的帮助。

upon.en: Brandon threw him upon the ground.

upper.en: There is an upper age limit for becoming a pilot.
Police have gained the upper hand over the drug dealers in the area.
upper.zh: 警方在与该地区的毒品贩子的较量中占据了上风。

uppermost.en: A feeling of pity for David was uppermost in her mind.
uppermost.zh: 对戴维的同情在她心中占主要位置。

uppermost.en: The one word which seems to be uppermost in every discussion is money.
uppermost.zh: 每次讨论都好像只有一个字最重要，那就是“

upright.en: The chimpanzee stood upright and grasped the bars of its cage.
upright.zh: 黑猩猩直立着，抓住笼子的铁栅。

upright.en: Katie was still awake, sitting bolt upright (=sitting with her back very straight) staring at the television.
upright.zh: 凯蒂还醒着，坐得笔直，眼睛盯着电视。

uproar.en: The house was in an uproar, with babies crying and people shouting.
uproar.zh: 房子里有婴儿在哭，还有人在大叫，一片嘈杂。

uproot.en: He rejected the idea of uprooting himself and moving to America.
uproot.zh: 他放弃了迁居美国的想法。

upset.en: She was deeply upset about the way her father treated her.
upset.zh: 父亲那样对她，她非常难过。

upset.en: Debbie was upset that he didn’t spend more time with her.
upset.zh: 他没有花更多的时间陪自己，黛比觉得不快。

upside.en: The upside of the whole thing is that we got a free trip to Jamaica.
upside.zh: 整个事情的好处是我们得到一次免费去牙买加的机会。

upstairs.en: I went upstairs and had a shower.
She’s upstairs in bed feeling ill.
upstairs.zh: 她身体不舒服，在楼上躺着。

upsurge.en: There was an upsurge in violence during June and July.
upsurge.zh: 六七月间暴力事件急剧增多。

upsurge.en: There was a genuine upsurge of religious feeling.
upsurge.zh: 突然生发出一种非常强烈的宗教情绪。

up-to-date.en: They have access to up-to-date information through a computer database.
up-to-date.zh: 他们可以通过计算机数据库获得最新信息。

up-to-date.en: Our magazine will keep you up to date with fashion.
up-to-date.zh: 我们的杂志可以让你即时掌握最新的时尚资讯。

upward.en: Stroke the cream onto your skin in an upward direction.
upward.zh: 把护肤霜在皮肤上轻轻由下向上涂抹。

upwards.en: Pointing upwards, he indicated a large nest high in the tree.
upwards.zh: 他朝上指指，示意树上高处有个大鸟窝。

upwards.en: The path began to climb steeply upwards.

urbane.en: Neil was urbane, witty, direct, and honest.
urbane.zh: 尼尔文雅机智，坦率诚实。

urge.en: I got a note from Moira urging me to get in touch.
urge.zh: 我收到莫伊拉的一封短信，一定要我保持联系。

urge.en: He urged that a referendum should be held by December.

urgent.en: He was in urgent need of medical attention.
The report called for urgent action to reduce lead in petrol.
urgent.zh: 报告呼吁迅速采取行动，减少汽油中的铅含量。

us.en: He arranged for us all to have a drink.
us.zh: 他安排我们大家一起喝一杯。

usable.en: The computer language involved was readily usable.
usable.zh: 所涉及的计算机语言便于使用。

use.zh: 我可以用一下你的电话吗？

use.en: I’ll show you which room you can use.
use.zh: 我来跟你说一下你可以用哪个房间。

used.en: I do the dishes every day, so I’m used to it.
used.zh: 我每天洗盘子，所以习惯了。

used.en: I can’t get used to the idea that you’re grown up now.
used.zh: 现在你已长大成人，但我不习惯这么想。

useful.en: A little Japanese can be really useful.
The space under the desk is useful for storing CDs.
useful.zh: 书桌下面的空间可以用来存放激光唱片。

usefulness.en: There are doubts as to the usefulness of this approach (=it may not be useful).
usefulness.zh: 有人怀疑这种方法是否有用。

usefulness.en: As a commuter service, the ferry has outlived its usefulness (=is no longer useful).
usefulness.zh: 作为一种通勤服务，渡船已经没有用武之地了。

useless.en: The doctor concluded that further treatment would be useless.
useless.zh: 医生下了结论，进一步治疗是无益的。

useless.en: Water had got into the radio, and now it was completely useless.
useless.zh: 收音机进了水，现在完全不能用了。

user.en: Drug users were warned about the dangers of sharing needles.
user.zh: 瘾君子们受到警告，共用针头非常危险。

usher.en: He ushered her into the room.
She stood back and ushered him in.
usher.zh: 她往后退了退，领他进去。

usual.en: Make a cheese sauce in the usual way.
usual.zh: 按通常的做法做奶酪酱。

usual.en: I’ll meet you at the usual time.

usually.en: Women usually live longer than men.
Usually I wear black, grey, or brown.
usually.zh: 通常我都穿黑色、灰色或者棕色的衣服。

utility.zh: 你的房租包括公用事业费吗？

utility.en: It’s a simple shareware utility that allows you to print signs and banners.
utility.zh: 这是个简单的共享应用软件，你可以用它来打印标牌和横幅。

utilize.en: We must consider how best to utilize what resources we have.
utilize.zh: 我们必须考虑怎样充分利用现有的资源。

utilize.en: The money will be used to build a new sports hall.
utilize.zh: 这笔钱将用来建造一座新的体育馆。

utmost.en: I have the utmost respect for her accomplishments.
utmost.zh: 我对她的成就充满敬意。

utmost.en: Baldwin treated the matter with the utmost seriousness.
utmost.zh: 鲍德温极其认真地对待这件事。

utter.en: This company treats its employees with utter contempt.
utter.zh: 这家公司对其员工不屑一顾。

utter.en: I watched in complete and utter horror as he pulled out a gun.
utter.zh: 我惊恐万分地看着他拔出枪来。

utterance.en: Politicians are judged by their public utterances.
utterance.zh: 人们根据政治家公开的言论来评判他们。

vacancy.en: There are still two vacancies on the school board.
vacancy.zh: 学校董事会还有两个职位空缺。

vacancy.en: We have no vacancies for photographers at the moment.
vacancy.zh: 我们目前没有摄影师职位空缺。

vacant.en: Only a few apartments were still vacant.
vacant.zh: 只有几套公寓仍然空着。

vacant.en: There was only a vacant lot (=empty unused area of land in a city) where her house used to be.
vacant.zh: 她以前房子所在的地方只剩下一块空地了。

vacate.en: Clay will vacate the position on June 19.
Guests must vacate their rooms by 11:00.

vacation.en: We’re planning a vacation in Europe.
vacation.zh: 我们正计划去欧洲度假。

vaccinate.en: All children should be vaccinated against measles.
vaccinate.zh: 所有儿童都应该接种麻疹疫苗。

vaccine.en: Doctors worried that there would not be enough vaccine for everyone who needed it.
vaccine.zh: 医生担心没有足够的疫苗给每个需要的人。

vacuum.en: Her husband’s death left a vacuum in her life.
vacuum.zh: 丈夫的去世使她的生活变得空虚。

vacuum.en: The process of learning a language does not take place in a vacuum.
vacuum.zh: 学习语言的过程在封闭状态下无法进行。

vague.en: The governor gave only a vague outline of his tax plan.
vague.zh: 州长只是含糊地大致说了一下他的税务计划。

vague.en: Julia was vague about where she had been and what she had been doing.
vague.zh: 关于她到过哪里，做了些什么，朱莉娅含糊其词。

vaguely.en: I vaguely remember a woman in a red dress standing outside the door.
vaguely.zh: 我依稀记得一个穿红色连衣裙的女人站在门外。

vaguely.en: There was something vaguely familiar about him.
vaguely.zh: 他身上有种似曾相识的感觉。

vain.en: Men can be just as vain as women.
vain.zh: 男人有时会和女人一样虚荣。

vain.en: Police searched in vain for the missing gunman.
vain.zh: 警方搜寻失踪的持枪歹徒，但毫无结果。

valid.en: Your return ticket is valid for three months.
valid.zh: 你的往返票有效期为三个月。

valid.en: Police officers must have a valid reason for stopping motorists.
valid.zh: 警察拦下驾车者必须有正当理由。

validate.en: The Supreme Court has validated the lower court’s interpretation of the law.
validate.zh: 最高法院已经认可下级法院对这条法规的阐释。

validate.en: Many scientists plan to wait until the results of the study are validated by future research.
validate.zh: 许多科学家计划等到调查结果被今后的研究证实了以后再作定论。

valuable.en: Their most valuable belongings were locked in a safe in the bedroom.
valuable.zh: 他们最值钱的财物锁在卧室保险箱里。

valuable.en: Muriel has made a valuable contribution to our company’s success.
valuable.zh: 缪里尔为我们公司的成功做出了宝贵的贡献。

valuation.en: The property has a valuation of $1.6 billion.

value.en: The alterations doubled the value of the house.
value.zh: 经改建后这所房子增值了一倍。

value.en: The lunch special is really good value.

van.en: She was in the van of the feminist movement.
van.zh: 她处于女权运动的前沿。

vanish.en: My keys were here a minute ago but now they’ve vanished.
vanish.zh: 我的钥匙刚刚还在这里，现在却不翼而飞了。

vanish.en: The youngster vanished without a trace one day and has never been found.
vanish.zh: 有一天，那个年轻人消失得无影无踪，再也找不到了。

vanity.en: Sabrina had none of the vanity so often associated with beautiful women.
vanity.zh: 萨布里娜没有一点漂亮女人经常会有的那种虚荣。

variable.en: Expect variable cloudiness and fog tomorrow.
variable.zh: 预计明天多云有雾，天气多变。

variable.en: Interest rates can be highly variable.

variance.en: Tradition and culture are often at variance with the needs of modern living.
variance.zh: 传统和文化常常与现代生活的需要有冲突。

variance.en: The developer requested a variance to build a shopping center on the east side of town.
variance.zh: 开发商要求获得特免，在城东建造一座购物中心。

variant.en: This game is a variant of netball.
variant.zh: 这种运动是无挡板篮球的一种变化形式。

variation.en: White bread is really just a variation of French bread.
variation.zh: 白面包其实只是法式长条面包的一种变化形式。

variation.en: There is a great deal of variation among the responses.

varied.en: The responsibilities of government are many, and they are varied.
varied.zh: 政府有很多职责，而且各不相同。

varied.en: A good teacher is aware of the extremely varied needs of each student.
varied.zh: 好老师能了解每位学生的不同需求。

variety.en: The girls come from a variety of different backgrounds.
variety.zh: 这些女孩出身背景各不相同。

variety.en: A variety of techniques were used.

various.en: The jacket is available in various colours.
various.zh: 这种夹克有好多种颜色可选。

various.en: There are various ways to answer your question.
various.zh: 有多种方法可以回答你的问题。

variously.en: His fortune has been variously estimated at between $1 and $2 billion.
variously.zh: 对他的财富有各种猜测，从10

vary.en: Test scores vary from school to school.
The heights of the plants vary from 8 cm to 20 cm.

vast.en: The government will have to borrow vast amounts of money.
vast.zh: 政府将不得不借用巨额资金。

vast.en: The refugees come across the border in vast numbers.

vastly.en: This book is vastly superior to his last one.
vastly.zh: 这本书远比他的上一本书优秀。

vault.en: The robber vaulted over the counter and took $200 in cash.
vault.zh: 抢劫犯跃过柜台，抢走了200

vault.en: On Sunday Michigan vaulted from No. 4 to the nation’s top team.
vault.zh: 星期天密歇根队从第四位一跃成为全国头号球队。

vegetable.en: Vitamin A is found in liver and green vegetables.
vegetable.zh: 动物肝脏和绿色蔬菜中含有维生素A

vegetarian.en: Our youngest daughter is a vegetarian.
vegetarian.zh: 我们的小女儿是个素食主义者。

vegetarian.en: I’m thinking about becoming a vegetarian.

vegetation.en: Lefkas has an abundance of lush green vegetation.
vegetation.zh: 莱夫卡斯有葱郁茂盛的植被。

vehement.en: Despite vehement opposition, the Act became law.
vehement.zh: 尽管遭到强烈的反对，这项法案还是成为了法律。

vehement.en: Despite her vehement protests, he pulled her inside.
vehement.zh: 尽管她强烈抗议，他还是把她拉了进去。

vehicle.en: The 1936 Olympics were used as a vehicle for Nazi propaganda.

veil.en: She lifted her veil with both hands.
I think it best to draw a veil over the whole incident.
veil.zh: 我认为这整件事最好是避而不谈。

vein.en: She felt the blood racing through her veins as they kissed.
vein.zh: 他们接吻时她觉得热血沸腾。

vein.en: There was more humour, in much the same vein.
vein.zh: 风格差不多，只是更幽默了。

velocity.en: The speedboat reached a velocity of 120 mph.
Martinez had good velocity on his fastball.
velocity.zh: 马丁内斯的快球速度极快。

vendor.en: He bought a copy from a newspaper vendor.
vendor.zh: 他从报贩那里买了一份报纸。

venerate.en: These children are venerated as holy beings.
The sun was an object of veneration.

vengeance.en: The music started up again with a vengeance.
vengeance.zh: 音乐再度响起，更加激昂。

venom.en: There was real venom in her voice.
The viper paralyses its prey by injecting it with venom.
venom.zh: 蝰蛇通过注入毒液使猎物麻痹。

vent.en: Children give vent to their anger in various ways.
vent.zh: 儿童用各种方法发泄怒气。

vent.en: He knew that if he gave full vent to his feelings, it would upset Joanna.
vent.zh: 他知道，要是他把自己的情绪全部发泄出来，就会把乔安娜惹火的。

ventilate.en: Both patients are sedated and ventilated.
ventilate.zh: 两位病人都用了镇静剂和呼吸机。

ventilate.en: The important thing is to ventilate your anger.
ventilate.zh: 重要的是要把你的愤怒表达出来。

venture.en: When darkness fell, he would venture out.
venture.zh: 天黑以后，他就会壮着胆子出去。

venture.en: She paused before venturing up the steps to the door.
venture.zh: 她犹豫了一下，大着胆子迈上台阶，走向门口。

venue.en: The first thing to do is book a venue.
venue.zh: 首先要做的是预订一个会场。

venue.en: The band will play (=perform at) as many venues as possible.
venue.zh: 那支乐队将在尽可能多的地方演出。

verbal.en: Her boss failed to stop the other workers from verbally abusing her.
verbal.zh: 她的老板没能阻止其他员工对她的谩骂。

verbal.en: Maria was getting loads of verbal from her staff.
verbal.zh: 玛丽亚饱受员工的责骂。

verbalize.en: Urge your child to verbalize his feelings.
verbalize.zh: 鼓励你的孩子用言语表达自己的情感。

verdict.en: The players anxiously awaited the verdict of the umpire.
verdict.zh: 球员焦急地等待裁判的裁决。

verge.en: Jess seemed on the verge of tears.
verge.zh: 杰斯似乎差点就要哭了。

verge.en: Mountain gorillas are on the verge of extinction.

verify.en: A computer program verifies that the system is working.
verify.zh: 电脑程序可以核查系统是否在运行。

verify.en: American forces will remain to verify compliance with the treaty.
verify.zh: 美军将继续驻留，核查条约是否得到遵守。

vernacular.en: Galileo wrote in the vernacular to reach a larger audience.
vernacular.zh: 为了让更多读者看懂，伽利略用本国语言写作。

vernacular.en: He lapsed into the local vernacular (=language spoken in a particular area).
vernacular.zh: 他说着说着就讲起了地方土话。

versatile.en: The potato is an extremely versatile vegetable.
versatile.zh: 马铃薯是一种用途极广的蔬菜。

versatile.en: Hegley’s outstanding versatility as an all-round entertainer
versatile.zh: 海格力作为一名全能艺人非同一般的多才多艺

verse.en: Let’s sing the last verse again.
verse.zh: 我们把最后一节再唱一遍吧。

verse.en: Learn the first two verses of the poem by heart.
verse.zh: 把这首诗的头两节背下来。
