version.en: I think I preferred the television version.
version.zh: 我觉得我更喜欢电视版。

version.en: Could Donna’s version of what happened that night be correct?
version.zh: 唐娜对那晚发生的事情的描述是否正确呢？

versus.en: The finance minister must weigh up the benefits of a tax cut versus those of increased public spending.
versus.zh: 财政部长必须权衡是减税还是增加公共开支更有利。

vertical.en: Formal communication channels are usually vertical.
vertical.zh: 正式的沟通渠道一般都是纵向的。

vertical.en: The tower now leans about 15 degrees from the vertical.

very.en: The fishing industry is very important to the area.
very.zh: 捕鱼业对于该地区非常重要。

vest.en: Copyright is vested in the author for 50 years.
vest.zh: 著作权归作者所有，为期50

vestige.en: The new law removed the last vestiges of royal power.
vestige.zh: 新法律废除了最后一点王权。

vestige.en: There’s not a vestige of truth in the story.
vestige.zh: 这个故事毫无真实性可言。

vestigial.en: The legs of snakes are vestigial or absent altogether.
vestigial.zh: 蛇的腿已经退化或完全消失。

veto.en: President Bush vetoed the bill on July 6.
Jenny wanted to invite all her friends, but I quickly vetoed that idea.
veto.zh: 珍妮想邀请她所有的朋友，不过我立即对此表示反对。

via.en: We flew to Athens via Paris.
via.zh: 我们经由巴黎飞往雅典。

via.en: I sent a message to Kitty via her sister.
via.zh: 我通过姬蒂的妹妹给她捎了个口信。

viable.en: The committee came forward with one viable solution.
viable.zh: 委员会提出了一个切实可行的解决方案。

viable.en: Will a hotel here be financially viable?
viable.zh: 在这里建一家酒店从资金上说可行吗？

vibrant.en: Hong Kong is a vibrant, fascinating city.
vibrant.zh: 香港是座富有活力的迷人城市。

vibrant.en: She was sixteen, young and vibrant.

vibrate.en: The floor was vibrating to the beat of the music.
vibrate.zh: 地板随着音乐的节奏在颤动。

vibrate.en: As air passes over our vocal cords, it makes them vibrate.
vibrate.zh: 气流通过我们的声带，使之产生振动。

vibration.en: The microscope must be free from vibration.
vibration.zh: 显微镜一定要避免震动。

vice.en: The police have smashed a vice ring (=a group of criminals involved in vice) in Chicago.
vice.zh: 警方捣毁了芝加哥的一个犯罪团伙。

vice versa.en: The boys may refuse to play with the girls, and vice versa.
vice versa.zh: 男孩可能拒绝和女孩玩耍，反之亦然。

vicinity.en: The stolen car was found in the vicinity of the station.
vicinity.zh: 被盗汽车在车站附近被发现。

vicinity.en: There used to be a mill in the vicinity.

vicious.en: Keep away from that dog, he can be vicious.
vicious.zh: 离那只狗远点，它有时很凶猛。

vicious.en: Sarah can be quite vicious at times.

victim.en: The victim received head injuries from which she died a week later.
victim.zh: 受害人头部受伤，一周后死亡。
大多数凶杀案的受害者不足30

victimize.en: The men claim they have been victimized because of their political activity.
victimize.zh: 那些人声称他们因为自己的政治活动而受到了迫害。

victorious.en: We were confident that the Allies would emerge victorious (=finally win).
victorious.zh: 我们确信盟军最终一定能获胜。

victory.en: The court’s decision represents a victory for all women.
victory.zh: 法庭的判决代表了所有女性的胜利。

victory.en: He said the court’s decision was a great victory.
victory.zh: 他说法庭的判决是一个重大胜利。

video.en: How much does it cost to hire videos?
Let’s stay at home and watch a video.
video.zh: 我们待在家里看录像吧。

vie.en: Simon and Julian were vying for her attention all through dinner.
vie.zh: 晚饭的时候，西蒙和朱利安从头到尾都在抢着向她献殷勤。

vie.en: There are at least twenty restaurants vying with each other for custom.

view.en: What’s your view on the subject?
Their view is that competition is good for business.
view.zh: 他们认为竞争对商业有利。

viewer.en: The new series has gone down well with viewers.
viewer.zh: 这个新的电视系列片很受观众欢迎。

viewer.en: In the painting, the woman has her back to the viewer.
viewer.zh: 画中的这名女子背对观看者。

viewpoint.en: Try and think of it from the child’s viewpoint.
viewpoint.zh: 尽量从孩子的角度来考虑这件事。

viewpoint.en: The islands were important from the viewpoint of American security.
viewpoint.zh: 从美国国土安全的角度考虑，这些岛屿很重要。

vigilant.en: Please remain vigilant at all times and report anything suspicious.
vigilant.zh: 请时刻保持警惕，有可疑情况随时报告。

vigilant.en: We were told to watch out for anything suspicious.
vigilant.zh: 我们被告知要警惕任何可疑情况

vigorous.en: Your dog needs at least 20 minutes of vigorous exercise every day.
vigorous.zh: 你的狗每天需要进行至少20

vigorous.en: Environmentalists have begun a vigorous campaign to oppose nuclear dumping in the area.
vigorous.zh: 环保人士已经发动了一场积极的运动，反对在该地区倾倒核废物。

village.en: The whole village came to the meeting.
village.zh: 全村的人都来参加会议。

vindicate.en: The charges are false, and we are sure we will be vindicated in court.
vindicate.zh: 指控不实，我们确信法庭会证明我们是无辜的。

vindicate.en: The decision to advertise has been vindicated by the fact that sales have grown.
vindicate.zh: 销售增长的事实证明做广告宣传的决定是正确的。

violate.en: Thirty-four protesters were arrested for violating criminal law.
Victims of burglaries often feel personally violated.
violate.zh: 入室盗窃的受害人往往觉得自己受到了人身侵犯。

violation.en: Troops crossed the border in violation of the agreement.
violation.zh: 部队违反协议，越过了边界。

violence.en: There is too much sex and violence on TV these days.
violence.zh: 如今电视上性爱和暴力场面太多。

violence.en: She spoke with a violence that surprised them both.
violence.zh: 她言辞激烈，令他们俩都很惊讶。

violent.en: Thirty-one people have been injured in violent incidents throughout the day.
The riots ended in the violent deaths of three teenagers.
violent.zh: 动乱以三名少年的惨死而告终。

violently.en: He rushed to the bathroom, where he was violently sick.
violently.zh: 他冲到卫生间，猛吐了一番。

viral.en: It is one of the most viewed viral videos on the web.
viral.zh: 这是网络上被观看次数最多的“

viral.en: They use humorous virals to promote their products.

virtual.en: Car ownership is a virtual necessity when you live in the country.
virtual.zh: 住在乡下，拥有汽车几乎是必需的。

virtual.en: Finding a cheap place to rent is a virtual impossibility in this area.
virtual.zh: 要在这个地区租到便宜的房子几乎不可能。

virtually.en: Virtually all the children come to school by bus.
virtually.zh: 几乎所有的孩子都乘公交车上学。

virtually.en: He was virtually unknown before running for office.
virtually.zh: 他在参加竞选之前几乎不为人知。

virtue.en: Women have often been used as symbols of virtue.
virtue.zh: 女性常被用作美德的象征。

virtue.en: Among her many virtues are loyalty, courage, and truthfulness.
virtue.zh: 她有许多美德，诸如忠诚、勇敢和诚实。

virtuous.en: Sue considered herself very virtuous because she neither drank nor smoked.
virtuous.zh: 休认为自己品行非常端正，因为她既不喝酒也不抽烟。

visa.en: I was still in New York, trying to get a visa to visit Russia.
visa.zh: 我仍在纽约，正在办理去俄罗斯的签证。

visa.en: She applied for a three-month tourist visa.
visa.zh: 她申请了三个月的旅游签证。

viscous.en: As the liquid cools, it becomes viscous.
viscous.zh: 这液体冷却后会变黏稠。

visibility.en: Visibility on the roads is down to 20 metres due to heavy fog.
visibility.zh: 道路能见度因浓雾降至20

visibility.en: The search for survivors was abandoned because of poor visibility.
visibility.zh: 由于能见度低，放弃了对幸存者的搜寻。

visible.en: The outline of the mountains was clearly visible.
The sign was clearly visible to passing motorists.
visible.zh: 这一标志过路司机可清楚地看见。

vision.en: She suffered temporary loss of vision after being struck on the head.
vision.zh: 她头部受撞击以后出现暂时性失明。

vision.en: Tears blurred her vision (=made it difficult for her to see).

visionary.en: Under his visionary leadership, the city prospered.
visionary.zh: 在他富有远见的领导下，这座城市蓬勃发展。

visit.en: Eric went to Seattle to visit his cousins.
visit.zh: 埃里克到西雅图去看望他的表兄弟。

visit.en: I was really pleased that they came to visit me.
visit.zh: 他们来看我，我真是高兴。

visitor.en: Times Square attracts more than 30 million visitors annually.
visitor.zh: 时代广场每年吸引三千多万游客。

visitor.en: Rina is a frequent visitor to the city.
visitor.zh: 里娜是这个城市的常客。

visual.en: Artists translate their ideas into visual images.
visual.zh: 画家把自己的思想转换成视觉画面。

visual.en: The tall tower adds to the visual impact of the building.
visual.zh: 高高的塔楼增强了这幢大楼的视觉效果。

visualize.en: I tried to visualize the house while he was describing it.
visualize.zh: 我一边听他描述，一边想象那房子的样子。

visualize.en: Somehow I can’t visualize myself staying with this company for much longer.
visualize.zh: 不知为什么，我想象不出自己还会在这家公司待很久。

visually.en: Chairs should be visually attractive as well as comfortable.
visually.zh: 椅子既要美观也要舒适。

visually.en: The process is easy to understand when it is demonstrated visually.
visually.zh: 用直观演示，这个过程就容易理解了。

vital.en: The work she does is absolutely vital.
vital.zh: 她所做的工作至关重要。

vital.en: These measures are vital to national security.
vital.zh: 这些措施对国家安全极其重要。

vitality.en: Despite her eighty years, Elsie was full of vitality.
The process of restructuring has injected some much-needed vitality into the company.
vitality.zh: 重组为公司注入了一些迫切需要的活力。

vitamin.en: Try to eat foods that are rich in vitamins and minerals.
vitamin.zh: 尽量吃富含维生素和矿物质的食物。

vitamin.en: Lack of vitamin E can cause skin diseases and tiredness.

vivid.en: I’ve got vivid memories of that summer.
vivid.zh: 我对那年夏天记忆犹新。

vivid.en: He had a vivid picture of her in his mind.
vivid.zh: 他的脑海中清晰地留着她的形象。

vocabulary.en: Teachers were impressed by his vocabulary.
vocabulary.zh: 他的词汇量给老师们留下了深刻的印象。

vocabulary.en: English has the largest vocabulary of any language.
vocabulary.zh: 英语在所有语言中词汇量最大。

vocal.en: Foley has been particularly vocal in his criticism of the government.
vocal.zh: 福利批评政府时尤其直言不讳。

vocal.en: She was a vocal opponent of the plan.
vocal.zh: 她是这个计划的强烈反对者。

vocation.en: Jan has a vocation for teaching.
vocation.zh: 简对教书有一种使命感。

vocation.en: You missed your vocation (=you would have been good at a particular job).

vogue.en: Short skirts are very much in vogue just now.
Suntanning first came into vogue in the mid-1930s.

voice.zh: 他立刻听出了她的声音。

voiceless.en: The vast majority of our people feel ignored and voiceless.
voiceless.zh: 我们人民中的绝大多数觉得受到了忽视，而且没有发言权。

void.en: Running the business helped to fill the void after his wife died.
void.zh: 做生意填补了他自妻子死后产生的孤寂感。

void.en: The amusement park will fill a void in this town, which has little entertainment for children.
void.zh: 这个游乐场将填补这座小城儿童娱乐设施匮乏的空白。

volcano.en: Pompei was destroyed when the volcano erupted in 79 AD.

volume.en: Can you turn the volume up?
Can you turn the TV up a bit?
volume.zh: 请把电视机调响一点好吗？

voluminous.en: He took voluminous notes during the lecture.
voluminous.zh: 他在听课时作了大量笔记。

voluntary.en: She does a lot of voluntary work for the Red Cross.
voluntary.zh: 她为红十字会做大量的志愿工作。

voluntary.en: Workers are being encouraged to take voluntary redundancy.

volunteer.en: Most of the relief work was done by volunteers.
volunteer.zh: 大部分救援工作都由志愿人员完成。

volunteer.en: I need some volunteers to help with the washing-up.
volunteer.zh: 我需要几个自告奋勇者帮我洗餐具。

vomit.en: He had swallowed so much sea water he wanted to vomit.
vomit.zh: 他呛了这么多海水，所以想吐。

vomit.en: I knew I was really in trouble when I began vomiting blood.
vomit.zh: 我开始吐血的时候才知道我的麻烦大了。

vote.en: In 1918 British women got the right to vote.
I voted for the Labour candidate in the last election.
vote.zh: 我在上次选举中投了工党候选人的票。

voter.en: Voters overwhelmingly rejected the Far Right in the May elections.
In Ireland 83% of voters favoured EC membership in 1972.

vouch.en: I’ll vouch for the quality of the report. I read it last night.
vouch.zh: 我为报告的质量作保，我昨晚看过。

vouch.en: Why don’t you phone my office? They’ll vouch for me.
vouch.zh: 你为什么不打电话到我的办公室？

voucher.en: The voucher can be used at most major supermarkets.
voucher.zh: 这种购物券可以在大多数大型超市使用。

voucher.en: First prize is a £1,000 travel voucher.

vow.en: Jim made a vow that he would find his wife’s killer.
vow.zh: 吉姆发誓要找到杀害他妻子的凶手。

vow.en: I made a vow never to go near the place again.
vow.zh: 我发誓再也不走近那个地方。

voyage.en: The voyage from England to India used to take six months.
voyage.zh: 过去从英格兰到印度要航行六个月。

voyage.en: I don’t want to make the voyage single-handed.

vulnerable.en: He took advantage of me when I was at my most vulnerable.
vulnerable.zh: 他在我最脆弱的时候利用了我。

vulnerable.en: We work mainly with the elderly and other vulnerable groups.
vulnerable.zh: 我们主要和老年人以及其他弱势群体打交道。

wade.en: I wish you wouldn’t always wade in with your opinion.
wade.zh: 我希望你不要总是硬插进来提意见。

wade.en: The police waded into the crowd swinging sticks.
wade.zh: 警察挥舞着警棍冲进人群。

wag.en: Some wag had drawn a face on the wall.
wag.zh: 某个爱搞笑的家伙在墙上画了张人脸。

wag.en: Are WAGs good role models for girls?
wag.zh: 体坛明星的娇妻、女友是女孩们的榜样吗？

wage.en: The wage increases will come into effect in June.

wager.en: Stipes wagered all his money on an unknown horse.
wager.zh: 斯蒂普斯把他所有的钱都押在一匹不出名的马上。

wail.en: Somewhere behind them a child began to wail.
wail.zh: 有个孩子在他们身后的什么地方大哭起来。

wail.en: The wind wailed in the chimney.
wail.zh: 风灌进烟囱里呼呼作响。

waist.en: The skirt was too big around the waist.
Lota was paralysed from the waist down.

waive.en: She waived her right to a lawyer.
waive.zh: 她放弃了请律师的权利。

wake.en: When she woke, the sun was streaming through the windows.
wake.zh: 她醒来时，阳光泻入窗内。

wake.en: Try not to wake the baby.

waken.en: She gently wakened the sleeping child.
waken.zh: 她轻轻地唤醒睡梦中的孩子。

walk.en: Doctors said he’d never walk again.
walk.zh: 医生说他再也不能行走了。

walk.en: Carrie walked into the room and sat down in her chair.
walk.zh: 卡丽走进房间，坐在她的椅子上。

walker.en: The area is popular with walkers.
walker.zh: 这地方很受徒步者欢迎。

wall.en: The estate is surrounded by high stone walls.
wall.zh: 庄园的四周是高高的石墙。

wall.en: We climbed over the wall into the orchard.

wallet.en: I’ve only got about £10 in my wallet.
wallet.zh: 我的钱包里只有大概十英镑。

wallet.en: He took a credit card out of his wallet.
wallet.zh: 他从钱包里拿出一张信用卡。

wallpaper.en: I haven’t finished wallpapering the bedroom yet.
wallpaper.zh: 我还没给卧室贴完墙纸。

wand.en: I can’t just wave a magic wand and make it all better.
wand.zh: 我可没本事一挥魔棒就把什么都变好。

wand.en: We were wanded by security guards before being allowed in.
wand.zh: 我们被保安人员用扫描器进行扫描安检后才被允许进入。

wander.en: I’ll wander around the mall for half an hour.
wander.zh: 我会在商场里逛半小时。

wander.en: She wandered aimlessly about the house.
wander.zh: 她漫无目的地在房子里走来走去。

wane.en: My enthusiasm for the project was waning.
wane.zh: 我对这个项目的热情逐渐减退了。

wane.en: The group’s influence had begun to wane by this time.
wane.zh: 此时，这个团体的影响力已经开始减弱。

want.en: What do you want for your birthday?

war.en: He served as a pilot during the war.
No one wants to start a trade war here.
war.zh: 这里没有人想挑起一场贸易战。

ward.en: She was made a ward of court.
Don’t forget insect repellent to ward off the mosquitoes.
ward.zh: 别忘了带上防蚊子的驱虫剂。

wardrobe.en: Can you hang these in the wardrobe, please?
wardrobe.zh: 请你把这些衣服挂到衣橱里去好吗？

wardrobe.en: You can win a complete new wardrobe.
wardrobe.zh: 你可以赢得各式齐全的新衣服。

warm.en: The house was lovely and warm.
I hope we get some warm weather soon.
warm.zh: 我希望天气很快就会回暖。

warmly.en: We were warmly welcomed by the villagers.
warmly.zh: 我们受到了村民的热情欢迎。

warmth.en: The children huddled closely together for warmth.
warmth.zh: 孩子们紧紧地挤在一起取暖。

warn.en: Travellers to Africa are being warned about the danger of HIV infection.
warn.zh: 去非洲旅行的人被警告要注意感染艾滋病的危险。

warn.en: Salmon farmers are warning of the severe crisis facing the industry.
warn.zh: 鲑鱼养殖场主警告说该行业正面临严重危机。

warning.en: This experience should serve as a warning against complacency.
warning.zh: 这个经历应该可以成为不要自满的警示。

warning.en: The Surrey team were given a warning last year for repeated offences.
warning.zh: 这支萨里的球队去年因多次犯规受到一次警告。

warp.en: The door must be warped. It won’t close properly.
warp.zh: 这门肯定是变形了，关不严。

warp.en: You mustn’t allow your dislike of her to warp your judgment.
warp.zh: 你不能因为不喜欢她而使自己的判断受到影响。

warrant.en: The magistrate issued a warrant for his arrest.
warrant.zh: 地方法官发出了对他的逮捕令。

warrant.en: The company issued warrants for 300,000 shares.

warranty.en: The car is still under warranty.
warranty.zh: 这辆汽车还在保修期内。

wartime.en: Even in wartime some people held concerts.
wartime.zh: 即使是在战争时期也有人举行音乐会。

wary.en: I’m a bit wary of driving in this fog.
wary.zh: 我有点害怕在这样的雾天开车。

wary.en: We must teach children to be wary of strangers.
wary.zh: 我们一定要教育孩子警惕陌生人。

wash.en: It’s your turn to wash the dishes.

washing.en: I really must do the washing (=wash the dirty clothes).
Could you put the washing out (=hang it on a washing line) for me?
washing.zh: 你能不能帮我把洗好的衣服晾出去？

waste.en: Being unemployed is such a waste of your talents.
waste.zh: 失业简直是浪费了你的才能。

waste.en: Many believe that state aid is a waste of taxpayers’ money.
waste.zh: 许多人认为政府援助是浪费纳税人的钱。

wasteful.en: The software is very wasteful of memory.
Lily had wastefully left the light on.
wasteful.zh: 莉莉让电灯开着，真浪费。

waster.en: All her friends are drunks or wasters.
waster.zh: 她的朋友不是酒鬼就是饭桶。

watch.en: Do you mind if I watch?
We sat and watched the sunset.

watcher.en: Fifteen thousand bird watchers visit annually.
Industry-watchers hailed the takeover as a triumph.
watcher.zh: 行业观察员把这次收购誉为一次巨大的成功。

watchful.en: The entrances are guarded by watchful security staff.
watchful.zh: 入口处由警惕的保安人员把守。

water.en: There’s water all over the bathroom floor.
Does anyone want a drink of water?

waterfront.en: The hotel is down on the waterfront.

waterproof.en: Rub the wax in to make the shoe waterproof.
waterproof.zh: 在鞋子上抹点蜡使其防水。

waterproof.en: Plastic sheeting was used to waterproof the shed.
waterproof.zh: 用了塑料板以防棚子进水。

watershed.en: The 1932 election represented a watershed in American politics.

watertight.en: Lucky for him, his alibi is watertight.
watertight.zh: 算他走运，不在犯罪现场的证据无懈可击。

watertight.en: Unless the ban is watertight, EU laws will overturn it.
watertight.zh: 这条禁令除非是十分严密，否则会被欧盟法律推翻。

watery.en: Her eyes were red and watery from crying.
watery.zh: 她的眼睛哭得红红的，眼里含满泪水。

watery.en: Snakes lay eggs in a watery environment.
watery.zh: 蛇在潮湿的环境里产卵。

wave.en: Dee watched the waves breaking on the shore.
wave.zh: 迪伊凝视着拍岸的波涛。

wave.en: The ship tipped over, and finally vanished beneath the waves.
wave.zh: 船倾覆了，最终沉没在海浪之下。

wavelength.en: Dad is just on a different wavelength from me.
wavelength.zh: 爸爸和我就是没有共同语言。

waver.en: The students’ attention did not waver.

wax.en: Journalists wax lyrical about the band.
wax.zh: 新闻记者盛赞那支乐队。

wax.en: Interest in the show has waxed and waned.
wax.zh: 人们对这个节目曾经颇有兴趣，现已热情不再。

way.en: There are several different ways we can tackle this problem.
way.zh: 我们可以用几种不同的方法处理这个问题。

way.en: Evening classes are one way of meeting new people.
way.zh: 上夜校是认识新朋友的一个渠道。

we.en: Shall we stop for a coffee?
we.zh: 我们停下来喝杯咖啡好吗？

we.en: So we all travelled down to Brighton together.
we.zh: 所以我们一起都去了布赖顿。

weak.en: The illness left her feeling weak.
weak.zh: 疾病使她感到身体虚弱。
光照不足，植物就生长不好。

weaken.en: Over the last two years the president’s position has weakened.
weaken.zh: 过去两年来，总统的地位被削弱了。

weaken.en: Changes in policy have weakened the power of the trade unions.
weaken.zh: 政策的变化削弱了工会的力量。

weakness.en: The legislation has a fundamental weakness.
weakness.zh: 这项立法有一个根本性缺陷。

weakness.en: The plan has strengths and weaknesses.
weakness.zh: 这个计划既有优点又有缺点。

wealth.en: The country’s wealth comes from its oil.
wealth.zh: 这个国家的财富来自石油。

wealth.en: The purpose of industry is to create wealth.
wealth.zh: 工业的目的就是创造财富。

wealthy.en: He left as a poor, working class boy and returned as a wealthy man.
wealthy.zh: 他走的时候是一个工人阶层的穷小子，回来时已经是一个腰缠万贯的富翁了。

wean.en: It’s time to start weaning her onto solid foods.
wean.zh: 该让她断奶吃固体食物了。

wean.en: I was weaned on a diet of Hollywood fantasy.
wean.zh: 我自幼深受好莱坞梦的影响。

weapon.en: They all had sticks which they planned to use as weapons.
weapon.zh: 他们都持有棍棒，打算当武器用。

weapon.en: Right now, she felt the need of every weapon in her armoury (=weapon that she had), including surprise.
weapon.zh: 此时此刻，她觉得有必要采取一切可以采用的手段，包括突然袭击。

wear.en: Susanna was wearing a black silk dress.
wear.zh: 苏珊娜穿着一条黑色真丝连衣裙。

wearer.en: Bicycle helmets offer wearers protection against head injury.
wearer.zh: 自行车头盔可以保护骑车者头部免受伤害。

weary.en: She found Rachel in the kitchen, looking old and weary.
weary.zh: 她发现雷切尔在厨房里，看上去苍老而疲惫。

weary.en: She sat down with a weary sigh.
weary.zh: 她疲倦地叹口气坐了下来。

weave.en: Only a few of the women still weave.
weave.zh: 只有数量很少的妇女还在编织。

weave.en: She weaves a complicated plot of romance and intrigue.
weave.zh: 她编织了一套爱情与阴谋交织的复杂情节。

web.en: He watched a spider spinning its web.

webcast.en: Various local news sites plan to webcast each of the mayoral debates.
webcast.zh: 当地各家新闻网站都计划在网上直播市长竞选的每一场辩论。

website.en: For more information on weight loss and healthy eating, visit our website.
website.zh: 有关减肥和健康饮食的更多信息，请访问我们的网站。

website.en: Responses will be posted (=put) on the website.

wedding.en: She’s busy planning her daughter’s wedding.
wedding.zh: 她正忙着筹备女儿的婚礼。

wedge.en: Their divorce has driven a wedge between the two families.
wedge.zh: 他们的离婚造成双方家庭闹翻。

wednesday.en: We can go Wednesday. American English

wee.en: She looked a wee bit confused.

weed.en: Nigel’s such a weed, isn’t he?
weed.zh: 奈杰尔真懦弱，是不是啊？

weed.en: Cars clogged the roads like weeds.

week.en: Letters were delivered twice a week only.
week.zh: 信件一星期只递送两次。

week.en: I can’t see you this week.

weekend.en: Are you doing anything nice this weekend?
weekend.zh: 这个周末你有什么好的安排？

weekend.en: I never work at the weekend.

weep.zh: 詹姆斯控制不住感情，哭了起来。

weep.en: She wept for the loss of her mother.

weigh.en: The young birds weigh only a few grams.
Do you know how much it weighs?

weight.en: The average weight of a baby at birth is just over seven pounds.
weight.zh: 婴儿的平均出生体重是七磅多一点。

weight.en: Fruit and vegetables are sold by weight.
weight.zh: 水果和蔬菜是称重出售的。

weird.en: A really weird thing happened last night.
weird.zh: 昨晚发生了一件非常奇怪的事。

welcome.en: Welcome back – it’s good to see you again.
I had the feeling I wasn’t really welcome.
welcome.zh: 我感觉到我其实不受欢迎。

weld.en: The new handle will have to be welded on.
His job is now to weld the players into a single team.
weld.zh: 他现在的任务是要把这些队员团结起来，打造成一个整体。

welfare.en: Our only concern is the children’s welfare.
welfare.zh: 我们唯一关心的是孩子们的幸福。

welfare.en: The company’s welfare officer deals with employees’ personal problems.
welfare.zh: 公司负责福利的工作人员处理雇员的个人问题。

well.en: James reads quite well for his age.
well.zh: 就詹姆斯的年龄来说，他的阅读能力算不错了。

well-being.en: We are responsible for the care and well-being of all our patients.
well-being.zh: 我们承担所有病人的护理工作，并对他们的健康负责。

well-being.en: A good meal promotes a feeling of well-being.
well-being.zh: 一顿美食能增强幸福感。

well-known.en: It’s a well-known fact that smoking can cause lung cancer.
well-known.zh: 抽烟会引起肺癌，这是一个众所周知的事实。

well-known.en: This is probably their best-known song.
well-known.zh: 这可能是他们最有名的歌曲。

well-off.en: Many pensioners are less well-off (=have less money) than they used to be.
well-off.zh: 许多退休人员生活都不如以前优裕了。

well-off.en: We’re well-off for public transport here.
well-off.zh: 我们这里公共交通发达。

west.en: A damp wind blew from the west.
west.zh: 从西面吹来一股潮湿的风。

west.en: There’s a slight chance of some sunshine in the west.
west.zh: 西部地区见晴的可能性不大。

westward.en: The ship turned westward, away from the coast.
westward.zh: 船调转方向离开海岸，向西驶去。

wet.en: I’ve washed your shirt but it’s still wet.
wet.zh: 我把你的衬衫洗过了，不过现在还是湿的。

wet.en: Take an umbrella or you’ll get wet.
wet.zh: 带把雨伞，不然你会被淋湿的。

what.en: What subjects did you enjoy most?

whatever.en: Help yourself to whatever you want.
The children were allowed to do whatever they liked.
whatever.zh: 孩子们可以想干什么就干什么。

wheel.en: The car slid sideways, its rear wheels spinning.
wheel.zh: 汽车向一侧打滑，后轮猛转。

wheel.en: The driver must have fallen asleep at the wheel.
wheel.zh: 司机一定是在开车时睡着了。

when.en: When did you first meet Dr Darnall?
when.zh: 你是什么时候认识达纳尔博士的？

whence.en: I walked to Rainbagh, whence I could complete the journey by car.
whence.zh: 我步行至雷恩巴夫，从那里我可以开车走完全程。

whenever.en: Larry always blames me whenever anything goes wrong.
whenever.zh: 每每有什么事情出现问题，拉里总是责怪我。

whenever.en: Whenever I hear that tune, it makes me think of you.
whenever.zh: 每当听到那曲子，我就会想起你。

whereabouts.en: He showed great reluctance to reveal his whereabouts.
whereabouts.zh: 他极不愿意说出他的行踪。

whereas.en: The old system was fairly complicated whereas the new system is really very simple.
whereas.zh: 旧系统相当复杂，而新系统却很简单。

whereas.en: Whereas the city spent over $1 billion on its museums and stadium, it failed to look after its schools.
whereas.zh: 这个城市花了十亿美元建造博物馆和体育馆，但是却忽略了对学校的建设。

wherein.en: Wherein lies the difference between conservatism and liberalism?
wherein.zh: 保守主义与自由主义区别何在？

wherever.en: Children will play wherever they happen to be.
wherever.zh: 小孩子走到哪里玩到哪里。

whether.en: Maurice asked me whether I needed any help.
whether.zh: 莫里斯问我是否需要帮助。

whether.en: There were times when I wondered whether or not we would get there.
whether.zh: 有时候我也想知道我们能不能做得到。

which.en: Which book are you looking for?
Which are the most important crops?
which.zh: 哪些农作物是最重要的？

whichever.en: It will be a difficult operation, whichever method you choose.
whichever.zh: 不管你选择哪种方法，手术都会很复杂。

whichever.en: Whichever way you look at it, things are pretty bad.
whichever.zh: 不管你怎么看，情况都相当糟。

while.en: They arrived while we were having dinner.
while.zh: 他们来时我们正在吃饭。

while.en: While she was asleep, thieves broke in and stole her handbag.
while.zh: 她睡着的时候，小偷闯进来偷走了她的手提包。

whim.en: I didn’t leave just on a whim (=for no good reason).
whim.zh: 我不是一时心血来潮离开的。

whim.en: At work they are at the whim of the boss.
whim.zh: 工作中他们要配合老板的步调行事。

whip.en: He whipped the horse into a canter.
whip.zh: 他抽了一下鞭子，马儿就小跑起来。

whip.en: The wind whipped her hair into her eyes.
whip.zh: 风把她的头发吹进了眼睛里。

whirl.en: We watched the seagulls whirling and shrieking over the harbour.
whirl.zh: 我们看海鸥在港口上空盘旋鸣叫。

whirl.en: She whirled around and her look shook him.
whirl.zh: 她猛地转身，脸上的表情让他震惊。

whisker.en: Schmidt finished second, losing by a whisker in the final event.
whisker.zh: 施密特在最后的项目中以微弱差距落败，屈居第二。

whisker.en: Doctors say he came within a whisker of dying on the operating table.
whisker.zh: 医生们说他险些死在手术台上。

whisper.en: You don’t have to whisper, no one can hear us.
whisper.zh: 你不必轻声轻语，没人听得到我们说话。

whisper.en: What are you two whispering about over there?
whisper.zh: 你们两人在那边嘀咕什么？

whistle.en: Adam whistled happily on his way to work.
whistle.zh: 亚当在上班路上愉快地吹着口哨。

whistle.en: I heard this song on the radio and I’ve been whistling it all day.
whistle.zh: 我在收音机里听到这首歌，就吹了一整天这个调子的口哨。

white.en: Are you OK? You’re white as a sheet (=extremely pale).
Her voice shook, and her face was white with anger.
white.zh: 她气得声音颤抖，脸色发白。

whitewash.en: The official report into the cause of the fire was labeled a whitewash.
whitewash.zh: 官方的火灾原因报告被说成是对真相的隐瞒。

whitewash.en: The walls were whitewashed and covered with bullfighting posters.
whitewash.zh: 墙壁粉刷过后贴满了斗牛比赛的海报。

whittle.en: We need to whittle down the list of guests for the party.
whittle.zh: 我们需要缩减聚会的客人名单。

whittle.en: The museum is worried that government funding will be whittled away.
whittle.zh: 博物馆担心政府拨款将会被削减。

whoever.en: I’ll take whoever wants to go.
When you’re done with the book, just give it to Kristin or Shelley or whoever.
whoever.zh: 你看完书以后，就给克里斯廷或谢利，或者随便谁都行。

whole.en: You have your whole life ahead of you!

whole.zh: 他的整个态度都让我讨厌。

wholesale.en: This company will not be successful until there are wholesale changes.
wholesale.zh: 如不作出大规模变革，这家公司不会有所作为。

wholesale.en: I can get it for you wholesale.
wholesale.zh: 我能以批发价为你买到它。

wholly.en: The report claimed that the disaster was wholly unavoidable.
wholly.zh: 报告称这场灾难完全无法避免。

whom.en: Desperate for money, she called her sister, whom she hadn’t spoken to in 20 years.
whom.zh: 因为急需用钱，她就给姐姐打了电话，她们已经20

whom.en: She brought with her three friends, none of whom I had ever met before.
whom.zh: 她带来三个朋友，没有一个是我以前见过的。

whose.en: That’s the man whose house has burned down.
whose.zh: 就是那个男人的房子被烧毁了。

why.en: Why do we have to take all these tests?
why.zh: 我们为什么一定要参加这些测验？

wicked.en: Carl had a wicked grin on his face as he crept up behind Ellen.
wicked.zh: 卡尔一脸坏笑地悄悄走到埃伦后面。

wicked.en: Tara hasn’t lost her wicked sense of humour.
wicked.zh: 塔拉那促狭的幽默感依然未减。

wide.en: As he ran toward me, his face broke into a wide grin.
wide.zh: 他笑逐颜开地向我跑来。

widely.en: Organic food is now widely available.
widely.zh: 现在有机食品很多地方都可买到。

widely.en: These laws were widely regarded as too strict.
widely.zh: 人们普遍认为这些法令太苛刻。

widen.zh: 这条河有变宽的河段，也有分流的河段。

widespread.en: There was widespread support for the war.
widespread.zh: 人们普遍支持这场战争。
暴风雨造成了大范围的破坏。

width.en: What’s the width of the desk?
width.zh: 这张书桌的宽度是多少？

width.en: It’s about six metres in width.

wield.en: The Church wields immense power in Ireland.
wield.zh: 在爱尔兰，教会操纵着大权。

wield.en: She had her car windows smashed by a gang wielding baseball bats.
wield.zh: 她的车窗被一伙挥舞棒球棒的人砸碎了。

wife.en: He threatened to kill his ex-wife’s boyfriend.
wife.zh: 他威胁要杀死前妻的男朋友。

wild.en: Nepal is stunning, with its wild, untamed landscape.
wild.zh: 尼泊尔有着自然原始的风景，美不胜收。

wilderness.en: The south side of the city had become a lawless wilderness.
wilderness.zh: 这座城市的南部已成为法外之地。

will.en: A meeting will be held next Tuesday at 3 p.m.

willing.en: How much are they willing to pay?
I told them I was perfectly willing to help.
willing.zh: 我告诉他们，我非常愿意帮忙。

willpower.en: It took all his willpower to remain calm.
willpower.zh: 他竭尽全力才保持了镇定。

win.en: Who do you think will win the next election?
win.zh: 你认为谁会在下一次竞选中获胜？

win.en: He won the Tour de France last year.
win.zh: 去年他在环法自行车大赛中获胜。

wind.en: The wind blew from the northeast.
Planes were unable to take off because of high winds.

window.en: Do you mind if I open the window?
She looked out of the window to see if it was raining.
window.zh: 她朝窗外望去，看是否下雨了。

windy.en: It’s too windy for a picnic.

wing.en: The pheasant flapped its wings vigorously.
She works in the hospital’s maternity wing.
wing.zh: 她在医院的产科病房工作。

wink.zh: 他顽皮地朝埃丽卡眨了眨眼。

wink.en: He winked an eye at his companion.

winner.en: Five lucky winners will each receive a signed copy of the album.
winner.zh: 五位幸运的获胜者每人将得到一张签名专辑。

winner.en: As a jockey he rode 10 winners.
winner.zh: 作为骑师他曾十度驾驭获胜赛马。

winter.en: It usually snows here in the winter.

wintertime.en: The hills look very bleak in wintertime.
wintertime.zh: 冬季这些山坡看上去很荒凉。

wipe.en: Wipe the table with a damp cloth.
Bill wiped his eyes (=wiped the tears from his face) and apologized.

wire.en: The game was very close and went right down to the wire.
wire.zh: 比赛竞争非常激烈，直到最后才见分晓。

wisdom.en: Local people are questioning the wisdom of spending so much money on a new road.
wisdom.zh: 当地人在质疑花这么多钱修建一条新路是否明智。

wisdom.en: You can always expect a few words of wisdom from Dave.
wisdom.zh: 戴夫总能冒出几句至理名言。

wise.en: It’s wise to check whether the flight times have changed before you leave for the airport.
wise.zh: 出发去机场之前核实一下航班时间是否有变化，这是明智的做法。

wise.en: I think you were wise to leave when you did.
wise.zh: 我认为你当时走掉很明智。

wish.en: I wish to make a complaint.
If you wish to discuss this matter further please do not hesitate to contact me.
wish.zh: 如果你想进一步讨论此事，请尽管和我联系。

wit.en: His sharp wit had them all smiling.
wit.zh: 他的机智诙谐让他们一个个都露出了笑脸。

wit.en: Alone and penniless, I was forced to live on my wits.
wit.zh: 孤身一人又身无分文，我只得靠我的机智来过活。

with.en: I saw Bob in town with his girlfriend.
with.zh: 我看到鲍勃与他的女朋友一起在镇上。

with.en: Put this bag with the others.
with.zh: 把这个包和其他的包放在一起。

withdraw.en: A knee injury forced her to withdraw from the competition.
withdraw.zh: 膝伤使她不得不退出了比赛。

withdraw.en: Parents have the right to withdraw their children from religious education lessons if they wish.
withdraw.zh: 家长如有意愿，则有权让自己的孩子退出宗教教育课。

withdrawal.en: Customers can use the machine to make withdrawals of up to £250 a day.
withdrawal.zh: 客户每天最多可以用取款机提取250

wither.zh: 他的职业生涯已每况愈下。

withhold.en: I withheld payment until they had completed the work.
withhold.zh: 我扣着钱，直到他们完工。

withhold.en: Ian was accused of withholding vital information from the police.
withhold.zh: 伊恩被控向警方隐瞒重要信息。

within.en: We should have the test results back within 24 hours.
He fell sick and died within a matter of weeks.
within.zh: 他病倒了，不出几星期就死了。

without.en: After the storm we were without electricity for five days.
without.zh: 暴风雨之后我们断电了五天。

without.en: We passed two ruined abbeys, one with a tower and one without.
without.zh: 我们路过两座破落的寺院，一座有塔楼，另一座没有。

withstand.en: This fabric can withstand steam and high temperatures.
withstand.zh: 这种织物耐蒸汽和高温。

withstand.en: The Chancellor has withstood the criticism and held firm.
withstand.zh: 总理顶住批评，坚持立场。

witness.en: Police have appealed for witnesses to come forward.
witness.zh: 警方呼吁目击者站出来。

witness.en: One witness to the accident said the driver appeared to be drunk.
witness.zh: 事故的一名目击者说司机似乎喝醉了。

woe.en: Woe betide anyone who smokes in our house!
woe.zh: 谁在我们房子里抽烟谁倒霉！

wolf.en: I work part-time in a coffee shop just to keep the wolf from the door.
wolf.zh: 我在一家咖啡馆打零工，勉强糊口。

woman.en: I was talking to a woman I met on the flight.
woman.zh: 我正和一个在飞机上认识的女子交谈。

woman.en: When a woman is pregnant, the levels of hormones in her body change.
woman.zh: 女人怀孕时，体内的荷尔蒙水平会发生变化。

wonder.en: I wonder how James is getting on.
wonder.zh: 我想知道詹姆斯的近况。

wonder.en: What are they going to do now, I wonder?
wonder.zh: 我想知道，他们现在打算怎么办呢？

wonderful.en: We had a wonderful time in Spain.
wonderful.zh: 我们在西班牙玩得非常开心。

wonderful.en: It’s wonderful what doctors can do nowadays.
wonderful.zh: 如今医生的本领着实令人称奇。

wonderfully.en: All of the performers played wonderfully.
wonderfully.zh: 所有演员都表演得非常精彩。

wood.en: Put some more wood on the fire.
Her house was made of wood.
wood.zh: 她家的房子是木头盖的。

word.en: Write an essay of about five hundred words.

work.en: Many young people in the area have never worked.
work.zh: 该地区的许多年轻人从未工作过。

workday.en: He commutes three hours on workdays.
workday.zh: 他每天上下班往返要花三小时。

worker.en: There is a shortage of skilled workers.
Some ex-miners now had jobs as unskilled workers in factories.
worker.zh: 一些过去当过矿工的人现在在工厂里做非技术工人的工作。

workforce.en: Women now represent almost 50% of the workforce.
workforce.zh: 如今女性几乎占全部劳动人口的 50%

workforce.en: The company is cutting its workforce.

working.en: Many working women rely on relatives for childcare.
working.zh: 许多在职妇女靠亲戚照看孩子。

working.en: A smaller working population will have to support a growing number of retired people.
working.zh: 缩减的劳动人口将不得不供养越来越多的退休人员。

workshop.en: They held a number of music workshops and seminars.
workshop.zh: 他们多次组织音乐研习班和研讨会。

world.en: Tuberculosis is still common in some parts of the world.
world.zh: 结核病在世界上某些地区仍很常见。

world.en: At that time China was the most powerful country in the world.
world.zh: 当时中国是世界上最强大的国家。

worldwide.en: We have offices in over 56 countries worldwide.

worm.en: He wormed his way under the fence.
worm.zh: 他吃力地从栅栏下钻过。

worm.en: Steve wormed his way out of going to the meeting.
worm.zh: 史蒂夫找借口不去开会。

worried.en: She gave me a worried look.
I’m really worried about my brother.

worry.en: You’ve really got no need to worry about your weight.
worry.zh: 你真的不必担心你的体重。

worse.en: The violence was worse than we expected.
worse.zh: 暴力事件比我们预想的更为严重。

worse.en: The traffic is much worse after five o'clock.

worsen.en: A lot of teachers expect the situation to worsen over the next few years.
worsen.zh: 许多老师认为接下来的几年情形会更糟。

worsen.en: Interfering now could worsen the problem.
worsen.zh: 目前介入可能会使问题更严重。

worship.en: They all worship the same god.

worst.en: This is the worst recession for fifty years.
My worst fear was that we would run out of food.
worst.zh: 我最大的担忧是我们会把食物吃光。

worth.en: The house must be worth quite a lot of money now.
worth.zh: 这房子现在一定值大钱了。

worth.en: One of the pictures is worth £50,000.

worthless.en: The house was full of worthless junk.
worthless.zh: 这房子里堆满了没有用的东西。

worthless.en: The information was worthless to me.
worthless.zh: 这些资料对我毫无用处。

worthwhile.en: He wanted to do a worthwhile job.
We decided to give the money to a worthwhile cause (=one that helps people).
worthwhile.zh: 我们决定把这笔钱投入到慈善事业中。

worthy.en: Leeds United were worthy winners of the competition.
worthy.zh: 利兹联队是比赛当之无愧的获胜者。

worthy.en: A couple of other books are worthy of mention.
worthy.zh: 还有一些其他的书值得一提。

would.en: They said they would meet us at 10.30 at the station.
She said she wouldn’t be coming to the library anymore.
would.zh: 她说她再也不会到图书馆来了。

wound.en: A nurse cleaned and bandaged the wound.
wound.zh: 护士把伤口清洗包扎好。

wound.en: It took several months for his wounds to heal.
wound.zh: 他的伤口几个月后才愈合。

wounded.en: It was only wounded pride that stopped him from apologizing.
wounded.zh: 他只是因为伤了自尊而不愿道歉。

wrap.en: The present was beautifully wrapped in gold paper.
wrap.zh: 礼物用金色包装纸包着，很漂亮。

wrap.en: Ella wrapped a thick coat around her shoulders.
wrap.zh: 埃拉肩上围了一件厚外套。

wrapping.en: I finally managed to get the plastic wrapping off.
wrapping.zh: 我终于去掉了塑料包装。

wrath.en: He was scared of incurring his father’s wrath.
wrath.zh: 他害怕惹他父亲大发脾气。

wreath.en: The prime minister laid a wreath at the war memorial.
wreath.zh: 首相向战争纪念碑献了花圈。

wreathe.en: The mountains were wreathed in mist.
His plump face was wreathed in smiles.
wreathe.zh: 他胖乎乎的脸上乐开了花。

wreck.en: Injury threatened to wreck his sporting career.
wreck.zh: 伤病可能会毁了他的运动生涯。

wreck.en: It was drink that wrecked their marriage.

wreckage.en: Firemen managed to pull some survivors from the wreckage.
wreckage.zh: 消防队员设法从残骸中拖出了几名幸存者。

wreckage.en: Accident investigators will examine the wreckage of the plane.
wreckage.zh: 事故调查人员将检查飞机残骸。

wrench.en: I wrenched the packet from his grasp.
wrench.zh: 我用力夺过他攥在手里的纸袋。

wrench.en: The door had been wrenched open.

wrestle.en: The two men wrestled with each other.
Police officers wrestled him to the ground.

wretched.en: Guy felt wretched about it now.
wretched.zh: 现在盖伊对那件事觉得很愧疚。
那个可恶的男孩在哪里？

wring.en: They are always trying to wring additional funds from the government.
wring.zh: 他们总想从政府手中搞到更多的资金。

wring.en: I managed to wring the information out of him.
wring.zh: 我想法从他那里弄到了这些信息。

wrinkle.en: Her face was a mass of wrinkles.
She walked over to the bed and smoothed out the wrinkles.

wrist.en: She had a gold watch on her wrist.

write.en: He wrote some very famous books.
write.zh: 他写过一些很有名的书。

writer.en: She’s one of my favourite writers.
writer.zh: 她是我最喜欢的作家之一。

writer.en: He’s always been a sloppy writer.

writhe.zh: 他躺着，痛得身体直扭动。

writing.en: What does the writing on the back say?
Some of his most powerful writing is based on his childhood experiences.
writing.zh: 他的一些最震慑人心的作品是根据儿时经历写成的。

written.en: Please send a cheque with written confirmation of your booking.
written.zh: 请寄支票，并附预订的书面确认。

wrong.en: I think I got question 3 wrong.

wrongly.en: Matthew was wrongly diagnosed as having a brain tumour.
His name had been wrongly spelt.

x-ray.en: The X-ray showed that her leg was not broken.
I had to go to hospital for an X-ray.

yard.en: The kids were playing in the back yard.

yardstick.en: Profit is the most important yardstick of success for any business.
yardstick.zh: 利润是衡量任何企业成功与否的最重要标杆。

yardstick.en: These subjects are used as a yardstick against which to measure the children’s progress.
yardstick.zh: 这些学科被用作衡量孩子学习进步的标尺。

yarn.en: The old captain would often spin (=tell) us a yarn about life aboard ship.
yarn.zh: 老船长经常会给我们讲一些船上生活的奇闻轶事。

yawn.zh: 艾伦伸伸懒腰，打了个呵欠。

yawn.en: The pit yawned open in front of them.
yawn.zh: 那深坑张着大口呈现在他们面前。

year.en: I arrived here two years ago.
We’ve known each other for over a year.

yearly.en: Salary levels are reviewed on a yearly basis.
yearly.zh: 工资水平每年都要审查。

yearly.en: The magazine is issued twice yearly (=two times a year).
yearly.zh: 这本杂志一年发行两期。

yearn.en: Phil had yearned to be a pilot from an early age.
yearn.zh: 菲尔从小就渴望成为一名飞行员。

yell.en: The crowd are on their feet yelling.

yellow.en: Yellow doesn’t suit me at all.
The room was decorated in a variety of reds, blues, and yellows.
yellow.zh: 房间以深浅不一的红色、蓝色和黄色装饰。

yelp.en: The water was hotter than she had expected, and she gave an involuntary yelp.
yelp.zh: 水比她料想的要烫，她不由自主地叫了一声。

yelp.en: The dog ran up and down, yelping.
yelp.zh: 那只狗跑来跑去，叫个不停。

yes.en: He proposed to me and I said yes.
Yes sir, how can I help you?
yes.zh: 是，先生，我能为您做些什么？

yet.en: I haven’t asked him yet (=but I will).

yield.en: Our research has only recently begun to yield important results.
yield.zh: 直到最近我们的研究才开始取得重要成果。

yield.en: Each of these oilfields could yield billions of barrels of oil.
yield.zh: 这些油田每一座都能开采出数十亿桶原油。

yoke.en: Beauty is forever yoked to youth in our culture.
yoke.zh: 在我们的文化中，美丽总是和青春分不开。

you.zh: 你们大家都必须仔细听着。

young.en: You’re too young to get married.

your.zh: 你能把你的车挪一下吗？

your.en: Is that your brother over there?

yours.en: This is our room, and yours is just across the hall.
yours.zh: 这是我们的房间，你们的在走廊那边。

yours.en: A lot of people have money problems, but yours are more serious than most people’s.
yours.zh: 许多人有财务问题，不过你的问题比大多数人的要严重。

yourself.en: Look at yourself in the mirror.
Come and warm yourselves by the fire.

youth.en: Many of these people had used drugs in their youth.
youth.zh: 这些人中有许多人年轻时吸过毒。

youth.en: They were friends when they were young.
youth.zh: 他们年轻的时候是朋友。

youthful.en: She has managed to maintain her youthful appearance.
The photo shows a smiling, youthful Burgos.
youthful.zh: 照片上是一个面带微笑、青春洋溢的布尔戈斯。

zeal.en: He approached the job with missionary zeal.
zeal.zh: 他以极大的热忱对待这份工作。

zeal.en: In their zeal to catch drug dealers, police have ignored citizens’ basic civil rights.
zeal.zh: 警方抓捕毒贩心切，却忽略了市民基本的公民权利。

zealous.en: No one was more zealous than Neil in supporting the proposal.
zealous.zh: 没有人比尼尔更热心地支持这项提议。

zero.en: Make x greater than or equal to zero.
The petrol gauge was already at zero.

zest.en: She had a great zest for life.
zest.zh: 她对生活有极大的热情。

zest.en: The danger of being caught added a certain zest to the affair.
zest.zh: 被捉奸的危险为这件风流韵事增添了一些刺激性。

zigzag.en: The path zigzagged down the hillside.
zigzag.zh: 小路沿着山坡蜿蜒而下。

zip.en: The zip on my skirt had broken.
Your zip’s undone at the back.

zone.en: San Francisco and Tokyo are both located in earthquake zones.
zone.zh: 旧金山和东京都位于地震带。

zone.en: The government has set up a special economic zone to promote private enterprise.
zone.zh: 政府设立了一个经济特区来推动私营企业的发展。

zoom.en: Brenda jumped in the car and zoomed off.
zoom.zh: 布伦达跳上汽车，疾驰而去。

zoom.en: The work was really easy and I was able to zoom through it in a couple of hours.
zoom.zh: 这工作容易得很，我两三个小时就干完了。

an.en: I got an A in French.
Julia got straight A’s (=all A’s) in high school.
an.zh: 朱莉娅读中学时成绩全部是A

abandonment.en: How could she abandon her own child?
abandonment.zh: 她怎么能抛弃自己的孩子呢？

abandonment.en: We had to abandon the car and walk the rest of the way.
abandonment.zh: 我们只好弃车，步行走完剩下的路。

abridge.en: The abridged edition was published in 1988.

abrogation.en: Both governments voted to abrogate the treaty.
abrogation.zh: 两国政府均投票通过废除这项条约。

abruptness.en: The bus came to an abrupt halt.
abruptness.zh: 公共汽车突然停了下来。

abruptness.en: Sorry, I didn’t mean to be so abrupt.
abruptness.zh: 对不起，我不是故意这样无礼的。

absurdity.en: It seems quite absurd to expect anyone to drive for 3 hours just for a 20-minute meeting.

absurdity.zh: 这似乎是个荒唐的想法。

accessibility.en: The island is only accessible by boat.
accessibility.zh: 这个岛只有坐船才能到。

accessibility.en: There is a church which is easily accessible from my home.

according.en: He decided to go of his own accord.
The door seemed to move of its own accord.

accounting.en: He was too shocked to give an account of what had happened.
accounting.zh: 他因受惊过度而无法描述所发生的事情。

accounting.en: Chomsky’s account of how children learn their first language
accounting.zh: 乔姆斯基关于儿童如何学习第一语言的描述

accountability.en: The government should be accountable to all the people of the country.
accountability.zh: 政府应当对全体国民负责。

accountability.en: Managers must be accountable for their decisions.
accountability.zh: 管理人员必须对自己作出的决定负责。

accrued.en: Interest will accrue until payment is made.
accrued.zh: 利息将会累计增加，直至付清款项。

accumulation.en: It is unjust that a privileged few should continue to accumulate wealth.
accumulation.zh: 少数特权阶级继续积聚财富，这是不公平的。

accumulation.en: Fat tends to accumulate around the hips and thighs.
accumulation.zh: 脂肪常常积聚在臀部和大腿部位。

accurately.en: The brochure tries to give a fair and accurate description of each hotel.
accurately.zh: 该手册尽量公正、准确地介绍每一家酒店。

accurately.en: Police believe Derek gave a reasonably accurate account of what happened.
accurately.zh: 警方相信德里克对事情的叙述是比较准确的。

aching.en: His feet were aching from standing so long.
aching.zh: 他站了那么久，双脚隐隐作痛。

achievable.en: She eventually achieved her goal of becoming a professor.
achievable.zh: 她终于实现目标，当上了教授。

achievable.en: Wilson has achieved considerable success as an artist.
achievable.zh: 威尔逊作为一名艺术家成就斐然。

acidity.en: I was expecting another of his acid remarks, but he remained silent.
acidity.zh: 我等着他再说一句刻薄的话，但他不吭声了。

acidity.en: People ask if the team is good enough. This match will be the acid test.
acidity.zh: 人们问这支球队是不是够好，经过这场比赛的考验就可见分晓。

acknowledgment.en: We want an acknowledgement of the existence of the problem.
acknowledgment.zh: 我们希望这问题的存在能够得到承认。

acknowledgment.en: The reduction in their grant is an acknowledgement that they have been paid too much.
acknowledgment.zh: 减少对他们的拨款就是承认他们拿得太多了。

acting.en: The new president’s first act should be to end the war.
acting.zh: 新总统的第一步行动应当是结束战争。

acting.en: The act of writing a list can help to calm you down.
acting.zh: 列清单可以帮助你冷静下来。

actively.en: She’s over 80, but is still very active.
My father always led a very active life.
actively.zh: 我父亲一直过着忙忙碌碌的生活。

adaptability.en: The American Constitution has proved adaptable in changing political conditions.
adaptability.zh: 事实证明美国宪法能适应政治形势的变化。

adaptability.en: The catfish is adaptable to a wide range of water conditions.
adaptability.zh: 鲶鱼能适应很多种水环境。

adequacy.en: Farmers have been slow to make adequate provision for their retirement.
adequacy.zh: 农民们迟迟没有为退休做好适当安排。

adequacy.en: Some creams we tested failed to give adequate protection against UV light.
adequacy.zh: 我们检测的有些防晒霜不能提供足够的防紫外线保护。

adequately.en: Farmers have been slow to make adequate provision for their retirement.
adequately.zh: 农民们迟迟没有为退休做好适当安排。

adequately.en: Some creams we tested failed to give adequate protection against UV light.
adequately.zh: 我们检测的有些防晒霜不能提供足够的防紫外线保护。

adrenaline.en: There’s nothing like a good horror film to get the adrenalin going (=make you feel nervously excited).
adrenaline.zh: 好的恐怖片最能让人看得血脉偾张。

advantageously.en: He was now in a more advantageous position.

adversely.en: They fear it could have an adverse effect on global financial markets.
adversely.zh: 他们担心这会对全球金融市场产生不利影响。

adversely.en: Miller’s campaign has received a good deal of adverse publicity.
adversely.zh: 米勒的竞选活动招来许多负面报道。

aesthetically.en: From an esthetic point of view, it’s a nice design.
aesthetically.zh: 从美学角度看，这是个不错的设计。

affirmation.en: The general affirmed rumors of an attack.
affirmation.zh: 将军证实了袭击的传闻。

affirmation.en: A spokesman for the company affirmed that a merger was likely.
affirmation.zh: 该公司的一位发言人证实合并是可能的。

aforesaid.en: The property belongs to the aforementioned Mr Jones.
aforesaid.zh: 该项财产属于前面提到的琼斯先生。

afterward.zh: 过了不多久，查尔斯来了。

afterward.en: The experience haunted me for years afterwards.
afterward.zh: 此后多年，这经历一直困扰着我。

aggravation.en: Their money problems were further aggravated by a rise in interest rates.
aggravation.zh: 由于利率上调，他们的财务问题更加严重。

aggravation.en: Building the new road will only aggravate the situation.
aggravation.zh: 建造那条新路只会使情况恶化。

aggregation.en: The smaller minorities got an aggregate of 1,327 votes.
aggregation.zh: 较小的少数党总共获得1,327

aggregation.en: In the aggregate (=as a group or in total), women outlive men by 7 or more years.
aggregation.zh: 总体来看，女性比男性多活七年或以上。

aggressiveness.en: Teachers apparently expect a certain amount of aggressive behaviour from boys.
aggressiveness.zh: 老师显然料到男孩子多少会有些好勇斗狠的行为。

agility.en: He was physically strong and mentally agile.

agreeably.en: We spent a most agreeable couple of hours.
agreeably.zh: 我们非常愉快地度过了几个小时。

agreeably.en: My parents are quite agreeable to my studying abroad.
agreeably.zh: 我父母很同意我去国外留学。

agricultural.en: More than 75% of the land is used for agriculture.

agriculturalist.en: More than 75% of the land is used for agriculture.

aids.en: Foreign aid from many countries poured into the famine area.
aids.zh: 来自许多国家的救援物资纷纷送到饥荒地区。

aids.en: He has been granted legal aid (=free legal services).

alertness.en: The animal raised its head, suddenly alert.
alertness.zh: 那只动物突然警觉地抬起头来。

alertness.en: Taking notes is one of the best ways to stay alert in lectures.
alertness.zh: 记笔记是听课时集中注意力的最佳方法之一。

alphabetic.en: The files are arranged in alphabetical order.
alphabetic.zh: 这些文件按字母顺序排列。
这些记录是以字母顺序归档的吗？

alphabetically.en: The files are arranged in alphabetical order.
alphabetically.zh: 这些文件按字母顺序排列。
这些记录是以字母顺序归档的吗？

alternation.en: The service runs on alternate days.
alternation.zh: 这个服务机构隔天开放一次。

alternation.en: Arrange the leeks and noodles in alternate layers.
alternation.zh: 一层韭葱、一层面条地交替放置。

amazingly.en: He’s an amazing player to watch.
amazingly.zh: 看他比赛那才叫精彩呢。

amazingly.en: It’s amazing how often you see drivers using mobile phones.
amazingly.zh: 常常看到司机在打手机，真让人难以置信。

amongst.en: The girl quickly disappeared among the crowd.
amongst.zh: 女孩转眼消失在人群中。

amongst.en: I could hear voices coming from somewhere among the bushes.
amongst.zh: 我能听到灌木丛中某个地方传来说话的声音。

amplification.en: These stories only amplified her fears.
amplification.zh: 这些故事徒增了她的恐惧感。

amplification.en: Would you care to amplify that remark?
amplification.zh: 请你把那句话解释一下好吗？

analyze.en: She still needs to analyse the data.
analyze.zh: 她仍需要分析这些数据。

analyze.en: You need to sit down and analyse why you feel so upset.
analyze.zh: 你得坐下来想一想自己为什么会那么生气。

analytic.en: During the course, students will develop their analytical skills.
analytic.zh: 在这门课上，学生的分析能力将得到提高。

ancestral.en: Lions and house cats evolved from a common ancestor (=the same ancestor).
ancestral.zh: 狮子和家猫从共同的原种进化而来。

annually.en: The school trip has become an annual event.
annually.zh: 学校组织的旅行成了一年一度的活动。

annually.en: The jazz festival is held annually in July.
annually.zh: 爵士音乐节每年7月举行。

anxiously.en: He was a bit anxious about the safety of the machinery.
anxiously.zh: 他有点担心机器的安全性。

apologise.en: I’m so sorry, I do apologize.
apologise.zh: 非常对不起，我真心道歉。

apologise.en: I think you should apologize to your brother.
apologise.zh: 我觉得你应该给你弟弟赔个不是。

applicability.en: The offer is only applicable to bookings for double rooms.
applicability.zh: 这个报价只适用于预订双人房。

appreciably.en: There’s no appreciable change in the patient’s condition.
appreciably.zh: 病人的状况没有明显改变。

appreciably.en: The two plans are not appreciably different.
appreciably.zh: 这两个计划没有明显的区别。

appropriately.en: It would not be appropriate for me to discuss that now.
It seemed somehow appropriate that we should begin our journey here.
appropriately.zh: 不知何故，我们从这里出发看来是合适的。

arbitrator.en: A committee will arbitrate between management and unions.
arbitrator.zh: 将由一个委员会来仲裁资方和工会的争端。
这个特别法庭仲裁纠纷。

aridity.en: Water from the Great Lakes is pumped to arid regions.
aridity.zh: 五大湖中的水被输往干旱地区。

aridity.en: My mind was arid, all inspiration gone.

arms.en: He had a tattoo on his left arm.

armory.en: Interest rates have become powerful weapons in the government’s armoury.
armory.zh: 利率已成为政府锦囊中强大的法宝。

arrogantly.zh: 他的傲慢让人无法忍受。

artificially.en: Food prices are being kept artificially low.
artificially.zh: 食品价格正被人为地控制在低水平。

artistically.en: Opinion about the artistic merit of his paintings has been mixed.
artistically.zh: 对于他的绘画作品的艺术价值，人们褒贬不一。

associated.en: I don’t associate him with energetic sports.
associated.zh: 我不会把他和剧烈的体育运动联系在一起。

associated.en: He did not associate himself with the pro-democracy movement.
associated.zh: 他没有表示支持这场拥护民主的运动。

attentively.en: Customers want companies that are attentive to their needs.
attentively.zh: 客户需要的是对其需求考虑周到的公司。

attractively.en: Women seem to find him attractive.
attractively.zh: 女性似乎觉得他很有吸引力。

attractively.en: Kitchen utensils should be attractive as well as functional.
attractively.zh: 厨房用具应该既美观又实用。

attractiveness.en: Women seem to find him attractive.
attractiveness.zh: 女性似乎觉得他很有吸引力。

attractiveness.en: Kitchen utensils should be attractive as well as functional.

modernise.zh: 他们需要更多的资金将本国的电话系统现代化。

modestly.zh: 他对自己在那次珠峰探险中所起的作用总是很谦虚。

modestly.zh: 你太谦虚了！你帮了我们大忙呢。

modified.zh: 这些反馈意见将用于修改明年的课程。

modified.zh: 这些法规只能由特别委员会来修改。

molecular.zh: 氧分子中只有两个原子。

monochromatic.zh: 我们向外面那一片灰蒙蒙的大地望去。

monogamous.zh: 单配偶现象在大多数兽类群体里很少见，但在鸟类中却很常见。

monogamous.zh: 我们生活在一夫一妻制的社会里。

moonlighting.zh: 月光下，水面一片银白色。

moonlighting.en: The hills were bathed in pale moonlight.
moonlighting.zh: 群山沐浴在淡淡的月光中。

moped.zh: 这么美好的一个早晨，你就别躺在那里自怨自艾了！

mold.zh: 另一个方法是把黏土倒入模具中，尤其用于铸造人像。

posthumously.zh: 他被追授军功十字勋章。

postmortem.zh: 尸检表明被害人是被掐死的。

postponement.zh: 比赛不得不推迟到下周举行。

potluck.zh: 我们没有预订酒店，所以只能碰运气。

profoundly.zh: 托尔斯泰的战争经历深刻影响了他的作品。
